text: 这双鞋对我很特别，是朋友送的。
pinyin: zhè shuāng xié duì wǒ hěn tè bié , shì péng you sòng de .
meaning: These shoes are special to me; they were a gift from a friend.

text: 轻
pinyin: qīng
meaning: light in weight

text: 这件衣服很轻，拿着方便。
pinyin: zhè jiàn yī fú hěn qīng , ná zhe fāng biàn .
meaning: This garment is light and easy to carry.

text: 短
pinyin: duǎn
meaning: short in length

text: 绿色的比蓝色的短。
pinyin: lǜ sè de bǐ lán sè de duǎn .
meaning: The green one is shorter than the blue one.

text: 低
pinyin: dī
meaning: low

text: 这双鞋的价格不低。
pinyin: zhè shuāng xié de jià gé bù dī .
meaning: These shoes are not cheap.

text: 鞋
pinyin: xié
meaning: shoe; shoes

text: 鞋要合适，走路才舒服。
pinyin: xié yào hé shì , zǒu lù cái shū fú .
meaning: Shoes should fit so walking is comfortable.

text: 样子
pinyin: yàng zi
meaning: appearance; look

text: 这个样子和平时不一样。
pinyin: zhè gè yàng zi hé píng shí bù yī yàng .
meaning: This look is different from usual.

text: 白色
pinyin: bái sè
meaning: the colour white

text: 白色的衣服洗得干干净净。
pinyin: bái sè de yī fú xǐ de gān gān jìng jìng .
meaning: The white clothes have been washed nice and clean.

text: 开心
pinyin: kāi xīn
meaning: happy

text: 穿得舒服，我很开心。
pinyin: chuān de shū fú , wǒ hěn kāi xīn .
meaning: I am happy when dressed comfortably.

text: 颜色
pinyin: yán sè
meaning: colour

text: 你喜欢什么颜色？
pinyin: nǐ xǐ huān shén me yán sè ?
meaning: What colour do you like?

text: 凉
pinyin: liáng
meaning: cool in temperature

text: 晚上有点凉，带一件衣服。
pinyin: wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , dài yī jiàn yī fú .
meaning: It is a little cool in the evening; bring another layer.

text: 红红的围巾，是朋友送的。
pinyin: hóng hóng de wéi jīn , shì péng you sòng de .
meaning: The red scarf was a gift from a friend.

text: 晚上有点凉，带不太重的衣服。
pinyin: wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , dài bù tài zhòng de yī fú .
meaning: It is a little cool at night; bring clothes that are not too heavy.

text: 绿色的衣服又轻又短。
pinyin: lǜ sè de yī fú yòu qīng yòu duǎn .
meaning: The green garment is both light and short.

text: 黄色那件还没干。
pinyin: huáng sè nà jiàn hái méi gàn .
meaning: The yellow one hasn't dried yet.

text: 千
pinyin: qiān
meaning: thousand

text: 一千是一百的十倍。
pinyin: yī qiān shì yī bǎi de shí bèi .
meaning: One thousand is ten times one hundred.

text: 万
pinyin: wàn
meaning: ten thousand

text: 一万是十个一千，不是一千。
pinyin: yī wàn shì shí gè yī qiān , bù shì yī qiān .
meaning: Ten thousand is ten thousands, not one thousand.

text: 亿
pinyin: yì
meaning: one hundred million

text: 一亿是一万万。
pinyin: yī yì shì yī wàn wàn .
meaning: One hundred million is ten thousand times ten thousand.

text: 一共
pinyin: yī gòng
meaning: altogether

text: 饭和车票一共一百二十块。
pinyin: fàn hé chē piào yī gòng yī bǎi èr shí kuài .
meaning: Food and tickets total one hundred and twenty yuan.

text: 部分
pinyin: bù fèn
meaning: part; portion

text: 车票只是费用的一部分。
pinyin: chē piào zhǐ shì fèi yòng de yī bù fèn .
meaning: Tickets are only part of the cost.

text: 全
pinyin: quán
meaning: all; whole

text: 大家全到了，再算钱。
pinyin: dà jiā quán dào le , zài suàn qián .
meaning: Everyone has arrived; now calculate the costs.

text: 全部
pinyin: quán bù
meaning: all; entire amount

text: 全部费用是一百二十块。
pinyin: quán bù fèi yòng shì yī bǎi èr shí kuài .
meaning: The entire cost is one hundred and twenty yuan.

text: 角
pinyin: jiǎo
meaning: one tenth of a yuan; currency counter

text: 五角是半块钱。
pinyin: wǔ jiǎo shì bàn kuài qián .
meaning: Five jiao is half a yuan.

text: 我们把一百二十块分成三份。
pinyin: wǒ men bǎ yī bǎi èr shí kuài fēn chéng sān fèn .
meaning: We divide one hundred and twenty yuan into three portions.

text: 斤
pinyin: jīn
meaning: half kilogram; weight unit

text: 两斤是一公斤。
pinyin: liǎng jīn shì yī gōng jīn .
meaning: Two jin equal one kilogram.

text: 公斤
pinyin: gōng jīn
meaning: kilogram

text: 我们买一公斤水果。
pinyin: wǒ men mǎi yī gōng jīn shuǐ guǒ .
meaning: We buy one kilogram of fruit.

text: 卖
pinyin: mài
meaning: to sell

text: 这家店卖水果，也卖水。
pinyin: zhè jiā diàn mài shuǐ guǒ , yě mài shuǐ .
meaning: This shop sells fruit and water.

text: 数
pinyin: shǔ
meaning: to count

text: 你数人数，我算钱。
pinyin: nǐ shǔ rén shù , wǒ suàn qián .
meaning: You count people; I will calculate the money.

text: 十多个人不是正好十个。
pinyin: shí duō gè rén bù shì zhèng hǎo shí gè .
meaning: More than ten people does not mean exactly ten.

text: 不少
pinyin: bù shǎo
meaning: quite a few; not little

text: 要买的东西不少，先写清楚。
pinyin: yào mǎi de dōng xi bù shǎo , xiān xiě qīng chu .
meaning: There are quite a few things to buy; write them clearly first.

text: 卡
pinyin: kǎ
meaning: card

text: 这张卡可以付款吗？
pinyin: zhè zhāng kǎ kě yǐ fù kuǎn ma ?
meaning: Can I pay with this card?

text: 银行卡
pinyin: yín háng kǎ
meaning: bank card

text: 我带了银行卡，也带了现金。
pinyin: wǒ dài le yín háng kǎ , yě dài le xiàn jīn .
meaning: I brought a bank card and cash.

text: 收入
pinyin: shōu rù
meaning: income; receipts

text: 我的收入不多，这次先定预算。
pinyin: wǒ de shōu rù bù duō , zhè cì xiān dìng yù suàn .
meaning: My income is not large; let us set a budget for this visit.

text: 今天每人花四十块。
pinyin: jīn tiān měi rén huā sì shí kuài .
meaning: Each person spends forty yuan today.

text: 算
pinyin: suàn
meaning: to calculate; count as

text: 先算全部费用，再分。
pinyin: xiān suàn quán bù fèi yòng , zài fēn .
meaning: Calculate the entire cost before dividing it.

text: 够
pinyin: gòu
meaning: enough

text: 一百五十块够付一百二十块。
pinyin: yī bǎi wǔ shí kuài gòu fù yī bǎi èr shí kuài .
meaning: One hundred and fifty yuan is enough to pay one hundred and twenty.

text: 正好
pinyin: zhèng hǎo
meaning: exactly; just right

text: 三个人，每人四十，正好一百二十。
pinyin: sān gè rén , měi rén sì shí , zhèng hǎo yī bǎi èr shí .
meaning: Three people at forty each makes exactly one hundred and twenty.

text: 一千是一百的十倍，一万是一千的十倍。
pinyin: yī qiān shì yī bǎi de shí bèi , yī wàn shì yī qiān de shí bèi .
meaning: One thousand is ten hundreds; ten thousand is ten thousands.

text: 十多个人参加，不是正好十个。
pinyin: shí duō gè rén cān jiā , bù shì zhèng hǎo shí gè .
meaning: More than ten people participate, not exactly ten.

text: 我这次预算一百五十，够就好。
pinyin: wǒ zhè cì yù suàn yī bǎi wǔ shí , gòu jiù hǎo .
meaning: My budget this time is one hundred and fifty; enough is fine.

text: 你说的是块还是角？
pinyin: nǐ shuō de shì kuài hái shi jiǎo ?
meaning: Do you mean yuan or jiao?

text: 层
pinyin: céng
meaning: floor; layer classifier

text: 朋友住三层，我先问怎么上去。
pinyin: péng you zhù sān céng , wǒ xiān wèn zěn me shàng qù .
meaning: My friend lives on the third floor; I first ask how to get upstairs.

text: 封
pinyin: fēng
meaning: letter classifier

text: 我写了一封信，放进信封。
pinyin: wǒ xiě le yī fēng xìn , fàng jìn xìn fēng .
meaning: I wrote a letter and put it in an envelope.

text: 放下
pinyin: fàng xià
meaning: to put down

text: 先把包裹放下，再找笔。
pinyin: xiān bǎ bāo guǒ fàng xià , zài zhǎo bǐ .
meaning: Put the parcel down first, then find a pen.

text: 条
pinyin: tiáo
meaning: long-item classifier

text: 这条围巾是给你的。
pinyin: zhè tiáo wéi jīn shì gěi nǐ de .
meaning: This scarf is for you.

text: 位
pinyin: wèi
meaning: polite person classifier

text: 那位朋友还没收到礼物。
pinyin: nà wèi péng you hái méi shōu dào lǐ wù .
meaning: That friend has not received the gift yet.

text: 份
pinyin: fèn
meaning: portion; copy classifier

text: 每人一份小礼物。
pinyin: měi rén yī fèn xiǎo lǐ wù .
meaning: One small gift for each person.

text: 套
pinyin: tào
meaning: set classifier

text: 我买了一套笔记本和笔。
pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yī tào bǐ jì běn hé bǐ .
meaning: I bought a set of notebooks and pens.

text: 纸
pinyin: zhǐ
meaning: paper

text: 这张纸用来写地址。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhǐ yòng lái xiě dì zhǐ .
meaning: This sheet of paper is for writing the address.

text: 笔
pinyin: bǐ
meaning: pen

text: 请借我一支笔。
pinyin: qǐng jiè wǒ yī zhī bǐ .
meaning: Please lend me a pen.

text: 笔记
pinyin: bǐ jì
meaning: notes

text: 地址在我的笔记里。
pinyin: dì zhǐ zài wǒ de bǐ jì lǐ .
meaning: The address is in my notes.

text: 笔记本
pinyin: bǐ jì běn
meaning: notebook

text: 新笔记本里还没有字。
pinyin: xīn bǐ jì běn lǐ hái méi yǒu zì .
meaning: The new notebook has no writing in it yet.

text: 交
pinyin: jiāo
meaning: to hand over

text: 我把包裹交到服务台。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ bāo guǒ jiāo dào fú wù tái .
meaning: I hand the parcel over at the service desk.

text: 交给
pinyin: jiāo gěi
meaning: to hand to

text: 请把这封信交给她。
pinyin: qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn jiāo gěi tā .
meaning: Please hand this letter to her.

text: 送给
pinyin: sòng gěi
meaning: to give as a gift

text: 我送给你一本书。
pinyin: wǒ sòng gěi nǐ yī běn shū .
meaning: I give you a book as a gift.

text: 送到
pinyin: sòng dào
meaning: to deliver to

text: 包裹送到学校，不是家里。
pinyin: bāo guǒ sòng dào xué xiào , bù shì jiā lǐ .
meaning: The parcel is delivered to the school, not the home.

text: 接
pinyin: jiē
meaning: to receive; meet

text: 我到门口接朋友。
pinyin: wǒ dào mén kǒu jiē péng you .
meaning: I go to the entrance to meet my friend.

text: 接到
pinyin: jiē dào
meaning: to receive; reach by receiving

text: 我接到通知后再去拿。
pinyin: wǒ jiē dào tōng zhī hòu zài qù ná .
meaning: I go to collect it after receiving the notice.

text: 接受
pinyin: jiē shòu
meaning: to accept

text: 你不方便接受也没关系。
pinyin: nǐ bù fāng biàn jiē shòu yě méi guān xì .
meaning: It is okay if accepting it is inconvenient for you.

text: 感谢
pinyin: gǎn xiè
meaning: to thank; gratitude

text: 谢谢你，我很感谢你的帮助。
pinyin: xiè xiè nǐ , wǒ hěn gǎn xiè nǐ de bāng zhù .
meaning: Thank you; I am very grateful for your help.

text: 感动
pinyin: gǎn dòng
meaning: to be moved

text: 看了信，我很感动。
pinyin: kàn le xìn , wǒ hěn gǎn dòng .
meaning: I was very moved after reading the letter.

text: 感到
pinyin: gǎn dào
meaning: to feel

text: 收到朋友的信，我感到很开心。
pinyin: shōu dào péng you de xìn , wǒ gǎn dào hěn kāi xīn .
meaning: Receiving my friend’s letter makes me feel happy.

text: 照顾
pinyin: zhào gù
meaning: to look after

text: 这几天谢谢你照顾我。
pinyin: zhè jǐ tiān xiè xiè nǐ zhào gù wǒ .
meaning: Thank you for looking after me these past few days.

text: 三层有两间房，一位朋友住在那里。
pinyin: sān céng yǒu liǎng jiān fáng , yī wèi péng you zhù zài nà lǐ .
meaning: There are two rooms on the third floor; a friend lives there.

text: 我送你一本书。
pinyin: wǒ sòng nǐ yī běn shū .
meaning: I give you a book as a gift.

text: 谢谢，不用了，你留着吧。
pinyin: xiè xiè , bù yòng le , nǐ liú zhe ba .
meaning: Thank you, no need; please keep it.

text: 请再确认一下收件人的名字。
pinyin: qǐng zài què rèn yī xià shōu jiàn rén de míng zi .
meaning: Please confirm the recipient’s name once more.

text: 周
pinyin: zhōu
meaning: week

text: 我们一周见一次。
pinyin: wǒ men yī zhōu jiàn yī cì .
meaning: We meet once a week.

text: 上周
pinyin: shàng zhōu
meaning: last week

text: 上周我们去了学校。
pinyin: shàng zhōu wǒ men qù le xué xiào .
meaning: Last week we went to the school.

text: 下周
pinyin: xià zhōu
meaning: next week

text: 下周再看一次演出。
pinyin: xià zhōu zài kàn yī cì yǎn chū .
meaning: We will see another performance next week.

text: 学期
pinyin: xué qī
meaning: school term

text: 这个学期每周都有活动。
pinyin: zhè gè xué qī měi zhōu dōu yǒu huó dòng .
meaning: There is an activity every week this term.

text: 周年
pinyin: zhōu nián
meaning: anniversary; full year

text: 这是学校十周年的节目。
pinyin: zhè shì xué xiào shí zhōu nián de jié mù .
meaning: This is the programme for the school’s tenth anniversary.

text: 不久
pinyin: bù jiǔ
meaning: soon; not long

text: 不久以后，还会有新节目。
pinyin: bù jiǔ yǐ hòu , hái huì yǒu xīn jié mù .
meaning: There will be another new programme before long.

text: 就要
pinyin: jiù yào
meaning: about to; soon going to

text: 节目就要开始了，先坐好。
pinyin: jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le , xiān zuò hǎo .
meaning: The programme is about to begin; take your seat first.

text: 快要
pinyin: kuài yào
meaning: nearly about to

text: 快要七点了，先看时间。
pinyin: kuài yào qī diǎn le , xiān kàn shí jiān .
meaning: It is nearly seven; check the time first.

text: 以后
pinyin: yǐ hòu
meaning: after; later

text: 散场以后，我们去喝茶。
pinyin: sàn chǎng yǐ hòu , wǒ men qù hē chá .
meaning: After the show ends, we will have tea.

text: 以前
pinyin: yǐ qián
meaning: before; formerly

text: 开场以前先检票。
pinyin: kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào .
meaning: Tickets are checked before the show starts.

text: 刚
pinyin: gāng
meaning: just

text: 我刚到，你在哪儿？
pinyin: wǒ gāng dào , nǐ zài nǎr ?
meaning: I just arrived; where are you?

text: 刚才
pinyin: gāng cái
meaning: just now

text: 刚才收到的是旧通知。
pinyin: gāng cái shōu dào de shì jiù tōng zhī .
meaning: What we received just now was the old notice.

text: 刚刚
pinyin: gāng gāng
meaning: just; only just

text: 新通知刚刚发来。
pinyin: xīn tōng zhī gāng gāng fā lái .
meaning: The new notice has only just arrived.

text: 这时
pinyin: zhè shí
meaning: at this time

text: 这时灯还亮着，节目没开始。
pinyin: zhè shí dēng hái liàng zhe , jié mù méi kāi shǐ .
meaning: At this time the lights are still on; the programme has not started.

text: 停
pinyin: tíng
meaning: to stop

text: 先停一下，看看票上的时间。
pinyin: xiān tíng yī xià , kàn kàn piào shàng de shí jiān .
meaning: Stop for a moment and check the time on the ticket.

text: 灯
pinyin: dēng
meaning: lamp; light

text: 灯暗了以后，别到处走。
pinyin: dēng àn le yǐ hòu , bié dào chù zǒu .
meaning: After the lights dim, do not walk around.

text: 节目
pinyin: jié mù
meaning: programme; performance item

text: 节目七点开始，不是六点半。
pinyin: jié mù qī diǎn kāi shǐ , bù shì liù diǎn bàn .
meaning: The programme starts at seven, not half past six.

text: 后来
pinyin: hòu lái
meaning: afterwards

text: 后来我们发现集合时间改了。
pinyin: hòu lái wǒ men fā xiàn jí hé shí jiān gǎi le .
meaning: Afterwards we discovered that the meeting time had changed.

text: 不一会儿
pinyin: bù yí huìr
meaning: in a little while

text: 不一会儿，朋友就到了。
pinyin: bù yí huìr , péng you jiù dào le .
meaning: Our friend arrived in a little while.

text: 半夜
pinyin: bàn yè
meaning: middle of the night

text: 别等到半夜才发消息。
pinyin: bié děng dào bàn yè cái fā xiāo xī .
meaning: Do not wait until the middle of the night to send the message.

text: 夜里
pinyin: yè lǐ
meaning: at night

text: 夜里回家，先看还有没有车。
pinyin: yè lǐ huí jiā , xiān kàn hái yǒu méi yǒu chē .
meaning: When going home at night, check whether transport is still running.

text: 早晨
pinyin: zǎo chén
meaning: early morning

text: 早晨我先看了新通知。
pinyin: zǎo chén wǒ xiān kàn le xīn tōng zhī .
meaning: I checked the new notice in the early morning.

text: 我们等十分钟，七点开始。
pinyin: wǒ men děng shí fēn zhōng , qī diǎn kāi shǐ .
meaning: We wait ten minutes; it starts at seven.

text: 在开场前，我们先检票。
pinyin: zài kāi chǎng qián , wǒ men xiān jiǎn piào .
meaning: Before the show starts, we first have our tickets checked.

text: 节目要开始了。
pinyin: jié mù yào kāi shǐ le .
meaning: The programme is about to begin.

text: 集合改成六点四十，开场还是七点。
pinyin: jí hé gǎi chéng liù diǎn sì shí , kāi chǎng hái shi qī diǎn .
meaning: The meeting time changed to six forty; the start is still seven.

text: 回家前先看看夜里有没有车。
pinyin: huí jiā qián xiān kàn kàn yè lǐ yǒu méi yǒu chē .
meaning: Before going home, check whether transport runs at night.

text: 多么
pinyin: duō me
meaning: how; how very

text: 这里多么安静啊！
pinyin: zhè lǐ duō me ān jìng a !
meaning: How quiet it is here!

text: 更
pinyin: gèng
meaning: more

text: 里面比门口更安静。
pinyin: lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu gèng ān jìng .
meaning: Inside is quieter than the entrance.

text: 十分
pinyin: shí fēn
meaning: very

text: 这间屋子十分亮。
pinyin: zhè jiān wū zi shí fēn liàng .
meaning: This room is very bright.

text: 挺
pinyin: tǐng

pinyin: yǒu wèn tí suí shí fā xiāo xī , huí fù kě néng yào děng .
meaning: Message at any time if there is a problem; a reply may take time.

text: 通
pinyin: tōng
meaning: to connect; get through

text: 电话还没通，我先发短信。
pinyin: diàn huà hái méi tōng , wǒ xiān fā duǎn xìn .
meaning: The call has not connected; I will send a text first.

text: 通过
pinyin: tōng guò
meaning: to pass through

text: 从入口通过，别走出口。
pinyin: cóng rù kǒu tōng guò , bié zǒu chū kǒu .
meaning: Go through the entrance, not the exit.

text: 进入
pinyin: jìn rù
meaning: to enter

text: 确认入口后，我们进入图书馆。
pinyin: què rèn rù kǒu hòu , wǒ men jìn rù tú shū guǎn .
meaning: After checking the entrance, we enter the library.

text: 走进
pinyin: zǒu jìn
meaning: to walk into

text: 我走进门，先看通知。
pinyin: wǒ zǒu jìn mén , xiān kàn tōng zhī .
meaning: I walk through the door and check the notice first.

text: 走开
pinyin: zǒu kāi
meaning: to walk away

text: 先别走开，我去问工作人员。
pinyin: xiān bié zǒu kāi , wǒ qù wèn gōng zuò rén yuán .
meaning: Do not walk away yet; I will ask a staff member.

text: 走过
pinyin: zǒu guò
meaning: to walk past

text: 我刚走过书店，没有进去。
pinyin: wǒ gāng zǒu guò shū diàn , méi yǒu jìn qù .
meaning: I just walked past the bookshop without going in.

text: 出口
pinyin: chū kǒu
meaning: exit

text: 出口在右边。
pinyin: chū kǒu zài yòu biān .
meaning: The exit is on the right.

text: 入口
pinyin: rù kǒu
meaning: entrance

text: 新的入口在东边。
pinyin: xīn de rù kǒu zài dōng biān .
meaning: The new entrance is on the east side.

text: 找出
pinyin: zhǎo chū
meaning: to find out; locate

text: 先找出最新的一条消息。
pinyin: xiān zhǎo chū zuì xīn de yī tiáo xiāo xī .
meaning: Find the newest message first.

text: 拿出
pinyin: ná chū
meaning: to take out

text: 进入以后拿出要还的书。
pinyin: jìn rù yǐ hòu ná chū yào huán de shū .
meaning: Take out the books to return after entering.

text: 我们经常见面，今天重新确认地址。
pinyin: wǒ men jīng cháng jiàn miàn , jīn tiān chóng xīn què rèn dì zhǐ .
meaning: We meet often; today we are confirming the address anew.

text: 到了，发消息，等朋友。
pinyin: dào le , fā xiāo xī , děng péng you .
meaning: Arrive, message, wait for the friend.

text: 我一到北门，就给你发消息。
pinyin: wǒ yī dào běi mén , jiù gěi nǐ fā xiāo xī .
meaning: I will message you as soon as I reach the north gate.

text: 我重新发了地址，先看最新的消息。
pinyin: wǒ chóng xīn fā le dì zhǐ , xiān kàn zuì xīn de xiāo xī .
meaning: I sent the address again; check the latest message first.

text: 我一到东边，就给你发消息。
pinyin: wǒ yī dào dōng biān , jiù gěi nǐ fā xiāo xī .
meaning: I will message as soon as I reach the east side.

text: 正是
pinyin: zhèng shì
meaning: exactly; precisely is

text: 这正是我想问的问题。
pinyin: zhè zhèng shì wǒ xiǎng wèn de wèn tí .
meaning: This is exactly the question I wanted to ask.

text: 正确
pinyin: zhèng què
meaning: correct

text: 这条地址是正确的，日期还要核对。
pinyin: zhè tiáo dì zhǐ shì zhèng què de , rì qī hái yào hé duì .
meaning: This address is correct; the date still needs checking.

text: 准确
pinyin: zhǔn què
meaning: accurate

text: 请说准确的时间，不要只说晚上。
pinyin: qǐng shuō zhǔn què de shí jiān , bú yào zhǐ shuō wǎn shang .
meaning: Please give the precise time, not just evening.

text: 真正
pinyin: zhēn zhèng
meaning: truly; genuinely

text: 我真正想确认的是入口。
pinyin: wǒ zhēn zhèng xiǎng què rèn de shì rù kǒu .
meaning: What I truly want to confirm is the entrance.

text: 直接
pinyin: zhí jiē
meaning: directly

text: 我直接问负责人，不猜他的意思。
pinyin: wǒ zhí jiē wèn fù zé rén , bù cāi tā de yì si .
meaning: I ask the person in charge directly rather than guessing what he means.

text: 意思
pinyin: yì si
meaning: meaning; intention

text: 我的意思是先确认，不是先进去。
pinyin: wǒ de yì si shì xiān què rèn , bù shì xiān jìn qù .
meaning: I mean to confirm first, not to go in first.

text: 重点
pinyin: zhòng diǎn
meaning: main point

text: 重点是今天的地址，不是旧图片。
pinyin: zhòng diǎn shì jīn tiān de dì zhǐ , bù shì jiù tú piàn .
meaning: The main point is today’s address, not the old image.

text: 主要
pinyin: zhǔ yào
meaning: main; principal

text: 主要问题是时间还没有确认。
pinyin: zhǔ yào wèn tí shì shí jiān hái méi yǒu què rèn .
meaning: The main problem is that the time is unconfirmed.

text: 观点
pinyin: guān diǎn
meaning: viewpoint

text: 我们观点不同，也可以慢慢讨论。
pinyin: wǒ men guān diǎn bù tóng , yě kě yǐ màn màn tǎo lùn .
meaning: We have different views but can still discuss them calmly.

text: 角度
pinyin: jiǎo dù
meaning: angle; perspective

text: 从客人的角度看，通知要清楚。
pinyin: cóng kè rén de jiǎo dù kàn , tōng zhī yào qīng chǔ .
meaning: From a guest’s perspective, the notice needs to be clear.

text: 方面
pinyin: fāng miàn
meaning: aspect

text: 时间方面还有一个问题。
pinyin: shí jiān fāng miàn hái yǒu yī gè wèn tí .
meaning: There is another issue concerning time.

text: 提
pinyin: tí
meaning: to raise; bring up

text: 有问题可以提，不用等到最后。
pinyin: yǒu wèn tí kě yǐ tí , bù yòng děng dào zuì hòu .
meaning: You can raise a problem without waiting until the end.

text: 提出
pinyin: tí chū
meaning: to put forward

text: 朋友提出先问入口的意见。
pinyin: péng you tí chū xiān wèn rù kǒu de yì jiàn .
meaning: My friend suggests asking about the entrance first.

text: 提到
pinyin: tí dào
meaning: to mention

text: 他提到北门，但没说从那里进。
pinyin: tā tí dào běi mén , dàn méi shuō cóng nà lǐ jìn .
meaning: He mentioned the north gate but did not say to enter there.

text: 讨论
pinyin: tǎo lùn
meaning: to discuss

text: 我们先讨论时间，再写通知。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān tǎo lùn shí jiān , zài xiě tōng zhī .
meaning: We will discuss the time first, then write the notice.

text: 问题
pinyin: wèn tí
meaning: question; problem

text: 这个问题是问时间，不是问价格。
pinyin: zhè gè wèn tí shì wèn shí jiān , bù shì wèn jià gé .
meaning: This question asks about time, not price.

text: 道理
pinyin: dào lǐ
meaning: reason; principle

text: 先确认再出发，这个道理我明白。
pinyin: xiān què rèn zài chū fā , zhè gè dào lǐ wǒ míng bái .
meaning: I understand why we should confirm before leaving.

text: 实际
pinyin: shí jì
meaning: actual; practical

text: 实际的入口在东边。
pinyin: shí jì de rù kǒu zài dōng biān .
meaning: The actual entrance is on the east side.

text: 实在
pinyin: shí zài
meaning: really; indeed

text: 这个时间实在不方便，我们换一天吧。
pinyin: zhè gè shí jiān shí zài bù fāng biàn , wǒ men huàn yī tiān ba .
meaning: This time really is inconvenient; let us choose another day.

text: 我对这个安排还有问题。
pinyin: wǒ duì zhè gè ān pái hái yǒu wèn tí .
meaning: I still have questions about this arrangement.

text: 同样
pinyin: tóng yàng
meaning: same; equally

text: 两个朋友有同样的问题。
pinyin: liǎng gè péng you yǒu tóng yàng de wèn tí .
meaning: Two friends have the same question.

text: 相同
pinyin: xiāng tóng
meaning: identical; the same

text: 两条消息的地址相同，日期不同。
pinyin: liǎng tiáo xiāo xī de dì zhǐ xiāng tóng , rì qī bù tóng .
meaning: The two messages have the same address but different dates.

text: 对，我就是这个意思。
pinyin: duì , wǒ jiù shì zhè gè yì si .
meaning: Yes, that is exactly what I mean.

text: 我说的就是今天，不是明天。
pinyin: wǒ shuō de jiù shì jīn tiān , bù shì míng tiān .
meaning: I mean today, not tomorrow.

text: 我明白，但这个时间实在不方便。
pinyin: wǒ míng bái , dàn zhè gè shí jiān shí zài bù fāng biàn .
meaning: I understand, but this time really is inconvenient.

text: 故意
pinyin: gù yì
meaning: deliberately; on purpose

text: 我不是故意拿错你的笔。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì gù yì ná cuò nǐ de bǐ .
meaning: I did not take your pen by mistake on purpose.

text: 好像
pinyin: hǎo xiàng
meaning: to seem; as if

text: 你好像不太开心，我问一下。
pinyin: nǐ hǎo xiàng bù tài kāi xīn , wǒ wèn yī xià .
meaning: You seem a little unhappy; I will ask.

text: 以为
pinyin: yǐ wéi
meaning: to think mistakenly or without confirmation

text: 我以为你同意了，其实还没问。
pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ tóng yì le , qí shí hái méi wèn .
meaning: I thought you agreed, but had not actually asked.

text: 感觉
pinyin: gǎn jué
meaning: to feel; perceive

text: 我感觉你有点儿不舒服。
pinyin: wǒ gǎn jué nǐ yǒu diǎn ér bù shū fú .
meaning: I feel that you are a little uncomfortable.

text: 难看
pinyin: nán kàn
meaning: unpleasant-looking; ugly

text: 我不喜欢这件衣服，但不说你穿得难看。
pinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huān zhè jiàn yī fú , dàn bù shuō nǐ chuān de nán kàn .
meaning: I dislike this item of clothing but do not tell you that you look ugly in it.

text: 可怕
pinyin: kě pà
meaning: frightening

text: 那个故事有点儿可怕，先别讲了。
pinyin: nà gè gù shì yǒu diǎn ér kě pà , xiān bié jiǎng le .
meaning: That story is a little frightening; stop telling it for now.

text: 笑话
pinyin: xiào hua
meaning: to ridicule; laugh at

text: 别笑话别人说得慢。
pinyin: bié xiào hua bié ren shuō de màn .
meaning: Do not ridicule someone for speaking slowly.

text: 笑话儿
pinyin: xiào huar
meaning: joke; a northern rhotic noun form

text: 这个笑话儿不好笑，换个话题吧。
pinyin: zhè gè xiào huar bù hǎo xiào , huàn gè huà tí ba .
meaning: This joke is not funny; let us change the topic.

text: 哭
pinyin: kū
meaning: to cry

text: 她哭了，我先问要不要帮忙。
pinyin: tā kū le , wǒ xiān wèn yào bù yào bāng máng .
meaning: She is crying; I first ask whether she wants help.

text: 喊
pinyin: hǎn
meaning: to shout; call out

text: 别喊，我在你旁边。
pinyin: bié hǎn , wǒ zài nǐ páng biān .
meaning: Do not shout; I am beside you.

text: 眼
pinyin: yǎn
meaning: eye

text: 别用手碰眼，先洗手。
pinyin: bié yòng shǒu pèng yǎn , xiān xǐ shǒu .
meaning: Do not touch your eyes with your hands; wash your hands first.

text: 眼睛
pinyin: yǎn jing
meaning: eyes

text: 她的眼睛有点儿红。
pinyin: tā de yǎn jing yǒu diǎn ér hóng .
meaning: Her eyes are a little red.

text: 脸
pinyin: liǎn
meaning: face

text: 他笑了，但不能只看脸就猜意思。
pinyin: tā xiào le , dàn bù néng zhǐ kàn liǎn jiù cāi yì si .
meaning: He smiled, but we cannot infer intention just from his face.

text: 嘴
pinyin: zuǐ
meaning: mouth

text: 他用手指了指嘴，没有说话。
pinyin: tā yòng shǒu zhǐ le zhǐ zuǐ , méi yǒu shuō huà .
meaning: He pointed at his mouth without speaking.

text: 头发
pinyin: tóu fa
meaning: hair

text: 我刚剪头发，朋友差点儿没认出来。
pinyin: wǒ gāng jiǎn tóu fa , péng you chà diǎn ér méi rèn chū lái .
meaning: I just had my hair cut; my friend nearly did not recognize me.

text: 点头
pinyin: diǎn tóu
meaning: to nod

text: 他点头了，我还要确认是不是同意。
pinyin: tā diǎn tóu le , wǒ hái yào què rèn shì bú shì tóng yì .
meaning: He nodded; I still need to confirm whether he agrees.

text: 小心
pinyin: xiǎo xīn
meaning: to be careful

text: 小心，杯子在桌边。
pinyin: xiǎo xīn , bēi zi zài zhuō biān .
meaning: Be careful; the cup is at the edge of the table.

text: 假
pinyin: jiǎ
meaning: false; fake

text: 那是假消息，不是真的通知。
pinyin: nà shì jiǎ xiāo xī , bù shì zhēn de tōng zhī .
meaning: That is a false message, not a real notice.

text: 好人
pinyin: hǎo rén
meaning: good person

text: 做好人不等于替朋友决定一切。
pinyin: zuò hǎo rén bù děng yú tì péng you jué dìng yī qiè .
meaning: Being a good person does not mean deciding everything for a friend.

text: 坏人
pinyin: huài rén
meaning: bad person

text: 拿错笔不等于就是坏人。
pinyin: ná cuò bǐ bù děng yú jiù shì huài rén .
meaning: Taking the wrong pen does not automatically make someone a bad person.

text: 好事
pinyin: hǎo shì
meaning: good deed; good thing

text: 先问需不需要帮助，再做好事。
pinyin: xiān wèn xū bù xū yào bāng zhù , zài zuò hǎo shì .
meaning: Ask whether help is needed before doing a good deed.

text: 气
pinyin: qì
meaning: to anger; annoy

text: 别故意气我，我真的不喜欢。
pinyin: bié gù yì qì wǒ , wǒ zhēn de bù xǐ huān .
meaning: Do not deliberately annoy me; I truly dislike it.

text: 我不是故意拿错笔的，对不起。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì gù yì ná cuò bǐ de , duì bù qǐ .
meaning: I did not intentionally take the wrong pen; sorry.

text: 你是在开玩笑吧？
pinyin: nǐ shì zài kāi wán xiào ba ?
meaning: You are joking, right?

text: 你是不是没听清？
pinyin: nǐ shì bú shì méi tīng qīng ?
meaning: Did you perhaps not hear clearly?

text: 你是不是在开玩笑？
pinyin: nǐ shì bú shì zài kāi wán xiào ?
meaning: Are you joking?

text: 对不起，我不继续说了。
pinyin: duì bù qǐ , wǒ bù jì xù shuō le .
meaning: Sorry, I will stop.

text: 必须
pinyin: bì xū
meaning: must; be required to

text: 下雪以后路不好走，必须先问场地的情况。
pinyin: xià xuě yǐ hòu lù bù hǎo zǒu , bì xū xiān wèn chǎng dì de qíng kuàng .
meaning: After snow the route is difficult; we must first ask about the venue.

text: 差不多
pinyin: chà bu duō
meaning: approximately; almost

text: 两条路的时间差不多，但不是完全一样。
pinyin: liǎng tiáo lù de shí jiān chà bu duō , dàn bù shì wán quán yī yàng .
meaning: The two routes take approximately the same time, but not exactly.

text: 如果
pinyin: rú guǒ
meaning: if

text: 如果明天下雨，我们就在室内见。
pinyin: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ , wǒ men jiù zài shì nèi jiàn .
meaning: If it rains tomorrow, we will meet indoors.

text: 只要
pinyin: zhǐ yào
meaning: as long as; provided that

text: 只要你有空，就可以参加。
pinyin: zhǐ yào nǐ yǒu kōng , jiù kě yǐ cān jiā .
meaning: As long as you are free, you can take part.

text: 条件
pinyin: tiáo jiàn
meaning: condition

text: 有空是这里说的条件，不是说必须下雨。
pinyin: yǒu kōng shì zhè lǐ shuō de tiáo jiàn , bù shì shuō bì xū xià yǔ .
meaning: Being free is the condition here; it does not mean rain is required.

text: 气温
pinyin: qì wēn
meaning: air temperature

text: 气温只有三度，我多带一件衣服。
pinyin: qì wēn zhǐ yǒu sān dù , wǒ duō dài yī jiàn yī fú .
meaning: The air temperature is only three degrees; I will bring another layer.

text: 多云
pinyin: duō yún
meaning: cloudy

text: 预报说多云，还没有说会下雨。
pinyin: yù bào shuō duō yún , hái méi yǒu shuō huì xià yǔ .
meaning: The forecast says cloudy; it has not said it will rain.

text: 晴
pinyin: qíng
meaning: clear; sunny

text: 天晴了，也要先看场地有没有开。
pinyin: tiān qíng le , yě yào xiān kàn chǎng dì yǒu méi yǒu kāi .
meaning: It has cleared up, but we still need to check whether the venue is open.

text: 晴天
pinyin: qíng tiān
meaning: sunny day; clear weather

text: 晴天我们在公园见。
pinyin: qíng tiān wǒ men zài gōng yuán jiàn .
meaning: In clear weather we meet at the park.

text: 阴
pinyin: yīn
meaning: overcast

text: 今天阴，但不一定下雨。
pinyin: jīn tiān yīn , dàn bù yí dìng xià yǔ .
meaning: Today is overcast, but it will not necessarily rain.

text: 阴天
pinyin: yīn tiān
meaning: overcast day

text: 阴天也可以出门，先看预报。
pinyin: yīn tiān yě kě yǐ chū mén , xiān kàn yù bào .
meaning: You can go out on an overcast day too; check the forecast first.

text: 下雪
pinyin: xià xuě
meaning: to snow

text: 如果下雪，就不骑车。
pinyin: rú guǒ xià xuě , jiù bù qí chē .
meaning: If it snows, we will not ride bicycles.

text: 雪
pinyin: xuě
meaning: snow

text: 路上有雪，走路要小心。
pinyin: lù shàng yǒu xuě , zǒu lù yào xiǎo xīn .
meaning: There is snow on the road; walk carefully.

text: 春天
pinyin: chūn tiān
meaning: spring

text: 春天我们常在公园见。
pinyin: chūn tiān wǒ men cháng zài gōng yuán jiàn .
meaning: We often meet in the park in spring.

text: 夏天
pinyin: xià tiān
meaning: summer

text: 夏天气温高，带水来吧。
pinyin: xià tiān qì wēn gāo , dài shuǐ lái ba .
meaning: Temperatures are high in summer; bring water.

text: 秋天
pinyin: qiū tiān
meaning: autumn

text: 秋天凉快，我想出去走走。
pinyin: qiū tiān liáng kuai , wǒ xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu .
meaning: Autumn is pleasantly cool; I would like to go for a walk.

text: 冬天
pinyin: dōng tiān
meaning: winter

text: 冬天也能见面，可以选室内。
pinyin: dōng tiān yě néng jiàn miàn , kě yǐ xuǎn shì nèi .
meaning: We can meet in winter too; we can choose indoors.

text: 北方
pinyin: běi fāng
meaning: the north; northern region

text: 朋友住在北方，冬天常下雪。
pinyin: péng you zhù zài běi fāng , dōng tiān cháng xià xuě .
meaning: My friend lives in the north, where it often snows in winter.

text: 南方
pinyin: nán fāng
meaning: the south; southern region

text: 我在南方长大，不太习惯雪天出门。
pinyin: wǒ zài nán fāng zhǎng dà , bù tài xí guàn xuě tiān chū mén .
meaning: I grew up in the south and am not used to going out in snow.

text: 凉快
pinyin: liáng kuai
meaning: pleasantly cool

pinyin: zhè gè fèi yòng bāo kuò cái liào ma ?
meaning: Does this fee include the materials?

text: 这门课适合已经学过基础的人。
pinyin: zhè mén kè shì hé yǐ jīng xué guò jī chǔ de rén .
meaning: This course suits people who’ve studied the basics.

text: 我想看完介绍再决定。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kàn wán jiè shào zài jué dìng .
meaning: I’d like to read the description before deciding.

text: 对我来说，周末比晚上方便。
pinyin: duì wǒ lái shuō , zhōu mò bǐ wǎn shang fāng biàn .
meaning: For me, weekends are more convenient than evenings.

text: 只要材料交齐，就可以开始审核。
pinyin: zhǐ yào cái liào jiāo qí , jiù kě yǐ kāi shǐ shěn hé .
meaning: Once all documents are in, the review can start.

text: 只有完成基础课程，才可以申请。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu wán chéng jī chǔ kè chéng , cái kě yǐ shēn qǐng .
meaning: You can apply only after completing the foundation course.

text: 先坚持四周，再决定要不要增加。
pinyin: xiān jiān chí sì zhōu , zài jué dìng yào bù yào zēng jiā .
meaning: Keep it up for four weeks, then decide whether to add more.

text: 这个费用包括课本吗？
pinyin: zhè gè fèi yòng bāo kuò kè běn ma ?
meaning: Does this fee include the textbook?

text: 我以前上过基础课，符合报名条件吗？
pinyin: wǒ yǐ qián shàng guò jī chǔ kè , fú hé bào míng tiáo jiàn ma ?
meaning: I took a foundation course before. Do I meet the requirements?

text: 程序
pinyin: chéng xù
meaning: procedure; computer program

text: 我们先确认办理程序，再去交材料。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān què rèn bàn lǐ chéng xù , zài qù jiāo cái liào .
meaning: Let’s check the procedure before submitting the documents.

text: 操作
pinyin: cāo zuò
meaning: operate; operation

text: 这个机器怎么操作？
pinyin: zhè gè jī qì zěn me cāo zuò ?
meaning: How do you operate this machine?

text: 产品
pinyin: chǎn pǐn
meaning: product

text: 这个产品主要给小房间用。
pinyin: zhè gè chǎn pǐn zhǔ yào gěi xiǎo fáng jiān yòng .
meaning: This product is mainly for small rooms.

text: 测试
pinyin: cè shì
meaning: test

text: 我们先测试一下新设计。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān cè shì yī xià xīn shè jì .
meaning: Let’s test the new design first.

text: 测量
pinyin: cè liáng
meaning: measure

text: 先测量桌子的宽度。
pinyin: xiān cè liáng zhuō zi de kuān dù .
meaning: Measure the width of the table first.

text: 承受
pinyin: chéng shòu
meaning: bear; withstand

text: 这个架子承受不了这么重的东西。
pinyin: zhè gè jià zi chéng shòu bù le zhè me zhòng de dōng xi .
meaning: This stand can’t hold something so heavy.

text: 这种材料太薄，我们换一种吧。
pinyin: zhè zhǒng cái liào tài báo , wǒ men huàn yī zhǒng ba .
meaning: This material is too thin; let’s use another.

text: 数据
pinyin: shù jù
meaning: data

text: 先把这两次的数据放在一起比较。
pinyin: xiān bǎ zhè liǎng cì de shù jù fàng zài yì qǐ bǐ jiào .
meaning: Put the data from these two trials together to compare.

text: 尺寸
pinyin: chǐ cùn
meaning: size; dimensions

text: 这个盒子的尺寸不对，放不进去。
pinyin: zhè gè hé zi de chǐ cùn bú duì , fàng bù jìn qù .
meaning: This box is the wrong size; it won’t fit.

text: 修理
pinyin: xiū lǐ
meaning: repair

text: 这把椅子还能修理吗？
pinyin: zhè bǎ yǐ zi hái néng xiū lǐ ma ?
meaning: Can this chair still be repaired?

text: 你用完工具放回原来的地方。
pinyin: nǐ yòng wán gōng jù fàng huí yuán lái de dì fāng .
meaning: Put the tools back where they were after using them.

text: 这些设备下周才送到。
pinyin: zhè xiē shè bèi xià zhōu cái sòng dào .
meaning: This equipment won’t arrive until next week.

text: 老师指导我们做第一次测试。
pinyin: lǎo shī zhǐ dǎo wǒ men zuò dì yī cì cè shì .
meaning: The teacher guided us through the first test.

text: 你能说明一下为什么要改尺寸吗？
pinyin: nǐ néng shuō míng yī xià wèi shén me yào gǎi chǐ cùn ma ?
meaning: Could you explain why the dimensions need changing?

text: 我们第一次合作，就把任务分清楚了。
pinyin: wǒ men dì yī cì hé zuò , jiù bǎ rèn wù fēn qīng chǔ le .
meaning: We clarified our tasks at the start of our first collaboration.

text: 方案
pinyin: fāng àn
meaning: plan; proposed approach

text: 两个方案都可以，我们比较一下费用。
pinyin: liǎng gè fāng àn dōu kě yǐ , wǒ men bǐ jiào yī xià fèi yòng .
meaning: Both plans work; let’s compare their costs.

text: 按照说明，先打开盖子。
pinyin: àn zhào shuō míng , xiān dǎ kāi gài zi .
meaning: Following the instructions, open the lid first.

text: 放得下是一回事，站得住是另一回事。
pinyin: fàng de xià shì yī huí shì , zhàn de zhù shì lìng yī huí shì .
meaning: Fitting is one thing; staying upright is another.

text: 这个盒子放不下手机。
pinyin: zhè gè hé zi fàng bù xià shǒu jī .
meaning: This box won’t fit the phone.

text: 要是第二个也不行，我们就换方案。
pinyin: yào shì dì èr gè yě bù xíng , wǒ men jiù huàn fāng àn .
meaning: If the second doesn’t work either, we’ll try a different plan.

text: 手机放得下，但架子站不住。
pinyin: shǒu jī fàng de xià , dàn jià zi zhàn bù zhù .
meaning: The phone fits, but the stand will not stay upright.

text: 你帮我扶一下，我来改后面这一块。
pinyin: nǐ bāng wǒ fú yī xià , wǒ lái gǎi hòu miàn zhè yī kuài .
meaning: Hold this steady for me while I change the back piece.

text: 辩论
pinyin: biàn lùn
meaning: debate

text: 这次辩论的题目是城市生活。
pinyin: zhè cì biàn lùn de tí mù shì chéng shì shēng huó .
meaning: This debate is about city life.

text: 你诚实地告诉我，不喜欢也没关系。
pinyin: nǐ chéng shí de gào sù wǒ , bù xǐ huān yě méi guān xì .
meaning: Tell me honestly; it’s okay if you don’t like it.

text: 避免
pinyin: bì miǎn
meaning: avoid

text: 先问清楚，可以避免误会。
pinyin: xiān wèn qīng chǔ , kě yǐ bì miǎn wù huì .
meaning: Asking first can avoid misunderstandings.

text: 片面
pinyin: piàn miàn
meaning: one-sided; incomplete

text: 只看价格来评价，太片面了。
pinyin: zhǐ kàn jià gé lái píng jià , tài piàn miàn le .
meaning: Judging only by price is too one-sided.

text: 结论
pinyin: jié lùn
meaning: conclusion

text: 看完前面的部分，再下结论吧。
pinyin: kàn wán qián miàn de bù fèn , zài xià jié lùn ba .
meaning: Watch the earlier parts before drawing a conclusion.

text: 细节
pinyin: xì jié
meaning: detail

text: 我想再看一遍这个细节。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zài kàn yī biàn zhè gè xì jié .
meaning: I’d like to watch this detail again.

text: 风格
pinyin: fēng gé
meaning: style

text: 这个导演的风格比较安静。
pinyin: zhè gè dǎo yǎn de fēng gé bǐ jiào ān jìng .
meaning: This director has a fairly quiet style.

text: 反映
pinyin: fǎn yìng
meaning: reflect; report a problem

text: 这部电影反映了小城里普通人的生活。
pinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng fǎn yìng le xiǎo chéng lǐ pǔ tōng rén de shēng huó .
meaning: This film reflects ordinary life in a small town.

text: 争论
pinyin: zhēng lùn
meaning: argue; disagreement

text: 我们为最后那句话争论了半天。
pinyin: wǒ men wèi zuì hòu nà jù huà zhēng lùn le bàn tiān .
meaning: We argued for ages about that final sentence.

text: 期待
pinyin: qī dài
meaning: look forward to; expect

text: 我很期待下周的演出。
pinyin: wǒ hěn qī dài xià zhōu de yǎn chū .
meaning: I’m really looking forward to next week’s performance.

text: 失望
pinyin: shī wàng
meaning: disappointed

text: 没买到票，我有点失望。
pinyin: méi mǎi dào piào , wǒ yǒu diǎn shī wàng .
meaning: I’m a little disappointed I couldn’t get tickets.

text: 赞成
pinyin: zàn chéng
meaning: agree with; support an opinion

text: 我赞成先看完再讨论。
pinyin: wǒ zàn chéng xiān kàn wán zài tǎo lùn .
meaning: I agree we should finish watching before discussing it.

text: 你怎么评价这个演员？
pinyin: nǐ zěn me píng jià zhè gè yǎn yuán ?
meaning: How would you assess this actor?

text: 这个演员以前演过老师。
pinyin: zhè gè yǎn yuán yǐ qián yǎn guò lǎo shī .
meaning: This actor played a teacher before.

text: 导演没有把最后的答案说出来。
pinyin: dǎo yǎn méi yǒu bǎ zuì hòu de dá àn shuō chū lái .
meaning: The director didn’t give away the final answer.

text: 观众都安静下来，等演出开始。
pinyin: guān zhòng dōu ān jìng xià lái , děng yǎn chū kāi shǐ .
meaning: The audience grew quiet, waiting for the performance.

text: 尽管中间有点慢，但是最后一段很好。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn zhōng jiān yǒu diǎn màn , dàn shì zuì hòu yī duàn hěn hǎo .
meaning: Although the middle is slow, the final section is good.

text: 他不一定会回来。
pinyin: tā bù yí dìng huì huí lái .
meaning: He won’t necessarily return.

text: 我又没说整部都好。
pinyin: wǒ yòu méi shuō zhěng bù dōu hǎo .
meaning: I didn’t say the whole thing was good.

text: 把不同意见说具体，反而少争论了。
pinyin: bǎ bù tóng yì jiàn shuō jù tǐ , fǎn ér shǎo zhēng lùn le .
meaning: Making our different views specific actually reduced the arguing.

text: 这一段我看法不一样。
pinyin: zhè yī duàn wǒ kàn fǎ bù yī yàng .
meaning: I see this section differently.

text: 我喜欢最后一段，没说整部都好。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān zuì hòu yī duàn , méi shuō zhěng bù dōu hǎo .
meaning: I liked the last part; I did not say the whole film was good.

text: 航班
pinyin: háng bān
meaning: flight

text: 这个航班明天早上出发。
pinyin: zhè gè háng bān míng tiān zǎo shàng chū fā .
meaning: This flight departs tomorrow morning.

text: 航空
pinyin: háng kōng
meaning: aviation; air transport

text: 这家航空公司有晚上的航班。
pinyin: zhè jiā háng kōng gōng sī yǒu wǎn shang de háng bān .
meaning: This airline has evening flights.

text: 长途
pinyin: cháng tú
meaning: long-distance

text: 这次长途旅行，我们准备坐火车。
pinyin: zhè cì cháng tú lǚ xíng , wǒ men zhǔn bèi zuò huǒ chē .
meaning: We plan to take the train on this long trip.

text: 高铁
pinyin: gāo tiě
meaning: high-speed rail

text: 坐高铁到那里大约两小时。
pinyin: zuò gāo tiě dào nà lǐ dà yuē liǎng xiǎo shí .
meaning: It takes around two hours to get there by high-speed train.

text: 晚点
pinyin: wǎn diǎn
meaning: be delayed, of transport

text: 这趟车晚点了半小时。
pinyin: zhè tàng chē wǎn diǎn le bàn xiǎo shí .
meaning: This service is half an hour late.

text: 预订
pinyin: yù dìng
meaning: book in advance

text: 我想预订周六晚上的房间。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yù dìng zhōu liù wǎn shang de fáng jiān .
meaning: I’d like to book a room for Saturday night.

text: 确认
pinyin: què rèn
meaning: confirm

text: 你再确认一下车站名字。
pinyin: nǐ zài què rèn yī xià chē zhàn míng zi .
meaning: Check the station name once more.

text: 途中
pinyin: tú zhōng
meaning: on the way; en route

text: 我们途中休息了十分钟。
pinyin: wǒ men tú zhōng xiū xī le shí fēn zhōng .
meaning: We took a ten-minute break on the way.

text: 堵车
pinyin: dǔ chē
meaning: be held up in traffic

text: 路上堵车，我可能晚一点到。
pinyin: lù shàng dǔ chē , wǒ kě néng wǎn yī diǎn dào .
meaning: I’m stuck in traffic and may arrive a little late.

text: 距离
pinyin: jù lí
meaning: distance

text: 两个车站之间的距离有多远？
pinyin: liǎng gè chē zhàn zhī jiān de jù lí yǒu duō yuǎn ?
meaning: How far apart are the two stations?

text: 立即
pinyin: lì jí
meaning: immediately

text: 看到通知以后，我立即给她打了电话。
pinyin: kàn dào tōng zhī yǐ hòu , wǒ lì jí gěi tā dǎ le diàn huà .
meaning: I called her immediately after seeing the notice.

text: 期限
pinyin: qī xiàn
meaning: deadline; time limit

text: 申请期限到周四晚上。
pinyin: shēn qǐng qī xiàn dào zhōu sì wǎn shang .
meaning: The application deadline is Thursday evening.

text: 延期
pinyin: yán qī
meaning: postpone; extend a deadline

text: 这次活动延期到下周了。
pinyin: zhè cì huó dòng yán qī dào xià zhōu le .
meaning: This event has been postponed until next week.

text: 两点那趟车取消了。
pinyin: liǎng diǎn nà tàng chē qǔ xiāo le .
meaning: The two o’clock service has been cancelled.

text: 转告
pinyin: zhuǎn gào
meaning: pass a message on

text: 请转告陈宇，我会晚半小时。
pinyin: qǐng zhuǎn gào chén yǔ , wǒ huì wǎn bàn xiǎo shí .
meaning: Please tell Chen Yu I’ll be half an hour late.

text: 我们几点出发比较好？
pinyin: wǒ men jǐ diǎn chū fā bǐ jiào hǎo ?
meaning: What time should we set off?

text: 除非先办好新票，否则不能直接上这趟车。
pinyin: chú fēi xiān bàn hǎo xīn piào , fǒu zé bù néng zhí jiē shàng zhè tàng chē .
meaning: Unless the new ticket is processed first, you can’t board this service directly.

text: 万一来不及，我就先给你电话。
pinyin: wàn yī lái bù jí , wǒ jiù xiān gěi nǐ diàn huà .
meaning: If I happen to run out of time, I’ll call you first.

text: 我们三点十分才出发。
pinyin: wǒ men sān diǎn shí fēn cái chū fā .
meaning: We won’t depart until 3:10.

text: 把两张票分开放，免得拿错。
pinyin: bǎ liǎng zhāng piào fēn kāi fàng , miǎn de ná cuò .
meaning: Keep the tickets apart so you don’t take the wrong one.

text: 到了先找三号窗口，三点前要办好。
pinyin: dào le xiān zhǎo sān hào chuāng kǒu , sān diǎn qián yào bàn hǎo .
meaning: Find counter three when you arrive; it must be done before three.

text: 我说的是快到车站，还没到你家。
pinyin: wǒ shuō de shì kuài dào chē zhàn , hái méi dào nǐ jiā .
meaning: I meant nearly at the station, not at your home yet.

text: 原则
pinyin: yuán zé
meaning: principle

text: 先问本人，是我们做这件事的原则。
pinyin: xiān wèn běn rén , shì wǒ men zuò zhè jiàn shì de yuán zé .
meaning: Asking the person first is our principle for this.

text: 我不在乎坐哪里，只要能听清。
pinyin: wǒ bù zài hū zuò nǎ lǐ , zhǐ yào néng tīng qīng .
meaning: I don’t mind where I sit as long as I can hear.

text: 在乎
pinyin: zài hū
meaning: care about

text: 我在乎的是你愿不愿意来，不是礼物。
pinyin: wǒ zài hū de shì nǐ yuàn bù yuàn yì lái , bù shì lǐ wù .
meaning: What matters to me is whether you want to come, not the gift.

text: 相处
pinyin: xiāng chǔ
meaning: get along; spend time together

text: 和她相处很轻松，不用一直找话题。
pinyin: hé tā xiāng chǔ hěn qīng sōng , bù yòng yì zhí zhǎo huà tí .
meaning: Spending time with her is easy; I don’t have to keep finding topics.

text: 我可能误会了，你不是这个意思吧？
pinyin: wǒ kě néng wù huì le , nǐ bù shì zhè gè yì si ba ?
meaning: I may have misunderstood; that isn’t what you meant, is it?

text: 难免
pinyin: nán miǎn
meaning: hard to avoid; inevitably sometimes

text: 刚到新的地方，难免有点不习惯。
pinyin: gāng dào xīn de dì fāng , nán miǎn yǒu diǎn bù xí guàn .
meaning: It’s natural to feel a little unfamiliar in a new place.

text: 约会
pinyin: yuē huì
meaning: date; arranged meeting

text: 他们第一次约会是在这家咖啡店。
pinyin: tā men dì yī cì yuē huì shì zài zhè jiā kā fēi diàn .
meaning: Their first date was at this café.

text: 我承认自己回复得太晚了。
pinyin: wǒ chéng rèn zì jǐ huí fù de tài wǎn le .
meaning: I admit I replied too late.

text: 担心
pinyin: dān xīn
meaning: worry; be concerned

text: 我担心你以为我不想见你。
pinyin: wǒ dān xīn nǐ yǐ wéi wǒ bù xiǎng jiàn nǐ .
meaning: I’m worried you’ll think I don’t want to see you.

text: 考虑
pinyin: kǎo lǜ
meaning: consider

text: 我想考虑一下，明天回复你。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kǎo lǜ yī xià , míng tiān huí fù nǐ .
meaning: I’d like to think about it and reply tomorrow.

text: 回复
pinyin: huí fù
meaning: reply

text: 谢谢你这么快回复。
pinyin: xiè xiè nǐ zhè me kuài huí fù .
meaning: Thanks for replying so quickly.

text: 你可以直接告诉我，不用猜我想听什么。
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē gào sù wǒ , bù yòng cāi wǒ xiǎng tīng shén me .
meaning: You can tell me directly; no need to guess what I want to hear.

text: 她的态度很认真，但说话不重。
pinyin: tā de tài dù hěn rèn zhēn , dàn shuō huà bù zhòng .
meaning: She takes it seriously without speaking harshly.

text: 我答应周二陪你吃饭。
pinyin: wǒ dā yìng zhōu èr péi nǐ chī fàn .
meaning: I agreed to have dinner with you on Tuesday.

text: 我想解释一下为什么没去。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiě shì yī xià wèi shén me méi qù .
meaning: I’d like to explain why I didn’t go.

text: 她坚持每周给家里打电话。
pinyin: tā jiān chí měi zhōu gěi jiā lǐ dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: She keeps calling home every week.

text: 我不是不想见你，而是今天想早点回家。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng jiàn nǐ , ér shì jīn tiān xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā .
meaning: It isn’t that I don’t want to see you; I want to go home early today.

text: 我怕你不高兴，才一直没说。
pinyin: wǒ pà nǐ bù gāo xìng , cái yì zhí méi shuō .
meaning: I kept quiet because I was worried you’d be upset.

text: 哪怕只坐十分钟，我也想见你一下。
pinyin: nǎ pà zhǐ zuò shí fēn zhōng , wǒ yě xiǎng jiàn nǐ yī xià .
meaning: Even if I can stay only ten minutes, I still want to see you.

text: 约好具体时间，比只说以后再约更有用。
pinyin: yuē hǎo jù tǐ shí jiān , bǐ zhǐ shuō yǐ hòu zài yuē gèng yǒu yòng .
meaning: Agreeing a specific time is more useful than just saying we’ll meet sometime.

text: 这次我不去，周二想单独和你吃饭。
pinyin: zhè cì wǒ bù qù , zhōu èr xiǎng dān dú hé nǐ chī fàn .
meaning: I will skip this one; I would like dinner with you on Tuesday.

text: 我回复晚了，让你不好算人数。
pinyin: wǒ huí fù wǎn le , ràng nǐ bù hǎo suàn rén shù .
meaning: I replied late, which made the headcount difficult.

text: 调皮
pinyin: tiáo pí
meaning: mischievous; playful

text: 这个孩子有点调皮，但不爱骗人。
pinyin: zhè gè hái zi yǒu diǎn tiáo pí , dàn bù ài piàn rén .
meaning: This child is a little mischievous but doesn’t like lying.

text: 过分
pinyin: guò fèn
meaning: excessive; go too far

text: 让一个人做完这些，太过分了。
pinyin: ràng yī gè rén zuò wán zhè xiē , tài guò fèn le .
meaning: Making one person do all this is too much.

text: 天真
pinyin: tiān zhēn
meaning: innocent; naive

text: 小时候我天真地以为月亮会跟着我走。
pinyin: xiǎo shí hòu wǒ tiān zhēn de yǐ wéi yuè liàng huì gēn zhe wǒ zǒu .
meaning: As a child I naively thought the moon followed me.

text: 得意
pinyin: dé yì
meaning: pleased with oneself; smug

text: 他赢了以后，笑得很得意。
pinyin: tā yíng le yǐ hòu , xiào de hěn dé yì .
meaning: After winning he smiled smugly.

text: 大方
pinyin: dà fāng
meaning: generous; at ease in manner

text: 她很大方，把自己的书借给大家。
pinyin: tā hěn dà fāng , bǎ zì jǐ de shū jiè gěi dà jiā .
meaning: She’s generous and lends everyone her books.

text: 看不起
pinyin: kàn bù qǐ
meaning: look down on

text: 他从来不因为工作不同就看不起别人。
pinyin: tā cóng lái bù yīn wèi gōng zuò bù tóng jiù kàn bù qǐ bié ren .
meaning: He never looks down on people for doing different work.

text: 自信
pinyin: zì xìn
meaning: self-confident; confidence

text: 准备以后，我比刚才自信多了。
pinyin: zhǔn bèi yǐ hòu , wǒ bǐ gāng cái zì xìn duō le .
meaning: After preparing I’m much more confident than before.

text: 亲密
pinyin: qīn mì
meaning: close; intimate

text: 他们从小一起长大，关系很亲密。
pinyin: tā men cóng xiǎo yì qǐ zhǎng dà , guān xì hěn qīn mì .
meaning: They grew up together and are very close.

text: 语法
pinyin: yǔ fǎ
meaning: grammar

text: 这句语法没错，但不适合这个场合。
pinyin: zhè jù yǔ fǎ méi cuò , dàn bù shì hé zhè gè chǎng hé .
meaning: The grammar is correct, but it doesn’t fit this situation.

text: 语音
pinyin: yǔ yīn
meaning: speech sounds; voice message

text: 这次课先练语音，再练对话。
pinyin: zhè cì kè xiān liàn yǔ yīn , zài liàn duì huà .
meaning: This class practises speech sounds before dialogue.

text: 形容
pinyin: xíng róng
meaning: describe

text: 你会怎么形容这个人的表情？
pinyin: nǐ huì zěn me xíng róng zhè gè rén de biǎo qíng ?
meaning: How would you describe this person’s expression?

text: 我把他的玩笑当真，误会了。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ tā de wán xiào dàng zhēn , wù huì le .
meaning: I took his joke seriously and misunderstood.

text: 这个话题我们上次聊过。
pinyin: zhè gè huà tí wǒ men shàng cì liáo guò .
meaning: We talked about this topic last time.

text: 他们关系很好，但意见不总一样。
pinyin: tā men guān xì hěn hǎo , dàn yì jiàn bù zǒng yī yàng .
meaning: They have a good relationship but don’t always agree.

text: 他说话时表情很认真。
pinyin: tā shuō huà shí biǎo qíng hěn rèn zhēn .
meaning: His expression was serious as he spoke.

text: 放松
pinyin: fàng sōng
meaning: relax; loosen

text: 先坐一会儿，放松一下。
pinyin: xiān zuò yī huì er , fàng sōng yī xià .
meaning: Sit for a while and relax.

text: 你今天可真早。
pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān kě zhēn zǎo .
meaning: You’re really early today.

text: 这件外套怪好看的。
pinyin: zhè jiàn wài tào guài hǎo kàn de .
meaning: This coat is quite nice.

text: 我才不要这个奖呢。
pinyin: wǒ cái bú yào zhè gè jiǎng ne .
meaning: I don’t want this award.

text: 还没吃怎么夸味道？
pinyin: hái méi chī zěn me kuā wèi dào ?
meaning: How can I praise the taste before eating?

text: 我刚才开玩笑的，不过那句说得不合适。
pinyin: wǒ gāng cái kāi wán xiào de , bù guò nà jù shuō de bù hé shì .
meaning: I was joking, but that line was not well chosen.

text: 没关系，先坐吧，我告诉你刚才说到哪儿。
pinyin: méi guān xì , xiān zuò ba , wǒ gào sù nǐ gāng cái shuō dào nǎr .
meaning: It is okay; sit down and I will tell you where we got to.

text: 概括
pinyin: gài kuò
meaning: summarise; give the main points

text: 你能用两句话概括这个故事吗？
pinyin: nǐ néng yòng liǎng jù huà gài kuò zhè gè gù shì ma ?
meaning: Can you summarise this story in two sentences?

text: 先描述你看到的，再说你怎么想。
pinyin: xiān miáo shù nǐ kàn dào de , zài shuō nǐ zěn me xiǎng .
meaning: Describe what you saw before saying what you think.

text: 主题
pinyin: zhǔ tí
meaning: theme; main subject

text: 这篇文章的主题是离开家以后怎样交朋友。
pinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng de zhǔ tí shì lí kāi jiā yǐ hòu zěn yàng jiāo péng yǒu .
meaning: This article is about making friends after leaving home.

text: 顺序
pinyin: shùn xù
meaning: order; sequence

text: 把这些事按发生的顺序讲。
pinyin: bǎ zhè xiē shì àn fā shēng de shùn xù jiǎng .
meaning: Tell these events in the order they happened.

text: 故事的背景是一座小城。
pinyin: gù shì de bèi jǐng shì yī zuò xiǎo chéng .
meaning: The story is set in a small town.

text: 这个角色一开始不愿意说实话。
pinyin: zhè gè jué sè yī kāi shǐ bù yuàn yì shuō shí huà .
meaning: This character doesn’t want to tell the truth at first.

text: 别忘了信放在桌上的那个细节。
pinyin: bié wàng le xìn fàng zài zhuō shàng de nà gè xì jié .
meaning: Don’t forget the detail about the letter on the table.

text: 我们现在还不能下这个结论。
pinyin: wǒ men xiàn zài hái bù néng xià zhè gè jié lùn .
meaning: We can’t draw that conclusion yet.

text: 他离开的原因是什么？
pinyin: tā lí kāi de yuán yīn shì shén me ?
meaning: Why did he leave?

text: 最后的结果和我想的不一样。
pinyin: zuì hòu de jié guǒ hé wǒ xiǎng de bù yī yàng .
meaning: The final outcome differs from what I expected.

text: 于是
pinyin: yú shì
meaning: so; thereupon

text: 雨突然大了，于是我们进了旁边的店。
pinyin: yǔ tū rán dà le , yú shì wǒ men jìn le páng biān de diàn .
meaning: The rain suddenly got heavier, so we went into the shop beside us.

text: 从此
pinyin: cóng cǐ
meaning: from then on

text: 从此，她每年都会回来看一次。
pinyin: cóng cǐ , tā měi nián dū huì huí lái kàn yī cì .
meaning: From then on she returned once a year.

text: 最初
pinyin: zuì chū
meaning: initially; at first

text: 我最初以为他不来了。
pinyin: wǒ zuì chū yǐ wéi tā bù lái le .
meaning: At first I thought he wasn’t coming.

text: 最后，你总结一下今天讨论的内容。
pinyin: zuì hòu , nǐ zǒng jié yī xià jīn tiān tǎo lùn de nèi róng .
meaning: At the end, sum up what we discussed today.

text: 哪一个画面给你的印象最深？
pinyin: nǎ yī gè huà miàn gěi nǐ de yìn xiàng zuì shēn ?
meaning: Which image made the strongest impression on you?

text: 这是我第一次一个人旅行的经历。
pinyin: zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì yī gè rén lǚ xíng de jīng lì .
meaning: This was my first experience of travelling alone.

text: 他看见身份证，于是给妹妹打电话。
pinyin: tā kàn jiàn shēn fèn zhèng , yú shì gěi mèi mei dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: He saw the ID and then called his sister.

text: 从此，她每年都去一次。
pinyin: cóng cǐ , tā měi nián dōu qù yī cì .
meaning: From then on she went once a year.

text: 他先看见纸条，又发现身份证，再给她打电话。
pinyin: tā xiān kàn jiàn zhǐ tiáo , yòu fā xiàn shēn fèn zhèng , zài gěi tā dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: He saw the note, found the ID and then called her.

text: 她不是不要帮助，只是不想每次都让哥哥送。
pinyin: tā bù shì bú yào bāng zhù , zhǐ shì bù xiǎng měi cì dōu ràng gē gē sòng .
meaning: She doesn’t reject help; she doesn’t want her brother to take her every time.

text: 我猜他可能担心，不过场景没有直接说。
pinyin: wǒ cāi tā kě néng dān xīn , bù guò chǎng jǐng méi yǒu zhí jiē shuō .
meaning: I guess he may be worried, but the scene does not directly say so.

text: 她忘了证件，哥哥送到车站，她仍然自己上了车。
pinyin: tā wàng le zhèng jiàn , gē gē sòng dào chē zhàn , tā réng rán zì jǐ shàng le chē .
meaning: She forgot her ID, her brother brought it to the station, and she still boarded on her own.

text: 冲突
pinyin: chōng tū
meaning: conflict; clash

text: 这两个安排有时间冲突。
pinyin: zhè liǎng gè ān pái yǒu shí jiān chōng tū .
meaning: These two arrangements clash in time.

text: 沟通
pinyin: gōu tōng
meaning: communicate

text: 有变化就早点沟通，别等到最后。
pinyin: yǒu biàn huà jiù zǎo diǎn gōu tōng , bié děng dào zuì hòu .
meaning: Communicate changes early rather than at the last moment.

text: 真诚
pinyin: zhēn chéng
meaning: sincere

text: 她的感谢很真诚，不是随口说的。
pinyin: tā de gǎn xiè hěn zhēn chéng , bù shì suí kǒu shuō de .
meaning: Her thanks are sincere, not just casual words.

text: 尊重
pinyin: zūn zhòng
meaning: respect

text: 我尊重你的决定，但想问清楚原因。
pinyin: wǒ zūn zhòng nǐ de jué dìng , dàn xiǎng wèn qīng chǔ yuán yīn .
meaning: I respect your decision but want to understand the reason.

text: 矛盾
pinyin: máo dùn
meaning: contradiction; conflict

text: 他说不在乎，却一直抱怨，这有点矛盾。
pinyin: tā shuō bù zài hū , què yì zhí bào yuàn , zhè yǒu diǎn máo dùn .
meaning: He says he doesn’t care but keeps complaining; that seems contradictory.

text: 抱怨
pinyin: bào yuàn
meaning: complain

text: 她抱怨等了很久，却没人告诉她原因。
pinyin: tā bào yuàn děng le hěn jiǔ , què méi rén gào sù tā yuán yīn .
meaning: She complained she’d waited a long time without anyone explaining why.

text: 偶然
pinyin: ǒu rán
meaning: by chance; accidental

text: 我们在车站偶然遇见了。
pinyin: wǒ men zài chē zhàn ǒu rán yù jiàn le .
meaning: We ran into each other at the station by chance.

text: 失误
pinyin: shī wù
meaning: mistake; error

text: 这次失误是我把时间记错了。
pinyin: zhè cì shī wù shì wǒ bǎ shí jiān jì cuò le .
meaning: My mistake this time was remembering the time incorrectly.

text: 无奈
pinyin: wú nài
meaning: helpless; having no good option

text: 她无奈地笑了，说车已经走了。
pinyin: tā wú nài de xiào le , shuō chē yǐ jīng zǒu le .
meaning: She smiled helplessly and said the bus had gone.

text: 消极
pinyin: xiāo jí
meaning: negative; passive

text: 一直等别人决定，太消极了。
pinyin: yì zhí děng bié ren jué dìng , tài xiāo jí le .
meaning: Waiting for others to decide is too passive.

text: 友谊
pinyin: yǒu yì
meaning: friendship

text: 我们的友谊不是靠每天见面维持的。
pinyin: wǒ men de yǒu yì bù shì kào měi tiān jiàn miàn wéi chí de .
meaning: Our friendship doesn’t depend on meeting every day.

text: 珍惜
pinyin: zhēn xī
meaning: cherish; value

text: 我很珍惜能一起做事的机会。
pinyin: wǒ hěn zhēn xī néng yì qǐ zuò shì de jī huì .
meaning: I value the chance to work together.

text: 联络
pinyin: lián luò
meaning: contact; keep in touch

text: 到了以后，我会和你联络。
pinyin: dào le yǐ hòu , wǒ huì hé nǐ lián luò .
meaning: I’ll contact you after arriving.

text: 指责
pinyin: zhǐ zé
meaning: accuse; criticise

text: 我想讨论这次安排，不是指责你这个人。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng tǎo lùn zhè cì ān pái , bù shì zhǐ zé nǐ zhè gè rén .
meaning: I want to discuss this arrangement, not attack you as a person.

text: 犹豫
pinyin: yóu yù
meaning: hesitate

text: 我犹豫了一下，还是给她打了电话。
pinyin: wǒ yóu yù le yī xià , hái shi gěi tā dǎ le diàn huà .
meaning: I hesitated briefly, then called her anyway.

text: 误解
pinyin: wù jiě
meaning: misunderstand; misunderstanding

text: 我担心你误解了那句话。
pinyin: wǒ dān xīn nǐ wù jiě le nà jù huà .
meaning: I’m worried you misunderstood that sentence.

text: 这次多出来的工作，我来承担。
pinyin: zhè cì duō chū lái de gōng zuò , wǒ lái chéng dān .
meaning: I’ll take on the extra work this time.

text: 我不能保证几点到，会再告诉你。
pinyin: wǒ bù néng bǎo zhèng jǐ diǎn dào , huì zài gào sù nǐ .
meaning: I can’t promise an arrival time; I’ll update you.

text: 她很可靠，有变化会主动说。
pinyin: tā hěn kě kào , yǒu biàn huà huì zhǔ dòng shuō .
meaning: She’s reliable and says when something changes.

text: 我信任你，才把这件事交给你。
pinyin: wǒ xìn rèn nǐ , cái bǎ zhè jiàn shì jiāo gěi nǐ .
meaning: I entrusted you with this because I trust you.

text: 我承认这次没有及时联系你。
pinyin: wǒ chéng rèn zhè cì méi yǒu jí shí lián xì nǐ .
meaning: I admit I didn’t contact you promptly this time.

text: 我等过以后，才体会到你的感受。
pinyin: wǒ děng guò yǐ hòu , cái tǐ huì dào nǐ de gǎn shòu .
meaning: After waiting myself, I understood how you felt.

text: 耐心
pinyin: nài xīn
meaning: patience; patient

text: 谢谢你耐心听我说完。
pinyin: xiè xiè nǐ nài xīn tīng wǒ shuō wán .
meaning: Thank you for patiently hearing me out.

text: 尊敬
pinyin: zūn jìng
meaning: respect; hold in esteem

text: 我很尊敬这位老师，她总会认真回答。
pinyin: wǒ hěn zūn jìng zhè wèi lǎo shī , tā zǒng huì rèn zhēn huí dá .
meaning: I respect this teacher; she always answers thoughtfully.

text: 我们毕竟约好了，他会等也正常。
pinyin: wǒ men bì jìng yuē hǎo le , tā huì děng yě zhèng cháng .
meaning: After all, we had made a plan; it makes sense he waited.

text: 我们明明约了两点，你却三点才来。
pinyin: wǒ men míng míng yuē le liǎng diǎn , nǐ què sān diǎn cái lái .
meaning: We agreed on two, yet you only came at three.

text: 他没来，邻居倒是主动帮了忙。
pinyin: tā méi lái , lín jū dǎo shì zhǔ dòng bāng le máng .
meaning: He did not come, but the neighbour unexpectedly offered help.

text: 尽管会议是临时的，但是我仍然该联系你。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn huì yì shì lín shí de , dàn shì wǒ réng rán gāi lián xì nǐ .
meaning: Although the meeting came up unexpectedly, I still should have contacted you.

text: 我不是抱怨你忙，而是想知道你来不来。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì bào yuàn nǐ máng , ér shì xiǎng zhī dào nǐ lái bù lái .
meaning: I am not complaining that you are busy; I want to know whether you are coming.

text: 我不知道你还来不来，所以一直没有找别人。
pinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ hái lái bù lái , suǒ yǐ yì zhí méi yǒu zhǎo bié ren .
meaning: I did not know whether you were still coming, so I did not ask someone else.

text: 我四点可以到，三点以前不能保证。
pinyin: wǒ sì diǎn kě yǐ dào , sān diǎn yǐ qián bù néng bǎo zhèng .
meaning: I can arrive at four; I cannot guarantee before three.

text: 我没有及时联系你，让你不好改安排。
pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu jí shí lián xì nǐ , ràng nǐ bù hǎo gǎi ān pái .
meaning: I did not contact you promptly, which made changing plans difficult.

text: 安慰
pinyin: ān wèi
meaning: comfort; reassure

text: 谢谢你安慰我，不过我想先安静一会儿。
pinyin: xiè xiè nǐ ān wèi wǒ , bù guò wǒ xiǎng xiān ān jìng yī huì er .
meaning: Thanks for comforting me, but I’d like a quiet moment first.

text: 你能耐心听完，再说哪里要改吗？
pinyin: nǐ néng nài xīn tīng wán , zài shuō nǎ lǐ yào gǎi ma ?
meaning: Could you listen patiently to the end before saying what to change?

text: 心态
pinyin: xīn tài
meaning: mindset; attitude

text: 我想换个心态，把这次当作练习。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng huàn gè xīn tài , bǎ zhè cì dàng zuò liàn xí .
meaning: I’d like to treat this as practice with a different mindset.

text: 心疼
pinyin: xīn téng
meaning: feel for someone; feel distressed about

text: 看你忙了这么久，我有点心疼。
pinyin: kàn nǐ máng le zhè me jiǔ , wǒ yǒu diǎn xīn téng .
meaning: I feel for you after seeing how long you’ve been busy.

text: 鼓励
pinyin: gǔ lì
meaning: encourage

text: 老师鼓励我再试一次。
pinyin: lǎo shī gǔ lì wǒ zài shì yī cì .
meaning: The teacher encouraged me to try again.

text: 打击
pinyin: dǎ jī
meaning: blow; discourage; strike

text: 这次结果对他的打击很大。
pinyin: zhè cì jié guǒ duì tā de dǎ jī hěn dà .
meaning: This result was a major blow to him.

text: 我在第二句有一个失误。
pinyin: wǒ zài dì èr jù yǒu yī gè shī wù .
meaning: I made a mistake in the second line.

text: 没有达到自己的目标，我有点失望。
pinyin: méi yǒu dá dào zì jǐ de mù biāo , wǒ yǒu diǎn shī wàng .
meaning: I’m a little disappointed I didn’t reach my own goal.

text: 自豪
pinyin: zì háo
meaning: proud

text: 我为她坚持完成这件事感到自豪。
pinyin: wǒ wèi tā jiān chí wán chéng zhè jiàn shì gǎn dào zì háo .
meaning: I’m proud of her for seeing it through.

text: 勇气
pinyin: yǒng qì
meaning: courage

text: 第一次上台，我用了很大勇气。
pinyin: dì yī cì shàng tái , wǒ yòng le hěn dà yǒng qì .
meaning: It took courage for me to go on stage the first time.

text: 吃力
pinyin: chī lì
meaning: strenuous; have difficulty

text: 这段太快，我跟得很吃力。
pinyin: zhè duàn tài kuài , wǒ gēn de hěn chī lì .
meaning: This part is so fast I struggle to keep up.

text: 恢复
pinyin: huī fù
meaning: recover; restore

text: 休息以后，我恢复了一点精神。
pinyin: xiū xī yǐ hòu , wǒ huī fù le yī diǎn jīng shén .
meaning: After resting, I got some energy back.

text: 缺乏
pinyin: quē fá
meaning: lack

text: 我不是不想说，只是缺乏练习机会。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng shuō , zhǐ shì quē fá liàn xí jī huì .
meaning: I do want to speak; I just lack chances to practise.

text: 难以
pinyin: nán yǐ
meaning: difficult to

text: 第一次听，难以判断他是什么意思。
pinyin: dì yī cì tīng , nán yǐ pàn duàn tā shì shén me yì si .
meaning: On first hearing, it’s difficult to judge what he means.

text: 渴望
pinyin: kě wàng
meaning: long for; strongly desire

text: 她渴望有一次自己选择的机会。
pinyin: tā kě wàng yǒu yī cì zì jǐ xuǎn zé de jī huì .
meaning: She longs for a chance to choose for herself.

text: 他无奈地说，票已经卖完了。
pinyin: tā wú nài de shuō , piào yǐ jīng mài wán le .
meaning: He said helplessly that the tickets had sold out.

text: 受不了
pinyin: shòu bù liǎo
meaning: cannot bear

text: 我受不了大家同时说话，听不清。
pinyin: wǒ shòu bù liǎo dà jiā tóng shí shuō huà , tīng bù qīng .
meaning: I can’t cope with everyone talking at once; I can’t hear clearly.

text: 我担心自己又会漏掉第二句。
pinyin: wǒ dān xīn zì jǐ yòu huì lòu diào dì èr jù .
meaning: I’m worried I’ll miss the second line again.

text: 我还在适应台上的声音。
pinyin: wǒ hái zài shì yìng tái shàng de shēng yīn .
meaning: I’m still getting used to the sound on stage.

text: 依然
pinyin: yī rán
meaning: still; remain

text: 练完以后，我依然有点紧张。
pinyin: liàn wán yǐ hòu , wǒ yī rán yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng .
meaning: After practising I was still a little nervous.

text: 主观
pinyin: zhǔ guān
meaning: subjective

text: 这只是我的主观感受，你可以不一样。
pinyin: zhè zhǐ shì wǒ de zhǔ guān gǎn shòu , nǐ kě yǐ bù yī yàng .
meaning: This is only my subjective impression; yours may differ.

text: 预期
pinyin: yù qī
meaning: expectation; expected

text: 这次效果比我的预期好。
pinyin: zhè cì xiào guǒ bǐ wǒ de yù qī hǎo .
meaning: The result was better than I expected.

text: 情形
pinyin: qíng xíng
meaning: situation; circumstances

text: 当时是什么情形，你再说详细一点。
pinyin: dāng shí shì shén me qíng xíng , nǐ zài shuō xiáng xì yī diǎn .
meaning: Tell me more about what was happening at the time.

text: 鼓掌
pinyin: gǔ zhǎng
meaning: applaud; clap

text: 演出结束以后，大家一起鼓掌。
pinyin: yǎn chū jié shù yǐ hòu , dà jiā yì qǐ gǔ zhǎng .
meaning: Everyone applauded after the performance.

text: 紧张归紧张，你还是唱完了。
pinyin: jǐn zhāng guī jǐn zhāng , nǐ hái shi chàng wán le .
meaning: Nervous or not, you still finished.

text: 再紧张，我也想把它唱完。
pinyin: zài jǐn zhāng , wǒ yě xiǎng bǎ tā chàng wán .
meaning: However nervous I am, I still want to finish it.

text: 音乐快得我都跟不上了。
pinyin: yīn yuè kuài de wǒ dōu gēn bù shàng le .
meaning: The music is so fast I cannot keep up.

text: 在我看来，后面接上了也是进步。
pinyin: zài wǒ kàn lái , hòu miàn jiē shàng le yě shì jìn bù .
meaning: In my view, picking it up afterwards is progress too.

text: 现在听，还是吃完东西再听？
pinyin: xiàn zài tīng , hái shi chī wán dōng xi zài tīng ?
meaning: Listen now, or after eating?

text: 你想说说，还是先安静一会儿？
pinyin: nǐ xiǎng shuō shuō , hái shi xiān ān jìng yī huì er ?
meaning: Would you like to talk, or have a quiet moment first?

text: 我听见第二句停了一下，后来又接上了。
pinyin: wǒ tīng jiàn dì èr jù tíng le yī xià , hòu lái yòu jiē shàng le .
meaning: I heard a pause in the second line, followed by a recovery.

text: 我告诉大家你等会儿回去，行吗？
pinyin: wǒ gào sù dà jiā nǐ děng huì ér huí qù , xíng ma ?
meaning: May I tell the others you will be back later?

text: 诗歌
pinyin: shī gē
meaning: poetry; poem

text: 这首诗歌写的是离开家以后的生活。
pinyin: zhè shǒu shī gē xiě de shì lí kāi jiā yǐ hòu de shēng huó .
meaning: This poem is about life after leaving home.

text: 歌曲
pinyin: gē qǔ
meaning: song

text: 你想先练哪一首歌曲？
pinyin: nǐ xiǎng xiān liàn nǎ yī shǒu gē qǔ ?
meaning: Which song would you like to practise first?

text: 专辑
pinyin: zhuān jí
meaning: album

text: 这张专辑里有两首我很喜欢的歌。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhuān jí lǐ yǒu liǎng shǒu wǒ hěn xǐ huān de gē .
meaning: There are two songs I really like on this album.

text: 浪漫
pinyin: làng màn
meaning: romantic

text: 你觉得这个故事浪漫，我觉得有点难过。
pinyin: nǐ jué de zhè gè gù shì làng màn , wǒ jué de yǒu diǎn nán guò .
meaning: You find this story romantic; I find it a little sad.

text: 象征
pinyin: xiàng zhēng
meaning: symbolise; symbol

text: 这里的灯象征有人在等。
pinyin: zhè lǐ de dēng xiàng zhēng yǒu rén zài děng .
meaning: The light here symbolises someone waiting.

text: 联想
pinyin: lián xiǎng
meaning: association; associate

text: 这个声音让我联想到小时候的院子。
pinyin: zhè gè shēng yīn ràng wǒ lián xiǎng dào xiǎo shí hòu de yuàn zi .
meaning: This sound makes me think of my childhood courtyard.

text: 内在
pinyin: nèi zài
meaning: inner; intrinsic

text: 故事看起来很安静，内在的冲突却很强。
pinyin: gù shì kàn qǐ lái hěn ān jìng , nèi zài de chōng tū què hěn qiáng .
meaning: The story looks quiet but has a strong inner conflict.

text: 记忆
pinyin: jì yì
meaning: memory

text: 这件事一直留在我的记忆里。
pinyin: zhè jiàn shì yì zhí liú zài wǒ de jì yì lǐ .
meaning: This event has stayed in my memory.

text: 回忆
pinyin: huí yì
meaning: recall; memory

text: 我想回忆一下那天到底怎么说的。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng huí yì yī xià nà tiān dào dǐ zěn me shuō de .
meaning: I’d like to recall exactly what was said that day.

text: 时光
pinyin: shí guāng
meaning: time; a period of life

text: 我们一起练习的时光很短，但我记得很清楚。
pinyin: wǒ men yì qǐ liàn xí de shí guāng hěn duǎn , dàn wǒ jì de hěn qīng chǔ .
meaning: Our time practising together was short, but I remember it clearly.

text: 岁月
pinyin: suì yuè
meaning: years; passage of time

text: 岁月过去，老屋的门已经换了。
pinyin: suì yuè guò qù , lǎo wū de mén yǐ jīng huàn le .
meaning: The years passed, and the old house has a new door.

text: 漫长
pinyin: màn cháng
meaning: long; prolonged

text: 等消息的那一晚很漫长。
pinyin: děng xiāo xī de nà yī wǎn hěn màn cháng .
meaning: That night waiting for news felt very long.

text: 舍不得
pinyin: shě bu de
meaning: be reluctant to part with or give up

text: 这件旧外套我一直舍不得扔。
pinyin: zhè jiàn jiù wài tào wǒ yì zhí shě bù de rēng .
meaning: I’ve never wanted to throw this old coat away.

text: 我想珍惜现在能见面的时间。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhēn xī xiàn zài néng jiàn miàn de shí jiān .
meaning: I want to value the time when we can meet now.

text: 他渴望再听见那个熟悉的声音。
pinyin: tā kě wàng zài tīng jiàn nà gè shú xī de shēng yīn .
meaning: He longs to hear that familiar voice again.

text: 散文
pinyin: sǎn wén
meaning: prose essay

text: 这篇散文把很小的事写得很有意思。
pinyin: zhè piān sǎn wén bǎ hěn xiǎo de shì xiě de hěn yǒu yì si .
meaning: This essay makes a small event interesting.

text: 感想
pinyin: gǎn xiǎng
meaning: thoughts; impressions after an experience

text: 看完以后，你有什么感想？
pinyin: kàn wán yǐ hòu , nǐ yǒu shén me gǎn xiǎng ?
meaning: What are your thoughts after watching?

text: 回顾
pinyin: huí gù
meaning: look back; review

text: 我们一起回顾了去年做过的事。
pinyin: wǒ men yì qǐ huí gù le qù nián zuò guò de shì .
meaning: We looked back at what we’d done last year.

text: 情节
pinyin: qíng jié
meaning: plot; storyline

text: 我记不清每个情节，但记得最后的画面。
pinyin: wǒ jì bù qīng měi gè qíng jié , dàn jì de zuì hòu de huà miàn .
meaning: I can’t recall every plot detail but remember the final image.

text: 这段的主题不只是等一个人回来。
pinyin: zhè duàn de zhǔ tí bù zhǐ shì děng yī gè rén huí lái .
meaning: This section’s theme isn’t only waiting for someone to return.

text: 画面
pinyin: huà miàn
meaning: image; scene

text: 这句话让人想到很安静的画面。
pinyin: zhè jù huà ràng rén xiǎng dào hěn ān jìng de huà miàn .
meaning: This sentence suggests a very quiet image.

text: 模仿
pinyin: mó fǎng
meaning: imitate

text: 我可以模仿这个读法，再听哪里不同。
pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ mó fǎng zhè gè dú fǎ , zài tīng nǎ lǐ bù tóng .
meaning: I can imitate this reading and listen for differences.

text: 单看这句，含义还不清楚。
pinyin: dān kàn zhè jù , hán yì hái bù qīng chǔ .
meaning: The meaning isn’t clear from this line alone.

text: 你会用什么词形容这种感觉？
pinyin: nǐ huì yòng shén me cí xíng róng zhè zhǒng gǎn jué ?
meaning: What word would you use to describe this feeling?

text: 随着时间过去，纸上的颜色慢慢变淡。
pinyin: suí zhe shí jiān guò qù , zhǐ shàng de yán sè màn màn biàn dàn .
meaning: As time passes, the colours on the paper gradually fade.

text: 这里不是说路突然变长，而是说回去的感觉变了。
pinyin: zhè lǐ bù shì shuō lù tū rán biàn zhǎng , ér shì shuō huí qù de gǎn jué biàn le .
meaning: Here it is not a suddenly lengthened road but a changed feeling about returning.

text: 这段既写离开，也写舍不得。
pinyin: zhè duàn jì xiě lí kāi , yě xiě shě bù de .
meaning: This section describes both leaving and reluctance to part.

text: 这里的你不一定是恋人。
pinyin: zhè lǐ de nǐ bù yí dìng shì liàn rén .
meaning: The you here is not necessarily a lover.

text: 我把照片装进包里。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ zhào piān zhuāng jìn bāo lǐ .
meaning: I put the photograph in the bag.

text: 哪句话让你这样想？
pinyin: nǎ jù huà ràng nǐ zhè yàng xiǎng ?
meaning: Which line makes you think that?

text: 我先想到恋人，不过也可能是在想家。
pinyin: wǒ xiān xiǎng dào liàn rén , bù guò yě kě néng shì zài xiǎng jiā .
meaning: I thought of a lover first, but it might also be about missing home.

text: 你的读法也有道理，最后两句能支持。
pinyin: nǐ de dú fǎ yě yǒu dào lǐ , zuì hòu liǎng jù néng zhī chí .
meaning: Your reading makes sense too; the final lines support it.

text: 真相
pinyin: zhēn xiàng
meaning: what actually happened; truth

text: 真相和我开始想的完全不同。
pinyin: zhēn xiàng hé wǒ kāi shǐ xiǎng de wán quán bù tóng .
meaning: What actually happened was completely different from my first idea.

text: 线索
pinyin: xiàn suǒ
meaning: clue

text: 门上的纸是我们找到新地方的线索。
pinyin: mén shàng de zhǐ shì wǒ men zhǎo dào xīn dì fāng de xiàn suǒ .
meaning: The paper on the door is a clue to finding the new venue.

text: 关键
pinyin: guān jiàn
meaning: key; crucial

text: 关键是他当时还没有看到消息。
pinyin: guān jiàn shì tā dāng shí hái méi yǒu kàn dào xiāo xī .
meaning: The key is that he had not seen the message then.

text: 分析
pinyin: fēn xī
meaning: analyse; analysis

text: 先说发生了什么，再分析为什么。
pinyin: xiān shuō fā shēng le shén me , zài fēn xī wèi shén me .
meaning: First say what happened, then analyse why.

text: 逻辑
pinyin: luó jí
meaning: logic

text: 按这个逻辑，发过消息就等于对方看过，可这不对。
pinyin: àn zhè gè luó jí , fā guò xiāo xī jiù děng yú duì fāng kàn guò , kě zhè bú duì .
meaning: By that logic, sending a message means the other person read it, but that is wrong.

text: 这个误解来自两个人知道的事情不同。
pinyin: zhè gè wù jiě lái zì liǎng gè rén zhī dào de shì qíng bù tóng .
meaning: The misunderstanding comes from the two people knowing different things.

text: 暂时
pinyin: zàn shí
meaning: temporarily; for now

text: 我们暂时在小厅等。
pinyin: wǒ men zàn shí zài xiǎo tīng děng .
meaning: We are waiting in the small hall for now.

text: 总算
pinyin: zǒng suàn
meaning: finally; at last

text: 我总算找到你们了。
pinyin: wǒ zǒng suàn zhǎo dào nǐ men le .
meaning: I finally found you all.

text: 居然
pinyin: jū rán
meaning: unexpectedly; to one’s surprise

text: 我居然在门口等了这么久。
pinyin: wǒ jū rán zài mén kǒu děng le zhè me jiǔ .
meaning: I cannot believe I waited at the door so long.

text: 干脆
pinyin: gān cuì
meaning: simply; decisively

text: 手机没电，干脆借一个打电话吧。
pinyin: shǒu jī méi diàn , gān cuì jiè yī gè dǎ diàn huà ba .
meaning: The phone is dead; let’s simply borrow one to make a call.

text: 毕竟
pinyin: bì jìng
meaning: after all

text: 毕竟他没有看到消息，不能说他故意不来。
pinyin: bì jìng tā méi yǒu kàn dào xiāo xī , bù néng shuō tā gù yì bù lái .
meaning: After all, he did not see the message; we cannot say he deliberately stayed away.

text: 我偶然在门口看见那个通知。
pinyin: wǒ ǒu rán zài mén kǒu kàn jiàn nà gè tōng zhī .
meaning: I happened to notice the sign at the entrance.

text: 怀疑
pinyin: huái yí
meaning: suspect; doubt

text: 我怀疑自己是不是记错了地方。
pinyin: wǒ huái yí zì jǐ shì bú shì jì cuò le dì fāng .
meaning: I wondered whether I had remembered the wrong place.

text: 事实是两个人都到了，只是不在同一个地方。
pinyin: shì shí shì liǎng gè rén dōu dào le , zhǐ shì bù zài tóng yī gè dì fāng .
meaning: The fact is that both arrived, but at different places.

text: 你先解释一下为什么换了地方。
pinyin: nǐ xiān jiě shì yī xià wèi shén me huàn le dì fāng .
meaning: First explain why the venue changed.

text: 下次换地方，我们要确认对方收到。
pinyin: xià cì huàn dì fāng , wǒ men yào què rèn duì fāng shōu dào .
meaning: Next time we change venues, let’s confirm the other person received the update.

text: 他这个表情不一定是在生气。
pinyin: tā zhè gè biǎo qíng bù yí dìng shì zài shēng qì .
meaning: His expression does not necessarily mean he is angry.

text: 这个细节前面已经出现过。
pinyin: zhè gè xì jié qián miàn yǐ jīng chū xiàn guò .
meaning: This detail appeared earlier.

text: 期间
pinyin: qī jiān
meaning: during; period

text: 活动期间，你可以来小厅找我。
pinyin: huó dòng qī jiān , nǐ kě yǐ lái xiǎo tīng zhǎo wǒ .
meaning: During the event, you can find me in the small hall.

text: 之前
pinyin: zhī qián
meaning: before

text: 出门之前，我看过原来的地址。
pinyin: chū mén zhī qián , wǒ kàn guò yuán lái de dì zhǐ .
meaning: Before leaving, I checked the original address.

text: 之后
pinyin: zhī hòu
meaning: after

text: 接通电话之后，他才知道我们在小厅。
pinyin: jiē tōng diàn huà zhī hòu , tā cái zhī dào wǒ men zài xiǎo tīng .
meaning: Only after the call connected did he know we were in the small hall.

text: 只凭一个表情，很难判断他在想什么。
pinyin: zhǐ píng yī gè biǎo qíng , hěn nán pàn duàn tā zài xiǎng shén me .
meaning: It is hard to judge his thoughts from one expression.

text: 我们再观察一下他后面的动作。
pinyin: wǒ men zài guān chá yī xià tā hòu miàn de dòng zuò .
meaning: Let’s observe what he does afterwards.

text: 门口有一个换地方的通知。
pinyin: mén kǒu yǒu yī gè huàn dì fāng de tōng zhī .
meaning: There is a notice at the entrance about the venue change.

text: 直到电话接通，他才知道我在门口。
pinyin: zhí dào diàn huà jiē tōng , tā cái zhī dào wǒ zài mén kǒu .
meaning: Only when the call connected did he know I was at the entrance.

text: 原来你们换地方了。
pinyin: yuán lái nǐ men huàn dì fāng le .
meaning: So you changed venues.

text: 我再等，也看不到小厅里的人。
pinyin: wǒ zài děng , yě kàn bù dào xiǎo tīng lǐ de rén .
meaning: However long I wait, I cannot see the people in the small hall.

text: 幸好接了，不然你可能还在外面。
pinyin: xìng hǎo jiē le , bù rán nǐ kě néng hái zài wài miàn .
meaning: Good thing I answered; otherwise you might still be outside.

text: 我把发过消息当成对方看过。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ fā guò xiāo xī dàng chéng duì fāng kàn guò .
meaning: I treated sending the message as the other person having read it.

text: 我发了，但还没确认你看到。
pinyin: wǒ fā le , dàn hái méi què rèn nǐ kàn dào .
meaning: I sent it, but have not confirmed you saw it.

text: 你刚才是没看到，还是没办法回复？
pinyin: nǐ gāng cái shì méi kàn dào , hái shi méi bàn fǎ huí fù ?
meaning: Did you not see it, or were you unable to reply?

text: 他当时还不知道我的手机没电。
pinyin: tā dāng shí hái bù zhī dào wǒ de shǒu jī méi diàn .
meaning: He did not yet know my phone was dead.

text: 不利
pinyin: bù lì
meaning: unfavourable; disadvantageous

text: 每天睡得太晚，对第二天的学习不利。
pinyin: měi tiān shuì de tài wǎn , duì dì èr tiān de xué xí bù lì .
meaning: Sleeping too late every day is bad for the following day’s study.

text: 我犹豫要不要每次都参加。
pinyin: wǒ yóu yù yào bù yào měi cì dōu cān jiā .
meaning: I’m unsure whether to join every time.

text: 计划太满，结果常和预期不同。
pinyin: jì huà tài mǎn , jié guǒ cháng hé yù qī bù tóng .
meaning: When the plan is too full, the result often differs from expectations.

text: 充足
pinyin: chōng zú
meaning: sufficient; ample

text: 我需要留出充足的休息时间。
pinyin: wǒ xū yào liú chū chōng zú de xiū xī shí jiān .
meaning: I need to leave enough time to rest.

text: 不足
pinyin: bù zú
meaning: insufficient; shortcoming

text: 睡眠不足的时候，我很难听进去。
pinyin: shuì mián bù zú de shí hou , wǒ hěn nán tīng jìn qù .
meaning: When I haven’t slept enough, I struggle to take things in.

text: 减轻
pinyin: jiǎn qīng
meaning: reduce; ease

text: 少安排一个晚上，能减轻一点压力。
pinyin: shǎo ān pái yī gè wǎn shang , néng jiǎn qīng yī diǎn yā lì .
meaning: Scheduling one fewer evening can ease the pressure a little.

text: 效率
pinyin: xiào lǜ
meaning: efficiency

text: 不是坐得越久，效率就越高。
pinyin: bù shì zuò de yuè jiǔ , xiào lǜ jiù yuè gāo .
meaning: Spending longer seated doesn’t necessarily make you more efficient.

text: 精力
pinyin: jīng lì
meaning: energy

text: 我晚上没有那么多精力。
pinyin: wǒ wǎn shang méi yǒu nà me duō jīng lì .
meaning: I don’t have that much energy in the evening.

text: 节省
pinyin: jié shěng
meaning: save; economise

text: 早点把地点说清楚，能节省找路的时间。
pinyin: zǎo diǎn bǎ dì diǎn shuō qīng chǔ , néng jié shěng zhǎo lù de shí jiān .
meaning: Clarifying the location early can save time finding the way.

text: 投入
pinyin: tóu rù
meaning: put in; invest time or effort

text: 这段练习已经投入不少时间。
pinyin: zhè duàn liàn xí yǐ jīng tóu rù bù shǎo shí jiān .
meaning: I’ve already put quite a lot of time into practising this section.

text: 有限
pinyin: yǒu xiàn
meaning: limited

text: 时间有限，我得先选最想做的。
pinyin: shí jiān yǒu xiàn , wǒ děi xiān xuǎn zuì xiǎng zuò de .
meaning: With limited time, I need to choose what I most want to do first.

text: 我想找一个能长期继续的办法。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī gè néng cháng qī jì xù de bàn fǎ .
meaning: I want a method I can sustain long term.

text: 这是短期调整，不是以后都不去了。
pinyin: zhè shì duǎn qī tiáo zhěng , bù shì yǐ hòu dōu bù qù le .
meaning: This is a short-term adjustment, not never going again.

text: 今天先把练习范围缩小到两段。
pinyin: jīn tiān xiān bǎ liàn xí fàn wéi suō xiǎo dào liǎng duàn .
meaning: Let’s limit today’s practice to two sections.

text: 收获
pinyin: shōu huò
meaning: gain; what one gets from an experience

text: 我今天的收获是终于和新朋友聊起来了。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān de shōu huò shì zhōng yú hé xīn péng you liáo qǐ lái le .
meaning: My gain today was finally chatting with a new friend.

text: 试两周以后，我们再调整时间。
pinyin: shì liǎng zhōu yǐ hòu , wǒ men zài tiáo zhěng shí jiān .
meaning: After trying it for two weeks, we’ll adjust the schedule.

text: 规律
pinyin: guī lǜ
meaning: regular pattern; regularity

text: 我想把作息变得规律一点。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zuò xī biàn de guī lǜ yī diǎn .
meaning: I want a slightly more regular routine.

text: 没人提醒，我也会自觉记下没听懂的地方。
pinyin: méi rén tí xǐng , wǒ yě huì zì jué jì xià méi tīng dǒng de dì fāng .
meaning: Without a reminder, I note down the parts I don’t understand.

text: 我想坚持练，不是每次都练到没力气。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiān chí liàn , bù shì měi cì dōu liàn dào méi lì qì .
meaning: I want to keep practising, not exhaust myself each time.

text: 这个方案保留了周六见面的时间。
pinyin: zhè gè fāng àn bǎo liú le zhōu liù jiàn miàn de shí jiān .
meaning: This plan keeps Saturday available for meeting.

text: 把每个晚上都安排满，我反而有压力。
pinyin: bǎ měi gè wǎn shang dōu ān pái mǎn , wǒ fǎn ér yǒu yā lì .
meaning: Filling every evening actually puts pressure on me.

text: 独立
pinyin: dú lì
meaning: independent; independently

text: 有些内容我能独立练，有些需要一起聊。
pinyin: yǒu xiē nèi róng wǒ néng dú lì liàn , yǒu xiē xū yào yì qǐ liáo .
meaning: Some things I can practise independently; others need conversation.

text: 我的目标是能参加聊天，不只是做完题。
pinyin: wǒ de mù biāo shì néng cān jiā liáo tiān , bù zhǐ shì zuò wán tí .
meaning: My goal is joining conversations, not just finishing questions.

text: 这个安排听起来合理，但得试了才知道。
pinyin: zhè gè ān pái tīng qǐ lái hé lǐ , dàn děi shì le cái zhī dào .
meaning: This schedule sounds reasonable, but we’ll need to try it.

text: 既然周一有课，就先不加活动了。
pinyin: jì rán zhōu yī yǒu kè , jiù xiān bù jiā huó dòng le .
meaning: Since there is class on Monday, let us not add an activity then.

text: 除非临时加班，否则我周六会来。
pinyin: chú fēi lín shí jiā bān , fǒu zé wǒ zhōu liù huì lái .
meaning: Unless overtime comes up, I will come Saturday.

text: 我想用这个办法练下去。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yòng zhè gè bàn fǎ liàn xià qù .
meaning: I want to keep practising this way.

text: 我留出周六，为的是和大家聊起来。
pinyin: wǒ liú chū zhōu liù , wèi de shì hé dà jiā liáo qǐ lái .
meaning: I keep Saturday available in order to start talking with everyone.

text: 这两周的周四，我不是上课就是唱歌。
pinyin: zhè liǎng zhōu de zhōu sì , wǒ bù shì shàng kè jiù shì chàng gē .
meaning: On Thursdays these two weeks I am either at class or singing.

text: 这次先不去，下次有合适的再约。
