meaning: I momentarily lost pace and stopped to reread.

text: 重复的那句仿佛换了一个说话的人。
pinyin: chóng fù de nà jù fǎng fú huàn le yī gè shuō huà de rén .
meaning: The repeated line seems to have a different speaker.

text: 好似
pinyin: hǎo sì
meaning: seem like; resemble

text: 那盏灯好似一个没回答的问题。
pinyin: nà zhǎn dēng hǎo sì yī gè méi huí dá de wèn tí .
meaning: That lamp seems like an unanswered question.

text: 幻想
pinyin: huàn xiǎng
meaning: imagine an unreal or hoped-for situation

text: 我幻想过再次见面，歌里没有把它写成事实。
pinyin: wǒ huàn xiǎng guò zài cì jiàn miàn , gē lǐ méi yǒu bǎ tā xiě chéng shì shí .
meaning: I imagined meeting again; the song doesn’t make it a fact.

text: 这一段唱得孤独，下一段又多了一点希望。
pinyin: zhè yī duàn chàng de gū dú , xià yī duàn yòu duō le yī diǎn xī wàng .
meaning: This verse sounds lonely; the next adds some hope.

text: 心灵
pinyin: xīn líng
meaning: inner emotional life; mind or spirit

text: 这首歌让我想起心灵里还没有说出的感受。
pinyin: zhè shǒu gē ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ xīn líng lǐ hái méi yǒu shuō chū de gǎn shòu .
meaning: This song recalls feelings within me that I haven’t yet expressed.

text: 融合
pinyin: róng hé
meaning: blend; integrate

text: 新歌融合两种唱法，但词和旋律都是我们新写的。
pinyin: xīn gē róng hé liǎng zhǒng chàng fǎ , dàn cí hé xuán lǜ dōu shì wǒ men xīn xiě de .
meaning: The new song blends two styles, with newly written words and melody.

text: 元素
pinyin: yuán sù
meaning: element; component

text: 门、灯和风是反复出现的元素。
pinyin: mén , dēng hé fēng shì fǎn fù chū xiàn de yuán sù .
meaning: Door, lamp and wind are recurring elements.

text: 你或是门外的朋友，或是镜中的自己。
pinyin: nǐ huò shì mén wài de péng you , huò shì jìng zhōng de zì jǐ .
meaning: “You” may be the friend outside or the self in the mirror.

text: 你不是已经看过歌词了吗，还漏了那个留字？
pinyin: nǐ bù shì yǐ jīng kàn guò gē cí le ma , hái lòu le nà gè liú zì ?
meaning: Haven’t you already read the lyrics? You still missed that 留?

text: 唱来唱去，都是这几个词在不同地方出现。
pinyin: chàng lái chàng qù , dōu shì zhè jǐ gè cí zài bù tóng dì fāng chū xiàn .
meaning: Across repeated singing the same words appear in different places.

text: 除了漏掉的留字，其他字这遍都唱出来了。
pinyin: chú le lòu diào de liú zì , qí tā zì zhè biàn dōu chàng chū lái le .
meaning: Apart from the omitted 留, the other words were sung this pass.

text: 我这样听，是因为后面有镜子里的我。
pinyin: wǒ zhè yàng tīng , shì yīn wèi hòu miàn yǒu jìng zi lǐ de wǒ .
meaning: I hear it this way because of the later self-in-the-mirror line.

text: 这里是不是少了一个留？我们看一下原稿。
pinyin: zhè lǐ shì bú shì shǎo le yī gè liú ? wǒ men kàn yī xià yuán gǎo .
meaning: Is 留 missing here? Let’s check the page.

text: 这遍先确认词，下一遍再试停顿。
pinyin: zhè biàn xiān què rèn cí , xià yī biàn zài shì tíng dùn .
meaning: Check the words on this pass; try pauses on the next.

text: 百分点
pinyin: bǎi fēn diǎn
meaning: percentage point

text: 百分之二十到百分之三十，增加十个百分点。
pinyin: bǎi fēn zhī èr shí dào bǎi fēn zhī sān shí , zēng jiā shí gè bǎi fēn diǎn .
meaning: Twenty percent to thirty percent is an increase of ten percentage points.

text: 办公
pinyin: bàn gōng
meaning: work in an office; handle office work

text: 我们周二在小厅办公，把两次记录放在一起看。
pinyin: wǒ men zhōu èr zài xiǎo tīng bàn gōng , bǎ liǎng cì jì lù fàng zài yì qǐ kàn .
meaning: We work in the hall Tuesday and compare the two sets of records.

text: 团队
pinyin: tuán duì
meaning: team

text: 团队可以意见不同，不用先找一个输赢。
pinyin: tuán duì kě yǐ yì jiàn bù tóng , bù yòng xiān zhǎo yī gè shū yíng .
meaning: A team can disagree without first declaring a winner.

text: 岗位
pinyin: gǎng wèi
meaning: job position; assigned post

text: 负责联系的岗位还在，不是换封信就不用人了。
pinyin: fù zé lián xì de gǎng wèi hái zài , bù shì huàn fēng xìn jiù bù yòng rén le .
meaning: The contact role is still needed; a new letter doesn’t remove it.

text: 策划
pinyin: cè huà
meaning: plan an event or project

text: 我在策划试点，先写清范围。
pinyin: wǒ zài cè huà shì diǎn , xiān xiě qīng fàn wéi .
meaning: I am planning the trial and first state its scope.

text: 策略
pinyin: cè lüè
meaning: strategy; approach

text: 先小范围试，是这次的策略。
pinyin: xiān xiǎo fàn wéi shì , shì zhè cì de cè lüè .
meaning: Testing on a small scale first is our strategy.

text: 决策
pinyin: jué cè
meaning: make a decision; decision-making

text: 这次决策只同意两周试点，不是永久更换。
pinyin: zhè cì jué cè zhǐ tóng yì liǎng zhōu shì diǎn , bù shì yǒng jiǔ gēng huàn .
meaning: This decision approves only a two-week trial, not a permanent change.

text: 定价
pinyin: dìng jià
meaning: set a price; pricing

text: 定价不在这次讨论范围里，我们先看联系方法。
pinyin: dìng jià bù zài zhè cì tǎo lùn fàn wéi lǐ , wǒ men xiān kàn lián xì fāng fǎ .
meaning: Pricing isn’t in this discussion; we’re examining contact methods.

text: 金额
pinyin: jīn é
meaning: amount of money

text: 记录里没有金额，不能推成收入增加。
pinyin: jì lù lǐ méi yǒu jīn é , bù néng tuī chéng shōu rù zēng jiā .
meaning: The record has no monetary amounts, so it doesn’t establish increased revenue.

text: 试点
pinyin: shì diǎn
meaning: limited pilot or trial

text: 两周试点以后，再决定要不要继续。
pinyin: liǎng zhōu shì diǎn yǐ hòu , zài jué dìng yào bù yào jì xù .
meaning: Decide whether to continue after the two-week trial.

text: 调研
pinyin: diào yán
meaning: investigate needs or circumstances

text: 先做一点调研，问大家为什么没回复。
pinyin: xiān zuò yī diǎn diào yán , wèn dà jiā wèi shén me méi huí fù .
meaning: First investigate why people didn’t reply.

text: 监测
pinyin: jiān cè
meaning: monitor

text: 监测回复数时，也记录发送对象和时间。
pinyin: jiān cè huí fù shù shí , yě jì lù fā sòng duì xiàng hé shí jiān .
meaning: When monitoring replies, record recipients and sending time too.

text: 差异
pinyin: chā yì
meaning: difference

text: 两组人的差异可能影响回复。
pinyin: liǎng zǔ rén de chā yì kě néng yǐng xiǎng huí fù .
meaning: Differences between the groups may affect replies.

text: 衡量
pinyin: héng liáng
meaning: assess; measure against a criterion

text: 衡量工作量，不能只数回复的人。
pinyin: héng liáng gōng zuò liàng , bù néng zhǐ shù huí fù de rén .
meaning: Assessing workload requires more than counting respondents.

text: 因素
pinyin: yīn sù
meaning: factor

text: 发送日期也是一个因素。
pinyin: fā sòng rì qī yě shì yī gè yīn sù .
meaning: The sending date is also a factor.

text: 应对
pinyin: yìng duì
meaning: respond to; deal with

text: 临时改时间，我们要有应对办法。
pinyin: lín shí gǎi shí jiān , wǒ men yào yǒu yìng duì bàn fǎ .
meaning: We need a way to deal with last-minute time changes.

text: 我采纳了把后续时间也记下的建议。
pinyin: wǒ cǎi nà le bǎ hòu xù shí jiān yě jì xià de jiàn yì .
meaning: I adopted the suggestion to record follow-up time too.

text: 陈宇协调发送和统计，不是一个人做全部。
pinyin: chén yǔ xié tiáo fā sòng hé tǒng jì , bù shì yī gè rén zuò quán bù .
meaning: Chen Yu coordinates sending and counts, not does everything himself.

text: 谁做后续，我们先协商，不直接加给林安。
pinyin: shéi zuò hòu xù , wǒ men xiān xié shāng , bù zhí jiē jiā gěi lín ān .
meaning: We discuss follow-up responsibilities before assigning them to Lin An.

text: 听取她的担心，不等于放弃整个想法。
pinyin: tīng qǔ tā de dān xīn , bù děng yú fàng qì zhěng gè xiǎng fǎ .
meaning: Hearing her concerns doesn’t mean abandoning the whole idea.

text: 周四提交修改后的方案。
pinyin: zhōu sì tí jiāo xiū gǎi hòu de fāng àn .
meaning: Submit the revised proposal Thursday.

text: 通报
pinyin: tōng bào
meaning: inform relevant people formally

text: 试点结果先向小组通报，再决定后面。
pinyin: shì diǎn jié guǒ xiān xiàng xiǎo zǔ tōng bào , zài jué dìng hòu miàn .
meaning: Report trial results to the group before deciding what follows.

text: 配置
pinyin: pèi zhì
meaning: allocate; set up resources

text: 现有人员配置只能每周做一小轮。
pinyin: xiàn yǒu rén yuán pèi zhì zhǐ néng měi zhōu zuò yī xiǎo lún .
meaning: Current staffing allows only one small round each week.

text: 关联
pinyin: guān lián
meaning: association; connection

text: 回复增加和换信有关联，不等于已经知道原因。
pinyin: huí fù zēng jiā hé huàn xìn yǒu guān lián , bù děng yú yǐ jīng zhī dào yuán yīn .
meaning: More replies are associated with a new letter, without establishing cause.

text: 核心
pinyin: hé xīn
meaning: core; central point

text: 核心问题是有没有更清楚，不只是更多。
pinyin: hé xīn wèn tí shì yǒu méi yǒu gèng qīng chǔ , bù zhǐ shì gèng duō .
meaning: The core question is whether it is clearer, not merely more.

text: 切实
pinyin: qiè shí
meaning: practical and real

text: 方案要有切实的分工，不能只写全力支持。
pinyin: fāng àn yào yǒu qiè shí de fēn gōng , bù néng zhǐ xiě quán lì zhī chí .
meaning: The proposal needs practical responsibilities, not only “full support.”

text: 常规
pinyin: cháng guī
meaning: routine; standard practice

text: 常规联系继续，试点只占一小部分。
pinyin: cháng guī lián xì jì xù , shì diǎn zhǐ zhàn yī xiǎo bù fèn .
meaning: Routine contact continues; the trial covers a small part.

text: 全力
pinyin: quán lì
meaning: with all one’s effort

text: 愿意全力做好，不代表有无限时间。
pinyin: yuàn yì quán lì zuò hǎo , bù dài biǎo yǒu wú xiàn shí jiān .
meaning: Wanting to do one’s best doesn’t mean having unlimited time.

text: 最终
pinyin: zuì zhōng
meaning: final; ultimately

text: 最终决定要等两周记录完整以后。
pinyin: zuì zhōng jué dìng yào děng liǎng zhōu jì lù wán zhěng yǐ hòu .
meaning: The final decision waits until two weeks of records are complete.

text: 能否减少后续，要看实际记录。
pinyin: néng fǒu jiǎn shǎo hòu xù , yào kàn shí jì jì lù .
meaning: Whether follow-up can be reduced depends on actual records.

text: 据这两次记录，回复比例确实不同。
pinyin: jù zhè liǎng cì jì lù , huí fù bǐ lì què shí bù tóng .
meaning: According to these two records, reply proportions differ.

text: 截至
pinyin: jié zhì
meaning: as of; up to an endpoint of an observation

text: 截至周一中午，第二组收到三十份回复。
pinyin: jié zhì zhōu yī zhōng wǔ , dì èr zǔ shōu dào sān shí fèn huí fù .
meaning: As of noon Monday the second group had thirty replies.

text: 因时间有限而减少这一轮数量。
pinyin: yīn shí jiān yǒu xiàn ér jiǎn shǎo zhè yī lún shù liàng .
meaning: Reduce this round’s size because time is limited.

text: 确认后便发出通知。
pinyin: què rèn hòu biàn fā chū tōng zhī .
meaning: Send the notice after confirmation.

text: 原来的安排被临时变化给打乱了。
pinyin: yuán lái de ān pái bèi lín shí biàn huà gěi dǎ luàn le .
meaning: The original arrangement was disrupted by a last-minute change.

text: 除试点外，常规联系也继续。
pinyin: chú shì diǎn wài , cháng guī lián xì yě jì xù .
meaning: Besides the trial, routine contact continues too.

text: 至于定价，这次先不讨论。
pinyin: zhì yú dìng jià , zhè cì xiān bù tǎo lùn .
meaning: As for pricing, we won’t discuss it this time.

text: 就算回复更多，也要把后续时间记完整。
pinyin: jiù suàn huí fù gèng duō , yě yào bǎ hòu xù shí jiān jì wán zhěng .
meaning: Even with more replies, follow-up time must be fully recorded.

text: 我支持试，不过还想确认这两组是不是同样的条件。
pinyin: wǒ zhī chí shì , bù guò hái xiǎng què rèn zhè liǎng zǔ shì bú shì tóng yàng de tiáo jiàn .
meaning: I support trying it, and want to check whether the two groups had the same conditions.

text: 现在可以说回复比例不同，还不能说只由信的长度造成。
pinyin: xiàn zài kě yǐ shuō huí fù bǐ lì bù tóng , hái bù néng shuō zhǐ yóu xìn de cháng dù zào chéng .
meaning: We can say reply proportions differ, not yet that letter length alone caused it.

text: 周四我能看一小时，先看样例和记录方式。
pinyin: zhōu sì wǒ néng kàn yī xiǎo shí , xiān kàn yàng lì hé jì lù fāng shì .
meaning: I can review for an hour Thursday, starting with examples and recording method.

text: 当成
pinyin: dàng chéng
meaning: take for; treat as

text: 他把个人的袋子当成交换活动的物品了。
pinyin: tā bǎ gè rén de dài zi dàng chéng jiāo huàn huó dòng de wù pǐn le .
meaning: He took a personal bag for an exchange-event item.

text: 当天
pinyin: dàng tiān
meaning: on that day

text: 当天我先还袋子，后来陈宇才放进稿子。
pinyin: dàng tiān wǒ xiān huán dài zi , hòu lái chén yǔ cái fàng jìn gǎo zi .
meaning: That day I returned the bag before Chen Yu put pages into it.

text: 仓库
pinyin: cāng kù
meaning: storeroom; warehouse

text: 袋子在二楼仓库，不在活动桌上。
pinyin: dài zi zài èr lóu cāng kù , bù zài huó dòng zhuō shàng .
meaning: The bag is in the upstairs storeroom, not on the event table.

text: 地下室
pinyin: dì xià shì
meaning: basement

text: 有人说找地下室，可我们没有把东西搬到那里。
pinyin: yǒu rén shuō zhǎo dì xià shì , kě wǒ men méi yǒu bǎ dōng xi bān dào nà lǐ .
meaning: Someone suggested the basement, but we hadn’t moved items there.

text: 楼道
pinyin: lóu dào
meaning: building corridor

text: 我在楼道里看到一张掉出来的纸。
pinyin: wǒ zài lóu dào lǐ kàn dào yī zhāng diào chū lái de zhǐ .
meaning: I saw a loose sheet in the corridor.

text: 楼房
pinyin: lóu fáng
meaning: multi-storey building

text: 这座楼房有两层，活动在一楼。
pinyin: zhè zuò lóu fáng yǒu liǎng céng , huó dòng zài yī lóu .
meaning: This two-storey building hosts the event downstairs.

text: 个人物品和可交换的书要分开放。
pinyin: gè rén wù pǐn hé kě jiāo huàn de shū yào fēn kāi fàng .
meaning: Keep personal belongings separate from exchangeable books.

text: 领取
pinyin: lǐng qǔ
meaning: collect something assigned or available

text: 领书在大厅，不能到私人物品里随便领取。
pinyin: lǐng shū zài dà tīng , bù néng dào sī rén wù pǐn lǐ suí biàn lǐng qǔ .
meaning: Collect books in the hall, not from private belongings.

text: 拿走
pinyin: ná zǒu
meaning: take away

text: 袋子被拿走了，不说明一定离开了楼房。
pinyin: dài zi bèi ná zǒu le , bù shuō míng yí dìng lí kāi le lóu fáng .
meaning: The bag was taken away, not necessarily out of the building.

text: 储存
pinyin: chǔ cún
meaning: store for later use

text: 二楼储存的是活动用的桌椅。
pinyin: èr lóu chǔ cún de shì huó dòng yòng de zhuō yǐ .
meaning: The upper floor stores tables and chairs for events.

text: 看管个人袋子不是志愿者已经答应的工作。
pinyin: kān guǎn gè rén dài zi bù shì zhì yuàn zhě yǐ jīng dā yìng de gōng zuò .
meaning: Watching personal bags isn’t a duty the volunteer has agreed to.

text: 我想收藏稿子，不是把它放进交换的书里。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng shōu cáng gǎo zi , bù shì bǎ tā fàng jìn jiāo huàn de shū lǐ .
meaning: I want to keep the pages, not place them among books for exchange.

text: 场馆管理员知道仓库在哪，但没看见每个袋子。
pinyin: chǎng guǎn guǎn lǐ yuán zhī dào cāng kù zài nǎ , dàn méi kàn jiàn měi gè dài zi .
meaning: The venue manager knows the storeroom, not every bag’s movements.

text: 场地太满，我们把不用的东西先移开。
pinyin: chǎng dì tài mǎn , wǒ men bǎ bù yòng de dōng xi xiān yí kāi .
meaning: The venue is crowded, so we move unneeded things aside.

text: 前来
pinyin: qián lái
meaning: come to a stated place

text: 前来换书的人越来越多，门口需要留空。
pinyin: qián lái huàn shū de rén yuè lái yuè duō , mén kǒu xū yào liú kōng .
meaning: More people came to exchange books, so the entrance needed clearing.

text: 路过
pinyin: lù guò
meaning: pass by

text: 我只是路过楼道，不知道谁拿着袋子上楼。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ shì lù guò lóu dào , bù zhī dào shéi ná zhe dài zi shàng lóu .
meaning: I only passed the corridor and don’t know who carried the bag upstairs.

text: 沿着
pinyin: yán zhe
meaning: along

text: 沿着楼道走到尽头，就是仓库。
pinyin: yán zhe lóu dào zǒu dào jìn tóu , jiù shì cāng kù .
meaning: Follow the corridor to its end for the storeroom.

text: 门的两侧都有箱子，我把袋子放到右边。
pinyin: mén de liǎng cè dōu yǒu xiāng zi , wǒ bǎ dài zi fàng dào yòu biān .
meaning: Boxes stand on both sides of the door; I put the bag on the right.

text: 前方正在搬桌子，我们先等一下。
pinyin: qián fāng zhèng zài bān zhuō zi , wǒ men xiān děng yī xià .
meaning: They are moving a table ahead, so we wait.

text: 纸条写此处放个人物品，后来位置变了。
pinyin: zhǐ tiáo xiě cǐ chù fàng gè rén wù pǐn , hòu lái wèi zhì biàn le .
meaning: The note says personal items go here; the location later changes.

text: 此前我只知道袋子还回来了。
pinyin: cǐ qián wǒ zhǐ zhī dào dài zi huán huí lái le .
meaning: Before this I only knew the bag had been returned.

text: 事后我们一起补清了每一步。
pinyin: shì hòu wǒ men yì qǐ bǔ qīng le měi yī bù .
meaning: Afterwards we reconstructed each step together.

text: 我把袋子的颜色当作位置的证明，记错了。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ dài zi de yán sè dàng zuò wèi zhì de zhèng míng , jì cuò le .
meaning: I wrongly treated the bag’s colour as proof of its location.

text: 她恰好看见我放纸，知道袋子那时还在。
pinyin: tā qià hǎo kàn jiàn wǒ fàng zhǐ , zhī dào dài zi nà shí hái zài .
meaning: She happened to see me insert the pages and knew the bag was there then.

text: 特地
pinyin: tè dì
meaning: especially for a purpose

text: 我特地带来原稿，想请大家排练。
pinyin: wǒ tè dì dài lái yuán gǎo , xiǎng qǐng dà jiā pái liàn .
meaning: I specially brought the original pages for rehearsal.

text: 抱歉，我以为这个也是活动的东西。
pinyin: bào qiàn , wǒ yǐ wéi zhè gè yě shì huó dòng de dōng xi .
meaning: Sorry, I thought this belonged to the event too.

text: 我为没有问就搬走道歉。
pinyin: wǒ wèi méi yǒu wèn jiù bān zǒu dào qiàn .
meaning: I apologise for moving it without asking.

text: 我们向在找袋子的人通报已经找到。
pinyin: wǒ men xiàng zài zhǎo dài zi de rén tōng bào yǐ jīng zhǎo dào .
meaning: We told the people searching that the bag was found.

text: 仓库里传出搬椅子的声音。
pinyin: cāng kù lǐ chuán chū bān yǐ zi de shēng yīn .
meaning: The sound of moving chairs came from the storeroom.

text: 志愿者回应说袋子是他搬上去的。
pinyin: zhì yuàn zhě huí yìng shuō dài zi shì tā bān shàng qù de .
meaning: The volunteer responded that he had moved the bag upstairs.

text: 追究
pinyin: zhuī jiū
meaning: investigate responsibility

text: 先把经过问清，不急着追究谁故意做了什么。
pinyin: xiān bǎ jīng guò wèn qīng , bù jí zhe zhuī jiū shéi gù yì zuò le shén me .
meaning: Clarify the events before pursuing claims of deliberate acts.

text: 涉及
pinyin: shè jí
meaning: involve; concern

text: 这个误会涉及放的位置和搬的人，不只涉及颜色。
pinyin: zhè gè wù huì shè jí fàng de wèi zhì hé bān de rén , bù zhǐ shè jí yán sè .
meaning: The confusion concerns placement and the mover, not only colour.

text: 沿着楼道走至尽头，就能看到仓库。
pinyin: yán zhe lóu dào zǒu zhì jìn tóu , jiù néng kàn dào cāng kù .
meaning: Follow the corridor to its end to see the storeroom.

text: 纸或是上楼时掉的，或是放下时掉的。
pinyin: zhǐ huò shì shàng lóu shí diào de , huò shì fàng xià shí diào de .
meaning: The sheet may have fallen while going upstairs or when put down.

text: 袋子被志愿者给搬到二楼了。
pinyin: dài zi bèi zhì yuàn zhě gěi bān dào èr lóu le .
meaning: The bag was moved upstairs by the volunteer.

text: 门口一箱，楼道一箱，东西放在不同位置。
pinyin: mén kǒu yī xiāng , lóu dào yī xiāng , dōng xi fàng zài bù tóng wèi zhì .
meaning: A box at the entrance and a box in the corridor put things in different places.

text: 就算找齐了，也不能说从来没有移动过。
pinyin: jiù suàn zhǎo qí le , yě bù néng shuō cóng lái méi yǒu yí dòng guò .
meaning: Even with the complete set recovered, we cannot say it never moved.

text: 我放进去时在，后来没有一直看。
pinyin: wǒ fàng jìn qù shí zài , hòu lái méi yǒu yì zhí kàn .
meaning: It was there when I inserted it; I wasn’t watching afterwards.

text: 志愿者说他搬到二楼，我没看见上楼那段。
pinyin: zhì yuàn zhě shuō tā bān dào èr lóu , wǒ méi kàn jiàn shàng lóu nà duàn .
meaning: The volunteer says he moved it upstairs; I didn’t see that part.

text: 页码都齐了，有一张多了折痕，但还能读。
pinyin: yè mǎ dōu qí le , yǒu yī zhāng duō le zhé hén , dàn hái néng dú .
meaning: All page numbers are present; one has a crease but remains legible.

text: 探讨
pinyin: tàn tǎo
meaning: discuss in depth

text: 我们想探讨散场后要不要留下聊天。
pinyin: wǒ men xiǎng tàn tǎo sàn chǎng hòu yào bù yào liú xià liáo tiān .
meaning: We want to discuss whether to stay and talk after the film.

text: 先听取不常发言的人的意见。
pinyin: xiān tīng qǔ bù cháng fā yán de rén de yì jiàn .
meaning: First hear the views of people who rarely speak.

text: 两次活动的差异不只有主持人。
pinyin: liǎng cì huó dòng de chā yì bù zhǐ yǒu zhǔ chí rén .
meaning: The two events differed in more than their host.

text: 影片本身也是一个因素。
pinyin: yǐng piàn běn shēn yě shì yī gè yīn sù .
meaning: The film itself is also a factor.

text: 本质
pinyin: běn zhì
meaning: essential nature

text: 我不觉得一次冷场就能看出活动的本质。
pinyin: wǒ bù jué de yī cì lěng chǎng jiù néng kàn chū huó dòng de běn zhì .
meaning: I don't think one awkward silence reveals the essential nature of the event.

text: 这次讨论的核心是怎样让人愿意留下。
pinyin: zhè cì tǎo lùn de hé xīn shì zěn yàng ràng rén yuàn yì liú xià .
meaning: The core issue is how to make people want to stay.

text: 讨论人数跟留下的人数有关联，但不一定说明原因。
pinyin: tǎo lùn rén shù gēn liú xià de rén shù yǒu guān lián , dàn bù yí dìng shuō míng yuán yīn .
meaning: Discussion participation and staying are connected, but that needn't explain the cause.

text: 据主持人的记录，上周有十二个人留下。
pinyin: jù zhǔ chí rén de jì lù , shàng zhōu yǒu shí èr gè rén liú xià .
meaning: According to the host's record, twelve people stayed last week.

text: 截至周日晚，收到八份回复。
pinyin: jié zhì zhōu rì wǎn , shōu dào bā fèn huí fù .
meaning: By Sunday evening, eight replies had arrived.

text: 百分之四十到百分之六十，增加二十个百分点。
pinyin: bǎi fēn zhī sì shí dào bǎi fēn zhī liù shí , zēng jiā èr shí gè bǎi fēn diǎn .
meaning: Forty to sixty percent is an increase of twenty percentage points.

text: 不能只用发言次数衡量参与。
pinyin: bù néng zhǐ yòng fā yán cì shù héng liáng cān yù .
meaning: Participation cannot be assessed solely by how often someone speaks.

text: 我倾向于先试一个短一点的讨论。
pinyin: wǒ qīng xiàng yú xiān shì yī gè duǎn yī diǎn de tǎo lùn .
meaning: I lean towards trying a shorter discussion first.

text: 小组采纳了先给一分钟想的建议。
pinyin: xiǎo zǔ cǎi nà le xiān gěi yī fēn zhōng xiǎng de jiàn yì .
meaning: The group adopted the suggestion of a minute to think first.

text: 这两场只是小范围试点。
pinyin: zhè liǎng chǎng zhǐ shì xiǎo fàn wéi shì diǎn .
meaning: These two events are only a small pilot.

text: 常规放映仍然保留。
pinyin: cháng guī fàng yìng réng rán bǎo liú .
meaning: The usual screenings remain.

text: 我们需要切实的安排，不只是一句多聊聊。
pinyin: wǒ men xū yào qiè shí de ān pái , bù zhǐ shì yī jù duō liáo liáo .
meaning: We need a practical plan, not merely 'talk more'.

text: 能否延长讨论，还要问场馆。
pinyin: néng fǒu yán cháng tǎo lùn , hái yào wèn chǎng guǎn .
meaning: Whether discussion can be extended still needs checking with the venue.

text: 周日晚回家太晚对我不便。
pinyin: zhōu rì wǎn huí jiā tài wǎn duì wǒ bù biàn .
meaning: Getting home too late on Sunday is inconvenient for me.

text: 至于
pinyin: zhì yú
meaning: as for

text: 至于换主持人，这次还没有决定。
pinyin: zhì yú huàn zhǔ chí rén , zhè cì hái méi yǒu jué dìng .
meaning: As for changing the host, that hasn't been decided.

text: 再说，留下的人也不一定每个都开口。
pinyin: zài shuō , liú xià de rén yě bù yí dìng měi gè dōu kāi kǒu .
meaning: Besides, not everyone who stays necessarily speaks.

text: 就是说
pinyin: jiù shì shuō
meaning: that is to say

text: 就是说，我们只知道这两次的人数不同。
pinyin: jiù shì shuō , wǒ men zhǐ zhī dào zhè liǎng cì de rén shù bù tóng .
meaning: That is, we only know attendance differed on these two occasions.

text: 很难说
pinyin: hěn nán shuō
meaning: hard to say

text: 换了主持人会不会更好，很难说。
pinyin: huàn le zhǔ chí rén huì bù huì gèng hǎo , hěn nán shuō .
meaning: It's hard to say whether changing hosts would help.

text: 说实话
pinyin: shuō shí huà
meaning: to be honest

text: 说实话，我上次只是怕错过末班车。
pinyin: shuō shí huà , wǒ shàng cì zhǐ shì pà cuò guò mò bān chē .
meaning: To be honest, I was just afraid of missing the last bus.

text: 先让她说完，别急着打断。
pinyin: xiān ràng tā shuō wán , bié jí zhe dǎ duàn .
meaning: Let her finish before interrupting.

text: 占据
pinyin: zhàn jù
meaning: occupy; take up

text: 别让一个人占据全部讨论时间。
pinyin: bié ràng yī gè rén zhàn jù quán bù tǎo lùn shí jiān .
meaning: Don't let one person take up all the discussion time.

text: 没人马上回应，不一定是没有兴趣。
pinyin: méi rén mǎ shàng huí yìng , bù yí dìng shì méi yǒu xìng qù .
meaning: No immediate response doesn't necessarily mean no interest.

text: 每个人可以提交一条问题。
pinyin: měi gè rén kě yǐ tí jiāo yī tiáo wèn tí .
meaning: Everyone can submit one question.

text: 主持人向小组通报新的散场时间。
pinyin: zhǔ chí rén xiàng xiǎo zǔ tōng bào xīn de sàn chǎng shí jiān .
meaning: The host told the group the new finishing time.

text: 场馆十点关门，不能聊到十一点。
pinyin: chǎng guǎn shí diǎn guān mén , bù néng liáo dào shí yī diǎn .
meaning: The venue closes at ten, so we can't talk until eleven.

text: 讨论名额和放映名额分别计算。
pinyin: tǎo lùn míng é hé fàng yìng míng é fēn bié jì suàn .
meaning: Discussion places and screening places are counted separately.

text: 最终决定等试点结束再做。
pinyin: zuì zhōng jué dìng děng shì diǎn jié shù zài zuò .
meaning: The final decision will wait until the pilot ends.

text: 把结束时间写清，免得大家错过车。
pinyin: bǎ jié shù shí jiān xiě qīng , miǎn de dà jiā cuò guò chē .
meaning: Write the finish time clearly so people don't miss their bus.

text: 据记录，上周有十二个人留下。
pinyin: jù jì lù , shàng zhōu yǒu shí èr gè rén liú xià .
meaning: The record says twelve stayed last week.

text: 再说，留下的人也不一定都开口。
pinyin: zài shuō , liú xià de rén yě bù yí dìng dōu kāi kǒu .
meaning: Besides, not all who stay speak.

text: 不是先走了就表示没兴趣。
pinyin: bù shì xiān zǒu le jiù biǎo shì méi xìng qù .
meaning: Leaving early does not automatically mean no interest.

text: 两次不只主持人不同，结束时间还不同。
pinyin: liǎng cì bù zhǐ zhǔ chí rén bù tóng , jié shù shí jiān hái bù tóng .
meaning: The host and finishing time both differed.

text: 你是赶车，还是今天不方便留下？
pinyin: nǐ shì gǎn chē , hái shi jīn tiān bù fāng biàn liú xià ?
meaning: Are you catching a bus, or is staying inconvenient today?

text: 还有人想补充吗？只听也可以。
pinyin: hái yǒu rén xiǎng bǔ chōng ma ? zhǐ tīng yě kě yǐ .
meaning: Would anyone like to add something? Listening is fine too.

text: 我喜欢这个问题，不过人数变化还有别的因素。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān zhè gè wèn tí , bù guò rén shù biàn huà hái yǒu bié de yīn sù .
meaning: I liked this question; other factors also affected the count.

text: 这份稿子先讲借书的故事，再给出数字。
pinyin: zhè fèn gǎo zi xiān jiǎng jiè shū de gù shì , zài gěi chū shù zì .
meaning: The draft starts with a borrowing story before giving numbers.

text: 章
pinyin: zhāng
meaning: chapter classifier

text: 第二章写夜间开放的安排。
pinyin: dì èr zhāng xiě yè jiān kāi fàng de ān pái .
meaning: Chapter two describes evening opening arrangements.

text: 说明书
pinyin: shuō míng shū
meaning: instruction manual

text: 设备的说明书放在柜台旁。
pinyin: shè bèi de shuō míng shū fàng zài guì tái páng .
meaning: The equipment manual is beside the counter.

text: 评
pinyin: píng
meaning: evaluate; comment on

text: 别只凭一句标题评整篇文章。
pinyin: bié zhǐ píng yī jù biāo tí píng zhěng piān wén zhāng .
meaning: Don't judge the whole article from its headline alone.

text: 评选
pinyin: píng xuǎn
meaning: select through evaluation

text: 读者可以评选最想参加的活动。
pinyin: dú zhě kě yǐ píng xuǎn zuì xiǎng cān jiā de huó dòng .
meaning: Readers can vote for the activity they most want to attend.

text: 优质
pinyin: yōu zhì
meaning: high-quality

text: 优质的活动也要安排合适的时间。
pinyin: yōu zhì de huó dòng yě yào ān pái hé shì de shí jiān .
meaning: Even a high-quality event needs suitable timing.

text: 外观
pinyin: wài guān
meaning: outward appearance

text: 外观变新不表示借书方式也变了。
pinyin: wài guān biàn xīn bù biǎo shì jiè shū fāng shì yě biàn le .
meaning: A new appearance doesn't mean borrowing procedures changed.

text: 本地杂志采访了图书馆工作人员。
pinyin: běn dì zá zhì cǎi fǎng le tú shū guǎn gōng zuò rén yuán .
meaning: A local magazine interviewed library staff.

text: 前来活动的人也有只听不借书的。
pinyin: qián lái huó dòng de rén yě yǒu zhǐ tīng bù jiè shū de .
meaning: Some event visitors listen without borrowing.

text: 此处登记活动，不办理借书。
pinyin: cǐ chù dēng jì huó dòng , bù bàn lǐ jiè shū .
meaning: Event registration happens here, not book borrowing.

text: 截至月底，共有六十四次到访。
pinyin: jié zhì yuè dǐ , gòng yǒu liù shí sì cì dào fǎng .
meaning: By month's end there were sixty-four visits.

text: 发放
pinyin: fā fàng
meaning: distribute

text: 工作人员在门口发放节目单。
pinyin: gōng zuò rén yuán zài mén kǒu fā fàng jié mù dān .
meaning: Staff hand out programmes at the entrance.

text: 发起
pinyin: fā qǐ
meaning: initiate

text: 两个读者发起了晚间读书活动。
pinyin: liǎng gè dú zhě fā qǐ le wǎn jiān dú shū huó dòng .
meaning: Two readers initiated the evening reading event.

text: 想带作品的人先提交一段介绍。
pinyin: xiǎng dài zuò pǐn de rén xiān tí jiāo yī duàn jiè shào .
meaning: People bringing work first submit a short introduction.

text: 馆员向报名的人通报时间调整。
pinyin: guǎn yuán xiàng bào míng de rén tōng bào shí jiān tiáo zhěng .
meaning: The librarian told registrants about the time change.

text: 场馆平日六点关门。
pinyin: chǎng guǎn píng rì liù diǎn guān mén .
meaning: The venue normally closes at six.

text: 夜间活动只用一楼场地。
pinyin: yè jiān huó dòng zhǐ yòng yī lóu chǎng dì .
meaning: The evening event uses only the downstairs space.

text: 周末讲座有二十个名额。
pinyin: zhōu mò jiǎng zuò yǒu èr shí gè míng é .
meaning: The weekend talk has twenty places.

text: 常规借书时间没有延长。
pinyin: cháng guī jiè shū shí jiān méi yǒu yán cháng .
meaning: Normal borrowing hours have not been extended.

text: 夜间开放先试点四周。
pinyin: yè jiān kāi fàng xiān shì diǎn sì zhōu .
meaning: Evening opening is initially a four-week pilot.

text: 错开收尾时间是一个切实的改进。
pinyin: cuò kāi shōu wěi shí jiān shì yī gè qiè shí de gǎi jìn .
meaning: Separating closing duties is a practical improvement.

text: 能否继续开放，还得看人员安排。
pinyin: néng fǒu jì xù kāi fàng , hái děi kàn rén yuán ān pái .
meaning: Continued opening depends on staffing.

text: 附近演出也是到访增加的因素。
pinyin: fù jìn yǎn chū yě shì dào fǎng zēng jiā de yīn sù .
meaning: A nearby performance also contributed to visits.

text: 这两件事有关联，文章却没有说谁造成谁。
pinyin: zhè liǎng jiàn shì yǒu guān lián , wén zhāng què méi yǒu shuō shéi zào chéng shéi .
meaning: The two are connected, but the article doesn't state which caused which.

text: 文章的核心是一次有条件的尝试。
pinyin: wén zhāng de hé xīn shì yī cì yǒu tiáo jiàn de cháng shì .
meaning: The article centres on a trial with conditions.

text: 两份材料的差异主要在关注的事。
pinyin: liǎng fèn cái liào de chā yì zhǔ yào zài guān zhù de shì .
meaning: The materials chiefly differ in what they focus on.

text: 据值班记录，六十四是到访次数。
pinyin: jù zhí bān jì lù , liù shí sì shì dào fǎng cì shù .
meaning: According to the duty record, sixty-four counts visits.

text: 至于借书，还是白天办理。
pinyin: zhì yú jiè shū , hái shi bái tiān bàn lǐ .
meaning: Borrowing is still handled during the day.

text: 最终决定要等试点结束。
pinyin: zuì zhōng jué dìng yào děng shì diǎn jié shù .
meaning: The final decision will wait until the pilot ends.

text: 忘了带卡，她只得白天再来借书。
pinyin: wàng le dài kǎ , tā zhǐ dé bái tiān zài lái jiè shū .
meaning: Having forgotten her card, she had to return in daytime to borrow.

text: 把借书时间写上，免得读者白跑。
pinyin: bǎ jiè shū shí jiān xiě shàng , miǎn de dú zhě bái pǎo .
meaning: Include borrowing hours so readers don't make a wasted trip.

text: 馆员先听取到访者的意见。
pinyin: guǎn yuán xiān tīng qǔ dào fǎng zhě de yì jiàn .
meaning: The librarian first hears visitors' views.

text: 一方面读者想留下，另一方面工作人员要收尾。
pinyin: yì fāng miàn dú zhě xiǎng liú xià , lìng yì fāng miàn gōng zuò rén yuán yào shōu wěi .
meaning: Readers want to stay; staff also need to close.

text: 从记录来看，这是六十四次到访。
pinyin: cóng jì lù lái kàn , zhè shì liù shí sì cì dào fǎng .
meaning: The record shows sixty-four visits.

text: 尽管灯还亮着，借书柜台仍然下班了。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn dēng hái liàng zhe , jiè shū guì tái réng rán xià bān le .
meaning: Though the lights remain on,lending has closed.

text: 不仅要问读者，也要问工作人员。
pinyin: bù jǐn yào wèn dú zhě , yě yào wèn gōng zuò rén yuán .
meaning: Ask readers and staff.

text: 若有人退出，则按登记顺序联系。
pinyin: ruò yǒu rén tuì chū , zé àn dēng jì shùn xù lián xì .
meaning: If someone withdraws,contact the waiting list in order.

text: 今晚可以借书，还是只参加活动？
pinyin: jīn wǎn kě yǐ jiè shū , hái shi zhǐ cān jiā huó dòng ?
meaning: Can I borrow tonight,or only attend the event?

text: 先试四个周四，是否继续还没决定。
pinyin: xiān shì sì gè zhōu sì , shì fǒu jì xù hái méi jué dìng .
meaning: Four Thursdays first;continuation is undecided.

text: 采访讲来由，报名要看本周通知。
pinyin: cǎi fǎng jiǎng lái yóu , bào míng yào kàn běn zhōu tōng zhī .
meaning: The interview explains the background;registration follows this week’s notice.

text: 议题
pinyin: yì tí
meaning: topic for discussion

text: 今天的议题是活动先读书还是先听歌。
pinyin: jīn tiān de yì tí shì huó dòng xiān dú shū hái shi xiān tīng gē .
meaning: Today's topic is whether reading or music comes first.

text: 座谈会
pinyin: zuò tán huì
meaning: discussion meeting

text: 这是小范围座谈会，不是长篇报告。
pinyin: zhè shì xiǎo fàn wéi zuò tán huì , bù shì zhǎng piān bào gào .
meaning: This is a small discussion meeting, not a long report.

text: 主持人
pinyin: zhǔ chí rén
meaning: host; facilitator

text: 主持人负责让不同的人有机会说。
pinyin: zhǔ chí rén fù zé ràng bù tóng de rén yǒu jī huì shuō .
meaning: The host helps different people have a chance to speak.

text: 发言人
pinyin: fā yán rén
meaning: spokesperson

text: 发言人转达小组已经确认的安排。
pinyin: fā yán rén zhuǎn dá xiǎo zǔ yǐ jīng què rèn de ān pái .
meaning: The spokesperson conveys arrangements the group has confirmed.

text: 协会
pinyin: xié huì
meaning: association

text: 协会愿意提供小厅。
pinyin: xié huì yuàn yì tí gōng xiǎo tīng .
meaning: The association is willing to provide the small room.

text: 会长
pinyin: huì zhǎng
meaning: association president

text: 会长周五才能确认场地。
pinyin: huì zhǎng zhōu wǔ cái néng què rèn chǎng dì .
meaning: The president can confirm the space on Friday.

text: 新人
pinyin: xīn rén
meaning: new member; newcomer

text: 新人也可以先听，不急着上台。
pinyin: xīn rén yě kě yǐ xiān tīng , bù jí zhe shàng tái .
meaning: Newcomers can listen first without rushing onstage.

text: 分工要写谁做和什么时候做。
pinyin: fēn gōng yào xiě shéi zuò hé shén me shí hou zuò .
meaning: Division of work should say who does what and when.

text: 检查设备是工作人员的职责。
pinyin: jiǎn chá shè bèi shì gōng zuò rén yuán de zhí zé .
meaning: Checking equipment is the staff's responsibility.

text: 我来协调两组的时间。
pinyin: wǒ lái xié tiáo liǎng zǔ de shí jiān .
meaning: I'll coordinate the two groups' times.

text: 还没问过场地，就不能承诺日期。
pinyin: hái méi wèn guò chǎng dì , jiù bù néng chéng nuò rì qī .
meaning: Without checking the venue,we can't promise a date.

text: 派出
pinyin: pài chū
meaning: send; dispatch

text: 协会派出两个人帮助布置。
pinyin: xié huì pài chū liǎng gè rén bāng zhù bù zhì .
meaning: The association sends two people to help set up.

text: 先区分建议和已经同意的事。
pinyin: xiān qū fēn jiàn yì hé yǐ jīng tóng yì de shì .
meaning: First distinguish suggestions from agreed matters.

text: 提升
pinyin: tí shēng
meaning: raise; improve

text: 我们想提升听歌时的体验。
pinyin: wǒ men xiǎng tí shēng tīng gē shí de tǐ yàn .
meaning: We want to improve the listening experience.

text: 先听取还没开口的人的意见。
pinyin: xiān tīng qǔ hái méi kāi kǒu de rén de yì jiàn .
meaning: First hear those who haven't spoken yet.

text: 会后可以提交补充意见。
pinyin: huì hòu kě yǐ tí jiāo bǔ chōng yì jiàn .
meaning: Additional views can be submitted after the meeting.

text: 留言
pinyin: liú yán
meaning: leave a message

text: 她留言说不能负责周六布置。
pinyin: tā liú yán shuō bù néng fù zé zhōu liù bù zhì .
meaning: She left a message saying she can't set up on Saturday.

text: 我先回应时间的问题。
pinyin: wǒ xiān huí yìng shí jiān de wèn tí .
meaning: I'll respond to the timing question first.

text: 音量的问题需要单独探讨。
pinyin: yīn liàng de wèn tí xū yào dān dú tàn tǎo .
meaning: Volume needs a separate discussion.

text: 至于节目单，我来整理。
pinyin: zhì yú jié mù dān , wǒ lái zhěng lǐ .
meaning: As for the programme,I will organise it.

text: 先确认房间，买东西以后再说。
pinyin: xiān què rèn fáng jiān , mǎi dōng xi yǐ hòu zài shuō .
meaning: Confirm the room first;discuss purchases later.

text: 凡是上台的人，都先确认自己的时间。
pinyin: fán shì shàng tái de rén , dōu xiān què rèn zì jǐ de shí jiān .
meaning: Everyone going onstage should confirm their timing first.

text: 若小厅不能用，就改期。
pinyin: ruò xiǎo tīng bù néng yòng , jiù gǎi qī .
meaning: If the room is unavailable,we'll reschedule.

text: 场地没确认，我们只得先等。
pinyin: chǎng dì méi què rèn , wǒ men zhǐ dé xiān děng .
meaning: With the venue unconfirmed,we have to wait.

text: 周六上午对她不便。
pinyin: zhōu liù shàng wǔ duì tā bù biàn .
meaning: Saturday morning is inconvenient for her.

text: 能否安排两次演奏，还没确定。
pinyin: néng fǒu ān pái liǎng cì yǎn zòu , hái méi què dìng .
meaning: Whether two performances are possible is undecided.

text: 先解决切实的问题。
pinyin: xiān jiě jué qiè shí de wèn tí .
meaning: First address the practical issues.

text: 最终顺序还要等周五确认。
pinyin: zuì zhōng shùn xù hái yào děng zhōu wǔ què rèn .
meaning: The final running order waits for Friday's confirmation.

text: 别让一个问题占据全部时间。
pinyin: bié ràng yī gè wèn tí zhàn jù quán bù shí jiān .
meaning: Don't let one question take all the time.

text: 我打断一下，先确认你说的是哪天。
pinyin: wǒ dǎ duàn yī xià , xiān què rèn nǐ shuō de shì nǎ tiān .
meaning: Let me interrupt briefly to confirm which day you mean.

text: 笑声
pinyin: xiào shēng
meaning: laughter

text: 笑声过后，我们继续讨论时间。
pinyin: xiào shēng guò hòu , wǒ men jì xù tǎo lùn shí jiān .
meaning: After the laughter,we returned to timing.

text: 掌声表示喜欢，不一定表示同意分工。
pinyin: zhǎng shēng biǎo shì xǐ huān , bù yí dìng biǎo shì tóng yì fēn gōng .
meaning: Applause shows appreciation,not necessarily agreement to duties.

text: 凡是上台的人，都先确认时间。
pinyin: fán shì shàng tái de rén , dōu xiān què rèn shí jiān .
meaning: All performers confirm timing first.

text: 与其临时赶人，不如先写清结束时间。
pinyin: yǔ qí lín shí gǎn rén , bù rú xiān xiě qīng jié shù shí jiān .
meaning: Better state the finish than hurry people out later.

text: 我不是答应搬桌子，而是想谢谢演奏的人。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì dā yìng bān zhuō zi , ér shì xiǎng xiè xiè yǎn zòu de rén .
meaning: I liked the song;I was thanking performers,not agreeing to move tables.

text: 先问时间，再写名字。
pinyin: xiān wèn shí jiān , zài xiě míng zi .
meaning: Ask timing before adding a name.

text: 周六下午两点以后，移动四把椅子，对吗？
pinyin: zhōu liù xià wǔ liǎng diǎn yǐ hòu , yí dòng sì bǎ yǐ zi , duì ma ?
meaning: After two Saturday afternoon,four chairs,right?

text: 这个值得试，但还要问演奏的人。
pinyin: zhè gè zhí de shì , dàn hái yào wèn yǎn zòu de rén .
meaning: Worth trying,but we still need to ask the performers.

text: 待会儿
pinyin: dāi huìr
meaning: in a little while

text: 我待会儿到，你们先进去。
pinyin: wǒ dāi huìr dào , nǐ men xiān jìn qù .
meaning: I'll arrive shortly;go in first.

text: 这场什么时候散，很难说。
pinyin: zhè chǎng shén me shí hou sàn , hěn nán shuō .
meaning: It's hard to say when this show will finish.

text: 说实话，我刚才没听清。
pinyin: shuō shí huà , wǒ gāng cái méi tīng qīng .
meaning: Honestly,I didn't catch that.

text: 买不到就算了，我们先进去。
pinyin: mǎi bù dào jiù suàn le , wǒ men xiān jìn qù .
meaning: If we can't get it,never mind;let's go in.

text: 你只管先坐下，我去拿水。
pinyin: nǐ zhǐ guǎn xiān zuò xià , wǒ qù ná shuǐ .
meaning: Go ahead and sit;I'll get water.

text: 我只顾看路，没听见后半句。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ gù kàn lù , méi tīng jiàn hòu bàn jù .
meaning: I was concentrating on the route and missed the second half.

text: 那班车已经走了，我只得等下一班。
pinyin: nà bān chē yǐ jīng zǒu le , wǒ zhǐ dé děng xià yī bān .
meaning: That bus has left,so I have to wait for the next.

text: 先看完，结尾出去再说。
pinyin: xiān kàn wán , jié wěi chū qù zài shuō .
meaning: Finish watching;discuss the ending outside.

text: 就是说，你会来，只是晚一点。
pinyin: jiù shì shuō , nǐ huì lái , zhǐ shì wǎn yī diǎn .
meaning: So you'll come,just a little later.

text: 他不再等上一班车了。
pinyin: tā bù zài děng shàng yī bān chē le .
meaning: He's no longer waiting for the previous bus.

text: 她前来取票，没留下看演出。
pinyin: tā qián lái qǔ piào , méi liú xià kàn yǎn chū .
meaning: She came to collect tickets without staying for the show.

text: 我路过门口，听到你说算了。
pinyin: wǒ lù guò mén kǒu , tīng dào nǐ shuō suàn le .
meaning: I passed the entrance and heard you say never mind.

text: 我坐在挨着门的位置。
pinyin: wǒ zuò zài āi zhe mén de wèi zhì .
meaning: I sit beside the door.

text: 沿着小路走到红门。
pinyin: yán zhe xiǎo lù zǒu dào hóng mén .
meaning: Follow the path to the red door.

text: 前方那辆不是我们等的车。
pinyin: qián fāng nà liàng bù shì wǒ men děng de chē .
meaning: The bus ahead isn't the one we're waiting for.

text: 通道
pinyin: tōng dào
meaning: passage

text: 别站在通道里等消息。
pinyin: bié zhàn zài tōng dào lǐ děng xiāo xī .
meaning: Don't wait for messages in the passage.

text: 响声把后半句盖住了。
pinyin: xiǎng shēng bǎ hòu bàn jù gài zhù le .
meaning: The noise drowned out the second half.

text: 笑声过后她又补了一句。
pinyin: xiào shēng guò hòu tā yòu bǔ le yī jù .
meaning: After the laughter,she added another sentence.

text: 音量太大，我没听清。
pinyin: yīn liàng tài dà , wǒ méi tīng qīng .
meaning: The volume was too loud for me to catch it.

text: 这里太吵，不便通话。
pinyin: zhè lǐ tài chǎo , bù biàn tōng huà .
meaning: It's too noisy here for a call.

text: 先留言，我出去再听。
pinyin: xiān liú yán , wǒ chū qù zài tīng .
meaning: Leave a message;I'll listen outside.

text: 她回应说不是不去。
pinyin: tā huí yìng shuō bù shì bù qù .
meaning: She replied that it wasn't a refusal to go.

text: 我打断一下，你刚才说先别等？
pinyin: wǒ dǎ duàn yī xià , nǐ gāng cái shuō xiān bié děng ?
meaning: Let me interrupt—did you say don't wait for now?

text: 把先别等和不会来区分开。
pinyin: bǎ xiān bié děng hé bù huì lái qū fēn kāi .
meaning: Distinguish don't wait for now from won't come.

text: 此处不能停留，请到门外等。
pinyin: cǐ chù bù néng tíng liú , qǐng dào mén wài děng .
meaning: No waiting here;please wait outside.

text: 当天我们在红门见，不在车站。
pinyin: dàng tiān wǒ men zài hóng mén jiàn , bù zài chē zhàn .
meaning: That day we met at the red door,not the station.

text: 此前我以为她不来了。
pinyin: cǐ qián wǒ yǐ wéi tā bù lái le .
meaning: Before this,I thought she wasn't coming.

text: 事后重听，才听出不是不去。
pinyin: shì hòu zhòng tīng , cái tīng chū bù shì bù qù .
meaning: Listening again afterwards,I caught wasn't refusing to go.

text: 小厅里传出音乐声。
pinyin: xiǎo tīng lǐ chuán chū yīn yuè shēng .
meaning: Music came from the small room.

text: 我忽略了那个先字。
pinyin: wǒ hū lüè le nà gè xiān zì .
meaning: I overlooked the word for now.

text: 这次我很想去，只是要晚到。
pinyin: zhè cì wǒ hěn xiǎng qù , zhǐ shì yào wǎn dào .
meaning: I really want to go this time;I'll just arrive late.

text: 我想问能否晚一点进场。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng wèn néng fǒu wǎn yī diǎn jìn chǎng .
meaning: I'd like to ask whether I can enter later.

text: 不是不去，只是晚一点到。
pinyin: bù shì bù qù , zhǐ shì wǎn yī diǎn dào .
meaning: I am coming,just arriving later.

text: 先别替我点，到了再看。
pinyin: xiān bié tì wǒ diǎn , dào le zài kàn .
meaning: Do not order for me yet;decide on arrival.

text: 你只管进去，我晚点到。
pinyin: nǐ zhǐ guǎn jìn qù , wǒ wǎn diǎn dào .
meaning: Go in;I will arrive later.

text: 我可没说不去啊。
pinyin: wǒ kě méi shuō bù qù a .
meaning: I did not say I would not go.

text: 先别点，我路上可能吃一点。
pinyin: xiān bié diǎn , wǒ lù shàng kě néng chī yī diǎn .
meaning: Do not order for me yet;I may eat en route.

text: 不是不好，是我没听懂。
pinyin: bù shì bù hǎo , shì wǒ méi tīng dǒng .
meaning: It is not bad;I did not understand.

text: 刚才后半句没听清，你再说一遍？
pinyin: gāng cái hòu bàn jù méi tīng qīng , nǐ zài shuō yī biàn ?
meaning: I missed the second half;could you repeat it?

text: 你会来，我们先进去，不替你点，对吗？
pinyin: nǐ huì lái , wǒ men xiān jìn qù , bù tì nǐ diǎn , duì ma ?
meaning: You are coming;we enter first and do not order for you yet,right?

text: 不用慢成这样，后半句别丢就好。
pinyin: bù yòng màn chéng zhè yàng , hòu bàn jù bié diū jiù hǎo .
meaning: Not that slowly—just keep the second half.

text: 她的心愿是走之前再一起唱一次。
pinyin: tā de xīn yuàn shì zǒu zhī qián zài yì qǐ chàng yī cì .
meaning: Her wish is to sing together once before leaving.

text: 这首歌写心灵里没有说完的话。
pinyin: zhè shǒu gē xiě xīn líng lǐ méi yǒu shuō wán de huà .
meaning: The song concerns words left unsaid in the inner self.

text: 海浪的声音接在最后一句后面。
pinyin: hǎi làng de shēng yīn jiē zài zuì hòu yī jù hòu miàn .
meaning: Sea-wave sounds follow the final line.

text: 她要去远方，但没有说永远不回来。
pinyin: tā yào qù yuǎn fāng , dàn méi yǒu shuō yǒng yuǎn bù huí lái .
meaning: She's going far away without saying she'll never return.

text: 这一句有孤独，也有期待。
pinyin: zhè yī jù yǒu gū dú , yě yǒu qī dài .
meaning: This line contains loneliness and anticipation.

text: 一起排练增进了了解。
pinyin: yì qǐ pái liàn zēng jìn le liǎo jiě .
meaning: Rehearsing together deepened understanding.

text: 我想平衡演出和休息。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng píng héng yǎn chū hé xiū xī .
meaning: I want to balance performing and resting.

text: 这段把说话和音乐融合起来。
pinyin: zhè duàn bǎ shuō huà hé yīn yuè róng hé qǐ lái .
meaning: This passage blends speech and music.

text: 雨声是这段音乐的一个元素。
pinyin: yǔ shēng shì zhè duàn yīn yuè de yī gè yuán sù .
meaning: Rain sounds are an element of this music.

text: 演奏结束后，她才把信拿出来。
pinyin: yǎn zòu jié shù hòu , tā cái bǎ xìn ná chū lái .
meaning: She takes out the letter after the performance.

text: 歌词没有写归来的日期。
pinyin: gē cí méi yǒu xiě guī lái de rì qī .
meaning: The lyrics give no return date.

text: 这一段节奏慢下来，话却没变。
pinyin: zhè yī duàn jié zòu màn xià lái , huà què méi biàn .
meaning: The passage slows while the words remain unchanged.

text: 乐曲在说话之后开始。
pinyin: yuè qǔ zài shuō huà zhī hòu kāi shǐ .
meaning: The piece starts after the spoken dialogue.

text: 这段短剧今晚首次上演。
pinyin: zhè duàn duǎn jù jīn wǎn shǒu cì shàng yǎn .
meaning: This short play is staged for the first time tonight.

text: 她上台以前先喝了水。
pinyin: tā shàng tái yǐ qián xiān hē le shuǐ .
meaning: She drank water before going onstage.

text: 主角最后没有拆信。
pinyin: zhǔ jué zuì hòu méi yǒu chāi xìn .
meaning: The lead doesn't open the letter at the end.

text: 这个场景发生在车站。
pinyin: zhè gè chǎng jǐng fā shēng zài chē zhàn .
meaning: This scene takes place at the station.

text: 场馆十点关闭。
pinyin: chǎng guǎn shí diǎn guān bì .
meaning: The venue closes at ten.

text: 明早我们去车站送行。
pinyin: míng zǎo wǒ men qù chē zhàn sòng xíng .
meaning: We'll see her off at the station tomorrow morning.

text: 那段安静让我很难忘。
pinyin: nà duàn ān jìng ràng wǒ hěn nán wàng .
meaning: That quiet passage is memorable to me.

text: 没唱完有点遗憾，但还能下次接着唱。
pinyin: méi chàng wán yǒu diǎn yí hàn , dàn hái néng xià cì jiē zhe chàng .
meaning: Not finishing is disappointing,but we can continue next time.

text: 她的情绪在最后一段变了。
pinyin: tā de qíng xù zài zuì hòu yī duàn biàn le .
meaning: Her mood changes in the final passage.

text: 她没有隐藏要走的事。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu yǐn cáng yào zǒu de shì .
meaning: She didn't hide that she was leaving.

text: 结尾只透露他已经写过信。
pinyin: jié wěi zhǐ tòu lù tā yǐ jīng xiě guò xìn .
meaning: The ending only reveals he has written a letter.

text: 我想收藏这张节目单。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng shōu cáng zhè zhāng jié mù dān .
meaning: I'd like to keep this programme.

text: 经过一番商量，我们先收东西。
pinyin: jīng guò yī fān shāng liáng , wǒ men xiān shōu dōng xi .
meaning: After some discussion,we put things away first.

text: 这段时而轻，时而响。
pinyin: zhè duàn shí ér qīng , shí ér xiǎng .
meaning: This passage is now quiet,now loud.

text: 早晚
pinyin: zǎo wǎn
meaning: sooner or later

text: 早晚还会见面，不等于已经定好日期。
pinyin: zǎo wǎn hái huì jiàn miàn , bù děng yú yǐ jīng dìng hǎo rì qī .
meaning: Seeing each other sooner or later isn't a fixed date.

text: 她仿佛想说什么，又停了。
pinyin: tā fǎng fú xiǎng shuō shén me , yòu tíng le .
meaning: She seems about to speak,then stops.

text: 我盼望下次一起唱。
pinyin: wǒ pàn wàng xià cì yì qǐ chàng .
meaning: I look forward to singing together next time.

text: 到了以后给我们留言。
pinyin: dào le yǐ hòu gěi wǒ men liú yán .
meaning: Leave us a message after arriving.

text: 没有确定时间，就别承诺周末回来。
pinyin: méi yǒu què dìng shí jiān , jiù bié chéng nuò zhōu mò huí lái .
meaning: Don't promise a weekend return before the time is settled.

text: 她时而笑，时而看窗外。
pinyin: tā shí ér xiào , shí ér kàn chuāng wài .
meaning: She alternately laughs and looks outside.

text: 上台并不表示不紧张。
pinyin: shàng tái bìng bù biǎo shì bù jǐn zhāng .
meaning: Going onstage does not mean no nerves.

text: 不是每一次等候都要答案。
pinyin: bù shì měi yī cì děng hòu dōu yào dá àn .
meaning: Not every wait needs an answer.

text: 我猜他舍不得她走，你从哪里听出别的意思？
pinyin: wǒ cāi tā shě bu de tā zǒu , nǐ cóng nǎ lǐ tīng chū bié de yì si ?
meaning: I think he is reluctant to part;what suggests another meaning to you?

text: 到了以后我发消息，时间没定的先不答应。
pinyin: dào le yǐ hòu wǒ fā xiāo xī , shí jiān méi dìng de xiān bù dā yìng .
meaning: I will message after arrival;I will not promise an unsettled date.

text: 我看见她收信，猜她想以后读；下次见面还没定。
pinyin: wǒ kàn jiàn tā shōu xìn , cāi tā xiǎng yǐ hòu dú ; xià cì jiàn miàn hái méi dìng .
meaning: I saw her put the letter away and guess she plans to read later;the next meeting is undated.

text: 你先读课文，我再读。
pinyin: nǐ xiān dú kè wén , wǒ zài dú .
meaning: Read the lesson text first; I will read afterwards.

text: 我有时上网，有时候读书。
pinyin: wǒ yǒu shí shàng wǎng , yǒu shí hou dú shū .
meaning: Sometimes I go online; sometimes I read.

text: 我在读书呢。
pinyin: wǒ zài dú shū ne .
meaning: I am reading right now.

text: 我正在读书呢。
pinyin: wǒ zhèng zài dú shū ne .
meaning: I am in the middle of reading.

text: 我读书呢，等一下。
pinyin: wǒ dú shū ne , děng yī xià .
meaning: I am reading; wait a moment.

text: 先吃晚饭，再去上课。
pinyin: xiān chī wǎn fàn , zài qù shàng kè .
meaning: Eat dinner first, then go to class.

text: 下课后，我们慢一点读。
pinyin: xià kè hòu , wǒ men màn yī diǎn dú .
meaning: After class, we read a little more slowly.

text: 晚上我再做听写。
pinyin: wǎn shang wǒ zài zuò tīng xiě .
meaning: I will do dictation again in the evening.

text: 星期日没有课，别去学校。
pinyin: xīng qī rì méi yǒu kè , bié qù xué xiào .
meaning: There is no class on Sunday; do not go to school.

text: 星期日有没有课？
pinyin: xīng qī rì yǒu méi yǒu kè ?
meaning: Is there class on Sunday?

text: 你是不是记错了？
pinyin: nǐ shì bu shì jì cuò le ?
meaning: Did you remember incorrectly?

text: 你喜欢不喜欢这本书？
pinyin: nǐ xǐ huān bù xǐ huān zhè běn shū ?
meaning: Do you like this book?

text: 我们在这边买车票。
pinyin: wǒ men zài zhè biān mǎi chē piào .
meaning: We buy tickets on this side.

text: 朋友在大学站下车。
pinyin: péng you zài dà xué zhàn xià chē .
meaning: Our friend gets off at University Station.

text: 我们八点零五分见面。
pinyin: wǒ men bā diǎn líng wǔ fēn jiàn miàn .
meaning: Let us meet at eight oh five.

text: 星期日两点半上车。
pinyin: xīng qī rì liǎng diǎn bàn shàng chē .
meaning: Board on Sunday at half past two.

text: 奶奶和爷爷一起喝茶。
pinyin: nǎi nai hé yé ye yì qǐ hē chá .
meaning: Grandmother drinks tea with grandfather.

text: 我跟朋友都喜欢喝茶。
pinyin: wǒ gēn péng you dōu xǐ huān hē chá .
meaning: My friend and I both like tea.

text: 下午去看朋友，还是在家读书？
pinyin: xià wǔ qù kàn péng you , hái shi zài jiā dú shū ?
meaning: Visit friends in the afternoon, or read at home?

text: 这个颜色真好看，太好看了！
pinyin: zhè gè yán sè zhēn hǎo kàn , tài hǎo kàn le !
meaning: This colour looks really good—so good!

text: 这三件，白色的最好看。
pinyin: zhè sān jiàn , bái sè de zuì hǎo kàn .
meaning: Of these three, the white one looks best.

text: 衣服还没干，现在不冷。
pinyin: yī fú hái méi gān , xiàn zài bù lěng .
meaning: The clothes are not dry yet; it is not cold now.

text: 太晚了！明天再看吧。
pinyin: tài wǎn le ! míng tiān zài kàn ba .
meaning: It is too late! Let us look again tomorrow.

text: 坐车比走路快。
pinyin: zuò chē bǐ zǒu lù kuài .
meaning: Taking a vehicle is faster than walking.

text: 商场没有图书馆安静。
pinyin: shāng chǎng méi yǒu tú shū guǎn ān jìng .
meaning: The shopping centre is not as quiet as the library.

text: 我们一起走，也一块儿聊天。
pinyin: wǒ men yì qǐ zǒu , yě yī kuàir liáo tiān .
meaning: We walk together and chat together.

text: 我想散步，也想听你说话。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng sàn bù , yě xiǎng tīng nǐ shuō huà .
meaning: I want to take a walk and also hear you speak.

text: 我知道了。
pinyin: wǒ zhī dào le .
meaning: I know now; understood.

text: 你明天回家吗？
pinyin: nǐ míng tiān huí jiā ma ?
meaning: Are you going home tomorrow?

text: 我读书呢。
pinyin: wǒ dú shū ne .
meaning: I am reading.

text: 几点考试？
pinyin: jǐ diǎn kǎo shì ?
meaning: What time is the exam?

text: 上午还是下午考试？
pinyin: shàng wǔ hái shi xià wǔ kǎo shì ?
meaning: Is the exam in the morning or afternoon?

text: 明天考不考？
pinyin: míng tiān kǎo bù kǎo ?
meaning: Is there a test tomorrow or not?

text: 你在网上买的吗？
pinyin: nǐ zài wǎng shàng mǎi de ma ?
meaning: Did you buy it online?

text: 楼前、楼后，门左边、门右边。
pinyin: lóu qián , lóu hòu , mén zuǒ biān , mén yòu biān .
meaning: In front of and behind the building; to the left and right of the gate.

text: 上边、下边、里边、外边、前边、后边。
pinyin: shàng biān , xià biān , lǐ bian , wài biān , qián biān , hòu biān .
meaning: Above, below, inside, outside, in front, behind.

text: 左边、右边、东边、南边、西边、北边。
pinyin: zuǒ biān , yòu biān , dōng biān , nán biān , xī biān , běi biān .
meaning: Left, right, east, south, west, north.

text: 面向北，右边是东，左边是西。
pinyin: miàn xiàng běi , yòu biān shì dōng , zuǒ biān shì xī .
meaning: Facing north, east is on the right and west on the left.

text: 几个人？两个人。
pinyin: jǐ gè rén ? liǎng gè rén .
meaning: How many people? Two.

text: 入口。出口。好！
pinyin: rù kǒu . chū kǒu . hǎo !
meaning: Entrance. Exit. Okay!

text: 邻居很热情，杯子坏了。
pinyin: lín jū hěn rè qíng , bēi zi huài le .
meaning: The neighbours are welcoming; the cup is broken.

text: 我不是工人，昨天没去学校。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì gōng rén , zuó tiān méi qù xué xiào .
meaning: I am not a worker; I did not go to school yesterday.

text: 她是一个热情的人。
pinyin: tā shì yī gè rè qíng de rén .
meaning: She is a welcoming person.

text: 门外是一棵树，前边是学校。
pinyin: mén wài shì yī kē shù , qián biān shì xué xiào .
meaning: Outside the door is a tree; ahead is the school.

text: 两本书在桌上，它们是我的。
pinyin: liǎng běn shū zài zhuō shàng , tā men shì wǒ de .
meaning: The two books are on the table; they are mine.

text: 咱一起读吧。咱们都参加，你也来。
pinyin: zán yì qǐ dú ba . zán men dōu cān jiā , nǐ yě lái .
meaning: Let us read together. All of us, including you, will participate.

text: 年轻的老师很热情，大家参加活动。
pinyin: nián qīng de lǎo shī hěn rè qíng , dà jiā cān jiā huó dòng .
meaning: The young teacher is welcoming; everyone joins the activity.

text: 这篇文章，我读懂了。大家热情，是我的看法。
pinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng , wǒ dú dǒng le . dà jiā rè qíng , shì wǒ de kàn fa .
meaning: I have read and understood this passage. “Everyone is welcoming” is my impression.

text: 我会说一点普通话。明天可能下雨，也可能不下。
pinyin: wǒ huì shuō yī diǎn pǔ tōng huà . míng tiān kě néng xià yǔ , yě kě néng bù xià .
meaning: I can speak a little Mandarin. It may rain tomorrow, or it may not.

text: 我该不该带食物？主人说不用带。
pinyin: wǒ gāi bù gāi dài shí wù ? zhǔ ren shuō bù yòng dài .
meaning: Should I bring food? The host said there was no need.

text: 不应该随便猜，先问清楚。
pinyin: bù yīng gāi suí biàn cāi , xiān wèn qīng chǔ .
meaning: We should not guess casually; ask clearly first.

text: 我带两瓶水，可以吗？行吗？可以。
pinyin: wǒ dài liǎng píng shuǐ , kě yǐ ma ? xíng ma ? kě yǐ .
meaning: May I bring two bottles of water? Is that okay? Yes.

text: 带这本书怎么样？合适，她喜欢读书。
pinyin: dài zhè běn shū zěn me yàng ? hé shì , tā xǐ huān dú shū .
meaning: How about bringing this book? Suitable; she likes reading.

text: 你愿意不愿意星期六来？愿意，但时间还要商量。
pinyin: nǐ yuàn yì bù yuàn yì xīng qī liù lái ? yuàn yì , dàn shí jiān hái yào shāng liang .
meaning: Are you willing to come on Saturday? Yes, but we still need to discuss the time.

text: 你星期五还是星期六方便？星期六。还是星期六吧。
pinyin: nǐ xīng qī wǔ hái shi xīng qī liù fāng biàn ? xīng qī liù . hái shi xīng qī liù ba .
meaning: Is Friday or Saturday convenient? Saturday. Let us choose Saturday, then.

text: 为什么选这里？这里安静。味道怎么样？不错。
pinyin: wèi shén me xuǎn zhè lǐ ? zhè lǐ ān jìng . wèi dao zěn me yàng ? bù cuò .
meaning: Why choose here? It is quiet. How does it taste? Good.

text: 怎样去？坐车到大学站，再走五分钟。
pinyin: zěn yàng qù ? zuò chē dào dà xué zhàn , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng .
meaning: How do we get there? Ride to University Station, then walk five minutes.

text: 为什么不叫外卖？想出去走走。这里服务怎么样？很热情。
pinyin: wèi shén me bù jiào wài mài ? xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu . zhè lǐ fú wù zěn me yàng ? hěn rè qíng .
meaning: Why not order delivery? I want a walk. How is the service here? Welcoming.

text: 你认为怎样去合适？坐车吧。
pinyin: nǐ rèn wéi zěn yàng qù hé shì ? zuò chē ba .
meaning: What way of getting there do you think is suitable? Let us take a vehicle.

text: 我看了看题目，才发现第二题没做。
pinyin: wǒ kàn le kàn tí mù , cái fā xiàn dì èr tí méi zuò .
meaning: I briefly looked at the questions and only then noticed I had not done the second.

text: 我们练习练习这段对话吧。
pinyin: wǒ men liàn xí liàn xí zhè duàn duì huà ba .
meaning: Let us practise this dialogue a little.

text: 看一场电影，去一回活动，检查两次答案。
pinyin: kàn yī chǎng diàn yǐng , qù yī huí huó dòng , jiǎn chá liǎng cì dá àn .
meaning: Watch one film showing, attend an activity once, check the answers twice.

text: 老师拍三下手，然后大家看一下题目。
pinyin: lǎo shī pāi sān xià shǒu , rán hòu dà jiā kàn yī xià tí mù .
meaning: The teacher claps three times, then everyone looks briefly at the questions.

text: 我检查了三次答案。
pinyin: wǒ jiǎn chá le sān cì dá àn .
meaning: I checked the answers three times.

text: 录音听了两遍，句子读了三次。
pinyin: lù yīn tīng le liǎng biàn , jù zi dú le sān cì .
meaning: The recording was heard twice through and the sentence read three times.

text: 昨天没那么冷，今天冷多了。
pinyin: zuó tiān méi nà me lěng , jīn tiān lěng duō le .
meaning: Yesterday was not that cold; today is much colder.

text: 我们这样做，别像昨天那样猜。
pinyin: wǒ men zhè yàng zuò , bié xiàng zuó tiān nà yàng cāi .
meaning: Let us do it this way, rather than guess like yesterday.

text: 这封信是朋友写的，那张图片是老师发的。
pinyin: zhè fēng xìn shì péng you xiě de , nà zhāng tú piàn shì lǎo shī fā de .
meaning: This letter was written by a friend; that image was sent by the teacher.

text: 我去问主办方，再发短信告诉你。
pinyin: wǒ qù wèn zhǔ bàn fāng , zài fā duǎn xìn gào sù nǐ .
meaning: I will ask the organizer, then text you.

text: 我们开开心心地去见朋友。
pinyin: wǒ men kāi kāi xīn xīn de qù jiàn péng you .
meaning: We go happily to meet our friends.

text: 这双鞋很合适，价格不低。
pinyin: zhè shuāng xié hěn hé shì , jià gé bù dī .
meaning: These shoes fit well and are not cheap.

text: 绿色的那件比较轻。
pinyin: lǜ sè de nà jiàn bǐ jiào qīng .
meaning: That green one is relatively light.

text: 这双鞋又重又贵，我今天不穿。
pinyin: zhè shuāng xié yòu zhòng yòu guì , wǒ jīn tiān bù chuān .
meaning: These shoes are both heavy and expensive; I will not wear them today.

text: 这个样子又可爱又自然。
pinyin: zhè gè yàng zi yòu kě ài yòu zì rán .
meaning: This look is both cute and natural.

text: 两万是二十个一千。
pinyin: liǎng wàn shì èr shí gè yī qiān .
meaning: Twenty thousand is twenty thousands.

text: 一亿是一万万，不是一百万。
pinyin: yī yì shì yī wàn wàn , bù shì yī bǎi wàn .
meaning: One hundred million is ten thousand ten-thousands, not one million.

text: 活动一个多小时，不是十多个小时。
pinyin: huó dòng yī gè duō xiǎo shí , bù shì shí duō gè xiǎo shí .
meaning: The activity lasts a little over an hour, not more than ten hours.

text: 水果三斤多，钱一百多块，先问具体是多少。
pinyin: shuǐ guǒ sān jīn duō , qián yī bǎi duō kuài , xiān wèn jù tǐ shì duō shao .
meaning: The fruit is a little over three jin and the cost over a hundred yuan; ask for exact amounts.

text: 一封信，一件衣服，一条围巾。
pinyin: yī fēng xìn , yī jiàn yī fú , yī tiáo wéi jīn .
meaning: A letter, an item of clothing, a scarf.

text: 这位老师收到两封信。
pinyin: zhè wèi lǎo shī shōu dào liǎng fēng xìn .
meaning: This teacher received two letters.

text: 我给她一支笔，包裹送到学校。
pinyin: wǒ gěi tā yī zhī bǐ , bāo guǒ sòng dào xué xiào .
meaning: I give her a pen; the parcel is delivered to the school.

text: 他学了两年汉语，在这里住三天。
pinyin: tā xué le liǎng nián hàn yǔ , zài zhè lǐ zhù sān tiān .
meaning: He has studied Chinese for two years and stays here for three days.

text: 一周以后再见，下周还有节目。
pinyin: yī zhōu yǐ hòu zài jiàn , xià zhōu hái yǒu jié mù .
meaning: See you a week later; there is another programme next week.

text: 开场以前先坐好，散场以后再出去。
pinyin: kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān zuò hǎo , sàn chǎng yǐ hòu zài chū qù .
meaning: Take your seat before the start; leave after the end.

text: 散场后喝茶，回家前看有没有车。
pinyin: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá , huí jiā qián kàn yǒu méi yǒu chē .
meaning: Have tea after the show; check transport before going home.

text: 快要七点了，节目就要开始了。
pinyin: kuài yào qī diǎn le , jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le .
meaning: It is nearly seven; the programme is about to begin.

text: 下周就要放假了，不是已经放假了。
pinyin: xià zhōu jiù yào fàng jià le , bù shì yǐ jīng fàng jià le .
meaning: The holiday starts next week; it has not already begun.

text: 这里更安静，十分舒服，特别适合读书，挺好的。
pinyin: zhè lǐ gèng ān jìng , shí fēn shū fú , tè bié shì hé dú shū , tǐng hǎo de .
meaning: It is quieter here, very comfortable, especially suitable for reading, and quite good.

text: 门口有一点儿吵，请把音量调小一点儿。
pinyin: mén kǒu yǒu yì diǎnr chǎo , qǐng bǎ yīn liàng diào xiǎo yì diǎn ér .
meaning: It is a little noisy at the entrance; please turn the volume down a little.

text: 里面比门口更安静，也比楼上还安静。
pinyin: lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu gèng ān jìng , yě bǐ lóu shàng hái ān jìng .
meaning: Inside is quieter than the entrance and even quieter than upstairs.

text: 门口不如里面安静，楼上有里面这么安静吗？
pinyin: mén kǒu bù rú lǐ miàn ān jìng , lóu shàng yǒu lǐ miàn zhè me ān jìng ma ?
meaning: The entrance is not as quiet as inside; is upstairs as quiet as inside?

text: 我只喝水，只有一个人喝茶。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ hē shuǐ , zhǐ yǒu yī gè rén hē chá .
meaning: I drink only water; only one person drinks tea.

text: 大多数人吃米饭，不能说所有人都吃米饭。
pinyin: dà duō shù rén chī mǐ fàn , bù néng shuō suǒ yǒu rén dōu chī mǐ fàn .
meaning: Most people eat rice; that does not mean everyone does.

text: 两份米饭和一份鱼，先确认配料。
pinyin: liǎng fèn mǐ fàn hé yī fèn yú , xiān què rèn pèi liào .
meaning: Two portions of rice and one fish dish: confirm the ingredients first.

text: 我的那份米饭不要油，清淡的菜先上。
pinyin: wǒ de nà fèn mǐ fàn bú yào yóu , qīng dàn de cài xiān shàng .
meaning: Do not add oil to my rice portion; serve the lightly seasoned dishes first.

text: 我一直在站台等，车忽然停了。
pinyin: wǒ yì zhí zài zhàn tái děng , chē hū rán tíng le .
meaning: I have been waiting at the stop all along; the vehicle suddenly stopped.

text: 都七点了，他七点才到，大家已经等了一会儿。
pinyin: dōu qī diǎn le , tā qī diǎn cái dào , dà jiā yǐ jīng děng le yī huì er .
meaning: It is already seven; he did not arrive until seven and everyone has already waited a while.

text: 今天就三个人，三个座位正好。
pinyin: jīn tiān jiù sān gè rén , sān gè zuò wèi zhèng hǎo .
meaning: Today there are only three people; three seats are exactly enough.

text: 天晚了，该回家了。
pinyin: tiān wǎn le , gāi huí jiā le .
meaning: It is late; it is time to go home.

text: 该发消息了，还没有发出去。
pinyin: gāi fā xiāo xī le , hái méi yǒu fā chū qù .
meaning: It is time to send the message; it has not gone through yet.

text: 我又走错了，明天再看新地址。
pinyin: wǒ yòu zǒu cuò le , míng tiān zài kàn xīn dì zhǐ .
meaning: I went the wrong way again; tomorrow I will check the new address again.

text: 你老看旧图片，老是走错入口。
pinyin: nǐ lǎo kàn jiù tú piàn , lǎo shì zǒu cuò rù kǒu .
meaning: You keep looking at the old image and repeatedly take the wrong entrance.

text: 先看地址，再出门，然后确认入口。
pinyin: xiān kàn dì zhǐ , zài chū mén , rán hòu què rèn rù kǒu .
meaning: Check the address first, then go out, then confirm the entrance.

text: 先还书，接着借书，接下来交作业。
pinyin: xiān huán shū , jiē zhe jiè shū , jiē xià lái jiāo zuò yè .
meaning: Return books, then borrow books, then hand in homework.

text: 手机一开机，就能看到新消息。
pinyin: shǒu jī yī kāi jī , jiù néng kàn dào xīn xiāo xī .
meaning: New messages can be seen as soon as the phone is switched on.

text: 一确认入口，我们就进去。
pinyin: yī què rèn rù kǒu , wǒ men jiù jìn qù .
meaning: We will go in as soon as the entrance is confirmed.

text: 入口就在东边，不在北门。
pinyin: rù kǒu jiù zài dōng biān , bù zài běi mén .
meaning: The entrance is right on the east side, not at the north gate.

text: 我就想确认时间，没有别的要求。
pinyin: wǒ jiù xiǎng què rèn shí jiān , méi yǒu bié de yāo qiú .
meaning: I only want to confirm the time; I have no other request.

text: 我明白，你提的就是时间问题。

meaning: Although we tried it only twice, we have found a problem.

text: 一旦人数定下来，就可以采购。
pinyin: yí dàn rén shù dìng xià lái , jiù kě yǐ cǎi gòu .
meaning: Once numbers are settled, purchasing can begin.

text: 大家讨论起来，才发现还有问题。
pinyin: dà jiā tǎo lùn qǐ lái , cái fā xiàn hái yǒu wèn tí .
meaning: Only as discussion began did everyone discover more issues.

text: 除非本人愿意，这本书才可以拿来交换。
pinyin: chú fēi běn rén yuàn yì , zhè běn shū cái kě yǐ ná lái jiāo huàn .
meaning: Only with the owner’s willingness can this book be offered for exchange.

text: 他先问清楚，从而避免把展示的书拿走。
pinyin: tā xiān wèn qīng chǔ , cóng ér bì miǎn bǎ zhǎn shì de shū ná zǒu .
meaning: By asking first he avoids taking a display-only book.

text: 他一看到新纸，就知道往哪里走。
pinyin: tā yī kàn dào xīn zhǐ , jiù zhī dào wǎng nǎ lǐ zǒu .
meaning: As soon as he sees the new paper, he knows where to go.

text: 我们可以发邮件，或是当面告诉他。
pinyin: wǒ men kě yǐ fā yóu jiàn , huò shì dāng miàn gào sù tā .
meaning: We can email or tell him in person.

text: 共计十本，包括两本字典。
pinyin: gòng jì shí běn , bāo kuò liǎng běn zì diǎn .
meaning: Ten books in total, including two dictionaries.

text: 拿我来说，先听一会儿比较容易开口。
pinyin: ná wǒ lái shuō , xiān tīng yī huì er bǐ jiào róng yì kāi kǒu .
meaning: For me, listening first makes speaking easier.

text: 尽管这本没读完，我还是想来听。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn zhè běn méi dú wán , wǒ hái shi xiǎng lái tīng .
meaning: Although I haven’t finished this book, I still want to come and listen.

text: 在我看来，先读再聊比较合适。
pinyin: zài wǒ kàn lái , xiān dú zài liáo bǐ jiào hé shì .
meaning: In my view, reading before talking works better.

text: 只凭人数，难以知道大家喜欢什么。
pinyin: zhǐ píng rén shù , nán yǐ zhī dào dà jiā xǐ huān shén me .
meaning: Numbers alone make it hard to know what people like.

text: 先确认小厅，再联络报名的人。
pinyin: xiān què rèn xiǎo tīng , zài lián luò bào míng de rén .
meaning: Confirm the hall first, then contact registered people.

text: 支持继续试，并不等于支持每天延长。
pinyin: zhī chí jì xù shì , bìng bù děng yú zhī chí měi tiān yán cháng .
meaning: Supporting further trial is not supporting extension every day.

text: 即使我这周不来，也想知道以后的安排。
pinyin: jí shǐ wǒ zhè zhōu bù lái , yě xiǎng zhī dào yǐ hòu de ān pái .
meaning: Even if I don’t come this week, I want to know later arrangements.

text: 没有人关门，就没有继续试办的安排。
pinyin: méi yǒu rén guān mén , jiù méi yǒu jì xù shì bàn de ān pái .
meaning: Without someone to close up there is no arrangement for continuing.

text: 尽管我赞成继续，但不要求马上每天延长。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn wǒ zàn chéng jì xù , dàn bú yào qiú mǎ shàng měi tiān yán cháng .
meaning: Although I favour continuing, I don’t demand daily extension immediately.

text: 我们依据到访记录和意见作评估。
pinyin: wǒ men yī jù dào fǎng jì lù hé yì jiàn zuò píng gū .
meaning: We evaluate using visit records and feedback.

text: 他居然记得我以前说过的话。
pinyin: tā jū rán jì de wǒ yǐ qián shuō guò de huà .
meaning: He unexpectedly remembers what I said before.

text: 明明已经到了，却说还在路上。
pinyin: míng míng yǐ jīng dào le , què shuō hái zài lù shàng .
meaning: They have clearly arrived, yet say they are still on the way.

text: 真有你的，一道汤放两次盐。
pinyin: zhēn yǒu nǐ de , yī dào tāng fàng liǎng cì yán .
meaning: Well, look at you—salting one soup twice.

text: 急什么急，还没到时间呢。
pinyin: jí shén me jí , hái méi dào shí jiān ne .
meaning: Why the rush? It isn’t time yet.

text: 随着声音变轻，我更注意他的动作。
pinyin: suí zhe shēng yīn biàn qīng , wǒ gèng zhù yì tā de dòng zuò .
meaning: As the sound grows softer, I attend more to his actions.

text: 有希望未必就不难过。
pinyin: yǒu xī wàng wèi bì jiù bù nán guò .
meaning: Hope does not necessarily remove sadness.

text: 别把人物的经历当成表演者的经历。
pinyin: bié bǎ rén wù de jīng lì dàng chéng biǎo yǎn zhě de jīng lì .
meaning: Don’t treat the character’s experience as the performer’s.

text: 我既想听明白，也想说清自己的看法。
pinyin: wǒ jì xiǎng tīng míng bái , yě xiǎng shuō qīng zì jǐ de kàn fǎ .
meaning: I want both to understand and explain my view.

text: 跟第一遍相比，这次我听清了收信。
pinyin: gēn dì yī biàn xiāng bǐ , zhè cì wǒ tīng qīng le shōu xìn .
meaning: Compared with the first viewing, I heard putting letters away clearly this time.

text: 虽已到场，却还没有听完她的解释。
pinyin: suī yǐ dào chǎng , què hái méi yǒu tīng wán tā de jiě shì .
meaning: Although present, he has not heard her full explanation.

text: 就算你记得很清楚，也可以再确认。
pinyin: jiù suàn nǐ jì de hěn qīng chǔ , yě kě yǐ zài què rèn .
meaning: Even if you remember clearly, you can check again.

text: 反复追问不但没有说清，反而又吵起来了。
pinyin: fǎn fù zhuī wèn bù dàn méi yǒu shuō qīng , fǎn ér yòu chǎo qǐ lái le .
meaning: Repeated questioning not only failed to clarify but restarted the argument.

text: 先确认到场，不只写下班。那倒也是。
pinyin: xiān què rèn dào chǎng , bù zhǐ xiě xià bān . nà dào yě shì .
meaning: Confirm arrival, not just finishing work. Fair point.

text: 等就等吧，不过给我一个大概时间。
pinyin: děng jiù děng ba , bù guò gěi wǒ yī gè dà gài shí jiān .
meaning: Fine, I’ll wait, but give me an approximate time.

text: 我想起来了，你说的是下班，不是到场。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qǐ lái le , nǐ shuō de shì xià bān , bù shì dào chǎng .
meaning: I remember now: you meant finishing work, not arrival.

text: 若无法到场，可以在线参加。
pinyin: ruò wú fǎ dào chǎng , kě yǐ zài xiàn cān jiā .
meaning: If unable to attend, you may join online.

text: 凡是报名的人，都能收到通知。
pinyin: fán shì bào míng de rén , dōu néng shōu dào tōng zhī .
meaning: Everyone who registers receives a notice.

text: 至于最后谁收，我们还没有确定。
pinyin: zhì yú zuì hòu shéi shōu , wǒ men hái méi yǒu què dìng .
meaning: As for who packs up, we haven’t decided.

text: 要么周五试，要么周六提前试。
pinyin: yào me zhōu wǔ shì , yào me zhōu liù tí qián shì .
meaning: Either test Friday or early Saturday.

text: 我今晚不去，再说已经很晚了。
pinyin: wǒ jīn wǎn bù qù , zài shuō yǐ jīng hěn wǎn le .
meaning: I’m not going tonight; besides, it’s already late.

text: 这只是一次尝试罢了，后面还要看看。
pinyin: zhè zhǐ shì yī cì cháng shì bà le , hòu miàn hái yào kàn kàn .
meaning: This is only one trial; we still need to see how it goes.

text: 据通知，活动改到周日。
pinyin: jù tōng zhī , huó dòng gǎi dào zhōu rì .
meaning: According to the notice, the event has moved to Sunday.

text: 我想帮她，反而挡住了通道。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bāng tā , fǎn ér dǎng zhù le tōng dào .
meaning: I meant to help but instead blocked the passage.

text: 他时而看照片，时而读说明。
pinyin: tā shí ér kàn zhào piān , shí ér dú shuō míng .
meaning: He alternated between the photograph and the explanation.

text: 连地面都没拍到，更难凭照片解释那句提醒。
pinyin: lián dì miàn dōu méi pāi dào , gèng nán píng zhào piān jiě shì nà jù tí xǐng .
meaning: The photo misses even the floor, making the warning harder to explain from it.

text: 图里没有声音，这就是说不能从它听见说了什么。
pinyin: tú lǐ méi yǒu shēng yīn , zhè jiù shì shuō bù néng cóng tā tīng jiàn shuō le shén me .
meaning: The photo has no audio, so you can’t hear the words from it.

text: 他或在看图，或在读后面的说明。
pinyin: tā huò zài kàn tú , huò zài dú hòu miàn de shuō míng .
meaning: He may be looking at the image or reading the later explanation.

text: 喜欢是喜欢，别让我每次都回一大段。
pinyin: xǐ huān shì xǐ huān , bié ràng wǒ měi cì dōu huí yī dà duàn .
meaning: I do like it; just don’t make me give a long reply every time.

text: 早不改，晚不改，偏在开场时改。
pinyin: zǎo bù gǎi , wǎn bù gǎi , piān zài kāi chǎng shí gǎi .
meaning: You choose the start of the show to change it.

text: 放着椅子不坐，偏要站着。
pinyin: fàng zhe yǐ zi bù zuò , piān yào zhàn zhe .
meaning: You have a chair but insist on standing.

text: 灯光时而亮，时而暗。
pinyin: dēng guāng shí ér liàng , shí ér àn .
meaning: The light brightens and dims at different moments.

text: 为了保留时间而缩短最后的歌。
pinyin: wèi le bǎo liú shí jiān ér suō duǎn zuì hòu de gē .
meaning: Shorten the final song to retain time.

text: 听完一番解释，他重新想了想。
pinyin: tīng wán yì fān jiě shì , tā chóng xīn xiǎng le xiǎng .
meaning: After hearing an explanation he reconsidered.

text: 她时时提醒我看后面的字。
pinyin: tā shí shí tí xǐng wǒ kàn hòu miàn de zì .
meaning: She repeatedly reminds me to look at the following words.

text: 这一段或像等候，或像准备出发。
pinyin: zhè yī duàn huò xiàng děng hòu , huò xiàng zhǔn bèi chū fā .
meaning: This section may resemble waiting or preparing to leave.

text: 这版不是慢一点了吗，还是觉得跟不上？
pinyin: zhè bǎn bù shì màn yī diǎn le ma , hái shi jué de gēn bù shàng ?
meaning: Isn’t this version slower? You still feel unable to keep up?

text: 看来看去，都是门、灯和风这几个元素。
pinyin: kàn lái kàn qù , dōu shì mén , dēng hé fēng zhè jǐ gè yuán sù .
meaning: On repeated looking the elements are door, lamp and wind.

text: 除了最后一行，前面的歌词都已确认。
pinyin: chú le zuì hòu yī xíng , qián miàn de gē cí dōu yǐ què rèn .
meaning: Except for the final line, the preceding lyrics are confirmed.

text: 因对象不同而暂时保留判断。
pinyin: yīn duì xiàng bù tóng ér zàn shí bǎo liú pàn duàn .
meaning: Hold judgement for now because recipients differ.

text: 记录完整后便向小组通报。
pinyin: jì lù wán zhěng hòu biàn xiàng xiǎo zǔ tōng bào .
meaning: Report to the group once the record is complete.

text: 他的说明被后来的数字给盖住了。
pinyin: tā de shuō míng bèi hòu lái de shù zì gěi gài zhù le .
meaning: His explanation was overshadowed by the later numbers.

text: 除最后一组外，其余记录都已完整。
pinyin: chú zuì hòu yī zǔ wài , qí yú jì lù dōu yǐ wán zhěng .
meaning: Except for the final group, all other records are complete.

text: 至于后续谁做，我们还要协商。
pinyin: zhì yú hòu xù shéi zuò , wǒ men hái yào xié shāng .
meaning: As for follow-up responsibility, we still need discussion.

text: 就算支持试点，也不能保证每个时段都有空。
pinyin: jiù suàn zhī chí shì diǎn , yě bù néng bǎo zhèng měi gè shí duàn dōu yǒu kōng .
meaning: Even supporting the trial doesn’t guarantee availability at every time.

text: 沿着河边走至桥旁再停。
pinyin: yán zhe hé biān zǒu zhì qiáo páng zài tíng .
meaning: Follow the riverbank to the bridge, then stop.

text: 他或在门口，或在活动桌旁。
pinyin: tā huò zài mén kǒu , huò zài huó dòng zhuō páng .
meaning: He may be at the door or the event table.

text: 那张纸被风给吹到桌边了。
pinyin: nà zhāng zhǐ bèi fēng gěi chuī dào zhuō biān le .
meaning: The sheet was blown to the table edge by the wind.

text: 这边一张，那边一张，纸散在桌上。
pinyin: zhè biān yī zhāng , nà biān yī zhāng , zhǐ sàn zài zhuō shàng .
meaning: A sheet here and a sheet there lie across the table.

text: 就算现在知道，也不能说刚才一直知道。
pinyin: jiù suàn xiàn zài zhī dào , yě bù néng shuō gāng cái yì zhí zhī dào .
meaning: Even knowing now doesn’t mean always knowing earlier.

text: 至于吃什么，你们先选。
pinyin: zhì yú chī shén me , nǐ men xiān xuǎn .
meaning: As for food, you choose first.

text: 那件事明天再说。
pinyin: nà jiàn shì míng tiān zài shuō .
meaning: Discuss that tomorrow.

text: 不是没人说话就表示没人在听。
pinyin: bù shì méi rén shuō huà jiù biǎo shì méi rén zài tīng .
meaning: Silence does not automatically mean nobody is listening.

text: 八人到十二人，人数增加百分之五十。
pinyin: bā rén dào shí èr rén , rén shù zēng jiā bǎi fēn zhī wǔ shí .
meaning: 8 to12 is a50% relative count increase.

text: 她不只想聊天，还想赶上车。
pinyin: tā bù zhǐ xiǎng liáo tiān , hái xiǎng gǎn shàng chē .
meaning: She wants to chat and catch the bus.

text: 一方面场地有限，另一方面有人只想听。
pinyin: yì fāng miàn chǎng dì yǒu xiàn , lìng yì fāng miàn yǒu rén zhǐ xiǎng tīng .
meaning: Space is limited and some only want to listen.

text: 从人员安排来看，暂时只能开四次。
pinyin: cóng rén yuán ān pái lái kàn , zàn shí zhǐ néng kāi sì cì .
meaning: Staffing permits four evenings for now.

text: 尽管有卡，仍要在白天办理。
pinyin: jǐn guǎn yǒu kǎ , réng yào zài bái tiān bàn lǐ .
meaning: Even with a card,you need daytime service.

text: 不仅看人数，也看收尾安排。
pinyin: bù jǐn kàn rén shù , yě kàn shōu wěi ān pái .
meaning: Consider attendance and closing duties.

text: 我读了两篇关于图书馆的文章。
pinyin: wǒ dú le liǎng piān guān yú tú shū guǎn de wén zhāng .
meaning: I read two articles about the library.

text: 若时间调整，则另行通知。
pinyin: ruò shí jiān tiáo zhěng , zé lìng xíng tōng zhī .
meaning: If timing changes,a separate notice follows.

text: 凡是改过的安排，都写进消息。
pinyin: fán shì gǎi guò de ān pái , dōu xiě jìn xiāo xī .
meaning: Include all changed arrangements.

text: 与其猜她有空，不如先问。
pinyin: yǔ qí cāi tā yǒu kōng , bù rú xiān wèn .
meaning: Better ask than guess her availability.

text: 这是待确认的建议，不是已经确定的顺序。
pinyin: zhè shì dài què rèn de jiàn yì , bù shì yǐ jīng què dìng de shùn xù .
meaning: This is a pending suggestion,not confirmed order.

text: 先确认场地，再发最终节目单。
pinyin: xiān què rèn chǎng dì , zài fā zuì zhōng jié mù dān .
meaning: Confirm the room before the final programme.

text: 若周五没确认，就先不安排。
pinyin: ruò zhōu wǔ méi què rèn , jiù xiān bù ān pái .
meaning: If unconfirmed Friday,do not schedule yet.

text: 把时间念一遍，免得记错。
pinyin: bǎ shí jiān niàn yī biàn , miǎn de jì cuò .
meaning: Read the time back to reduce mistakes.

text: 不是不喜欢，只是还没看懂。
pinyin: bù shì bù xǐ huān , zhǐ shì hái méi kàn dǒng .
meaning: I do like it;I have not understood it yet.

text: 结尾先别讲，我还没看。
pinyin: jié wěi xiān bié jiǎng , wǒ hái méi kàn .
meaning: Do not tell the ending yet;I have not watched.

text: 有问题只管问。
pinyin: yǒu wèn tí zhǐ guǎn wèn .
meaning: Go ahead and ask questions.

text: 我可没说每个人都得等。
pinyin: wǒ kě méi shuō měi gè rén dōu děi děng .
meaning: I did not say everyone must wait.

text: 到了再发消息。
pinyin: dào le zài fā xiāo xī .
meaning: Message when you arrive.

text: 不是换地方，是我记错了。
pinyin: bù shì huàn dì fāng , shì wǒ jì cuò le .
meaning: The venue did not change;I remembered wrong.

text: 雨声仿佛从窗外进来。
pinyin: yǔ shēng fǎng fú cóng chuāng wài jìn lái .
meaning: Rain seems to come from outside.

text: 她一番话让我明白了。
pinyin: tā yī fān huà ràng wǒ míng bái le .
meaning: Her explanation helped me understand.

text: 这个问题早晚要面对。
pinyin: zhè gè wèn tí zǎo wǎn yào miàn duì .
meaning: This issue needs facing sooner or later.

text: 歌词的期待不等于已经买好车票。
pinyin: gē cí de qī dài bù děng yú yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo chē piào .
meaning: Lyric anticipation does not mean a ticket is booked.

text: 不是每一个没说完的故事都取消了结尾。
pinyin: bù shì měi yī gè méi shuō wán de gù shì dōu qǔ xiāo liǎo jié wěi .
meaning: Not every unfinished story cancels its ending.

text: 你好！我是林安。
pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì Lín Ān.
meaning: Hello! I’m Lin An.

text: 这是我妈妈。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ māma.
meaning: This is my mum.

text: 这是我的马。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de mǎ.
meaning: This is my horse.

text: 我的马不大，它很小。
pinyin: Wǒ de mǎ bú dà, tā hěn xiǎo.
meaning: My horse isn’t big. It’s very small.

text: 你有马吗？
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu mǎ ma?
meaning: Do you have a horse?

text: 你好！我是林安。这是我妈妈。这是我的马。我的马不大，它很小。你有马吗？
pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì Lín Ān. Zhè shì wǒ māma. Zhè shì wǒ de mǎ. Wǒ de mǎ bú dà, tā hěn xiǎo. Nǐ yǒu mǎ ma?
meaning: Hello! I’m Lin An. This is my mum. This is my horse. My horse isn’t big. It’s very small. Do you have a horse?

parts.text: 你好！我是林安。
这是我妈妈。
这是我的马。
我的马不大，它很小。
你有马吗？

text: 山上有人。
pinyin: Shān shang yǒu rén.
meaning: There are people on the mountain.

text: 山下有水。
pinyin: Shān xià yǒu shuǐ.
meaning: There is water below the mountain.

text: 我看山，山很大。
pinyin: Wǒ kàn shān, shān hěn dà.
meaning: I look at the mountain. It is big.

text: 他们在山上休息。

text: 我们家有三口人，住在这栋楼。

text: 家里有两间房，楼上有床和洗手间。

text: 楼下有厨房，旁边有一张桌子。
pinyin: lóu xià yǒu chú fáng , páng biān yǒu yī zhāng zhuō zi .

text: 桌子上有电脑，没有电视机。

text: 地上还有一本书，请拿到桌子上。
pinyin: dì shang hái yǒu yī běn shū , qǐng ná dào zhuō zi shàng .

text: 杯子里边没有水，杯子也不干净。
pinyin: bēi zi lǐ bian méi yǒu shuǐ , bēi zi yě bù gān jìng .
meaning: There is no water inside the cup, and the cup is not clean.

text: 先洗手，再洗杯子，准备两杯水。
pinyin: xiān xǐ shǒu , zài xǐ bēi zi , zhǔn bèi liǎng bēi shuǐ .
meaning: First wash your hands, then wash the cups and prepare two glasses of water.

text: 家里有电，电脑可以用。
pinyin: jiā lǐ yǒu diàn , diàn nǎo kě yǐ yòng .
meaning: There is electricity at home, so the computer can be used.

text: 这栋楼的楼下有一家商店，可以买牛奶。

meaning: There is a shop downstairs in this building where you can buy milk.

meaning: A little sad, but I believe you. How about Saturday?

text: 也许方便，不一定能早来。先商量。
pinyin: yě xǔ fāng biàn , bù yí dìng néng zǎo lái . xiān shāng liang .
meaning: Perhaps convenient; not sure I can come early. Let us discuss it first.

text: 放心，不急着答应。先休息，明天说。
pinyin: fàng xīn , bù jí zhe dā ying . xiān xiū xī , míng tiān shuō .
meaning: Do not worry; no rush to agree. Rest first and tell me tomorrow.

text: 好。改时间，不是改变交朋友的想法。
pinyin: hǎo . gǎi shí jiān , bù shì gǎi biàn jiāo péng yǒu de xiǎng fa .
meaning: Okay. Changing the time does not mean changing my wish to make friends.

text: 晚上出去吃吧？我想找个安静的地方。
pinyin: wǎn shang chū qù chī ba ? wǒ xiǎng zhǎo gè ān jìng de dì fāng .
meaning: Want to eat out tonight? I'd like somewhere quiet.

text: 好啊。你想吃什么？
pinyin: hǎo a . nǐ xiǎng chī shén me ?
meaning: Sure. What would you like?

text: 今天不想吃快餐，也不想叫外卖。
pinyin: jīn tiān bù xiǎng chī kuài cān , yě bù xiǎng jiào wài mài .
meaning: I don't want fast food or delivery today.

text: 那去我家附近那家饭馆吧，菜的味道不错。
pinyin: nà qù wǒ jiā fù jìn nà jiā fàn guǎn ba , cài de wèi dào bù cuò .
meaning: Then let's go to the restaurant near my home. The food's good.

text: 你去过？
pinyin: nǐ qù guò ?
meaning: Have you been?

text: 去过，上周和小周一起去的。
pinyin: qù guò , shàng zhōu hé xiǎo zhōu yì qǐ qù de .
meaning: Yes, with Xiao Zhou last week.

text: 要等很久吗？
pinyin: yào děng hěn jiǔ ma ?
meaning: Is the wait long?

text: 大概二十分钟。你饿了吗？
pinyin: dà gài èr shí fēn zhōng . nǐ è le ma ?
meaning: About twenty minutes. Are you hungry?

text: 还好。我们六点出发，怎么样？
pinyin: hái hǎo . wǒ men liù diǎn chū fā , zěn me yàng ?
meaning: Not too hungry. Shall we leave at six?

text: 行。坐车十分钟，再走五分钟。
pinyin: xíng . zuò chē shí fēn zhōng , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng .
meaning: Okay. Ten minutes by bus, then a five-minute walk.

text: 到了以后，你帮我点菜吧。不要太辣。
pinyin: dào le yǐ hòu , nǐ bāng wǒ diǎn cài ba . bú yào tài là .
meaning: Help me order when we get there. Nothing too spicy.

text: 好。我们先点两个菜，不够再加。
pinyin: hǎo . wǒ men xiān diǎn liǎng gè cài , bù gòu zài jiā .
meaning: Okay. We'll start with two dishes and order more if we need them.
