text: 下班以后，我约陈宇出去吃饭。中午已经吃过快餐，晚上想找一家安静的饭馆，坐下来慢慢聊。
pinyin: xià bān yǐ hòu , wǒ yuē chén yǔ chū qù chī fàn . zhōng wǔ yǐ jīng chī guò kuài cān , wǎn shang xiǎng zhǎo yī jiā ān jìng de fàn guǎn , zuò xià lái màn màn liáo .
meaning: After work I asked Chen Yu to eat out. I'd already had fast food at lunch and wanted a quiet restaurant where we could sit and chat.

text: 陈宇说他家附近有一家，菜的味道不错。他上周和小周去过，不过那天等了二十分钟才有座位。
pinyin: chén yǔ shuō tā jiā fù jìn yǒu yī jiā , cài de wèi dào bù cuò . tā shàng zhōu hé xiǎo zhōu qù guò , bù guò nà tiān děng le èr shí fēn zhōng cái yǒu zuò wèi .
meaning: He knew one near his home with good food. He and Xiao Zhou had gone the previous week, though they'd waited twenty minutes for seats.

text: 我们六点出发，坐车十分钟，再走五分钟。进门时前面还有两位顾客，服务员请我们在门边等一会儿。
pinyin: wǒ men liù diǎn chū fā , zuò chē shí fēn zhōng , zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng . jìn mén shí qián miàn hái yǒu liǎng wèi gù kè , fú wù yuán qǐng wǒ men zài mén biān děng yī huì er .
meaning: We left at six, rode the bus for ten minutes and walked another five. Two customers were ahead of us; a server asked us to wait by the entrance.

text: 这次只等了十分钟。坐下以后，陈宇先问我想吃什么。我不太能吃辣，就点了炒鸡蛋和一盘青菜。
pinyin: zhè cì zhǐ děng le shí fēn zhōng . zuò xià yǐ hòu , chén yǔ xiān wèn wǒ xiǎng chī shén me . wǒ bù tài néng chī là , jiù diǎn le chǎo jī dàn hé yī pán qīng cài .
meaning: This time the wait was only ten minutes. Once seated, Chen Yu asked what I'd like. I can't eat very spicy food, so I ordered scrambled eggs and a plate of greens.

text: 菜来得很快，我对味道很满意。陈宇说上周也好吃，就是那次等得久，他有点不满。
pinyin: cài lái de hěn kuài , wǒ duì wèi dào hěn mǎn yì . chén yǔ shuō shàng zhōu yě hǎo chī , jiù shì nà cì děng de jiǔ , tā yǒu diǎn bù mǎn .
meaning: The food came quickly and I liked it very much. Chen Yu said last week's food was good too; he'd just been a little unhappy about the long wait.

text: 吃完我们走回车站，他问下次还来不来。我说来啊，不过午餐别再叫我吃快餐了，今天想换换。
pinyin: chī wán wǒ men zǒu huí chē zhàn , tā wèn xià cì hái lái bù lái . wǒ shuō lái a , bù guò wǔ cān bié zài jiào wǒ chī kuài cān le , jīn tiān xiǎng huàn huàn .
meaning: After dinner we walked back to the stop. Would I come again? Yes, I said, but please don't invite me for fast food at lunch again. I wanted a change today.

text: 那我信你一次。

meaning: How do I fill in this form?

pinyin: tā xǐ huān shén me yàng de diàn yǐng ?
meaning: What kind of films does she like?

text: 我认为这本书值得再读一次。
pinyin: wǒ rèn wéi zhè běn shū zhí de zài dú yī cì .
meaning: I think this book is worth reading again.

text: 看完电影，我们聊了聊各自的看法。
pinyin: kàn wán diàn yǐng , wǒ men liáo le liáo gè zì de kàn fǎ .
meaning: After the film we talked about what each of us thought.

text: 他迟到的原因是坐错了车。
pinyin: tā chí dào de yuán yīn shì zuò cuò le chē .
meaning: He was late because he took the wrong bus.

text: 住得近的好处是可以走路上班。
pinyin: zhù de jìn de hǎo chù shì kě yǐ zǒu lù shàng bān .
meaning: The advantage of living nearby is being able to walk to work.

text: 睡得太晚有什么坏处？
pinyin: shuì de tài wǎn yǒu shén me huài chù ?
meaning: What are the drawbacks of going to bed too late?

text: 这杯茶的味道和昨天的不一样。
pinyin: zhè bēi chá de wèi dào hé zuó tiān de bù yī yàng .
meaning: This tea tastes different from yesterday's.

text: 车站对面新开了一家饭馆。
pinyin: chē zhàn duì miàn xīn kāi le yī jiā fàn guǎn .
meaning: A new restaurant has opened opposite the station.

text: 楼下的快餐店十二点人最多。
pinyin: lóu xià de kuài cān diàn shí èr diǎn rén zuì duō .
meaning: The fast-food place downstairs is busiest at noon.

text: 雨太大了，我们叫外卖吧。
pinyin: yǔ tài dà le , wǒ men jiào wài mài ba .

text: 家里还有两包方便面。
pinyin: jiā lǐ hái yǒu liǎng bāo fāng biàn miàn .
meaning: There are still two packets of instant noodles at home.

text: 这家旅馆的服务很好。
pinyin: zhè jiā lǚ guǎn de fú wù hěn hǎo .
meaning: The service at this hotel is very good.

text: 店里只有一位顾客。
pinyin: diàn lǐ zhǐ yǒu yī wèi gù kè .
meaning: There's only one customer in the shop.

text: 照片拍得很好，我很满意。
pinyin: zhào piān pāi de hěn hǎo , wǒ hěn mǎn yì .
meaning: The photo came out well. I'm very happy with it.

text: 她对这个安排不满，想换个时间。
pinyin: tā duì zhè gè ān pái bù mǎn , xiǎng huàn gè shí jiān .
meaning: She's unhappy with this arrangement and wants a different time.

text: 周末可以做很多事，比如看书、散步。
pinyin: zhōu mò kě yǐ zuò hěn duō shì , bǐ rú kàn shū , sàn bù .
meaning: There's plenty to do at weekends, like reading or walking.

text: 我们住在不同的城市。
pinyin: wǒ men zhù zài bù tóng de chéng shì .
meaning: We live in different cities.

text: 窗边还有一个座位。

text: 晚上见面，你穿什么？还没想好。蓝色的还是绿色的？晚上有点凉，蓝色那件长一点吧？对。绿色的又轻又短，我带蓝色的。那里面穿什么？白色的。黄色那件还没干。鞋呢？我们还要走一会儿。黑色的，走路舒服。还有朋友送的红色围巾。好啊。到时候我也戴红色的。你也有？那照片里可能认错我们。认鞋就行，我的是白色的。行，晚上见。
pinyin: wǎn shang jiàn miàn , nǐ chuān shén me ? hái méi xiǎng hǎo . lán sè de hái shi lǜ sè de ? wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , lán sè nà jiàn zhǎng yī diǎn ba ? duì . lǜ sè de yòu qīng yòu duǎn , wǒ dài lán sè de . nà lǐ miàn chuān shén me ? bái sè de . huáng sè nà jiàn hái méi gàn . xié ne ? wǒ men hái yào zǒu yī huì er . hēi sè de , zǒu lù shū fú . hái yǒu péng you sòng de hóng sè wéi jīn . hǎo a . dào shí hou wǒ yě dài hóng sè de . nǐ yě yǒu ? nà zhào piān lǐ kě néng rèn cuò wǒ men . rèn xié jiù xíng , wǒ de shì bái sè de . xíng , wǎn shang jiàn .
meaning: What are you wearing for tonight's meet-up? I haven't decided. Blue or green? It'll be cool tonight. Isn't the blue one longer? Yes. The green one's light and short. I'll bring the blue one. What will you wear underneath? White. The yellow one hasn't dried yet. What about shoes? We'll be walking for a while. Black ones. They're comfortable. And the red scarf my friend gave me. Nice. I'll wear my red one too. You have one too? People might mix us up in photos. Just look at the shoes. Mine are white. Okay. See you tonight.

text: 晚上我和陈宇约好见朋友。出门前他问我穿什么，说晚上有点凉，让我带一件长一点的衣服。
pinyin: wǎn shang wǒ hé chén yǔ yuē hǎo jiàn péng you . chū mén qián tā wèn wǒ chuān shén me , shuō wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , ràng wǒ dài yī jiàn zhǎng yī diǎn de yī fú .
meaning: Chen Yu and I planned to meet friends tonight. Before leaving he asked what I planned to wear, said it would be cool and suggested a longer layer.

text: 绿色那件又轻又短，蓝色的长一点。我把蓝色的放进包里，里面穿白色的。黄色那件还没干，只好留在家里。
pinyin: lǜ sè nà jiàn yòu qīng yòu duǎn , lán sè de zhǎng yī diǎn . wǒ bǎ lán sè de fàng jìn bāo lǐ , lǐ miàn chuān bái sè de . huáng sè nà jiàn hái méi gàn , zhǐ hǎo liú zài jiā lǐ .
meaning: The green one was light and short; the blue one was longer. I packed the blue one and wore white underneath. The yellow one hadn't dried, so it stayed home.

text: 我穿黑色的鞋，也戴上朋友送的红色围巾。这双鞋虽然普通，走远路却很舒服，今天正好用得上。
pinyin: wǒ chuān hēi sè de xié , yě dài shàng péng you sòng de hóng sè wéi jīn . zhè shuāng xié suī rán pǔ tōng , zǒu yuǎn lù què hěn shū fú , jīn tiān zhèng hǎo yòng de shàng .
meaning: I wore black shoes and the red scarf a friend had given me. The shoes were ordinary but comfortable for long walks, just right for today.

text: 到车站时，我先看到一条红色围巾，走近才发现是陈宇。他的鞋是白色的，还真的和我们说好的一样。
pinyin: dào chē zhàn shí , wǒ xiān kàn dào yī tiáo hóng sè wéi jīn , zǒu jìn cái fā xiàn shì chén yǔ . tā de xié shì bái sè de , hái zhēn de hé wǒ men shuō hǎo de yī yàng .
meaning: At the stop I first saw a red scarf; closer up, I realised it was Chen Yu. His shoes were white, just as we'd said.

text: 朋友给我们拍照片，笑着说两条围巾的样子很可爱。陈宇问我是不是故意和他穿一样，我说是他先说也戴红色的。
pinyin: péng you gěi wǒ men pāi zhào piàn , xiào zhe shuō liǎng tiáo wéi jīn de yàng zi hěn kě ài . chén yǔ wèn wǒ shì bú shì gù yì hé tā chuān yī yàng , wǒ shuō shì tā xiān shuō yě dài hóng sè de .
meaning: A friend took a photo and laughed that the two scarves looked cute. Chen Yu asked if I'd deliberately matched him. I said he'd been the one to choose red too.

text: 回家时风有点大，我从包里拿出蓝色的衣服。陈宇说幸好带了，我说对，还好它不重。
pinyin: huí jiā shí fēng yǒu diǎn dà , wǒ cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lán sè de yī fú . chén yǔ shuō xìng hǎo dài le , wǒ shuō duì , hái hǎo tā bù zhòng .
meaning: It was windy on the way home, so I took out the blue layer. Chen Yu said it was lucky I'd brought it. Yes, I said, and luckily it wasn't heavy.

text: 照片里两条红围巾，哪条是你的？
pinyin: zhào piān lǐ liǎng tiáo hóng wéi jīn , nǎ tiáo shì nǐ de ?
meaning: Two red scarves in the photo. Which is yours?

text: 看鞋，黑的是我的。
pinyin: kàn xié , hēi de shì wǒ de .
meaning: Look at the shoes. The black ones are mine.

text: 你站我旁边，鞋看不到。
pinyin: nǐ zhàn wǒ páng biān , xié kàn bù dào .
meaning: You're standing next to me. We can't see the shoes.

text: 那看包，我的包在右边。
pinyin: nà kàn bāo , wǒ de bāo zài yòu biān .
meaning: Then look at the bags. Mine's on the right.

text: 看到了。这张拍得挺好。
pinyin: kàn dào le . zhè zhāng pāi de tǐng hǎo .
meaning: Found it. This photo came out nicely.

text: 发给我吧，我也想留着。
pinyin: fā gěi wǒ ba , wǒ yě xiǎng liú zhe .

text: 她家的小猫真可爱。

text: 我只要一个普通杯子，不用大的。

text: 她说谢谢，还说看了信很感动。我也感谢她的帮助。

text: 信要交给谁？
pinyin: xìn yào jiāo gěi shéi ?

text: 交给老师。先确认收件人，再寄，别只看楼层。
pinyin: jiāo gěi lǎo shī . xiān què rèn shōu jiàn rén , zài jì , bié zhǐ kàn lóu céng .

text: 朋友前几天照顾我，我想感谢她。她看了信，说很感动。
pinyin: péng you qián jǐ tiān zhào gù wǒ , wǒ xiǎng gǎn xiè tā . tā kàn le xìn , shuō hěn gǎn dòng .
meaning: My friend looked after me a few days ago, and I wanted to thank her. She read the letter and said she was moved.

text: 我送给她一条围巾。那件衣服不是礼物，留给我自己。
pinyin: wǒ sòng gěi tā yī tiáo wéi jīn . nà jiàn yī fú bù shì lǐ wù , liú gěi wǒ zì jǐ .
meaning: I give her a scarf. The item of clothing is not a gift; I keep it for myself.

text: 给老师的礼物是一套笔记本和笔，每人一份，不用猜价格。
pinyin: gěi lǎo shī de lǐ wù shì yī tào bǐ jì běn hé bǐ , měi rén yī fèn , bù yòng cāi jià gé .
meaning: The teacher’s gift is a set of notebooks and pens: one gift each, with no need to guess the price.

text: 朋友住三层，但这个包裹要送到学校。学校地址在我的笔记里。
pinyin: péng you zhù sān céng , dàn zhè gè bāo guǒ yào sòng dào xué xiào . xué xiào dì zhǐ zài wǒ de bǐ jì lǐ .
meaning: My friend lives on the third floor, but this parcel goes to the school. The school address is in my notes.

text: 我先把包裹放下，拿纸和笔写地址，再检查收件人。
pinyin: wǒ xiān bǎ bāo guǒ fàng xià , ná zhǐ hé bǐ xiě dì zhǐ , zài jiǎn chá shōu jiàn rén .
meaning: I put the parcel down, take paper and a pen to write the address, and then check the recipient.

text: 接到服务台的通知后，老师可以去拿。我请朋友把另一封信交给她。
pinyin: jiē dào fú wù tái de tōng zhī hòu , lǎo shī kě yǐ qù ná . wǒ qǐng péng you bǎ lìng yī fēng xìn jiāo gěi tā .
meaning: After receiving the service desk’s notice, the teacher can collect it. I ask my friend to hand her the other letter.

text: 别人不方便接受礼物，也可以说不用了。感谢不一定要靠送东西。

meaning: Someone who finds accepting a gift inconvenient can decline it. Gratitude does not have to depend on giving things.

pinyin: wǒ gāng cái zhǐ kàn sān céng , wàng le bǔ xiě .

text: 楼层不是名字。是送给老师的那一份吗？
pinyin: lóu céng bù shì míng zi . shì sòng gěi lǎo shī de nà yī fèn ma ?

text: 对。写上名字，再检查一遍。
pinyin: duì . xiě shàng míng zi , zài jiǎn chá yī biàn .
meaning: Yes. Add the name and check once more.

text: 这样才清楚。谢谢你照顾我的包裹。
pinyin: zhè yàng cái qīng chǔ . xiè xiè nǐ zhào gù wǒ de bāo guǒ .
meaning: Now it is clear. Thank you for looking after my parcel.

text: 你刚到吗？我早晨看了通知，说六点半集合。
pinyin: nǐ gāng dào ma ? wǒ zǎo chén kàn le tōng zhī , shuō liù diǎn bàn jí hé .
meaning: Did you just arrive? I read a notice this morning saying to meet at half past six.

text: 先停一下。新通知刚刚发来，集合改成六点四十。
pinyin: xiān tíng yī xià . xīn tōng zhī gāng gāng fā lái , jí hé gǎi chéng liù diǎn sì shí .
meaning: Wait. The new notice has just arrived; the meeting time changed to six forty.

text: 节目也改了吗？
pinyin: jié mù yě gǎi le ma ?
meaning: Did the programme time change too?

text: 没有，还是七点。开场以前先检票，六点四十集合就好。
pinyin: méi yǒu , hái shi qī diǎn . kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào , liù diǎn sì shí jí hé jiù hǎo .
meaning: No, still seven. Tickets are checked before the start; meeting at six forty is fine.

text: 那我们有二十分钟。刚才收到的是什么？

meaning: Then we have twenty minutes. What did we receive just now?

text: 刚才是旧的。上周的图片也别当成今天的。
pinyin: gāng cái shì jiù de . shàng zhōu de tú piàn yě bié dàng chéng jīn tiān de .
meaning: That was the old one. Do not treat last week’s image as today’s either.

text: 这时灯还亮着，节目还没开始吧？

meaning: The lights are still on now; it has not started yet, right?

text: 对，快要七点了。灯暗了以后先别走，节目就要开始了。
pinyin: duì , kuài yào qī diǎn le . dēng àn le yǐ hòu xiān bié zǒu , jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le .
meaning: Right, nearly seven. Stay seated after the lights dim; the programme is about to begin.

text: 散场后喝茶？夜里还有车吗？

meaning: Tea after the show? Will transport still be running at night?

text: 先确认，别到半夜才问。不一会儿，另一位朋友也会到。
pinyin: xiān què rèn , bié dào bàn yè cái wèn . bù yí huìr , lìng yī wèi péng you yě huì dào .
meaning: Check first; do not wait until midnight to ask. Another friend will arrive shortly too.

text: 学校十周年，这个学期节目不少。下周还有？
pinyin: xué xiào shí zhōu nián , zhè gè xué qī jié mù bù shǎo . xià zhōu hái yǒu ?
meaning: It is the school’s tenth anniversary; quite a few programmes this term. Another next week?

text: 有，不久以后再发通知。今天先看这一场。
pinyin: yǒu , bù jiǔ yǐ hòu zài fā tōng zhī . jīn tiān xiān kàn zhè yī chǎng .
meaning: Yes, another notice will be sent before long. Today let us watch this one first.

pinyin: cóng liù diǎn sì shí dào qī diǎn yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng , bù shì èr shí diǎn . kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào , zài rù chǎng .
meaning: There are twenty minutes from six forty to seven, not twenty o’clock. Have tickets checked before the start, then enter.

text: 这时灯还亮着。快要七点了，节目要开始了，但还没有开始。
pinyin: zhè shí dēng hái liàng zhe . kuài yào qī diǎn le , jié mù yào kāi shǐ le , dàn hái méi yǒu kāi shǐ .
meaning: The lights are still on now. It is nearly seven and the programme is about to begin, but it has not started yet.

text: 灯暗了以后，先坐好。散场后再喝茶，回家前先确认夜里有没有车。
pinyin: dēng àn le yǐ hòu , xiān zuò hǎo . sàn chǎng hòu zài hē chá , huí jiā qián xiān què rèn yè lǐ yǒu méi yǒu chē .
meaning: When the lights dim, stay seated. Have tea after the show and check night transport before going home.

text: 不一会儿，朋友也来了。我们没有等到半夜才问回家的办法。
pinyin: bù yí huìr , péng you yě lái le . wǒ men méi yǒu děng dào bàn yè cái wèn huí jiā de bàn fǎ .
meaning: Our friend arrived in a little while too. We did not wait until the middle of the night to ask how to get home.

text: 学校十周年，这个学期每周都有活动。上周去过一次，下周还想再去。
pinyin: xué xiào shí zhōu nián , zhè gè xué qī měi zhōu dōu yǒu huó dòng . shàng zhōu qù guò yī cì , xià zhōu hái xiǎng zài qù .
meaning: For the school’s tenth anniversary there is an activity every week this term. We went once last week and want to go again next week.

text: 不久以后会发下周的通知。今天这一张不能拿来确定下周的时间。
pinyin: bù jiǔ yǐ hòu huì fā xià zhōu de tōng zhī . jīn tiān zhè yī zhāng bù néng ná lái què dìng xià zhōu de shí jiān .
meaning: Next week’s notice will be sent before long. Today’s notice cannot establish next week’s times.

text: 早晨的通知写六点半集合。新通知刚刚改成六点四十，节目还是七点。刚才收到的图片是旧的。后来我们才看到新消息，先停下来检查了一遍。从六点四十到七点有二十分钟，不是二十点。开场以前先检票，再入场。这时灯还亮着。快要七点了，节目要开始了，但还没有开始。灯暗了以后，先坐好。散场后再喝茶，回家前先确认夜里有没有车。不一会儿，朋友也来了。我们没有等到半夜才问回家的办法。学校十周年，这个学期每周都有活动。上周去过一次，下周还想再去。不久以后会发下周的通知。今天这一张不能拿来确定下周的时间。

text: 刚到门口，先停一停。旧图放下，新消息看清。
pinyin: gāng dào mén kǒu , xiān tíng yī tíng . jiù tú fàng xià , xīn xiāo xī kàn qīng .
meaning: Just at the door, pause a moment. Put down the old image; read the new message clearly.

text: 六点四十，一起集合。二十分钟以后，七点开场。
pinyin: liù diǎn sì shí , yì qǐ jí hé . èr shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu , qī diǎn kāi chǎng .
meaning: Meet together at six forty. Twenty minutes later, start at seven.

text: 开场前检票，灯暗后坐好。要开始了，不是已经散场。
pinyin: kāi chǎng qián jiǎn piào , dēng àn hòu zuò hǎo . yào kāi shǐ le , bù shì yǐ jīng sàn chǎng .
meaning: Check tickets before the start; sit when the lights dim. About to begin does not mean already ended.

text: 散场后喝茶，回家前看车。不等半夜，才想办法。
pinyin: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá , huí jiā qián kàn chē . bù děng bàn yè , cái xiǎng bàn fǎ .
meaning: Tea after the show; check transport before heading home. Do not leave planning until midnight.

text: 上周是上周，下周等通知。今天的时间，别送给明天。
pinyin: shàng zhōu shì shàng zhōu , xià zhōu děng tōng zhī . jīn tiān de shí jiān , bié sòng gěi míng tiān .
meaning: Last week is last week; wait for next week’s notice. Do not give today’s times to tomorrow.

text: 一周又一周，朋友还会见。周年有节目，我们慢慢看。
pinyin: yī zhōu yòu yī zhōu , péng you hái huì jiàn . zhōu nián yǒu jié mù , wǒ men màn màn kàn .
meaning: Week after week, we will meet friends again. Anniversary programmes: we can take our time watching.

text: 好久没见！你明天也有空儿吗？
pinyin: hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn ! nǐ míng tiān yě yǒu kòngr ma ?
meaning: Long time no see! Are you free tomorrow too?

text: 明天还不知道。今天门口有一点儿响，我们先看里面吧。
pinyin: míng tiān hái bù zhī dào . jīn tiān mén kǒu yǒu yì diǎnr xiǎng , wǒ men xiān kàn lǐ miàn ba .
meaning: I do not know about tomorrow yet. The entrance is a little loud today; let us check inside first.

text: 里面好多座位，没满。这里比门口更安静。
pinyin: lǐ miàn hǎo duō zuò wèi , méi mǎn . zhè lǐ bǐ mén kǒu gèng ān jìng .
meaning: There are many seats inside, not all occupied. It is quieter than the entrance.

text: 挺舒服的，但灯十分亮，我不太喜欢。
pinyin: tǐng shū fú de , dàn dēng shí fēn liàng , wǒ bù tài xǐ huān .
meaning: Quite comfortable, but the lights are very bright; I do not particularly like that.

text: 后面没有这么亮，也离音箱更远。
pinyin: hòu miàn méi yǒu zhè me liàng , yě lí yīn xiāng gèng yuǎn .
meaning: It is not this bright farther back, and it is farther from the speaker.

text: 好，那边读书的人不少，我们小声说。
pinyin: hǎo , nà biān dú shū de rén bù shǎo , wǒ men xiǎo shēng shuō .
meaning: Good. Quite a few people are reading there; let us speak quietly.

text: 门口四十，里面五十，贵十块。费用不超过五十，行吗？
pinyin: mén kǒu sì shí , lǐ miàn wǔ shí , guì shí kuài . fèi yòng bù chāo guò wǔ shí , xíng ma ?
meaning: The entrance is forty and inside fifty, ten more. At most fifty, okay?

text: 行。门口不如里面安静，十块是差价，不是全部。
pinyin: xíng . mén kǒu bù rú lǐ miàn ān jìng , shí kuài shì chà jià , bù shì quán bù .
meaning: Okay. The entrance is not as quiet as inside. Ten is the difference, not the total.

text: 两边温度不同，里面比门口低三度。
pinyin: liǎng biān wēn dù bù tóng , lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu dī sān dù .
meaning: The temperatures differ; inside is three degrees lower than the entrance.

text: 但我没量声音，不能说低了多少分贝。只觉得这里更合适。
pinyin: dàn wǒ méi liáng shēng yīn , bù néng shuō dī le duō shao fēn bèi . zhǐ jué de zhè lǐ gèng hé shì .
meaning: But I did not measure the sound; I cannot say how many decibels lower it is. I only feel it is more suitable.

text: 音箱的声音有点儿难听，要不要再大声说？
pinyin: yīn xiāng de shēng yīn yǒu diǎn ér nán tīng , yào bù yào zài dà shēng shuō ?
meaning: The speaker sounds a little unpleasant. Should we speak louder?

text: 不用大声。我听得见，音量小一点点就好。
pinyin: bù yòng dà shēng . wǒ tīng de jiàn , yīn liàng xiǎo yì diǎn diǎn jiù hǎo .
meaning: No need to speak loudly. I can hear; just lower the volume a tiny bit.

text: 我和朋友好久没见。今天见面，明天有没有空儿还不知道。

meaning: My friend and I have not met for a long time. We meet today; we do not yet know whether tomorrow is free.

text: 门口有一点儿响，也不够安静。里面更安静，座位还没满。
pinyin: mén kǒu yǒu yì diǎnr xiǎng , yě bù gòu ān jìng . lǐ miàn gèng ān jìng , zuò wèi hái méi mǎn .
meaning: The entrance is a little loud and not quiet enough. Inside is quieter, and seats are still available.

text: 里面有好多座位，挺舒服的。前面的灯十分亮，我不太喜欢，所以选后面。
pinyin: lǐ miàn yǒu hǎo duō zuò wèi , tǐng shū fú de . qián miàn de dēng shí fēn liàng , wǒ bù tài xǐ huān , suǒ yǐ xuǎn hòu miàn .
meaning: Inside has many seats and is quite comfortable. The front lights are very bright and I do not particularly like them, so we choose farther back.

text: 后面离音箱远，灯也没有前面这么亮。有人读书，我们就小声说。
pinyin: hòu miàn lí yīn xiāng yuǎn , dēng yě méi yǒu qián miàn zhè me liàng . yǒu rén dú shū , wǒ men jiù xiǎo shēng shuō .
meaning: Farther back is away from the speaker, and the lights are not as bright as at the front. People are reading, so we speak quietly.

text: 门口四十，里面五十。里面比门口贵十块，但费用没有超过五十。
pinyin: mén kǒu sì shí , lǐ miàn wǔ shí . lǐ miàn bǐ mén kǒu guì shí kuài , dàn fèi yòng méi yǒu chāo guò wǔ shí .
meaning: The entrance costs forty and inside fifty. Inside is ten more, but the cost does not exceed fifty.

text: 门口不如里面安静。这是我们的感受，不是测出来的声音数字。

text: 温度表显示，里面比门口低三度。这个三度说的是温度，不是音量。

meaning: The thermometer shows that inside is three degrees lower than the entrance. These three degrees refer to temperature, not volume.

text: 音箱有点儿难听，不过不用大声说。音量小一点点就好，我们也没有要求别人离开。

text: 三人要饭，一人不要。大多数，不是每一个。
pinyin: sān rén yào fàn , yī rén bú yào . dà duō shù , bù shì měi yī gè .
meaning: Three want rice, one does not. The majority, not every person.

text: 一人只喝水，三人想喝茶。谁吃鸡，谁吃鱼，先问才知道。
pinyin: yī rén zhǐ hē shuǐ , sān rén xiǎng hē chá . shéi chī jī , shéi chī yú , xiān wèn cái zhī dào .
meaning: One drinks only water, three want tea. Who eats chicken or fish? Ask before knowing.

text: 蛋和油，配料看清。没有确认，不能替人猜。
pinyin: dàn hé yóu , pèi liào kàn qīng . méi yǒu què rèn , bù néng tì rén cāi .
meaning: Egg and oil: read the ingredients. Without confirmation, do not guess for someone else.

text: 二两不是两份，份数分量要分开。菜先上一部分，饱了不用加。
pinyin: èr liǎng bù shì liǎng fèn , fèn shǔ fèn liàng yào fēn kāi . cài xiān shàng yī bù fèn , bǎo le bù yòng jiā .
meaning: Two liang is not two portions; separate portion counts and weight. Serve some dishes first; no need to add when full.

text: 请客也看预算，公平先商量。全家来吃饭，也问每个人。
pinyin: qǐng kè yě kàn yù suàn , gōng píng xiān shāng liáng . quán jiā lái chī fàn , yě wèn měi gè rén .
meaning: Even when treating, check the budget and discuss fairness. Even for a family meal, ask each person.

pinyin: hái méi dào . wǒ liù diǎn chū fā , zuò gōng gòng qì chē . xiàn zài hái zài chē shàng .
meaning: Not yet. I set off at six by bus and am still on the vehicle now.

text: 快点儿，我们已经等了一会儿。

text: 我有点儿急，但不能让司机开快。今天交通不顺利。
pinyin: wǒ yǒu diǎn ér jí , dàn bù néng ràng sī jī kāi kuài . jīn tiān jiāo tōng bù shùn lì .
meaning: I am anxious, but I cannot ask the driver to speed up. Traffic is not going smoothly today.

text: 车忽然停了。司机说路口的车辆很多，这辆公交车可能要改道。
pinyin: chē hū rán tíng le . sī jī shuō lù kǒu de chē liàng hěn duō , zhè liàng gōng jiāo chē kě néng yào gǎi dào .
meaning: It suddenly stopped. The driver says there are many vehicles at the intersection and this bus may need a different route.

text: 到学校的站了吗？
pinyin: dào xué xiào de zhàn le ma ?
meaning: Have you reached the school stop?

text: 还没有。刚经过学校，没停车。车还没到那个站。

text: 停车场那边近吗？你在那里下吧。
pinyin: tíng chē chǎng nà biān jìn ma ? nǐ zài nà lǐ xià ba .

text: 停车场不是站台，我先等到车停好再下。离学校近，也不能在路边下。

meaning: The car park is not the stop; I will wait until the vehicle stops properly before getting off. Being near the school does not mean I can get off at the roadside.

text: 那该什么时候再问你？

text: 手机信号不好。我看手表了，但到达时间还没确认。时间一确认，我一定发消息。

Before I'd finished, Chen Yu asked when we'd leave. Laughing, I asked him to wait while I explained the route, then we'd decide the time together. We agreed to meet at the stop at three. That suited Xiao Zhou: she was busy in the morning but could come out that afternoon. The activity-room clock chimed. I thought something was wrong with the equipment. Chen Yu said it was the normal chime: four o'clock, time to go home. Before leaving I checked the chair; I'd taken the bag. Chen Yu told me not to leave it at the stop on Saturday. I wouldn't, I said; I'd need it for the water.

parts.text: 今天我们在活动室商量周六去哪儿。我一高兴，说话就大声了。陈宇轻轻提醒我，旁边还在上课。
我把门关上，也小声了一点。小周刚来，想坐在我们旁边，可是我的包占了座位。我赶紧拿开，让她坐下。
我提议去河边，陈宇还没听完就问几点出发。我笑着让他等一下，先把要走的路讲完，再一起定时间。
我们最后约了三点在车站见。小周说这个时间不错，她上午还有事情，下午正好能够出来。
活动室的钟响了，我以为设备出了问题。陈宇说那是正常的报时声音，已经四点，该回家了。
出门前我又看了一眼椅子，包已经拿走了。陈宇说周六别把包忘在车站，我说不会，到时里面还要装水呢。

pinyin: zuó tiān zài wǎn huì shàng , wǒ rèn shi le lǐ ān . tā xìng lǐ , zuò zài dà jiā dōu jiào lǎo wáng de nà wèi péng you páng biān , bāng lǎo wáng ná zhe yī fèn wǎn bào . jīn tiān dào dú shū xiǎo zǔ , wǒ yòu jiàn dào le lǐ ān . tā kàn jiàn wǒ jiù xiào le , shuō yuán lái shì nǐ a , zuó tiān shuō huà de rén tài duō , jīn tiān kě yǐ màn màn liáo . lǎo wáng zhèng zài lǐ miàn wǔ shuì , wǒ jiù xiān hé lǐ ān kàn bào zhǐ . dì èr yè xiě zhe chūn jié de huó dòng , lǐ ān shuō zì jǐ guò nián yào huí jiā , huó dòng jié shù hòu jiù chū fā . wǒ jīn nián xiǎng liú zài zhè lǐ , hé péng you yì qǐ guò nián . wǒ men kàn jiàn huó dòng yào dài yī dào cài , jiù kāi shǐ shuō zì jǐ huì zuò shén me ; lǐ ān shuō tā zhǐ huì zhǔ miàn . lǎo wáng xǐng le , zǒu guò lái wèn wǒ men dú dào nǎ lǐ le . wǒ zhǐ gěi tā kàn nà tiáo huó dòng xiāo xī , tā shuō wǎn shang dà jiā kě yǐ yì qǐ lái , bù yòng xiàn zài jiù xiǎng hǎo dài shén me . huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ gěi lǐ ān fā le shū diàn de dì zhǐ . wǎn shang shuì qián , tā shuō wǎn ān , hái wèn wǒ xià cì néng bù néng dài yī běn xǐ huān de shū lái .
meaning: I met Li An at yesterday's evening party. His surname was Li. He sat beside the friend everyone calls Lao Wang and helped him carry an evening newspaper. I saw Li An again at the reading group today. He smiled: oh, it's you! There had been too many people talking yesterday; today we could chat properly. Lao Wang was napping inside, so Li An and I read the newspaper first. The second page described a Spring Festival event. Li An would go home for the New Year, leaving after that event. I wanted to stay here and celebrate with friends this year. The event asked everyone to bring a dish, so we talked about what we could cook. Li An said he only knew how to cook noodles. When Lao Wang woke he asked how far we'd read. I showed him the event notice. We could all come that evening, he said; we didn't need to decide on a dish yet. Back home I sent Li An the bookshop address. Before bed he said goodnight and asked me to bring a favourite book next time.

text: 你说你只会煮面，是真的吗？
pinyin: nǐ shuō nǐ zhǐ huì zhǔ miàn , shì zhēn de ma ?
meaning: Is it true you can only cook noodles?

text: 还会烧水，泡茶。
pinyin: hái huì shāo shuǐ , pào chá .
meaning: I can boil water and make tea too.

text: 那我们过年喝你的茶？
pinyin: nà wǒ men guò nián hē nǐ de chá ?
meaning: Then shall we have your tea at New Year?

text: 行，不过菜还是你们做。
pinyin: xíng , bù guò cài hái shi nǐ men zuò .
meaning: Sure, but you can cook the food.

text: 老王说不用现在想好。
pinyin: lǎo wáng shuō bù yòng xiàn zài xiǎng hǎo .
meaning: Lao Wang said we don't have to decide now.

text: 那先喝茶吧，面明天再想。
pinyin: nà xiān hē chá ba , miàn míng tiān zài xiǎng .
meaning: Let's have tea now and think about noodles tomorrow.

text: 朋友已经出院，今天在家休息。我打电话问现在方不方便说话，她说可以，声音也比上次轻松了。
pinyin: péng you yǐ jīng chū yuàn , jīn tiān zài jiā xiū xī . wǒ dǎ diàn huà wèn xiàn zài fāng bù fāng biàn shuō huà , tā shuō kě yǐ , shēng yīn yě bǐ shàng cì qīng sōng le .
meaning: My friend had left hospital and was resting at home. I called to ask if it was a good time to talk. It was, and she sounded more relaxed than last time.

text: 我们约好四点半见，五点我就走。她想睡一会儿，我也还有事，所以坐半小时正好。
pinyin: wǒ men yuē hǎo sì diǎn bàn jiàn , wǔ diǎn wǒ jiù zǒu . tā xiǎng shuì yī huì er , wǒ yě hái yǒu shì , suǒ yǐ zuò bàn xiǎo shí zhèng hǎo .
meaning: We arranged to meet at four thirty and for me to leave at five. She wanted a nap, and I had other plans too, so half an hour suited us.

text: 她想继续看上次的小说，我就在书架上找。不一会儿找到了，可是夹在里面的纸掉了出来，上面还有她写的两句话。
pinyin: tā xiǎng jì xù kàn shàng cì de xiǎo shuō , wǒ jiù zài shū jià shàng zhǎo . bù yī huì er zhǎo dào le , kě shì jiā zài lǐ miàn de zhǐ diào le chū lái , shàng miàn hái yǒu tā xiě de liǎng jù huà .
meaning: She wanted to carry on reading the novel from last time. I found it on the bookshelf shortly afterwards, but a sheet slipped out with two sentences she'd written.

text: 我把书和纸一起拍给她看，她说就是这本，纸也别忘了带。我把它放回书里，再把书放进包里。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ shū hé zhǐ yì qǐ pāi gěi tā kàn , tā shuō jiù shì zhè běn , zhǐ yě bié wàng le dài . wǒ bǎ tā fàng huí shū lǐ , zài bǎ shū fàng jìn bāo lǐ .
meaning: I sent her a photo of the book and paper. It was the right one, and she asked me to bring the paper too. I put it back inside the book and put the book in my bag.

text: 四点半到她家时，太阳已经照到窗边。她坐在椅子上，我们聊了小说里的朋友，也说了下次去哪家书店。
pinyin: sì diǎn bàn dào tā jiā shí , tài yáng yǐ jīng zhào dào chuāng biān . tā zuò zài yǐ zi shàng , wǒ men liáo le xiǎo shuō lǐ de péng you , yě shuō le xià cì qù nǎ jiā shū diàn .
meaning: At four thirty the sun was shining by her window. We sat and chatted about the friends in the novel and which bookshop to visit next time.

text: 快五点时，我先告别。走到楼下，她还发来消息，说我带对了书，却忘了把自己的围巾带走。

meaning: Just before five I said goodbye. When I got downstairs she messaged: I'd brought the right book but forgotten to take my own scarf.

text: 这个月份经常下雨。

text: 她把一生的照片整理好了。

Let's go for a walk. It became cooler after sunset. The moon is round tonight. She took a photo of the moon. There are lots of stars in the sky. It's too cloudy to see stars today. I couldn't sleep that night. It's very late. Let's chat tomorrow. There's a cloud in the sky. The child looked up at a plane in the sky. Which month would you like to travel in? It often rains in this month. This book tells the story of the painter's life. She organised her lifetime of photographs. I'll always remember that meeting. She says she'll never finish telling this story.

meaning: Last week I drew only a table. This week I wanted to add the cat beside it, but the cat kept moving. By the time I'd drawn its head, it was on the other side.

text: 陈宇来看我的画，说桌子越来越像了。我说自己以前想成为画家，现在连一只猫都画不完。他笑了，让我先等猫睡着。
pinyin: chén yǔ lái kàn wǒ de huà , shuō zhuō zi yuè lái yuè xiàng le . wǒ shuō zì jǐ yǐ qián xiǎng chéng wéi huà jiā , xiàn zài lián yī zhǐ māo dōu huà bù wán . tā xiào le , ràng wǒ xiān děng māo shuì zháo .
meaning: Chen Yu said the table was looking more convincing. I'd once dreamed of becoming a painter, I said, yet couldn't finish one cat. He laughed and suggested waiting until it slept.

text: 我想起网上看到的展览，早就想去，可周末一直没空。陈宇在网站上查了时间，发现周四晚上也开门。

meaning: I remembered an exhibition I'd seen online. I'd wanted to go for a while but had no free weekends. Chen Yu checked the website and found it open on Thursday evenings.

text: 周四我们下班后一起去。展览里有画家的作品，也有她年轻时用过的本子，里面画了许多很小的桌子和椅子。
pinyin: zhōu sì wǒ men xià bān hòu yì qǐ qù . zhǎn lǎn lǐ yǒu huà jiā de zuò pǐn , yě yǒu tā nián qīng shí yòng guò de běn zi , lǐ miàn huà le xǔ duō hěn xiǎo de zhuō zi hé yǐ zi .
meaning: We went after work on Thursday. The exhibition showed the painter's works and notebooks she'd used when younger, full of tiny tables and chairs.

text: 画家出来和大家说话，我问她是不是一开始就画得好。她拿出一张旧画，说这张桌子的一条腿比别的长，自己现在还留着。

meaning: When the painter spoke with us I asked whether she'd been good from the start. She showed an old drawing of a table with one leg longer than the others; she'd still kept it.

text: 回家以后，我把没画完的猫放在桌上，今后还想继续画。陈宇给我发了张照片，这回猫睡着了，我终于不用追着它看。
pinyin: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ méi huà wán de māo fàng zài zhuō shàng , jīn hòu hái xiǎng jì xù huà . chén yǔ gěi wǒ fā le zhāng zhào piān , zhè huí māo shuì zháo le , wǒ zhōng yú bù yòng zhuī zhe tā kàn .

text: 这个展览介绍了科学的发展。
pinyin: zhè gè zhǎn lǎn jiè shào le kē xué de fā zhǎn .

text: 他每一科都很认真地学习。

text: 这条路越走越窄。越练习，我越有信心。房间里的人越来越多。她的画越来越好看了。我们终于把这件事做成了。这张画没画成，明天再试吧。她想成为画家。多年以后，他们成为了好朋友。她终于实现了开书店的理想。这个计划今年能实现吗？我早就想参加，现在才有空。她早就看过这部电影了。读了三遍，我才明白。他等到下午三点才走。两个人同时说，我没听清。两个活动同时开始，我只能去一个。今后每周我们都见一次吧。她想今后多留一点时间画画。我在广告里看见了这家店。门口的广告写着周末有表演。我在网站上找到了开门时间。这个网站有很多画家的介绍。我把照片发到网上了。网上也能买这本书。她最喜欢的明星今晚有表演。这位明星以前住在这条街上。这部影片我还没有看完。影片还没开始，我们先找座位。这本小说我看了三遍。她写的第一部小说今年出版了。我画一张图，再说给你听。她在纸上画了一只猫。这张画儿是我画的。孩子们把画儿贴在墙上。这位画家喜欢画家乡的街道。我去看了一位年轻画家的作品。这位作家写过很多小说。我想给喜欢的作家写一封信。她从小就对科学有兴趣。这个展览介绍了科学的发展。这一科的成绩还没出来。他每一科都很认真地学习。这首歌最近很流行。那时流行穿这种外套。

meaning: This is a photo from when there were three of us. Remember?

text: 记得。现在小组变成五个人了。
pinyin: jì de . xiàn zài xiǎo zǔ biàn chéng wǔ gè rén le .
meaning: Yes. Now our group has grown to five.

text: 照片里你穿的外套，我姐姐也有一件。

text: 你姐姐现在做什么？

meaning: What does your sister do now?

text: 她是商人，在市中心开了一家茶叶店。
pinyin: tā shì shāng rén , zài shì zhōng xīn kāi le yī jiā chá yè diàn .
meaning: She's a businesswoman with a tea shop in the city centre.

text: 那我们下次去看看？我正好想买点茶。
pinyin: nà wǒ men xià cì qù kàn kàn ? wǒ zhèng hǎo xiǎng mǎi diǎn chá .
meaning: Shall we visit next time? I'd like to buy some tea.

text: 好。今天星期三，周六下午去吧。
pinyin: hǎo . jīn tiān xīng qī sān , zhōu liù xià wǔ qù ba .
meaning: Sure. It's Wednesday today; let's go on Saturday afternoon.

text: 行，三点在活动中心门口见，再一起坐车过去。

meaning: Okay. Meet at the activity centre entrance at three, then take the bus together.

meaning: Looking through old photos reminded me that our group once had only three people. Five of us now read together, and we'd moved from a small room to the activity centre.

text: 陈宇看照片，认出了自己以前的外套。我说姐姐也有一件，他就问姐姐现在做什么。我告诉他，她在市中心开了茶叶店。
pinyin: chén yǔ kàn zhào piān , rèn chū le zì jǐ yǐ qián de wài tào . wǒ shuō jiě jie yě yǒu yī jiàn , tā jiù wèn jiě jie xiàn zài zuò shén me . wǒ gào sù tā , tā zài shì zhōng xīn kāi le chá yè diàn .
meaning: Chen Yu recognised his old coat in a photo. I said my sister had one like it, and he asked what she did now. She had a tea shop in the city centre.

text: 姐姐过去在南方长大，现在搬到这里。我去她店里看过，里面有许多小杯子，客人可以先坐下喝一点茶。

meaning: My sister had grown up in the south and moved here. I'd visited her shop. It had lots of little cups, and customers could sit and taste some tea first.

text: 我们周三约好，周六三点在活动中心门口见。我把店的地址发给另外三位朋友，问她们要不要一起去。

meaning: On Wednesday we arranged to meet at the activity centre entrance at three on Saturday. I sent the shop address to the other three friends and asked if they'd like to join us.

text: 周六有一位朋友要上班，四个人一起去了。姐姐先拿来茶，陈宇选了一小袋，付款时才想起信用卡忘在家里。
pinyin: zhōu liù yǒu yī wèi péng you yào shàng bān , sì gè rén yì qǐ qù le . jiě jie xiān ná lái chá , chén yǔ xuǎn le yī xiǎo dài , fù kuǎn shí cái xiǎng qǐ xìn yòng kǎ wàng zài jiā lǐ .
meaning: One friend had work on Saturday, so four of us went. My sister brought tea. Chen Yu chose a small bag and only remembered when paying that his credit card was at home.

text: 他用手机付了钱，我们又坐了一会儿。走以前，姐姐帮我们拍了照片；这次四个人站在一起，下次想五个人都来。

text: 饭熟了，汤还很烫，不能马上喝。

meaning: A problem arose; do not panic first. A new problem has arisen; stop and ask first. Dividing the work greatly reduced repetition. Confirming the address first can greatly reduce the chance of going the wrong way. There is a lot of information; still check it line by line. The group has many messages; find the latest notice first. The paper fell; pick it up first. When working together, divide the tasks first. Clarify the arrangements before starting work. Being tall does not mean knowing every answer. She is tall, but still ask whether she is willing to help. The manager asks us to check the records first. The manager has not returned; ask the staff first. The term-start date still needs checking against the notice. Our schedules change after term starts; arrange a new meeting. Water flows downward; place the cup properly first. The water keeps running; turn it off first. Difficult problems can be discussed separately. Shutting off the water properly saves a lot of water. This time we saved ten yuan; still check the price next time. Put the camera in place and ask before taking a photo. The bank is to the right of the main entrance, not the event venue. With different languages, start by speaking a little more slowly. Learning a language requires practice and time.

text: 你好，我姓李，叫我小李就行。
pinyin: nǐ hǎo , wǒ xìng lǐ , jiào wǒ xiǎo lǐ jiù xíng .
meaning: Hi, my surname is Li. Just call me Xiao Li.

text: 你是上周来过的那位？我认得你的声音。
pinyin: nǐ shì shàng zhōu lái guò de nà wèi ? wǒ rèn de nǐ de shēng yīn .
meaning: Were you here last week? I recognise your voice.

text: 对，不过你当时坐在里面，我们没说上话。
pinyin: duì , bù guò nǐ dāng shí zuò zài lǐ miàn , wǒ men méi shuō shàng huà .
meaning: Yes, but you were sitting inside and we didn't get to talk.

text: 那今天坐这儿吧，我帮你留个位子。
pinyin: nà jīn tiān zuò zhèr ba , wǒ bāng nǐ liú gè wèi zi .
meaning: Sit here today, then. I'll save you a seat.

text: 谢谢。刚才门口那位男子也是组里的成员吗？
pinyin: xiè xiè . gāng cái mén kǒu nà wèi nán zi yě shì zǔ lǐ de chéng yuán ma ?
meaning: Thanks. Is the man at the entrance a member too?

text: 是，大家叫他老王。他来得最早，连门口的猫都认得他。
pinyin: shì , dà jiā jiào tā lǎo wáng . tā lái de zuì zǎo , lián mén kǒu de māo dōu rèn de tā .
meaning: Yes, we call him Lao Wang. He comes so early even the cat outside knows him.

text: 猫也来参加？
pinyin: māo yě lái cān jiā ?
meaning: Does the cat join in too?

text: 不，它只来吃东西。你家乡在哪里？
pinyin: bù , tā zhǐ lái chī dōng xi . nǐ jiā xiāng zài nǎ lǐ ?
meaning: No, it's only here for food. Where's your hometown?

text: 在南方。我父母还住在那里。
pinyin: zài nán fāng . wǒ fù mǔ hái zhù zài nà lǐ .
meaning: In the south. My parents still live there.

text: 我母亲也是南方人，下次你们可以聊聊。
pinyin: wǒ mǔ qīn yě shì nán fāng rén , xià cì nǐ men kě yǐ liáo liáo .
meaning: My mother's from the south too. You could chat next time.

text: 好。今天还有谁没到？
pinyin: hǎo . jīn tiān hái yǒu shéi méi dào ?
meaning: Sure. Who hasn't arrived today?

text: 第三位新成员还在路上，我们先拿书。
pinyin: dì sān wèi xīn chéng yuán hái zài lù shàng , wǒ men xiān ná shū .
meaning: The third new member is still on the way. Let's get the books first.

text: 我第二次去读书小组，刚到门口就有人叫小李。我一开始没反应过来，才想起上周自己说可以这样称呼。
pinyin: wǒ dì èr cì qù dú shū xiǎo zǔ , gāng dào mén kǒu jiù yǒu rén jiào xiǎo lǐ . wǒ yī kāi shǐ méi fǎn yìng guò lái , cái xiǎng qǐ shàng zhōu zì jǐ shuō kě yǐ zhè yàng chēng hū .
meaning: On my second visit to the reading group someone called out Xiao Li at the entrance. It took me a moment to remember I'd suggested that name last week.

text: 陈宇认得我的声音，给我留了一个位子。这次我坐在中间，刚坐下就和旁边两位成员聊了起来。
pinyin: chén yǔ rèn de wǒ de shēng yīn , gěi wǒ liú le yī gè wèi zi . zhè cì wǒ zuò zài zhōng jiān , gāng zuò xià jiù hé páng biān liǎng wèi chéng yuán liáo le qǐ lái .
meaning: Chen Yu recognised my voice and saved me a seat. This time I sat in the middle and started chatting with the two members beside me as soon as I sat down.

text: 门口的男子是老王，他已经参加小组两年了。他每次都早到，先开窗，再把书放到各张桌子上。
pinyin: mén kǒu de nán zi shì lǎo wáng , tā yǐ jīng cān jiā xiǎo zǔ liǎng nián le . tā měi cì dōu zǎo dào , xiān kāi chuāng , zài bǎ shū fàng dào gè zhāng zhuō zi shàng .
meaning: The man by the entrance was Lao Wang. He'd been in the group for two years and always arrived early to open the windows and put books on the tables.

text: 一只猫跟着他进来，在椅子旁边坐下。陈宇说猫只认得带吃的来的人，老王说今天没带吃的，它也跟来了。
pinyin: yī zhǐ māo gēn zhe tā jìn lái , zài yǐ zi páng biān zuò xià . chén yǔ shuō māo zhǐ rèn de dài chī de lái de rén , lǎo wáng shuō jīn tiān méi dài chī de , tā yě gēn lái le .
meaning: A cat followed him in and sat beside a chair. Chen Yu said it only knew people who brought food. Lao Wang pointed out that it followed him today even though he hadn't brought any.

text: 大家聊天时，我说自己的家乡在南方，父母还住在那里。陈宇说他母亲也是南方人，下次可能一起来。
pinyin: dà jiā liáo tiān shí , wǒ shuō zì jǐ de jiā xiāng zài nán fāng , fù mǔ hái zhù zài nà lǐ . chén yǔ shuō tā mǔ qīn yě shì nán fāng rén , xià cì kě néng yì qǐ lái .
meaning: While we chatted I said my hometown was in the south and my parents still lived there. Chen Yu's mother was from the south too and might come with him next time.

text: 第三位新成员到了以后，我们才开始读书。回家时，我已经能叫出几位成员的名字，也和陈宇约好了下周再见。

meaning: We began reading after the third new member arrived. By the time I left I could name several members and had arranged to see Chen Yu again the next week.

text: 你刚才说那只猫也认得我？
pinyin: nǐ gāng cái shuō nà zhǐ māo yě rèn de wǒ ?
meaning: Did you say that cat knows me too?

text: 你上次带了吃的，它记得。
pinyin: nǐ shàng cì dài le chī de , tā jì de .
meaning: You brought food last time. It remembers.

text: 那今天没带怎么办？
pinyin: nà jīn tiān méi dài zěn me bàn ?
meaning: What happens if I didn't bring any today?

text: 你问它呀，它就在你椅子下面。
pinyin: nǐ wèn tā ya , tā jiù zài nǐ yǐ zi xià miàn .
meaning: Ask it. It's right under your chair.

text: 怪不得我一坐下，它就看着我。
pinyin: guài bu de wǒ yī zuò xià , tā jiù kàn zhe wǒ .
meaning: No wonder it looked at me as soon as I sat down.

text: 你们慢慢聊，我们先读书。
pinyin: nǐ men màn màn liáo , wǒ men xiān dú shū .
meaning: You two have a chat. We'll start reading.

text: 两个孩子的个性不一样。
pinyin: liǎng gè hái zi de gè xìng bù yī yàng .
meaning: The two children have different personalities.

text: 我们性格不同，却很聊得来。
pinyin: wǒ men xìng gé bù tóng , què hěn liáo de lái .
meaning: Our personalities differ, but we get on well.

text: 大家把这条路称为老街。
pinyin: dà jiā bǎ zhè tiáo lù chēng wéi lǎo jiē .
meaning: Everyone calls this road the old street.

text: 这个字你认得吗？
pinyin: zhè gè zì nǐ rèn de ma ?
meaning: Do you recognise this character?

text: 我一听声音就认出你了。
pinyin: wǒ yī tīng shēng yīn jiù rèn chū nǐ le .
meaning: I recognised you as soon as I heard your voice.

text: 他给远方的亲人写了一封信。
pinyin: tā gěi yuǎn fāng de qīn rén xiě le yī fēng xìn .
meaning: He wrote a letter to relatives far away.

text: 听见家乡话，我觉得特别亲切。
pinyin: tīng jiàn jiā xiāng huà , wǒ jué de tè bié qīn qiè .
meaning: Hearing my hometown dialect feels especially warm and familiar.

text: 他的父母都住在北京。
pinyin: tā de fù mǔ dōu zhù zài běi jīng .
meaning: Both his parents live in Beijing.

text: 她的父亲今天来接她。
pinyin: tā de fù qīn jīn tiān lái jiē tā .
meaning: Her father is coming to pick her up today.

text: 她和母亲每晚通电话。
pinyin: tā hé mǔ qīn měi wǎn tōng diàn huà .
meaning: She speaks to her mother on the phone each evening.

text: 这张表需要填写子女的姓名。
pinyin: zhè zhāng biǎo xū yào tián xiě zǐ nǚ de xìng míng .
meaning: This form asks for the children's names.

text: 家属在门口等他下班。
pinyin: jiā shǔ zài mén kǒu děng tā xià bān .
meaning: His family are waiting outside for him to finish work.

text: 她给我们看了家乡的照片。
pinyin: tā gěi wǒ men kàn le jiā xiāng de zhào piān .
meaning: She showed us photos of her hometown.

text: 这首歌让她想起故乡。
pinyin: zhè shǒu gē ràng tā xiǎng qǐ gù xiāng .
meaning: This song reminds her of her hometown.

text: 他这个年纪还每天跑步。
pinyin: tā zhè gè nián jì hái měi tiān pǎo bù .
meaning: At his age he still runs every day.

text: 这件外套是那位男子的。
pinyin: zhè jiàn wài tào shì nà wèi nán zi de .
meaning: This coat belongs to that man.

text: 站在门边的女子正在打电话。
pinyin: zhàn zài mén biān de nǚ zǐ zhèng zài dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: The woman standing by the door is on the phone.

text: 这两条路有什么关系？
pinyin: zhè liǎng tiáo lù yǒu shén me guān xì ?
meaning: How are these two roads connected?

text: 参加活动的人员请先到门口集合。
pinyin: cān jiā huó dòng de rén yuán qǐng xiān dào mén kǒu jí hé .
meaning: People taking part should gather at the entrance first.

text: 新成员下周第一次来。
pinyin: xīn chéng yuán xià zhōu dì yī cì lái .
meaning: The new member is coming for the first time next week.

text: 门口那位姑娘是小李。我向一位姑娘打听车站在哪里。这家店的老板是我的熟人。到了活动现场，我看见了几个熟人。她的衣服很有个性。两个孩子的个性不一样。他的性格很安静。我们性格不同，却很聊得来。这种小店常被称为夫妻店。大家把这条路称为老街。我认得他，他以前住在这里。这个字你认得吗？她换了眼镜，我差点没认出她。我一听声音就认出你了。过年时，她回家看亲人。他给远方的亲人写了一封信。老师很亲切，我有问题都敢问。听见家乡话，我觉得特别亲切。周末我和父母一起吃饭。他的父母都住在北京。我的父亲喜欢种花。她的父亲今天来接她。母亲给我寄了一件外套。她和母亲每晚通电话。她的两个子女都已经工作了。这张表需要填写子女的姓名。通知说员工可以带家属参加。家属在门口等他下班。我的家乡在南方。她给我们看了家乡的照片。离开故乡多年，他还是喜欢那里的菜。这首歌让她想起故乡。她年纪比我小，但经验比我多。他这个年纪还每天跑步。一名男子在车站外等人。这件外套是那位男子的。两名女子一起走进书店。站在门边的女子正在打电话。我和她的关系一直很好。这两条路有什么关系？工作人员帮我们找座位。参加活动的人员请先到门口集合。我们小组有五位成员。新成员下周第一次来。
pinyin: mén kǒu nà wèi gū niáng shì xiǎo lǐ . wǒ xiàng yī wèi gū niáng dǎ tīng chē zhàn zài nǎ lǐ . zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn shì wǒ de shú rén . dào le huó dòng xiàn chǎng , wǒ kàn jiàn le jǐ gè shú rén . tā de yī fú hěn yǒu gè xìng . liǎng gè hái zi de gè xìng bù yī yàng . tā de xìng gé hěn ān jìng . wǒ men xìng gé bù tóng , què hěn liáo de lái . zhè zhǒng xiǎo diàn cháng bèi chēng wéi fū qī diàn . dà jiā bǎ zhè tiáo lù chēng wéi lǎo jiē . wǒ rèn de tā , tā yǐ qián zhù zài zhè lǐ . zhè gè zì nǐ rèn de ma ? tā huàn le yǎn jìng , wǒ chà diǎn méi rèn chū tā . wǒ yī tīng shēng yīn jiù rèn chū nǐ le . guò nián shí , tā huí jiā kàn qīn rén . tā gěi yuǎn fāng de qīn rén xiě le yī fēng xìn . lǎo shī hěn qīn qiè , wǒ yǒu wèn tí dōu gǎn wèn . tīng jiàn jiā xiāng huà , wǒ jué de tè bié qīn qiè . zhōu mò wǒ hé fù mǔ yì qǐ chī fàn . tā de fù mǔ dōu zhù zài běi jīng . wǒ de fù qīn xǐ huān zhǒng huā . tā de fù qīn jīn tiān lái jiē tā . mǔ qīn gěi wǒ jì le yī jiàn wài tào . tā hé mǔ qīn měi wǎn tōng diàn huà . tā de liǎng gè zi nǚ dōu yǐ jīng gōng zuò le . zhè zhāng biǎo xū yào tián xiě zǐ nǚ de xìng míng . tōng zhī shuō yuán gōng kě yǐ dài jiā shǔ cān jiā . jiā shǔ zài mén kǒu děng tā xià bān . wǒ de jiā xiāng zài nán fāng . tā gěi wǒ men kàn le jiā xiāng de zhào piān . lí kāi gù xiāng duō nián , tā hái shi xǐ huān nà lǐ de cài . zhè shǒu gē ràng tā xiǎng qǐ gù xiāng . tā nián jì bǐ wǒ xiǎo , dàn jīng yàn bǐ wǒ duō . tā zhè gè nián jì hái měi tiān pǎo bù . yī míng nán zi zài chē zhàn wài děng rén . zhè jiàn wài tào shì nà wèi nán zi de . liǎng míng nǚ zǐ yì qǐ zǒu jìn shū diàn . zhàn zài mén biān de nǚ zǐ zhèng zài dǎ diàn huà . wǒ hé tā de guān xì yì zhí hěn hǎo . zhè liǎng tiáo lù yǒu shén me guān xì ? gōng zuò rén yuán bāng wǒ men zhǎo zuò wèi . cān jiā huó dòng de rén yuán qǐng xiān dào mén kǒu jí hé . wǒ men xiǎo zǔ yǒu wǔ wèi chéng yuán . xīn chéng yuán xià zhōu dì yī cì lái .
meaning: The young woman at the entrance is Xiao Li. I asked a young woman where the station was. The owner of this shop is someone I know. I saw a few people I knew at the event. Her clothes have an individual style. The two children have different personalities. He has a quiet temperament. Our personalities differ, but we get on well. This kind of small shop is often called a husband-and-wife shop. Everyone calls this road the old street. I know him; he used to live here. Do you recognise this character? She changed her glasses and I almost didn't recognise her. I recognised you as soon as I heard your voice. She goes home to see her loved ones at New Year. He wrote a letter to relatives far away. The teacher is friendly, so I feel able to ask questions. Hearing my hometown dialect feels especially warm and familiar. I eat with my parents at the weekend. Both his parents live in Beijing. My father likes growing flowers. Her father is coming to pick her up today. My mother posted me a coat. She speaks to her mother on the phone each evening. Both her children are already working. This form asks for the children's names. The notice says employees can bring family members. His family are waiting outside for him to finish work. My hometown is in the south. She showed us photos of her hometown. Years after leaving his hometown, he still likes its food. This song reminds her of her hometown. She is younger than me but more experienced. At his age he still runs every day. A man is waiting for someone outside the station. This coat belongs to that man. Two women entered the bookshop together. The woman standing by the door is on the phone. She and I have always had a good relationship. How are these two roads connected? A staff member helped us find seats. People taking part should gather at the entrance first. There are five members in our group. The new member is coming for the first time next week.

text: 今天谁都可以来听吗？我没报比赛。
pinyin: jīn tiān shéi dōu kě yǐ lái tīng ma ? wǒ méi bào bǐ sài .
meaning: Can anyone listen today? I haven't entered the competition.

text: 可以，今天是读书活动，比赛是下个月的事。
pinyin: kě yǐ , jīn tiān shì dú shū huó dòng , bǐ sài shì xià gè yuè de shì .
meaning: Yes. Today is a reading event. The competition is next month.

text: 那就好。我有点害怕在很多人面前读。
pinyin: nà jiù hǎo . wǒ yǒu diǎn hài pà zài hěn duō rén miàn qián dú .
meaning: Good. I'm a little afraid of reading in front of lots of people.

text: 你先和我坐一桌，想读什么就选什么。
pinyin: nǐ xiān hé wǒ zuò yī zhuō , xiǎng dú shén me jiù xuǎn shén me .
meaning: Sit at my table first. Choose whatever you'd like to read.

text: 这两篇的难度差不多吗？
pinyin: zhè liǎng piān de nán dù chà bu duō ma ?
meaning: Are these two passages about equally difficult?

text: 左边的短一点。我上次读过，还挺有意思。
pinyin: zuǒ biān de duǎn yī diǎn . wǒ shàng cì dú guò , hái tǐng yǒu yì si .
meaning: The one on the left is shorter. I've read it before; it's interesting.

text: 那我先选这篇，先听你读一遍。
pinyin: nà wǒ xiān xuǎn zhè piān , xiān tīng nǐ dú yī biàn .
meaning: I'll pick that one and listen to you read it first.

text: 行。每个人读一小段，轮到你还早呢。
pinyin: xíng . měi gè rén dú yī xiǎo duàn , lún dào nǐ hái zǎo ne .
meaning: Sure. We each read a short section. It'll be a while before your turn.

text: 这里有各种书，我还想看看旁边那本。
pinyin: zhè lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng shū , wǒ hái xiǎng kàn kàn páng biān nà běn .
meaning: There are all sorts of books here. I'd like to look at the one beside it too.

text: 等这段读完再看吧。时间足够，不用急。
pinyin: děng zhè duàn dú wán zài kàn ba . shí jiān zú gòu , bù yòng jí .
meaning: Let's finish this section first. There's enough time; no rush.

text: 好，我读第一句，你帮我听听？
pinyin: hǎo , wǒ dú dì yī jù , nǐ bāng wǒ tīng tīng ?
meaning: Okay, shall I read the first sentence while you listen?

text: 来吧。我听着，你慢慢读。
pinyin: lái ba . wǒ tīng zhe , nǐ màn màn dú .
meaning: Go ahead. I'm listening; take your time.

text: 周末的读书活动对大家开放。我没有报名下个月的比赛，还是可以参加今天的活动。门口有一群人在选书，我站在后面看了一会儿。
pinyin: zhōu mò de dú shū huó dòng duì dà jiā kāi fàng . wǒ méi yǒu bào míng xià gè yuè de bǐ sài , hái shi kě yǐ cān jiā jīn tiān de huó dòng . mén kǒu yǒu yī qún rén zài xuǎn shū , wǒ zhàn zài hòu miàn kàn le yī huì er .
meaning: The weekend reading event was open to everyone. I hadn't entered next month's competition, but I could join today's activity. A group was choosing books at the entrance, and I watched for a while.

text: 陈宇看见我，把我带到他的桌子旁边。桌上放着两篇文章，他说左边的短一点，自己上次读过。
pinyin: chén yǔ kàn jiàn wǒ , bǎ wǒ dài dào tā de zhuō zi páng biān . zhuō shàng fàng zhe liǎng piān wén zhāng , tā shuō zuǒ biān de duǎn yī diǎn , zì jǐ shàng cì dú guò .
meaning: Chen Yu saw me and brought me to his table. There were two passages on it. The left one was shorter, and he'd read it before.

text: 我选了短的那篇，想先听别人读。他给我指了第一段，我一边听，一边用手跟着字走。
pinyin: wǒ xuǎn le duǎn de nà piān , xiǎng xiān tīng bié ren dú . tā gěi wǒ zhǐ le dì yī duàn , wǒ yī biān tīng , yī biān yòng shǒu gēn zhe zì zǒu .
meaning: I chose the shorter one and wanted to listen first. He pointed to the first paragraph, and I followed the characters with my finger while listening.

text: 轮到我时，我读了第一句。声音不太大，陈宇把椅子往我这边挪了一点，说这样听得更清楚。
pinyin: lún dào wǒ shí , wǒ dú le dì yī jù . shēng yīn bù tài dà , chén yǔ bǎ yǐ zi wǎng wǒ zhè biān nuó le yī diǎn , shuō zhè yàng tīng de gèng qīng chǔ .
meaning: When my turn came I read the first sentence. I was quiet, so Chen Yu moved his chair closer and said he could hear more clearly that way.

text: 后来各桌开始聊天，每个人说自己喜欢哪一段。旁边一位朋友喜欢结尾，我喜欢开头，两个人又一起看了一遍。
pinyin: hòu lái gè zhuō kāi shǐ liáo tiān , měi gè rén shuō zì jǐ xǐ huān nǎ yī duàn . páng biān yī wèi péng you xǐ huān jié wěi , wǒ xǐ huān kāi tóu , liǎng gè rén yòu yì qǐ kàn le yī biàn .
meaning: Later the tables began chatting about favourite sections. Someone beside me liked the ending; I liked the beginning. We looked through it together again.

text: 回去的路上，我问陈宇下周还有没有活动。他说有，我就把时间记下来。这次只读了一句，下次想试试一整段。
pinyin: huí qù de lù shàng , wǒ wèn chén yǔ xià zhōu hái yǒu méi yǒu huó dòng . tā shuō yǒu , wǒ jiù bǎ shí jiān jì xià lái . zhè cì zhǐ dú le yī jù , xià cì xiǎng shì shì yī zhěng duàn .
meaning: On the way home I asked if there was another event next week. There was, so I wrote down the time. I'd read one sentence this time and wanted to try a whole paragraph next time.

text: 周末的读书活动对大家开放。我没有报名下个月的比赛，还是可以参加今天的活动。门口有一群人在选书，我站在后面看了一会儿。陈宇看见我，把我带到他的桌子旁边。桌上放着两篇文章，他说左边的短一点，自己上次读过。我选了短的那篇，想先听别人读。他给我指了第一段，我一边听，一边用手跟着字走。轮到我时，我读了第一句。声音不太大，陈宇把椅子往我这边挪了一点，说这样听得更清楚。后来各桌开始聊天，每个人说自己喜欢哪一段。旁边一位朋友喜欢结尾，我喜欢开头，两个人又一起看了一遍。回去的路上，我问陈宇下周还有没有活动。他说有，我就把时间记下来。这次只读了一句，下次想试试一整段。
pinyin: zhōu mò de dú shū huó dòng duì dà jiā kāi fàng . wǒ méi yǒu bào míng xià gè yuè de bǐ sài , hái shi kě yǐ cān jiā jīn tiān de huó dòng . mén kǒu yǒu yī qún rén zài xuǎn shū , wǒ zhàn zài hòu miàn kàn le yī huì er . chén yǔ kàn jiàn wǒ , bǎ wǒ dài dào tā de zhuō zi páng biān . zhuō shàng fàng zhe liǎng piān wén zhāng , tā shuō zuǒ biān de duǎn yī diǎn , zì jǐ shàng cì dú guò . wǒ xuǎn le duǎn de nà piān , xiǎng xiān tīng bié ren dú . tā gěi wǒ zhǐ le dì yī duàn , wǒ yī biān tīng , yī biān yòng shǒu gēn zhe zì zǒu . lún dào wǒ shí , wǒ dú le dì yī jù . shēng yīn bù tài dà , chén yǔ bǎ yǐ zi wǎng wǒ zhè biān nuó le yī diǎn , shuō zhè yàng tīng de gèng qīng chǔ . hòu lái gè zhuō kāi shǐ liáo tiān , měi gè rén shuō zì jǐ xǐ huān nǎ yī duàn . páng biān yī wèi péng you xǐ huān jié wěi , wǒ xǐ huān kāi tóu , liǎng gè rén yòu yì qǐ kàn le yī biàn . huí qù de lù shàng , wǒ wèn chén yǔ xià zhōu hái yǒu méi yǒu huó dòng . tā shuō yǒu , wǒ jiù bǎ shí jiān jì xià lái . zhè cì zhǐ dú le yī jù , xià cì xiǎng shì shì yī zhěng duàn .
meaning: The weekend reading event was open to everyone. I hadn't entered next month's competition, but I could join today's activity. A group was choosing books at the entrance, and I watched for a while. Chen Yu saw me and brought me to his table. There were two passages on it. The left one was shorter, and he'd read it before. I chose the shorter one and wanted to listen first. He pointed to the first paragraph, and I followed the characters with my finger while listening. When my turn came I read the first sentence. I was quiet, so Chen Yu moved his chair closer and said he could hear more clearly that way. Later the tables began chatting about favourite sections. Someone beside me liked the ending; I liked the beginning. We looked through it together again. On the way home I asked if there was another event next week. There was, so I wrote down the time. I'd read one sentence this time and wanted to try a whole paragraph next time.

陈宇看见我，把我带到他的桌子旁边。桌上放着两篇文章，他说左边的短一点，自己上次读过。
我选了短的那篇，想先听别人读。他给我指了第一段，我一边听，一边用手跟着字走。
轮到我时，我读了第一句。声音不太大，陈宇把椅子往我这边挪了一点，说这样听得更清楚。
后来各桌开始聊天，每个人说自己喜欢哪一段。旁边一位朋友喜欢结尾，我喜欢开头，两个人又一起看了一遍。
回去的路上，我问陈宇下周还有没有活动。他说有，我就把时间记下来。这次只读了一句，下次想试试一整段。

text: 你刚才读得比我大声。
pinyin: nǐ gāng cái dú de bǐ wǒ dà shēng .
meaning: You read louder than me just now.

text: 因为你坐得近，我不用往后面喊。
pinyin: yīn wèi nǐ zuò de jìn , wǒ bù yòng wǎng hòu miàn hǎn .
meaning: You were nearby, so I didn't have to shout to the back.

text: 下次也坐这儿吧？
pinyin: xià cì yě zuò zhèr ba ?
meaning: Shall we sit here next time too?

text: 行，不过你得早点来，别让我一直留着椅子。
pinyin: xíng , bù guò nǐ děi zǎo diǎn lái , bié ràng wǒ yì zhí liú zhe yǐ zi .
meaning: Sure, but come early. Don't make me save the chair forever.

text: 好，我给椅子也带一杯茶。
pinyin: hǎo , wǒ gěi yǐ zi yě dài yī bēi chá .
meaning: Okay, I'll bring tea for the chair too.

text: 给我就行，椅子喝不了。
pinyin: gěi wǒ jiù xíng , yǐ zi hē bù le .
meaning: Give it to me. The chair can't drink.

text: 正好。两点到三点你负责名单，我负责入口。

text: 名单放在哪里？

text: 放在门口那张桌子上。我会提前拿过去。

text: 行，搬到窗户旁边？

text: 一位新朋友没带书，我问陈宇还有没有。他从包里拿出一本，放到桌上，让朋友先选一段看。

text: 快三点时，小周到了。我把名单给她，又告诉她那本借来的书是谁在看。她拿笔记了下来，我才去拿自己的包。

text: 走到门口，陈宇还问我下次来不来。我说来，下次如果有时间，可以多留一会儿。他笑着说先去忙今天的事吧。

text: 麻烦你帮我一个忙，问问小周周六几点能到。
pinyin: má fán nǐ bāng wǒ yī gè máng , wèn wèn xiǎo zhōu zhōu liù jǐ diǎn néng dào .
meaning: Could you do me a favour and ask when Xiao Zhou can arrive on Saturday?

text: 行，我下午联系她。她现在去理发了。
pinyin: xíng , wǒ xià wǔ lián xì tā . tā xiàn zài qù lǐ fà le .
meaning: Sure. I'll contact her this afternoon. She's getting a haircut now.

text: 我想约她一起去书店，三点还是四点都可以。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yuē tā yì qǐ qù shū diàn , sān diǎn hái shi sì diǎn dōu kě yǐ .
meaning: I'd like to go to the bookshop with her. Three or four would work.

text: 那我把两个时间都问一下。
pinyin: nà wǒ bǎ liǎng gè shí jiān dōu wèn yī xià .
meaning: I'll ask about both times.

text: 好。我先去办公室复印两页，回来再看消息。
pinyin: hǎo . wǒ xiān qù bàn gōng shì fù yìn liǎng yè , huí lái zài kàn xiāo xī .
meaning: Good. I'll photocopy two pages at the office and check the messages when I return.

text: 你去办公室？能帮我也复印这一页吗？
pinyin: nǐ qù bàn gōng shì ? néng bāng wǒ yě fù yìn zhè yī yè ma ?
meaning: You're going to the office? Could you copy this page for me too?

text: 能，拿给我吧。
pinyin: néng , ná gěi wǒ ba .

text: 谢谢。书店还有一位朋友要来，我也问问她。
pinyin: xiè xiè . shū diàn hái yǒu yī wèi péng you yào lái , wǒ yě wèn wèn tā .

text: 那我们到了先互相介绍一下。
pinyin: nà wǒ men dào le xiān hù xiāng jiè shào yī xià .

text: 好，别一下问太多，让我先等小周回消息。

下午两点，她说三点半能到。这个时间也合适，我就在手机里写好书店的地址，发给陈宇和她。
另外一位朋友四点到，我们先找了四个位子。她来了以后，陈宇介绍我们认识；聊了一会儿，才发现我们上次去过同一个活动。
走以前，我把复印的那一页给陈宇。他拿着纸笑了，说我们忙着等消息，他自己都忘了这件事。

text: 你这张纸上怎么有个茶杯印？
pinyin: nǐ zhè zhāng zhǐ shàng zěn me yǒu gè chá bēi yìn ?
meaning: Why is there a teacup mark on this page?

text: 我拿到以后放桌上，茶也放桌上了。
pinyin: wǒ ná dào yǐ hòu fàng zhuō shàng , chá yě fàng zhuō shàng le .
meaning: I put it on the table after getting it, alongside my tea.

text: 幸好字还看得清。
pinyin: xìng hǎo zì hái kàn de qīng .
meaning: Luckily the writing is still clear.

text: 要不要再复印一张？
pinyin: yào bù yào zài fù yìn yī zhāng ?
meaning: Shall I make another copy?

text: 不用，这个印也会一起印上去。
pinyin: bù yòng , zhè gè yìn yě huì yì qǐ yìn shàng qù .
meaning: No. The mark would be copied too.

text: 也是。下次先把茶喝完。
pinyin: yě shì . xià cì xiān bǎ chá hē wán .
meaning: True. I'll finish the tea first next time.

text: 她向朋友请教做这道菜的方法。
pinyin: tā xiàng péng you qǐng jiào zuò zhè dào cài de fāng fǎ .
meaning: She asked a friend how to make this dish.

text: 你帮我打听到地址了吗？
pinyin: nǐ bāng wǒ dǎ tīng dào dì zhǐ le ma ?
meaning: Did you find out the address for me?

text: 我访问过那所学校。
pinyin: wǒ fǎng wèn guò nà suǒ xué xiào .
meaning: I've visited that school.

text: 她接待了两位从外地来的客人。
pinyin: tā jiē dài le liǎng wèi cóng wài dì lái de kè rén .
meaning: She hosted two visitors from out of town.

text: 发现错误要及时改正。
pinyin: fā xiàn cuò wù yào jí shí gǎi zhèng .
meaning: An error should be corrected promptly when found.

text: 她提前告诉我周末没空。
pinyin: tā tí qián gào sù wǒ zhōu mò méi kōng .
meaning: She told me in advance that she was busy at the weekend.

text: 我想约她周六一起吃饭。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yuē tā zhōu liù yì qǐ chī fàn .
meaning: I'd like to invite her for a meal on Saturday.

text: 她到车站和家人告别。
pinyin: tā dào chē zhàn hé jiā rén gào bié .
meaning: She went to the station to say goodbye to her family.

text: 他在楼下理发，半小时后回来。
pinyin: tā zài lóu xià lǐ fà , bàn xiǎo shí hòu huí lái .
meaning: He's getting a haircut downstairs and will be back in half an hour.

text: 她结婚以后搬到了北京。
pinyin: tā jié hūn yǐ hòu bān dào le běi jīng .
meaning: She moved to Beijing after getting married.

text: 她和老师谈话以后，放心了。
pinyin: tā hé lǎo shī tán huà yǐ hòu , fàng xīn le .
meaning: She felt reassured after speaking with the teacher.

text: 这个建议很有用，我会试试。
pinyin: zhè gè jiàn yì hěn yǒu yòng , wǒ huì shì shì .
meaning: This suggestion is useful; I'll try it.

text: 她补充了一条新的消息。
pinyin: tā bǔ chōng le yī tiáo xīn de xiāo xī .
meaning: She added a piece of new information.

text: 楼下有地方可以复印。
pinyin: lóu xià yǒu dì fāng kě yǐ fù yìn .
meaning: There's somewhere downstairs where you can make photocopies.

text: 他和我很亲，常常来找我。
pinyin: tā hé wǒ hěn qīn , cháng cháng lái zhǎo wǒ .
meaning: He's very close to me and often comes to see me.

text: 他领导这个小组完成了任务。
pinyin: tā lǐng dǎo zhè gè xiǎo zǔ wán chéng le rèn wù .
meaning: He led the group in completing the task.

text: 我喜欢和性格不同的人交往。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān hé xìng gé bù tóng de rén jiāo wǎng .
meaning: I like getting to know people with different personalities.

text: 照片里六个人站得整整齐齐，只有我手上的杯子快要掉了。我想把照片保留下来，以后见面再给大家看。
pinyin: zhào piān lǐ liù gè rén zhàn de zhěng zhěng qí qí , zhǐ yǒu wǒ shǒu shàng de bēi zi kuài yào diào le . wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhào piān bǎo liú xià lái , yǐ hòu jiàn miàn zài gěi dà jiā kàn .
meaning: The six of us stood neatly in the photo, except that the cup in my hand was about to fall. I wanted to keep it and show everyone when we met again.

text: 打开通知，我发现标题写星期六，第二页的表格却写星期日。我给陈宇发消息，他一下就想起来，上次只修改了标题。
pinyin: dǎ kāi tōng zhī , wǒ fā xiàn biāo tí xiě xīng qī liù , dì èr yè de biǎo gé què xiě xīng qī rì . wǒ gěi chén yǔ fā xiāo xī , tā yī xià jiù xiǎng qǐ lái , shàng cì zhǐ xiū gǎi le biāo tí .
meaning: The notice title said Saturday, but the table on page two said Sunday. I messaged Chen Yu, who remembered he'd changed only the title last time.

text: 他问我具体什么时候要，我说六点以前就行。他先保留原件，再把第二页的日期改好，保存以后重新发来。
pinyin: tā wèn wǒ jù tǐ shén me shí hou yào , wǒ shuō liù diǎn yǐ qián jiù xíng . tā xiān bǎo liú yuán jiàn , zài bǎ dì èr yè de rì qī gǎi hǎo , bǎo cún yǐ hòu chóng xīn fā lái .
meaning: He asked exactly when I needed it. Before six was fine. He kept the original, changed the date on page two, saved it and sent it again.

text: 这次文件一共三页，内容都在。我回了一句收到，又把合照单独存到照片里，免得下次还得找半天。
pinyin: zhè cì wén jiàn yī gòng sān yè , nèi róng dōu zài . wǒ huí le yī jù shōu dào , yòu bǎ hé zhào dān dú cún dào zhào piān lǐ , miǎn de xià cì hái děi zhǎo bàn tiān .
meaning: The file now had all three pages. I replied that I'd received it and saved the group photo separately so I wouldn't spend ages looking next time.

text: 傍晚陈宇问我照片选好了没有。我说选好了，就是那张杯子快掉的。他笑我每次拍照，都要先给大家找点事做。
pinyin: bàng wǎn chén yǔ wèn wǒ zhào piān xuǎn hǎo le méi yǒu . wǒ shuō xuǎn hǎo le , jiù shì nà zhāng bēi zi kuài diào de . tā xiào wǒ měi cì pāi zhào , dōu yào xiān gěi dà jiā zhǎo diǎn shì zuò .
meaning: That evening Chen Yu asked if I'd chosen a photo. I had: the one with the falling cup. He laughed that every time I posed I found something for everyone to do.

text: 我想找上次活动的合照，就问陈宇文件存在哪里。他说找到了，在第一个文件夹里，顺便把通知也发给我。照片里六个人站得整整齐齐，只有我手上的杯子快要掉了。我想把照片保留下来，以后见面再给大家看。打开通知，我发现标题写星期六，第二页的表格却写星期日。我给陈宇发消息，他一下就想起来，上次只修改了标题。他问我具体什么时候要，我说六点以前就行。他先保留原件，再把第二页的日期改好，保存以后重新发来。这次文件一共三页，内容都在。我回了一句收到，又把合照单独存到照片里，免得下次还得找半天。傍晚陈宇问我照片选好了没有。我说选好了，就是那张杯子快掉的。他笑我每次拍照，都要先给大家找点事做。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo shàng cì huó dòng de hé zhào , jiù wèn chén yǔ wén jiàn cún zài nǎ lǐ . tā shuō zhǎo dào le , zài dì yī gè wén jiàn jiā lǐ , shùn biàn bǎ tōng zhī yě fā gěi wǒ . zhào piān lǐ liù gè rén zhàn de zhěng zhěng qí qí , zhǐ yǒu wǒ shǒu shàng de bēi zi kuài yào diào le . wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhào piān bǎo liú xià lái , yǐ hòu jiàn miàn zài gěi dà jiā kàn . dǎ kāi tōng zhī , wǒ fā xiàn biāo tí xiě xīng qī liù , dì èr yè de biǎo gé què xiě xīng qī rì . wǒ gěi chén yǔ fā xiāo xī , tā yī xià jiù xiǎng qǐ lái , shàng cì zhǐ xiū gǎi le biāo tí . tā wèn wǒ jù tǐ shén me shí hou yào , wǒ shuō liù diǎn yǐ qián jiù xíng . tā xiān bǎo liú yuán jiàn , zài bǎ dì èr yè de rì qī gǎi hǎo , bǎo cún yǐ hòu chóng xīn fā lái . zhè cì wén jiàn yī gòng sān yè , nèi róng dōu zài . wǒ huí le yī jù shōu dào , yòu bǎ hé zhào dān dú cún dào zhào piān lǐ , miǎn de xià cì hái děi zhǎo bàn tiān . bàng wǎn chén yǔ wèn wǒ zhào piān xuǎn hǎo le méi yǒu . wǒ shuō xuǎn hǎo le , jiù shì nà zhāng bēi zi kuài diào de . tā xiào wǒ měi cì pāi zhào , dōu yào xiān gěi dà jiā zhǎo diǎn shì zuò .
meaning: I wanted the group photo from our last event and asked Chen Yu where he'd saved it. It was in the first folder, he said, and he sent the notice too. The six of us stood neatly in the photo, except that the cup in my hand was about to fall. I wanted to keep it and show everyone when we met again. The notice title said Saturday, but the table on page two said Sunday. I messaged Chen Yu, who remembered he'd changed only the title last time. He asked exactly when I needed it. Before six was fine. He kept the original, changed the date on page two, saved it and sent it again. The file now had all three pages. I replied that I'd received it and saved the group photo separately so I wouldn't spend ages looking next time. That evening Chen Yu asked if I'd chosen a photo. I had: the one with the falling cup. He laughed that every time I posed I found something for everyone to do.

text: 你那杯子怎么还没掉？
pinyin: nǐ nà bēi zi zěn me hái méi diào ?
meaning: How has your cup still not fallen?

text: 照片里的杯子不会掉。
pinyin: zhào piān lǐ de bēi zi bù huì diào .
meaning: Cups in photos don't fall.

text: 那你以后每次都拿这一张？
pinyin: nà nǐ yǐ hòu měi cì dōu ná zhè yī zhāng ?
meaning: Will you carry this photo every time, then?

text: 带照片比带杯子轻多了。
pinyin: dài zhào piān bǐ dài bēi zi qīng duō le .
meaning: A photo's much lighter than a cup.

text: 好，下次我负责拍，你负责拿稳。
pinyin: hǎo , xià cì wǒ fù zé pāi , nǐ fù zé ná wěn .
meaning: Okay. Next time I'll take the photo and you hold it steady.

text: 拿照片的话，我有把握。
pinyin: ná zhào piān de huà , wǒ yǒu bǎ wò .
meaning: If it's the photo I'm holding, I can manage.

text: 你那杯子怎么还没掉？照片里的杯子不会掉。那你以后每次都拿这一张？带照片比带杯子轻多了。好，下次我负责拍，你负责拿稳。拿照片的话，我有把握。
pinyin: nǐ nà bēi zi zěn me hái méi diào ? zhào piān lǐ de bēi zi bù huì diào . nà nǐ yǐ hòu měi cì dōu ná zhè yī zhāng ? dài zhào piān bǐ dài bēi zi qīng duō le . hǎo , xià cì wǒ fù zé pāi , nǐ fù zé ná wěn . ná zhào piān de huà , wǒ yǒu bǎ wò .
meaning: How has your cup still not fallen? Cups in photos don't fall. Will you carry this photo every time, then? A photo's much lighter than a cup. Okay. Next time I'll take the photo and you hold it steady. If it's the photo I'm holding, I can manage.

text: 这些信我一直存着。
pinyin: zhè xiē xìn wǒ yì zhí cún zhe .
meaning: I've kept these letters all this time.

text: 这张老照片保存得很好。
pinyin: zhè zhāng lǎo zhào piān bǎo cún de hěn hǎo .
meaning: This old photo has been preserved well.

text: 给我保留一个位子，好吗？
pinyin: gěi wǒ bǎo liú yī gè wèi zi , hǎo ma ?
meaning: Could you keep a seat for me?

text: 她正在整理旅行的照片。
pinyin: tā zhèng zài zhěng lǐ lǚ xíng de zhào piān .
meaning: She's sorting through her travel photos.

text: 他穿得干净整齐。
pinyin: tā chuān de gān jìng zhěng qí .
meaning: He's dressed cleanly and neatly.

text: 请把完整的地址发给我。
pinyin: qǐng bǎ wán zhěng de dì zhǐ fā gěi wǒ .
meaning: Please send me the full address.

text: 我把文件放进包里了。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ wén jiàn fàng jìn bāo lǐ le .
meaning: I put the document in my bag.

text: 表格里还有一格没填。
pinyin: biǎo gé lǐ hái yǒu yī gé méi tián .
meaning: There's still one blank field in the form.

text: 我读完标题，就想继续看。
pinyin: wǒ dú wán biāo tí , jiù xiǎng jì xù kàn .
meaning: The title made me want to read on.

text: 她给我介绍了课程的内容。
pinyin: tā gěi wǒ jiè shào le kè chéng de nèi róng .
meaning: She introduced the course content to me.

text: 我们找到了去年旅行的记录。
pinyin: wǒ men zhǎo dào le qù nián lǚ xíng de jì lù .
meaning: We found last year's travel records.

text: 你说钱已经付了，有证据吗？
pinyin: nǐ shuō qián yǐ jīng fù le , yǒu zhèng jù ma ?
meaning: You say you've paid. Do you have evidence?

text: 我想用行动证明自己能做好。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yòng xíng dòng zhèng míng zì jǐ néng zuò hǎo .
meaning: I'd like to show through my actions that I can do it well.

text: 请说一个具体的例子。
pinyin: qǐng shuō yī gè jù tǐ de lì zi .
meaning: Please give a specific example.

text: 这次分工很明确。
pinyin: zhè cì fēn gōng hěn míng què .
meaning: The responsibilities are clear this time.

text: 地址写错是我的错误。
pinyin: dì zhǐ xiě cuò shì wǒ de cuò wù .
meaning: Writing the wrong address was my mistake.

text: 时间改了，通知也要修改。
pinyin: shí jiān gǎi le , tōng zhī yě yào xiū gǎi .
meaning: The time has changed, so the notice needs revising too.

text: 他帮我修好了自行车。
pinyin: tā bāng wǒ xiū hǎo le zì xíng chē .
meaning: He helped fix my bicycle.

text: 我们先处理漏水的问题。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān chǔ lǐ lòu shuǐ de wèn tí .
meaning: Let's deal with the leak first.

text: 换一条路能解决堵车的问题吗？
pinyin: huàn yī tiáo lù néng jiě jué dǔ chē de wèn tí ma ?
meaning: Would taking a different route solve the traffic problem?

text: 她终于达到了自己的目标。
pinyin: tā zhōng yú dá dào le zì jǐ de mù biāo .
meaning: She finally reached her goal.

text: 会议结束以后，我们一起吃饭。
pinyin: huì yì jié shù yǐ hòu , wǒ men yì qǐ chī fàn .
meaning: We had a meal together after the meeting.

text: 照片先存在电脑里。这些信我一直存着。保存以后，关掉电脑吧。这张老照片保存得很好。我想保留这张票。给我保留一个位子，好吗？周末我整理了书架。她正在整理旅行的照片。桌上的书放得很整齐。他穿得干净整齐。这本书是完整的，一页也没少。请把完整的地址发给我。这份文件有三页。我把文件放进包里了。请在表格上写名字。表格里还有一格没填。这个标题太长了。我读完标题，就想继续看。这本书的内容很有趣。她给我介绍了课程的内容。我每天记录开支。我们找到了去年旅行的记录。照片是他到过这里的证据。你说钱已经付了，有证据吗？这张票可以证明我买过。我想用行动证明自己能做好。具体几点见？请说一个具体的例子。他说得很明确，周四不能来。这次分工很明确。我发现了一个错误。地址写错是我的错误。我修改了文章的最后一段。时间改了，通知也要修改。门坏了，明天来修。他帮我修好了自行车。这件事我下午处理。我们先处理漏水的问题。问题已经解决了。换一条路能解决堵车的问题吗？房间温度达到了二十度。她终于达到了自己的目标。电影九点结束。会议结束以后，我们一起吃饭。

meaning: Is the table big enough for the four of us tonight?

text: 够。再拿两把椅子就行。

meaning: There were four of us at dinner tonight. The table had only two chairs, so I brought two more from the room and laid out four pairs of chopsticks.

text: 陈宇带来一束花，我把它放在桌子中间。他问今晚有什么菜，我说有白菜、鸡蛋和汤，都是刚做好的。

meaning: Chen Yu brought flowers, which I placed in the middle of the table. He asked about the food: Chinese cabbage, eggs and soup, all freshly cooked.

text: 陈宇想喝果汁，小周选红茶，王宁从冰箱拿了可乐。我自己倒水，四个人的杯子很快就不一样了。
pinyin: chén yǔ xiǎng hē guǒ zhī , xiǎo zhōu xuǎn hóng chá , wáng níng cóng bīng xiāng ná le kě lè . wǒ zì jǐ dào shuǐ , sì gè rén de bēi zi hěn kuài jiù bù yī yàng le .
meaning: Chen Yu wanted fruit juice, Xiao Zhou chose black tea, and Wang Ning fetched cola from the fridge. I poured water for myself; soon all four cups contained different drinks.

text: 汤刚端上桌，陈宇就想喝一口。我让他等等，先吃别的菜。他把碗放下，却说光看着就觉得饿。
pinyin: tāng gāng duān shàng zhuō , chén yǔ jiù xiǎng hē yī kǒu . wǒ ràng tā děng děng , xiān chī bié de cài . tā bǎ wǎn fàng xià , què shuō guāng kàn zhe jiù jué de è .
meaning: When the soup arrived Chen Yu wanted a taste immediately. I asked him to wait and try the other food first. He put down the bowl, saying the sight alone made him hungry.

text: 我们边吃边聊上次旅行，我拿出手机给大家看照片。每张照片都有一只猫，我说当地的猫比人还会找好吃的。
pinyin: wǒ men biān chī biān liáo shàng cì lǚ xíng , wǒ ná chū shǒu jī gěi dà jiā kàn zhào piān . měi zhāng zhào piān dōu yǒu yī zhǐ māo , wǒ shuō dāng dì de māo bǐ rén hái huì zhǎo hǎo chī de .
meaning: We chatted about our last trip over dinner. I showed everyone photos on my phone. Each had a cat; I said the local cats were better than people at finding good food.

text: 这顿饭吃到八点。剩下的汤我放进冰箱，四个人一起收拾桌子，那束花留着，明天还想放在窗边。
pinyin: zhè dùn fàn chī dào bā diǎn . shèng xià de tāng wǒ fàng jìn bīng xiāng , sì gè rén yì qǐ shōu shí zhuō zi , nà shù huā liú zhe , míng tiān hái xiǎng fàng zài chuāng biān .
meaning: Dinner lasted until eight. I put the remaining soup in the fridge. We cleared the table together and kept the flowers to put by the window tomorrow.

text: 今天小组六个人，纸够吗？
pinyin: jīn tiān xiǎo zǔ liù gè rén , zhǐ gòu ma ?
meaning: Do we have enough paper for the six people in the group today?

text: 只有四张，还缺两张。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu sì zhāng , hái quē liǎng zhāng .
meaning: Only four sheets. We're short of two.

text: 我去拿，你把笔放好。
pinyin: wǒ qù ná , nǐ bǎ bǐ fàng hǎo .
meaning: I'll fetch them. You lay out the pens.

text: 行，给每组配两支笔？
pinyin: xíng , gěi měi zǔ pèi liǎng zhī bǐ ?
meaning: Okay. Two pens per group?

text: 对。两组分别拿三张纸。
pinyin: duì . liǎng zǔ fēn bié ná sān zhāng zhǐ .
meaning: Yes. Three sheets for each of the two groups.

text: 纸上要写名字吗？
pinyin: zhǐ shàng yào xiě míng zi ma ?
meaning: Do we need names on the paper?

text: 写吧，大家一张一张递给我。
pinyin: xiě ba , dà jiā yī zhāng yī zhāng dì gěi wǒ .
meaning: Yes. Have everyone pass me theirs one at a time.

text: 好。这个活动收费吗？
pinyin: hǎo . zhè gè huó dòng shōu fèi ma ?
meaning: Okay. Is there a charge for this activity?

text: 不收费，大家来坐坐，聊聊书就行。
pinyin: bù shōu fèi , dà jiā lái zuò zuò , liáo liáo shū jiù xíng .
meaning: No. People can just sit and chat about books.

text: 那我再叫一个朋友来？
pinyin: nà wǒ zài jiào yī gè péng you lái ?
meaning: Shall I invite another friend?

text: 可以，不过我得再拿一张纸。
pinyin: kě yǐ , bù guò wǒ děi zài ná yī zhāng zhǐ .
meaning: Sure, but I'll need one more sheet.

text: 我来拿吧，你今天已经跑三次了。
pinyin: wǒ lái ná ba , nǐ jīn tiān yǐ jīng pǎo sān cì le .
meaning: I'll fetch it. You've gone three times already today.

text: 读书小组今天有六个人，我到得早，先帮忙放纸和笔。桌上只有四张纸，我又拿来两张，分成两组，每组放三张。
pinyin: dú shū xiǎo zǔ jīn tiān yǒu liù gè rén , wǒ dào de zǎo , xiān bāng máng fàng zhǐ hé bǐ . zhuō shàng zhǐ yǒu sì zhāng zhǐ , wǒ yòu ná lái liǎng zhāng , fēn chéng liǎng zǔ , měi zǔ fàng sān zhāng .
meaning: Six people came to today's reading group. I arrived early to help with paper and pens. There were four sheets; I fetched two more and put three on each group's table.

text: 林安问笔怎么配，我说每组两支，大家轮着用。她把椅子也放好，门口很快就有人进来了。
pinyin: lín ān wèn bǐ zěn me pèi , wǒ shuō měi zǔ liǎng zhī , dà jiā lún zhe yòng . tā bǎ yǐ zi yě fàng hǎo , mén kǒu hěn kuài jiù yǒu rén jìn lái le .
meaning: Lin An asked about pens. Each group could share two. She arranged the chairs too, and people soon began arriving.

text: 有人第一次来，问活动是不是收费。我说不收费，只要带一本自己想说的书。她笑了，说这次带了两本，正好可以借给别人。
pinyin: yǒu rén dì yī cì lái , wèn huó dòng shì bú shì shōu fèi . wǒ shuō bù shōu fèi , zhǐ yào dài yī běn zì jǐ xiǎng shuō de shū . tā xiào le , shuō zhè cì dài le liǎng běn , zhèng hǎo kě yǐ jiè gěi bié ren .
meaning: A new visitor asked about the charge. There was none; people just needed a book they wanted to talk about. She smiled: she'd brought two and could lend one.

text: 六个人到齐以后，大家在纸上写名字，再一张一张递过来。我看见两个相同的姓，就问他们是不是已经认识。
pinyin: liù gè rén dào qí yǐ hòu , dà jiā zài zhǐ shàng xiě míng zi , zài yī zhāng yī zhāng dì guò lái . wǒ kàn jiàn liǎng gè xiāng tóng de xìng , jiù wèn tā men shì bú shì yǐ jīng rèn shi .
meaning: Once all six had arrived, everyone wrote their name and passed over their sheet. Two shared a surname, so I asked if they knew each other already.

text: 他们以前没见过，今天却带了同一本书。两个人马上坐到一起，说好一人先讲一段，另一人再接着讲。
pinyin: tā men yǐ qián méi jiàn guò , jīn tiān què dài le tóng yī běn shū . liǎng gè rén mǎ shàng zuò dào yì qǐ , shuō hǎo yī rén xiān jiǎng yī duàn , lìng yī rén zài jiē zhe jiǎng .
meaning: They hadn't met, but had brought the same book. They sat together immediately and agreed to take turns talking about a passage.

text: 活动结束时，桌上六张纸都还在，有一支笔却不知道是谁的。我刚问完，大家都笑了，那是我自己带来的。
pinyin: huó dòng jié shù shí , zhuō shàng liù zhāng zhǐ dōu hái zài , yǒu yī zhī bǐ què bù zhī dào shì shéi de . wǒ gāng wèn wán , dà jiā dōu xiào le , nà shì wǒ zì jǐ dài lái de .
meaning: At the end all six sheets were still on the table, but we couldn't identify one pen. Everyone laughed when I asked: I'd brought it myself.

text: 这本书缺了一页。
pinyin: zhè běn shū quē le yī yè .
meaning: This book has a missing page.

text: 我缺少参加这种活动的经验。
pinyin: wǒ quē shǎo cān jiā zhè zhǒng huó dòng de jīng yàn .
meaning: I lack experience of this kind of event.

text: 报名的人数超过了椅子的数量。
pinyin: bào míng de rén shù chāo guò le yǐ zi de shù liàng .
meaning: More people signed up than there are chairs.

text: 读完那本书，我心里很满足。
pinyin: dú wán nà běn shū , wǒ xīn lǐ hěn mǎn zú .
meaning: Finishing that book left me feeling satisfied.

text: 两组分别坐在左边和右边。
pinyin: liǎng zǔ fēn bié zuò zài zuǒ biān hé yòu biān .
meaning: The two groups sit on the left and right respectively.

text: 我们换一种方式试试。
pinyin: wǒ men huàn yī zhǒng fāng shì shì shì .
meaning: Let's try a different way.

text: 每个房间配两把椅子。
pinyin: měi gè fáng jiān pèi liǎng bǎ yǐ zi .
meaning: Each room gets two chairs.

text: 你拿着这一边，我来配合你。
pinyin: nǐ ná zhe zhè yī biān , wǒ lái pèi hé nǐ .
meaning: Hold this side and I'll work with you.

text: 这些杯子放齐一点吧。
pinyin: zhè xiē bēi zi fàng qí yī diǎn ba .
meaning: Arrange these cups more evenly.

text: 这本书我看了整整三遍。
pinyin: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le zhěng zhěng sān biàn .
meaning: I read this book three full times.

text: 整个小组都来了。
pinyin: zhěng gè xiǎo zǔ dōu lái le .
meaning: The entire group came.

text: 这个计划的整体安排不错。
pinyin: zhè gè jì huà de zhěng tǐ ān pái bù cuò .
meaning: The overall arrangement of this plan is good.

text: 我们想更全面地了解这座城市。
pinyin: wǒ men xiǎng gèng quán miàn de liǎo jiě zhè zuò chéng shì .
meaning: We'd like to understand this city more fully.

text: 人群慢慢走出了车站。
pinyin: rén qún màn màn zǒu chū le chē zhàn .
meaning: The crowd slowly left the station.

text: 双方都愿意再谈一次。
pinyin: shuāng fāng dōu yuàn yì zài tán yī cì .
meaning: Both sides are willing to talk again.

text: 你这里能用人民币吗？
pinyin: nǐ zhè lǐ néng yòng rén mín bì ma ?
meaning: Can I use renminbi here?

text: 钱付完了，我们走吧。
pinyin: qián fù wán le , wǒ men zǒu ba .
meaning: We've paid. Let's go.

text: 支付完成以后，我收到了消息。
pinyin: zhī fù wán chéng yǐ hòu , wǒ shōu dào le xiāo xī .
meaning: I got a message when the payment was complete.

text: 报名以后，还要交费吗？
pinyin: bào míng yǐ hòu , hái yào jiāo fèi ma ?
meaning: Is there a fee after signing up?

text: 这里停车怎么收费？
pinyin: zhè lǐ tíng chē zěn me shōu fèi ?
meaning: How much do you charge for parking here?

text: 昨天那首歌，你今天还想练吗？
pinyin: zuó tiān nà shǒu gē , nǐ jīn tiān hái xiǎng liàn ma ?
meaning: Do you want to practise yesterday's song again today?

text: 想。今天比昨天清楚多了，不过最后一句还没唱好。
pinyin: xiǎng . jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān qīng chǔ duō le , bù guò zuì hòu yī jù hái méi chàng hǎo .
meaning: Yes. It's much clearer today, but I still can't get the last line right.

text: 我唱一遍，你听听？
pinyin: wǒ chàng yī biàn , nǐ tīng tīng ?
meaning: Shall I sing it once for you?

text: 好。别太快，我想听清每个字。
pinyin: hǎo . bié tài kuài , wǒ xiǎng tīng qīng měi gè zì .
meaning: Yes. Not too fast; I want to hear every word.

text: 这样行吗？
pinyin: zhè yàng xíng ma ?
meaning: Is this okay?

text: 行，这次比较容易跟。再来一遍吧。
pinyin: xíng , zhè cì bǐ jiào róng yì gēn . zài lái yī biàn ba .
meaning: Yes. This time it's fairly easy to follow. Once more, please.

text: 你已经唱了三遍，我只唱了两遍。
pinyin: nǐ yǐ jīng chàng le sān biàn , wǒ zhǐ chàng le liǎng biàn .
meaning: You've sung it three times; I've sung it only twice.

text: 那你再唱一次，正好。
pinyin: nà nǐ zài chàng yī cì , zhèng hǎo .
meaning: One more from you will make it even.

text: 下周五的演唱会，你买票了吗？
pinyin: xià zhōu wǔ de yǎn chàng huì , nǐ mǎi piào le ma ?
meaning: Have you got a ticket for next Friday's concert?

text: 买了，七点开门，八点开始。
pinyin: mǎi le , qī diǎn kāi mén , bā diǎn kāi shǐ .
meaning: Yes. Doors open at seven; it starts at eight.

text: 我们六点半在车站见？
pinyin: wǒ men liù diǎn bàn zài chē zhàn jiàn ?
meaning: Meet at the station at six thirty?

text: 好，在路上还可以唱，不过小声一点。
pinyin: hǎo , zài lù shàng hái kě yǐ chàng , bù guò xiǎo shēng yī diǎn .
meaning: Okay. We can sing on the way, but quietly.

text: 陈宇昨天和我练一首歌，最后一句我总是唱不清。他今天又来，我们先把这句读慢一点，再一起唱。
pinyin: chén yǔ zuó tiān hé wǒ liàn yī shǒu gē , zuì hòu yī jù wǒ zǒng shì chàng bù qīng . tā jīn tiān yòu lái , wǒ men xiān bǎ zhè jù dú màn yī diǎn , zài yì qǐ chàng .
meaning: Chen Yu and I practised a song yesterday, but I couldn't sing the last line clearly. When he came today we read it slowly first, then sang it together.

text: 我唱了三遍，他唱了两遍。我让他再唱一次，他故意拿着笔当话筒，站得像已经上了舞台。
pinyin: wǒ chàng le sān biàn , tā chàng le liǎng biàn . wǒ ràng tā zài chàng yī cì , tā gù yì ná zhe bǐ dāng huà tǒng , zhàn de xiàng yǐ jīng shàng le wǔ tái .
meaning: I sang it three times and he sang it twice. I asked for one more; he used his pen as a microphone and stood as though already onstage.

text: 这一遍我听清了最后两个字，就跟着唱。他说比昨天好听，我也觉得今天更加轻松，不再只顾着赶上音乐。
pinyin: zhè yī biàn wǒ tīng qīng le zuì hòu liǎng gè zì , jiù gēn zhe chàng . tā shuō bǐ zuó tiān hǎo tīng , wǒ yě jué de jīn tiān gèng jiā qīng sōng , bù zài zhǐ gù zhe gǎn shàng yīn yuè .
meaning: I heard the last two words this time and sang along. He thought it sounded better than yesterday. I felt more relaxed too, rather than just trying to keep up with the music.

text: 下周五我们要去看演唱会。七点开门，八点开始，所以约好六点半在车站见，先一起吃点东西。
pinyin: xià zhōu wǔ wǒ men yào qù kàn yǎn chàng huì . qī diǎn kāi mén , bā diǎn kāi shǐ , suǒ yǐ yuē hǎo liù diǎn bàn zài chē zhàn jiàn , xiān yì qǐ chī diǎn dōng xi .
meaning: We're going to a concert next Friday. Doors open at seven and it starts at eight. We'll meet at the station at six thirty and get something to eat first.

text: 我最喜欢的歌手这次和乐队一起演出。以前我只听过歌声，这次还想看看他们在舞台上怎么互相配合。
pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de gē shǒu zhè cì hé yuè duì yì qǐ yǎn chū . yǐ qián wǒ zhǐ tīng guò gē shēng , zhè cì hái xiǎng kàn kàn tā men zài wǔ tái shàng zěn me hù xiāng pèi hé .
meaning: My favourite singer is performing with a band. Before I'd only heard the singing; now I wanted to see how they worked together onstage.

text: 晚上我把笔收好，陈宇还问下次有没有话筒。我说话筒没有，两支笔倒是有，让他选一个颜色就行。
pinyin: wǎn shang wǒ bǎ bǐ shōu hǎo , chén yǔ hái wèn xià cì yǒu méi yǒu huà tǒng . wǒ shuō huà tǒng méi yǒu , liǎng zhī bǐ dǎo shì yǒu , ràng tā xuǎn yī gè yán sè jiù xíng .
meaning: That evening I put away the pen. Chen Yu asked whether we'd have a microphone next time. We wouldn't, I said, but I had two pens; he could choose a colour.
