pinyin: chén yǔ zuó tiān hé wǒ liàn yī shǒu gē , zuì hòu yī jù wǒ zǒng shì chàng bù qīng . tā jīn tiān yòu lái , wǒ men xiān bǎ zhè jù dú màn yī diǎn , zài yì qǐ chàng . wǒ chàng le sān biàn , tā chàng le liǎng biàn . wǒ ràng tā zài chàng yī cì , tā gù yì ná zhe bǐ dāng huà tǒng , zhàn de xiàng yǐ jīng shàng le wǔ tái . zhè yī biàn wǒ tīng qīng le zuì hòu liǎng gè zì , jiù gēn zhe chàng . tā shuō bǐ zuó tiān hǎo tīng , wǒ yě jué de jīn tiān gèng jiā qīng sōng , bù zài zhǐ gù zhe gǎn shàng yīn yuè . xià zhōu wǔ wǒ men yào qù kàn yǎn chàng huì . qī diǎn kāi mén , bā diǎn kāi shǐ , suǒ yǐ yuē hǎo liù diǎn bàn zài chē zhàn jiàn , xiān yì qǐ chī diǎn dōng xi . wǒ zuì xǐ huān de gē shǒu zhè cì hé yuè duì yì qǐ yǎn chū . yǐ qián wǒ zhǐ tīng guò gē shēng , zhè cì hái xiǎng kàn kàn tā men zài wǔ tái shàng zěn me hù xiāng pèi hé . wǎn shang wǒ bǎ bǐ shōu hǎo , chén yǔ hái wèn xià cì yǒu méi yǒu huà tǒng . wǒ shuō huà tǒng méi yǒu , liǎng zhī bǐ dǎo shì yǒu , ràng tā xuǎn yī gè yán sè jiù xíng .
meaning: Chen Yu and I practised a song yesterday, but I couldn't sing the last line clearly. When he came today we read it slowly first, then sang it together. I sang it three times and he sang it twice. I asked for one more; he used his pen as a microphone and stood as though already onstage. I heard the last two words this time and sang along. He thought it sounded better than yesterday. I felt more relaxed too, rather than just trying to keep up with the music. We're going to a concert next Friday. Doors open at seven and it starts at eight. We'll meet at the station at six thirty and get something to eat first. My favourite singer is performing with a band. Before I'd only heard the singing; now I wanted to see how they worked together onstage. That evening I put away the pen. Chen Yu asked whether we'd have a microphone next time. We wouldn't, I said, but I had two pens; he could choose a colour.

text: 哪个唱得好听？

text: 笔都一样，是你唱。

text: 那我选蓝色，看起来像上台了。

text: 好，今天只唱歌，不画画。

text: 今天她比昨天更加开心。

text: 这个队比上次强了。

text: 这台电脑的功能很强大。
pinyin: zhè tái diàn nǎo de gōng néng hěn qiáng dà .

text: 她又强调了一次，六点出发。

text: 阳光很强烈，我们坐到树下吧。
pinyin: yáng guāng hěn qiáng liè , wǒ men zuò dào shù xià ba .
meaning: The sunlight is intense. Let's sit under the tree.

text: 他把计划进一步说清楚了。
pinyin: tā bǎ jì huà jìn yí bù shuō qīng chǔ le .
meaning: He explained the plan more clearly.

text: 她每天练习，一点一点进步。
pinyin: tā měi tiān liàn xí , yī diǎn yī diǎn jìn bù .

text: 这个安排还有改进的地方。
pinyin: zhè gè ān pái hái yǒu gǎi jìn de dì fāng .
meaning: This arrangement still has room for improvement.

text: 他想学习新的技术。
pinyin: tā xiǎng xué xí xīn de jì shù .
meaning: He wants to learn new techniques.

text: 这座城市有一所艺术学校。
pinyin: zhè zuò chéng shì yǒu yī suǒ yì shù xué xiào .
meaning: This city has an art school.

text: 舞台前面有一排椅子。

text: 今晚谁来演唱？

text: 我和朋友一起去看演唱会。

text: 这次演出很成功。

text: 她从小就想当演员。

text: 歌声停了，大家拍手。

text: 周六的演出，你想去吗？

meaning: Do you want to go to Saturday's performance?

text: 想，票价是多少？
pinyin: xiǎng , piào jià shì duō shao ?
meaning: Yes. How much are tickets?

text: 网上写二十元，至少提前一天订。
pinyin: wǎng shàng xiě èr shí yuán , zhì shǎo tí qián yī tiān dìng .

text: 那今天订吧，还有位子吗？

meaning: Let's book today. Are there still seats?

text: 目前只剩两个，我们正好两个人。

meaning: There are only two left at present. Just right for us.

text: 活动在哪儿？

meaning: Where's the event?

text: 在学校旁边的公共活动室，不在上次那个地方。

text: 我差点走错。几点开始？
pinyin: wǒ chà diǎn zǒu cuò . jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ ?

text: 七点。票上写仅限当天使用。

pinyin: piào jià shì èr shí yuán , shí jiān shì wǎn shang qī diǎn . dì zhǐ zài xué xiào páng biān de gōng gòng huó dòng shì , wǒ bǎ tā cún jìn shǒu jī , miǎn de zǒu dào shàng cì de dì fāng .
meaning: Tickets were twenty yuan and the show started at seven. I saved the address of the shared activity room by the school so I wouldn't go to the previous venue.

text: 周六六点半，我们在学校门口见面。陈宇穿了一件新衬衫，我问他是不是专门买的。他说不是，只是终于想起来穿。
pinyin: zhōu liù liù diǎn bàn , wǒ men zài xué xiào mén kǒu jiàn miàn . chén yǔ chuān le yī jiàn xīn chèn shān , wǒ wèn tā shì bú shì zhuān mén mǎi de . tā shuō bù shì , zhǐ shì zhōng yú xiǎng qǐ lái chuān .
meaning: We met at the school entrance at six thirty on Saturday. Chen Yu had a new shirt. Had he bought it for this? No, he said; he'd finally remembered to wear it.

text: 走到活动室，门口的人看了票，让我们进去。前面两排已经坐满，我们的位子在第三排，离舞台也不远。

meaning: At the activity room someone checked our tickets and let us in. The first two rows were full. Our seats were in the third row, still near the stage.

text: 演出开始以后，陈宇把手机放进包里。我也收起来，坐着听了一个多小时。最后一首歌，我们都听过，就轻轻跟着唱。
pinyin: yǎn chū kāi shǐ yǐ hòu , chén yǔ bǎ shǒu jī fàng jìn bāo lǐ . wǒ yě shōu qǐ lái , zuò zhe tīng le yī gè duō xiǎo shí . zuì hòu yī shǒu gē , wǒ men dōu tīng guò , jiù qīng qīng gēn zhe chàng .
meaning: When the show began Chen Yu put his phone away. I did too, and we listened for over an hour. We both knew the last song and quietly sang along.

text: 结束时我问他，下次还来吗。他说来，不过至少早一点订，省得每次都只剩两个位子。
pinyin: jié shù shí wǒ wèn tā , xià cì hái lái ma . tā shuō lái , bù guò zhì shǎo zǎo yī diǎn dìng , shěng de měi cì dōu zhǐ shèng liǎng gè wèi zi .

text: 你还记得从前那家书店吗？
pinyin: nǐ hái jì de cóng qián nà jiā shū diàn ma ?
meaning: Do you remember that old bookshop?

text: 记得，我们放学以后常去。
pinyin: jì de , wǒ men fàng xué yǐ hòu cháng qù .
meaning: Yes. We used to go after school.

text: 今天想不想去看看？
pinyin: jīn tiān xiǎng bù xiǎng qù kàn kàn ?
meaning: Shall we have a look today?

text: 想。不过它年初就搬走了。
pinyin: xiǎng . bù guò tā nián chū jiù bān zǒu le .
meaning: Yes. But it moved at the beginning of the year.

text: 啊，我还准备往老地方走。
pinyin: a , wǒ hái zhǔn bèi wǎng lǎo dì fāng zǒu .

text: 新地址在地铁站旁边，我发给你。
pinyin: xīn dì zhǐ zài dì tiě zhàn páng biān , wǒ fā gěi nǐ .

text: 收到了。那我立刻出门。
pinyin: shōu dào le . nà wǒ lì kè chū mén .

text: 别急，我还在找钥匙。

text: 你每次放钥匙的地方都不一样。

text: 找到了，在昨天那件外套里。

text: 那三点在书店门口见？

text: 好。今天先看书，别又只聊一个下午。

meaning: Yes. Let's actually look at books today instead of just chatting all afternoon again.

text: 我曾经住在学校旁边，放学后常去街角的书店。后来搬家了，几年没回去，那家店的地址却一直留在手机里。
pinyin: wǒ céng jīng zhù zài xué xiào páng biān , fàng xué hòu cháng qù jiē jiǎo de shū diàn . hòu lái bān jiā le , jǐ nián méi huí qù , nà jiā diàn de dì zhǐ què yì zhí liú zài shǒu jī lǐ .
meaning: I once lived by the school and often visited the bookshop on the corner after class. I moved away and hadn't returned for years, but kept its address on my phone.

text: 今天我和陈宇约好去看看。我本来想去老地方，他告诉我，书店年初已经搬到地铁站旁边。我赶紧改了地址。
pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ hé chén yǔ yuē hǎo qù kàn kàn . wǒ běn lái xiǎng qù lǎo dì fāng , tā gào sù wǒ , shū diàn nián chū yǐ jīng bān dào dì tiě zhàn páng biān . wǒ gǎn jǐn gǎi le dì zhǐ .
meaning: Today Chen Yu and I arranged a visit. I'd planned to go to the old place, but he told me the shop had moved by the metro at the beginning of the year. I quickly changed the address.

text: 三点，我们在新店门口见面。门口的字还是从前那几个，里面却大多了，窗边多了两张桌子，可以坐着读书。
pinyin: sān diǎn , wǒ men zài xīn diàn mén kǒu jiàn miàn . mén kǒu de zì hái shi cóng qián nà jǐ gè , lǐ miàn què dà duō le , chuāng biān duō le liǎng zhāng zhuō zi , kě yǐ zuò zhe dú shū .
meaning: We met outside the new shop at three. The sign still had the same words, but inside it was much bigger, with two new tables by the window for reading.

text: 老板认出了陈宇，问他最近忙不忙。陈宇说，忙，不过经过这里就会进来。我站在旁边，突然觉得几年过去了，好像也没那么久。
pinyin: lǎo bǎn rèn chū le chén yǔ , wèn tā zuì jìn máng bù máng . chén yǔ shuō , máng , bù guò jīng guò zhè lǐ jiù huì jìn lái . wǒ zhàn zài páng biān , tū rán jué de jǐ nián guò qù le , hǎo xiàng yě méi nà me jiǔ .
meaning: The owner recognised Chen Yu and asked if he'd been busy. Yes, he said, but he always dropped in when passing. Standing beside him, I suddenly felt those years hadn't been so long.

text: 我在书架上找到以前读过的一本小说。陈宇说封面早已换了，我打开一看，第一句话还是一样，连当初画的那条线都想起来了。
pinyin: wǒ zài shū jià shàng zhǎo dào yǐ qián dú guò de yī běn xiǎo shuō . chén yǔ shuō fēng miàn zǎo yǐ huàn le , wǒ dǎ kāi yī kàn , dì yī jù huà hái shi yī yàng , lián dāng chū huà de nà tiáo xiàn dōu xiǎng qǐ lái le .
meaning: I found a novel I'd read before. Chen Yu said the cover had changed long ago. Inside, the first sentence was the same, and I even remembered the line I'd underlined.

text: 回家时我们各买了一本书。陈宇说，这次总算不是光聊天。我说，聊也聊了，书也买了，下次还能继续。
pinyin: huí jiā shí wǒ men gè mǎi le yī běn shū . chén yǔ shuō , zhè cì zǒng suàn bù shì guāng liáo tiān . wǒ shuō , liáo yě liáo le , shū yě mǎi le , xià cì hái néng jì xù .
meaning: We each bought a book before leaving. Chen Yu said we'd finally done more than chat. We'd chatted and bought books, I said; next time we could do both again.

text: 这本书本来就在我包里。

pinyin: tāng yào liáng le , gǎn kuài hē .
meaning: The soup will get cold. Drink it while it's hot.

text: 收到地址，我立刻出发。
pinyin: shōu dào dì zhǐ , wǒ lì kè chū fā .
meaning: I'll leave as soon as I get the address.

text: 看到朋友进来，他连忙站起来。
pinyin: kàn dào péng you jìn lái , tā lián máng zhàn qǐ lái .
meaning: He hurriedly stood up when he saw his friend come in.

text: 那张照片始终放在他的桌上。
pinyin: nà zhāng zhào piān shǐ zhōng fàng zài tā de zhuō shàng .
meaning: That photo has stayed on his desk all this time.

text: 通知上写着活动已取消。
pinyin: tōng zhī shàng xiě zhe huó dòng yǐ qǔ xiāo .
meaning: The notice says the event has been cancelled.

text: 这件事我早已忘了。
pinyin: zhè jiàn shì wǒ zǎo yǐ wàng le .
meaning: I'd forgotten about that long ago.

text: 自从那次见面，我们常常联系。
pinyin: zì cóng nà cì jiàn miàn , wǒ men cháng cháng lián xì .
meaning: We've kept in touch often since that meeting.

text: 奶奶喜欢讲从前的事。
pinyin: nǎi nai xǐ huān jiǎng cóng qián de shì .
meaning: Grandma likes talking about the old days.

text: 我们聊了一会儿过去的生活。
pinyin: wǒ men liáo le yī huì er guò qù de shēng huó .
meaning: We talked about our lives in the past for a while.

text: 当初买这辆车的时候，它还是新的。
pinyin: dāng chū mǎi zhè liàng chē de shí hou , tā hái shi xīn de .
meaning: This car was new when I first bought it.

text: 他至今没有回复那封信。
pinyin: tā zhì jīn méi yǒu huí fù nà fēng xìn .
meaning: He still hasn't replied to that letter.

text: 我喜欢看八十年代的电影。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān kàn bā shí nián dài de diàn yǐng .
meaning: I like watching films from the eighties.

text: 我们年初约好了夏天见面。
pinyin: wǒ men nián chū yuē hǎo le xià tiān jiàn miàn .
meaning: We arranged at the beginning of the year to meet in summer.

text: 这家店到年底就开了十年了。
pinyin: zhè jiā diàn dào nián dǐ jiù kāi le shí nián le .
meaning: This shop will have been open for ten years by the end of the year.

text: 天气有变化，记得带外套。
pinyin: tiān qì yǒu biàn huà , jì de dài wài tào .
meaning: The weather's changing. Remember a coat.

text: 水慢慢变为了冰。
pinyin: shuǐ màn màn biàn wéi le bīng .
meaning: The water gradually turned to ice.

text: 看着孩子成长，她很高兴。
pinyin: kàn zhe hái zi chéng zhǎng , tā hěn gāo xìng .

text: 这首歌给我留下了很深的印象。
pinyin: zhè shǒu gē gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn de yìn xiàng .
meaning: This song made a deep impression on me.

meaning: I'd planned to walk, but then it rained. This book was in my bag all along. I once lived on this street. She taught me piano once. I've never been to this shop. He never eats spicy food. text: 吃完饭出去散步吗？

meaning: Shall we walk after dinner?

text: 想去，不过我有点困。
pinyin: xiǎng qù , bù guò wǒ yǒu diǎn kùn .
meaning: I'd like to, but I'm a little sleepy.

text: 你今天整天都坐在电脑前吧？
pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān zhěng tiān dōu zuò zài diàn nǎo qián ba ?
meaning: You've sat at the computer all day, haven't you?

text: 是啊，连续开了三个会。

meaning: Yes. Three meetings in a row.

text: 那出去走二十分钟，换换空气。
pinyin: nà chū qù zǒu èr shí fēn zhōng , huàn huàn kōng qì .
meaning: Let's walk for twenty minutes and get some fresh air.

text: 去哪儿？公园有点远。
pinyin: qù nǎr ? gōng yuán yǒu diǎn yuǎn .
meaning: Where? The park's a little far.

text: 去河边，不到十分钟就到了。
pinyin: qù hé biān , bù dào shí fēn zhōng jiù dào le .
meaning: The river. It takes less than ten minutes to get there.

text: 外面冷不冷？
pinyin: wài miàn lěng bù lěng ?
meaning: Is it cold outside?

text: 今天挺暖和，带件薄外套就行。
pinyin: jīn tiān tǐng nuǎn huo , dài jiàn báo wài tào jiù xíng .

text: 行。我拿钥匙，你等我一下。
pinyin: xíng . wǒ ná yào shi , nǐ děng wǒ yī xià .
meaning: Okay. I'll fetch my keys. Wait a moment.

text: 我在门口等，今天不跑步。
pinyin: wǒ zài mén kǒu děng , jīn tiān bù pǎo bù .
meaning: I'll wait by the door. No jogging today.

text: 太好了，跑的话，你得把我拉回来。
pinyin: tài hǎo le , pǎo de huà , nǐ děi bǎ wǒ lā huí lái .
meaning: Great. If we ran, you'd have to drag me home.

text: 今天我连续开了三个会，午饭也是坐在电脑前吃的。晚上吃完饭，林安问我要不要去散步，我觉得困，差点说不去。
pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ lián xù kāi le sān gè huì , wǔ fàn yě shì zuò zài diàn nǎo qián chī de . wǎn shang chī wán fàn , lín ān wèn wǒ yào bù yào qù sàn bù , wǒ jué de kùn , chà diǎn shuō bù qù .
meaning: I had three meetings in a row today and ate lunch at the computer too. After dinner Lin An suggested a walk. I was sleepy and nearly said no.

text: 她说不用跑，出去走二十分钟就回来。我拿了一件薄外套，跟她去河边。路上还有人推着自行车，慢慢往家走。
pinyin: tā shuō bù yòng pǎo , chū qù zǒu èr shí fēn zhōng jiù huí lái . wǒ ná le yī jiàn báo wài tào , gēn tā qù hé biān . lù shàng hái yǒu rén tuī zhe zì xíng chē , màn màn wǎng jiā zǒu .
meaning: She said we wouldn't run; just twenty minutes out and back. I took a light jacket and followed her to the river. Other people were wheeling bicycles slowly home.

text: 我们走到桥边停了一会儿。水面上有灯的光，风也不冷。我终于不想一直看手机了，就把它放进了口袋。
pinyin: wǒ men zǒu dào qiáo biān tíng le yī huì er . shuǐ miàn shàng yǒu dēng de guāng , fēng yě bù lěng . wǒ zhōng yú bù xiǎng yì zhí kàn shǒu jī le , jiù bǎ tā fàng jìn le kǒu dài .
meaning: We stopped by the bridge. Lights shone on the water and the breeze wasn't cold. I finally stopped wanting to stare at my phone and put it in my pocket.

text: 林安说她通常晚饭后出来走走，往往在这里碰见邻居。话刚说完，就有人叫她的名字，还问旁边的我是不是新来的朋友。
pinyin: lín ān shuō tā tōng cháng wǎn fàn hòu chū lái zǒu zǒu , wǎng wǎng zài zhè lǐ pèng jiàn lín jū . huà gāng shuō wán , jiù yǒu rén jiào tā de míng zi , hái wèn páng biān de wǒ shì bú shì xīn lái de péng you .
meaning: Lin An said she usually walked after dinner and often met neighbours here. Just then someone called her name and asked if I was a new friend.

text: 我们聊了几句，就往回走。到家一看，出门整整二十分钟。林安问我还困不困，我说不困了，不过想喝点水。
pinyin: wǒ men liáo le jǐ jù , jiù wǎng huí zǒu . dào jiā yī kàn , chū mén zhěng zhěng èr shí fēn zhōng . lín ān wèn wǒ hái kùn bù kùn , wǒ shuō bù kùn le , bù guò xiǎng hē diǎn shuǐ .
meaning: We chatted briefly and headed back. We'd been out for exactly twenty minutes. Lin An asked if I was still sleepy. No, but I'd like some water.

text: 她把水倒好，问明天还去吗。我说去，钥匙已经放在门边了。这次不用再找半天。
pinyin: tā bǎ shuǐ dào hǎo , wèn míng tiān hái qù ma . wǒ shuō qù , yào shi yǐ jīng fàng zài mén biān le . zhè cì bù yòng zài zhǎo bàn tiān .

text: 今天我连续开了三个会，午饭也是坐在电脑前吃的。晚上吃完饭，林安问我要不要去散步，我觉得困，差点说不去。她说不用跑，出去走二十分钟就回来。我拿了一件薄外套，跟她去河边。路上还有人推着自行车，慢慢往家走。我们走到桥边停了一会儿。水面上有灯的光，风也不冷。我终于不想一直看手机了，就把它放进了口袋。林安说她通常晚饭后出来走走，往往在这里碰见邻居。话刚说完，就有人叫她的名字，还问旁边的我是不是新来的朋友。我们聊了几句，就往回走。到家一看，出门整整二十分钟。林安问我还困不困，我说不困了，不过想喝点水。她把水倒好，问明天还去吗。我说去，钥匙已经放在门边了。这次不用再找半天。
pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ lián xù kāi le sān gè huì , wǔ fàn yě shì zuò zài diàn nǎo qián chī de . wǎn shang chī wán fàn , lín ān wèn wǒ yào bù yào qù sàn bù , wǒ jué de kùn , chà diǎn shuō bù qù . tā shuō bù yòng pǎo , chū qù zǒu èr shí fēn zhōng jiù huí lái . wǒ ná le yī jiàn báo wài tào , gēn tā qù hé biān . lù shàng hái yǒu rén tuī zhe zì xíng chē , màn màn wǎng jiā zǒu . wǒ men zǒu dào qiáo biān tíng le yī huì er . shuǐ miàn shàng yǒu dēng de guāng , fēng yě bù lěng . wǒ zhōng yú bù xiǎng yì zhí kàn shǒu jī le , jiù bǎ tā fàng jìn le kǒu dài . lín ān shuō tā tōng cháng wǎn fàn hòu chū lái zǒu zǒu , wǎng wǎng zài zhè lǐ pèng jiàn lín jū . huà gāng shuō wán , jiù yǒu rén jiào tā de míng zi , hái wèn páng biān de wǒ shì bú shì xīn lái de péng you . wǒ men liáo le jǐ jù , jiù wǎng huí zǒu . dào jiā yī kàn , chū mén zhěng zhěng èr shí fēn zhōng . lín ān wèn wǒ hái kùn bù kùn , wǒ shuō bù kùn le , bù guò xiǎng hē diǎn shuǐ . tā bǎ shuǐ dào hǎo , wèn míng tiān hái qù ma . wǒ shuō qù , yào shi yǐ jīng fàng zài mén biān le . zhè cì bù yòng zài zhǎo bàn tiān .
meaning: I had three meetings in a row today and ate lunch at the computer too. After dinner Lin An suggested a walk. I was sleepy and nearly said no. She said we wouldn't run; just twenty minutes out and back. I took a light jacket and followed her to the river. Other people were wheeling bicycles slowly home. We stopped by the bridge. Lights shone on the water and the breeze wasn't cold. I finally stopped wanting to stare at my phone and put it in my pocket. Lin An said she usually walked after dinner and often met neighbours here. Just then someone called her name and asked if I was a new friend. We chatted briefly and headed back. We'd been out for exactly twenty minutes. Lin An asked if I was still sleepy. No, but I'd like some water. She poured water and asked if I'd go again tomorrow. Yes, I said; my keys were already by the door. No long search this time.

pinyin: míng tiān shè qū yǒu yī chǎng xiǎo yǎn chū , wǒ hé chén yǔ yì qǐ chàng yī shǒu gē . jīn tiān tā lái bāng wǒ liàn xí , wǒ fǎn fù chàng dào zuì hòu liǎng jù , què měi cì dōu wàng le yī jù .
meaning: Chen Yu and I are singing at a small community show tomorrow. Today he came to practise with me. I kept reaching the last two lines and forgetting one.

text: 他关掉音乐，让我先慢慢说。我看着纸读了两遍，再把纸放下。这一次说全了，心里也没有刚才那么急。
pinyin: tā guān diào yīn yuè , ràng wǒ xiān màn màn shuō . wǒ kàn zhe zhǐ dú le liǎng biàn , zài bǎ zhǐ fàng xià . zhè yī cì shuō quán le , xīn lǐ yě méi yǒu gāng cái nà me jí .
meaning: He turned off the music and asked me to say it slowly. I read from the paper twice and put it down. This time I said every line and felt less rushed.

text: 陈宇想放音乐，我说再练两遍。他就坐在旁边，等我把最后一句说清楚。说完我才发现，刚才一直把两个词的顺序弄反了。
pinyin: chén yǔ xiǎng fàng yīn yuè , wǒ shuō zài liàn liǎng biàn . tā jiù zuò zài páng biān , děng wǒ bǎ zuì hòu yī jù shuō qīng chǔ . shuō wán wǒ cái fā xiàn , gāng cái yì zhí bǎ liǎng gè cí de shùn xù nòng fǎn le .
meaning: Chen Yu wanted to put on the music, but I asked for two more tries. He waited beside me as I said the last line clearly. I realised I'd been reversing two words.

text: 我们商量好明天一起上台。我唱第一句，他接第二句。音乐响起来，他向我点头，我这次就跟上了。
pinyin: wǒ men shāng liáng hǎo míng tiān yì qǐ shàng tái . wǒ chàng dì yī jù , tā jiē dì èr jù . yīn yuè xiǎng qǐ lái , tā xiàng wǒ diǎn tóu , wǒ zhè cì jiù gēn shàng le .
meaning: We agreed how we'd sing together onstage. I'd sing the first line and he'd take the second. When the music began he nodded to me, and this time I kept up.

text: 练完以后，我说想先喝点水。他刚答应，就又放起音乐。我举着杯子看他，他也笑了，赶紧停下来。
pinyin: liàn wán yǐ hòu , wǒ shuō xiǎng xiān hē diǎn shuǐ . tā gāng dā yìng , jiù yòu fàng qǐ yīn yuè . wǒ jǔ zhe bēi zi kàn tā , tā yě xiào le , gǎn jǐn tíng xià lái .
meaning: After practice I asked for some water. He agreed, then started the music again. I looked at him over my cup; he laughed and quickly stopped it.

text: 晚上我把要穿的衣服放好，又给陈宇发消息，说明天门口见。他回了一句，记得带水。我说水会带，最后两句也会带。
pinyin: wǎn shang wǒ bǎ yào chuān de yī fú fàng hǎo , yòu gěi chén yǔ fā xiāo xī , shuō míng tiān mén kǒu jiàn . tā huí le yī jù , jì de dài shuǐ . wǒ shuō shuǐ huì dài , zuì hòu liǎng jù yě huì dài .
meaning: That evening I laid out my clothes and messaged Chen Yu about meeting at the entrance tomorrow. He reminded me to bring water. I'd bring water, I said, and the final two lines too.

text: 周六去河边的事，还去吗？
pinyin: zhōu liù qù hé biān de shì , hái qù ma ?
meaning: Are we still going to the river on Saturday?

text: 想去。不过天气预报说下午有雨。
pinyin: xiǎng qù . bù guò tiān qì yù bào shuō xià wǔ yǒu yǔ .
meaning: I'd like to, but the forecast says rain in the afternoon.

text: 那我们早上去？大概九点出门。
pinyin: nà wǒ men zǎo shàng qù ? dà gài jiǔ diǎn chū mén .
meaning: Shall we go in the morning? Leave around nine.

text: 那下午在我家见吧，要是没下雨，再出去。
pinyin: nà xià wǔ zài wǒ jiā jiàn ba , yào shì méi xià yǔ , zài chū qù .
meaning: Come to mine in the afternoon, then. If it doesn't rain, we can go out.

text: 好，几点到？
pinyin: hǎo , jǐ diǎn dào ?
meaning: Okay. What time should I arrive?

text: 两点左右。你不用带吃的，我来做。
pinyin: liǎng diǎn zuǒ yòu . nǐ bù yòng dài chī de , wǒ lái zuò .
meaning: Around two. No need to bring food; I'll cook.

text: 我带点茶吧，家里还有一盒。
pinyin: wǒ dài diǎn chá ba , jiā lǐ hái yǒu yī hé .
meaning: I'll bring some tea. I have a box at home.

text: 行。路上大约要多久？
pinyin: xíng . lù shàng dà yuē yào duō jiǔ ?
meaning: Sure. How long does the journey take?

text: 二十分钟左右，下课以后我先回家拿茶。
pinyin: èr shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu , xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ xiān huí jiā ná chá .
meaning: About twenty minutes. I'll go home for the tea after class.

text: 那我两点以前把饭做好。
pinyin: nà wǒ liǎng diǎn yǐ qián bǎ fàn zuò hǎo .

text: 好。希望下午有太阳，吃完还想出去走走。
pinyin: hǎo . xī wàng xià wǔ yǒu tài yáng , chī wán hái xiǎng chū qù zǒu zǒu .

text: 我和陈宇本来想周六去河边，天气预报却说下午有雨。我提议早上去，他上午要上课，不能早点出门。

meaning: Chen Yu and I had planned a riverside trip on Saturday, but the forecast said afternoon rain. I suggested the morning; he had class and couldn't leave early.

text: 我们就改成下午在我家见。他两点左右到，带一盒茶，我来做饭。要是没下雨，吃完还可以去河边。
pinyin: wǒ men jiù gǎi chéng xià wǔ zài wǒ jiā jiàn . tā liǎng diǎn zuǒ yòu dào , dài yī hé chá , wǒ lái zuò fàn . yào shì méi xià yǔ , chī wán hái kě yǐ qù hé biān .
meaning: We switched to meeting at my home in the afternoon. He'd come around two with tea, and I'd cook. If it didn't rain, we could still walk to the river afterwards.

text: 周六一点半，陈宇发消息，说已经回家拿了茶，预计二十分钟以后到。我把汤放在小火上，等他过来。
pinyin: zhōu liù yī diǎn bàn , chén yǔ fā xiāo xī , shuō yǐ jīng huí jiā ná le chá , yù jì èr shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu dào . wǒ bǎ tāng fàng zài xiǎo huǒ shàng , děng tā guò lái .
meaning: At one thirty on Saturday Chen Yu messaged that he'd fetched the tea and expected to arrive twenty minutes later. I left the soup over low heat and waited.

text: 他进门时，外面刚下起雨。我们先吃饭，聊他今天的课。他说预习时没看懂的一段，老师用一张图讲清楚了。
pinyin: tā jìn mén shí , wài miàn gāng xià qǐ yǔ . wǒ men xiān chī fàn , liáo tā jīn tiān de kè . tā shuō yù xí shí méi kàn dǒng de yī duàn , lǎo shī yòng yī zhāng tú jiǎng qīng chǔ le .
meaning: It began raining just as he came in. Over lunch we talked about his class. He said the teacher used a diagram to explain a passage he hadn't understood while preparing.

text: 三点多，雨停了，窗外亮起来。陈宇拿起外套，问我现在还想不想走。我说当然想，碗先放着，回来再洗。

meaning: After three the rain stopped and it brightened outside. Chen Yu picked up his coat and asked if I still wanted a walk. Of course; we'd leave the dishes and wash them when we returned.

text: 走到河边，我们发现路上还有不少水。我庆幸今天穿了旧鞋，陈宇却一直低头看他的白鞋，说下次一定穿黑的。

text: 你的白鞋还好吗？

meaning: Are your white shoes okay?

text: 刚才还是白的。
pinyin: gāng cái hái shi bái de .
meaning: They were white a moment ago.

text: 现在大概有三种颜色。
pinyin: xiàn zài dà gài yǒu sān zhǒng yán sè .
meaning: Now there are probably three colours.

text: 回去洗洗吧。
pinyin: huí qù xǐ xǐ ba .
meaning: Wash them when we get back.

text: 下次我穿黑的，比较保险。
pinyin: xià cì wǒ chuān hēi de , bǐ jiào bǎo xiǎn .
meaning: I'll wear black ones next time. A safer bet.

text: 你的白鞋还好吗？刚才还是白的。现在呢？现在大概有三种颜色。回去洗洗吧。下次我穿黑的，比较保险。
pinyin: nǐ de bái xié hái hǎo ma ? gāng cái hái shi bái de . xiàn zài ne ? xiàn zài dà gài yǒu sān zhǒng yán sè . huí qù xǐ xǐ ba . xià cì wǒ chuān hēi de , bǐ jiào bǎo xiǎn .
meaning: Are your white shoes okay? They were white a moment ago. And now? Now there are probably three colours. Wash them when we get back. I'll wear black ones next time. A safer bet.

text: 我大概读了二十页。
pinyin: wǒ dà gài dú le èr shí yè .
meaning: I've read roughly twenty pages.

text: 恐怕要下雨，带把伞吧。
pinyin: kǒng pà yào xià yǔ , dài bǎ sǎn ba .
meaning: It looks like rain. Take an umbrella.

text: 房间里大约有十个人。
pinyin: fáng jiān lǐ dà yuē yǒu shí gè rén .
meaning: There are about ten people in the room.

text: 希望这次别再下雨了。
pinyin: xī wàng zhè cì bié zài xià yǔ le .
meaning: I hope it doesn't rain again this time.

text: 生日时你许了什么愿望？
pinyin: shēng rì shí nǐ xǔ le shén me yuàn wàng ?
meaning: What wish did you make on your birthday?

text: 这本书将来可能还会用到。
pinyin: zhè běn shū jiāng lái kě néng hái huì yòng dào .
meaning: This book might come in useful later.

text: 你决定点什么菜了吗？
pinyin: nǐ jué dìng diǎn shén me cài le ma ?
meaning: Have you decided what to order?

text: 这个时间不适合打电话。
pinyin: zhè gè shí jiān bù shì hé dǎ diàn huà .
meaning: This isn't a good time to call.

text: 这是我搬家的主要理由。
pinyin: zhè shì wǒ bān jiā de zhǔ yào lǐ yóu .
meaning: That's my main reason for moving.

text: 手机没电了，我不得不借他的。
pinyin: shǒu jī méi diàn le , wǒ bù dé bù jiè tā de .
meaning: My phone ran out of power, so I had to borrow his.

text: 你不必等我，先进去吧。
pinyin: nǐ bù bì děng wǒ , xiān jìn qù ba .
meaning: You don't need to wait for me. Go in first.

text: 刚搬来时，她觉得不安。
pinyin: gāng bān lái shí , tā jué de bù ān .
meaning: She felt uneasy when she first moved here.

text: 我们得先了解可能的风险。
pinyin: wǒ men děi xiān liǎo jiě kě néng de fēng xiǎn .
meaning: We need to understand the possible risks first.

text: 旅行前，我买了保险。
pinyin: lǚ xíng qián , wǒ mǎi le bǎo xiǎn .
meaning: I bought insurance before travelling.

text: 这次旅行出了一个小意外，车坏了。
pinyin: zhè cì lǚ xíng chū le yī gè xiǎo yì wài , chē huài le .
meaning: There was a small mishap on this trip: the car broke down.

text: 这项工作预计需要三天。
pinyin: zhè xiàng gōng zuò yù jì xū yào sān tiān .
meaning: This job is expected to take three days.

text: 今晚的天气预报我还没看。
pinyin: jīn wǎn de tiān qì yù bào wǒ hái méi kàn .
meaning: I haven't seen tonight's weather forecast yet.

text: 你预习的时候，看懂这段了吗？
pinyin: nǐ yù xí de shí hou , kàn dǒng zhè duàn le ma ?
meaning: Did you understand this passage when preparing for class?

text: 信中说他仍住在老地方。
pinyin: xìn zhōng shuō tā réng zhù zài lǎo dì fāng .
meaning: The letter says he still lives at the old address.

text: 过了十年，我仍然记得那首歌。
pinyin: guò le shí nián , wǒ réng rán jì de nà shǒu gē .
meaning: Ten years later, I still remember that song.

text: 老师用一张图解释这个概念。
pinyin: lǎo shī yòng yī zhāng tú jiě shì zhè gè gài niàn .
meaning: The teacher explained the concept with a diagram.

text: 搬到这里以后，我的观念慢慢变了。
pinyin: bān dào zhè lǐ yǐ hòu , wǒ de guān niàn màn màn biàn le .
meaning: My outlook gradually changed after moving here.

text: 他大概六点到。我大概读了二十页。今天恐怕来不及了。恐怕要下雨，带把伞吧。走过去大约十分钟。房间里大约有十个人。我希望明天能见到你。希望这次别再下雨了。去海边是她今年的愿望。生日时你许了什么愿望？将来我想住在海边。这本书将来可能还会用到。我们决定周日出发。你决定点什么菜了吗？这双鞋很适合走路。这个时间不适合打电话。你不想去，总有个理由吧。这是我搬家的主要理由。下雨了，我们不得不回家。手机没电了，我不得不借他的。不必带饭，家里有吃的。你不必等我，先进去吧。一直没收到消息，我有点不安。刚搬来时，她觉得不安。这种投资的风险很高。我们得先了解可能的风险。早点出门比较保险。旅行前，我买了保险。见到你，我有点意外。这次旅行出了一个小意外，车坏了。我们预计八点到家。这项工作预计需要三天。天气预报说下午有雨。今晚的天气预报我还没看。我先预习明天的课。你预习的时候，看懂这段了吗？通知上写着原票仍有效。信中说他仍住在老地方。下雨了，他们仍然在等。过了十年，我仍然记得那首歌。我对这个概念还不太清楚。老师用一张图解释这个概念。她的生活观念和我不同。搬到这里以后，我的观念慢慢变了。

meaning: He'll probably arrive at six. I've read roughly twenty pages. I'm afraid we won't have time today. It looks like rain. Take an umbrella. It's about a ten-minute walk. There are about ten people in the room. I hope I can see you tomorrow. I hope it doesn't rain again this time. Going to the seaside is her wish for this year. What wish did you make on your birthday? The letter says he still lives at the old address. It's raining, but they're still waiting. Ten years later, I still remember that song. I'm not yet clear about this concept. text: 你怎么站在门外？活动还没开始吧？
pinyin: nǐ zěn me zhàn zài mén wài ? huó dòng hái méi kāi shǐ ba ?
meaning: Why are you outside? The event hasn't started yet, has it?

text: 我收到一张图，说今天取消了。
pinyin: wǒ shōu dào yī zhāng tú , shuō jīn tiān qǔ xiāo le .
meaning: Someone sent me an image saying it was cancelled today.

text: 让我看看。这上面是上个月的日期。
pinyin: ràng wǒ kàn kàn . zhè shàng miàn shì shàng gè yuè de rì qī .
meaning: Let me see. That's last month's date.

text: 啊，我白跑一趟了？
pinyin: a , wǒ bái pǎo yī tàng le ?
meaning: Oh, have I come all this way for nothing?

text: 不是，今天并没有取消，只是换到二楼。
pinyin: bù shì , jīn tiān bìng méi yǒu qǔ xiāo , zhǐ shì huàn dào èr lóu .
meaning: No. It hasn't been cancelled today; it's moved upstairs.

text: 你怎么知道？
pinyin: nǐ zěn me zhī dào ?
meaning: How do you know?

text: 我刚问了门口的工作人员，新通知也贴在这儿。
pinyin: wǒ gāng wèn le mén kǒu de gōng zuò rén yuán , xīn tōng zhī yě tiē zài zhèr .
meaning: I just asked the staff member by the door. The new notice is here too.

text: 果然，写着二楼。那赶紧上去吧。
pinyin: guǒ rán , xiě zhe èr lóu . nà gǎn jǐn shàng qù ba .
meaning: You're right: it says the second floor. Let's go up quickly.

text: 时间没变，七点开始，还早。
pinyin: shí jiān méi biàn , qī diǎn kāi shǐ , hái zǎo .
meaning: The time hasn't changed. It starts at seven. We've time.

text: 千万别告诉大家我看错日期。
pinyin: qiān wàn bié gào sù dà jiā wǒ kàn cuò rì qī .
meaning: Please don't tell everyone I got the date wrong.

text: 我不说，你下次先把图放大。
pinyin: wǒ bù shuō , nǐ xià cì xiān bǎ tú fàng dà .
meaning: I won't. Zoom in on the image first next time.

text: 好。我刚才根本没看下面那一行。
pinyin: hǎo . wǒ gāng cái gēn běn méi kàn xià miàn nà yī xíng .
meaning: Okay. I didn't look at the bottom line at all.

text: 我六点半到活动室门口，看见陈宇站在外面。他拿着手机，说今天的活动取消了，我差点也跟着往回走。
pinyin: wǒ liù diǎn bàn dào huó dòng shì mén kǒu , kàn jiàn chén yǔ zhàn zài wài miàn . tā ná zhuó shǒu jī , shuō jīn tiān de huó dòng qǔ xiāo le , wǒ chà diǎn yě gēn zhe wǎng huí zǒu .
meaning: I arrived at the activity room at six thirty and found Chen Yu outside with his phone. He said the event was cancelled. I almost headed home with him.

text: 他把图片给我看，我注意到下面有日期，是上个月的。我把图放大，他终于看清楚，问今天是不是仍然在这里。
pinyin: tā bǎ tú piàn gěi wǒ kàn , wǒ zhù yì dào xià miàn yǒu rì qī , shì shàng gè yuè de . wǒ bǎ tú fàng dà , tā zhōng yú kàn qīng chǔ , wèn jīn tiān shì bú shì réng rán zài zhè lǐ .
meaning: He showed me the image. The date at the bottom was from last month. I zoomed in, and he finally saw it and asked whether today's event was still here.

text: 门口的工作人员告诉我们，今天换到二楼，时间没变，仍是七点开始。旁边贴着一张新通知，上面也写得清楚。
pinyin: mén kǒu de gōng zuò rén yuán gào sù wǒ men , jīn tiān huàn dào èr lóu , shí jiān méi biàn , réng shì qī diǎn kāi shǐ . páng biān tiē zhe yī zhāng xīn tōng zhī , shàng miàn yě xiě de qīng chǔ .
meaning: The staff member said today's event had moved to the second floor, still starting at seven. The new notice beside the door said the same.

text: 陈宇把新通知拍下来，发给同来的两个朋友。一个朋友已经快到了，说幸好看到消息，刚才也准备回家。
pinyin: chén yǔ bǎ xīn tōng zhī pāi xià lái , fā gěi tóng lái de liǎng gè péng you . yī gè péng you yǐ jīng kuài dào le , shuō xìng hǎo kàn dào xiāo xī , gāng cái yě zhǔn bèi huí jiā .
meaning: Chen Yu photographed the new notice and sent it to two friends coming along. One was nearly there and was glad of the message: they'd been about to go home too.

text: 我们先上楼，找了四个连在一起的位子。两位朋友过来坐下，一个笑着问陈宇，是不是上个月就来过。

meaning: We went upstairs and found four seats together. When the friends sat down, one jokingly asked Chen Yu whether he'd come last month already.

meaning: That evening I chose three travel photos and prepared a few sentences for each: a station, a mountain view, and us finding our way in the rain.

text: 第二天九点，我们在门口集中。陈宇让大家按名单签名，再拿自己的名字卡。他看见我的照片，说那张雨里的应该放在最后。
pinyin: dì èr tiān jiǔ diǎn , wǒ men zài mén kǒu jí zhōng . chén yǔ ràng dà jiā àn míng dān qiān míng , zài ná zì jǐ de míng zi kǎ . tā kàn jiàn wǒ de zhào piān , shuō nà zhāng yǔ lǐ de yīng gāi fàng zài zuì hòu .
meaning: At nine the next day we gathered at the entrance. Chen Yu asked us to sign in following the list and collect our name cards. Seeing my photos, he suggested putting the rainy one last.

text: 进房间以后，小周先介绍今天的安排。每组代表发言两分钟，其他人可以提问，之后大家再自由聊天。

text: 轮到我时，我先讲车站和山，最后放出雨里的照片。有人问是不是迷路了，我说是，最后是一位路过的奶奶带我们找到车站。
pinyin: lún dào wǒ shí , wǒ xiān jiǎng chē zhàn hé shān , zuì hòu fàng chū yǔ lǐ de zhào piān . yǒu rén wèn shì bú shì mí lù le , wǒ shuō shì , zuì hòu shì yī wèi lù guò de nǎi nai dài wǒ men zhǎo dào chē zhàn .

text: 活动结束，小周来问那张照片还有没有。我发给她，她说下次出门一定带地图。我说地图我们带了，下次要记得打开。

text: 你在哪儿？我把箱子搬到哪儿？
pinyin: nǐ zài nǎr ? wǒ bǎ xiāng zi bān dào nǎr ?
meaning: Where are you? Where should I bring the box?

text: 我在一楼门口，朝这边走。
pinyin: wǒ zài yī lóu mén kǒu , cháo zhè biān zǒu .
meaning: At the entrance on the ground floor. Come this way.

text: 大的还是小的？
pinyin: dà de hái shi xiǎo de ?
meaning: The big one or the small one?

text: 先搬小的，里面是安装工具。
pinyin: xiān bān xiǎo de , lǐ miàn shì ān zhuāng gōng jù .
meaning: Bring the small one first. It has the assembly tools inside.

text: 大的里面都是书，确实有点重。
pinyin: dà de lǐ miàn dōu shì shū , què shí yǒu diǎn zhòng .
meaning: The big one's full of books. It really is heavy.

text: 放着吧，等我一起搬。先帮我推开门。
pinyin: fàng zhe ba , děng wǒ yì qǐ bān . xiān bāng wǒ tuī kāi mén .
meaning: Leave it for now; we'll carry it together. Push the door open for me first.

text: 好。工具拿进去以后，我上去吗？
pinyin: hǎo . gōng jù ná jìn qù yǐ hòu , wǒ shàng qù ma ?
meaning: Okay. After taking the tools inside, should I go upstairs?

text: 先在一楼等，桌子装好再把书搬上去。
pinyin: xiān zài yī lóu děng , zhuō zi zhuāng hǎo zài bǎ shū bān shàng qù .
meaning: Wait on the ground floor first. We'll carry the books up when the desk is assembled.

text: 那我把小箱子放在门边那张旧桌子底下。
pinyin: nà wǒ bǎ xiǎo xiāng zi fàng zài mén biān nà zhāng jiù zhuō zi dǐ xià .
meaning: I'll put the small box under the old table by the entrance, then.

text: 行，别放在门后面，开门会碰到。
pinyin: xíng , bié fàng zài mén hòu miàn , kāi mén huì pèng dào .
meaning: Okay. Don't put it behind the door; the door will hit it.

text: 知道了。你背上那个包要放下来吗？
pinyin: zhī dào le . nǐ bèi shàng nà gè bāo yào fàng xià lái ma ?
meaning: Got it. Do you want to put down the bag on your back?

text: 当然，先帮我拿一下，我还没找到拉链。
pinyin: dāng rán , xiān bāng wǒ ná yī xià , wǒ hái méi zhǎo dào lā liàn .
meaning: Yes. Hold it for a moment; I haven't found the zip yet.

meaning: Lin An was moving today and I went to help. She stood by the ground-floor entrance with a big backpack, waving me over and asking me to take the small box first.

text: 小箱子里面是安装工具，大箱子里面都是书。我把工具拿进去，放在门边的旧桌子底下。书太重，等她放下包，我们再一起搬。
pinyin: xiǎo xiāng zi lǐ miàn shì ān zhuāng gōng jù , dà xiāng zi lǐ miàn dōu shì shū . wǒ bǎ gōng jù ná jìn qù , fàng zài mén biān de jiù zhuō zi dǐ xià . shū tài zhòng , děng tā fàng xià bāo , wǒ men zài yì qǐ bān .
meaning: The small box held assembly tools; the big one held books. I took the tools inside and put them under the old table by the entrance. The books were heavy, so we'd carry them together after she put down her bag.

text: 林安把门推开，我看见里面还有两件新家具。一张木头桌子还没装好，旁边放着椅子。她说桌子是准备搬到二楼的。
pinyin: lín ān bǎ mén tuī kāi , wǒ kàn jiàn lǐ miàn hái yǒu liǎng jiàn xīn jiā jù . yī zhāng mù tou zhuō zi hái méi zhuāng hǎo , páng biān fàng zhe yǐ zi . tā shuō zhuō zi shì zhǔn bèi bān dào èr lóu de .
meaning: Lin An pushed the door open. Inside were two new pieces of furniture: an unassembled wooden desk and a chair beside it. She said the desk was going upstairs.

text: 我们先把桌子装好，再一起抬上去。到了二楼，她把桌子放在朝南的窗边，我问书是不是也放这里，她说放在旁边的书架上。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān bǎ zhuō zi zhuāng hǎo , zài yì qǐ tái shàng qù . dào le èr lóu , tā bǎ zhuō zi fàng zài cháo nán de chuāng biān , wǒ wèn shū shì bú shì yě fàng zhè lǐ , tā shuō fàng zài páng biān de shū jià shàng .
meaning: We assembled the desk and carried it up together. Upstairs she put it by the south-facing window. I asked about the books; they'd go on the bookshelf beside it.

text: 我下去拿书，她在楼上等。我拿了几本上来，放进书架，大箱子剩下的书就分几次拿，不再整箱搬。
pinyin: wǒ xià qù ná shū , tā zài lóu shàng děng . wǒ ná le jǐ běn shàng lái , fàng jìn shū jià , dà xiāng zi shèng xià de shū jiù fēn jǐ cì ná , bù zài zhěng xiāng bān .
meaning: I went down for the books while she waited upstairs. I brought up a few and put them on the shelf. We made several trips for the rest rather than moving the whole box.

text: 全部放好以后，林安请我坐下喝水。我说椅子终于能用了，她笑着说今天最有用的家具，果然还是椅子。

meaning: When everything was in place Lin An offered me a seat and water. Finally a use for the chair, I said. She laughed that it really was today's most useful piece of furniture.

我下去拿书，她在楼上等。我拿了几本上来，放进书架，大箱子剩下的书就分几次拿，不再整箱搬。
全部放好以后，林安请我坐下喝水。我说椅子终于能用了，她笑着说今天最有用的家具，果然还是椅子。

text: 今天最有用的家具是什么？

text: 椅子，我已经走不动了。

text: 桌子也装好了。
pinyin: zhuō zi yě zhuāng hǎo le .

text: 桌子给书坐，我坐椅子。
pinyin: zhuō zi gěi shū zuò , wǒ zuò yǐ zi .

text: 好，水放你前面。
pinyin: hǎo , shuǐ fàng nǐ qián miàn .

text: 谢谢，今天不想再把它搬来搬去了。
pinyin: xiè xiè , jīn tiān bù xiǎng zài bǎ tā bān lái bān qù le .
meaning: Thanks. I don't want to keep carrying it around today.

text: 小时候，爸爸常背我回家。

text: 她从我背后走过来。

text: 椅子底下有一只猫。

text: 你先进去，我在里面等。
pinyin: nǐ xiān jìn qù , wǒ zài lǐ miàn děng .

text: 我把自行车放在外面。

text: 书上面还有一张纸。
pinyin: shū shàng miàn hái yǒu yī zhāng zhǐ .

text: 下面还有两个房间。
pinyin: xià miàn hái yǒu liǎng gè fáng jiān .
meaning: There are two more rooms downstairs.

text: 坐在前面的人是我姐姐。
pinyin: zuò zài qián miàn de rén shì wǒ jiě jie .
meaning: The person sitting in front is my sister.

text: 把这把椅子放在后面吧。
pinyin: bǎ zhè bǎ yǐ zi fàng zài hòu miàn ba .

text: 上来以后，先把包放下。
pinyin: shàng lái yǐ hòu , xiān bǎ bāo fàng xià .

text: 他从楼上下来了。
pinyin: tā cóng lóu shàng xià lái le .

text: 她带着空箱子下去了。
pinyin: tā dài zhe kōng xiāng zi xià qù le .

text: 运输过程中，箱子没有打开。

text: 这张桌子还没安装好。

text: 我们周末去买家具。

text: 工具放在小箱子里。

text: 门口放着两块木头。

text: 他轻轻推开窗户。

text: 那我们去河边的小店吧，里面人少。

text: 今天我和陈宇约好去听演出，出门以前却觉得累。我给他发消息，说想找一个安静的地方坐坐，他提议去河边的小店。

meaning: Chen Yu and I had planned to see a performance today, but I felt tired before leaving. I messaged that I'd like somewhere quiet to sit; he suggested the little shop by the river.

text: 我怕他失望，问要不要他先去看演出。他说今天主要是想和我见面，演出下次也能听。我看到这句话，心里轻松了一点。

meaning: Worried he'd be disappointed, I asked if he'd like to go to the show first. He said he mainly wanted to see me today; the show could wait. Reading that made me feel more relaxed.

text: 到店里以后，我找了窗边的两把椅子。陈宇过来时带了一本薄书，说以前在那里读过，想给我看看。

text: 今天我和陈宇约好去听演出，出门以前却觉得累。我给他发消息，说想找一个安静的地方坐坐，他提议去河边的小店。我怕他失望，问要不要他先去看演出。他说今天主要是想和我见面，演出下次也能听。我看到这句话，心里轻松了一点。到店里以后，我找了窗边的两把椅子。陈宇过来时带了一本薄书，说以前在那里读过，想给我看看。我们点了茶，他翻到里面的一张照片。照片里是一条我小时候走过的路，我指给他看。他说去年也去过那里，我们就聊起那条路旁边的小店。聊了一会儿，我不那么累了。他问还想不想去听歌，我说今天就坐在这里吧。这本书还没看完，茶也很好喝。傍晚我们一起走到车站。他说下次还坐窗边，我说好，不过这次的书先借我。他把书递来，说椅子不能借，书可以。
pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ hé chén yǔ yuē hǎo qù tīng yǎn chū , chū mén yǐ qián què jué de lèi . wǒ gěi tā fā xiāo xī , shuō xiǎng zhǎo yī gè ān jìng de dì fāng zuò zuò , tā tí yì qù hé biān de xiǎo diàn . wǒ pà tā shī wàng , wèn yào bù yào tā xiān qù kàn yǎn chū . tā shuō jīn tiān zhǔ yào shì xiǎng hé wǒ jiàn miàn , yǎn chū xià cì yě néng tīng . wǒ kàn dào zhè jù huà , xīn lǐ qīng sōng le yī diǎn . dào diàn lǐ yǐ hòu , wǒ zhǎo le chuāng biān de liǎng bǎ yǐ zi . chén yǔ guò lái shí dài le yī běn báo shū , shuō yǐ qián zài nà lǐ dú guò , xiǎng gěi wǒ kàn kàn . wǒ men diǎn le chá , tā fān dào lǐ miàn de yī zhāng zhào piān . zhào piān lǐ shì yī tiáo wǒ xiǎo shí hòu zǒu guò de lù , wǒ zhǐ gěi tā kàn . tā shuō qù nián yě qù guò nà lǐ , wǒ men jiù liáo qǐ nà tiáo lù páng biān de xiǎo diàn . liáo le yī huì er , wǒ bù nà me lèi le . tā wèn hái xiǎng bù xiǎng qù tīng gē , wǒ shuō jīn tiān jiù zuò zài zhè lǐ ba . zhè běn shū hái méi kàn wán , chá yě hěn hǎo hē . bàng wǎn wǒ men yì qǐ zǒu dào chē zhàn . tā shuō xià cì hái zuò chuāng biān , wǒ shuō hǎo , bù guò zhè cì de shū xiān jiè wǒ . tā bǎ shū dì lái , shuō yǐ zi bù néng jiè , shū kě yǐ .
meaning: Chen Yu and I had planned to see a performance today, but I felt tired before leaving. I messaged that I'd like somewhere quiet to sit; he suggested the little shop by the river. Worried he'd be disappointed, I asked if he'd like to go to the show first. He said he mainly wanted to see me today; the show could wait. Reading that made me feel more relaxed. At the shop I found two chairs by the window. Chen Yu arrived with a slim book he'd read there before and wanted to show me. We ordered tea. He turned to a photo of a road I'd walked along as a child. I pointed it out. He said he'd been there last year too, and we talked about the little shops beside that road. text: 对，周日下午她常听。你可以向她请教，她知道好多故事。
pinyin: duì , zhōu rì xià wǔ tā cháng tīng . nǐ kě yǐ xiàng tā qǐng jiào , tā zhī dào hǎo duō gù shì .

text: 我怕听不懂，她会不会笑我？

text: 不会。我也常问，她每次都讲得很高兴。

text: 好，那我带橙子，也带上问题。

text: 问题不用装袋子，橙子要。

text: 放心，橙子我会装好。

text: 周日陈宇请我去家里做客，我三点到，带了一袋橙子。奶奶在客厅听京剧，见我进来，就把声音调小，招呼我坐下。
pinyin: zhōu rì chén yǔ qǐng wǒ qù jiā lǐ zuò kè , wǒ sān diǎn dào , dài le yī dài chéng zi . nǎi nai zài kè tīng tīng jīng jù , jiàn wǒ jìn lái , jiù bǎ shēng yīn diào xiǎo , zhāo hū wǒ zuò xià .
meaning: Chen Yu invited me over on Sunday. I arrived at three with oranges. Grandma was listening to Peking opera in the living room; she turned it down when I came in and welcomed me.

text: 我问奶奶，这段讲的是什么。她指着屏幕，先介绍两个角色，再讲他们为什么在这里见面。我听懂以后，再看就有意思多了。
pinyin: wǒ wèn nǎi nai , zhè duàn jiǎng de shì shén me . tā zhǐ zhe píng mù , xiān jiè shào liǎng gè jué sè , zài jiǎng tā men wèi shén me zài zhè lǐ jiàn miàn . wǒ tīng dǒng yǐ hòu , zài kàn jiù yǒu yì si duō le .
meaning: I asked Grandma what this scene was about. Pointing to the screen, she introduced the two characters and explained why they were meeting here. Understanding that made it much more interesting.

text: 陈宇端来茶，说他小时候也像我一样，总问同一个问题。奶奶说他那时更爱问，问完还要跟着唱两句。
pinyin: chén yǔ duān lái chá , shuō tā xiǎo shí hòu yě xiàng wǒ yī yàng , zǒng wèn tóng yī gè wèn tí . nǎi nai shuō tā nà shí gèng ài wèn , wèn wán hái yào gēn zhe chàng liǎng jù .
meaning: Chen Yu brought tea and said he'd asked the same questions as a child. Grandma said he'd asked even more, then tried singing a couple of lines himself.

text: 我们聊到附近的公园。奶奶说国庆的时候，那里有京剧和武术表演，陈宇去年陪她看过。我说今年也想去，他们就让我到时一起。
pinyin: wǒ men liáo dào fù jìn de gōng yuán . nǎi nai shuō guó qìng de shí hou , nà lǐ yǒu jīng jù hé wǔ shù biǎo yǎn , chén yǔ qù nián péi tā kàn guò . wǒ shuō jīn nián yě xiǎng qù , tā men jiù ràng wǒ dào shí yì qǐ .
meaning: We talked about the nearby park. Grandma said it had Peking opera and martial arts performances over National Day. Chen Yu had gone with her last year. I'd like to go this year too, so they invited me along.

text: 晚饭前，我帮陈宇把碗放好。他让奶奶再说一段，我才发现她不看屏幕，也记得那些人物的名字和话。
pinyin: wǎn fàn qián , wǒ bāng chén yǔ bǎ wǎn fàng hǎo . tā ràng nǎi nai zài shuō yī duàn , wǒ cái fā xiàn tā bù kàn píng mù , yě jì de nà xiē rén wù de míng zi hé huà .
meaning: Before dinner I helped Chen Yu set out bowls. He asked Grandma to tell us another part. I realised she knew the characters' names and lines without looking at the screen.

text: 回家时，她塞给我两个橙子，说路上带着。我说本来是送给她的，她笑着说吃了一下午，还想让我明天也尝尝。
pinyin: huí jiā shí , tā sāi gěi wǒ liǎng gè chéng zi , shuō lù shàng dài zhe . wǒ shuō běn lái shì sòng gěi tā de , tā xiào zhe shuō chī le yī xià wǔ , hái xiǎng ràng wǒ míng tiān yě cháng cháng .
meaning: When I left she gave me two oranges to take. I'd brought them for her, I said. She laughed that she'd had some all afternoon and wanted me to enjoy them tomorrow too.

text: 你小时候也跟着唱？

text: 现在来一句？

text: 先吃饭，唱完饭可能凉了。

text: 那明年国庆再听？

text: 别急，饭吃完再说。

text: 这本书介绍了不同地方的文化。

text: 当地的华人朋友邀请我们吃饭。

text: 他在课上读了一篇关于中华民族的文章。

text: 第一次去她家做客，我带了一盒茶。

text: 这个书架上都是文学作品。

text: 学校有一个美术社团。

text: 我到门口了，怎么没看见你？
pinyin: wǒ dào mén kǒu le , zěn me méi kàn jiàn nǐ ?
meaning: I'm at the entrance. Why can't I see you?

text: 你在哪个门？我在东门。
pinyin: nǐ zài nǎ gè mén ? wǒ zài dōng mén .
meaning: Which entrance? I'm at the east gate.

text: 你发的地址写西门，我在西门啊。
pinyin: nǐ fā de dì zhǐ xiě xī mén , wǒ zài xī mén a .
meaning: The address you sent says west gate. That's where I am.

text: 对不起，我发了上次的地址，忘了改。
pinyin: duì bù qǐ , wǒ fā le shàng cì de dì zhǐ , wàng le gǎi .
meaning: Sorry. I sent the previous address and forgot to change it.

text: 那我还要走多久？
pinyin: nà wǒ hái yào zǒu duō jiǔ ?
meaning: How much farther do I have to walk?

text: 大约十分钟。我过去接你吧。
pinyin: dà yuē shí fēn zhōng . wǒ guò qù jiē nǐ ba .
meaning: About ten minutes. I'll come and meet you.

text: 好，我在西门旁边的小店等。
pinyin: hǎo , wǒ zài xī mén páng biān de xiǎo diàn děng .
meaning: Okay. I'll wait at the little shop by the west gate.

text: 你先坐下，别在太阳底下等。
pinyin: nǐ xiān zuò xià , bié zài tài yáng dǐ xià děng .
meaning: Have a seat. Don't wait in the sun.

text: 行。我还以为今天没有活动。
pinyin: xíng . wǒ hái yǐ wéi jīn tiān méi yǒu huó dòng .
meaning: Okay. I thought there was no event today.

text: 有，是我发错了。新的地址已经发送给你。
pinyin: yǒu , shì wǒ fā cuò le . xīn de dì zhǐ yǐ jīng fā sòng gěi nǐ .
meaning: There is. My mistake. I've sent you the new address.

text: 收到了，这次也有门口的照片。
pinyin: shōu dào le , zhè cì yě yǒu mén kǒu de zhào piān .
meaning: Got it. There's a photo of the entrance too this time.

text: 对，我快到了，先给你买瓶水。
pinyin: duì , wǒ kuài dào le , xiān gěi nǐ mǎi píng shuǐ .
meaning: Yes. I'm almost there. I'll get you a bottle of water first.

meaning: It was about ten minutes to the east gate, under a strong sun. I asked the way. He told me to find a seat and he'd come over, so I waited by the little shop.

text: 他给我发送了新地址和门口照片，我放大照片一看，上面挂着今天活动的名字。这才知道刚才找不到的原因。

meaning: He sent the new address and a photo of the entrance, showing today's event name. That explained why I hadn't been able to find it earlier.

text: 陈宇过来时，手上拿着两瓶水。他又说对不起，我说没事，先喝一口再走。他把另一瓶给我，带我从旁边的小路过去。

meaning: Chen Yu arrived with two bottles of water and apologised again. It was okay, I said; let's have a drink before walking. He handed me a bottle and led me along the little path.

text: 到东门以后，我们看见几个朋友也刚到。陈宇把新地址和照片一起发到群里，又问有没有人已经去了西门。

meaning: At the east gate some friends were arriving too. Chen Yu sent the new address and photo to the group and asked if anyone else had gone to the west gate.

text: 只有我走错了，大家都笑着说我替他们看过另一边。我说下次就让我发地址，陈宇说好，不过今天先进去，第一首歌已经开始了。

陈宇过来时，手上拿着两瓶水。他又说对不起，我说没事，先喝一口再走。他把另一瓶给我，带我从旁边的小路过去。
到东门以后，我们看见几个朋友也刚到。陈宇把新地址和照片一起发到群里，又问有没有人已经去了西门。
只有我走错了，大家都笑着说我替他们看过另一边。我说下次就让我发地址，陈宇说好，不过今天先进去，第一首歌已经开始了。

text: 下次让我发地址。
pinyin: xià cì ràng wǒ fā dì zhǐ .
meaning: Let me send the address next time.

text: 好，你已经认识两个门了。
pinyin: hǎo , nǐ yǐ jīng rèn shi liǎng gè mén le .
meaning: Okay. You know both gates now.

text: 多认识一个门，多走十分钟。
pinyin: duō rèn shi yī gè mén , duō zǒu shí fēn zhōng .
meaning: One more gate, ten more minutes walking.

text: 我下次先带水。
pinyin: wǒ xià cì xiān dài shuǐ .
meaning: I'll bring water first next time.

text: 先发对地址，水我自己带。
pinyin: xiān fā duì dì zhǐ , shuǐ wǒ zì jǐ dài .
meaning: Send the right address first. I'll bring my own water.

text: 行，这次记住了。
pinyin: xíng , zhè cì jì zhù le .
meaning: Okay. I'll remember this time.

text: 新闻正在报道那起事件。

text: 那次事故以后，他开车更小心了。
pinyin: nà cì shì gù yǐ hòu , tā kāi chē gèng xiǎo xīn le .

text: 他没有想到这样做的后果。

meaning: He hadn't thought about the consequences.

text: 他反应很快，一下就接住了杯子。
pinyin: tā fǎn yìng hěn kuài , yī xià jiù jiē zhù le bēi zi .
meaning: He reacted quickly and caught the cup at once.

text: 你可以直接表达自己的想法。
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē biǎo dá zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ .

text: 学校发表了关于停课的声明。

text: 他们宣布了比赛结果。
pinyin: tā men xuān bù le bǐ sài jié guǒ .
meaning: They announced the competition results.

text: 发送之前，先看看地址对不对。
pinyin: fā sòng zhī qián , xiān kàn kàn dì zhǐ duì bú duì .

text: 这个洞还能补吗？

meaning: Can this hole still be mended?

text: 我想把房间里的设备完善一下。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ fáng jiān lǐ de shè bèi wán shàn yī xià .

text: 注意看第二行，日期在那里。

text: 这句话听起来有点奇怪。
pinyin: zhè jù huà tīng qǐ lái yǒu diǎn qí guài .

text: 看完电影，她还在伤心。
pinyin: kàn wán diàn yǐng , tā hái zài shāng xīn .
meaning: She's still upset after watching the film.

text: 这句话伤了她的心。
pinyin: zhè jù huà shāng le tā de xīn .
meaning: This sentence hurt her feelings.

text: 我不想失去这个朋友。
pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng shī qù zhè gè péng you .
meaning: I don't want to lose this friend.

text: 太阳消失在云里了。
pinyin: tài yáng xiāo shī zài yún lǐ le .

text: 我们一起工作多年，彼此很信任。
pinyin: wǒ men yì qǐ gōng zuò duō nián , bǐ cǐ hěn xìn rèn .
meaning: We've worked together for years and trust each other.

text: 你怎么对待新来的同学？
pinyin: nǐ zěn me duì dài xīn lái de tóng xué ?
meaning: How do you treat the new classmate?

text: 这件事和昨天的问题相关。

text: 小周生日，你准备送什么？
pinyin: xiǎo zhōu shēng rì , nǐ zhǔn bèi sòng shén me ?
meaning: What are you giving Xiao Zhou for her birthday?

text: 我做了一个布袋，她平时带书，可以用。
pinyin: wǒ zuò le yī gè bù dài , tā píng shí dài shū , kě yǐ yòng .
meaning: I made a cloth bag. She carries books, so it should be useful.

text: 你自己设计的？让我看看。
pinyin: nǐ zì jǐ shè jì de ? ràng wǒ kàn kàn .
meaning: You designed it yourself? Let me see.

text: 蓝色的布，里面加了一层，袋口有个扣子。
pinyin: lán sè de bù , lǐ miàn jiā le yī céng , dài kǒu yǒu gè kòu zi .
meaning: Blue cloth, with another layer inside and a button at the opening.

text: 金色扣子？不会真是金的吧？
pinyin: jīn sè kòu zi ? bù huì zhēn shì jīn de ba ?
meaning: A gold-coloured button? Don't tell me it's real gold?

text: 想得美，就是普通扣子，好看一点。
pinyin: xiǎng de měi , jiù shì pǔ tōng kòu zi , hǎo kàn yī diǎn .
meaning: You wish. It's an ordinary button. Just looks nice.

text: 那这张彩色卡也是你做的？
pinyin: nà zhè zhāng cǎi sè kǎ yě shì nǐ zuò de ?
meaning: Did you make this coloured card too?

text: 对，用了我们上次旅行的照片。她看见应该会笑。
pinyin: duì , yòng le wǒ men shàng cì lǚ xíng de zhào piān . tā kàn jiàn yīng gāi huì xiào .
meaning: Yes. With a photo from our last trip. It should make her laugh.

text: 哪张？不会是她拿着两杯茶那张吧？
pinyin: nǎ zhāng ? bù huì shì tā ná zhe liǎng bēi chá nà zhāng ba ?
meaning: Which one? Not the one where she's holding two cups of tea?

text: 就是那张，卡上写祝你每天都有好茶。
pinyin: jiù shì nà zhāng , kǎ shàng xiě zhù nǐ měi tiān dōu yǒu hǎo chá .
meaning: That's the one. The card wishes her good tea every day.

text: 那袋子是不是应该装茶，不装书？
pinyin: nà dài zi shì bú shì yīng gāi zhuāng chá , bù zhuāng shū ?
meaning: Should the bag hold tea rather than books, then?

text: 先装书吧，茶倒进去就不好洗了。
pinyin: xiān zhuāng shū ba , chá dào jìn qù jiù bù hǎo xǐ le .
meaning: Books first. Tea poured inside would be hard to wash out.

text: 袋口需要一个扣子，我去附近的小店买。银色和金色都有，我选了金色，付了五元现金，回家把它缝好。
pinyin: dài kǒu xū yào yī gè kòu zi , wǒ qù fù jìn de xiǎo diàn mǎi . yín sè hé jīn sè dōu yǒu , wǒ xuǎn le jīn sè , fù le wǔ yuán xiàn jīn , huí jiā bǎ tā fèng hǎo .
meaning: I needed a button for the opening and went to the nearby shop. It had silver-coloured and gold-coloured ones. I chose gold-coloured, paid five yuan in cash and sewed it on at home.

text: 陈宇来看袋子，问是不是我自己设计的。我说是，这个袋子只能手提，不过装书很方便。他把自己的书放进去，两本都装下了。
pinyin: chén yǔ lái kàn dài zi , wèn shì bú shì wǒ zì jǐ shè jì de . wǒ shuō shì , zhè gè dài zi zhǐ néng shǒu tí , bù guò zhuāng shū hěn fāng biàn . tā bǎ zì jǐ de shū fàng jìn qù , liǎng běn dōu zhuāng xià le .
meaning: Chen Yu came to see the bag and asked if I'd designed it. Yes; it could only be carried by hand, but was handy for books. He tried his books, and both fitted.

text: 我又做了一张彩色卡，用了上次旅行时小周拿着两杯茶的照片。为了让她想起那一天，我写了祝你每天都有好茶。
pinyin: wǒ yòu zuò le yī zhāng cǎi sè kǎ , yòng le shàng cì lǚ xíng shí xiǎo zhōu ná zhe liǎng bēi chá de zhào piān . wèi le ràng tā xiǎng qǐ nà yī tiān , wǒ xiě le zhù nǐ měi tiān dōu yǒu hǎo chá .
meaning: I made a coloured card with the travel photo of Xiao Zhou holding two cups of tea. To remind her of that day I wrote a wish for good tea every day.

text: 生日那天，她打开袋子，先看见卡，就笑了。她说那天明明是替陈宇拿茶，照片里却像两杯都是自己的。
pinyin: shēng rì nà tiān , tā dǎ kāi dài zi , xiān kàn jiàn kǎ , jiù xiào le . tā shuō nà tiān míng míng shì tì chén yǔ ná chá , zhào piān lǐ què xiàng liǎng bēi dōu shì zì jǐ de .
meaning: On her birthday she opened the bag, saw the card and laughed. She'd actually been holding Chen Yu's tea that day, but the photo made both cups look like hers.

text: 她把卡收进袋子，说这张要留作纪念，书也正好能放。我问扣子喜欢吗，她说喜欢，像袋口有一点小太阳。
pinyin: tā bǎ kǎ shōu jìn dài zi , shuō zhè zhāng yào liú zuò jì niàn , shū yě zhèng hǎo néng fàng . wǒ wèn kòu zi xǐ huān ma , tā shuō xǐ huān , xiàng dài kǒu yǒu yī diǎn xiǎo tài yáng .
meaning: She put the card into the bag, saying she'd keep it as a souvenir and her books would fit too. Did she like the button? Yes; it was like a little sun at the bag's opening.

text: 小周生日快到了，我想给她做一个能装书的布袋。家里有一块蓝色布，我先画了设计图，再把里面加上一层。袋口需要一个扣子，我去附近的小店买。银色和金色都有，我选了金色，付了五元现金，回家把它缝好。陈宇来看袋子，问是不是我自己设计的。我说是，这个袋子只能手提，不过装书很方便。他把自己的书放进去，两本都装下了。我又做了一张彩色卡，用了上次旅行时小周拿着两杯茶的照片。为了让她想起那一天，我写了祝你每天都有好茶。生日那天，她打开袋子，先看见卡，就笑了。她说那天明明是替陈宇拿茶，照片里却像两杯都是自己的。她把卡收进袋子，说这张要留作纪念，书也正好能放。我问扣子喜欢吗，她说喜欢，像袋口有一点小太阳。

text: 那两杯茶有一杯是你的。
pinyin: nà liǎng bēi chá yǒu yī bēi shì nǐ de .
meaning: One of those two cups was yours.

text: 我知道，可她拿着，看起来更稳。
pinyin: wǒ zhī dào , kě tā ná zhe , kàn qǐ lái gèng wěn .
meaning: I know, but she was holding it and looked steadier.

text: 你只负责拍照？
pinyin: nǐ zhǐ fù zé pāi zhào ?
meaning: You just took the photo?

text: 对，茶的颜色很好看。
pinyin: duì , chá de yán sè hěn hǎo kàn .
meaning: Yes. The tea had a lovely colour.

text: 下次你拿，我拍。
pinyin: xià cì nǐ ná , wǒ pāi .
meaning: Next time you hold it and I'll take the photo.

text: 那卡上写祝我别洒就行。
pinyin: nà kǎ shàng xiě zhù wǒ bié sǎ jiù xíng .
meaning: Then the card can just wish me not to spill it.

text: 那两杯茶有一杯是你的。我知道，可她拿着，看起来更稳。你只负责拍照？对，茶的颜色很好看。下次你拿，我拍。那卡上写祝我别洒就行。

text: 我买这个袋子，是为了装书。
pinyin: wǒ mǎi zhè gè dài zi , shì wèi le zhuāng shū .
meaning: I bought this bag to carry books.

text: 她很有爱心，经常照顾邻居的猫。
pinyin: tā hěn yǒu ài xīn , jīng cháng zhào gù lín jū de māo .
meaning: She's caring and often looks after her neighbour's cat.

text: 我想自己设计一张生日卡。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zì jǐ shè jì yī zhāng shēng rì kǎ .
meaning: I'd like to design a birthday card myself.

text: 这个故事是他上大学时创作的。
pinyin: zhè gè gù shì shì tā shàng dà xué shí chuàng zuò de .
meaning: He created this story when he was at university.

text: 她想给孩子创造一个安静的环境。
pinyin: tā xiǎng gěi hái zi chuàng zào yī gè ān jìng de huán jìng .
meaning: She wants to create a quiet environment for the child.

text: 他在设计上做了一些创新。
pinyin: tā zài shè jì shàng zuò le yī xiē chuàng xīn .
meaning: He introduced some innovations in the design.

text: 展览里有学生的作品。
pinyin: zhǎn lǎn lǐ yǒu xué sheng de zuò pǐn .
meaning: The exhibition includes students' work.

text: 我想给作者写一封信。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng gěi zuò zhě xiě yī fēng xìn .
meaning: I'd like to write a letter to the author.

text: 我想把这张照片打印成彩色的。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè zhāng zhào piān dǎ yìn chéng cǎi sè de .
meaning: I'd like to print this photo in colour.

text: 桌上的布是蓝色的。
pinyin: zhuō shàng de bù shì lán sè de .
meaning: The cloth on the table is blue.

text: 这个小盒子是金做的。
pinyin: zhè gè xiǎo hé zi shì jīn zuò de .
meaning: This little box is made of gold.

text: 她买了一对银耳环。
pinyin: tā mǎi le yī duì yín ěr huán .
meaning: She bought a pair of silver earrings.

text: 我想纪念第一次自己旅行。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jì niàn dì yī cì zì jǐ lǚ xíng .
meaning: I'd like to commemorate my first trip alone.

text: 祝你旅途顺利。
pinyin: zhù nǐ lǚ tú shùn lì .
meaning: Have a smooth journey.

text: 关掉不用的灯，节约用电。
pinyin: guān diào bù yòng de dēng , jié yuē yòng diàn .
meaning: Switch off unused lights to save electricity.

text: 别浪费时间找了，我这里还有一支。
pinyin: bié làng fèi shí jiān zhǎo le , wǒ zhè lǐ hái yǒu yī zhī .
meaning: Don't waste time looking. I have another one here.

text: 这块空地方可以利用起来。
pinyin: zhè kuài kòng dì fāng kě yǐ lì yòng qǐ lái .
meaning: We can make use of this empty space.

text: 手机这个功能我还不会用。
pinyin: shǒu jī zhè gè gōng néng wǒ hái bù huì yòng .
meaning: I don't know how to use this phone feature yet.

text: 这张卡适用的商店有哪些？
pinyin: zhè zhāng kǎ shì yòng de shāng diàn yǒu nǎ xiē ?
meaning: Which shops can this card be used at?

text: 这个手机应用很好用。
pinyin: zhè gè shǒu jī yìng yòng hěn hǎo yòng .
meaning: This phone app is useful.

text: 我想减少不必要的消费。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiǎn shǎo bù bì yào de xiāo fèi .
meaning: I'd like to cut unnecessary spending.

text: 我没带现金，用手机付吧。
pinyin: wǒ méi dài xiàn jīn , yòng shǒu jī fù ba .
meaning: I don't have cash. I'll pay with my phone.

text: 为了赶车，我们早点出门。我买这个袋子，是为了装书。这次义卖是爱心活动。她很有爱心，经常照顾邻居的猫。这个杯子是谁设计的？我想自己设计一张生日卡。她正在创作一首歌。这个故事是他上大学时创作的。大家一起创造了新的机会。她想给孩子创造一个安静的环境。这家店的菜总有一点创新。他在设计上做了一些创新。这是她最近的作品。展览里有学生的作品。这本书的作者是谁？我想给作者写一封信。你带彩色笔了吗？我想把这张照片打印成彩色的。我用这块布做了一个袋子。桌上的布是蓝色的。她戴着一条金项链。这个小盒子是金做的。这只戒指是银做的。她买了一对银耳环。这张票我留着做纪念。我想纪念第一次自己旅行。祝你生日快乐！祝你旅途顺利。旧纸也能用，可以节约一点。关掉不用的灯，节约用电。买了不吃，就浪费了。别浪费时间找了，我这里还有一支。我想利用周末整理房间。这块空地方可以利用起来。这个包有防水的功能吗？手机这个功能我还不会用。这个办法适用于小房间。这张卡适用的商店有哪些？他把学到的方法应用在工作中。这个手机应用很好用。这家店消费不高。我想减少不必要的消费。可以付现金吗？我没带现金，用手机付吧。

text: 你快递到了，我放在门边了。
pinyin: nǐ kuài dì dào le , wǒ fàng zài mén biān le .
meaning: Your delivery arrived. I put it by the door.

text: 谢谢！你别拆，我订的被子有点大。
pinyin: xiè xiè ! nǐ bié chāi , wǒ dìng de bèi zi yǒu diǎn dà .
meaning: Thanks! Don't open it yet; the quilt I ordered is rather big.

text: 这么大一个袋子，你一个人拿得动吗？
pinyin: zhè me dà yī gè dài zi , nǐ yī gè rén ná de dòng ma ?
meaning: Can you carry a bag that big on your own?

text: 能，你帮我把门打开就行。
pinyin: néng , nǐ bāng wǒ bǎ mén dǎ kāi jiù xíng .
meaning: Yes. Just help me open the door.

text: 等一下，袋子下面湿了。
pinyin: děng yī xià , dài zi xià miàn shī le .
meaning: Wait, the bottom of the bag is wet.

text: 刚才下雨了吧？先别放沙发上。
pinyin: gāng cái xià yǔ le ba ? xiān bié fàng shā fā shàng .
meaning: Was it raining earlier? Let's keep it off the sofa.

text: 放哪里？椅子上也有你的裤子。
pinyin: fàng nǎ lǐ ? yǐ zi shàng yě yǒu nǐ de kù zi .
meaning: Where should it go? Your trousers are on the chair too.

text: 我把裤子拿走，你把袋子放到椅子上。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ kù zi ná zǒu , nǐ bǎ dài zi fàng dào yǐ zi shàng .
meaning: I'll move the trousers. Put the bag on the chair.

text: 这条绳子太紧了，解不开。
pinyin: zhè tiáo shéng zi tài jǐn le , jiě bù kāi .
meaning: This cord is too tight. I can't undo it.

text: 剪刀在书架上。剪开外面的袋子，别剪到被子。
pinyin: jiǎn dāo zài shū jià shàng . jiǎn kāi wài miàn de dài zi , bié jiǎn dào bèi zi .
meaning: The scissors are on the bookshelf. Cut the outer bag, not the quilt.

text: 里面没湿。你今晚就盖这个？
pinyin: lǐ miàn méi shī . nǐ jīn wǎn jiù gài zhè gè ?
meaning: It's dry inside. Are you using it tonight?

text: 对，旧被子明天洗。谢谢你，差点把新被子留在门口过夜。
pinyin: duì , jiù bèi zi míng tiān xǐ . xiè xiè nǐ , chà diǎn bǎ xīn bèi zi liú zài mén kǒu guò yè .
meaning: Yes. I'll wash the old one tomorrow. Thanks; I nearly left the new quilt outside overnight.

text: 我下班回家时，看见门边放着一个很大的袋子。房东帮我收了快递，还发消息说今天下雨，袋子下面湿了。
pinyin: wǒ xià bān huí jiā shí , kàn jiàn mén biān fàng zhe yī gè hěn dà de dài zi . fáng dōng bāng wǒ shōu le kuài dì , hái fā xiāo xī shuō jīn tiān xià yǔ , dài zi xià miàn shī le .
meaning: When I got home from work, I found a large bag beside the door. The landlord had taken my delivery and messaged that the rain had wet the bottom.

text: 我想把袋子直接放在沙发上，朋友拦住我，说先看看里面。我把裤子挪到另一把椅子上，两个人才有地方放袋子。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ dài zi zhí jiē fàng zài shā fā shàng , péng you lán zhù wǒ , shuō xiān kàn kàn lǐ miàn . wǒ bǎ kù zi nuó dào lìng yī bǎ yǐ zi shàng , liǎng gè rén cái yǒu dì fāng fàng dài zi .
meaning: I was going to put it straight on the sofa. My friend stopped me and suggested checking inside first. I moved my trousers to the other chair so we had somewhere to put the bag.

text: 绳子太紧，朋友拉了几次也没有解开。我去书架上拿剪刀，慢慢剪开外面的袋子，里面的被子没有湿。
pinyin: shéng zi tài jǐn , péng you lā le jǐ cì yě méi yǒu jiě kāi . wǒ qù shū jià shàng ná jiǎn dāo , màn màn jiǎn kāi wài miàn de dài zi , lǐ miàn de bèi zi méi yǒu shī .
meaning: The cord was too tight to undo. I fetched scissors from the bookshelf and carefully cut the outer bag. The quilt inside was dry.

text: 我高兴地把新被子抱进卧室，想今晚就用。朋友问旧的放哪里，我说先和裤子放在一起，明天再洗。
pinyin: wǒ gāo xìng de bǎ xīn bèi zi bào jìn wò shì , xiǎng jīn wǎn jiù yòng . péng you wèn jiù de fàng nǎ lǐ , wǒ shuō xiān hé kù zi fàng zài yì qǐ , míng tiān zài xǐ .
meaning: I happily took the new quilt into the bedroom to use that night. My friend asked about the old one. I'd put it with the trousers until I washed it tomorrow.

text: 两把椅子都放满东西，我们只好坐在沙发上喝水。朋友笑着说，你现在最需要订的，可能不是被子，是一个更大的房间。
pinyin: liǎng bǎ yǐ zi dōu fàng mǎn dōng xi , wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zuò zài shā fā shàng hē shuǐ . péng you xiào zhe shuō , nǐ xiàn zài zuì xū yào dìng de , kě néng bù shì bèi zi , shì yī gè gèng dà de fáng jiān .
meaning: Both chairs were now full, so we sat on the sofa with water. My friend joked that my next order should perhaps be a bigger room, not another quilt.

text: 我把裤子挂好，旧被子搬进卧室，终于空出一个座位。房间没变大，至少明天吃早饭不用站着了。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ kù zi guà hǎo , jiù bèi zi bān jìn wò shì , zhōng yú kōng chū yī gè zuò wèi . fáng jiān méi biàn dà , zhì shǎo míng tiān chī zǎo fàn bù yòng zhàn zhe le .
meaning: I hung up the trousers and moved the old quilt into the bedroom, finally freeing a seat. The room was no bigger, but at least I wouldn't have to eat breakfast standing up.

text: 你把剪刀放哪里了？
pinyin: nǐ bǎ jiǎn dāo fàng nǎ lǐ le ?
meaning: Where did you put the scissors?

text: 书架上，最上面那一层。
pinyin: shū jià shàng , zuì shàng miàn nà yī céng .
meaning: On the top shelf of the bookshelf.

text: 我够不到。
pinyin: wǒ gòu bù dào .
meaning: I can't reach.

text: 那我来。你别把被子当椅子踩。
pinyin: nà wǒ lái . nǐ bié bǎ bèi zi dāng yǐ zi cǎi .
meaning: I'll get them. Don't stand on the quilt as if it were a chair.

text: 我只是想试试软不软。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ shì xiǎng shì shì ruǎn bù ruǎn .
meaning: I was just testing how soft it is.

text: 用脚试？今晚这被子归你了。
pinyin: yòng jiǎo shì ? jīn wǎn zhè bèi zi guī nǐ le .

pinyin: zhè zhāng zhǐ jiào dì di nòng huài le .
meaning: My younger brother damaged this paper.

text: 我给房东打电话，问能不能养猫。
pinyin: wǒ gěi fáng dōng dǎ diàn huà , wèn néng bù néng yǎng māo .
meaning: I called the landlord to ask about keeping a cat.

text: 房屋里面很干净。
pinyin: fáng wū lǐ miàn hěn gān jìng .
meaning: The inside of the house is clean.

text: 这间房的房租比那间高。
pinyin: zhè jiān fáng de fáng zū bǐ nà jiān gāo .
meaning: The rent for this room is higher than for that one.

text: 她想订一个生日蛋糕。
pinyin: tā xiǎng dìng yī gè shēng rì dàn gāo .
meaning: She wants to order a birthday cake.

text: 他把椅子放到窗边了。
pinyin: tā bǎ yǐ zi fàng dào chuāng biān le .
meaning: He moved the chair beside the window.

text: 我想把这张画挂在墙上。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè zhāng huà guà zài qiáng shàng .
meaning: I'd like to hang this picture on the wall.

text: 先解开袋子，再拿里面的东西。
pinyin: xiān jiě kāi dài zi , zài ná lǐ miàn de dōng xi .
meaning: Open the bag before taking anything out.

text: 瓶盖太紧，我打不开。
pinyin: píng gài tài jǐn , wǒ dǎ bù kāi .
meaning: The bottle cap is too tight for me to open.

text: 这张旧照片是在北京拍的。
pinyin: zhè zhāng jiù zhào piān shì zài běi jīng pāi de .
meaning: This old photo was taken in Beijing.

text: 我买了一个小书架放在床边。
pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yī gè xiǎo shū jià fàng zài chuáng biān .
meaning: I bought a small bookshelf to put by the bed.

text: 这个沙发坐着很舒服。
pinyin: zhè gè shā fā zuò zhe hěn shū fú .
meaning: This sofa is comfortable to sit on.

text: 晚上冷，记得盖好被子。
pinyin: wǎn shang lěng , jì de gài hǎo bèi zi .
meaning: It's cold at night. Keep the quilt over you.

text: 他的裤子上有一点泥。
pinyin: tā de kù zi shàng yǒu yī diǎn ní .
meaning: There is some mud on his trousers.

text: 这件衬衫洗完以后变小了。
pinyin: zhè jiàn chèn shān xǐ wán yǐ hòu biàn xiǎo le .
meaning: This shirt shrank after washing.

text: 我给爸爸买了一件新衬衣。
pinyin: wǒ gěi bà bà mǎi le yī jiàn xīn chèn yī .
meaning: I bought my father a new shirt.

text: 我的上衣留在朋友家了。
pinyin: wǒ de shàng yī liú zài péng you jiā le .
meaning: I left my top at a friend's home.

text: 这条裙子没有口袋。
pinyin: zhè tiáo qún zi méi yǒu kǒu dài .
meaning: This skirt has no pockets.

text: 这个皮包是她自己买的。
pinyin: zhè gè pí bāo shì tā zì jǐ mǎi de .
meaning: She bought this leather handbag herself.

text: 这件衣服用了很软的皮。

text: 请把那杯水拿过来。她把钥匙放在桌上了。我的鞋被雨弄湿了。门被风吹开了。我的外套叫他拿走了。这张纸叫弟弟弄坏了。房东明天来修门。我给房东打电话，问能不能养猫。这张图画了街边的房屋。房屋里面很干净。我今天交了房租。这间房的房租比那间高。我们订了两张票。她想订一个生日蛋糕。把书放到我包里吧。他把椅子放到窗边了。外套挂在门后。我想把这张画挂在墙上。她帮我解开绳子。先解开袋子，再拿里面的东西。这双鞋有点紧。瓶盖太紧，我打不开。我把旧手机给了弟弟。这张旧照片是在北京拍的。书架上还有几个空位。我买了一个小书架放在床边。猫睡在沙发上。这个沙发坐着很舒服。我把被子拿出去晒了。晚上冷，记得盖好被子。这条裤子太长了。他的裤子上有一点泥。他今天穿了一件白衬衫。这件衬衫洗完以后变小了。她把衬衣挂起来了。我给爸爸买了一件新衬衣。这件上衣和那条裤子很合适。我的上衣留在朋友家了。她试了一条蓝裙子。这条裙子没有口袋。妈妈的皮包放在椅子上。这个皮包是她自己买的。这双鞋是皮的。这件衣服用了很软的皮。
pinyin: qǐng bǎ nà bēi shuǐ ná guò lái . tā bǎ yào shi fàng zài zhuō shàng le . wǒ de xié bèi yǔ nòng shī le . mén bèi fēng chuī kāi le . wǒ de wài tào jiào tā ná zǒu le . zhè zhāng zhǐ jiào dì di nòng huài le . fáng dōng míng tiān lái xiū mén . wǒ gěi fáng dōng dǎ diàn huà , wèn néng bù néng yǎng māo . zhè zhāng tú huà le jiē biān de fáng wū . fáng wū lǐ miàn hěn gān jìng . wǒ jīn tiān jiāo le fáng zū . zhè jiān fáng de fáng zū bǐ nà jiān gāo . wǒ men dìng le liǎng zhāng piào . tā xiǎng dìng yī gè shēng rì dàn gāo . bǎ shū fàng dào wǒ bāo lǐ ba . tā bǎ yǐ zi fàng dào chuāng biān le . wài tào guà zài mén hòu . wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè zhāng huà guà zài qiáng shàng . tā bāng wǒ jiě kāi shéng zi . xiān jiě kāi dài zi , zài ná lǐ miàn de dōng xi . zhè shuāng xié yǒu diǎn jǐn . píng gài tài jǐn , wǒ dǎ bù kāi . wǒ bǎ jiù shǒu jī gěi le dì di . zhè zhāng jiù zhào piān shì zài běi jīng pāi de . shū jià shàng hái yǒu jǐ gè kōng wèi . wǒ mǎi le yī gè xiǎo shū jià fàng zài chuáng biān . māo shuì zài shā fā shàng . zhè gè shā fā zuò zhe hěn shū fú . wǒ bǎ bèi zi ná chū qù shài le . wǎn shang lěng , jì de gài hǎo bèi zi . zhè tiáo kù zi tài zhǎng le . tā de kù zi shàng yǒu yī diǎn ní . tā jīn tiān chuān le yī jiàn bái chèn shān . zhè jiàn chèn shān xǐ wán yǐ hòu biàn xiǎo le . tā bǎ chèn yī guà qǐ lái le . wǒ gěi bà bà mǎi le yī jiàn xīn chèn yī . zhè jiàn shàng yī hé nà tiáo kù zi hěn hé shì . wǒ de shàng yī liú zài péng you jiā le . tā shì le yī tiáo lán qún zi . zhè tiáo qún zi méi yǒu kǒu dài . mā mā de pí bāo fàng zài yǐ zi shàng . zhè gè pí bāo shì tā zì jǐ mǎi de . zhè shuāng xié shì pí de . zhè jiàn yī fú yòng le hěn ruǎn de pí .
meaning: Please bring that glass of water. She put the keys on the table. My shoes got wet in the rain. The wind blew the door open. He took my coat away. My younger brother damaged this paper. The coat hangs behind the door. I'd like to hang this picture on the wall. She helped me undo the cord. Open the bag before taking anything out. These shoes are a little tight. The bottle cap is too tight for me to open. I gave my old phone to my younger brother. This old photo was taken in Beijing. There are a few empty spaces on the bookshelf. I bought a small bookshelf to put by the bed. The cat is asleep on the sofa. This sofa is comfortable to sit on. I took the quilt outside to air. It's cold at night. Keep the quilt over you. These trousers are too long. There is some mud on his trousers. He is wearing a white shirt today. This shirt shrank after washing. She hung up the shirt. I bought my father a new shirt. This top goes well with those trousers. I left my top at a friend's home. She tried on a blue skirt. This skirt has no pockets. My mother's leather handbag is on the chair. She bought this leather handbag herself. These shoes are leather. This garment uses very soft leather.

text: 除了我，你们都看过这个节目了？
pinyin: chú le wǒ , nǐ men dōu kàn guò zhè gè jié mù le ?
meaning: Has everyone seen this show except me?

text: 我也没看完，只看了开头。
pinyin: wǒ yě méi kàn wán , zhǐ kàn le kāi tóu .
meaning: I haven't finished either. I've only seen the beginning.

text: 那你干吗说最后一集最好？
pinyin: nà nǐ gàn má shuō zuì hòu yī jí zuì hǎo ?
meaning: Then why did you say the last episode was the best?

text: 我听姐姐说的。她一边看一边哭，纸都用完了。
pinyin: wǒ tīng jiě jie shuō de . tā yī biān kàn yī biān kū , zhǐ dōu yòng wán le .
meaning: My sister told me. She cried so much watching it that she used up the tissues.

text: 这么动人？我还以为是那种一直让人笑的节目。
pinyin: zhè me dòng rén ? wǒ hái yǐ wéi shì nà zhǒng yì zhí ràng rén xiào de jié mù .
meaning: Is it that moving? I thought it was the kind that keeps you laughing.

text: 开头是很好笑。后面怎么样，我真不知道。
pinyin: kāi tóu shì hěn hǎo xiào . hòu miàn zěn me yàng , wǒ zhēn bù zhī dào .
meaning: The beginning is funny. I honestly don't know about the rest.

text: 今晚电视台还播吗？
pinyin: jīn wǎn diàn shì tái hái bō ma ?
meaning: Is the TV station showing it again tonight?

text: 八点重播第一集。你要来我家一起看吗？
pinyin: bā diǎn chóng bō dì yī jí . nǐ yào lái wǒ jiā yì qǐ kàn ma ?
meaning: The first episode is repeated at eight. Want to watch at my place?

text: 来。除了看节目，我们还可以点个晚饭。
pinyin: lái . chú le kàn jié mù , wǒ men hái kě yǐ diǎn gè wǎn fàn .
meaning: Yes. Besides watching, we can order dinner.

text: 好，但你别看到一半就问最后谁回来了。
pinyin: hǎo , dàn nǐ bié kàn dào yí bàn jiù wèn zuì hòu shéi huí lái le .
meaning: Fine, but don't ask who returns at the end halfway through.

text: 你不是也不知道吗？
pinyin: nǐ bù shì yě bù zhī dào ma ?
meaning: You don't know either, do you?

text: 所以别问，我也想知道。
pinyin: suǒ yǐ bié wèn , wǒ yě xiǎng zhī dào .
meaning: Exactly. Don't ask; I want to find out too.

text: 最近朋友们都在聊一个电视节目。我没看过，听他们说最后一集时，总觉得自己少认识了几个朋友。
pinyin: zuì jìn péng you men dōu zài liáo yī gè diàn shì jié mù . wǒ méi kàn guò , tīng tā men shuō zuì hòu yī jí shí , zǒng jué de zì jǐ shǎo rèn shi le jǐ gè péng you .
meaning: My friends have been talking about a TV show. When they discussed its last episode, I felt as if there were a few friends I had yet to meet.

text: 陈宇说除了看最后一集，还得从第一集开始。我问他是不是全看完了，他承认只看了开头，后面的情节都是姐姐告诉他的。
pinyin: chén yǔ shuō chú le kàn zuì hòu yī jí , hái děi cóng dì yī jí kāi shǐ . wǒ wèn tā shì bú shì quán kàn wán le , tā chéng rèn zhǐ kàn le kāi tóu , hòu miàn de qíng jié dōu shì jiě jie gào sù tā de .
meaning: Chen Yu said I needed the first episode as well as the last. When I asked if he had finished it, he admitted he had only seen the beginning. His sister had told him the rest.

text: 我们在互联网上查到电视台晚上八点重播第一集。我下班后带了晚饭去他家，两个人先吃，再打开电视。
pinyin: wǒ men zài hù lián wǎng shàng chá dào diàn shì tái wǎn shang bā diǎn chóng bō dì yī jí . wǒ xià bān hòu dài le wǎn fàn qù tā jiā , liǎng gè rén xiān chī , zài dǎ kāi diàn shì .
meaning: Online we found that the station repeated episode one at eight. I took dinner to his place after work. We ate before turning on the TV.

text: 节目开头很好笑，陈宇总看我有没有笑。我说你也看屏幕，别把我当观众里的唯一一个人。
pinyin: jié mù kāi tóu hěn hǎo xiào , chén yǔ zǒng kàn wǒ yǒu méi yǒu xiào . wǒ shuō nǐ yě kàn píng mù , bié bǎ wǒ dāng guān zhòng lǐ de wéi yī yī gè rén .
meaning: The opening was funny. Chen Yu kept checking my reaction. I told him to watch the screen too, instead of treating me as the only person in the audience.

text: 看到最后，门外响起一个人的声音，可画面没有拍到是谁。我们都想再看一集，明天却还要上班，只好先关掉。
pinyin: kàn dào zuì hòu , mén wài xiǎng qǐ yī gè rén de shēng yīn , kě huà miàn méi yǒu pāi dào shì shéi . wǒ men dōu xiǎng zài kàn yī jí , míng tiān què hái yào shàng bān , zhǐ hǎo xiān guān diào .
meaning: At the end someone spoke outside the door, but the camera did not show who. We both wanted another episode, but work the next day meant switching off.

text: 回家以后，我给他发消息说除了周五晚上，其他晚上都能再看。他马上回，周四吧，我也想知道门外是谁。

meaning: Back home I messaged that any evening except Friday worked for another episode. He immediately suggested Thursday: he wanted to know who was outside too.

text: 你姐姐说门外是谁了吗？
pinyin: nǐ jiě jie shuō mén wài shì shéi le ma ?
meaning: Did your sister tell you who was outside?

text: 说了，但我忘了名字。
pinyin: shuō le , dàn wǒ wàng le míng zi .
meaning: Yes, but I've forgotten the name.

text: 这个时候忘得正好。
pinyin: zhè gè shí hou wàng de zhèng hǎo .
meaning: That's a good time to forget.

text: 那你别帮我想起来。
pinyin: nà nǐ bié bāng wǒ xiǎng qǐ lái .
meaning: Don't help me remember, then.

text: 除了看下一集，我们还有别的办法吗？

text: 周五一起做饭吧？我想叫上小周。

meaning: Shall we cook together on Friday? I'd like to invite Xiao Zhou.

text: 周五不行，我要加班。周六能不能来？
pinyin: zhōu wǔ bù xíng , wǒ yào jiā bān . zhōu liù néng bù néng lái ?
meaning: I can't on Friday; I'm working late. Would Saturday work?

text: 我问问她。你想吃什么？
pinyin: wǒ wèn wèn tā . nǐ xiǎng chī shén me ?
meaning: I'll ask her. What would you like to eat?

text: 面条吧，不光吃饭，还能一起看节目。
pinyin: miàn tiáo ba , bù guāng chī fàn , hái néng yì qǐ kàn jié mù .
meaning: Noodles. We could watch a show as well as eat.

text: 好主意。要是她来，我做三个人的。
pinyin: hǎo zhǔ yì . yào shì tā lái , wǒ zuò sān gè rén de .
meaning: Good idea. If she comes, I'll cook for three.

text: 她上次说不能吃很辣的，别忘了。
pinyin: tā shàng cì shuō bù néng chī hěn là de , bié wàng le .
meaning: She said she couldn't eat very spicy food last time. Don't forget.

text: 那辣的放旁边，自己加。
pinyin: nà là de fàng páng biān , zì jǐ jiā .
meaning: We can put the chilli on the side and add it ourselves.

text: 我同意。只有你自己吃的那碗，才可以全放进去。
pinyin: wǒ tóng yì . zhǐ yǒu nǐ zì jǐ chī de nà wǎn , cái kě yǐ quán fàng jìn qù .
meaning: Agreed. Only your own bowl gets the whole lot.

text: 你反对我的做法？

text: 我反对把我的面条变成一碗辣椒。

text: 好，并且我会带一个能吃饭的嘴。

text: 周六下午，我买了面条和蔬菜，并且提前洗好三个碗。陈宇带来饮料，还带了一个大碗，说小碗恐怕不够他吃。
pinyin: zhōu liù xià wǔ , wǒ mǎi le miàn tiáo hé shū cài , bìng qiě tí qián xǐ hǎo sān gè wǎn . chén yǔ dài lái yǐn liào , hái dài le yī gè dà wǎn , shuō xiǎo wǎn kǒng pà bù gòu tā chī .
meaning: On Saturday afternoon I bought noodles and vegetables and washed three bowls in advance. Chen Yu brought drinks and a large bowl, saying a small one might not be enough.

text: 面条煮好以后，小周先尝了一口，说这样正好。我给自己的那碗加了辣椒，陈宇加了一点，又赶紧拿饮料。
pinyin: miàn tiáo zhǔ hǎo yǐ hòu , xiǎo zhōu xiān cháng le yī kǒu , shuō zhè yàng zhèng hǎo . wǒ gěi zì jǐ de nà wǎn jiā le là jiāo , chén yǔ jiā le yī diǎn , yòu gǎn jǐn ná yǐn liào .
meaning: Once the noodles were ready, Xiao Zhou tasted hers and said they were just right. I added chilli to my bowl. Chen Yu tried a little and quickly reached for his drink.

text: 我们一边吃一边看节目。好笑的地方来了，陈宇差点把饮料放进我的碗里，说下次只有他自己吃的那碗，才可以离饮料这么近。
pinyin: wǒ men yī biān chī yī biān kàn jié mù . hǎo xiào de dì fāng lái le , chén yǔ chà diǎn bǎ yǐn liào fàng jìn wǒ de wǎn lǐ , shuō xià cì zhǐ yǒu tā zì jǐ chī de nà wǎn , cái kě yǐ lí yǐn liào zhè me jìn .
meaning: We ate while watching a show. At a funny moment Chen Yu nearly put his drink in my bowl. He said next time only his own bowl should be that close to his drink.

text: 吃完以后，小周帮我洗碗，陈宇把剩下的饮料收好。三个人商量，下次去他家，他说可以，但先别期待他也能做饭。
pinyin: chī wán yǐ hòu , xiǎo zhōu bāng wǒ xǐ wǎn , chén yǔ bǎ shèng xià de yǐn liào shōu hǎo . sān gè rén shāng liáng , xià cì qù tā jiā , tā shuō kě yǐ , dàn xiān bié qī dài tā yě néng zuò fàn .
meaning: After eating, Xiao Zhou helped wash up and Chen Yu put away the drinks. We agreed to meet at his place next time. He said yes, but asked us not to expect him to cook too.

text: 我想周五请朋友来做饭，陈宇却要加班。他提议改到周六，我问过小周以后，三个人都同意了。小周说只要不太辣，她就很想吃面条。我平时爱吃辣，原来打算把辣椒直接放进锅里，这次先把它留在一只小碗里。周六下午，我买了面条和蔬菜，并且提前洗好三个碗。陈宇带来饮料，还带了一个大碗，说小碗恐怕不够他吃。面条煮好以后，小周先尝了一口，说这样正好。我给自己的那碗加了辣椒，陈宇加了一点，又赶紧拿饮料。我们一边吃一边看节目。好笑的地方来了，陈宇差点把饮料放进我的碗里，说下次只有他自己吃的那碗，才可以离饮料这么近。吃完以后，小周帮我洗碗，陈宇把剩下的饮料收好。三个人商量，下次去他家，他说可以，但先别期待他也能做饭。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhōu wǔ qǐng péng you lái zuò fàn , chén yǔ què yào jiā bān . tā tí yì gǎi dào zhōu liù , wǒ wèn guò xiǎo zhōu yǐ hòu , sān gè rén dōu tóng yì le . xiǎo zhōu shuō zhǐ yào bù tài là , tā jiù hěn xiǎng chī miàn tiáo . wǒ píng shí ài chī là , yuán lái dǎ suàn bǎ là jiāo zhí jiē fàng jìn guō lǐ , zhè cì xiān bǎ tā liú zài yī zhǐ xiǎo wǎn lǐ . zhōu liù xià wǔ , wǒ mǎi le miàn tiáo hé shū cài , bìng qiě tí qián xǐ hǎo sān gè wǎn . chén yǔ dài lái yǐn liào , hái dài le yī gè dà wǎn , shuō xiǎo wǎn kǒng pà bù gòu tā chī . miàn tiáo zhǔ hǎo yǐ hòu , xiǎo zhōu xiān cháng le yī kǒu , shuō zhè yàng zhèng hǎo . wǒ gěi zì jǐ de nà wǎn jiā le là jiāo , chén yǔ jiā le yī diǎn , yòu gǎn jǐn ná yǐn liào . wǒ men yī biān chī yī biān kàn jié mù . hǎo xiào de dì fāng lái le , chén yǔ chà diǎn bǎ yǐn liào fàng jìn wǒ de wǎn lǐ , shuō xià cì zhǐ yǒu tā zì jǐ chī de nà wǎn , cái kě yǐ lí yǐn liào zhè me jìn . chī wán yǐ hòu , xiǎo zhōu bāng wǒ xǐ wǎn , chén yǔ bǎ shèng xià de yǐn liào shōu hǎo . sān gè rén shāng liáng , xià cì qù tā jiā , tā shuō kě yǐ , dàn xiān bié qī dài tā yě néng zuò fàn .

Xiao Zhou wanted noodles as long as they were not too spicy. I usually like chilli in the pot, but this time I kept it in a small bowl. On Saturday afternoon I bought noodles and vegetables and washed three bowls in advance. Chen Yu brought drinks and a large bowl, saying a small one might not be enough. Once the noodles were ready, Xiao Zhou tasted hers and said they were just right. I added chilli to my bowl. Chen Yu tried a little and quickly reached for his drink. We ate while watching a show. text: 你带的这个大碗，能放多少面条？
pinyin: nǐ dài de zhè gè dà wǎn , néng fàng duō shao miàn tiáo ?
meaning: How many noodles does that big bowl hold?

text: 不知道，要是吃不完，我就带回家。
pinyin: bù zhī dào , yào shì chī bù wán , wǒ jiù dài huí jiā .

text: 你不仅来吃饭，还想带走？

text: 我还带了饮料，不是空手来的。

text: 那我认可这个理由。

text: 谢谢，面条可以再加一点吗？

text: 要是你有空，就来喝茶吧。

text: 只有周六我才有空。

text: 我们都同意先吃饭。

text: 她没有反对，只是问了一下费用。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu fǎn duì , zhǐ shì wèn le yī xià fèi yòng .
meaning: She did not object; she just asked about the cost.

text: 妈妈坚决反对我晚上一个人去。
pinyin: mā mā jiān jué fǎn duì wǒ wǎn shang yī gè rén qù .
meaning: My mother strongly opposed my going alone at night.

text: 我主张把时间留给大家提问。
pinyin: wǒ zhǔ zhāng bǎ shí jiān liú gěi dà jiā tí wèn .
meaning: I suggest leaving time for everyone's questions.

text: 这个主意是小周提的。
pinyin: zhè gè zhǔ yì shì xiǎo zhōu tí de .
meaning: Xiao Zhou suggested this idea.

text: 我们先制定旅行计划。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān zhì dìng lǚ xíng jì huà .
meaning: Let's draw up a travel plan first.

text: 这项制度已经用了十年。
pinyin: zhè xiàng zhì dù yǐ jīng yòng le shí nián .
meaning: This system has been used for ten years.

text: 这家公司有完整的服务规范。
pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī yǒu wán zhěng de fú wù guī fàn .
meaning: This company has a complete set of service standards.

text: 他问这份合同是否合法。
pinyin: tā wèn zhè fèn hé tóng shì fǒu hé fǎ .

text: 这个项目还没有得到批准。

text: 老师认可了我的修改。
pinyin: lǎo shī rèn kě le wǒ de xiū gǎi .
meaning: The teacher accepted my revisions.

text: 我想确保每个人都有座位。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng què bǎo měi gè rén dōu yǒu zuò wèi .
meaning: I'd like to make sure everyone has a seat.

text: 她写了张纸条，防止自己忘记。
pinyin: tā xiě le zhāng zhǐ tiáo , fáng zhǐ zì jǐ wàng jì .
meaning: She wrote herself a note to avoid forgetting.

text: 这次检查是为了预防机器故障。
pinyin: zhè cì jiǎn chá shì wèi le yù fáng jī qì gù zhàng .

text: 我打电话问了他的情况。
pinyin: wǒ dǎ diàn huà wèn le tā de qíng kuàng .

text: 我还不知道如何回答他。
pinyin: wǒ hái bù zhī dào rú hé huí dá tā .

text: 我们能不能晚一点走？

text: 不是笑你，我上次星期一才去，门都关了。

text: 那你比我还晚一天。

text: 所以我们这次一起去，谁也别一个人看通知。

text: 好，你念时间，我看地址。

text: 周六，下午两点。

text: 你突然说这么大声干吗？我听见了。

text: 我怕你又听成周日。

text: 好好说就行，我还没紧张到连两点都听不见。

text: 行，周六一点半在车站见？

text: 好。要是我星期一才来，你就别等了。

text: 周六我一点二十分就到了。陈宇来时问我是不是紧张，我说不是，刚才那班车来得早，我就上了。

text: 我们到门口时，里面已经有音乐声。今天真有人，陈宇说完自己先笑了。我让他进去再笑，后面还有人在等。

text: 表演结束后，我们在路边吃东西。陈宇问下周还来不来，我说先看看日期，今天总算没白跑。

meaning: After the performance we ate by the road. Chen Yu asked about coming next week. I suggested checking the date first. At least we had not made a wasted trip today.

pinyin: tā zài xiāo xī lǐ xiě le hā hā . hā hā , yuán lái nǐ yě wàng le . nǐ gàn má chuān zhè me duō ? nǐ zhàn zài mén kǒu gàn má ? tā men huàn le yī gè huà tí . zhè gè huà tí wǒ men zuó tiān tán guò . tā gěi nǎi nai niàn le yī fēng xìn . nǐ niàn màn yī diǎn , wǒ xiǎng jì xià lái . tū rán xià yǔ le . mén tū rán kāi le , wǒ xià le yī tiào . tā kuài sù shōu hǎo dōng xi jiù chū mén le . zhè gè fāng fǎ kě yǐ kuài sù zhǎo dào wén jiàn . chē de sù dù màn xià lái le . tā pǎo bù de sù dù bǐ wǒ kuài . yè lǐ , zhè tiáo jiē hěn jìng . wū lǐ hěn jìng , zhǐ tīng de jiàn zhōng de shēng yīn . tā dì yī cì shàng tái , yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng . bié jǐn zhāng , wǒ péi nǐ jìn qù . tīng dào zhè jù huà , tā lè le . tā men yī biān kàn zhào piān yī biān lè . tā duì míng nián de shēng huó hěn lè guān . tā zǒng néng zhǎo dào bàn fǎ , hěn lè guān . dà jiā yì qǐ dù guò le yī gè huān lè de wǎn shang . wū lǐ chōng mǎn le huān lè de xiào shēng . tā bǎ zhè gè rén wù yǎn huó le . tā bǎ gù shì jiǎng de hěn huó . lǎo shī jiǎng de gù shì hěn shēng dòng . zhè zhāng zhào piān shēng dòng de biǎo xiàn le dāng shí de shēng huó . tā de gē shēng hěn dòng rén . zhè shì yī gè hěn dòng rén de gù shì . tā jīn tiān de biǎo xiàn bǐ shàng cì hǎo . tā zài bǐ sài zhōng biǎo xiàn de hěn hǎo . wǒ men wǎn shang qù kàn biǎo yǎn . hái zi men zhǔn bèi le yī gè xiǎo biǎo yǎn . tā de jìn bù hěn míng xiǎn . liǎng zhāng tú de qū bié hěn míng xiǎn . shuì le yī jué , wǒ jīng shen duō le . tā jīn tiān kàn zhe hěn jīng shen . jīn tiān zhuàng tài bù cuò , wǒ xiǎng zài pǎo yī quān . tā gōng zuò shí de zhuàng tài bǐ zuó tiān hǎo . hái zi men zì jué bǎ wán jù shōu hǎo le . dà jiā dōu hěn zì jué , méi yǒu rén chā duì . huí qù hǎo hǎo xiū xī ba . wǒ xiǎng hǎo hǎo xué zuò fàn .

She read a letter aloud to her grandmother. Read more slowly; I'd like to write it down. It suddenly started raining. The door suddenly opened and startled me. He quickly packed his things and left. This method finds files quickly. The car slowed down. He runs faster than I do. This street is quiet at night. The room is quiet; only the clock can be heard. She is nervous about going on stage for the first time. Don't be nervous; I'll go in with you. He laughed at those words. They laughed while looking at the photos.
