text: 我想把每周的会改短一点，先试两周。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ měi zhōu de huì gǎi duǎn yī diǎn , xiān shì liǎng zhōu .
meaning: I’d like to shorten the weekly meeting for a two-week trial.

text: 现在四十五分钟，你想改成多久？
pinyin: xiàn zài sì shí wǔ fēn zhōng , nǐ xiǎng gǎi chéng duō jiǔ ?
meaning: It’s forty-five minutes now. How long do you propose?

text: 二十分钟。每个人先写三点，只讨论需要一起决定的。
pinyin: èr shí fēn zhōng . měi gè rén xiān xiě sān diǎn , zhǐ tǎo lùn xū yào yì qǐ jué dìng de .
meaning: Twenty minutes. Each person writes three points first; we discuss what needs a joint decision.

text: 那准备材料的时间会不会更长？别只算开会。
pinyin: nà zhǔn bèi cái liào de shí jiān huì bù huì gèng zhǎng ? bié zhǐ suàn kāi huì .
meaning: Will preparation take longer? Don’t count only the meeting.

text: 对，这个也要记。每点最多两三句，不做整页介绍。
pinyin: duì , zhè gè yě yào jì . měi diǎn zuì duō liǎng sān jù , bù zuò zhěng yè jiè shào .
meaning: Right, we should record that too. Two or three sentences per point, not a full-page presentation.

text: 时间还是周四五点吗？客户那边五点半可能来电话。
pinyin: shí jiān hái shi zhōu sì wǔ diǎn ma ? kè hù nà biān wǔ diǎn bàn kě néng lái diàn huà .
meaning: Still Thursday at five? The customer may call at half five.

text: 我先想周三三点，可只问了三个人，还有三个没答复。
pinyin: wǒ xiān xiǎng zhōu sān sān diǎn , kě zhǐ wèn le sān gè rén , hái yǒu sān gè méi dá fù .
meaning: I first thought Wednesday at three, but have asked only three people; three haven’t replied.

text: 我周三三点要见客户，这个时间不行。
pinyin: wǒ zhōu sān sān diǎn yào jiàn kè hù , zhè gè shí jiān bù xíng .
meaning: I have a customer meeting Wednesday at three; that won’t work.

text: 那周四三点呢？我先问完六个人，再发新安排。
pinyin: nà zhōu sì sān diǎn ne ? wǒ xiān wèn wán liù gè rén , zài fā xīn ān pái .
meaning: What about Thursday at three? I’ll ask all six before sending a new schedule.

text: 这个可以。两周以后根据什么评估？
pinyin: zhè gè kě yǐ . liǎng zhōu yǐ hòu gēn jù shén me píng gū ?
meaning: That works. What will you use for the assessment after two weeks?

text: 看开会和准备共用了多久，也看最后谁做什么有没有说清。
pinyin: kàn kāi huì hé zhǔn bèi gòng yòng le duō jiǔ , yě kàn zuì hòu shéi zuò shén me yǒu méi yǒu shuō qīng .
meaning: Total meeting and preparation time, plus whether responsibilities were clear at the end.

text: 要是有个问题二十分钟讲不完呢？
pinyin: yào shì yǒu gè wèn tí èr shí fēn zhōng jiǎng bù wán ne ?
meaning: What if a question can’t be finished in twenty minutes?

text: 先看需要谁。只有两个人相关，就另外约，不让其他四个一直等。
pinyin: xiān kàn xū yào shéi . zhǐ yǒu liǎng gè rén xiāng guān , jiù lìng wài yuē , bù ràng qí tā sì gè yì zhí děng .
meaning: Check who is needed. If only two people are involved, arrange a separate time rather than keeping the other four waiting.

text: 但那个时间也要算进去。
pinyin: dàn nà gè shí jiān yě yào suàn jìn qù .
meaning: But that time needs counting too.

text: 对。不是换个名字，就不算开会了。
pinyin: duì . bù shì huàn gè míng zi , jiù bù suàn kāi huì le .
meaning: Right. Renaming it doesn’t mean it stops being meeting time.

text: 好，我可以试。材料最晚什么时候写？
pinyin: hǎo , wǒ kě yǐ shì . cái liào zuì wǎn shén me shí hou xiě ?
meaning: Okay, I’ll try. When is the latest for writing the notes?

text: 周四中午以前。周二下班前，我先确认大家三点都方便。
pinyin: zhōu sì zhōng wǔ yǐ qián . zhōu èr xià bān qián , wǒ xiān què rèn dà jiā sān diǎn dōu fāng biàn .
meaning: Before Thursday noon. Before leaving work Tuesday I’ll first confirm that three suits everyone.

text: 那先等答复，别现在就告诉客户时间已经改好了。
pinyin: nà xiān děng dá fù , bié xiàn zài jiù gào sù kè hù shí jiān yǐ jīng gǎi hǎo le .
meaning: Then wait for the replies. Don’t tell the customer the time has changed already.

text: 我想把每周的会改短一点，先试两周。现在四十五分钟，你想改成多久？二十分钟。每个人先写三点，只讨论需要一起决定的。那准备材料的时间会不会更长？别只算开会。对，这个也要记。每点最多两三句，不做整页介绍。时间还是周四五点吗？客户那边五点半可能来电话。我先想周三三点，可只问了三个人，还有三个没答复。我周三三点要见客户，这个时间不行。那周四三点呢？我先问完六个人，再发新安排。这个可以。两周以后根据什么评估？看开会和准备共用了多久，也看最后谁做什么有没有说清。要是有个问题二十分钟讲不完呢？先看需要谁。只有两个人相关，就另外约，不让其他四个一直等。但那个时间也要算进去。对。不是换个名字，就不算开会了。好，我可以试。材料最晚什么时候写？周四中午以前。周二下班前，我先确认大家三点都方便。那先等答复，别现在就告诉客户时间已经改好了。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ měi zhōu de huì gǎi duǎn yī diǎn , xiān shì liǎng zhōu . xiàn zài sì shí wǔ fēn zhōng , nǐ xiǎng gǎi chéng duō jiǔ ? èr shí fēn zhōng . měi gè rén xiān xiě sān diǎn , zhǐ tǎo lùn xū yào yì qǐ jué dìng de . nà zhǔn bèi cái liào de shí jiān huì bù huì gèng zhǎng ? bié zhǐ suàn kāi huì . duì , zhè gè yě yào jì . měi diǎn zuì duō liǎng sān jù , bù zuò zhěng yè jiè shào . shí jiān hái shi zhōu sì wǔ diǎn ma ? kè hù nà biān wǔ diǎn bàn kě néng lái diàn huà . wǒ xiān xiǎng zhōu sān sān diǎn , kě zhǐ wèn le sān gè rén , hái yǒu sān gè méi dá fù . wǒ zhōu sān sān diǎn yào jiàn kè hù , zhè gè shí jiān bù xíng . nà zhōu sì sān diǎn ne ? wǒ xiān wèn wán liù gè rén , zài fā xīn ān pái . zhè gè kě yǐ . liǎng zhōu yǐ hòu gēn jù shén me píng gū ? kàn kāi huì hé zhǔn bèi gòng yòng le duō jiǔ , yě kàn zuì hòu shéi zuò shén me yǒu méi yǒu shuō qīng . yào shì yǒu gè wèn tí èr shí fēn zhōng jiǎng bù wán ne ? xiān kàn xū yào shéi . zhǐ yǒu liǎng gè rén xiāng guān , jiù lìng wài yuē , bù ràng qí tā sì gè yì zhí děng . dàn nà gè shí jiān yě yào suàn jìn qù . duì . bù shì huàn gè míng zi , jiù bù suàn kāi huì le . hǎo , wǒ kě yǐ shì . cái liào zuì wǎn shén me shí hou xiě ? zhōu sì zhōng wǔ yǐ qián . zhōu èr xià bān qián , wǒ xiān què rèn dà jiā sān diǎn dōu fāng biàn . nà xiān děng dá fù , bié xiàn zài jiù gào sù kè hù shí jiān yǐ jīng gǎi hǎo le .
meaning: I’d like to shorten the weekly meeting for a two-week trial. It’s forty-five minutes now. How long do you propose? Twenty minutes. Each person writes three points first; we discuss what needs a joint decision. Will preparation take longer? Don’t count only the meeting. Right, we should record that too. Two or three sentences per point, not a full-page presentation. Still Thursday at five? The customer may call at half five. I first thought Wednesday at three, but have asked only three people; three haven’t replied. I have a customer meeting Wednesday at three; that won’t work. What about Thursday at three? I’ll ask all six before sending a new schedule. That works. What will you use for the assessment after two weeks? Total meeting and preparation time, plus whether responsibilities were clear at the end. What if a question can’t be finished in twenty minutes? Check who is needed. If only two people are involved, arrange a separate time rather than keeping the other four waiting. But that time needs counting too. Right. Renaming it doesn’t mean it stops being meeting time. Okay, I’ll try. When is the latest for writing the notes? Before Thursday noon. Before leaving work Tuesday I’ll first confirm that three suits everyone. Then wait for the replies. Don’t tell the customer the time has changed already.

parts.text: 我想把每周的会改短一点，先试两周。
现在四十五分钟，你想改成多久？
二十分钟。每个人先写三点，只讨论需要一起决定的。
那准备材料的时间会不会更长？别只算开会。
对，这个也要记。每点最多两三句，不做整页介绍。
时间还是周四五点吗？客户那边五点半可能来电话。
我先想周三三点，可只问了三个人，还有三个没答复。
我周三三点要见客户，这个时间不行。
那周四三点呢？我先问完六个人，再发新安排。
这个可以。两周以后根据什么评估？
看开会和准备共用了多久，也看最后谁做什么有没有说清。
要是有个问题二十分钟讲不完呢？
先看需要谁。只有两个人相关，就另外约，不让其他四个一直等。
但那个时间也要算进去。

好，我可以试。材料最晚什么时候写？
周四中午以前。周二下班前，我先确认大家三点都方便。
那先等答复，别现在就告诉客户时间已经改好了。

text: 我们六个人每周四下午五点开会，一般聊四十五分钟。有时五点半客户打电话，一位同事就要出去接，回来又问刚才决定了什么。我想把会议改早、改短，出于方便大家的考虑，先提出周三三点、二十分钟。说出来时我觉得很简单，听到同事的问题，才发现自己只想到了会议里面的时间。
pinyin: wǒ men liù gè rén měi zhōu sì xià wǔ wǔ diǎn kāi huì , yì bān liáo sì shí wǔ fēn zhōng . yǒu shí wǔ diǎn bàn kè hù dǎ diàn huà , yī wèi tóng shì jiù yào chū qù jiē , huí lái yòu wèn gāng cái jué dìng le shén me . wǒ xiǎng bǎ huì yì gǎi zǎo , gǎi duǎn , chū yú fāng biàn dà jiā de kǎo lǜ , xiān tí chū zhōu sān sān diǎn , èr shí fēn zhōng . shuō chū lái shí wǒ jué de hěn jiǎn dān , tīng dào tóng shì de wèn tí , cái fā xiàn zì jǐ zhǐ xiǎng dào le huì yì lǐ miàn de shí jiān .
meaning: Our six-person team met Thursdays at five for about forty-five minutes. A customer call at 5:30 sometimes took a colleague out, who then needed the decisions repeated. I proposed Wednesday at three for twenty minutes. It sounded simple until colleagues' questions showed I’d counted only time inside the meeting.

text: 第一个问题是准备材料。我建议每个人提前写三点，只讨论需要一起决定的事情。同事问，会开短了，材料会不会反而要做一整页。我说不用做一页，每点两三句话就好，后来也把准备时间放进记录里。短的目标不是把同样长的内容换个地方做，而是让大家先知道最需要决定的是什么。
pinyin: dì yī gè wèn tí shì zhǔn bèi cái liào . wǒ jiàn yì měi gè rén tí qián xiě sān diǎn , zhǐ tǎo lùn xū yào yì qǐ jué dìng de shì qíng . tóng shì wèn , huì kāi duǎn le , cái liào huì bù huì fǎn ér yào zuò yī zhěng yè . wǒ shuō bù yòng zuò yī yè , měi diǎn liǎng sān jù huà jiù hǎo , hòu lái yě bǎ zhǔn bèi shí jiān fàng jìn jì lù lǐ . duǎn de mù biāo bù shì bǎ tóng yàng zhǎng de nèi róng huàn gè dì fāng zuò , ér shì ràng dà jiā xiān zhī dào zuì xū yào jué dìng de shì shén me .
meaning: I suggested three points in advance, discussing only joint decisions. A colleague worried preparation would become a full-page document. I proposed two or three sentences per point and included preparation time in the record. The goal wasn’t moving equally long work elsewhere, but identifying the most important decisions.

text: 第二个问题是时间。我只问了三个人，觉得三点大概方便，就先写进方案。另外一位说，周三三点要见客户，不能来。我这才把还没收到的答复和已经同意分开。我们换成周四三点这个选择，但没有立刻发通知。我到周二下班前问完六个人，收到答复以后才确定两周试用。
pinyin: dì èr gè wèn tí shì shí jiān . wǒ zhǐ wèn le sān gè rén , jué de sān diǎn dà gài fāng biàn , jiù xiān xiě jìn fāng àn . lìng wài yī wèi shuō , zhōu sān sān diǎn yào jiàn kè hù , bù néng lái . wǒ zhè cái bǎ hái méi shōu dào de dá fù hé yǐ jīng tóng yì fēn kāi . wǒ men huàn chéng zhōu sì sān diǎn zhè gè xuǎn zé , dàn méi yǒu lì kè fā tōng zhī . wǒ dào zhōu èr xià bān qián wèn wán liù gè rén , shōu dào dá fù yǐ hòu cái què dìng liǎng zhōu shì yòng .
meaning: I had checked only three people’s availability and assumed three was likely suitable. Another had a customer appointment on Wednesday at three. I separated missing replies from agreement. We considered Thursday at three, but waited until all six had replied before Tuesday’s finish to confirm the two-week trial.

text: 第一次按新安排开会，我准备三点用了五分钟，会议用了十八分钟。有人没有问题要一起决定，就简单说这周按原安排继续。大家结束时知道谁负责联系场地、谁问人数、谁确认客户的时间。我觉得轻松了一些，不过没有说十八分钟本身就能证明有成效；如果结束以后还得四处问刚才决定了什么，短也没有解决问题。
pinyin: dì yī cì àn xīn ān pái kāi huì , wǒ zhǔn bèi sān diǎn yòng le wǔ fēn zhōng , huì yì yòng le shí bā fēn zhōng . yǒu rén méi yǒu wèn tí yào yì qǐ jué dìng , jiù jiǎn dān shuō zhè zhōu àn yuán ān pái jì xù . dà jiā jié shù shí zhī dào shéi fù zé lián xì chǎng dì , shéi wèn rén shù , shéi què rèn kè hù de shí jiān . wǒ jué de qīng sōng le yī xiē , bù guò méi yǒu shuō shí bā fēn zhōng běn shēn jiù néng zhèng míng yǒu chéng xiào ; rú guǒ jié shù yǐ hòu hái děi sì chù wèn gāng cái jué dìng le shén me , duǎn yě méi yǒu jiě jué wèn tí .
meaning: In the first trial I spent five minutes preparing and eighteen in the meeting. People without joint questions briefly confirmed existing work. At the end responsibilities for venue, numbers and customer time were clear. I felt relief, without treating eighteen minutes alone as proof of effectiveness; having to chase decisions afterwards would still be a problem.

text: 第二次有一个场地问题。原来能用的房间临时要维修，活动是否改到室内，和采购什么东西都有关系。我们用了二十六分钟，没有在二十分钟一到就假装问题已经讲完。最后两个负责的人又谈了十分钟，我也是其中一个。那天我准备材料用了十二分钟，把自己的时间加起来，一共四十八分钟，比第一次多得很明显。
pinyin: dì èr cì yǒu yī gè chǎng dì wèn tí . yuán lái néng yòng de fáng jiān lín shí yào wéi xiū , huó dòng shì fǒu gǎi dào shì nèi , hé cǎi gòu shén me dōng xi dōu yǒu guān xì . wǒ men yòng le èr shí liù fēn zhōng , méi yǒu zài èr shí fēn zhōng yī dào jiù jiǎ zhuāng wèn tí yǐ jīng jiǎng wán . zuì hòu liǎng gè fù zé de rén yòu tán le shí fēn zhōng , wǒ yě shì qí zhōng yī gè . nà tiān wǒ zhǔn bèi cái liào yòng le shí èr fēn zhōng , bǎ zì jǐ de shí jiān jiā qǐ lái , yī gòng sì shí bā fēn zhōng , bǐ dì yī cì duō de hěn míng xiǎn .
meaning: The second trial involved room repairs affecting the indoor venue and purchases. We took twenty-six minutes rather than pretending the issue was finished at twenty. Two responsible people, including me, then talked for ten minutes. With my twelve-minute preparation, my total was forty-eight minutes, noticeably more than the first trial.

text: 同事提醒，四十八分钟不能直接和以前四十五分钟相比，因为以前我们只记过会议时间，没有记我准备了多久。他说得对。我们能看出这次有额外工作，也能发现哪部分需要改，但还不能说整个方案一定省时间。把没记录的时间当成零，结果就会看起来比实际好；拿一次有问题的会当作所有会议，也会太快下结论。
pinyin: tóng shì tí xǐng , sì shí bā fēn zhōng bù néng zhí jiē hé yǐ qián sì shí wǔ fēn zhōng xiāng bǐ , yīn wèi yǐ qián wǒ men zhǐ jì guò huì yì shí jiān , méi yǒu jì wǒ zhǔn bèi le duō jiǔ . tā shuō de duì . wǒ men néng kàn chū zhè cì yǒu é wài gōng zuò , yě néng fā xiàn nǎ bù fèn xū yào gǎi , dàn hái bù néng shuō zhěng gè fāng àn yí dìng shěng shí jiān . bǎ méi jì lù de shí jiān dàng chéng líng , jié guǒ jiù huì kàn qǐ lái bǐ shí jì hǎo ; ná yī cì yǒu wèn tí de huì dàng zuò suǒ yǒu huì yì , yě huì tài kuài xià jié lùn .
meaning: A colleague noted that forty-eight couldn’t directly be compared with the old forty-five: we’d recorded only the old meeting, not my preparation. We could identify extra work and revisions, but not claim the whole plan saved time. Treating unrecorded time as zero would flatter the result, while one problematic meeting couldn’t represent them all.

text: 两周以后，我们先保留周四三点，再调整材料。每个人除了三点，也写一句最需要谁回答；只有两个人相关的细节，能提前问就提前问。采购的人要知道实际数量，不用等全组都看完颜色和包装。我们没有减少需要一起决定的问题，只把不需要六个人一起等的内容分开，另外花的时间仍然记录。
pinyin: liǎng zhōu yǐ hòu , wǒ men xiān bǎo liú zhōu sì sān diǎn , zài tiáo zhěng cái liào . měi gè rén chú le sān diǎn , yě xiě yī jù zuì xū yào shéi huí dá ; zhǐ yǒu liǎng gè rén xiāng guān de xì jié , néng tí qián wèn jiù tí qián wèn . cǎi gòu de rén yào zhī dào shí jì shù liàng , bù yòng děng quán zǔ dōu kàn wán yán sè hé bāo zhuāng . wǒ men méi yǒu jiǎn shǎo xū yào yì qǐ jué dìng de wèn tí , zhǐ bǎ bù xū yào liù gè rén yì qǐ děng de nèi róng fēn kāi , lìng wài huā de shí jiān réng rán jì lù .
meaning: After two weeks we kept Thursday at three and added who needed to answer each question. Details involving only two people could be checked earlier. Purchasers needed actual quantities without waiting for everyone to inspect colours and packaging. We separated work not requiring all six while still recording the additional time.

text: 这个方案从最初一个简单想法，变成了有条件的尝试。有人愿意试，有人先问代价，都帮我看见没想到的地方。我们没有因为第二次用了二十六分钟，就把所有内容恢复到原样，也没有因为第一次只有十八分钟，就说以后只能这样。接下来再记录两周，把问题和改法一起留下，才知道哪些部分值得继续。
pinyin: zhè gè fāng àn cóng zuì chū yī gè jiǎn dān xiǎng fǎ , biàn chéng le yǒu tiáo jiàn de cháng shì . yǒu rén yuàn yì shì , yǒu rén xiān wèn dài jià , dōu bāng wǒ kàn jiàn méi xiǎng dào de dì fāng . wǒ men méi yǒu yīn wèi dì èr cì yòng le èr shí liù fēn zhōng , jiù bǎ suǒ yǒu nèi róng huī fù dào yuán yàng , yě méi yǒu yīn wèi dì yī cì zhǐ yǒu shí bā fēn zhōng , jiù shuō yǐ hòu zhǐ néng zhè yàng . jiē xià lái zài jì lù liǎng zhōu , bǎ wèn tí hé gǎi fǎ yì qǐ liú xià , cái zhī dào nǎ xiē bù fèn zhí de jì xù .
meaning: The simple idea became a conditional trial. Willingness and objections both exposed gaps. We didn’t restore everything after the twenty-six-minute meeting or make the eighteen-minute one a permanent rule. Two more weeks of recording problems and revisions would show which parts deserved keeping.

meaning: Our six-person team met Thursdays at five for about forty-five minutes. A customer call at 5:30 sometimes took a colleague out, who then needed the decisions repeated. I proposed Wednesday at three for twenty minutes. It sounded simple until colleagues' questions showed I’d counted only time inside the meeting. I suggested three points in advance, discussing only joint decisions. A colleague worried preparation would become a full-page document. I proposed two or three sentences per point and included preparation time in the record. The goal wasn’t moving equally long work elsewhere, but identifying the most important decisions. I had checked only three people’s availability and assumed three was likely suitable. Another had a customer appointment on Wednesday at three. I separated missing replies from agreement. We considered Thursday at three, but waited until all six had replied before Tuesday’s finish to confirm the two-week trial. In the first trial I spent five minutes preparing and eighteen in the meeting. People without joint questions briefly confirmed existing work. At the end responsibilities for venue, numbers and customer time were clear. I felt relief, without treating eighteen minutes alone as proof of effectiveness; having to chase decisions afterwards would still be a problem. The second trial involved room repairs affecting the indoor venue and purchases. We took twenty-six minutes rather than pretending the issue was finished at twenty. Two responsible people, including me, then talked for ten minutes. With my twelve-minute preparation, my total was forty-eight minutes, noticeably more than the first trial. A colleague noted that forty-eight couldn’t directly be compared with the old forty-five: we’d recorded only the old meeting, not my preparation. We could identify extra work and revisions, but not claim the whole plan saved time. Treating unrecorded time as zero would flatter the result, while one problematic meeting couldn’t represent them all. After two weeks we kept Thursday at three and added who needed to answer each question. Details involving only two people could be checked earlier. Purchasers needed actual quantities without waiting for everyone to inspect colours and packaging. We separated work not requiring all six while still recording the additional time. The simple idea became a conditional trial. Willingness and objections both exposed gaps. We didn’t restore everything after the twenty-six-minute meeting or make the eighteen-minute one a permanent rule. Two more weeks of recording problems and revisions would show which parts deserved keeping.

text: 人员变动以后，这部分没人负责。
pinyin: rén yuán biàn dòng yǐ hòu , zhè bù fèn méi rén fù zé .
meaning: After the staff change, nobody was responsible for this section.

text: 两边达成了一个先试两周的安排。
pinyin: liǎng biān dá chéng le yī gè xiān shì liǎng zhōu de ān pái .
meaning: The two sides reached an agreement to try it for two weeks.

text: 这个办法的成效要看后面的情况。
pinyin: zhè gè bàn fǎ de chéng xiào yào kàn hòu miàn de qíng kuàng .
meaning: The effectiveness of this approach depends on what follows.

text: 收到答复以后，我才改了时间。
pinyin: shōu dào dá fù yǐ hòu , wǒ cái gǎi le shí jiān .
meaning: I changed the time only after receiving a reply.

text: 只传达结论，不传达原因，容易误会。
pinyin: zhǐ chuán dá jié lùn , bù chuán dá yuán yīn , róng yì wù huì .
meaning: Conveying the conclusion without the reason can cause misunderstandings.

text: 消息传递了几次，开会时间就被说错了。
pinyin: xiāo xī chuán dì le jǐ cì , kāi huì shí jiān jiù bèi shuō cuò le .
meaning: After the message passed through several people, the meeting time was misreported.

text: 这个名字不易记，我们再写一遍。
pinyin: zhè gè míng zi bù yì jì , wǒ men zài xiě yī biàn .
meaning: This name is hard to remember; let’s write it again.

text: 她出于好意提醒我，却没有替我做决定。
pinyin: tā chū yú hǎo yì tí xǐng wǒ , què méi yǒu tì wǒ zuò jué dìng .
meaning: She reminded me with good intentions without deciding for me.

text: 我们把重复的内容合在一起，从而缩短了介绍。
pinyin: wǒ men bǎ chóng fù de nèi róng hé zài yì qǐ , cóng ér suō duǎn le jiè shào .
meaning: We combined repeated material and thereby shortened the introduction.

text: 这里的工作不单一，除了介绍，还要回答问题。
pinyin: zhè lǐ de gōng zuò bù dān yī , chú le jiè shào , hái yào huí dá wèn tí .
meaning: The work here is varied: introducing things and answering questions.

text: 活动初期，大家还不知道去哪里登记。
pinyin: huó dòng chū qī , dà jiā hái bù zhī dào qù nǎ lǐ dēng jì .
meaning: Early in the event, people did not know where to register.

text: 两次结果的差距不大，别只说好很多。
pinyin: liǎng cì jié guǒ de chā jù bù dà , bié zhǐ shuō hǎo hěn duō .
meaning: The gap between the two results is small; do not merely call it much better.

text: 她负责采购，我负责把东西送过去。
pinyin: tā fù zé cǎi gòu , wǒ fù zé bǎ dōng xi sòng guò qù .
meaning: She handles purchases, and I take the items there.

text: 补贴还没到账，我们先问负责的人。
pinyin: bǔ tiē hái méi dào zhàng , wǒ men xiān wèn fù zé de rén .
meaning: The allowance has not arrived; we will ask the person responsible.

text: 这篇文章层次很清楚，每一段都有重点。
pinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng céng cì hěn qīng chǔ , měi yī duàn dōu yǒu zhòng diǎn .
meaning: The article has a clear structure, with a focus in each paragraph.

text: 省了钱，却花了很多时间，这也是代价。
pinyin: shěng le qián , què huā le hěn duō shí jiān , zhè yě shì dài jià .
meaning: Money was saved but much time spent; that is a cost too.

text: 我大致明白了，还想问两个细节。
pinyin: wǒ dà zhì míng bái le , hái xiǎng wèn liǎng gè xì jié .
meaning: I roughly understand but want to ask about two details.

text: 第一次尝试没有成功，她换了一个方法。
pinyin: dì yī cì cháng shì méi yǒu chéng gōng , tā huàn le yī gè fāng fǎ .
meaning: Her first attempt failed, so she tried another approach.

fā xiàn wèn tí , jiù jí shí jì xià lái . xiān shì liǎng zhōu , zài píng gū yǒu méi yǒu bāng zhù . zhè cì píng gū bāo kuò shí jiān hé shí jì gōng zuò . nǐ xuǎn zhè gè shí jiān , yǒu shén me yī jù ? yì wèn tí , biàn yú dà jiā zhǔn bèi . bǎ cái liào fàng zài tóng yī gè dì fāng , biàn yú chá zhǎo . shí jiān yǒu biàn dòng , qǐng zài què rèn yī cì . rén yuán biàn dòng yǐ hòu , zhè bù fèn méi rén fù zé . wǒ men hái méi dá chéng yí zhì , xiān bú yào fā tōng zhī . liǎng biān dá chéng le yī gè xiān shì liǎng zhōu de ān pái . huì kāi de duǎn , bù yí dìng dài biǎo yǒu chéng xiào . zhè gè bàn fǎ de chéng bù yì zhǎo dào . zhè gè míng zi bù yì jì , wǒ men zài xiě yī biàn . wǒ chū yú fāng biàn kè hù de kǎo lǜ , xiǎng bǎ huì yì tí qián . tā chū yú hǎo yì tí xǐng wǒ , què méi yǒu tì wǒ zuò jué dìng . xiān yī . zhè lǐ de gōng zuò bù dān yī , chú le jiè shào , hái yào huí dá wèn tí . chū qī xiān yòng jiǎn dān de biǎo , bù jí zhe jiā gōng néng . huó dòng chū qī , dà jiā hái bù zhī dào qù nǎ lǐ dēng jì . chǔ yī xiē . zhè piān wén zhāng céng cì hěn qīng chǔ , měi yī duàn dōu yǒu zhòng diǎn . rú guǒ shǎo kāi huì de dài jià shì dà jiā bù zhī dào gāi zuò shén me , jiù yào zài gǎi . shěng le qián , què huā le hěn duō shí jiān , zhè yě shì dài jià . wǒ men xiān shuō dà zhì ān pái , jù tǐ shí jiān děng dá fù . wǒ dà zhì míng bái le , hái xiǎng wèn liǎng gè xì jié . wǒ men kě yǐ cháng shì liǎng zhōu , bù bì yī cì dìng yī nián . dì yī cì cháng shì méi yǒu chéng gōng , tā huàn le yī gè fāng fǎ .

text: 同事提出把会改到周三三点，我先说这个时间不行。我那天下午要见客户，时间已经约好，不想因为内部会议再改。我担心他把这个回答理解成我反对所有变化，就补了一句：改短可以试，但要先问完大家。我们讨论的不是谁更愿意合作，而是哪个安排真的能让六个人到场。
pinyin: tóng shì tí chū bǎ huì gǎi dào zhōu sān sān diǎn , wǒ xiān shuō zhè gè shí jiān bù xíng . wǒ nà tiān xià wǔ yào jiàn kè hù , shí jiān yǐ jīng yuē hǎo , bù xiǎng yīn wèi nèi bù huì yì zài gǎi . wǒ dān xīn tā bǎ zhè gè huí dá lǐ jiě chéng wǒ fǎn duì suǒ yǒu biàn huà , jiù bǔ le yī jù : gǎi duǎn kě yǐ shì , dàn yào xiān wèn wán dà jiā . wǒ men tǎo lùn de bù shì shéi gèng yuàn yì hé zuò , ér shì nǎ gè ān pái zhēn de néng ràng liù gè rén dào chǎng .
meaning: When the colleague proposed Wednesday at three, I objected because of a confirmed customer appointment. I clarified I wasn’t rejecting every change: shorter meetings were worth trying after checking everyone’s availability. The issue wasn’t who was more cooperative, but what actually let all six attend.

text: 他说只收到三个人答复，我问另外三个人怎么办。没答复的人可能还没看见，也可能要确认自己的安排，不能算作同意。后来他问了周四三点，到周二下班前收齐回复，才发通知。我看见这个过程，比较放心，因为新时间不是一边说要确认，一边已经替所有人答应。
pinyin: tā shuō zhǐ shōu dào sān gè rén dá fù , wǒ wèn lìng wài sān gè rén zěn me bàn . méi dá fù de rén kě néng hái méi kàn jiàn , yě kě néng yào què rèn zì jǐ de ān pái , bù néng suàn zuò tóng yì . hòu lái tā wèn le zhōu sì sān diǎn , dào zhōu èr xià bān qián shōu qí huí fù , cái fā tōng zhī . wǒ kàn jiàn zhè gè guò chéng , bǐ jiào fàng xīn , yīn wèi xīn shí jiān bù shì yī biān shuō yào què rèn , yī biān yǐ jīng tì suǒ yǒu rén dā yìng .
meaning: Only three replies had arrived. Others might not have seen the request or might need to check their calendars, so silence wasn’t agreement. He checked Thursday at three and sent notice only after receiving all replies before Tuesday’s finish. That process reassured me; confirmation wasn’t promised after deciding on everyone’s behalf.

text: 我还问了材料的长度。以前我参加过一种很短的会，每个人会前要做很长的介绍，结果会议时间少了，准备时间更多。这个同事听完，没有说我想得太多，而是把记录增加到包括准备。他也同意每点只写两三句，先说明问题，不需要把所有背景都写成一个新的报告。
pinyin: wǒ hái wèn le cái liào de cháng dù . yǐ qián wǒ cān jiā guò yī zhǒng hěn duǎn de huì , měi gè rén huì qián yào zuò hěn zhǎng de jiè shào , jié guǒ huì yì shí jiān shǎo le , zhǔn bèi shí jiān gèng duō . zhè gè tóng shì tīng wán , méi yǒu shuō wǒ xiǎng de tài duō , ér shì bǎ jì lù zēng jiā dào bāo kuò zhǔn bèi . tā yě tóng yì měi diǎn zhǐ xiě liǎng sān jù , xiān shuō míng wèn tí , bù xū yào bǎ suǒ yǒu bèi jǐng dōu xiě chéng yī gè xīn de bào gào .
meaning: I’d attended short meetings requiring long advance presentations, cutting meeting time but increasing preparation. He listened and included preparation in the record. Each point would be two or three sentences identifying a problem, rather than making all background into a new report.

text: 第一次十八分钟结束，我知道自己下午要确认哪几个客户的时间，没有再去问一次。这个结果对我比十八这个数字更重要。另一个同事负责场地，结束前发现自己漏听了人数，就当场问清。我们没有为了守住二十分钟，把他的问题留到一封又一封邮件里，反而趁大家在一起补了一句。
pinyin: dì yī cì shí bā fēn zhōng jié shù , wǒ zhī dào zì jǐ xià wǔ yào què rèn nǎ jǐ gè kè hù de shí jiān , méi yǒu zài qù wèn yī cì . zhè gè jié guǒ duì wǒ bǐ shí bā zhè gè shù zì gèng zhòng yào . lìng yī gè tóng shì fù zé chǎng dì , jié shù qián fā xiàn zì jǐ lòu tīng le rén shù , jiù dāng chǎng wèn qīng . wǒ men méi yǒu wèi le shǒu zhù èr shí fēn zhōng , bǎ tā de wèn tí liú dào yī fēng yòu yī fēng yóu jiàn lǐ , fǎn ér chèn dà jiā zài yì qǐ bǔ le yī jù .
meaning: After the first eighteen-minute meeting I knew which customer times to confirm. That mattered more than the number eighteen. The venue organiser clarified a missed attendance number before finishing. We didn’t protect twenty minutes by sending the question into repeated later emails; we settled it together.

text: 第二次场地要维修，采购和活动安排都受到影响。会开了二十六分钟，后来还有两个人继续谈。我不是那两个人，就回去确认客户的时间。快下班时，准备材料的同事过来问我记录放在哪里，我把表打开给他看：我只参加了前面的会议，后面十分钟是他和另一个人的。他说对，那一段要另写，别把我的时间也算进去。
pinyin: dì èr cì chǎng dì yào wéi xiū , cǎi gòu hé huó dòng ān pái dōu shòu dào yǐng xiǎng . huì kāi le èr shí liù fēn zhōng , hòu lái hái yǒu liǎng gè rén jì xù tán . wǒ bù shì nà liǎng gè rén , jiù huí qù què rèn kè hù de shí jiān . kuài xià bān shí , zhǔn bèi cái liào de tóng shì guò lái wèn wǒ jì lù fàng zài nǎ lǐ , wǒ bǎ biǎo dǎ kāi gěi tā kàn : wǒ zhǐ cān jiā le qián miàn de huì yì , hòu miàn shí fēn zhōng shì tā hé lìng yī gè rén de . tā shuō duì , nà yī duàn yào lìng xiě , bié bǎ wǒ de shí jiān yě suàn jìn qù .
meaning: Repairs to the venue affected both purchasing and activity plans. The meeting lasted twenty-six minutes, then two people continued. I wasn't one of them and returned to confirming customer times. Near the end of the day my colleague asked where the records were. I showed him: I'd attended only the main meeting; the extra ten minutes belonged to him and someone else. Right, he said—record it separately rather than adding it to my time.

text: 准备材料最多的同事说自己那天一共用了四十八分钟。我提醒他，以前的准备没有记录，四十五只是会议本身。我们不是想让数字永远好看，也不是一看到增加就停止。知道旧记录少了什么，才能公平一点比较。后来我们把记录写得更具体，会议、个人准备、另外讨论分别记，不把所有时间混在同一个格子里。
pinyin: zhǔn bèi cái liào zuì duō de tóng shì shuō zì jǐ nà tiān yī gòng yòng le sì shí bā fēn zhōng . wǒ tí xǐng tā , yǐ qián de zhǔn bèi méi yǒu jì lù , sì shí wǔ zhǐ shì huì yì běn shēn . wǒ men bù shì xiǎng ràng shù zì yǒng yuǎn hǎo kàn , yě bù shì yī kàn dào zēng jiā jiù tíng zhǐ . zhī dào jiù jì lù shǎo le shén me , cái néng gōng píng yī diǎn bǐ jiào . hòu lái wǒ men bǎ jì lù xiě de gèng jù tǐ , huì yì , gè rén zhǔn bèi , lìng wài tǎo lùn fēn bié jì , bù bǎ suǒ yǒu shí jiān hùn zài tóng yī gè gé zi lǐ .
meaning: The colleague with the most preparation reported forty-eight total minutes. I reminded him the old forty-five was only the meeting. We weren’t trying to flatter numbers or stop at any increase. Understanding the missing baseline allowed fairer comparison. We recorded meetings, personal preparation and separate discussion in different fields.

text: 两周的尝试结束，我同意继续周四三点，但提出新的问题：如果客户临时需要联系，有没有办法先把我负责的内容说完。我不要求每次都排第一，只希望有变化时能协调。对方说先问当天有没有急的事情，再决定顺序。我觉得这样比一年固定一种顺序更符合我们的工作，也还需要在后面试。
pinyin: liǎng zhōu de cháng shì jié shù , wǒ tóng yì jì xù zhōu sì sān diǎn , dàn tí chū xīn de wèn tí : rú guǒ kè hù lín shí xū yào lián xì , yǒu méi yǒu bàn fǎ xiān bǎ wǒ fù zé de nèi róng shuō wán . wǒ bú yào qiú měi cì dōu pái dì yī , zhǐ xī wàng yǒu biàn huà shí néng xié tiáo . duì fāng shuō xiān wèn dàng tiān yǒu méi yǒu jí de shì qíng , zài jué dìng shùn xù . wǒ jué de zhè yàng bǐ yī nián gù dìng yī zhǒng shùn xù gèng fú hé wǒ men de gōng zuò , yě hái xū yào zài hòu miàn shì .
meaning: After two weeks I supported keeping Thursday at three and asked about covering my items early if a customer unexpectedly needed me. I wasn’t demanding always going first. We would check urgent matters and set an order each day. That seemed better suited to our work than a year-long fixed sequence, though still needing trials.

text: 我对这个方案的评价，不是同意的人多就一定好，也不是有人提反对就一定不行。最有用的变化是大家能说明原因，再把实际办法改出来。提出想法的人没有失去面子，提问题的人也没有被叫作不合作。我们还会有分歧，但至少知道下次该拿什么情况来谈，而不是只说我觉得快、你觉得慢。
pinyin: wǒ duì zhè gè fāng àn de píng jià , bù shì tóng yì de rén duō jiù yí dìng hǎo , yě bù shì yǒu rén tí fǎn duì jiù yí dìng bù xíng . zuì yǒu yòng de biàn huà shì dà jiā néng shuō míng yuán yīn , zài bǎ shí jì bàn fǎ gǎi chū lái . tí chū xiǎng fǎ de rén méi yǒu shī qù miàn zi , tí wèn tí de rén yě méi yǒu bèi jiào zuò bù hé zuò . wǒ men hái huì yǒu fēn qí , dàn zhì shǎo zhī dào xià cì gāi ná shén me qíng kuàng lái tán , ér bù shì zhǐ shuō wǒ jué de kuài , nǐ jué de màn .
meaning: My judgment wasn’t that many supporters proved it good or one objection proved it bad. The useful change was explaining reasons and revising actions. Neither proposal nor objection meant losing face or being called uncooperative. Disagreement would remain, but now we knew what evidence to discuss beyond feelings of fast or slow.

shì nǎ gè ān pái zhēn de néng ràng liù gè rén dào chǎng . tā shuō zhǐ shōu dào sān gè rén dá fù , wǒ wèn lìng wài sān gè rén zěn me bàn . méi dá fù de rén kě néng hái méi kàn jiàn , yě kě néng yào què 准备材料最多的同事说自己那天一共用了四十八分钟。我提醒他，以前的准备没有记录，四十五只是会议本身。我们不是想让数字永远好看，也不是一看到增加就停止。知道旧记录少了什么，才能公平一点比较。后来我们把记录写得更具体，会议、个人准备、另外讨论分别记，不把所有时间混在同一个格子里。
两周的尝试结束，我同意继续周四三点，但提出新的问题：如果客户临时需要联系，有没有办法先把我负责的内容说完。我不要求每次都排第一，只希望有变化时能协调。对方说先问当天有没有急的事情，再决定顺序。我觉得这样比一年固定一种顺序更符合我们的工作，也还需要在后面试。
我对这个方案的评价，不是同意的人多就一定好，也不是有人提反对就一定不行。最有用的变化是大家能说明原因，再把实际办法改出来。提出想法的人没有失去面子，提问题的人也没有被叫作不合作。我们还会有分歧，但至少知道下次该拿什么情况来谈，而不是只说我觉得快、你觉得慢。

text: 周六的旧书交换，还有什么没确认？
pinyin: zhōu liù de jiù shū jiāo huàn , hái yǒu shén me méi què rèn ?
meaning: What is still unconfirmed for Saturday’s book exchange?

text: 房间。原来订的二楼房间要维修，负责人说可以换到一楼。
pinyin: fáng jiān . yuán lái dìng de èr lóu fáng jiān yào wéi xiū , fù zé rén shuō kě yǐ huàn dào yī lóu .
meaning: The room. The original upstairs room needs repairs; the organiser says we can move downstairs.

text: 一楼那个有多大？我们共计二十八人呢。
pinyin: yī lóu nà gè yǒu duō dà ? wǒ men gòng jì èr shí bā rén ne .
meaning: How big is the downstairs one? We have twenty-eight people in total.

text: 能进三十个人，座位只有二十四个。四个负责的人不用一直坐。
pinyin: néng jìn sān shí gè rén , zuò wèi zhǐ yǒu èr shí sì gè . sì gè fù zé de rén bù yòng yì zhí zuò .
meaning: It holds thirty people but has twenty-four seats. The four organisers don’t need to sit throughout.

text: 二十八已经包括我们四个，对吧？
pinyin: èr shí bā yǐ jīng bāo kuò wǒ men sì gè , duì ba ?
meaning: The twenty-eight already includes the four of us, right?

text: 对。不是二十八再加四个。名单里都写了。
pinyin: duì . bù shì èr shí bā zài jiā sì gè . míng dān lǐ dōu xiě le .
meaning: Right. Not twenty-eight plus four; the list includes us.

text: 那先确认新房间，再发公告。别还没定就让大家找。
pinyin: nà xiān què rèn xīn fáng jiān , zài fā gōng gào . bié hái méi dìng jiù ràng dà jiā zhǎo .
meaning: Then confirm the new room before announcing it. Don’t send everyone looking before it’s settled.

text: 我今天下午问。确认以后，把邮件附件里的地图也改掉。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān xià wǔ wèn . què rèn yǐ hòu , bǎ yóu jiàn fù jiàn lǐ de dì tú yě gǎi diào .
meaning: I’ll ask this afternoon, then update the map in the email attachment.

text: 门口那张纸呢？有些人可能只看了原来的安排。
pinyin: mén kǒu nà zhāng zhǐ ne ? yǒu xiē rén kě néng zhǐ kàn le yuán lái de ān pái .
meaning: And the paper at the entrance? Some may have seen only the old plan.

text: 也换。我在原来的门口等半小时，告诉来的人往哪里走。
pinyin: yě huàn . wǒ zài yuán lái de mén kǒu děng bàn xiǎo shí , gào sù lái de rén wǎng nǎ lǐ zǒu .
meaning: Replace it too. I’ll wait at the original entrance for half an hour to give directions.

text: 你一个人等，搬书谁帮？
pinyin: nǐ yī gè rén děng , bān shū shéi bāng ?
meaning: If you’re waiting alone, who helps move the books?

text: 另外三个人先搬。我进去以后，再准备分享环节。
pinyin: lìng wài sān gè rén xiān bān . wǒ jìn qù yǐ hòu , zài zhǔn bèi fēn xiǎng huán jié .
meaning: The other three move them first. When I join them, I’ll prepare the sharing session.

text: 每个人都要上去讲吗？
pinyin: měi gè rén dōu yào shàng qù jiǎng ma ?
meaning: Does everyone have to speak at the front?

text: 不用，自愿。想听的可以一直听，不影响换书。
pinyin: bù yòng , zì yuàn . xiǎng tīng de kě yǐ yì zhí tīng , bù yǐng xiǎng huàn shū .
meaning: No, it’s voluntary. People can just listen and still exchange books.

text: 要是换房间时已经有人拿书呢？
pinyin: yào shì huàn fáng jiān shí yǐ jīng yǒu rén ná shū ne ?
meaning: What if people are already taking books when we move rooms?

text: 先暂停，问清楚是谁的、换好了没有，再一起搬。
pinyin: xiān zàn tíng , wèn qīng chǔ shì shéi de , huàn hǎo le méi yǒu , zài yì qǐ bān .
meaning: Pause first, check ownership and whether exchanges are agreed, then move them together.

text: 好。我们是在换地方，不是在把书全换成自己的。
pinyin: hǎo . wǒ men shì zài huàn dì fāng , bù shì zài bǎ shū quán huàn chéng zì jǐ de .
meaning: Okay. We are changing rooms, not making every book our own.

text: 这个提醒给你自己吧，你上次拿着别人的书讲了十分钟。
pinyin: zhè gè tí xǐng gěi nǐ zì jǐ ba , nǐ shàng cì ná zhe bié ren de shū jiǎng le shí fēn zhōng .
meaning: Keep that reminder for yourself. Last time you talked for ten minutes holding someone else’s book.

text: 这次旧书交换原来安排在周六下午两点，二楼的小房间。周四我们收到通知，房间要维修，可以申请换到一楼。四个组织的人先核对名单：共计二十八人，已经包括我们四个，不是另外还有二十八位参加者。一楼能进三十人，但只有二十四个座位，这个区别也要说清楚，不能只看大的数字就答应所有新请求。
pinyin: zhè cì jiù shū jiāo huàn yuán lái ān pái zài zhōu liù xià wǔ liǎng diǎn , èr lóu de xiǎo fáng jiān . zhōu sì wǒ men shōu dào tōng zhī , fáng jiān yào wéi xiū , kě yǐ shēn qǐng huàn dào yī lóu . sì gè zǔ zhī de rén xiān hé duì míng dān : gòng jì èr shí bā rén , yǐ jīng bāo kuò wǒ men sì gè , bù shì lìng wài hái yǒu èr shí bā wèi cān jiā zhě . yī lóu néng jìn sān shí rén , dàn zhǐ yǒu èr shí sì gè zuò wèi , zhè gè qū bié yě yào shuō qīng chǔ , bù néng zhǐ kàn dà de shù zì jiù dā yìng suǒ yǒu xīn qǐng qiú .
meaning: The book exchange was planned for Saturday at two in an upstairs room. On Thursday repairs led to an offer to apply for the downstairs room. Our total registration was twenty-eight, including four organisers, not twenty-eight guests plus four. The downstairs room held thirty but had twenty-four seats; we needed to distinguish capacity from seating rather than use the larger number for every request.

text: 当天我联系负责人，确认一楼房间能用到四点，桌子和座位可以留下。交换时大家会走动，分享时参加的二十四个人可以坐，组织的人不用一直坐着。得到确认以后，我才发布新的公告，写清时间不变、房间更换。我也打开邮件附件里的地图，把原来指向二楼的箭头改到一楼，免得文字说一楼，地图还叫人上楼。
pinyin: dàng tiān wǒ lián xì fù zé rén , què rèn yī lóu fáng jiān néng yòng dào sì diǎn , zhuō zi hé zuò wèi kě yǐ liú xià . jiāo huàn shí dà jiā huì zǒu dòng , fēn xiǎng shí cān jiā de èr shí sì gè rén kě yǐ zuò , zǔ zhī de rén bù yòng yì zhí zuò zhe . dé dào què rèn yǐ hòu , wǒ cái fā bù xīn de gōng gào , xiě qīng shí jiān bù biàn , fáng jiān gēng huàn . wǒ yě dǎ kāi yóu jiàn fù jiàn lǐ de dì tú , bǎ yuán lái zhǐ xiàng èr lóu de jiàn tóu gǎi dào yī lóu , miǎn de wén zì shuō yī lóu , dì tú hái jiào rén shàng lóu .
meaning: I confirmed the room was available until four, with tables and seats retained. Guests could circulate during exchange and the twenty-four participants sit during sharing; organisers needn’t sit throughout. Only then did I announce the unchanged time and new room, also correcting the email map so its arrow no longer directed people upstairs.

text: 另外一位朋友检查二维码，发现扫出来还是旧安排。原来改了邮件，并不会让那张网页自己改变。我们把网页也改好，又用两部手机各看一次。我用自己的手机试了一次，又请旁边的朋友试，看到的都是新房间了。有位老人说他没有带手机，我把门口的纸给他看，指了指小厅的方向。他说原来就在隔壁，那不用回家拿手机了。
pinyin: lìng wài yī wèi péng you jiǎn chá èr wéi mǎ , fā xiàn sǎo chū lái hái shi jiù ān pái . yuán lái gǎi le yóu jiàn , bìng bù huì ràng nà zhāng wǎng yè zì jǐ gǎi biàn . wǒ men bǎ wǎng yè yě gǎi hǎo , yòu yòng liǎng bù shǒu jī gè kàn yī cì . wǒ yòng zì jǐ de shǒu jī shì le yī cì , yòu qǐng páng biān de péng you shì , kàn dào de dōu shì xīn fáng jiān le . yǒu wèi lǎo rén shuō tā méi yǒu dài shǒu jī , wǒ bǎ mén kǒu de zhǐ gěi tā kàn , zhǐ le zhǐ xiǎo tīng de fāng xiàng . tā shuō yuán lái jiù zài gé bì , nà bù yòng huí jiā ná shǒu jī le .
meaning: Another friend found that the QR code still opened the old schedule. Editing the email had not changed the webpage. We updated it and tried two phones; both now showed the new room. An older visitor had not brought a phone, so I showed him the paper notice and pointed towards the small hall. He was pleased it was next door: he would not need to go home for his phone.

text: 周六一点半，我站在原来的门口等了半小时，另外三个人先搬书。一个早到的人拿来两本，还没说好换什么，就把书放在桌上。我请大家先暂停拿书，把已经说好交换的和只是展示的分开。他问是不是活动终止了，我说没有，只是先把书和位置弄清楚，一楼摆好就恢复，开始时间仍然是两点。
pinyin: zhōu liù yī diǎn bàn , wǒ zhàn zài yuán lái de mén kǒu děng le bàn xiǎo shí , lìng wài sān gè rén xiān bān shū . yī gè zǎo dào de rén ná lái liǎng běn , hái méi shuō hǎo huàn shén me , jiù bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō shàng . wǒ qǐng dà jiā xiān zàn tíng ná shū , bǎ yǐ jīng shuō hǎo jiāo huàn de hé zhǐ shì zhǎn shì de fēn kāi . tā wèn shì bú shì huó dòng zhōng zhǐ le , wǒ shuō méi yǒu , zhǐ shì xiān bǎ shū hé wèi zhì nòng qīng chǔ , yī lóu bǎi hǎo jiù huī fù , kāi shǐ shí jiān réng rán shì liǎng diǎn .
meaning: From 1:30 Saturday I waited at the old entrance for half an hour while three organisers moved books. An early arrival placed two books down before agreeing an exchange. We paused taking books and separated agreed exchanges from displays. I clarified this wasn’t cancellation: we’d resume once arranged downstairs, still starting at two.

text: 两点以后，大家陆续到一楼。有个人说没有看新邮件，只按原来记住的二楼找，后来在门口看到纸才下来。这样的人不是没认真准备，有可能他确认过原来的信息以后，就没有再打开。我们给他指了展示书的位置，没有让他先证明看过通知，也没有把找错房间当成不能参加的理由。
pinyin: liǎng diǎn yǐ hòu , dà jiā lù xù dào yī lóu . yǒu gè rén shuō méi yǒu kàn xīn yóu jiàn , zhǐ àn yuán lái jì zhù de èr lóu zhǎo , hòu lái zài mén kǒu kàn dào zhǐ cái xià lái . zhè yàng de rén bù shì méi rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi , yǒu kě néng tā què rèn guò yuán lái de xìn xī yǐ hòu , jiù méi yǒu zài dǎ kāi . wǒ men gěi tā zhǐ le zhǎn shì shū de wèi zhì , méi yǒu ràng tā xiān zhèng míng kàn guò tōng zhī , yě méi yǒu bǎ zhǎo cuò fáng jiān dàng chéng bù néng cān jiā de lǐ yóu .
meaning: After two, people arrived downstairs. One had remembered upstairs from the original information, finding the paper only later. Having checked earlier, he might simply not have reopened the email. We showed him the display table without demanding proof he’d read the update or treating the wrong room as disqualification.

text: 交换环节，有人把语言词典放在做菜的书旁边，因为封面画了苹果。我们笑了一下，再打开看内容，把它放回学习语言那边。展示封面的区域确实在旁边，他把两种分类混在一起了。他问原来展示封面的是另一张桌子啊，我指给他看，他点点头，把那本词典拿回语言类，又帮旁边的人递了两本书。
pinyin: jiāo huàn huán jié , yǒu rén bǎ yǔ yán cí diǎn fàng zài zuò cài de shū páng biān , yīn wèi fēng miàn huà le píng guǒ . wǒ men xiào le yī xià , zài dǎ kāi kàn nèi róng , bǎ tā fàng huí xué xí yǔ yán nà biān . zhǎn shì fēng miàn de qū yù què shí zài páng biān , tā bǎ liǎng zhǒng fēn lèi hùn zài yì qǐ le . tā wèn yuán lái zhǎn shì fēng miàn de shì lìng yī zhāng zhuō zi a , wǒ zhǐ gěi tā kàn , tā diǎn diǎn tóu , bǎ nà běn cí diǎn ná huí yǔ yán lèi , yòu bāng páng biān de rén dì le liǎng běn shū .
meaning: During exchange someone sorted a language dictionary with cookbooks because of an apple cover. We checked the contents and moved it. A separate cover exhibition had caused the confusion. He asked whether the cover exhibition was on another table. I pointed it out. He nodded, returned the dictionary to the language section and passed two books to the next person.

text: 三点开始分享，自愿参加的人先说最想推荐的一点，不必把整本书的故事讲完。有个人只想听，我们也留了座位。四个组织的人有时在旁边整理，有时站着听，不是每个人都不断找事情做。活动快结束，我们问哪些书还属于原来的人，哪些已经换好，再分开收，不因为桌上剩下就把它们全当成捐来的书。
pinyin: sān diǎn kāi shǐ fēn xiǎng , zì yuàn cān jiā de rén xiān shuō zuì xiǎng tuī jiàn de yī diǎn , bù bì bǎ zhěng běn shū de gù shì jiǎng wán . yǒu gè rén zhǐ xiǎng tīng , wǒ men yě liú le zuò wèi . sì gè zǔ zhī de rén yǒu shí zài páng biān zhěng lǐ , yǒu shí zhàn zhe tīng , bù shì měi gè rén dōu bù duàn zhǎo shì qíng zuò . huó dòng kuài jié shù , wǒ men wèn nǎ xiē shū hái shǔ yú yuán lái de rén , nǎ xiē yǐ jīng huàn hǎo , zài fēn kāi shōu , bù yīn wèi zhuō shàng shèng xià jiù bǎ tā men quán dàng chéng juān lái de shū .
meaning: At three voluntary speakers shared one recommendation rather than a whole plot. Listeners had seats too. Organisers alternated tidying and listening. Before finishing we checked original ownership and completed exchanges, rather than treating all remaining books as donations.

text: 四点以前，我们收好东西，把能再用的纸集中留下，不能用的按这里的回收安排处理。最后一位朋友拿着书准备走，又回头问下次还办不办。我说想办，请他先告诉我今天怎么找过来的。他拿出手机，照片上还是旧入口。旁边的人也说自己的消息没有更新。我把这几张图记下来，下次先检查这些地方，再把新地址发出去。
pinyin: sì diǎn yǐ qián , wǒ men shōu hǎo dōng xi , bǎ néng zài yòng de zhǐ jí zhōng liú xià , bù néng yòng de àn zhè lǐ de huí shōu ān pái chǔ lǐ . zuì hòu yī wèi péng you ná zhe shū zhǔn bèi zǒu , yòu huí tóu wèn xià cì hái bàn bù bàn . wǒ shuō xiǎng bàn , qǐng tā xiān gào sù wǒ jīn tiān zěn me zhǎo guò lái de . tā ná chū shǒu jī , zhào piān shàng hái shi jiù rù kǒu . páng biān de rén yě shuō zì jǐ de xiāo xī méi yǒu gēng xīn . wǒ bǎ zhè jǐ zhāng tú jì xià lái , xià cì xiān jiǎn chá zhè xiē dì fāng , zài bǎ xīn dì zhǐ fā chū qù .
meaning: Before four we packed up, keeping reusable paper and sorting the rest for recycling. The last friend turned back to ask about another event. I hoped so; how had he found us today? His phone still showed a photo of the old entrance. Someone else had an outdated message too. I noted those versions so next time I'd check them before sending the new address.

zhuō zi hé zuò wèi kě yǐ liú xià . jiāo huàn shí dà jiā huì zǒu dòng , fēn xiǎng shí cān jiā de èr shí sì gè rén kě yǐ zuò , zǔ zhī de rén bù yòng yì zhí zuò zhe . dé dào què rèn yǐ hòu , wǒ cái fā bù xīn de gōng gào , xiě qīng shí jiān bù biàn , fáng jiān gēng huàn . wǒ yě dǎ kāi yóu jiàn fù jiàn lǐ de dì tú , bǎ yuán lái zhǐ xiàng èr lóu de jiàn tóu gǎi dào yī lóu , miǎn de wén zì shuō yī lóu , text: 她和我们分享了一个好用的办法。

text: 我第一次来旧书交换，最早看到的安排是二楼、周六两点。报名以后，我把时间记在日历里，邮件没有再打开。周六到了原来的门口，发现有人站在那里问是不是来换书。我说是，她告诉我已经换到一楼，时间仍然是两点。我当时一点四十五到，所以还在她等候的半小时里面。
pinyin: wǒ dì yī cì lái jiù shū jiāo huàn , zuì zǎo kàn dào de ān pái shì èr lóu , zhōu liù liǎng diǎn . bào míng yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ shí jiān jì zài rì lì lǐ , yóu jiàn méi yǒu zài dǎ kāi . zhōu liù dào le yuán lái de mén kǒu , fā xiàn yǒu rén zhàn zài nà lǐ wèn shì bú shì lái huàn shū . wǒ shuō shì , tā gào sù wǒ yǐ jīng huàn dào yī lóu , shí jiān réng rán shì liǎng diǎn . wǒ dāng shí yī diǎn sì shí wǔ dào , suǒ yǐ hái zài tā děng hòu de bàn xiǎo shí lǐ miàn .
meaning: For my first book exchange I remembered upstairs, Saturday at two. After registering I didn’t reopen the email. At the original entrance at 1:45, an organiser directed me downstairs, still starting at two. I arrived during her half-hour waiting period.

text: 她没有只指一个方向，就回头忙自己的事，而是把纸上的房间名指给我看。我带了两本，一本想换，一本只是想让朋友看看。我问能不能都放，她说可以，但要把只是展示的注明。我这才发现，带来一本书不一定代表愿意把它给出去；别人看见放在桌上，也不一定知道我的想法。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu zhǐ zhǐ yī gè fāng xiàng , jiù huí tóu máng zì jǐ de shì , ér shì bǎ zhǐ shàng de fáng jiān míng zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn . wǒ dài le liǎng běn , yī běn xiǎng huàn , yī běn zhǐ shì xiǎng ràng péng you kàn kàn . wǒ wèn néng bù néng dōu fàng , tā shuō kě yǐ , dàn yào bǎ zhǐ shì zhǎn shì de zhù míng . wǒ zhè cái fā xiàn , dài lái yī běn shū bù yí dìng dài biǎo yuàn yì bǎ tā gěi chū qù ; bié ren kàn jiàn fàng zài zhuō shàng , yě bù yí dìng zhī dào wǒ de xiǎng fǎ .
meaning: She pointed out the written room name rather than a vague direction. I had one book to exchange and one merely to show. She asked me to mark the display-only one. Bringing a book didn’t necessarily mean giving it away, and others couldn’t infer my intention from it sitting on the table.

text: 搬到一楼时，桌子还在摆，大家先暂停拿书。我听见“暂停”，以为今天不办了，又问了一次。她说只是等摆好，活动仍然两点开始，不是终止。这个回答让我放心，因为我已经走了半小时才到，也想见见报名的人。后来我听见别的人也问，她没有因为刚解释过，就说大家应该都知道。
pinyin: bān dào yī lóu shí , zhuō zi hái zài bǎi , dà jiā xiān zàn tíng ná shū . wǒ tīng jiàn zàn tíng , yǐ wéi jīn tiān bù bàn le , yòu wèn le yī cì . tā shuō zhǐ shì děng bǎi hǎo , huó dòng réng rán liǎng diǎn kāi shǐ , bù shì zhōng zhǐ . zhè gè huí dá ràng wǒ fàng xīn , yīn wèi wǒ yǐ jīng zǒu le bàn xiǎo shí cái dào , yě xiǎng jiàn jiàn bào míng de rén . hòu lái wǒ tīng jiàn bié de rén yě wèn , tā méi yǒu yīn wèi gāng jiě shì guò , jiù shuō dà jiā yīng gāi dōu zhī dào .
meaning: While tables were arranged, taking books paused. I initially feared there was no event, but she clarified the temporary pause and two o’clock start. After a half-hour journey I was relieved. She answered others' similar questions without assuming everyone knew just because she’d explained once.

text: 我看名单上的人数是二十八，又看到只有二十四个座位，有点担心。组织的人告诉我，二十八已经包括他们四位。他们不用一直坐，参加分享的二十四个人都有座位。这里不是靠说“大家随便挤一挤”来解决，也不是把不愿意站的人叫作不合作；她直接说明了名单怎么数、座位给谁。
pinyin: wǒ kàn míng dān shàng de rén shù shì èr shí bā , yòu kàn dào zhǐ yǒu èr shí sì gè zuò wèi , yǒu diǎn dān xīn . zǔ zhī de rén gào sù wǒ , èr shí bā yǐ jīng bāo kuò tā men sì wèi . tā men bù yòng yì zhí zuò , cān jiā fēn xiǎng de èr shí sì gè rén dōu yǒu zuò wèi . zhè lǐ bù shì kào shuō dà jiā suí biàn jǐ yī jǐ lái jiě jué , yě bù shì bǎ bù yuàn yì zhàn de rén jiào zuò bù hé zuò ; tā zhí jiē shuō míng le míng dān zěn me shù , zuò wèi gěi shéi .
meaning: The twenty-eight names and twenty-four seats worried me. The four organisers were included in the total and wouldn’t sit throughout, leaving seats for twenty-four participants. They explained the count and seating without asking everyone to squeeze together or calling someone uncooperative for wanting a seat.

text: 两点以后有个人从楼上下来，说只看到旧邮件。我才知道如果晚来，门口那个人不一定还站着，但新的纸会一直留到活动结束。她提前等半小时，是多一种帮助，不是唯一一种找路办法。我回头看自己手机里的附件，确实还存着旧地图，所以把新房间记下来，没有再按旧箭头找。
pinyin: liǎng diǎn yǐ hòu yǒu gè rén cóng lóu shàng xià lái , shuō zhǐ kàn dào jiù yóu jiàn . wǒ cái zhī dào rú guǒ wǎn lái , mén kǒu nà gè rén bù yí dìng hái zhàn zhe , dàn xīn de zhǐ huì yì zhí liú dào huó dòng jié shù . tā tí qián děng bàn xiǎo shí , shì duō yī zhǒng bāng zhù , bù shì wéi yī yī zhǒng zhǎo lù bàn fǎ . wǒ huí tóu kàn zì jǐ shǒu jī lǐ de fù jiàn , què shí hái cún zhe jiù dì tú , suǒ yǐ bǎ xīn fáng jiān jì xià lái , méi yǒu zài àn jiù jiàn tóu zhǎo .
meaning: A later arrival had followed the old email upstairs. The organiser wouldn’t necessarily still be waiting for late guests, but the paper would remain until the end. The half-hour presence was an extra aid, not the only directions. My phone still held the old attachment, so I noted the room rather than trusting its old arrow.

text: 换书的时候，我和一个人想换同一本。他先来的，不过还在看。我没有直接拿走，问他是不是已经想要。他说还没决定，可以让我先看。我们后来各选了一本，也分享了一下为什么喜欢。我喜欢的那一本有几页写过字，对方先告诉我，我看过以后觉得可以，再答应交换，没有等到回家才发现。
pinyin: huàn shū de shí hou , wǒ hé yī gè rén xiǎng huàn tóng yī běn . tā xiān lái de , bù guò hái zài kàn . wǒ méi yǒu zhí jiē ná zǒu , wèn tā shì bú shì yǐ jīng xiǎng yào . tā shuō hái méi jué dìng , kě yǐ ràng wǒ xiān kàn . wǒ men hòu lái gè xuǎn le yī běn , yě fēn xiǎng le yī xià wèi shén me xǐ huān . wǒ xǐ huān de nà yī běn yǒu jǐ yè xiě guò zì , duì fāng xiān gào sù wǒ , wǒ kàn guò yǐ hòu jué de kě yǐ , zài dā yìng jiāo huàn , méi yǒu děng dào huí jiā cái fā xiàn .
meaning: Another person and I were interested in the same book. I checked whether he’d chosen it rather than taking it. He hadn’t and let me look. We each chose one and discussed our reasons. The owner told me mine had writing on several pages; I checked and accepted before the exchange, rather than discovering it at home.

text: 三点分享时，我不想站到前面，就一直听。有个人讲到故事结尾，旁边的朋友笑着说先别讲，我还没读完。他停了一下，赶紧把下一页合上，改说自己为什么喜欢那个角色。我觉得有意思，就问那个人在开头是不是也这样。他说你先读，读完我们再聊，又把书名写给了我。
pinyin: sān diǎn fēn xiǎng shí , wǒ bù xiǎng zhàn dào qián miàn , jiù yì zhí tīng . yǒu gè rén jiǎng dào gù shì jié wěi , páng biān de péng you xiào zhe shuō xiān bié jiǎng , wǒ hái méi dú wán . tā tíng le yī xià , gǎn jǐn bǎ xià yī yè hé shàng , gǎi shuō zì jǐ wèi shén me xǐ huān nà gè jué sè . wǒ jué de yǒu yì si , jiù wèn nà gè rén zài kāi tóu shì bú shì yě zhè yàng . tā shuō nǐ xiān dú , dú wán wǒ men zài liáo , yòu bǎ shū míng xiě gěi le wǒ .
meaning: At three I stayed in my seat to listen. One speaker reached the ending; a friend laughed, 'Don't tell us—I haven't finished it!' He closed the next page and switched to why he liked the character. Interested, I asked whether the character behaved that way at the start too. Read it first, he said, and we'd talk afterwards. He wrote down the title for me.

text: 快四点我收好换来的书，把只是展示的那本也带回。有人问下次能不能帮忙，我说想试登记，不过先确认日期。他指给我看今天那张表，说登记就是问清书名和是谁带来的，不用一下负责所有东西。我拍了张照片，回去慢慢看。出门以后，他发来一条消息，说日期定好就联系我，我回了好，先把刚换的书读完。
pinyin: kuài sì diǎn wǒ shōu hǎo huàn lái de shū , bǎ zhǐ shì zhǎn shì de nà běn yě dài huí . yǒu rén wèn xià cì néng bù néng bāng máng , wǒ shuō xiǎng shì dēng jì , bù guò xiān què rèn rì qī . tā zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn jīn tiān nà zhāng biǎo , shuō dēng jì jiù shì wèn qīng shū míng hé shì shéi dài lái de , bù yòng yī xià fù zé suǒ yǒu dōng xi . wǒ pāi le zhāng zhào piān , huí qù màn màn kàn . chū mén yǐ hòu , tā fā lái yī tiáo xiāo xī , shuō rì qī dìng hǎo jiù lián xì wǒ , wǒ huí le hǎo , xiān bǎ gāng huàn de shū dú wán .
meaning: Near four I packed the books I'd swapped and took my display-only book home too. Asked about helping next time, I wanted to try registration but needed the date first. He showed me the form: ask the title and who brought it; I wouldn't have to run everything. I took a photo to study at home. Later he messaged that he'd contact me once the date was fixed. Fine, I replied—first I'd finish my new book.

tā zhí jiē shuō míng le míng dān zěn me shù , zuò wèi gěi shéi . liǎng diǎn yǐ hòu yǒu gè rén cóng lóu shàng xià lái , shuō zhǐ kàn dào jiù yóu jiàn . wǒ cái zhī dào rú guǒ wǎn lái , mén kǒu nà gè rén bù yí dìng hái zhàn zhe , dàn xīn de zhǐ huì yì zhí liú dào huó dòng jié shù . tā tí qián děng bàn xiǎo shí , shì duō yī zhǒng bāng zhù , bù shì wéi yī yī zhǒng zhǎo lù bàn fǎ . wǒ huí tóu kàn zì jǐ shǒu jī lǐ de fù jiàn , què shí hái cún zhe jiù dì tú , suǒ yǐ bǎ xīn fáng jiān jì xià lái , méi yǒu zài àn jiù jiàn tóu zhǎo . huàn shū de shí hou , wǒ hé yī gè rén xiǎng huàn tóng yī běn . tā xiān lái de , bù guò hái zài kàn . wǒ méi yǒu zhí jiē ná zǒu , wèn tā shì bú shì yǐ jīng xiǎng yào . tā shuō hái méi jué dìng , kě yǐ ràng wǒ xiān kàn . wǒ men hòu lái gè xuǎn le yī běn , yě fēn xiǎng le yī xià wèi shén me xǐ huān . wǒ xǐ huān de nà yī běn yǒu jǐ yè xiě guò zì , duì fāng xiān gào sù wǒ , wǒ kàn guò yǐ hòu jué de kě yǐ , zài dā yìng jiāo huàn , méi yǒu děng dào huí jiā cái fā xiàn . sān diǎn fēn xiǎng shí , wǒ bù xiǎng zhàn dào qián miàn , jiù yì zhí tīng . yǒu gè rén jiǎng dào gù shì jié wěi , páng biān de péng you xiào zhe shuō xiān bié jiǎng , wǒ hái méi dú wán . tā tíng le yī xià , gǎn jǐn bǎ xià yī yè hé shàng , gǎi shuō zì jǐ wèi shén me xǐ huān nà gè jué sè . wǒ jué de yǒu yì si , jiù wèn nà gè rén zài kāi tóu shì bú shì yě zhè yàng . tā shuō nǐ xiān dú , dú wán wǒ men zài liáo , yòu bǎ shū míng xiě gěi le wǒ . kuài sì diǎn wǒ shōu hǎo huàn lái de shū , bǎ zhǐ shì zhǎn shì de nà běn yě dài huí . yǒu rén wèn xià cì néng bù néng bāng máng , wǒ shuō xiǎng shì dēng jì , bù guò xiān què rèn rì qī . tā zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn jīn tiān nà zhāng biǎo , shuō dēng jì jiù shì wèn qīng shū míng hé shì shéi dài lái de , bù yòng yī xià fù zé suǒ yǒu dōng xi . wǒ pāi le zhāng zhào piān , huí qù màn màn kàn . chū mén yǐ hòu , tā fā lái yī tiáo xiāo xī , shuō rì qī dìng hǎo jiù lián xì wǒ , wǒ huí le hǎo , xiān bǎ gāng huàn de shū dú wán .
meaning: For my first book exchange I remembered upstairs, Saturday at two. After registering I didn’t reopen the email. At the original entrance at 1:45, an organiser directed me downstairs, still starting at two. I arrived during her half-hour waiting period. She pointed out the written room name rather than a vague direction. I had one book to exchange and one merely to show. She asked me to mark the display-only one. Bringing a book didn’t necessarily mean giving it away, and others couldn’t infer my intention from it sitting on the table. While tables were arranged, taking books paused. I initially feared there was no event, but she clarified the temporary pause and two o’clock start. After a half-hour journey I was relieved. She answered others' similar questions without assuming everyone knew just because she’d explained once. The twenty-eight names and twenty-four seats worried me. The four organisers were included in the total and wouldn’t sit throughout, leaving seats for twenty-four participants. They explained the count and seating without asking everyone to squeeze together or calling someone uncooperative for wanting a seat. A later arrival had followed the old email upstairs. The organiser wouldn’t necessarily still be waiting for late guests, but the paper would remain until the end. The half-hour presence was an extra aid, not the only directions. My phone still held the old attachment, so I noted the room rather than trusting its old arrow. Another person and I were interested in the same book. I checked whether he’d chosen it rather than taking it. He hadn’t and let me look. We each chose one and discussed our reasons. The owner told me mine had writing on several pages; I checked and accepted before the exchange, rather than discovering it at home. At three I stayed in my seat to listen. One speaker reached the ending; a friend laughed, 'Don't tell us—I haven't finished it!' He closed the next page and switched to why he liked the character. Interested, I asked whether the character behaved that way at the start too. Read it first, he said, and we'd talk afterwards. He wrote down the title for me. Near four I packed the books I'd swapped and took my display-only book home too. Asked about helping next time, I wanted to try registration but needed the date first. He showed me the form: ask the title and who brought it; I wouldn't have to run everything. I took a photo to study at home. Later he messaged that he'd contact me once the date was fixed. Fine, I replied—first I'd finish my new book.

parts.text: 我第一次来旧书交换，最早看到的安排是二楼、周六两点。报名以后，我把时间记在日历里，邮件没有再打开。周六到了原来的门口，发现有人站在那里问是不是来换书。我说是，她告诉我已经换到一楼，时间仍然是两点。我当时一点四十五到，所以还在她等候的半小时里面。
她没有只指一个方向，就回头忙自己的事，而是把纸上的房间名指给我看。我带了两本，一本想换，一本只是想让朋友看看。我问能不能都放，她说可以，但要把只是展示的注明。我这才发现，带来一本书不一定代表愿意把它给出去；别人看见放在桌上，也不一定知道我的想法。
搬到一楼时，桌子还在摆，大家先暂停拿书。我听见“暂停”，以为今天不办了，又问了一次。她说只是等摆好，活动仍然两点开始，不是终止。这个回答让我放心，因为我已经走了半小时才到，也想见见报名的人。后来我听见别的人也问，她没有因为刚解释过，就说大家应该都知道。
我看名单上的人数是二十八，又看到只有二十四个座位，有点担心。组织的人告诉我，二十八已经包括他们四位。他们不用一直坐，参加分享的二十四个人都有座位。这里不是靠说“大家随便挤一挤”来解决，也不是把不愿意站的人叫作不合作；她直接说明了名单怎么数、座位给谁。
两点以后有个人从楼上下来，说只看到旧邮件。我才知道如果晚来，门口那个人不一定还站着，但新的纸会一直留到活动结束。她提前等半小时，是多一种帮助，不是唯一一种找路办法。我回头看自己手机里的附件，确实还存着旧地图，所以把新房间记下来，没有再按旧箭头找。
换书的时候，我和一个人想换同一本。他先来的，不过还在看。我没有直接拿走，问他是不是已经想要。他说还没决定，可以让我先看。我们后来各选了一本，也分享了一下为什么喜欢。我喜欢的那一本有几页写过字，对方先告诉我，我看过以后觉得可以，再答应交换，没有等到回家才发现。
三点分享时，我不想站到前面，就一直听。有个人讲到故事结尾，旁边的朋友笑着说先别讲，我还没读完。他停了一下，赶紧把下一页合上，改说自己为什么喜欢那个角色。我觉得有意思，就问那个人在开头是不是也这样。他说你先读，读完我们再聊，又把书名写给了我。
快四点我收好换来的书，把只是展示的那本也带回。有人问下次能不能帮忙，我说想试登记，不过先确认日期。他指给我看今天那张表，说登记就是问清书名和是谁带来的，不用一下负责所有东西。我拍了张照片，回去慢慢看。出门以后，他发来一条消息，说日期定好就联系我，我回了好，先把刚换的书读完。

text: 你怎么开始办这个读书小组的？
pinyin: nǐ zěn me kāi shǐ bàn zhè gè dú shū xiǎo zǔ de ?
meaning: How did you start this reading group?

text: 我偶然在社区见到一位朋友，她问有没有地方一起读。
pinyin: wǒ ǒu rán zài shè qū jiàn dào yī wèi péng you , tā wèn yǒu méi yǒu dì fāng yì qǐ dú .
meaning: I happened to meet a friend in the community who asked about a place to read together.

text: 所以一开始就决定每周办？
pinyin: suǒ yǐ yī kāi shǐ jiù jué dìng měi zhōu bàn ?
meaning: So you decided straight away to run it every week?

text: 没有，先试六周。第一次六个人，上周十个人。
pinyin: méi yǒu , xiān shì liù zhōu . dì yī cì liù gè rén , shàng zhōu shí gè rén .
meaning: No, we started with a six-week trial. Six people came first time, ten last week.

text: 人数多了，是不是大家都更喜欢了？
pinyin: rén shù duō le , shì bú shì dà jiā dōu gèng xǐ huān le ?
meaning: Does growing attendance mean everyone likes it more?

text: 有的人是朋友带来的，我还不知道他们会不会再来。
pinyin: yǒu de rén shì péng you dài lái de , wǒ hái bù zhī dào tā men huì bù huì zài lái .
meaning: Some were brought by friends. I don’t know yet whether they will return.

text: 你自己最难的是什么？
pinyin: nǐ zì jǐ zuì nán de shì shén me ?
meaning: What is hardest for you personally?

text: 安排谁先说。我以前觉得，安静就说明没人想说。
pinyin: ān pái shéi xiān shuō . wǒ yǐ qián jué de , ān jìng jiù shuō míng méi rén xiǎng shuō .
meaning: Arranging who speaks first. I used to think silence meant no one wanted to talk.

text: 现在不这样看待了？
pinyin: xiàn zài bù zhè yàng kàn dài le ?
meaning: You don’t see it that way now?

text: 对。有个人第二次才告诉我，他第一次是在认真听。
pinyin: duì . yǒu gè rén dì èr cì cái gào sù wǒ , tā dì yī cì shì zài rèn zhēn tīng .
meaning: Right. One person told me on his second visit that he’d been listening carefully on the first.

text: 后来怎么安排？
pinyin: hòu lái zěn me ān pái ?
meaning: How did you organise it after that?

text: 先读半小时，再交流半小时。想说的先说，不想说的可以听。
pinyin: xiān dú bàn xiǎo shí , zài jiāo liú bàn xiǎo shí . xiǎng shuō de xiān shuō , bù xiǎng shuō de kě yǐ tīng .
meaning: Read for half an hour, then discuss for half an hour. Those who want to speak can; others can listen.

text: 这样是不是就没有压力了？
pinyin: zhè yàng shì bú shì jiù méi yǒu yā lì le ?
meaning: Does that remove all the pressure?

text: 也不能这么说。有人还是怕讲错，我会先问他想不想说一句。
pinyin: yě bù néng zhè me shuō . yǒu rén hái shi pà jiǎng cuò , wǒ huì xiān wèn tā xiǎng bù xiǎng shuō yī jù .
meaning: Not necessarily. Some still fear mistakes; I ask whether they’d like to start with one sentence.

text: 年龄不同，会不会很难聊到一起？
pinyin: nián líng bù tóng , huì bù huì hěn nán liáo dào yì qǐ ?
meaning: Does the age difference make it hard to find common ground?

text: 有时喜欢的书不同，但同一本书也会有不同看法。
pinyin: yǒu shí xǐ huān de shū bù tóng , dàn tóng yī běn shū yě huì yǒu bù tóng kàn fǎ .
meaning: Sometimes book preferences differ, but even one book can bring different views.

text: 接下来你最想改什么？
pinyin: jiē xià lái nǐ zuì xiǎng gǎi shén me ?
meaning: What do you most want to change next?

text: 通知别太频繁。一周发一次，改时间再单独联络。
pinyin: tōng zhī bié tài pín fán . yī zhōu fā yī cì , gǎi shí jiān zài dān dú lián luò .
meaning: Make notifications less frequent: once a week, with separate contact if the time changes.

text: 社区的读书小组试办了六周以后，我去采访负责联络的林安。小厅里的书柜没有很特别的安排，椅子围着一张桌子，也没有讲台。我原来以为，她会先告诉我多少人报名、以后准备办多大。她却拿出一封来信，说这个人第二次来以后才写，想问下次能不能先听，再决定自己要不要说。
pinyin: shè qū de dú shū xiǎo zǔ shì bàn le liù zhōu yǐ hòu , wǒ qù cǎi fǎng fù zé lián luò de lín ān . xiǎo tīng lǐ de shū guì méi yǒu hěn tè bié de ān pái , yǐ zi wéi zhe yī zhāng zhuō zi , yě méi yǒu jiǎng tái . wǒ yuán lái yǐ wéi , tā huì xiān gào sù wǒ duō shao rén bào míng , yǐ hòu zhǔn bèi bàn duō dà . tā què ná chū yī fēng lái xìn , shuō zhè gè rén dì èr cì lái yǐ hòu cái xiě , xiǎng wèn xià cì néng bù néng xiān tīng , zài jué dìng zì jǐ yào bù yào shuō .
meaning: After the community reading group’s six-week trial, I interviewed Lin An, who handles contact. A bookcase and chairs around a table replaced any special equipment or lectern. I expected registration totals and expansion plans; instead she showed a letter from a second-time visitor asking to listen first and decide later whether to speak.

text: 我问她为什么在意这个问题。她说，第一次活动有六个人，有一段时间大家都安静，她以为准备得不好，就急着一直说。后来其中一个人告诉她，他不是没有兴趣，而是在听别人怎么谈这本书。这个例子使她改变了对安静的看法，但她也说，不能因此认定每个安静的人都一样，有的人可能真的不喜欢。
pinyin: wǒ wèn tā wèi shén me zài yì zhè gè wèn tí . tā shuō , dì yī cì huó dòng yǒu liù gè rén , yǒu yī duàn shí jiān dà jiā dōu ān jìng , tā yǐ wéi zhǔn bèi de bù hǎo , jiù jí zhe yì zhí shuō . hòu lái qí zhōng yī gè rén gào sù tā , tā bù shì méi yǒu xìng qù , ér shì zài tīng bié ren zěn me tán zhè běn shū . zhè gè lì zi shǐ tā gǎi biàn le duì ān jìng de kàn fǎ , dàn tā yě shuō , bù néng yīn cǐ rèn dìng měi gè ān jìng de rén dōu yī yàng , yǒu de rén kě néng zhēn de bù xǐ huān .
meaning: I asked why it mattered. At the first six-person meeting silence made her think she’d prepared poorly, so she filled it by talking. One participant later explained that he was listening to how others discussed the book. This changed her view of silence, though she didn’t assume all quiet people were alike: some might genuinely dislike the event.

text: 活动现在先读半小时，再交流半小时，加上一点开始前的整理，负责的人会早点来。对于参加者，正式安排仍然是一个小时。想说的人先说，暂时不想说的可以听；如果有人愿意说一句，她就给他留一点时间，不要求一次把全部感受讲完。这个办法减轻了一些人的压力，也需要她学会等，不是把所有空处马上填满。
pinyin: huó dòng xiàn zài xiān dú bàn xiǎo shí , zài jiāo liú bàn xiǎo shí , jiā shàng yī diǎn kāi shǐ qián de zhěng lǐ , fù zé de rén huì zǎo diǎn lái . duì yú cān jiā zhě , zhèng shì ān pái réng rán shì yī gè xiǎo shí . xiǎng shuō de rén xiān shuō , zàn shí bù xiǎng shuō de kě yǐ tīng ; rú guǒ yǒu rén yuàn yì shuō yī jù , tā jiù gěi tā liú yī diǎn shí jiān , bú yào qiú yī cì bǎ quán bù gǎn shòu jiǎng wán . zhè gè bàn fǎ jiǎn qīng le yī xiē rén de yā lì , yě xū yào tā xué huì děng , bù shì bǎ suǒ yǒu kōng chù mǎ shàng tián mǎn .
meaning: Participants read for half an hour and discuss for half an hour. Organisers arrive earlier for preparation, but the formal session remains one hour. Speakers can go first and others listen; someone willing to say one sentence gets time without needing a complete account. This eases some pressure and requires her to wait instead of filling every gap.

text: 我听她说上周有十个人，就问人数增加是不是说明办法一定有效。她没有直接答应这个判断。上周有两个人是朋友带来的，有的人只是偶尔来，她还不知道以后会不会保持这个人数。她认为，人数可以记，但来的人有没有找到想读的内容、日期是不是合适，也要问清楚。十个人到场，不能替十个人回答所有问题。
pinyin: wǒ tīng tā shuō shàng zhōu yǒu shí gè rén , jiù wèn rén shù zēng jiā shì bú shì shuō míng bàn fǎ yí dìng yǒu xiào . tā méi yǒu zhí jiē dā yìng zhè gè pàn duàn . shàng zhōu yǒu liǎng gè rén shì péng you dài lái de , yǒu de rén zhǐ shì ǒu ěr lái , tā hái bù zhī dào yǐ hòu huì bù huì bǎo chí zhè gè rén shù . tā rèn wéi , rén shù kě yǐ jì , dàn lái de rén yǒu méi yǒu zhǎo dào xiǎng dú de nèi róng , rì qī shì bú shì hé shì , yě yào wèn qīng chǔ . shí gè rén dào chǎng , bù néng tì shí gè rén huí dá suǒ yǒu wèn tí .
meaning: When she said ten attended last week, I asked whether this proved the approach worked. She qualified that: two had come with friends, some attended only occasionally, and future numbers were unknown. Counts mattered alongside interests and scheduling. Ten people’s presence couldn’t answer every question on their behalf.

text: 我又问年龄会不会影响交流。她说有时候选书会不同，不过同样年龄的人也不一定喜欢同一种故事。一次较年轻的参加者想知道角色为什么不直接道歉，另一位年长的朋友说自己年轻时也不愿先开口。他们并没有马上同意，但后来各自找出一段支持自己的看法，比只说“你们这个年龄都这样”更能继续聊。
pinyin: wǒ yòu wèn nián líng huì bù huì yǐng xiǎng jiāo liú . tā shuō yǒu shí hou xuǎn shū huì bù tóng , bù guò tóng yàng nián líng de rén yě bù yí dìng xǐ huān tóng yī zhǒng gù shì . yī cì jiào nián qīng de cān jiā zhě xiǎng zhī dào jué sè wèi shén me bù zhí jiē dào qiàn , lìng yī wèi nián zhǎng de péng you shuō zì jǐ nián qīng shí yě bù yuàn xiān kāi kǒu . tā men bìng méi yǒu mǎ shàng tóng yì , dàn hòu lái gè zì zhǎo chū yī duàn zhī chí zì jǐ de kàn fǎ , bǐ zhǐ shuō nǐ men zhè gè nián líng dōu zhè yàng gèng néng jì xù liáo .
meaning: She said age sometimes affected book choice, but people of the same age could have different preferences. A younger reader questioned a character’s failure to apologise; an older reader recalled not wanting to speak first when young. They didn’t instantly agree but found passages supporting their views, which kept discussion going better than generalisations about age.

text: 接下来，她想改的是通知。我听见“联络更方便”，以为要发更多消息，她说正好相反。近来日期、书名、准备事项分开发，有人找不到最重要的一条。她准备一周发一次完整安排，如果时间更换，再单独通知。少发并不等于不联络，而是让同一个人不用在几条消息里来回找。
pinyin: jiē xià lái , tā xiǎng gǎi de shì tōng zhī . wǒ tīng jiàn lián luò gèng fāng biàn , yǐ wéi yào fā gèng duō xiāo xī , tā shuō zhèng hǎo xiāng fǎn . jìn lái rì qī , shū míng , zhǔn bèi shì xiàng fēn kāi fā , yǒu rén zhǎo bù dào zuì zhòng yào de yī tiáo . tā zhǔn bèi yī zhōu fā yī cì wán zhěng ān pái , rú guǒ shí jiān gēng huàn , zài dān dú tōng zhī . shǎo fā bìng bù děng yú bù lián luò , ér shì ràng tóng yī gè rén bù yòng zài jǐ tiáo xiāo xī lǐ lái huí zhǎo .
meaning: Her next change concerned notices. I assumed easier contact meant more messages; she meant the opposite. Dates, titles and preparations had been sent separately, obscuring the key information. One weekly complete schedule plus separate updates for changed times would reduce searching without ending contact.

text: 采访快结束，我问她是不是很有信心一直办下去。她说想继续，但要先确认下个月的小厅和自己的时间。她说得很坚定，却没有保证每次都有十个人，也没有说所有人都会爱上读书。她希望以后有人愿意帮一次联络，自己也能坐下来读，不必每周只顾着安排别人怎么说。
pinyin: cǎi fǎng kuài jié shù , wǒ wèn tā shì bú shì hěn yǒu xìn xīn yì zhí bàn xià qù . tā shuō xiǎng jì xù , dàn yào xiān què rèn xià gè yuè de xiǎo tīng hé zì jǐ de shí jiān . tā shuō de hěn jiān dìng , què méi yǒu bǎo zhèng měi cì dōu yǒu shí gè rén , yě méi yǒu shuō suǒ yǒu rén dū huì ài shàng dú shū . tā xī wàng yǐ hòu yǒu rén yuàn yì bāng yī cì lián luò , zì jǐ yě néng zuò xià lái dú , bù bì měi zhōu zhǐ gù zhe ān pái bié ren zěn me shuō .
meaning: At the end she wanted to continue but needed to check next month’s venue and availability. She was firm without guaranteeing ten attendees or universal enthusiasm. She hoped someone might help with contact occasionally, allowing her to read rather than only organise others’ speech.

text: 回去整理采访时，我没有把标题写成“一个办法让所有人开口”。她讲的是一次试办中的具体变化，还有不知道的地方。她的例子让我受到启发：听一个人的经验，既可以了解她怎么做，也要听她把话说到哪里为止。保留这些限制，不会让她的经验变得没用，反而让我知道自己可以试什么，又不能直接断定什么。
pinyin: huí qù zhěng lǐ cǎi fǎng shí , wǒ méi yǒu bǎ biāo tí xiě chéng yī gè bàn fǎ ràng suǒ yǒu rén kāi kǒu . tā jiǎng de shì yī cì shì bàn zhōng de jù tǐ biàn huà , hái yǒu bù zhī dào de dì fāng . tā de lì zi ràng wǒ shòu dào qǐ fā : tīng yī gè rén de jīng yàn , jì kě yǐ liǎo jiě tā zěn me zuò , yě yào tīng tā bǎ huà shuō dào nǎ lǐ wéi zhǐ . bǎo liú zhè xiē xiàn zhì , bù huì ràng tā de jīng yàn biàn de méi yòng , fǎn ér ràng wǒ zhī dào zì jǐ kě yǐ shì shén me , yòu bù néng zhí jiē duàn dìng shén me .
meaning: I avoided a headline claiming one method made everyone speak. She described particular changes in a trial and remaining unknowns. Her examples suggested listening both to what someone did and where they limited their claims. Keeping those limits made the experience useful by distinguishing possibilities to try from conclusions not yet justified.

zhèng měi cì dōu yǒu shí gè rén , yě méi yǒu shuō suǒ yǒu rén dū huì ài shàng dú shū . tā xī wàng yǐ hòu yǒu rén yuàn yì bāng yī cì lián luò , zì jǐ yě néng zuò xià lái dú , bù bì měi zhōu zhǐ gù zhe ān pái bié ren zěn me shuō . huí qù zhěng lǐ cǎi fǎng shí , wǒ méi yǒu bǎ biāo tí xiě chéng yī gè bàn fǎ ràng suǒ yǒu rén kāi kǒu . tā jiǎng de shì yī cì shì bàn zhōng de jù tǐ biàn huà , hái yǒu bù zhī dào de dì fāng . tā de lì zi ràng wǒ shòu dào qǐ fā : tīng yī gè rén de jīng yàn , jì kě yǐ liǎo jiě tā zěn me zuò , yě yào tīng tā bǎ huà shuō dào nǎ lǐ wéi zhǐ . bǎo liú zhè xiē xiàn zhì , bù huì ràng tā de jīng yàn biàn de méi yòng , fǎn ér ràng wǒ zhī dào zì jǐ kě yǐ shì shén me , yòu bù néng zhí jiē duàn dìng shén me .
meaning: After the community reading group’s six-week trial, I interviewed Lin An, who handles contact. A bookcase and chairs around a table replaced any special equipment or lectern. I expected registration totals and expansion plans; instead she showed a letter from a second-time visitor asking to listen first and decide later whether to speak. I asked why it mattered. At the first six-person meeting silence made her think she’d prepared poorly, so she filled it by talking. One participant later explained that he was listening to how others discussed the book. This changed her view of silence, though she didn’t assume all quiet people were alike: some might genuinely dislike the event. Participants read for half an hour and discuss for half an hour. Organisers arrive earlier for preparation, but the formal session remains one hour. Speakers can go first and others listen; someone willing to say one sentence gets time without needing a complete account. This eases some pressure and requires her to wait instead of filling every gap. When she said ten attended last week, I asked whether this proved the approach worked. She qualified that: two had come with friends, some attended only occasionally, and future numbers were unknown. Counts mattered alongside interests and scheduling. Ten people’s presence couldn’t answer every question on their behalf. She said age sometimes affected book choice, but people of the same age could have different preferences. A younger reader questioned a character’s failure to apologise; an older reader recalled not wanting to speak first when young. They didn’t instantly agree but found passages supporting their views, which kept discussion going better than generalisations about age. Her next change concerned notices. I assumed easier contact meant more messages; she meant the opposite. Dates, titles and preparations had been sent separately, obscuring the key information. One weekly complete schedule plus separate updates for changed times would reduce searching without ending contact. At the end she wanted to continue but needed to check next month’s venue and availability. She was firm without guaranteeing ten attendees or universal enthusiasm. She hoped someone might help with contact occasionally, allowing her to read rather than only organise others’ speech. I avoided a headline claiming one method made everyone speak. She described particular changes in a trial and remaining unknowns. Her examples suggested listening both to what someone did and where they limited their claims. Keeping those limits made the experience useful by distinguishing possibilities to try from conclusions not yet justified.

parts.text: 社区的读书小组试办了六周以后，我去采访负责联络的林安。小厅里的书柜没有很特别的安排，椅子围着一张桌子，也没有讲台。我原来以为，她会先告诉我多少人报名、以后准备办多大。她却拿出一封来信，说这个人第二次来以后才写，想问下次能不能先听，再决定自己要不要说。
我问她为什么在意这个问题。她说，第一次活动有六个人，有一段时间大家都安静，她以为准备得不好，就急着一直说。后来其中一个人告诉她，他不是没有兴趣，而是在听别人怎么谈这本书。这个例子使她改变了对安静的看法，但她也说，不能因此认定每个安静的人都一样，有的人可能真的不喜欢。
活动现在先读半小时，再交流半小时，加上一点开始前的整理，负责的人会早点来。对于参加者，正式安排仍然是一个小时。想说的人先说，暂时不想说的可以听；如果有人愿意说一句，她就给他留一点时间，不要求一次把全部感受讲完。这个办法减轻了一些人的压力，也需要她学会等，不是把所有空处马上填满。
我听她说上周有十个人，就问人数增加是不是说明办法一定有效。她没有直接答应这个判断。上周有两个人是朋友带来的，有的人只是偶尔来，她还不知道以后会不会保持这个人数。她认为，人数可以记，但来的人有没有找到想读的内容、日期是不是合适，也要问清楚。十个人到场，不能替十个人回答所有问题。
我又问年龄会不会影响交流。她说有时候选书会不同，不过同样年龄的人也不一定喜欢同一种故事。一次较年轻的参加者想知道角色为什么不直接道歉，另一位年长的朋友说自己年轻时也不愿先开口。他们并没有马上同意，但后来各自找出一段支持自己的看法，比只说“你们这个年龄都这样”更能继续聊。
接下来，她想改的是通知。我听见“联络更方便”，以为要发更多消息，她说正好相反。近来日期、书名、准备事项分开发，有人找不到最重要的一条。她准备一周发一次完整安排，如果时间更换，再单独通知。少发并不等于不联络，而是让同一个人不用在几条消息里来回找。
采访快结束，我问她是不是很有信心一直办下去。她说想继续，但要先确认下个月的小厅和自己的时间。她说得很坚定，却没有保证每次都有十个人，也没有说所有人都会爱上读书。她希望以后有人愿意帮一次联络，自己也能坐下来读，不必每周只顾着安排别人怎么说。
回去整理采访时，我没有把标题写成“一个办法让所有人开口”。她讲的是一次试办中的具体变化，还有不知道的地方。她的例子让我受到启发：听一个人的经验，既可以了解她怎么做，也要听她把话说到哪里为止。保留这些限制，不会让她的经验变得没用，反而让我知道自己可以试什么，又不能直接断定什么。

text: 你的肩比你的嘴先参加讨论了。

text: 肩说，下次请提前讲清楚。

text: 太好了，肩已经同意了。
