dà jiā nán dé zài tóng yī tiān xià wǔ dōu yǒu kōng . nán dé lái yī cì , wǒ men màn màn guàng . zhǐ píng yī cì huó dòng , nán yǐ pàn duàn yǐ hòu huì bù huì yì zhí lái . mén huài le , wū lǐ de rén nán yǐ chū qù . tā hěn jiān dìng de shuō , dú bù wán yě kě yǐ lái . shì guò yǐ hòu , tā gèng jiān dìng zì jǐ de xuǎn zé . xiān shuō yī jù jiù xíng , zhè yàng néng jiǎn qīng yī xiē yā lì . bǎ shū fēn kāi ná , kě yǐ jiǎn qīng měi cì de zhòng liàng . nà wèi zhǐ tīng de péng you , hòu lái gěi le wǒ yī gè qǐ fā . tā de wèn tí qǐ fā wǒ huàn yī zhǒng zuò fǎ . néng cān jiā de qián tí shì yǒu kōng , bù shì bì xū jiǎng de hǎo . wǒ men tóng yì bāng máng , qián tí shì xiān shuō qīng rì qī . zhè gè shè qū de xiǎo tīng měi zhōu liù xià wǔ kě yǐ yòng . tā zài shè qū lǐ rèn shi le jǐ gè lín jū . huó dòng yǐ hòu , wǒ shōu jí dà jiā xiǎng dú de shū míng . tā shōu jí le jǐ zhāng jiù dì tú . wǒ bù tài tóng yì méi shuō huà jiù shì méi cān jiā zhè gè shuō fǎ . liǎng gè rén de shuō fǎ bù wán quán yī yàng . zuì jìn lián luò tài pín fán , yǒu rén xī wàng zhǐ shōu yī cì tōng zhī . tā bù xiǎng pín fán gēng huàn xué xí dì diǎn . zhè běn shì rù mén de shū , lì zi bǐ jiào duǎn . gāng rù mén de shí hou , tā měi tiān zhǐ liàn shí fēn zhōng . xiǎo tīng lǐ de shū guì , bù shì suǒ yǒu shū dōu kě yǐ jiè zǒu . tā bǎ zì diǎn fàng huí shū guì zuì shàng miàn . zhè fēng lái xìn wèn , xià cì néng bù néng xiān tīng zài jué dìng yào bù yào shuō . tā de lái xìn lǐ méi yǒu xiě xīn de dì zhǐ .
meaning: My first contact with this reading group was through a friend. She has had contact with several kinds of work. This meeting happened by chance; we hadn’t arranged it. He happened to find an old letter inside the book. I come occasionally, not every week. She occasionally makes bread at home. When someone cannot find the page, we patiently wait a moment. This needs patience; it won’t be finished today. As attendance grew, deciding who speaks first kept troubling me. The noise outside bothered her for several days. How do you view people who listen without speaking? They view the same matter differently. Arranging turns is also a skill that needs practice. He is learning bicycle-repair skills. We do not decide speaking order by age. The form asks for age, not birthplace. If the date changes, I will contact the registered participants. Remember to contact her after changing your number. Half an hour reading plus half an hour discussion totals one hour. The two tickets plus travel cost exceed my budget. Recently attendance has been higher than at the beginning. Recently she has often left work earlier. It is rare for everyone to be free on the same afternoon. We rarely get to come here; let’s take our time looking around. One visit alone makes it hard to judge whether someone will keep coming. The broken door makes it difficult for those inside to get out. She firmly said people could come without finishing the book. After trying it he was more certain of his choice. Starting with one sentence can ease some pressure. Carrying the books separately reduces each load. The friend who initially only listened later gave me an idea. Her question inspired me to try a different approach. The prerequisite for attending is availability, not speaking well. We agree to help provided the date is clarified first. This community’s small hall is available on Saturday afternoons. She has met several neighbours in the community. After the event I collect titles people want to read. He collected several old maps. I disagree with the view that not speaking means not participating. The two accounts are not entirely the same. Recent contact was too frequent; someone wanted just one notification. She does not want to change study locations frequently. This is an introductory book with fairly short examples. When starting out he practised only ten minutes a day. Not every book in the hall’s bookcase can be borrowed. She put the dictionary back at the top of the bookcase. This letter asks whether one can listen first and decide later whether to speak. His letter did not give the new address.

parts.text: 我第一次接触这个读书小组，是朋友带我来的。
她接触过几种不同的工作。
这次见面是偶然的，我们没有提前约。
他偶然发现书里夹着一封旧信。
我偶尔来一次，不是每周都来。
她偶尔在家做面包。
有人找不到页，我们耐心等他一下。
这件事需要耐心，今天做不完。
人多以后，谁先说这个问题一直困扰我。
门外的声音困扰了她好几天。
你怎么看待有人只听不说？
同一件事，他们看待的方式不同。
安排大家轮流说，也是一种需要练习的技能。
他正在学习修理自行车的技能。
我们不按年龄决定谁先说。
表上要写年龄，不是出生地。
日期变了，我会和报名的人联络。
换号码以后，记得和她联络。
读半小时，加上交流半小时，一共一个小时。
两张票加上车费，超过了我的预算。
近来每次来的人比刚开始多。
近来她常常早点下班。
大家难得在同一天下午都有空。
难得来一次，我们慢慢逛。
只凭一次活动，难以判断以后会不会一直来。
门坏了，屋里的人难以出去。
她很坚定地说，读不完也可以来。
试过以后，他更坚定自己的选择。
先说一句就行，这样能减轻一些压力。
把书分开拿，可以减轻每次的重量。
那位只听的朋友，后来给了我一个启发。
她的问题启发我换一种做法。
能参加的前提是有空，不是必须讲得好。
我们同意帮忙，前提是先说清日期。
这个社区的小厅每周六下午可以用。
她在社区里认识了几个邻居。
活动以后，我收集大家想读的书名。
他收集了几张旧地图。
我不太同意“没说话就是没参加”这个说法。
两个人的说法不完全一样。
最近联络太频繁，有人希望只收一次通知。
她不想频繁更换学习地点。
这本是入门的书，例子比较短。
刚入门的时候，他每天只练十分钟。
小厅里的书柜，不是所有书都可以借走。
她把字典放回书柜最上面。
这封来信问，下次能不能先听再决定要不要说。
他的来信里没有写新的地址。

text: 我是在朋友带领下第一次接触这个读书小组的。那天下午六个人围着桌子坐，我带来一本书，却不想马上介绍。负责的人一见安静，就自己讲了很长一段。我没有觉得她讲得不好，只是在记谁读过哪些部分，也想听别人怎样说。我走的时候没有解释，所以她当时并不知道我安静的原因。
pinyin: wǒ shì zài péng you dài lǐng xià dì yī cì jiē chù zhè gè dú shū xiǎo zǔ de . nà tiān xià wǔ liù gè rén wéi zhe zhuō zi zuò , wǒ dài lái yī běn shū , què bù xiǎng mǎ shàng jiè shào . fù zé de rén yī jiàn ān jìng , jiù zì jǐ jiǎng le hěn zhǎng yī duàn . wǒ méi yǒu jué de tā jiǎng de bù hǎo , zhǐ shì zài jì shéi dú guò nǎ xiē bù fèn , yě xiǎng tīng bié ren zěn yàng shuō . wǒ zǒu de shí hou méi yǒu jiě shì , suǒ yǐ tā dāng shí bìng bù zhī dào wǒ ān jìng de yuán yīn .
meaning: A friend brought me to the reading group. Six people sat around the table; I had a book but didn’t want to introduce it immediately. The organiser filled the silence with a long explanation. I was listening to others’ reading and ways of discussing it, not disliking her account, but didn’t explain before leaving.

text: 第二次来，我在门口告诉她，上次听得很认真。她问是不是不喜欢在人前说，我说有一点，不过也因为那本书还没读完。她没有让我下次先全部读完再来，而是说可以谈自己已经读到的地方。我后来写了一封来信，问能不能先听再决定，这样不用报名时就答应一定发言。
pinyin: dì èr cì lái , wǒ zài mén kǒu gào sù tā , shàng cì tīng de hěn rèn zhēn . tā wèn shì bú shì bù xǐ huān zài rén qián shuō , wǒ shuō yǒu yī diǎn , bù guò yě yīn wèi nà běn shū hái méi dú wán . tā méi yǒu ràng wǒ xià cì xiān quán bù dú wán zài lái , ér shì shuō kě yǐ tán zì jǐ yǐ jīng dú dào de dì fāng . wǒ hòu lái xiě le yī fēng lái xìn , wèn néng bù néng xiān tīng zài jué dìng , zhè yàng bù yòng bào míng shí jiù dā yìng yí dìng fā yán .
meaning: At my second visit I explained that I’d listened carefully. I was somewhat nervous about speaking and also hadn’t finished the book. She invited discussion of what I’d read instead of requiring completion. I later wrote asking to decide about speaking after listening, rather than commit at registration.

text: 第三次的安排是先读半小时，再交流半小时。我坐在书柜旁边，读到一个角色回家以后又走的地方。她问谁想说，我没有举手；等别人讲完，我才说，自己不觉得他是不在意家里的人。我的一句话引来一个问题，我又找出前面的一小段给大家看。那次我并没有说很多，但比第一回更愿意接着聊。
pinyin: dì sān cì de ān pái shì xiān dú bàn xiǎo shí , zài jiāo liú bàn xiǎo shí . wǒ zuò zài shū guì páng biān , dú dào yī gè jué sè huí jiā yǐ hòu yòu zǒu de dì fāng . tā wèn shéi xiǎng shuō , wǒ méi yǒu jǔ shǒu ; děng bié ren jiǎng wán , wǒ cái shuō , zì jǐ bù jué de tā shì bù zài yì jiā lǐ de rén . wǒ de yī jù huà yǐn lái yī gè wèn tí , wǒ yòu zhǎo chū qián miàn de yī xiǎo duàn gěi dà jiā kàn . nà cì wǒ bìng méi yǒu shuō hěn duō , dàn bǐ dì yī huí gèng yuàn yì jiē zhe liáo .
meaning: At the third session we read and discussed for half an hour each. A character’s departure after returning home interested me. I waited until others spoke, then suggested he wasn’t indifferent to his family. A question prompted me to point to an earlier passage. I spoke little but felt more willing to continue than on the first visit.

text: 有人问我是不是这个新安排把我变得会说了。我觉得这么说太快。我第一次不说，也和那天没读完有关；第三次选的书我更熟悉，朋友也坐在旁边。新安排给了我准备时间，这一点有帮助，却不是只有一个原因。以后换一本难的，我可能仍然先听，不代表这几次参加都白费了。
pinyin: yǒu rén wèn wǒ shì bú shì zhè gè xīn ān pái bǎ wǒ biàn de huì shuō le . wǒ jué de zhè me shuō tài kuài . wǒ dì yī cì bù shuō , yě hé nà tiān méi dú wán yǒu guān ; dì sān cì xuǎn de shū wǒ gèng shú xī , péng you yě zuò zài páng biān . xīn ān pái gěi le wǒ zhǔn bèi shí jiān , zhè yī diǎn yǒu bāng zhù , què bù shì zhǐ yǒu yī gè yuán yīn . yǐ hòu huàn yī běn nán de , wǒ kě néng réng rán xiān tīng , bù dài biǎo zhè jǐ cì cān jiā dōu bái fèi le .
meaning: I resisted attributing my speaking entirely to the new arrangement. Unfinished reading, greater familiarity with the third book and a friend beside me also mattered. Preparation time helped but was not the sole cause. Listening first to a difficult future book wouldn’t erase the value of previous participation.

text: 我参加的时候，发现大家年龄不同。有一位朋友说年轻人都爱看快的故事，我正好喜欢读得慢一点，就告诉他自己的选择。他听了笑，说他自己也常常跳过不喜欢的地方。我们后来没有继续替所有年轻人和年长的人下结论，而是聊这一本哪里想慢慢看，哪里读过就想往下走。
pinyin: wǒ cān jiā de shí hou , fā xiàn dà jiā nián líng bù tóng . yǒu yī wèi péng you shuō nián qīng rén dōu ài kàn kuài de gù shì , wǒ zhèng hǎo xǐ huān dú de màn yī diǎn , jiù gào sù tā zì jǐ de xuǎn zé . tā tīng le xiào , shuō tā zì jǐ yě cháng cháng tiào guò bù xǐ huān de dì fāng . wǒ men hòu lái méi yǒu jì xù tì suǒ yǒu nián qīng rén hé nián zhǎng de rén xià jié lùn , ér shì liáo zhè yī běn nǎ lǐ xiǎng màn màn kàn , nǎ lǐ dú guò jiù xiǎng wǎng xià zǒu .
meaning: A participant generalised that young people liked fast stories. I preferred reading slowly and said so; he admitted skipping parts himself. We moved from age generalisations to which parts of this book each wanted to savour or move past.

text: 最近通知发得频繁，我有一次看见书名，以为时间和以前相同，到了以后才发现那周晚了半小时。负责的人后来把每周安排放在一条消息里，改时间再单独发。我把最重要的日期记下来，感觉比原来容易找。这是我自己的情况，另一个朋友仍然喜欢早点收到书名，方便先借到书。
pinyin: zuì jìn tōng zhī fā de pín fán , wǒ yǒu yī cì kàn jiàn shū míng , yǐ wéi shí jiān hé yǐ qián xiāng tóng , dào le yǐ hòu cái fā xiàn nà zhōu wǎn le bàn xiǎo shí . fù zé de rén hòu lái bǎ měi zhōu ān pái fàng zài yī tiáo xiāo xī lǐ , gǎi shí jiān zài dān dú fā . wǒ bǎ zuì zhòng yào de rì qī jì xià lái , gǎn jué bǐ yuán lái róng yì zhǎo . zhè shì wǒ zì jǐ de qíng kuàng , lìng yī gè péng you réng rán xǐ huān zǎo diǎn shōu dào shū míng , fāng biàn xiān jiè dào shū .
meaning: Frequent notices led me once to assume the usual time and miss a half-hour delay. A consolidated weekly message with separate time-change notices helped me find the essentials. That was my experience; another friend preferred earlier book-title notice to arrange borrowing.

text: 我们把两个需要都告诉她。她拿出本子记下来，说下一本书名放在这周消息的最后，下周的时间和地点仍然一起发。朋友说这样就能先去借书，我也不用一条条找日期。她问我们愿不愿意帮忙看一下消息清不清楚，我们答应了。下一周收到时，朋友马上回她书已经借到，我把日期放进日历，还在旁边记了小厅的位置。
pinyin: wǒ men bǎ liǎng gè xū yào dōu gào sù tā . tā ná chū běn zi jì xià lái , shuō xià yī běn shū míng fàng zài zhè zhōu xiāo xī de zuì hòu , xià zhōu de shí jiān hé dì diǎn réng rán yì qǐ fā . péng you shuō zhè yàng jiù néng xiān qù jiè shū , wǒ yě bù yòng yī tiáo tiáo zhǎo rì qī . tā wèn wǒ men yuàn bù yuàn yì bāng máng kàn yī xià xiāo xī qīng bù qīng chǔ , wǒ men dā yìng le . xià yī zhōu shōu dào shí , péng you mǎ shàng huí tā shū yǐ jīng jiè dào , wǒ bǎ rì qī fàng jìn rì lì , hái zài páng biān jì le xiǎo tīng de wèi zhì .
meaning: We told her both needs. She noted them: the next title would go at the end of this week's message; next week's time and place would still arrive together. My friend could borrow the book early, and I could find the date easily. We agreed to check whether the message was clear. The following week he replied that he'd borrowed it; I added the date and small hall to my calendar.

text: 我现在偶尔来，也会错过几周。再回来时，有人记得我的名字，有人是第一次见。我希望小组继续，但不希望负责的人只能看人数来判断自己的努力。对我来说，能在准备好一句话以后开口，别人愿意耐心听，这已经是很具体的收获。是不是以后每周都来，还要看我的时间，不必现在就作出一个永远不变的答应。
pinyin: wǒ xiàn zài ǒu ěr lái , yě huì cuò guò jǐ zhōu . zài huí lái shí , yǒu rén jì de wǒ de míng zi , yǒu rén shì dì yī cì jiàn . wǒ xī wàng xiǎo zǔ jì xù , dàn bù xī wàng fù zé de rén zhǐ néng kàn rén shù lái pàn duàn zì jǐ de nǔ lì . duì wǒ lái shuō , néng zài zhǔn bèi hǎo yī jù huà yǐ hòu kāi kǒu , bié ren yuàn yì nài xīn tīng , zhè yǐ jīng shì hěn jù tǐ de shōu huò . shì bú shì yǐ hòu měi zhōu dōu lái , hái yào kàn wǒ de shí jiān , bù bì xiàn zài jiù zuò chū yī gè yǒng yuǎn bù biàn de dā yìng .
meaning: I attend occasionally and miss weeks. Returning brings both familiar and new people. I hope the group continues without the organiser judging effort only by attendance. Being able to offer one prepared sentence and receive patient attention is a concrete benefit. Weekly future attendance still depends on my availability, without an eternal promise now.

text: 我是在朋友带领下第一次接触这个读书小组的。那天下午六个人围着桌子坐，我带来一本书，却不想马上介绍。负责的人一见安静，就自己讲了很长一段。我没有觉得她讲得不好，只是在记谁读过哪些部分，也想听别人怎样说。我走的时候没有解释，所以她当时并不知道我安静的原因。第二次来，我在门口告诉她，上次听得很认真。她问是不是不喜欢在人前说，我说有一点，不过也因为那本书还没读完。她没有让我下次先全部读完再来，而是说可以谈自己已经读到的地方。我后来写了一封来信，问能不能先听再决定，这样不用报名时就答应一定发言。第三次的安排是先读半小时，再交流半小时。我坐在书柜旁边，读到一个角色回家以后又走的地方。她问谁想说，我没有举手；等别人讲完，我才说，自己不觉得他是不在意家里的人。我的一句话引来一个问题，我又找出前面的一小段给大家看。那次我并没有说很多，但比第一回更愿意接着聊。有人问我是不是这个新安排把我变得会说了。我觉得这么说太快。我第一次不说，也和那天没读完有关；第三次选的书我更熟悉，朋友也坐在旁边。新安排给了我准备时间，这一点有帮助，却不是只有一个原因。以后换一本难的，我可能仍然先听，不代表这几次参加都白费了。我参加的时候，发现大家年龄不同。有一位朋友说年轻人都爱看快的故事，我正好喜欢读得慢一点，就告诉他自己的选择。他听了笑，说他自己也常常跳过不喜欢的地方。我们后来没有继续替所有年轻人和年长的人下结论，而是聊这一本哪里想慢慢看，哪里读过就想往下走。最近通知发得频繁，我有一次看见书名，以为时间和以前相同，到了以后才发现那周晚了半小时。负责的人后来把每周安排放在一条消息里，改时间再单独发。我把最重要的日期记下来，感觉比原来容易找。这是我自己的情况，另一个朋友仍然喜欢早点收到书名，方便先借到书。我们把两个需要都告诉她。她拿出本子记下来，说下一本书名放在这周消息的最后，下周的时间和地点仍然一起发。朋友说这样就能先去借书，我也不用一条条找日期。她问我们愿不愿意帮忙看一下消息清不清楚，我们答应了。下一周收到时，朋友马上回她书已经借到，我把日期放进日历，还在旁边记了小厅的位置。我现在偶尔来，也会错过几周。再回来时，有人记得我的名字，有人是第一次见。我希望小组继续，但不希望负责的人只能看人数来判断自己的努力。对我来说，能在准备好一句话以后开口，别人愿意耐心听，这已经是很具体的收获。是不是以后每周都来，还要看我的时间，不必现在就作出一个永远不变的答应。

meaning: A friend brought me to the reading group. Six people sat around the table; I had a book but didn’t want to introduce it immediately. The organiser filled the silence with a long explanation. I was listening to others’ reading and ways of discussing it, not disliking her account, but didn’t explain before leaving. At my second visit I explained that I’d listened carefully. I was somewhat nervous about speaking and also hadn’t finished the book. She invited discussion of what I’d read instead of requiring completion. I later wrote asking to decide about speaking after listening, rather than commit at registration. At the third session we read and discussed for half an hour each. A character’s departure after returning home interested me. I waited until others spoke, then suggested he wasn’t indifferent to his family. A question prompted me to point to an earlier passage. I spoke little but felt more willing to continue than on the first visit. I resisted attributing my speaking entirely to the new arrangement. Unfinished reading, greater familiarity with the third book and a friend beside me also mattered. Preparation time helped but was not the sole cause. Listening first to a difficult future book wouldn’t erase the value of previous participation. A participant generalised that young people liked fast stories. I preferred reading slowly and said so; he admitted skipping parts himself. We moved from age generalisations to which parts of this book each wanted to savour or move past. Frequent notices led me once to assume the usual time and miss a half-hour delay. A consolidated weekly message with separate time-change notices helped me find the essentials. That was my experience; another friend preferred earlier book-title notice to arrange borrowing. We told her both needs. She noted them: the next title would go at the end of this week's message; next week's time and place would still arrive together. My friend could borrow the book early, and I could find the date easily. We agreed to check whether the message was clear. The following week he replied that he'd borrowed it; I added the date and small hall to my calendar. I attend occasionally and miss weeks. Returning brings both familiar and new people. I hope the group continues without the organiser judging effort only by attendance. Being able to offer one prepared sentence and receive patient attention is a concrete benefit. Weekly future attendance still depends on my availability, without an eternal promise now.

text: 你看了小图书馆延长时间的那篇文章吗？
pinyin: nǐ kàn le xiǎo tú shū guǎn yán cháng shí jiān de nà piān wén zhāng ma ?
meaning: Did you read the article about the small library extending its hours?

text: 看了。我希望周四能继续开到八点，下班后才来得及。
pinyin: kàn le . wǒ xī wàng zhōu sì néng jì xù kāi dào bā diǎn , xià bān hòu cái lái de jí .
meaning: Yes. I hope Thursdays continue until eight; I can only get there after work.

text: 文章说四周共六十四人次，你觉得够吗？
pinyin: wén zhāng shuō sì zhōu gòng liù shí sì rén cì , nǐ jué de gòu ma ?
meaning: It says sixty-four visits over four weeks. Is that enough, in your view?

text: 够不够要看什么目的吧，至少不是完全没人来。
pinyin: gòu bù gòu yào kàn shén me mù dì ba , zhì shǎo bù shì wán quán méi rén lái .
meaning: Enough for what purpose? At least it wasn’t entirely unused.

text: 但也不是六十四个不同的人。
pinyin: dàn yě bù shì liù shí sì gè bù tóng de rén .
meaning: But not necessarily sixty-four different people.

text: 对，我就去了三次，不能把我算成三个居民。
pinyin: duì , wǒ jiù qù le sān cì , bù néng bǎ wǒ suàn chéng sān gè jū mín .
meaning: Right. I went three times; that doesn’t make me three residents.

text: 有人评论说，大家都喜欢聊天，应该改成交流活动。
pinyin: yǒu rén píng lùn shuō , dà jiā dōu xǐ huān liáo tiān , yīng gāi gǎi chéng jiāo liú huó dòng .
meaning: Someone commented that everyone likes chatting, so it should become a discussion event.

text: 我可不是，我去是想安静看书。
pinyin: wǒ kě bú shì , wǒ qù shì xiǎng ān jìng kàn shū .
meaning: I don’t. I go to read quietly.

text: 所以“大家都喜欢”说得太满了。
pinyin: suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu xǐ huān shuō de tài mǎn le .
meaning: So “everyone likes it” goes too far.

text: 是啊。我想聊天的时候，会另外找地方。
pinyin: shì a . wǒ xiǎng liáo tiān de shí hou , huì lìng wài zhǎo dì fāng .
meaning: Yes. When I want to talk, I go somewhere else.

text: 你会要求每天都延长吗？
pinyin: nǐ huì yāo qiú měi tiān dōu yán cháng ma ?
meaning: Would you ask for longer hours every day?

text: 现在不敢这么说。先把周四安排好，再看看别的日子。
pinyin: xiàn zài bù gǎn zhè me shuō . xiān bǎ zhōu sì ān pái hǎo , zài kàn kàn bié de rì zi .
meaning: Not at this stage. Settle Thursdays first, then look at other days.

text: 负责关门的两个人，每次都多留两小时。
pinyin: fù zé guān mén de liǎng gè rén , měi cì dōu duō liú liǎng xiǎo shí .
meaning: The two people closing up each stay two extra hours.

text: 这也要算进去。不能只问来的人方便不方便。
pinyin: zhè yě yào suàn jìn qù . bù néng zhǐ wèn lái de rén fāng biàn bù fāng biàn .
meaning: That matters too. We can’t consider only convenience for visitors.

text: 如果他们下个月没空呢？
pinyin: rú guǒ tā men xià gè yuè méi kōng ne ?
meaning: What if they are unavailable next month?

text: 就先确认有没有别人接，不要先发继续开放的通知。
pinyin: jiù xiān què rèn yǒu méi yǒu bié ren jiē , bú yào xiān fā jì xù kāi fàng de tōng zhī .
meaning: Check for someone to take over before announcing continued opening.

text: 看来你的立场是继续试，不是保证马上扩大。
pinyin: kàn lái nǐ de lì chǎng shì jì xù shì , bù shì bǎo zhèng mǎ shàng kuò dà .
meaning: So your position is to keep trying, not guarantee immediate expansion.

text: 对。支持这个办法，也可以说清还不知道什么。
pinyin: duì . zhī chí zhè gè bàn fǎ , yě kě yǐ shuō qīng hái bù zhī dào shén me .
meaning: Right. Supporting it can include stating what we still don’t know.

pinyin: nǐ kàn le xiǎo tú shū guǎn yán cháng shí jiān de nà piān wén zhāng ma ? kàn le . wǒ xī wàng zhōu sì néng jì xù kāi dào bā diǎn , xià bān hòu cái lái de jí . wén zhāng shuō sì zhōu gòng liù shí sì rén cì , nǐ jué de gòu ma ? gòu bù gòu yào kàn shén me mù dì ba , zhì shǎo bù shì wán quán méi rén lái . dàn yě bù shì liù shí sì gè bù tóng de rén . duì , wǒ jiù qù le sān cì , bù néng bǎ wǒ suàn chéng sān gè jū mín . yǒu rén píng lùn shuō , dà jiā dōu xǐ huān liáo tiān , yīng gāi gǎi chéng jiāo liú huó dòng . wǒ kě bú shì , wǒ qù shì xiǎng ān jìng kàn shū . suǒ yǐ dà jiā dōu xǐ huān shuō de tài mǎn le . shì a . wǒ xiǎng liáo tiān de shí hou , huì lìng wài zhǎo dì fāng . nǐ huì yāo qiú měi tiān dōu yán cháng ma ? xiàn zài bù gǎn zhè me shuō . xiān bǎ zhōu sì ān pái hǎo , zài kàn kàn bié de rì zi . fù zé guān mén de liǎng gè rén , měi cì dōu duō liú liǎng xiǎo shí . zhè yě yào suàn jìn qù . bù néng zhǐ wèn lái de rén fāng biàn bù fāng biàn . rú guǒ tā men xià gè yuè méi kōng ne ? jiù xiān què rèn yǒu méi yǒu bié ren jiē , bú yào xiān fā jì xù kāi fàng de tōng zhī . kàn lái nǐ de lì chǎng shì jì xù shì , bù shì bǎo zhèng mǎ shàng kuò dà . duì . zhī chí zhè gè bàn fǎ , yě kě yǐ shuō qīng hái bù zhī dào shén me .
meaning: Did you read the article about the small library extending its hours? Yes. I hope Thursdays continue until eight; I can only get there after work. It says sixty-four visits over four weeks. Is that enough, in your view? Enough for what purpose? At least it wasn’t entirely unused. But not necessarily sixty-four different people. Right. I went three times; that doesn’t make me three residents. Someone commented that everyone likes chatting, so it should become a discussion event. I don’t. I go to read quietly. So “everyone likes it” goes too far. Yes. When I want to talk, I go somewhere else. Would you ask for longer hours every day? Not at this stage. Settle Thursdays first, then look at other days. The two people closing up each stay two extra hours. That matters too. We can’t consider only convenience for visitors. What if they are unavailable next month? Check for someone to take over before announcing continued opening. So your position is to keep trying, not guarantee immediate expansion. Right. Supporting it can include stating what we still don’t know.

text: 这个社区的小图书馆原来每天下午六点关闭。四周试办中，周四延长到晚上八点，其他日子的时间不变。我支持再试四周，因为下班以后来的人确实找到了一段能读书的时间。不过，我的立场不是马上每天都开到八点，也不是说不来的人都不喜欢读书。这两个更大的判断，需要另外的依据。
pinyin: zhè gè shè qū de xiǎo tú shū guǎn yuán lái měi tiān xià wǔ liù diǎn guān bì . sì zhōu shì bàn zhōng , zhōu sì yán cháng dào wǎn shang bā diǎn , qí tā rì zi de shí jiān bù biàn . wǒ zhī chí zài shì sì zhōu , yīn wèi xià bān yǐ hòu lái de rén què shí zhǎo dào le yī duàn néng dú shū de shí jiān . bù guò , wǒ de lì chǎng bù shì mǎ shàng měi tiān dōu kāi dào bā diǎn , yě bù shì shuō bù lái de rén dōu bù xǐ huān dú shū . zhè liǎng gè gèng dà de pàn duàn , xū yào lìng wài de yī jù .
meaning: The community’s small library normally closed at six. A four-week pilot extended Thursdays to eight, with other days unchanged. I support another four weeks because some workers found time to read, but not immediate daily extension or a claim that non-attendees dislike reading. Those broader judgments need separate support.

text: 工作人员把四个周四的晚间到访分别记为十八、二十、十二和十四人次，共六十四人次。这些记录不包括负责的人。人次说明发生了多少次到访，不等于有六十四个不同的居民。一个人来了三次，就贡献三人次；如果要知道有多少不同的人，需要另一种记录，这次没有做。
pinyin: gōng zuò rén yuán bǎ sì gè zhōu sì de wǎn jiān dào fǎng fēn bié jì wèi shí bā , èr shí , shí èr hé shí sì rén cì , gòng liù shí sì rén cì . zhè xiē jì lù bù bāo kuò fù zé de rén . rén cì shuō míng fā shēng le duō shao cì dào fǎng , bù děng yú yǒu liù shí sì gè bù tóng de jū mín . yī gè rén lái le sān cì , jiù gòng xiàn sān rén cì ; rú guǒ yào zhī dào yǒu duō shao bù tóng de rén , xū yào lìng yī zhǒng jì lù , zhè cì méi yǒu zuò .
meaning: The four Thursday evenings recorded eighteen, twenty, twelve and fourteen visitor entries, sixty-four total, excluding staff. These are visits rather than sixty-four distinct residents: one person attending three times contributes three. Unique attendance would require a different record that wasn’t kept.

text: 有人说六十四太少，也有人说已经很多。我觉得先问清比较的对象，才能讨论这个差距。小厅只有三十个座位，不能拿一个晚上来的人数，直接和全社区的居民人数比较，再决定所有人的需要。记录里也没有写谁在外地、谁那个晚上要照顾家人，所以没有到场，并不能独自说明这个时间对他们没有价值。
pinyin: yǒu rén shuō liù shí sì tài shǎo , yě yǒu rén shuō yǐ jīng hěn duō . wǒ jué de xiān wèn qīng bǐ jiào de duì xiàng , cái néng tǎo lùn zhè gè chā jù . xiǎo tīng zhǐ yǒu sān shí gè zuò wèi , bù néng ná yī gè wǎn shang lái de rén shù , zhí jiē hé quán shè qū de jū mín rén shù bǐ jiào , zài jué dìng suǒ yǒu rén de xū yào . jì lù lǐ yě méi yǒu xiě shéi zài wài dì , shéi nà gè wǎn shang yào zhào gù jiā rén , suǒ yǐ méi yǒu dào chǎng , bìng bù néng dú zì shuō míng zhè gè shí jiān duì tā men méi yǒu jià zhí .
meaning: Some judged sixty-four low, others high. We need to establish the comparison before interpreting a gap. The hall’s thirty seats and one evening’s attendance cannot directly represent the needs of the whole community. Records don’t show travel or caregiving conflicts, so absence alone cannot establish that the hours had no value.

text: 延长开放不是没有成本。两位负责的人每次多留两小时，四周合起来是十六小时的人员时间，整理和关门也在这段时间里。这个数字不是两个人各自留了十六小时，更不是每位居民都花了十六小时。下个月能不能继续，先要问两个人的安排，有没有别人接手，不能只看到访者方便，就替负责的人答应。
pinyin: yán cháng kāi fàng bù shì méi yǒu chéng běn . liǎng wèi fù zé de rén měi cì duō liú liǎng xiǎo shí , sì zhōu hé qǐ lái shì shí liù xiǎo shí de rén yuán shí jiān , zhěng lǐ hé guān mén yě zài zhè duàn shí jiān lǐ . zhè gè shù zì bù shì liǎng gè rén gè zì liú le shí liù xiǎo shí , gèng bù shì měi wèi jū mín dōu huā le shí liù xiǎo shí . xià gè yuè néng bù néng jì xù , xiān yào wèn liǎng gè rén de ān pái , yǒu méi yǒu bié ren jiē shǒu , bù néng zhǐ kàn dào fǎng zhě fāng biàn , jiù tì fù zé de rén dā yìng .
meaning: Two staff each stayed two extra hours per evening: sixteen staff-hours across four weeks, including tidying and closing. It is not sixteen hours for each person or each resident. Next month depends on availability and potential replacements, not a promise made for staff solely because visitors benefit.

text: 在评论里，有人建议把晚间改成交流活动，说一起聊天更能吸引人。我的主观感受正好不同：我下班以后想有一个安静地方，把没读完的几页读完。还有人愿意来讨论，我不认为他们错了；但在一个小厅里，两种活动同时进行，会有声音的矛盾。能否另找时间或地点，要先问场地安排，不能只把所有人放进去就当作两种需要都满足。
pinyin: zài píng lùn lǐ , yǒu rén jiàn yì bǎ wǎn jiān gǎi chéng jiāo liú huó dòng , shuō yì qǐ liáo tiān gèng néng xī yǐn rén . wǒ de zhǔ guān gǎn shòu zhèng hǎo bù tóng : wǒ xià bān yǐ hòu xiǎng yǒu yī gè ān jìng dì fāng , bǎ méi dú wán de jǐ yè dú wán . hái yǒu rén yuàn yì lái tǎo lùn , wǒ bù rèn wéi tā men cuò le ; dàn zài yī gè xiǎo tīng lǐ , liǎng zhǒng huó dòng tóng shí jìn xíng , huì yǒu shēng yīn de máo dùn . néng fǒu lìng zhǎo shí jiān huò dì diǎn , yào xiān wèn chǎng dì ān pái , bù néng zhǐ bǎ suǒ yǒu rén fàng jìn qù jiù dàng zuò liǎng zhǒng xū yào dōu mǎn zú .
meaning: One comment proposed discussion to attract people. My own preference is a quiet place to finish reading after work. Others may want conversation too, but simultaneous activities in one small hall create noise conflict. A separate time or space needs checking; simply combining everyone doesn’t satisfy both needs.

text: 我也担心，只收集来的人意见，会缺乏没来的群体的声音。如果他们说交通不方便，延长两小时可能没有解决那个问题；如果有人只在周二有空，也不能说周四的成效已经替他解决了。可以在原来的公告旁边留一个反馈办法，让愿意的人说明时间和原因，不强迫任何人解释自己的全部生活。
pinyin: wǒ yě dān xīn , zhǐ shōu jí lái de rén yì jiàn , huì quē fá méi lái de qún tǐ de shēng yīn . rú guǒ tā men shuō jiāo tōng bù fāng biàn , yán cháng liǎng xiǎo shí kě néng méi yǒu jiě jué nà gè wèn tí ; rú guǒ yǒu rén zhǐ zài zhōu èr yǒu kōng , yě bù néng shuō zhōu sì de chéng xiào yǐ jīng tì tā jiě jué le . kě yǐ zài yuán lái de gōng gào páng biān liú yī gè fǎn kuì bàn fǎ , ràng yuàn yì de rén shuō míng shí jiān hé yuán yīn , bù qiǎng pò rèn hé rén jiě shì zì jǐ de quán bù shēng huó .
meaning: Only asking attendees leaves non-attendees’ views missing. Longer hours may not solve travel difficulty or a Tuesday-only schedule. A feedback channel by the existing notice could invite timing and reasons without demanding accounts of everyone’s whole life.

text: 因此，我建议继续周四四周，把到访次数、安静阅读的情况和负责人的时间分别记下来。一次人多不算每次都好，一次下雨人少也不该直接终止。我们还不能排除天气和不同活动的影响，可以把情况写清，再作评估。继续试是为了检验安排能不能持续，不是先把想要的结论写好，再找数字装进去。
pinyin: yīn cǐ , wǒ jiàn yì jì xù zhōu sì sì zhōu , bǎ dào fǎng cì shù , ān jìng yuè dú de qíng kuàng hé fù zé rén de shí jiān fēn bié jì xià lái . yī cì rén duō bù suàn měi cì dōu hǎo , yī cì xià yǔ rén shǎo yě bù gāi zhí jiē zhōng zhǐ . wǒ men hái bù néng pái chú tiān qì hé bù tóng huó dòng de yǐng xiǎng , kě yǐ bǎ qíng kuàng xiě qīng , zài zuò píng gū . jì xù shì shì wèi le jiǎn yàn ān pái néng bù néng chí xù , bù shì xiān bǎ xiǎng yào de jié lùn xiě hǎo , zài zhǎo shù zì zhuāng jìn qù .
meaning: I propose four more Thursdays, recording visits, quiet reading and staffing time separately. One busy evening doesn’t prove all evenings work; one rainy low-attendance evening shouldn’t alone end the trial. Weather and other events remain possible influences. Continued testing should examine sustainability rather than fit numbers into a predetermined conclusion.

text: 这个建议保留了我的期望，也承认它的限制。我希望下班以后有地方读，并愿意提前收好书，不让关门的人不断等。以后如果证据支持扩大，再讨论其他日子；如果人员时间不够，就先缩小或暂停。把支持说得有条件，不会使它变成反对，反而让下一步可以具体地问、具体地做。
pinyin: zhè gè jiàn yì bǎo liú le wǒ de qī wàng , yě chéng rèn tā de xiàn zhì . wǒ xī wàng xià bān yǐ hòu yǒu dì fāng dú , bìng yuàn yì tí qián shōu hǎo shū , bù ràng guān mén de rén bù duàn děng . yǐ hòu rú guǒ zhèng jù zhī chí kuò dà , zài tǎo lùn qí tā rì zi ; rú guǒ rén yuán shí jiān bù gòu , jiù xiān suō xiǎo huò zàn tíng . bǎ zhī chí shuō de yǒu tiáo jiàn , bù huì shǐ tā biàn chéng fǎn duì , fǎn ér ràng xià yī bù kě yǐ jù tǐ de wèn , jù tǐ de zuò .
meaning: I hope for a place after work and will pack before closing. Expansion can be discussed if supported; inadequate staffing may require reducing or pausing hours. Conditional support remains support, while making the next steps concrete.

pinyin: zhè gè shè qū de xiǎo tú shū guǎn yuán lái měi tiān xià wǔ liù diǎn guān bì . sì zhōu shì bàn zhōng , zhōu sì yán cháng dào wǎn shang bā diǎn , qí tā rì zi de shí jiān bù biàn . wǒ zhī chí zài shì sì zhōu , yīn wèi xià bān yǐ hòu lái de rén què shí zhǎo dào le yī duàn néng dú shū de shí jiān . bù guò , wǒ de lì chǎng bù shì mǎ shàng měi tiān dōu kāi dào bā diǎn , yě bù shì shuō bù lái de rén dōu bù xǐ huān dú shū . zhè liǎng gè gèng dà de pàn duàn , xū yào lìng wài de yī jù . gōng zuò rén yuán bǎ sì gè zhōu sì de wǎn jiān dào fǎng fēn bié jì wèi shí bā , èr shí , shí èr hé shí sì rén cì , gòng liù shí sì rén cì . zhè xiē jì lù bù bāo kuò fù zé de rén . rén cì shuō míng fā shēng le duō shao cì dào fǎng , bù děng yú yǒu liù shí sì gè bù tóng de jū mín . yī gè rén lái le sān cì , jiù gòng xiàn sān rén cì ; rú guǒ yào zhī dào yǒu duō shao bù tóng de rén , xū yào lìng yī zhǒng jì lù , zhè cì méi yǒu zuò . yǒu rén shuō liù shí sì tài shǎo , yě yǒu rén shuō yǐ jīng hěn duō . wǒ jué de xiān wèn qīng bǐ jiào de duì xiàng , cái néng tǎo lùn zhè gè chā jù . xiǎo tīng zhǐ yǒu sān shí gè zuò wèi , bù néng ná yī gè wǎn shang lái de rén shù , zhí jiē hé quán shè qū de jū mín rén shù bǐ jiào , zài jué dìng suǒ yǒu rén de xū yào . jì lù lǐ yě méi yǒu xiě shéi zài wài dì , shéi nà gè wǎn shang yào zhào gù jiā rén , suǒ yǐ méi yǒu dào chǎng , bìng bù néng dú zì shuō míng zhè gè shí jiān duì tā men méi yǒu jià zhí . yán cháng kāi fàng bù shì méi yǒu chéng běn . liǎng wèi fù zé de rén měi cì duō liú liǎng xiǎo shí , sì zhōu hé qǐ lái shì shí liù xiǎo shí de rén yuán shí jiān , zhěng lǐ hé guān mén yě zài zhè duàn shí jiān lǐ . zhè gè shù zì bù shì liǎng gè rén gè zì liú le shí liù xiǎo shí , gèng bù shì měi wèi jū mín dōu huā le shí liù xiǎo shí . xià gè yuè néng bù néng jì xù , xiān yào wèn liǎng gè rén de ān pái , yǒu méi yǒu bié ren jiē shǒu , bù néng zhǐ kàn dào fǎng zhě fāng biàn , jiù tì fù zé de rén dā yìng . zài píng lùn lǐ , yǒu rén jiàn yì bǎ wǎn jiān gǎi chéng jiāo liú huó dòng , shuō yì qǐ liáo tiān gèng néng xī yǐn rén . wǒ de zhǔ guān gǎn shòu zhèng hǎo bù tóng : wǒ xià bān yǐ hòu xiǎng yǒu yī gè ān jìng dì fāng , bǎ méi dú wán de jǐ yè dú wán . hái yǒu rén yuàn yì lái tǎo lùn , wǒ bù rèn wéi tā men cuò le ; dàn zài yī gè xiǎo tīng lǐ , liǎng zhǒng huó dòng tóng shí jìn xíng , huì yǒu shēng yīn de máo dùn . néng fǒu lìng zhǎo shí jiān huò dì diǎn , yào xiān wèn chǎng dì ān pái , bù néng zhǐ bǎ suǒ yǒu rén fàng jìn qù jiù dàng zuò liǎng zhǒng xū yào dōu mǎn zú . wǒ yě dān xīn , zhǐ shōu jí lái de rén yì jiàn , huì quē fá méi lái de qún tǐ de shēng yīn . rú guǒ tā men shuō jiāo tōng bù fāng biàn , yán cháng liǎng xiǎo shí kě néng méi yǒu jiě jué nà gè wèn tí ; rú guǒ yǒu rén zhǐ zài zhōu èr yǒu kōng , yě bù néng shuō zhōu sì de chéng xiào yǐ jīng tì tā jiě jué le . kě yǐ zài yuán lái de gōng gào páng biān liú yī gè fǎn kuì bàn fǎ , ràng yuàn yì de rén shuō míng shí jiān hé yuán yīn , bù qiǎng pò rèn hé rén jiě shì zì jǐ de quán bù shēng huó . yīn cǐ , wǒ jiàn yì jì xù zhōu sì sì zhōu , bǎ dào fǎng cì shù , ān jìng yuè dú de qíng kuàng hé fù zé rén de shí jiān fēn bié jì xià lái . yī cì rén duō bù suàn měi cì dōu hǎo , yī cì xià yǔ rén shǎo yě bù gāi zhí jiē zhōng zhǐ . wǒ men hái bù néng pái chú tiān qì hé bù tóng huó dòng de yǐng xiǎng , kě yǐ bǎ qíng kuàng xiě qīng , zài zuò píng gū . jì xù shì shì wèi le jiǎn yàn ān pái néng bù néng chí xù , bù shì xiān bǎ xiǎng yào de jié lùn xiě hǎo , zài zhǎo shù zì zhuāng jìn qù . zhè gè jiàn yì bǎo liú le wǒ de qī wàng , yě chéng rèn tā de xiàn zhì . wǒ xī wàng xià bān yǐ hòu yǒu dì fāng dú , bìng yuàn yì tí qián shōu hǎo shū , bù ràng guān mén de rén bù duàn děng . yǐ hòu rú guǒ zhèng jù zhī chí kuò dà , zài tǎo lùn qí tā rì zi ; rú guǒ rén yuán shí jiān bù gòu , jiù xiān suō xiǎo huò zàn tíng . bǎ zhī chí shuō de yǒu tiáo jiàn , bù huì shǐ tā biàn chéng fǎn duì , fǎn ér ràng xià yī bù kě yǐ jù tǐ de wèn , jù tǐ de zuò .
meaning: The community’s small library normally closed at six. A four-week pilot extended Thursdays to eight, with other days unchanged. I support another four weeks because some workers found time to read, but not immediate daily extension or a claim that non-attendees dislike reading. Those broader judgments need separate support. The four Thursday evenings recorded eighteen, twenty, twelve and fourteen visitor entries, sixty-four total, excluding staff. These are visits rather than sixty-four distinct residents: one person attending three times contributes three. Unique attendance would require a different record that wasn’t kept. Some judged sixty-four low, others high. We need to establish the comparison before interpreting a gap. The hall’s thirty seats and one evening’s attendance cannot directly represent the needs of the whole community. Records don’t show travel or caregiving conflicts, so absence alone cannot establish that the hours had no value. Two staff each stayed two extra hours per evening: sixteen staff-hours across four weeks, including tidying and closing. It is not sixteen hours for each person or each resident. Next month depends on availability and potential replacements, not a promise made for staff solely because visitors benefit. One comment proposed discussion to attract people. My own preference is a quiet place to finish reading after work. Others may want conversation too, but simultaneous activities in one small hall create noise conflict. A separate time or space needs checking; simply combining everyone doesn’t satisfy both needs. Only asking attendees leaves non-attendees’ views missing. Longer hours may not solve travel difficulty or a Tuesday-only schedule. A feedback channel by the existing notice could invite timing and reasons without demanding accounts of everyone’s whole life. I propose four more Thursdays, recording visits, quiet reading and staffing time separately. One busy evening doesn’t prove all evenings work; one rainy low-attendance evening shouldn’t alone end the trial. Weather and other events remain possible influences. Continued testing should examine sustainability rather than fit numbers into a predetermined conclusion. I hope for a place after work and will pack before closing. Expansion can be discussed if supported; inadequate staffing may require reducing or pausing hours. Conditional support remains support, while making the next steps concrete.

工作人员把四个周四的晚间到访分别记为十八、二十、十二和十四人次，共六十四人次。这些记录不包括负责的人。人次说明发生了多少次到访，不等于有六十四个不同的居民。一个人来了三次，就贡献三人次；如果要知道有多少不同的人，需要另一种记录，这次没有做。
有人说六十四太少，也有人说已经很多。我觉得先问清比较的对象，才能讨论这个差距。小厅只有三十个座位，不能拿一个晚上来的人数，直接和全社区的居民人数比较，再决定所有人的需要。记录里也没有写谁在外地、谁那个晚上要照顾家人，所以没有到场，并不能独自说明这个时间对他们没有价值。
延长开放不是没有成本。两位负责的人每次多留两小时，四周合起来是十六小时的人员时间，整理和关门也在这段时间里。这个数字不是两个人各自留了十六小时，更不是每位居民都花了十六小时。下个月能不能继续，先要问两个人的安排，有没有别人接手，不能只看到访者方便，就替负责的人答应。
在评论里，有人建议把晚间改成交流活动，说一起聊天更能吸引人。我的主观感受正好不同：我下班以后想有一个安静地方，把没读完的几页读完。还有人愿意来讨论，我不认为他们错了；但在一个小厅里，两种活动同时进行，会有声音的矛盾。能否另找时间或地点，要先问场地安排，不能只把所有人放进去就当作两种需要都满足。
我也担心，只收集来的人意见，会缺乏没来的群体的声音。如果他们说交通不方便，延长两小时可能没有解决那个问题；如果有人只在周二有空，也不能说周四的成效已经替他解决了。可以在原来的公告旁边留一个反馈办法，让愿意的人说明时间和原因，不强迫任何人解释自己的全部生活。
因此，我建议继续周四四周，把到访次数、安静阅读的情况和负责人的时间分别记下来。一次人多不算每次都好，一次下雨人少也不该直接终止。我们还不能排除天气和不同活动的影响，可以把情况写清，再作评估。继续试是为了检验安排能不能持续，不是先把想要的结论写好，再找数字装进去。
这个建议保留了我的期望，也承认它的限制。我希望下班以后有地方读，并愿意提前收好书，不让关门的人不断等。以后如果证据支持扩大，再讨论其他日子；如果人员时间不够，就先缩小或暂停。把支持说得有条件，不会使它变成反对，反而让下一步可以具体地问、具体地做。

text: 你一晚上看了多少页？
pinyin: nǐ yī wǎn shang kàn le duō shao yè ?
meaning: How many pages did you read this evening?

text: 三页。
pinyin: sān yè .
meaning: Three.

text: 我看了二十页。
pinyin: wǒ kàn le èr shí yè .
meaning: I read twenty.

text: 你的书一页只有两句话吧？
pinyin: nǐ de shū yī yè zhǐ yǒu liǎng jù huà ba ?
meaning: Does your book have only two sentences per page?

text: 对，还有很大的画。
pinyin: duì , hái yǒu hěn dà de huà .
meaning: Yes, and large pictures.

text: 那别光比页数。
pinyin: nà bié guāng bǐ yè shù .
meaning: Then don’t compare only page counts.

text: 你的三页是不是一页全是字？
pinyin: nǐ de sān yè shì bú shì yī yè quán shì zì ?
meaning: Are your three pages full of text?

text: 是，还来回看了两次。
pinyin: shì , hái lái huí kàn le liǎng cì .
meaning: Yes, and I read them twice.

text: 好，我们都各自看明白一点了。
pinyin: hǎo , wǒ men dōu gè zì kàn míng bái yī diǎn le .
meaning: Okay, we each understood a little more.

text: 我还没完全明白，最后一句要再想。
pinyin: wǒ hái méi wán quán míng bái , zuì hòu yī jù yào zài xiǎng .
meaning: Not entirely for me; I still need to think about the final sentence.

text: 那我先出去，你留在这里想。
pinyin: nà wǒ xiān chū qù , nǐ liú zài zhè lǐ xiǎng .
meaning: Then I’ll go outside first; you can stay and think.

text: 八点关门以前，我一定收好书。
pinyin: bā diǎn guān mén yǐ qián , wǒ yí dìng shōu hǎo shū .
meaning: I’ll put the book away before closing at eight.

text: 她提醒我，不要把主观印象当成人数。
pinyin: tā tí xǐng wǒ , bú yào bǎ zhǔ guān yìn xiàng dàng chéng rén shù .
meaning: She reminded me not to treat a subjective impression as a count.

text: 他解释了自己的立场，也听了对方的理由。
pinyin: tā jiě shì le zì jǐ de lì chǎng , yě tīng le duì fāng de lǐ yóu .
meaning: He explained his position and listened to the other side’s reasons.

text: 这个故事的时间逻辑有问题。
pinyin: zhè gè gù shì de shí jiān luó jí yǒu wèn tí .
meaning: The chronology of this story has a logical problem.

text: 他说的两个时间互相矛盾。
pinyin: tā shuō de liǎng gè shí jiān hù xiāng máo dùn .
meaning: The two times he gave contradict each other.

text: 我是间接听到这个消息的，没有见到本人。
pinyin: wǒ shì jiàn jiē tīng dào zhè gè xiāo xī de , méi yǒu jiàn dào běn rén .
meaning: I heard this news indirectly, without seeing the person.

text: 先排除时间冲突，再选地点。
pinyin: xiān pái chú shí jiān chōng tū , zài xuǎn dì diǎn .
meaning: Rule out scheduling conflicts before choosing the venue.

text: 她把说话的声音控制得很小。
pinyin: tā bǎ shuō huà de shēng yīn kòng zhì de hěn xiǎo .
meaning: She kept her speaking voice very quiet.

text: 发现的问题已经加以说明。
pinyin: fā xiàn de wèn tí yǐ jīng jiā yǐ shuō míng .
meaning: The problems found have been explained.

text: 他依据原来的记录核对日期。
pinyin: tā yī jù yuán lái de jì lù hé duì rì qī .
meaning: He checked dates against the original record.

text: 请把两种说法都记下来。
pinyin: qǐng bǎ liǎng zhǒng shuō fǎ dōu jì xià lái .
meaning: Please record both accounts.

text: 这个建议的前提还没有确认。
pinyin: zhè gè jiàn yì de qián tí hái méi yǒu què rèn .
meaning: The premise of this suggestion has not been confirmed.

text: 评估不能只看一次最好结果。
pinyin: píng gū bù néng zhǐ kàn yī cì zuì hǎo jié guǒ .
meaning: An evaluation cannot look only at one best result.

text: 她读完文章，写了一条简短评论。
pinyin: tā dú wán wén zhāng , xiě le yī tiáo jiǎn duǎn píng lùn .
meaning: After reading the article she wrote a short comment.

text: 大家对结尾的期望不一样。
pinyin: dà jiā duì jié wěi de qī wàng bù yī yàng .
meaning: People have different expectations of the ending.

text: 一句解释改变了争论的局面。
pinyin: yī jù jiě shì gǎi biàn le zhēng lùn de jú miàn .
meaning: An explanation changed the course of the argument.

text: 这段解释缺乏具体例子。
pinyin: zhè duàn jiě shì quē fá jù tǐ lì zi .
meaning: This explanation lacks concrete examples.

text: 不能用一个人代表整个群体。
pinyin: bù néng yòng yī gè rén dài biǎo zhěng gè qún tǐ .
meaning: One person cannot stand for a whole group.

text: 这次交通费在总费用中的比重更大。
pinyin: zhè cì jiāo tōng fèi zài zǒng fèi yòng zhōng de bǐ zhòng gèng dà .
meaning: Travel makes up a larger share of the total cost this time.

text: 便宜的材料不一定让总成本下降。
pinyin: pián yi de cái liào bù yí dìng ràng zǒng chéng běn xià jiàng .
meaning: Cheap material doesn’t necessarily reduce total cost.

text: 我们下周再看看这个办法的成效。
pinyin: wǒ men xià zhōu zài kàn kàn zhè gè bàn fǎ de chéng xiào .
meaning: We will look again at this method’s results next week.

text: 路线大致相同，最后一段不同。
pinyin: lù xiàn dà zhì xiāng tóng , zuì hòu yī duàn bù tóng .
meaning: The routes are broadly the same, but differ at the end.

text: 她不想只做单一类型的工作。
pinyin: tā bù xiǎng zhǐ zuò dān yī lèi xíng de gōng zuò .
meaning: She doesn’t want to do only one type of work.

text: 练习的表现和实际比赛还有差距。
pinyin: liàn xí de biǎo xiàn hé shí jì bǐ sài hái yǒu chā jù .
meaning: There is still a gap between practice performance and competition.

text: 这一次检验发现了两个问题。
pinyin: zhè yī cì jiǎn yàn fā xiàn le liǎng gè wèn tí .
meaning: This examination found two problems.

text: 我喜欢晚上读，但这是主观感受。她提醒我，不要把主观印象当成人数。我的立场是先继续试，不是马上每天延长。他解释了自己的立场，也听了对方的理由。从有人来跳到人人需要，这个逻辑不成立。这个故事的时间逻辑有问题。想安静读和想聊天，在同一个小厅里有矛盾。他说的两个时间互相矛盾。报名表间接告诉我们有人有兴趣，不说明一定到场。我是间接听到这个消息的，没有见到本人。还不能排除天气影响人数。先排除时间冲突，再选地点。可以控制一次试办的时长，不能控制谁一定来。她把说话的声音控制得很小。这些意见要加以讨论，不是直接删掉。发现的问题已经加以说明。人数是一个依据，但不是全部。他依据原来的记录核对日期。我不同意“少来一次就是不需要”这个说法。请把两种说法都记下来。继续试办的前提是有人能负责关门。这个建议的前提还没有确认。四周以后，再评估延长时间的安排。评估不能只看一次最好结果。这条评论提出了安静的问题。她读完文章，写了一条简短评论。我期望方便一些，不是要求随时开门。大家对结尾的期望不一样。我们想改变下班以后无处读书的局面。一句解释改变了争论的局面。没有问不来的人，记录就缺乏他们的意见。这段解释缺乏具体例子。不同群体需要的时间可能不同。不能用一个人代表整个群体。不知道总人数，就算不出这个比重。这次交通费在总费用中的比重更大。多开两小时，也有整理和关门的成本。便宜的材料不一定让总成本下降。有人找到读书时间，是一个成效，但还要继续看。我们下周再看看这个办法的成效。我先大致介绍四周的记录。路线大致相同，最后一段不同。只看总人数，这个依据太单一。她不想只做单一类型的工作。想来的时间和开放时间有差距。练习的表现和实际比赛还有差距。再试四周，可以检验这个安排能不能持续。这一次检验发现了两个问题。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān wǎn shang dú , dàn zhè shì zhǔ guān gǎn shòu . tā tí xǐng wǒ , bú yào bǎ zhǔ guān yìn xiàng dàng chéng rén shù . wǒ de lì chǎng shì xiān jì xù shì , bù shì mǎ shàng měi tiān yán cháng . tā jiě shì le zì jǐ de lì chǎng , yě tīng le duì fāng de lǐ yóu . cóng yǒu rén lái tiào dào rén rén xū yào , zhè gè luó jí bù chéng lì . zhè gè gù shì de shí jiān luó jí yǒu wèn tí . xiǎng ān jìng dú hé xiǎng liáo tiān , zài tóng yī gè xiǎo tīng lǐ yǒu máo dùn . tā shuō de liǎng gè shí jiān hù xiāng máo dùn . bào míng biǎo jiàn jiē gào sù wǒ men yǒu rén yǒu xìng qù , bù shuō míng yí dìng dào chǎng . wǒ shì jiàn jiē tīng dào zhè gè xiāo xī de , méi yǒu jiàn dào běn rén . hái bù néng pái chú tiān qì yǐng xiǎng rén shù . xiān pái chú shí jiān chōng tū , zài xuǎn dì diǎn . kě yǐ kòng zhì yī cì shì bàn de shí zhǎng , bù néng kòng zhì shéi yí dìng lái . tā bǎ shuō huà de shēng yīn kòng zhì de hěn xiǎo . zhè xiē yì jiàn yào jiā yǐ tǎo lùn , bù shì zhí jiē shān diào . fā xiàn de wèn tí yǐ jīng jiā yǐ shuō míng . rén shù shì yī gè yī jù , dàn bù shì quán bù . tā yī jù yuán lái de jì lù hé duì rì qī . wǒ bù tóng yì shǎo lái yī cì jiù shì bù xū yào zhè gè shuō fǎ . qǐng bǎ liǎng zhǒng shuō fǎ dōu jì xià lái . jì xù shì bàn de qián tí shì yǒu rén néng fù zé guān mén . zhè gè jiàn yì de qián tí hái méi yǒu què rèn . sì zhōu yǐ hòu , zài píng gū yán cháng shí jiān de ān pái . píng gū bù néng zhǐ kàn yī cì zuì hǎo jié guǒ . zhè tiáo píng lùn tí chū le ān jìng de wèn tí . tā dú wán wén zhāng , xiě le yī tiáo jiǎn duǎn píng lùn . wǒ qī wàng fāng biàn yī xiē , bù shì yāo qiú suí shí kāi mén . dà jiā duì jié wěi de qī wàng bù yī yàng . wǒ men xiǎng gǎi biàn xià bān yǐ hòu wú chù dú shū de jú miàn . yī jù jiě shì gǎi biàn le zhēng lùn de jú miàn . méi yǒu wèn bù lái de rén , jì lù jiù quē fá tā men de yì jiàn . zhè duàn jiě shì quē fá jù tǐ lì zi . bù tóng qún tǐ xū yào de shí jiān kě néng bù tóng . bù néng yòng yī gè rén dài biǎo zhěng gè qún tǐ . bù zhī dào zǒng rén shù , jiù suàn bù chū zhè gè bǐ zhòng . zhè cì jiāo tōng fèi zài zǒng fèi yòng zhōng de bǐ zhòng gèng dà . duō kāi liǎng xiǎo shí , yě yǒu zhěng lǐ hé guān mén de chéng běn . pián yi de cái liào bù yí dìng ràng zǒng chéng běn xià jiàng . yǒu rén zhǎo dào dú shū shí jiān , shì yī gè chéng xiào , dàn hái yào jì xù kàn . wǒ men xià zhōu zài kàn kàn zhè gè bàn fǎ de chéng xiào . wǒ xiān dà zhì jiè shào sì zhōu de jì lù . lù xiàn dà zhì xiāng tóng , zuì hòu yī duàn bù tóng . zhǐ kàn zǒng rén shù , zhè gè yī jù tài dān yī . tā bù xiǎng zhǐ zuò dān yī lèi xíng de gōng zuò . xiǎng lái de shí jiān hé kāi fàng shí jiān yǒu chā jù . liàn xí de biǎo xiàn hé shí jì bǐ sài hái yǒu chā jù . zài shì sì zhōu , kě yǐ jiǎn yàn zhè gè ān pái néng bù néng chí xù . zhè yī cì jiǎn yàn fā xiàn le liǎng gè wèn tí .
meaning: I like evening reading, but that is a subjective experience. She reminded me not to treat a subjective impression as a count. My position is to continue the trial, not extend every day immediately. He explained his position and listened to the other side’s reasons. The logic of jumping from some attendance to universal need doesn’t hold. The chronology of this story has a logical problem. Quiet reading and conversation conflict in the same small hall. The two times he gave contradict each other. Registration indirectly indicates interest, not certain attendance. I heard this news indirectly, without seeing the person. We cannot yet rule out the weather affecting attendance. Rule out scheduling conflicts before choosing the venue. We can control a trial’s duration, not who will definitely attend. She kept her speaking voice very quiet. These views need to be discussed, not simply deleted. The problems found have been explained. Attendance is one basis, not the whole picture. He checked dates against the original record. I disagree with the claim that missing one visit means no need. Please record both accounts. Continuing the pilot requires someone to close up. The premise of this suggestion has not been confirmed. Evaluate the extended hours after four weeks. An evaluation cannot look only at one best result. This comment raises the issue of quiet. After reading the article she wrote a short comment. I hope for more convenience, not opening at any time. People have different expectations of the ending. We want to change the lack of a reading place after work. An explanation changed the course of the argument. Without asking non-attendees, the record lacks their views. This explanation lacks concrete examples. Different groups may need different hours. One person cannot stand for a whole group. Without the total population we cannot calculate this proportion. Travel makes up a larger share of the total cost this time. Two additional hours also involve tidying and closing costs. Cheap material doesn’t necessarily reduce total cost. Some finding time to read is a benefit, but further observation is needed. We will look again at this method’s results next week. I will first give a broad account of the four-week records. The routes are broadly the same, but differ at the end. Total attendance alone is too one-dimensional a basis. She doesn’t want to do only one type of work. There is a gap between desired visiting times and opening hours. There is still a gap between practice performance and competition. Another four-week trial can test whether this arrangement can continue. This examination found two problems.

text: 我也是这个小图书馆的读者，但没有参加四周的周四晚间试办。不是因为我不需要晚上读书，而是周四有课，结束以后已经八点半。看到有人写“没有来就没有需要”，我想说明自己的情况。开放到八点，对一些人很合适，对我却还是有半小时的差距；这个差距不是一句“不够积极”能消除的。
pinyin: wǒ yě shì zhè gè xiǎo tú shū guǎn de dú zhě , dàn méi yǒu cān jiā sì zhōu de zhōu sì wǎn jiān shì bàn . bù shì yīn wèi wǒ bù xū yào wǎn shang dú shū , ér shì zhōu sì yǒu kè , jié shù yǐ hòu yǐ jīng bā diǎn bàn . kàn dào yǒu rén xiě méi yǒu lái jiù méi yǒu xū yào , wǒ xiǎng shuō míng zì jǐ de qíng kuàng . kāi fàng dào bā diǎn , duì yī xiē rén hěn hé shì , duì wǒ què hái shi yǒu bàn xiǎo shí de chā jù ; zhè gè chā jù bù shì yī jù bù gòu jī jí néng xiāo chú de .
meaning: I use the small library but didn’t attend the Thursday pilot because class ends at 8:30. Absence doesn’t mean no need for evening reading. Closing at eight suits some but leaves a half-hour gap for me, not a problem solved by calling me insufficiently keen.

text: 我没有因此要求立刻延长到九点。听到两位工作人员每次已经多留两小时，我知道他们也有自己的安排。我希望以后评估时，能把像我这样没到场的人意见加进去，而不是由来得最多的人替大家作决定。也许别的日子更合适，也许根本没有足够人手，两个可能都需要先问。
pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu yīn cǐ yāo qiú lì kè yán cháng dào jiǔ diǎn . tīng dào liǎng wèi gōng zuò rén yuán měi cì yǐ jīng duō liú liǎng xiǎo shí , wǒ zhī dào tā men yě yǒu zì jǐ de ān pái . wǒ xī wàng yǐ hòu píng gū shí , néng bǎ xiàng wǒ zhè yàng méi dào chǎng de rén yì jiàn jiā jìn qù , ér bù shì yóu lái de zuì duō de rén tì dà jiā zuò jué dìng . yě xǔ bié de rì zi gèng hé shì , yě xǔ gēn běn méi yǒu zú gòu rén shǒu , liǎng gè kě néng dōu xū yào xiān wèn .
meaning: I am not demanding immediate nine-o’clock closing. The two staff already stay two extra hours and have their own schedules. I want non-attendee views included, rather than frequent visitors deciding for all. Another day might suit or staffing might be insufficient; both need asking.

text: 文章里的六十四人次，让我知道这个时间不是没人用。但是我不知道其中多少人只来一次、多少人常来，也不能算出他们在所有读者中的比重。总读者有多少，这次记录没有提供。缺了这个数字，就不能把六十四直接叫作大多数，或者反过来叫作没有价值的一小群人。
pinyin: wén zhāng lǐ de liù shí sì rén cì , ràng wǒ zhī dào zhè gè shí jiān bù shì méi rén yòng . dàn shì wǒ bù zhī dào qí zhōng duō shao rén zhǐ lái yī cì , duō shao rén cháng lái , yě bù néng suàn chū tā men zài suǒ yǒu dú zhě zhōng de bǐ zhòng . zǒng dú zhě yǒu duō shao , zhè cì jì lù méi yǒu tí gōng . quē le zhè gè shù zì , jiù bù néng bǎ liù shí sì zhí jiē jiào zuò dà duō shù , huò zhě fǎn guò lái jiào zuò méi yǒu jià zhí de yī xiǎo qún rén .
meaning: Sixty-four visits show use, but don’t reveal unique or repeat visitors or their share of all readers. Total readership is not given. The figure cannot establish either a majority or a supposedly worthless small minority.

text: 有一个评论建议换成交流活动。我其实喜欢聊书，也想认识新朋友，可是如果好不容易找到安静时间，旁边一直有人说话，我就难以看下去。这并不矛盾：同一个人在不同时间，也可以想要不同活动。我愿意周末参加读书交流，但下课以后的短时间，常常只想安静读一会儿。
pinyin: yǒu yī gè píng lùn jiàn yì huàn chéng jiāo liú huó dòng . wǒ qí shí xǐ huān liáo shū , yě xiǎng rèn shi xīn péng you , kě shì rú guǒ hǎo bù róng yì zhǎo dào ān jìng shí jiān , páng biān yì zhí yǒu rén shuō huà , wǒ jiù nán yǐ kàn xià qù . zhè bìng bù máo dùn : tóng yī gè rén zài bù tóng shí jiān , yě kě yǐ xiǎng yào bù tóng huó dòng . wǒ yuàn yì zhōu mò cān jiā dú shū jiāo liú , dàn xià kè yǐ hòu de duǎn shí jiān , cháng cháng zhǐ xiǎng ān jìng dú yī huì er .
meaning: I like discussing books and meeting people, but constant nearby talk impedes quiet reading. Wanting different activities at different times is consistent. I might join a weekend discussion while preferring quiet reading after class.

text: 如果真要找另外的地方交流，先确认房间能不能用、有没有人负责，再发通知。不能为了让评论里每个人满意，就在没有人接手的时候同时答应两场活动。我看见文章说先继续四周，觉得这个范围清楚；它没有替我解决周四八点半的问题，却给我们一个继续提供意见的时间。
pinyin: rú guǒ zhēn yào zhǎo lìng wài de dì fāng jiāo liú , xiān què rèn fáng jiān néng bù néng yòng , yǒu méi yǒu rén fù zé , zài fā tōng zhī . bù néng wèi le ràng píng lùn lǐ měi gè rén mǎn yì , jiù zài méi yǒu rén jiē shǒu de shí hou tóng shí dā yìng liǎng chǎng huó dòng . wǒ kàn jiàn wén zhāng shuō xiān jì xù sì zhōu , jué de zhè gè fàn wéi qīng chǔ ; tā méi yǒu tì wǒ jiě jué zhōu sì bā diǎn bàn de wèn tí , què gěi wǒ men yī gè jì xù tí gōng yì jiàn de shí jiān .
meaning: Another discussion venue requires confirmed space and an organiser before notice. Promising two events with no one to run them doesn’t satisfy commenters. Another four-week pilot has a clear scope: it doesn’t solve my 8:30 issue but permits further feedback.

text: 我后来写给负责人的意见很短：周四有课，八点半才结束，能不能以后考虑别的晚间。我也问了五位同学，有两位愿意周二来，一位星期三方便，另外两位说最近没有时间。负责人回信谢谢我，说会把这些安排和其他反馈放在一起看。我把五个人的回答原样发过去，没有再替没问过的同学填一个时间。
pinyin: wǒ hòu lái xiě gěi fù zé rén de yì jiàn hěn duǎn : zhōu sì yǒu kè , bā diǎn bàn cái jié shù , néng bù néng yǐ hòu kǎo lǜ bié de wǎn jiān . wǒ yě wèn le wǔ wèi tóng xué , yǒu liǎng wèi yuàn yì zhōu èr lái , yī wèi xīng qī sān fāng biàn , lìng wài liǎng wèi shuō zuì jìn méi yǒu shí jiān . fù zé rén huí xìn xiè xiè wǒ , shuō huì bǎ zhè xiē ān pái hé qí tā fǎn kuì fàng zài yì qǐ kàn . wǒ bǎ wǔ gè rén de huí dá yuán yàng fā guò qù , méi yǒu zài tì méi wèn guò de tóng xué tián yī gè shí jiān .
meaning: My note to the organiser was brief: Thursday class ended at 8:30; could another evening be considered later? I asked five classmates too. Two preferred Tuesday, one Wednesday and two had no time recently. The organiser thanked me and would consider these alongside other feedback. I sent their answers as given, leaving out classmates I hadn't asked.

text: 负责人回复说，会把这些意见和到访记录放在一起看，先确认下个月的人手。我没有把这句答复理解成已经保证换日期，也没有觉得她一时不能答应就是不重视。她给出了下一步要做的事，我也可以等那个结果出来，再决定是否参加。能把暂时不知道的地方说清楚，反而比马上说什么都可以更可信。
pinyin: fù zé rén huí fù shuō , huì bǎ zhè xiē yì jiàn hé dào fǎng jì lù fàng zài yì qǐ kàn , xiān què rèn xià gè yuè de rén shǒu . wǒ méi yǒu bǎ zhè jù dá fù lǐ jiě chéng yǐ jīng bǎo zhèng huàn rì qī , yě méi yǒu jué de tā yī shí bù néng dā yìng jiù shì bù zhòng shì . tā gěi chū le xià yī bù yào zuò de shì , wǒ yě kě yǐ děng nà gè jié guǒ chū lái , zài jué dìng shì fǒu cān jiā . néng bǎ zàn shí bù zhī dào de dì fāng shuō qīng chǔ , fǎn ér bǐ mǎ shàng shuō shén me dōu kě yǐ gèng kě xìn .
meaning: The organiser would consider feedback with attendance and check next month’s staff. That is neither a guarantee to change days nor indifference if she cannot promise now. A concrete next step allows a later participation decision; clear uncertainty is more credible than agreeing to everything immediately.

text: 所以，我赞成继续试，也希望最后的评估不要只留下一个总数。来的人读了什么、没来的人有哪些时间限制、负责的人还能不能继续，这些都不是同一个问题。把它们分开问，不会让讨论失去方向。我们仍然想让阅读方便一些，只是不把一种方便说成所有人的方便，也不把一个人的情况说成唯一答案。

zhè gè chā jù bù shì yī jù bù gòu jī jí néng xiāo chú de . wǒ méi yǒu yīn cǐ yāo qiú lì kè yán cháng dào jiǔ diǎn . tīng dào liǎng wèi gōng zuò rén yuán měi cì yǐ jīng duō liú liǎng xiǎo shí , wǒ zhī dào tā men yě yǒu zì jǐ de ān pái . wǒ xī wàng yǐ hòu píng gū shí , néng bǎ xiàng wǒ zhè yàng méi dào chǎng de rén yì jiàn jiā jìn qù , ér bù shì yóu lái de zuì duō de rén tì dà jiā zuò jué dìng . yě xǔ bié de rì zi gèng hé shì , yě xǔ gēn běn méi yǒu zú gòu rén shǒu , liǎng gè kě néng dōu xū yào xiān wèn . wén zhāng lǐ de liù shí sì rén cì , ràng wǒ zhī dào zhè gè shí jiān bù shì méi rén yòng . dàn shì wǒ bù zhī dào qí zhōng duō shao rén zhǐ lái yī cì , duō shao rén cháng lái , yě bù néng suàn chū tā men zài suǒ yǒu dú zhě zhōng de bǐ zhòng . zǒng dú zhě yǒu duō shao , zhè cì jì lù méi yǒu tí gōng . quē le zhè gè shù zì , jiù bù néng bǎ liù shí sì zhí jiē jiào zuò dà duō shù , huò zhě fǎn guò lái jiào zuò méi yǒu jià zhí de yī xiǎo qún rén . yǒu yī gè píng lùn jiàn yì huàn chéng jiāo liú huó dòng . wǒ qí shí xǐ huān liáo shū , yě xiǎng rèn shi xīn péng you , kě shì rú guǒ hǎo bù róng yì zhǎo dào ān jìng shí jiān , páng biān yì zhí yǒu rén shuō huà , wǒ jiù nán yǐ kàn xià qù . zhè bìng bù máo dùn : tóng yī gè rén zài bù tóng shí jiān , yě kě yǐ xiǎng yào bù tóng huó dòng . wǒ yuàn yì zhōu mò cān jiā dú shū jiāo liú , dàn xià kè yǐ hòu de duǎn shí jiān , cháng cháng zhǐ xiǎng ān jìng dú yī huì er . rú guǒ zhēn yào zhǎo lìng wài de dì fāng jiāo liú , xiān què rèn fáng jiān néng bù néng yòng , yǒu méi yǒu rén fù zé , zài fā tōng zhī . bù néng wèi le ràng píng lùn lǐ měi gè rén mǎn yì , jiù zài méi yǒu rén jiē shǒu de shí hou tóng shí dā yìng liǎng chǎng huó dòng . wǒ kàn jiàn wén zhāng shuō xiān jì xù sì zhōu , jué de zhè gè fàn wéi qīng chǔ ; meaning: I use the small library but didn’t attend the Thursday pilot because class ends at 8:30. Absence doesn’t mean no need for evening reading. Closing at eight suits some but leaves a half-hour gap for me, not a problem solved by calling me insufficiently keen. I am not demanding immediate nine-o’clock closing. The two staff already stay two extra hours and have their own schedules. I want non-attendee views included, rather than frequent visitors deciding for all. Another day might suit or staffing might be insufficient; both need asking. Sixty-four visits show use, but don’t reveal unique or repeat visitors or their share of all readers. Total readership is not given. The figure cannot establish either a majority or a supposedly worthless small minority. I like discussing books and meeting people, but constant nearby talk impedes quiet reading. Wanting different activities at different times is consistent. I might join a weekend discussion while preferring quiet reading after class. Another discussion venue requires confirmed space and an organiser before notice. Promising two events with no one to run them doesn’t satisfy commenters. Another four-week pilot has a clear scope: it doesn’t solve my 8:30 issue but permits further feedback. My note to the organiser was brief: Thursday class ended at 8:30; could another evening be considered later? I asked five classmates too. Two preferred Tuesday, one Wednesday and two had no time recently. The organiser thanked me and would consider these alongside other feedback. I sent their answers as given, leaving out classmates I hadn't asked. The organiser would consider feedback with attendance and check next month’s staff. That is neither a guarantee to change days nor indifference if she cannot promise now. A concrete next step allows a later participation decision; clear uncertainty is more credible than agreeing to everything immediately. I support further trial and an evaluation beyond one total. Reading needs, non-attendee timing constraints and staff availability are separate questions that can guide the shared aim of convenient reading without pretending one convenience fits all or one person has the sole answer.

text: 你尝一口，今天这汤是不是有点咸？
pinyin: nǐ cháng yī kǒu , jīn tiān zhè tāng shì bú shì yǒu diǎn xián ?
meaning: Try some. Is today’s soup a little salty?

text: 你可真会放盐。
pinyin: nǐ kě zhēn huì fàng yán .
meaning: You certainly know how to add salt.

text: 是在夸我吗？我都放了两次了。
pinyin: shì zài kuā wǒ ma ? wǒ dōu fàng le liǎng cì le .
meaning: Is that praise? I added it twice.

text: 就是在说放多了。我的嘴今天不用再吃别的盐了。
pinyin: jiù shì zài shuō fàng duō le . wǒ de zuǐ jīn tiān bù yòng zài chī bié de yán le .
meaning: I mean you added too much. My mouth doesn’t need any other salt today.

text: 你们很熟才这么说吧？
pinyin: nǐ men hěn shú cái zhè me shuō ba ?
meaning: You say that because you know each other well, right?

text: 对，平时就这么说。你还没尝呢，先喝一口。
pinyin: duì , píng shí jiù zhè me shuō . nǐ hái méi cháng ne , xiān hē yī kǒu .
meaning: Yes, that's how we usually talk. You haven't tried it yet—have a sip first.

text: 我刚才以为你在生气，没敢笑。
pinyin: wǒ gāng cái yǐ wéi nǐ zài shēng qì , méi gǎn xiào .
meaning: I thought you were angry, so I didn’t dare laugh.

text: 没生气，是汤太咸。我还等着他做别的菜呢。
pinyin: méi shēng qì , shì tāng tài xián . wǒ hái děng zhe tā zuò bié de cài ne .
meaning: I'm not angry—the soup's too salty. I'm still waiting for his other dishes.

text: 那就好。不过别叫我傻，我不喜欢。
pinyin: nà jiù hǎo . bù guò bié jiào wǒ shǎ , wǒ bù xǐ huān .
meaning: Good. But don't call me silly; I don't like it.

text: 好，不这样叫。刚才也不是在说你。
pinyin: hǎo , bù zhè yàng jiào . gāng cái yě bù shì zài shuō nǐ .
meaning: Okay, I won’t. I wasn’t referring to you earlier either.

text: 真有你的，能把一道汤放两次盐。
pinyin: zhēn yǒu nǐ de , néng bǎ yī dào tāng fàng liǎng cì yán .
meaning: Well, look at you—managing to salt one soup twice.

text: 别再说了，我已经拿水来了。
pinyin: bié zài shuō le , wǒ yǐ jīng ná shuǐ lái le .
meaning: Enough about it. I’ve brought water already.

text: 行，不说了。你准备加多少？
pinyin: xíng , bù shuō le . nǐ zhǔn bèi jiā duō shao ?
meaning: Okay, I’ll stop. How much will you add?

text: 先加一点，再尝，不把整瓶都倒进去。
pinyin: xiān jiā yī diǎn , zài cháng , bù bǎ zhěng píng dōu dào jìn qù .
meaning: A little first, then taste, not the whole bottle.

text: 这次终于先尝了。
pinyin: zhè cì zhōng yú xiān cháng le .
meaning: Finally tasting first this time.

text: 我说别再说，你还来一句？
pinyin: wǒ shuō bié zài shuō , nǐ hái lái yī jù ?
meaning: I asked you to stop, and you add another line?

text: 对不起，这句也收回。我去拿碗。
pinyin: duì bù qǐ , zhè jù yě shōu huí . wǒ qù ná wǎn .
meaning: Sorry, I take that one back too. I’ll get the bowls.

text: 拿三个就行，你这次不用替盐拿一碗。
pinyin: ná sān gè jiù xíng , nǐ zhè cì bù yòng tì yán ná yī wǎn .
meaning: Three is enough. No need for a bowl for the salt this time.

text: 你尝一口，今天这汤是不是有点咸？你可真会放盐。是在夸我吗？我都放了两次了。就是在说放多了。我的嘴今天不用再吃别的盐了。你们很熟才这么说吧？对，平时就这么说。你还没尝呢，先喝一口。我刚才以为你在生气，没敢笑。没生气，是汤太咸。我还等着他做别的菜呢。那就好。不过别叫我傻，我不喜欢。好，不这样叫。刚才也不是在说你。真有你的，能把一道汤放两次盐。别再说了，我已经拿水来了。行，不说了。你准备加多少？先加一点，再尝，不把整瓶都倒进去。这次终于先尝了。我说别再说，你还来一句？对不起，这句也收回。我去拿碗。拿三个就行，你这次不用替盐拿一碗。
pinyin: nǐ cháng yī kǒu , jīn tiān zhè tāng shì bú shì yǒu diǎn xián ? nǐ kě zhēn huì fàng yán . shì zài kuā wǒ ma ? wǒ dōu fàng le liǎng cì le . jiù shì zài shuō fàng duō le . wǒ de zuǐ jīn tiān bù yòng zài chī bié de yán le . nǐ men hěn shú cái zhè me shuō ba ? duì , píng shí jiù zhè me shuō . nǐ hái méi cháng ne , xiān hē yī kǒu . wǒ gāng cái yǐ wéi nǐ zài shēng qì , méi gǎn xiào . méi shēng qì , shì tāng tài xián . wǒ hái děng zhe tā zuò bié de cài ne . nà jiù hǎo . bù guò bié jiào wǒ shǎ , wǒ bù xǐ huān . hǎo , bù zhè yàng jiào . gāng cái yě bù shì zài shuō nǐ . zhēn yǒu nǐ de , néng bǎ yī dào tāng fàng liǎng cì yán . bié zài shuō le , wǒ yǐ jīng ná shuǐ lái le . xíng , bù shuō le . nǐ zhǔn bèi jiā duō shao ? xiān jiā yī diǎn , zài cháng , bù bǎ zhěng píng dōu dào jìn qù . zhè cì zhōng yú xiān cháng le . wǒ shuō bié zài shuō , nǐ hái lái yī jù ? duì bù qǐ , zhè jù yě shōu huí . wǒ qù ná wǎn . ná sān gè jiù xíng , nǐ zhè cì bù yòng tì yán ná yī wǎn .
meaning: Try some. Is today’s soup a little salty? You certainly know how to add salt. Is that praise? I added it twice. I mean you added too much. My mouth doesn’t need any other salt today. You say that because you know each other well, right? Yes, that's how we usually talk. You haven't tried it yet—have a sip first. I thought you were angry, so I didn’t dare laugh. I'm not angry—the soup's too salty. I'm still waiting for his other dishes. Good. But don't call me silly; I don't like it. Okay, I won’t. I wasn’t referring to you earlier either. Well, look at you—managing to salt one soup twice. Enough about it. I’ve brought water already. Okay, I’ll stop. How much will you add? A little first, then taste, not the whole bottle. Finally tasting first this time. I asked you to stop, and you add another line? Sorry, I take that one back too. I’ll get the bowls. Three is enough. No need for a bowl for the salt this time.

text: 周末我们本来想去公园，下午却下了很大的雨。三个朋友改到我家吃饭，其中两个人很熟，另一位是第一次来。我做了一道汤，一边接电话，一边找调料。电话结束以后，又照平时的习惯放了一次盐，等尝的时候才发现太咸。我说可能放了两次，朋友看着汤笑，说我可真会放盐。
pinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men běn lái xiǎng qù gōng yuán , xià wǔ què xià le hěn dà de yǔ . sān gè péng you gǎi dào wǒ jiā chī fàn , qí zhōng liǎng gè rén hěn shú , lìng yī wèi shì dì yī cì lái . wǒ zuò le yī dào tāng , yī biān jiē diàn huà , yī biān zhǎo tiáo liào . diàn huà jié shù yǐ hòu , yòu zhào píng shí de xí guàn fàng le yī cì yán , děng cháng de shí hou cái fā xiàn tài xián . wǒ shuō kě néng fàng le liǎng cì , péng you kàn zhe tāng xiào , shuō wǒ kě zhēn huì fàng yán .
meaning: Rain moved our planned park visit to my home. Two of the three friends knew each other well; one was visiting for the first time. While cooking soup I took a call and added salt, then added it again out of habit. When I noticed the saltiness, a friend smiled at the soup and said I certainly knew how to add salt.

text: 我抬头问他是在夸我吗，他笑着说自己的嘴今天不用再吃别的盐了。我低头又尝一小口，确实咸得喝不下去。刚才电话一来，我把盐罐放在手边，挂了以后又拿起来，连自己都忘了前面已经放过。朋友还等着我做别的菜，我就请他先把水递来，别光站在那里看我笑。
pinyin: wǒ tái tóu wèn tā shì zài kuā wǒ ma , tā xiào zhe shuō zì jǐ de zuǐ jīn tiān bù yòng zài chī bié de yán le . wǒ dī tóu yòu cháng yī xiǎo kǒu , què shí xián de hē bù xià qù . gāng cái diàn huà yī lái , wǒ bǎ yán guàn fàng zài shǒu biān , guà le yǐ hòu yòu ná qǐ lái , lián zì jǐ dōu wàng le qián miàn yǐ jīng fàng guò . péng you hái děng zhe wǒ zuò bié de cài , wǒ jiù qǐng tā xiān bǎ shuǐ dì lái , bié guāng zhàn zài nà lǐ kàn wǒ xiào .
meaning: I asked whether that was praise. He laughed that his mouth needed no more salt today. Another tiny sip was too salty to drink. When the phone rang I'd set the salt jar beside me, then picked it up again afterwards, forgetting the first addition. Since he was waiting for the other dishes, I asked him to pass the water instead of just standing there laughing.

text: 第一次来的朋友没有笑。她后来悄悄问，我们是不是已经开始吵架。我愣了一下，说没有，他平时就这么说，还问她刚才有没有尝。她说没有，一进门就看见我们对着汤说话。我把经过讲给她，她才明白为什么他拿盐开玩笑，不过还是先问我这汤真的能喝吗。我说等一下，马上救回来。
pinyin: dì yī cì lái de péng you méi yǒu xiào . tā hòu lái qiāo qiāo wèn , wǒ men shì bú shì yǐ jīng kāi shǐ chǎo jià . wǒ lèng le yī xià , shuō méi yǒu , tā píng shí jiù zhè me shuō , hái wèn tā gāng cái yǒu méi yǒu cháng . tā shuō méi yǒu , yī jìn mén jiù kàn jiàn wǒ men duì zhe tāng shuō huà . wǒ bǎ jīng guò jiǎng gěi tā , tā cái míng bái wèi shén me tā ná yán kāi wán xiào , bù guò hái shi xiān wèn wǒ zhè tāng zhēn de néng hē ma . wǒ shuō děng yī xià , mǎ shàng jiù huí lái .
meaning: The new friend didn't laugh. Quietly she asked if we'd started arguing. Taken aback, I said no and asked if she'd tasted it yet. She hadn't; she'd arrived to find us talking over the soup. Once I explained the salt, she understood the joke, but still wanted to know if it was drinkable. Wait a moment, I said—I'd rescue it.

text: 她说自己不喜欢被叫作傻，我马上答应不这样叫。朋友也说刚才是在说我放盐，不是在说她。她点点头，问有没有能帮忙的。我让她把桌上三双筷子摆好，自己去厨房拿水。回来的时候，桌子已经收得很干净，她还把我忘在椅子上的外套挂起来。我说谢谢，这回可不是反话。
pinyin: tā shuō zì jǐ bù xǐ huān bèi jiào zuò shǎ , wǒ mǎ shàng dā yìng bù zhè yàng jiào . péng you yě shuō gāng cái shì zài shuō wǒ fàng yán , bù shì zài shuō tā . tā diǎn diǎn tóu , wèn yǒu méi yǒu néng bāng máng de . wǒ ràng tā bǎ zhuō shàng sān shuāng kuài zi bǎi hǎo , zì jǐ qù chú fáng ná shuǐ . huí lái de shí hou , zhuō zi yǐ jīng shōu de hěn gān jìng , tā hái bǎ wǒ wàng zài yǐ zi shàng de wài tào guà qǐ lái . wǒ shuō xiè xiè , zhè huí kě bú shì fǎn huà .
meaning: She said she didn't like being called silly, and I agreed not to call her that. My friend explained he'd meant my salt mistake. She nodded and offered to help. I asked her to set out three pairs of chopsticks while I fetched water. When I returned, the table was tidy and she'd hung up the coat I'd left on a chair. I thanked her—and this time it wasn't irony.

text: 我拿了水来，想先加一点再尝。另一个人又说真有我的，一道汤可以放两次盐。我起初也笑，可他连续说了几次，我就告诉他别再说了。他答应，却又加了一句“这次终于先尝了”。我问，已经说停了，怎么还要补一句。他这才道歉，不再拿同一件事说，转身去拿碗。
pinyin: wǒ ná le shuǐ lái , xiǎng xiān jiā yī diǎn zài cháng . lìng yī gè rén yòu shuō zhēn yǒu wǒ de , yī dào tāng kě yǐ fàng liǎng cì yán . wǒ qǐ chū yě xiào , kě tā lián xù shuō le jǐ cì , wǒ jiù gào sù tā bié zài shuō le . tā dā yìng , què yòu jiā le yī jù zhè cì zhōng yú xiān cháng le . wǒ wèn , yǐ jīng shuō tíng le , zěn me hái yào bǔ yī jù . tā zhè cái dào qiàn , bù zài ná tóng yī jiàn shì shuō , zhuǎn shēn qù ná wǎn .
meaning: I brought water to add a little and taste again. Another tease about salting twice initially amused me, but repetition didn’t. I asked him to stop. He agreed yet added another remark about finally tasting first; I pointed out the contradiction. He apologised and got the bowls instead.

text: 后来我自己说，拿三个碗就行，这次不用替盐拿一个。大家笑了一下，也就接着吃饭。加过水的汤终于能喝了，我先给新朋友盛了一点，请她再尝尝。她说好多了，又问我平时是不是也一边接电话一边做饭。我赶紧把手机放到另一边，说今天到吃完以前，谁打来都先等一下。
pinyin: hòu lái wǒ zì jǐ shuō , ná sān gè wǎn jiù xíng , zhè cì bù yòng tì yán ná yī gè . dà jiā xiào le yī xià , yě jiù jiē zhe chī fàn . jiā guò shuǐ de tāng zhōng yú néng hē le , wǒ xiān gěi xīn péng you shèng le yī diǎn , qǐng tā zài cháng cháng . tā shuō hǎo duō le , yòu wèn wǒ píng shí shì bú shì yě yī biān jiē diàn huà yī biān zuò fàn . wǒ gǎn jǐn bǎ shǒu jī fàng dào lìng yī biān , shuō jīn tiān dào chī wán yǐ qián , shéi dǎ lái dōu xiān děng yī xià .
meaning: I told him to bring three bowls—no extra one for the salt. We laughed and started dinner. With water added, the soup was finally drinkable, so I served the new friend a little. Much better, she said: did I usually cook while answering calls? I put my phone aside. Whoever called could wait until we'd finished eating.

text: 吃饭时，我们又谈到外面的雨。有人说挑的天气真好，新朋友这次马上问，是不是在说本来想去公园，现在去不了。他说对，也说现在在家喝汤不错。同样一个“好”，前一句带着和实际情况相反的意思，后一句却真是在说另一个方面。她把前后连起来问，比直接判断说好就一定在夸，更容易听清。
pinyin: chī fàn shí , wǒ men yòu tán dào wài miàn de yǔ . yǒu rén shuō tiāo de tiān qì zhēn hǎo , xīn péng you zhè cì mǎ shàng wèn , shì bú shì zài shuō běn lái xiǎng qù gōng yuán , xiàn zài qù bù le . tā shuō duì , yě shuō xiàn zài zài jiā hē tāng bù cuò . tóng yàng yī gè hǎo , qián yī jù dài zhe hé shí jì qíng kuàng xiāng fǎn de yì si , hòu yī jù què zhēn shì zài shuō lìng yī gè fāng miàn . tā bǎ qián hòu lián qǐ lái wèn , bǐ zhí jiē pàn duàn shuō hǎo jiù yí dìng zài kuā , gèng róng yì tīng qīng .
meaning: Over dinner “lovely weather” referred ironically to our cancelled park trip, whereas enjoying soup at home was a sincere positive comment on a different aspect. The newcomer checked the context. The same word need not carry the same intention in successive remarks.

text: 饭快吃完，雨还没停。朋友拿着伞站在门口，又看了看窗外，说今天的公园只好留到下次了。新朋友问那下次是谁做汤，我们三个都笑了。我说还是我，不过先把电话关掉。他说好，还把碗送进厨房。她回家以后发消息谢谢我们，说汤后来好喝，第一次见面也没那么紧张了。
pinyin: fàn kuài chī wán , yǔ hái méi tíng . péng you ná zhe sǎn zhàn zài mén kǒu , yòu kàn le kàn chuāng wài , shuō jīn tiān de gōng yuán zhǐ hǎo liú dào xià cì le . xīn péng you wèn nà xià cì shì shéi zuò tāng , wǒ men sān gè dōu xiào le . wǒ shuō hái shi wǒ , bù guò xiān bǎ diàn huà guān diào . tā shuō hǎo , hái bǎ wǎn sòng jìn chú fáng . tā huí jiā yǐ hòu fā xiāo xī xiè xiè wǒ men , shuō tāng hòu lái hǎo hē , dì yī cì jiàn miàn yě méi nà me jǐn zhāng le .
meaning: Near the end of dinner it was still raining. My friend stood by the door with an umbrella: the park would have to wait. The newcomer asked who'd make soup next time, and all three of us laughed. Me again, I said, but with the phone off. He agreed and took the bowls to the kitchen. Later she messaged her thanks: the soup had turned out well, and she'd felt less nervous about meeting us.

fàng le liǎng cì , péng you kàn zhe tāng xiào , shuō wǒ kě zhēn huì fàng yán . wǒ tái tóu wèn tā shì zài kuā wǒ ma , tā xiào zhe shuō zì jǐ de zuǐ jīn tiān bù yòng zài chī bié de yán le . wǒ dī tóu yòu cháng yī xiǎo kǒu , què shí xián de hē bù xià qù . gāng cái diàn huà yī lái , wǒ bǎ yán guàn fàng zài shǒu biān , guà le yǐ hòu yòu ná qǐ lái , lián zì jǐ dōu wàng le qián miàn yǐ jīng fàng guò . péng you hái děng zhe wǒ zuò bié de cài , wǒ jiù qǐng tā xiān bǎ shuǐ dì lái , bié guāng zhàn zài nà lǐ kàn wǒ xiào . dì yī cì lái de péng you méi yǒu xiào . tā hòu lái qiāo qiāo wèn , wǒ men shì bú shì yǐ jīng kāi shǐ chǎo jià . wǒ lèng le yī xià , shuō méi yǒu , tā píng shí jiù zhè me shuō , hái wèn tā gāng cái yǒu méi yǒu cháng . tā shuō méi yǒu , yī jìn mén jiù kàn jiàn wǒ men duì zhe tāng shuō huà . wǒ bǎ jīng guò jiǎng gěi tā , tā cái míng bái wèi shén me tā ná yán kāi wán xiào , bù guò hái shi xiān wèn wǒ zhè tāng zhēn de néng hē ma . wǒ shuō děng yī xià , mǎ shàng jiù huí lái . tā shuō zì jǐ bù xǐ huān bèi jiào zuò shǎ , wǒ mǎ shàng dā yìng bù zhè yàng jiào . péng you yě shuō gāng cái shì zài shuō wǒ fàng yán , bù shì zài shuō tā . tā diǎn diǎn tóu , wèn yǒu méi yǒu néng bāng máng de . wǒ ràng tā bǎ zhuō shàng sān shuāng kuài zi bǎi hǎo , zì jǐ qù chú fáng ná shuǐ . huí lái de shí hou , zhuō zi yǐ jīng shōu de hěn gān jìng , tā hái bǎ wǒ wàng zài yǐ zi shàng de wài tào guà qǐ lái . wǒ shuō xiè xiè , zhè huí kě bú shì fǎn huà . wǒ ná le shuǐ lái , xiǎng xiān jiā yī diǎn zài cháng . lìng yī gè rén yòu shuō zhēn yǒu wǒ de , yī dào tāng kě yǐ fàng liǎng cì yán . wǒ qǐ chū yě xiào , kě tā lián xù shuō le jǐ cì , wǒ jiù gào sù tā bié zài shuō le . tā dā yìng , què yòu jiā le yī jù zhè cì zhōng yú xiān cháng le . wǒ wèn , yǐ jīng shuō tíng le , zěn me hái yào bǔ yī jù . tā zhè cái dào qiàn , bù zài ná tóng yī jiàn shì shuō , zhuǎn shēn qù ná wǎn . hòu lái wǒ zì jǐ shuō , ná sān gè wǎn jiù xíng , zhè cì bù yòng tì yán ná yī gè . dà jiā xiào le yī xià , yě jiù jiē zhe chī fàn . jiā guò shuǐ de tāng zhōng yú néng hē le , wǒ xiān gěi xīn péng you shèng le yī diǎn , qǐng tā zài cháng cháng . tā shuō hǎo duō le , yòu wèn wǒ píng shí shì bú shì yě yī biān jiē diàn huà yī biān zuò fàn . wǒ gǎn jǐn bǎ shǒu jī fàng dào lìng yī biān , shuō jīn tiān dào chī wán yǐ qián , shéi dǎ lái dōu xiān děng yī xià . chī fàn shí , wǒ men yòu tán dào wài miàn de yǔ . yǒu rén shuō tiāo de tiān qì zhēn hǎo , xīn péng you zhè cì mǎ shàng wèn , shì bú shì zài shuō běn lái xiǎng qù gōng yuán , xiàn zài qù bù le . tā shuō duì , yě shuō xiàn zài zài jiā hē tāng bù cuò . tóng yàng yī gè hǎo , qián yī jù dài zhe hé shí jì qíng kuàng xiāng fǎn de yì si , hòu yī jù què zhēn shì zài shuō lìng yī gè fāng miàn . tā bǎ qián hòu lián qǐ lái wèn , bǐ zhí jiē pàn duàn shuō hǎo jiù yí dìng zài kuā , gèng róng yì tīng qīng . fàn kuài chī wán , yǔ hái méi tíng . péng you ná zhe sǎn zhàn zài mén kǒu , yòu kàn le kàn chuāng wài , shuō jīn tiān de gōng yuán zhǐ hǎo liú dào xià cì le . xīn péng you wèn nà xià cì shì shéi zuò tāng , wǒ men sān gè dōu xiào le . wǒ shuō hái shi wǒ , bù guò xiān bǎ diàn huà guān diào . tā shuō hǎo , hái bǎ wǎn sòng jìn chú fáng . tā huí jiā yǐ hòu fā xiāo xī xiè xiè wǒ men , shuō tāng hòu lái hǎo hē , dì yī cì jiàn miàn yě méi nà me jǐn zhāng le .
meaning: Rain moved our planned park visit to my home. Two of the three friends knew each other well; one was visiting for the first time. While cooking soup I took a call and added salt, then added it again out of habit. When I noticed the saltiness, a friend smiled at the soup and said I certainly knew how to add salt. I asked whether that was praise. He laughed that his mouth needed no more salt today. Another tiny sip was too salty to drink. When the phone rang I'd set the salt jar beside me, then picked it up again afterwards, forgetting the first addition. Since he was waiting for the other dishes, I asked him to pass the water instead of just standing there laughing. The new friend didn't laugh. Quietly she asked if we'd started arguing. Taken aback, I said no and asked if she'd tasted it yet. She hadn't; she'd arrived to find us talking over the soup. Once I explained the salt, she understood the joke, but still wanted to know if it was drinkable. Wait a moment, I said—I'd rescue it. She said she didn't like being called silly, and I agreed not to call her that. My friend explained he'd meant my salt mistake. She nodded and offered to help. I asked her to set out three pairs of chopsticks while I fetched water. When I returned, the table was tidy and she'd hung up the coat I'd left on a chair. I thanked her—and this time it wasn't irony. I brought water to add a little and taste again. Another tease about salting twice initially amused me, but repetition didn’t. I asked him to stop. He agreed yet added another remark about finally tasting first; I pointed out the contradiction. He apologised and got the bowls instead. I told him to bring three bowls—no extra one for the salt. We laughed and started dinner. With water added, the soup was finally drinkable, so I served the new friend a little. Much better, she said: did I usually cook while answering calls? I put my phone aside. Whoever called could wait until we'd finished eating. Over dinner “lovely weather” referred ironically to our cancelled park trip, whereas enjoying soup at home was a sincere positive comment on a different aspect. The newcomer checked the context. The same word need not carry the same intention in successive remarks. Near the end of dinner it was still raining. My friend stood by the door with an umbrella: the park would have to wait. The newcomer asked who'd make soup next time, and all three of us laughed. Me again, I said, but with the phone off. He agreed and took the bowls to the kitchen. Later she messaged her thanks: the soup had turned out well, and she'd felt less nervous about meeting us.

parts.text: 周末我们本来想去公园，下午却下了很大的雨。三个朋友改到我家吃饭，其中两个人很熟，另一位是第一次来。我做了一道汤，一边接电话，一边找调料。电话结束以后，又照平时的习惯放了一次盐，等尝的时候才发现太咸。我说可能放了两次，朋友看着汤笑，说我可真会放盐。
我抬头问他是在夸我吗，他笑着说自己的嘴今天不用再吃别的盐了。我低头又尝一小口，确实咸得喝不下去。刚才电话一来，我把盐罐放在手边，挂了以后又拿起来，连自己都忘了前面已经放过。朋友还等着我做别的菜，我就请他先把水递来，别光站在那里看我笑。
第一次来的朋友没有笑。她后来悄悄问，我们是不是已经开始吵架。我愣了一下，说没有，他平时就这么说，还问她刚才有没有尝。她说没有，一进门就看见我们对着汤说话。我把经过讲给她，她才明白为什么他拿盐开玩笑，不过还是先问我这汤真的能喝吗。我说等一下，马上救回来。
她说自己不喜欢被叫作傻，我马上答应不这样叫。朋友也说刚才是在说我放盐，不是在说她。她点点头，问有没有能帮忙的。我让她把桌上三双筷子摆好，自己去厨房拿水。回来的时候，桌子已经收得很干净，她还把我忘在椅子上的外套挂起来。我说谢谢，这回可不是反话。
我拿了水来，想先加一点再尝。另一个人又说真有我的，一道汤可以放两次盐。我起初也笑，可他连续说了几次，我就告诉他别再说了。他答应，却又加了一句“这次终于先尝了”。我问，已经说停了，怎么还要补一句。他这才道歉，不再拿同一件事说，转身去拿碗。
后来我自己说，拿三个碗就行，这次不用替盐拿一个。大家笑了一下，也就接着吃饭。加过水的汤终于能喝了，我先给新朋友盛了一点，请她再尝尝。她说好多了，又问我平时是不是也一边接电话一边做饭。我赶紧把手机放到另一边，说今天到吃完以前，谁打来都先等一下。
吃饭时，我们又谈到外面的雨。有人说挑的天气真好，新朋友这次马上问，是不是在说本来想去公园，现在去不了。他说对，也说现在在家喝汤不错。同样一个“好”，前一句带着和实际情况相反的意思，后一句却真是在说另一个方面。她把前后连起来问，比直接判断说好就一定在夸，更容易听清。
饭快吃完，雨还没停。朋友拿着伞站在门口，又看了看窗外，说今天的公园只好留到下次了。新朋友问那下次是谁做汤，我们三个都笑了。我说还是我，不过先把电话关掉。他说好，还把碗送进厨房。她回家以后发消息谢谢我们，说汤后来好喝，第一次见面也没那么紧张了。

text: 外面雨这么大，我们挑的天气可真好。
pinyin: wài miàn yǔ zhè me dà , wǒ men tiāo de tiān qì kě zhēn hǎo .
meaning: With that heavy rain outside, we picked such lovely weather.

text: 你是在说天气不好吧？
pinyin: nǐ shì zài shuō tiān qì bù hǎo ba ?
meaning: You mean the weather is bad, right?

text: 对，本来想去公园，现在只能在家。
pinyin: duì , běn lái xiǎng qù gōng yuán , xiàn zài zhǐ néng zài jiā .
meaning: Yes. We wanted the park, but are staying home now.

text: 那今天也不错，有汤喝。
pinyin: nà jīn tiān yě bù cuò , yǒu tāng hē .
meaning: Still not a bad day: there is soup.

text: 你还没尝，别急着说不错。
pinyin: nǐ hái méi cháng , bié jí zhe shuō bù cuò .
meaning: You haven’t tasted it. Don’t say it’s good yet.

text: 我只说有汤，没说味道。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ shuō yǒu tāng , méi shuō wèi dào .
meaning: I said there is soup, not how it tastes.

text: 这话听起来真小心。
pinyin: zhè huà tīng qǐ lái zhēn xiǎo xīn .
meaning: That sounds very cautious.

text: 毕竟我看见你放了两次盐。
pinyin: bì jìng wǒ kàn jiàn nǐ fàng le liǎng cì yán .
meaning: After all, I saw you add salt twice.

text: 你居然一直看着。
pinyin: nǐ jū rán yì zhí kàn zhe .
meaning: You were watching the whole time?

text: 我就在旁边洗菜，想不看也难。
pinyin: wǒ jiù zài páng biān xǐ cài , xiǎng bù kàn yě nán .
meaning: I was washing vegetables beside you; hard not to notice.

text: 好，先尝，再决定要不要加水。
pinyin: hǎo , xiān cháng , zài jué dìng yào bù yào jiā shuǐ .
meaning: Okay, taste first, then decide about water.

text: 我只拿小勺，给自己留条路。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ ná xiǎo sháo , gěi zì jǐ liú tiáo lù .
meaning: I’m taking a small spoon, leaving myself a way out.
