text: 周五晚上六点，我问陈宇第二天下午能不能两点到小厅，一起给活动拍照。他十分钟以后回复，说两点才能下班，从公司过去要半小时，大概两点半到，问可不可以。我当时还在收东西，只看见前面两点，又觉得他已经答应，就回了好，到时联系。后来我把日历记成两点，没有再看后面那一段。
pinyin: zhōu wǔ wǎn shang liù diǎn , wǒ wèn chén yǔ dì èr tiān xià wǔ néng bù néng liǎng diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , yì qǐ gěi huó dòng pāi zhào . tā shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu huí fù , shuō liǎng diǎn cái néng xià bān , cóng gōng sī guò qù yào bàn xiǎo shí , dà gài liǎng diǎn bàn dào , wèn kě bù kě yǐ . wǒ dāng shí hái zài shōu dōng xi , zhǐ kàn jiàn qián miàn liǎng diǎn , yòu jué de tā yǐ jīng dā yìng , jiù huí le hǎo , dào shí lián xì . hòu lái wǒ bǎ rì lì jì chéng liǎng diǎn , méi yǒu zài kàn hòu miàn nà yī duàn .
meaning: At six Friday evening I asked Chen Yu about arriving at the hall at two Saturday to take activity photos. Ten minutes later he said he finished work at two, needed half an hour and expected about 2:30, asking whether that worked. While packing I noticed two and took it as acceptance, replied okay and entered two without rereading.

text: 周六我特意提前到，想先把桌子和几件要拍的东西摆好。两点到了，他没来。两点五分我发消息问怎么还没到，等了几分钟没答复。我不知道他已经在走路，脑子里先想到的是他忘记了。两点十二分，他说在路上，估计两点半；我回了一句，你每次都迟到。这句话发出去以后，我还觉得自己是在说实话。
pinyin: zhōu liù wǒ tè yì tí qián dào , xiǎng xiān bǎ zhuō zi hé jǐ jiàn yào pāi de dōng xi bǎi hǎo . liǎng diǎn dào le , tā méi lái . liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn wǒ fā xiāo xī wèn zěn me hái méi dào , děng le jǐ fēn zhōng méi dá fù . wǒ bù zhī dào tā yǐ jīng zài zǒu lù , nǎo zi lǐ xiān xiǎng dào de shì tā wàng jì le . liǎng diǎn shí èr fēn , tā shuō zài lù shàng , gū jì liǎng diǎn bàn ; wǒ huí le yī jù , nǐ měi cì dōu chí dào . zhè jù huà fā chū qù yǐ hòu , wǒ hái jué de zì jǐ shì zài shuō shí huà .
meaning: I came early Saturday to prepare. At two he was absent; my 2:05 message initially went unanswered. Not knowing he was walking, I assumed forgetfulness. At 2:12 he estimated arrival at 2:30. I sent “you’re late every time,” then felt it was simply truthful.

text: 他两点半到了，第一句不是道歉，而是说自己从没答应两点到。我听着仿佛他只想把所有事情都推给我，没让他讲完，就再提自己已经等了半小时。他也说我从没认真看消息。两个从没、每次，把这一天下午的等待变成了对所有过去的判断；可是我们当时谁都没有查看以前究竟发生多少次。
pinyin: tā liǎng diǎn bàn dào le , dì yī jù bù shì dào qiàn , ér shì shuō zì jǐ cóng méi dā yìng liǎng diǎn dào . wǒ tīng zhe fǎng fú tā zhǐ xiǎng bǎ suǒ yǒu shì qíng dōu tuī gěi wǒ , méi ràng tā jiǎng wán , jiù zài tí zì jǐ yǐ jīng děng le bàn xiǎo shí . tā yě shuō wǒ cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn xiāo xī . liǎng gè cóng méi , měi cì , bǎ zhè yī tiān xià wǔ de děng dài biàn chéng le duì suǒ yǒu guò qù de pàn duàn ; kě shì wǒ men dāng shí shéi dōu méi yǒu chá kàn yǐ qián jiū jìng fā shēng duō shao cì .
meaning: At 2:30 he said he’d never promised two rather than opening with an apology. It felt like shifting everything to me, and we interrupted each other with claims that I never read carefully and he was always late, without checking earlier occasions.

text: 后来我们挨着桌子坐，把手机放在中间。我先找到自己的邀请，他再把下面那条完整回复指给我看。两点下班、半小时过去、大概两点半到，都在那条里。我承认没有看完整；他也说好、到时联系可以再问一句，确认最后到场的时间，而不是假定我们已经完全一样。记录没有消除所有难受，却让我们不再围着两个不同的记忆打转。
pinyin: hòu lái wǒ men āi zhe zhuō zi zuò , bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhōng jiān . wǒ xiān zhǎo dào zì jǐ de yāo qǐng , tā zài bǎ xià miàn nà tiáo wán zhěng huí fù zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn . liǎng diǎn xià bān , bàn xiǎo shí guò qù , dà gài liǎng diǎn bàn dào , dōu zài nà tiáo lǐ . wǒ chéng rèn méi yǒu kàn wán zhěng ; tā yě shuō hǎo , dào shí lián xì kě yǐ zài wèn yī jù , què rèn zuì hòu dào chǎng de shí jiān , ér bù shì jiǎ dìng wǒ men yǐ jīng wán quán yī yàng . jì lù méi yǒu xiāo chú suǒ yǒu nán shòu , què ràng wǒ men bù zài wéi zhe liǎng gè bù tóng de jì yì dǎ zhuǎn .
meaning: Sitting beside the table, we checked the full exchange together. The reply stated finishing at two, half-hour travel and about 2:30 arrival. I admitted missing it; he recognised that a clearer confirmation could have checked the shared arrival time. The record didn’t erase hurt, but ended circling around different recollections.

text: 我还问，两点五分不回复，是不是因为他不愿意理我。他说当时在走路，十二分停下来才看手机。我亲眼见到的是他两点半到，不是前面每分钟在哪里，所以这段我没有自己的观察。他解释自己的经过，我可以继续问不清楚的地方，却不能只因为自己没看到，就说这个经过肯定不存在。暂时相信和亲眼证实，也不必叫作同一件事。
pinyin: wǒ hái wèn , liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn bù huí fù , shì bú shì yīn wèi tā bù yuàn yì lǐ wǒ . tā shuō dāng shí zài zǒu lù , shí èr fēn tíng xià lái cái kàn shǒu jī . wǒ qīn yǎn jiàn dào de shì tā liǎng diǎn bàn dào , bù shì qián miàn měi fēn zhōng zài nǎ lǐ , suǒ yǐ zhè duàn wǒ méi yǒu zì jǐ de guān chá . tā jiě shì zì jǐ de jīng guò , wǒ kě yǐ jì xù wèn bù qīng chǔ de dì fāng , què bù néng zhǐ yīn wèi zì jǐ méi kàn dào , jiù shuō zhè gè jīng guò kěn dìng bù cún zài . zàn shí xiāng xìn hé qīn yǎn zhèng shí , yě bù bì jiào zuò tóng yī jiàn shì .
meaning: He explained the delayed reply as walking until stopping at 2:12. I had seen his arrival, not each earlier minute. I could ask about uncertainties but couldn’t deny an account solely because I hadn’t witnessed it. Accepting an account and firsthand verification remain different.

text: 他问我最不舒服的是哪一点。我说表面上是等半小时，实际还觉得只有自己认真准备，另一个人没把约定放在心上。他没有用两点半到了这一点，让我立刻觉得等待不算。他说，下班和到场确实不同，他没有故意忘记，不过以后可以把到场写得更清楚。如果真的改了，就给新的估计，不只说快了快了。
pinyin: tā wèn wǒ zuì bù shū fú de shì nǎ yī diǎn . wǒ shuō biǎo miàn shàng shì děng bàn xiǎo shí , shí jì hái jué de zhǐ yǒu zì jǐ rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi , lìng yī gè rén méi bǎ yuē dìng fàng zài xīn shàng . tā méi yǒu yòng liǎng diǎn bàn dào le zhè yī diǎn , ràng wǒ lì kè jué de děng dài bù suàn . tā shuō , xià bān hé dào chǎng què shí bù tóng , tā méi yǒu gù yì wàng jì , bù guò yǐ hòu kě yǐ bǎ dào chǎng xiě de gèng qīng chǔ . rú guǒ zhēn de gǎi le , jiù gěi xīn de gū jì , bù zhǐ shuō kuài le kuài le .
meaning: Waiting mattered alongside feeling alone in taking preparation seriously. He didn’t treat arrival at 2:30 as erasing that. He distinguished finishing work and arrival, denied intentional forgetting and offered clearer future arrival and revised estimates instead of “soon.”

text: 我向他道歉的是没看完整，以及把这次说成每次。他向我道歉的是从没认真看那句，还有没听完就打断。我们没有把道歉写成一个人承认全部都错，另一个人全部都对。两个人可以负责不同的部分；看到一条记录以后，也不需要为了保持生气，就继续坚持里面没有写过的时间。
pinyin: wǒ xiàng tā dào qiàn de shì méi kàn wán zhěng , yǐ jí bǎ zhè cì shuō chéng měi cì . tā xiàng wǒ dào qiàn de shì cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn nà jù , hái yǒu méi tīng wán jiù dǎ duàn . wǒ men méi yǒu bǎ dào qiàn xiě chéng yī gè rén chéng rèn quán bù dōu cuò , lìng yī gè rén quán bù dōu duì . liǎng gè rén kě yǐ fù zé bù tóng de bù fèn ; kàn dào yī tiáo jì lù yǐ hòu , yě bù xū yào wèi le bǎo chí shēng qì , jiù jì xù jiān chí lǐ miàn méi yǒu xiě guò de shí jiān .
meaning: I apologised for incomplete reading and overgeneralisation; he apologised for “never reading carefully” and interrupting. Each took responsibility for different parts rather than one person accepting all fault. The record allowed me to revise a claim without preserving it merely to remain angry.

text: 下一次约的是周四六点到小厅，我们把到场地点和时间重新写了一遍，并约五点半确认。我把六点圈起来，陈宇问这回写的是到场，不是下班吧。我说对，又在旁边写上小厅。真有急事就打电话，不方便接时稍后回复。他打开包给我看，相机和充电线已经放好了，周四我带纸和笔，到了就能开始。
pinyin: xià yī cì yuē de shì zhōu sì liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǒ men bǎ dào chǎng dì diǎn hé shí jiān chóng xīn xiě le yī biàn , bìng yuē wǔ diǎn bàn què rèn . wǒ bǎ liù diǎn quān qǐ lái , chén yǔ wèn zhè huí xiě de shì dào chǎng , bù shì xià bān ba . wǒ shuō duì , yòu zài páng biān xiě shàng xiǎo tīng . zhēn yǒu jí shì jiù dǎ diàn huà , bù fāng biàn jiē shí shāo hòu huí fù . tā dǎ kāi bāo gěi wǒ kàn , xiàng jī hé chōng diàn xiàn yǐ jīng fàng hǎo le , zhōu sì wǒ dài zhǐ hé bǐ , dào le jiù néng kāi shǐ .
meaning: Next time was Thursday at six at the hall, with confirmation at 5:30. I circled six. Arrival, not leaving work? Chen Yu asked. Yes, I said, and added the hall beside it. We'd call about anything urgent and reply later if unable to answer. He showed me the camera and cable in his bag; I'd bring paper and a pen on Thursday.

text: 说完以后，我仍然有一点不想聊天，就先把桌上的东西摆好。他没有再追着问我生不生气，拿起相机，让我站到窗边试一下光。我说那里太亮，他把椅子挪到另一边，自己差点坐进照片里。我忍不住笑了一下，又想起刚才在门口等的那半小时。等拍完收东西时，心里才比来时轻了一点。
pinyin: shuō wán yǐ hòu , wǒ réng rán yǒu yī diǎn bù xiǎng liáo tiān , jiù xiān bǎ zhuō shàng de dōng xi bǎi hǎo . tā méi yǒu zài zhuī zhe wèn wǒ shēng bù shēng qì , ná qǐ xiàng jī , ràng wǒ zhàn dào chuāng biān shì yī xià guāng . wǒ shuō nà lǐ tài liàng , tā bǎ yǐ zi nuó dào lìng yī biān , zì jǐ chà diǎn zuò jìn zhào piān lǐ . wǒ rěn bú zhù xiào le yī xià , yòu xiǎng qǐ gāng cái zài mén kǒu děng de nà bàn xiǎo shí . děng pāi wán shōu dōng xi shí , xīn lǐ cái bǐ lái shí qīng le yī diǎn .
meaning: I still didn't feel like talking and began arranging the things on the table. He stopped asking whether I was angry and tested the light by the window. Too bright, I said. Moving the chair, he nearly sat in the photograph himself, and I couldn't help laughing—though I still remembered the half-hour wait. Only after packing up did I feel a little lighter.

text: 回家后我再打开日历，两点那个数字还是自己亲手写的。我往下补了两点下班、两点半到，才觉得这一天终于和聊天记录对上。陈宇发来一张下午的照片，问选哪张，我说等我明天再看，现在先把周四的时间记好。他回了六点到小厅，我又回他六点到，不是六点出门，两个人这才没有再解释。
pinyin: huí jiā hòu wǒ zài dǎ kāi rì lì , liǎng diǎn nà gè shù zì hái shi zì jǐ qīn shǒu xiě de . wǒ wǎng xià bǔ le liǎng diǎn xià bān , liǎng diǎn bàn dào , cái jué de zhè yī tiān zhōng yú hé liáo tiān jì lù duì shàng . chén yǔ fā lái yī zhāng xià wǔ de zhào piān , wèn xuǎn nǎ zhāng , wǒ shuō děng wǒ míng tiān zài kàn , xiàn zài xiān bǎ zhōu sì de shí jiān jì hǎo . tā huí le liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǒ yòu huí tā liù diǎn dào , bù shì liù diǎn chū mén , liǎng gè rén zhè cái méi yǒu zài jiě shì .
meaning: At home, the two in my calendar was still the number I'd written. Adding two for leaving work and 2:30 for arrival finally made it match the messages. Chen Yu sent a photograph and asked which to choose. I'd look tomorrow; first I'd record Thursday. Six at the hall, he replied. Six for arrival, not departure, I added. At last neither of us needed another explanation.

text: 周五晚上六点，我问陈宇第二天下午能不能两点到小厅，一起给活动拍照。他十分钟以后回复，说两点才能下班，从公司过去要半小时，大概两点半到，问可不可以。我当时还在收东西，只看见前面两点，又觉得他已经答应，就回了好，到时联系。后来我把日历记成两点，没有再看后面那一段。周六我特意提前到，想先把桌子和几件要拍的东西摆好。两点到了，他没来。两点五分我发消息问怎么还没到，等了几分钟没答复。我不知道他已经在走路，脑子里先想到的是他忘记了。两点十二分，他说在路上，估计两点半；我回了一句，你每次都迟到。这句话发出去以后，我还觉得自己是在说实话。他两点半到了，第一句不是道歉，而是说自己从没答应两点到。我听着仿佛他只想把所有事情都推给我，没让他讲完，就再提自己已经等了半小时。他也说我从没认真看消息。两个从没、每次，把这一天下午的等待变成了对所有过去的判断；可是我们当时谁都没有查看以前究竟发生多少次。后来我们挨着桌子坐，把手机放在中间。我先找到自己的邀请，他再把下面那条完整回复指给我看。两点下班、半小时过去、大概两点半到，都在那条里。我承认没有看完整；他也说好、到时联系可以再问一句，确认最后到场的时间，而不是假定我们已经完全一样。记录没有消除所有难受，却让我们不再围着两个不同的记忆打转。我还问，两点五分不回复，是不是因为他不愿意理我。他说当时在走路，十二分停下来才看手机。我亲眼见到的是他两点半到，不是前面每分钟在哪里，所以这段我没有自己的观察。他解释自己的经过，我可以继续问不清楚的地方，却不能只因为自己没看到，就说这个经过肯定不存在。暂时相信和亲眼证实，也不必叫作同一件事。他问我最不舒服的是哪一点。我说表面上是等半小时，实际还觉得只有自己认真准备，另一个人没把约定放在心上。他没有用两点半到了这一点，让我立刻觉得等待不算。他说，下班和到场确实不同，他没有故意忘记，不过以后可以把到场写得更清楚。如果真的改了，就给新的估计，不只说快了快了。我向他道歉的是没看完整，以及把这次说成每次。他向我道歉的是从没认真看那句，还有没听完就打断。我们没有把道歉写成一个人承认全部都错，另一个人全部都对。两个人可以负责不同的部分；看到一条记录以后，也不需要为了保持生气，就继续坚持里面没有写过的时间。下一次约的是周四六点到小厅，我们把到场地点和时间重新写了一遍，并约五点半确认。我把六点圈起来，陈宇问这回写的是到场，不是下班吧。我说对，又在旁边写上小厅。真有急事就打电话，不方便接时稍后回复。他打开包给我看，相机和充电线已经放好了，周四我带纸和笔，到了就能开始。说完以后，我仍然有一点不想聊天，就先把桌上的东西摆好。他没有再追着问我生不生气，拿起相机，让我站到窗边试一下光。我说那里太亮，他把椅子挪到另一边，自己差点坐进照片里。我忍不住笑了一下，又想起刚才在门口等的那半小时。等拍完收东西时，心里才比来时轻了一点。回家后我再打开日历，两点那个数字还是自己亲手写的。我往下补了两点下班、两点半到，才觉得这一天终于和聊天记录对上。陈宇发来一张下午的照片，问选哪张，我说等我明天再看，现在先把周四的时间记好。他回了六点到小厅，我又回他六点到，不是六点出门，两个人这才没有再解释。

wǒ huí le yī jù , nǐ měi cì dōu chí dào . zhè jù huà fā chū qù yǐ hòu , wǒ hái jué de zì jǐ shì zài shuō shí huà . tā liǎng diǎn bàn dào le , dì yī jù bù shì dào qiàn , ér shì shuō zì jǐ cóng méi dā yìng liǎng diǎn dào . wǒ tīng zhe fǎng fú tā zhǐ xiǎng bǎ suǒ yǒu shì qíng dōu tuī gěi wǒ , méi ràng tā jiǎng wán , jiù zài tí zì jǐ yǐ jīng děng le bàn xiǎo shí . tā yě shuō wǒ cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn xiāo xī . liǎng gè cóng méi , měi cì , bǎ zhè yī tiān xià wǔ de děng dài biàn chéng le duì suǒ yǒu guò qù de pàn duàn ; kě shì wǒ men dāng shí shéi dōu méi yǒu chá kàn yǐ qián jiū jìng fā shēng duō shao cì . hòu lái wǒ men āi zhe zhuō zi zuò , bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhōng jiān . wǒ xiān zhǎo dào zì jǐ de yāo qǐng , tā zài bǎ xià miàn nà tiáo wán zhěng huí fù zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn . liǎng diǎn xià bān , bàn xiǎo shí guò qù , dà gài liǎng diǎn bàn dào , dōu zài nà tiáo lǐ . wǒ chéng rèn méi yǒu kàn wán zhěng ; tā yě shuō hǎo , dào shí lián xì kě yǐ zài wèn yī jù , què rèn zuì hòu dào chǎng de shí jiān , ér bù shì jiǎ dìng wǒ men yǐ jīng wán quán yī yàng . jì lù méi yǒu xiāo chú suǒ yǒu nán shòu , què ràng wǒ men bù zài wéi zhe liǎng gè bù tóng de jì yì dǎ zhuǎn . wǒ hái wèn , liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn bù huí fù , shì bú shì yīn wèi tā bù yuàn yì lǐ wǒ . tā shuō dāng shí zài zǒu lù , shí èr fēn tíng xià lái cái kàn shǒu jī . wǒ qīn yǎn jiàn dào de shì tā liǎng diǎn bàn dào , bù shì qián miàn měi fēn zhōng zài nǎ lǐ , suǒ yǐ zhè duàn wǒ méi yǒu zì jǐ de guān chá . tā jiě shì zì jǐ de jīng guò , wǒ kě yǐ jì xù wèn bù qīng chǔ de dì fāng , què bù néng zhǐ yīn wèi zì jǐ méi kàn dào , jiù shuō zhè gè jīng guò kěn dìng bù cún zài . zàn shí xiāng xìn hé qīn yǎn zhèng shí , yě bù bì jiào zuò tóng yī jiàn shì . tā wèn wǒ zuì bù shū fú de shì nǎ yī diǎn . wǒ shuō biǎo miàn shàng shì děng bàn xiǎo shí , shí jì hái jué de zhǐ yǒu zì jǐ rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi , lìng yī gè rén méi bǎ yuē dìng fàng zài xīn shàng . tā méi yǒu yòng liǎng diǎn bàn dào le zhè yī diǎn , ràng wǒ lì kè jué de děng dài bù suàn . tā shuō , xià bān hé dào chǎng què shí bù tóng , tā méi yǒu gù yì wàng jì , bù guò yǐ hòu kě yǐ bǎ dào chǎng xiě de gèng qīng chǔ . rú guǒ zhēn de gǎi le , jiù gěi xīn de gū jì , bù zhǐ shuō kuài le kuài le . wǒ xiàng tā dào qiàn de shì méi kàn wán zhěng , yǐ jí bǎ zhè cì shuō chéng měi cì . tā xiàng wǒ dào qiàn de shì cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn nà jù , hái yǒu méi tīng wán jiù dǎ duàn . wǒ men méi yǒu bǎ dào qiàn xiě chéng yī gè rén chéng rèn quán bù dōu cuò , lìng yī gè rén quán bù dōu duì . liǎng gè rén kě yǐ fù zé bù tóng de bù fèn ; kàn dào yī tiáo jì lù yǐ hòu , yě bù xū yào wèi le bǎo chí shēng qì , jiù jì xù jiān chí lǐ miàn méi yǒu xiě guò de shí jiān . xià yī cì yuē de shì zhōu sì liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǒ men bǎ dào chǎng dì diǎn hé shí jiān chóng xīn xiě le yī biàn , bìng yuē wǔ diǎn bàn què rèn . wǒ bǎ liù diǎn quān qǐ lái , chén yǔ wèn zhè huí xiě de shì dào chǎng , bù shì xià bān ba . wǒ shuō duì , yòu zài páng biān xiě shàng xiǎo tīng . zhēn yǒu jí shì jiù dǎ diàn huà , bù fāng biàn jiē shí shāo hòu huí fù . tā dǎ kāi bāo gěi wǒ kàn , xiàng jī hé chōng diàn xiàn yǐ jīng fàng hǎo le , zhōu sì wǒ dài zhǐ hé bǐ , dào le jiù néng kāi shǐ . shuō wán yǐ hòu , wǒ réng rán yǒu yī diǎn bù xiǎng liáo tiān , jiù xiān bǎ zhuō shàng de dōng xi bǎi hǎo . tā méi yǒu zài zhuī zhe wèn wǒ shēng bù shēng qì , ná qǐ xiàng jī , ràng wǒ zhàn dào chuāng biān shì yī xià guāng . wǒ shuō nà lǐ tài liàng , tā bǎ yǐ zi nuó dào lìng yī biān , zì jǐ chà diǎn zuò jìn zhào piān lǐ . wǒ rěn bú zhù xiào le yī xià , yòu xiǎng qǐ gāng cái zài mén kǒu děng de nà bàn xiǎo shí . děng pāi wán shōu dōng xi shí , xīn lǐ cái bǐ lái shí qīng le yī diǎn . huí jiā hòu wǒ zài dǎ kāi rì lì , liǎng diǎn nà gè shù zì hái shi zì jǐ qīn shǒu xiě de . wǒ wǎng xià bǔ le liǎng diǎn xià bān , liǎng diǎn bàn dào , cái jué de zhè yī tiān zhōng yú hé liáo tiān jì lù duì shàng . chén yǔ fā lái yī zhāng xià wǔ de zhào piān , wèn xuǎn nǎ zhāng , wǒ shuō děng wǒ míng tiān zài kàn , xiàn zài xiān bǎ zhōu sì de shí jiān jì hǎo . tā huí le liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǒ yòu huí tā liù diǎn dào , bù shì liù diǎn chū mén , liǎng gè rén zhè cái méi yǒu zài jiě shì .
meaning: At six Friday evening I asked Chen Yu about arriving at the hall at two Saturday to take activity photos. Ten minutes later he said he finished work at two, needed half an hour and expected about 2:30, asking whether that worked. While packing I noticed two and took it as acceptance, replied okay and entered two without rereading. I came early Saturday to prepare. At two he was absent; my 2:05 message initially went unanswered. Not knowing he was walking, I assumed forgetfulness. At 2:12 he estimated arrival at 2:30. I sent “you’re late every time,” then felt it was simply truthful. At 2:30 he said he’d never promised two rather than opening with an apology. It felt like shifting everything to me, and we interrupted each other with claims that I never read carefully and he was always late, without checking earlier occasions. Sitting beside the table, we checked the full exchange together. The reply stated finishing at two, half-hour travel and about 2:30 arrival. I admitted missing it; he recognised that a clearer confirmation could have checked the shared arrival time. The record didn’t erase hurt, but ended circling around different recollections. He explained the delayed reply as walking until stopping at 2:12. I had seen his arrival, not each earlier minute. I could ask about uncertainties but couldn’t deny an account solely because I hadn’t witnessed it. Accepting an account and firsthand verification remain different. Waiting mattered alongside feeling alone in taking preparation seriously. He didn’t treat arrival at 2:30 as erasing that. He distinguished finishing work and arrival, denied intentional forgetting and offered clearer future arrival and revised estimates instead of “soon.” I apologised for incomplete reading and overgeneralisation; he apologised for “never reading carefully” and interrupting. Each took responsibility for different parts rather than one person accepting all fault. The record allowed me to revise a claim without preserving it merely to remain angry. Next time was Thursday at six at the hall, with confirmation at 5:30. I circled six. Arrival, not leaving work? Chen Yu asked. Yes, I said, and added the hall beside it. We'd call about anything urgent and reply later if unable to answer. He showed me the camera and cable in his bag; I'd bring paper and a pen on Thursday. I still didn't feel like talking and began arranging the things on the table. He stopped asking whether I was angry and tested the light by the window. Too bright, I said. Moving the chair, he nearly sat in the photograph himself, and I couldn't help laughing—though I still remembered the half-hour wait. Only after packing up did I feel a little lighter. At home, the two in my calendar was still the number I'd written. Adding two for leaving work and 2:30 for arrival finally made it match the messages. Chen Yu sent a photograph and asked which to choose. I'd look tomorrow; first I'd record Thursday. Six at the hall, he replied. Six for arrival, not departure, I added. At last neither of us needed another explanation.

parts.text: 周五晚上六点，我问陈宇第二天下午能不能两点到小厅，一起给活动拍照。他十分钟以后回复，说两点才能下班，从公司过去要半小时，大概两点半到，问可不可以。我当时还在收东西，只看见前面两点，又觉得他已经答应，就回了好，到时联系。后来我把日历记成两点，没有再看后面那一段。
周六我特意提前到，想先把桌子和几件要拍的东西摆好。两点到了，他没来。两点五分我发消息问怎么还没到，等了几分钟没答复。我不知道他已经在走路，脑子里先想到的是他忘记了。两点十二分，他说在路上，估计两点半；我回了一句，你每次都迟到。这句话发出去以后，我还觉得自己是在说实话。
他两点半到了，第一句不是道歉，而是说自己从没答应两点到。我听着仿佛他只想把所有事情都推给我，没让他讲完，就再提自己已经等了半小时。他也说我从没认真看消息。两个从没、每次，把这一天下午的等待变成了对所有过去的判断；可是我们当时谁都没有查看以前究竟发生多少次。
后来我们挨着桌子坐，把手机放在中间。我先找到自己的邀请，他再把下面那条完整回复指给我看。两点下班、半小时过去、大概两点半到，都在那条里。我承认没有看完整；他也说好、到时联系可以再问一句，确认最后到场的时间，而不是假定我们已经完全一样。记录没有消除所有难受，却让我们不再围着两个不同的记忆打转。
我还问，两点五分不回复，是不是因为他不愿意理我。他说当时在走路，十二分停下来才看手机。我亲眼见到的是他两点半到，不是前面每分钟在哪里，所以这段我没有自己的观察。他解释自己的经过，我可以继续问不清楚的地方，却不能只因为自己没看到，就说这个经过肯定不存在。暂时相信和亲眼证实，也不必叫作同一件事。
他问我最不舒服的是哪一点。我说表面上是等半小时，实际还觉得只有自己认真准备，另一个人没把约定放在心上。他没有用两点半到了这一点，让我立刻觉得等待不算。他说，下班和到场确实不同，他没有故意忘记，不过以后可以把到场写得更清楚。如果真的改了，就给新的估计，不只说快了快了。
我向他道歉的是没看完整，以及把这次说成每次。他向我道歉的是从没认真看那句，还有没听完就打断。我们没有把道歉写成一个人承认全部都错，另一个人全部都对。两个人可以负责不同的部分；看到一条记录以后，也不需要为了保持生气，就继续坚持里面没有写过的时间。
下一次约的是周四六点到小厅，我们把到场地点和时间重新写了一遍，并约五点半确认。我把六点圈起来，陈宇问这回写的是到场，不是下班吧。我说对，又在旁边写上小厅。真有急事就打电话，不方便接时稍后回复。他打开包给我看，相机和充电线已经放好了，周四我带纸和笔，到了就能开始。
说完以后，我仍然有一点不想聊天，就先把桌上的东西摆好。他没有再追着问我生不生气，拿起相机，让我站到窗边试一下光。我说那里太亮，他把椅子挪到另一边，自己差点坐进照片里。我忍不住笑了一下，又想起刚才在门口等的那半小时。等拍完收东西时，心里才比来时轻了一点。
回家后我再打开日历，两点那个数字还是自己亲手写的。我往下补了两点下班、两点半到，才觉得这一天终于和聊天记录对上。陈宇发来一张下午的照片，问选哪张，我说等我明天再看，现在先把周四的时间记好。他回了六点到小厅，我又回他六点到，不是六点出门，两个人这才没有再解释。

text: 你还在生气吗？
pinyin: nǐ hái zài shēng qì ma ?
meaning: Are you still upset?

text: 有一点，不过想先说完。
pinyin: yǒu yī diǎn , bù guò xiǎng xiān shuō wán .
meaning: A little, but I want to finish talking first.

text: 那我先不解释。
pinyin: nà wǒ xiān bù jiě shì .
meaning: Then I’ll hold off explaining.

text: 你这么说，又好像等着找机会解释。
pinyin: nǐ zhè me shuō , yòu hǎo xiàng děng zhe zhǎo jī huì jiě shì .
meaning: That still sounds like waiting for a chance to explain.

text: 被你听出来了。我先听，真的。
pinyin: bèi nǐ tīng chū lái le . wǒ xiān tīng , zhēn de .
meaning: You caught it. I will listen first, honestly.

text: 我不是要你永远不能说。
pinyin: wǒ bù shì yào nǐ yǒng yuǎn bù néng shuō .
meaning: I don’t mean you can never speak.

text: 是让我不要抢着说。
pinyin: shì ràng wǒ bú yào qiǎng zhe shuō .
meaning: You mean don’t rush to interrupt.

text: 对。让我讲完这一段。
pinyin: duì . ràng wǒ jiǎng wán zhè yī duàn .
meaning: Right. Let me finish this part.

text: 好，我把手机放下来。
pinyin: hǎo , wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng xià lái .
meaning: Okay, I’ll put my phone down.

text: 手机可以一起看，别一边看一边打断。
pinyin: shǒu jī kě yǐ yì qǐ kàn , bié yī biān kàn yī biān dǎ duàn .
meaning: We can check the phone together; just don’t interrupt while looking.

text: 那我挨着桌子坐，等你说完。
pinyin: nà wǒ āi zhe zhuō zi zuò , děng nǐ shuō wán .
meaning: Then I’ll sit by the table and wait until you finish.

text: 这次等我说完，不算迟到啊。
pinyin: zhè cì děng wǒ shuō wán , bù suàn chí dào a .
meaning: This time, waiting needn’t count as being late.

text: 这个承诺只包括周四那一次。
pinyin: zhè gè chéng nuò zhǐ bāo kuò zhōu sì nà yī cì .
meaning: This promise covers only that Thursday.

text: 她道歉以后，也改了下一次的安排。
pinyin: tā dào qiàn yǐ hòu , yě gǎi le xià yī cì de ān pái .
meaning: After apologising she changed the next arrangement too.

text: 今天不便接电话，抱歉。
pinyin: jīn tiān bù biàn jiē diàn huà , bào qiàn .
meaning: Sorry, it isn’t convenient to take a call today.

text: 不要把一次沉默当作最后的答复。
pinyin: bú yào bǎ yī cì chén mò dàng zuò zuì hòu de dá fù .
meaning: Don’t treat one silence as the final answer.

text: 门外的声音打断了我们的谈话。
pinyin: mén wài de shēng yīn dǎ duàn le wǒ men de tán huà .
meaning: The sound outside interrupted our conversation.

text: 她错过一班车，后来坐了下一班。
pinyin: tā cuò guò yī bān chē , hòu lái zuò le xià yī bān .
meaning: She missed one bus, then took the next.

text: 少带一本书，不至于完全没法参加。
pinyin: shǎo dài yī běn shū , bù zhì yú wán quán méi fǎ cān jiā .
meaning: One fewer book doesn’t make participation entirely impossible.

text: 她从不把借来的书留给别人。
pinyin: tā cóng bù bǎ jiè lái de shū liú gěi bié ren .
meaning: She never passes borrowed books to someone else.

text: 我从没去过那个小厅。
pinyin: wǒ cóng méi qù guò nà gè xiǎo tīng .
meaning: I have never been to that hall.

text: 她说愿意原谅，不代表马上忘记。
pinyin: tā shuō yuàn yì yuán liàng , bù dài biǎo mǎ shàng wàng jì .
meaning: She says she is willing to forgive; that doesn’t mean instantly forgetting.

text: 这个办法依赖两个人都看到通知。
pinyin: zhè gè bàn fǎ yī lài liǎng gè rén dōu kàn dào tōng zhī .
meaning: This approach depends on both people seeing the notice.

text: 她没来另有缘故，不是没有兴趣。
pinyin: tā méi lái lìng yǒu yuán gù , bù shì méi yǒu xìng qù .
meaning: Her absence has another cause, not lack of interest.

text: 我们按原来的约定见面。
pinyin: wǒ men àn yuán lái de yuē dìng jiàn miàn .
meaning: We meet according to the original arrangement.

text: 她查看地图，才发现入口变了。
pinyin: tā chá kàn dì tú , cái fā xiàn rù kǒu biàn le .
meaning: She checked the map and found the entrance had changed.

text: 此前的记录没有包括最后那一天。
pinyin: cǐ qián de jì lù méi yǒu bāo kuò zuì hòu nà yī tiān .
meaning: The earlier record excluded the final day.

text: 他说明了此事的经过。
pinyin: tā shuō míng le cǐ shì de jīng guò .
meaning: He explained how this matter unfolded.

text: 表面上两个安排相同，负责的人不同。
pinyin: biǎo miàn shàng liǎng gè ān pái xiāng tóng , fù zé de rén bù tóng .
meaning: The arrangements look the same, but the people responsible differ.

text: 这个办法能不能长久用，还要看时间。
pinyin: zhè gè bàn fǎ néng bù néng cháng jiǔ yòng , hái yào kàn shí jiān .
meaning: Whether this approach can last depends on availability.

text: 他听过意见，但没有全部采纳。
pinyin: tā tīng guò yì jiàn , dàn méi yǒu quán bù cǎi nà .
meaning: He heard the suggestions without adopting them all.

text: 如果不便来，可以早点告诉我。
pinyin: rú guǒ bù biàn lái , kě yǐ zǎo diǎn gào sù wǒ .
meaning: If coming is inconvenient, you can tell me early.

text: 我们以为快到了，不料走错了门。
pinyin: wǒ men yǐ wéi kuài dào le , bù liào zǒu cuò le mén .
meaning: We thought we were close, but unexpectedly went to the wrong entrance.

text: 她拨打了通知上的号码。
pinyin: tā bō dǎ le tōng zhī shàng de hào mǎ .
meaning: She called the number on the notice.

text: 别人说先等，他偏要马上走。
pinyin: bié ren shuō xiān děng , tā piān yào mǎ shàng zǒu .
meaning: Others said to wait, but he insisted on leaving immediately.

text: 这张纸恰好放得进盒子。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhǐ qià hǎo fàng de jìn hé zi .
meaning: This sheet fits just right in the box.

text: 她特意给我留了一个座位。
pinyin: tā tè yì gěi wǒ liú le yī gè zuò wèi .
meaning: She deliberately saved a seat for me.

text: 他亲眼看见门关了。
pinyin: tā qīn yǎn kàn jiàn mén guān le .
meaning: He saw the door close himself.

text: 灯光让窗外仿佛亮了一点。
pinyin: dēng guāng ràng chuāng wài fǎng fú liàng le yī diǎn .
meaning: The light makes outside the window seem a little brighter.

text: 她不再每天翻那封信。
pinyin: tā bù zài měi tiān fān nà fēng xìn .
meaning: She no longer rereads that letter daily.

text: 她不怎么喝咖啡，常常选茶。
pinyin: tā bù zěn me hē kā fēi , cháng cháng xuǎn chá .
meaning: She doesn’t drink much coffee and often chooses tea.

text: 这句话本身没有写到场时间。
pinyin: zhè jù huà běn shēn méi yǒu xiě dào chǎng shí jiān .
meaning: The sentence itself gives no arrival time.

text: 练习次数多了，不等于每次都练对。
pinyin: liàn xí cì shù duō le , bù děng yú měi cì dōu liàn duì .
meaning: More practice sessions don’t mean every one was correct.

text: 这两把椅子挨着，不是隔着整个房间。
pinyin: zhè liǎng bǎ yǐ zi āi zhe , bù shì gé zhe zhěng gè fáng jiān .
meaning: These chairs are next to each other, not across the room.

meaning: I promise to confirm ahead, not that nothing will ever change. This promise covers only that Thursday. I need to apologise for speaking too harshly. After apologising she changed the next arrangement too. Sorry, I didn’t read the whole message. Sorry, it isn’t convenient to take a call today. I took finishing work at two to mean arriving at two. Don’t treat one silence as the final answer. I let her finish without interrupting immediately. The sound outside interrupted our conversation. I missed preparing together at two, not the whole afternoon. She missed one bus, then took the next. This unclear arrangement doesn’t establish deliberate lateness every time. One fewer book doesn’t make participation entirely impossible. He said I never read messages, but cited only this occasion. She never passes borrowed books to someone else. I never promised to arrive at two, only to finish work then. I have never been to that hall. I want to ask you to forgive that harsh remark. She says she is willing to forgive; that doesn’t mean instantly forgetting. We relied too much on remembered times without checking again. This approach depends on both people seeing the notice. Did unfinished work cause your later reply? Her absence has another cause, not lack of interest. Next time state the agreed arrival, not just finishing work. We meet according to the original arrangement. I checked the full Friday exchange again. She checked the map and found the entrance had changed. Before this I had remembered two, so I arrived first. The earlier record excluded the final day. I want to clarify this matter first without reopening every old argument. He explained how this matter unfolded. On the surface it is half an hour; the hurt is feeling abandoned. The arrangements look the same, but the people responsible differ. We want a lasting friendship, not guesses on every occasion. Whether this approach can last depends on availability. I adopted her suggestion to state the time ahead. He heard the suggestions without adopting them all. It wasn’t convenient for her to look at her phone then, not deliberate ignoring. If coming is inconvenient, you can tell me early. I wanted to explain, but that sentence unexpectedly upset her again. We thought we were close, but unexpectedly went to the wrong entrance. For something urgent, you can call instead of only waiting for a message. She called the number on the notice. I wanted to calm down, but he brought it up again just then. Others said to wait, but he insisted on leaving immediately. When he replied I had just reached the hall. This sheet fits just right in the box. I came early specially to arrange the tables. She deliberately saved a seat for me. I saw her arrive myself, not her earlier journey. He saw the door close himself. Without a reply I felt as if I alone was waiting. The light makes outside the window seem a little brighter. After clarification I no longer insisted he was late every time. She no longer rereads that letter daily. I wasn’t very keen to chat that day; I wanted to clarify the arrangement first. She doesn’t drink much coffee and often chooses tea. The waiting itself had tired her, before the harsh remarks. The sentence itself gives no arrival time. We said every time without checking how many earlier occurrences there were. More practice sessions don’t mean every one was correct. We sat beside the table with the phone between us to check together. These chairs are next to each other, not across the room.

text: 那天我下班以后走去小厅，原来预计两点半到。周五收到邀请时，我把两点才能离开公司、还要半小时写在同一条回复里，也问可以吗。看到好，我就当作两个人已经约好两点半。我没有再把这个时间单独写一遍，也不知道她的日历里记的是两点。我们各自觉得已经说清，却依赖了不同的重点。
pinyin: nà tiān wǒ xià bān yǐ hòu zǒu qù xiǎo tīng , yuán lái yù jì liǎng diǎn bàn dào . zhōu wǔ shōu dào yāo qǐng shí , wǒ bǎ liǎng diǎn cái néng lí kāi gōng sī , hái yào bàn xiǎo shí xiě zài tóng yī tiáo huí fù lǐ , yě wèn kě yǐ ma . kàn dào hǎo , wǒ jiù dàng zuò liǎng gè rén yǐ jīng yuē hǎo liǎng diǎn bàn . wǒ méi yǒu zài bǎ zhè gè shí jiān dān dú xiě yī biàn , yě bù zhī dào tā de rì lì lǐ jì de shì liǎng diǎn . wǒ men gè zì jué de yǐ jīng shuō qīng , què yī lài le bù tóng de zhòng diǎn .
meaning: I expected 2:30 arrival after work. My Friday reply combined finishing at two, half-hour travel and asking whether that worked. Her okay seemed agreement on 2:30; I didn’t repeat it and didn’t know her calendar said two. We each felt clear while relying on different details.

text: 两点五分她发消息时，我正在走路，没有马上打开手机。十二分在路口停下，我才看见，回说在路上，估计两点半。我不是故意让她等答复，也没有想到她已经一个人准备了那么久。收到每次都迟到，我一下觉得自己的安排被全部否定：明明已经说明，还被说成每次。我也回了很重的一句，说她从没认真看。
pinyin: liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn tā fā xiāo xī shí , wǒ zhèng zài zǒu lù , méi yǒu mǎ shàng dǎ kāi shǒu jī . shí èr fēn zài lù kǒu tíng xià , wǒ cái kàn jiàn , huí shuō zài lù shàng , gū jì liǎng diǎn bàn . wǒ bù shì gù yì ràng tā děng dá fù , yě méi yǒu xiǎng dào tā yǐ jīng yī gè rén zhǔn bèi le nà me jiǔ . shōu dào měi cì dōu chí dào , wǒ yī xià jué de zì jǐ de ān pái bèi quán bù fǒu dìng : míng míng yǐ jīng shuō míng , hái bèi shuō chéng měi cì . wǒ yě huí le hěn zhòng de yī jù , shuō tā cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn .
meaning: Walking delayed my 2:05 message check until stopping at 2:12. I replied with the estimate, not deliberately withholding a response or knowing her preparation time. “Always late” felt like denying the arrangement I’d explained, and I replied with an equally harsh “never reads carefully.”

text: 到场以后，我首先想证明时间没有错。我把消息给她看，话说得快，她一提等待，我就打断。那时候我以为只要她看见两点半，问题就结束了。不料她更生气，说我连她最难受的地方都不听。我后来想，记录可以解决约定里写了什么，不能替一个人解释等待时怎么想，也不能让我随便把她的感受删掉。
pinyin: dào chǎng yǐ hòu , wǒ shǒu xiān xiǎng zhèng míng shí jiān méi yǒu cuò . wǒ bǎ xiāo xī gěi tā kàn , huà shuō de kuài , tā yī tí děng dài , wǒ jiù dǎ duàn . nà shí hòu wǒ yǐ wéi zhǐ yào tā kàn jiàn liǎng diǎn bàn , wèn tí jiù jié shù le . bù liào tā gèng shēng qì , shuō wǒ lián tā zuì nán shòu de dì fāng dōu bù tīng . wǒ hòu lái xiǎng , jì lù kě yǐ jiě jué yuē dìng lǐ xiě le shén me , bù néng tì yī gè rén jiě shì děng dài shí zěn me xiǎng , yě bù néng ràng wǒ suí biàn bǎ tā de gǎn shòu shān diào .
meaning: On arrival I wanted proof of the correct time and interrupted her waiting account. I thought the 2:30 message would end the issue, but she felt unheard. A record establishes wording, not another person’s experience, and doesn’t license dismissing it.

text: 我们把手机放在桌上，轮流指着看。她承认漏看后面的半小时，我才慢慢平静下来。她问两点五分没回复的缘故，我把走路、停下看手机的过程说了。她没有亲眼看到那段，只能听我的解释；我也没有看见她一个人在小厅时怎么想。各自有自己的经历，也有看不到的部分，不是谁能拿出一条消息，就拥有整个下午。
pinyin: wǒ men bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài zhuō shàng , lún liú zhǐ zhe kàn . tā chéng rèn lòu kàn hòu miàn de bàn xiǎo shí , wǒ cái màn màn píng jìng xià lái . tā wèn liǎng diǎn wǔ fēn méi huí fù de yuán gù , wǒ bǎ zǒu lù , tíng xià kàn shǒu jī de guò chéng shuō le . tā méi yǒu qīn yǎn kàn dào nà duàn , zhǐ néng tīng wǒ de jiě shì ; wǒ yě méi yǒu kàn jiàn tā yī gè rén zài xiǎo tīng shí zěn me xiǎng . gè zì yǒu zì jǐ de jīng lì , yě yǒu kàn bù dào de bù fèn , bù shì shéi néng ná chū yī tiáo xiāo xī , jiù yōng yǒu zhěng gè xià wǔ .
meaning: Checking together calmed me when she acknowledged missing the travel time. I explained walking and stopping; neither of us had witnessed the other’s whole experience. A message didn’t give either ownership of the entire afternoon.

text: 我说没有答应两点到，这句话本身可以核对。但我说她从没认真看，就没有同样的依据。我想到以前她记得我忘了带的东西，也提醒过活动地点，明显不是从没。我没有把这些例子拿来反过来证明她每次都认真，只是收回原来的总说法。关于过去的次数，要真讨论就一件一件看，不在生气的时候随口补成全部。
pinyin: wǒ shuō méi yǒu dā yìng liǎng diǎn dào , zhè jù huà běn shēn kě yǐ hé duì . dàn wǒ shuō tā cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn , jiù méi yǒu tóng yàng de yī jù . wǒ xiǎng dào yǐ qián tā jì de wǒ wàng le dài de dōng xi , yě tí xǐng guò huó dòng dì diǎn , míng xiǎn bù shì cóng méi . wǒ méi yǒu bǎ zhè xiē lì zi ná lái fǎn guò lái zhèng míng tā měi cì dōu rèn zhēn , zhǐ shì shōu huí yuán lái de zǒng shuō fǎ . guān yú guò qù de cì shù , yào zhēn tǎo lùn jiù yī jiàn yī jiàn kàn , bù zài shēng qì de shí hou suí kǒu bǔ chéng quán bù .
meaning: Not promising two is checkable; “never reads carefully” isn’t supported in the same way. She’d remembered forgotten things and venues before. Those examples invalidate never without proving always. Past frequency requires specific review, not emotional universal wording.

text: 她说特意早到，是想一起准备，不只是按表等一个数字。我才想到，自己虽然预计两点半，也可以先问那之前需要多少准备。如果她确实需要两点一起做，我可能不能参加同一安排，可以改地点、改分工，或者直接说这次不便。我写可以吗，是一个问题；她回好，是答复，却没有把双方需要的全部事情都展开。
pinyin: tā shuō tè yì zǎo dào , shì xiǎng yì qǐ zhǔn bèi , bù zhǐ shì àn biǎo děng yī gè shù zì . wǒ cái xiǎng dào , zì jǐ suī rán yù jì liǎng diǎn bàn , yě kě yǐ xiān wèn nà zhī qián xū yào duō shao zhǔn bèi . rú guǒ tā què shí xū yào liǎng diǎn yì qǐ zuò , wǒ kě néng bù néng cān jiā tóng yī ān pái , kě yǐ gǎi dì diǎn , gǎi fēn gōng , huò zhě zhí jiē shuō zhè cì bù biàn . wǒ xiě kě yǐ ma , shì yī gè wèn tí ; tā huí hǎo , shì dá fù , què méi yǒu bǎ shuāng fāng xū yào de quán bù shì qíng dōu zhǎn kāi .
meaning: She’d come early for joint preparation. I could have asked what was needed before 2:30. If two was essential, we might change place, responsibilities or acknowledge my unavailability. The question and okay didn’t unpack every preparation need.

text: 后来我们分别道歉。她说每次迟到那句太重，我也收回从没认真看，想到上一次，她还问了我两遍在哪里见。说完这些，我们都安静了一会儿。桌上的照片还没拍，她先把纸拿出来，我打开相机。她问要不要先看窗边的光，我说好，跟着她走过去，终于不用两个人一直站在门口说刚才谁怎么想。
pinyin: hòu lái wǒ men fēn bié dào qiàn . tā shuō měi cì chí dào nà jù tài zhòng , wǒ yě shōu huí cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn , xiǎng dào shàng yī cì , tā hái wèn le wǒ liǎng biàn zài nǎ lǐ jiàn . shuō wán zhè xiē , wǒ men dōu ān jìng le yī huì er . zhuō shàng de zhào piān hái méi pāi , tā xiān bǎ zhǐ ná chū lái , wǒ dǎ kāi xiàng jī . tā wèn yào bù yào xiān kàn chuāng biān de guāng , wǒ shuō hǎo , gēn zhe tā zǒu guò qù , zhōng yú bù yòng liǎng gè rén yì zhí zhàn zài mén kǒu shuō gāng cái shéi zěn me xiǎng .
meaning: We both apologised. She withdrew 'late every time'; I withdrew 'never read carefully,' remembering that last time she'd checked where to meet twice. We were quiet for a moment. She took out the paper and I opened the camera. Shall we check the window light? Yes. We could finally move from the doorway and begin, rather than keep discussing what we'd thought.

text: 周四的安排我们写成六点到小厅，五点半再确认。她看着我的日历，提醒我别只记下班的时间，我就在六点后面加了到小厅四个字。路上真有变化，我会再给一个大概时间；着急就打电话，不方便接的时候稍后回。她说这样就能知道先做什么，又把自己要带的东西列在旁边，让我拍下来别忘。
pinyin: zhōu sì de ān pái wǒ men xiě chéng liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǔ diǎn bàn zài què rèn . tā kàn zhe wǒ de rì lì , tí xǐng wǒ bié zhǐ jì xià bān de shí jiān , wǒ jiù zài liù diǎn hòu miàn jiā le dào xiǎo tīng sì gè zì . lù shàng zhēn yǒu biàn huà , wǒ huì zài gěi yī gè dà gài shí jiān ; zháo jí jiù dǎ diàn huà , bù fāng biàn jiē de shí hou shāo hòu huí . tā shuō zhè yàng jiù néng zhī dào xiān zuò shén me , yòu bǎ zì jǐ yào dài de dōng xi liè zài páng biān , ràng wǒ pāi xià lái bié wàng .
meaning: We entered Thursday six at the hall, confirming at 5:30. Looking at my calendar, she reminded me not to note just my finish time, so I added 'arrive at the hall.' I'd update the estimate if travel changed; we'd call urgently and reply later when unable to answer. That let her plan what to do first. She listed what she was bringing and told me to photograph it.

text: 拍照片的时候，她还是比较安静。我差点又问是不是还没原谅，话到了嘴边，先咽了回去。她已经把周四记在日历里，现在问这个只会让她再说一遍。最后一张拍好，她走过来看，说这张光不错。我把照片发给她，又把椅子放回墙边。出门时她说周四见，我回了好，提醒自己五点半先发消息。
pinyin: pāi zhào piàn de shí hou , tā hái shi bǐ jiào ān jìng . wǒ chà diǎn yòu wèn shì bú shì hái méi yuán liàng , huà dào le zuǐ biān , xiān yàn le huí qù . tā yǐ jīng bǎ zhōu sì jì zài rì lì lǐ , xiàn zài wèn zhè gè zhǐ huì ràng tā zài shuō yī biàn . zuì hòu yī zhāng pāi hǎo , tā zǒu guò lái kàn , shuō zhè zhāng guāng bù cuò . wǒ bǎ zhào piān fā gěi tā , yòu bǎ yǐ zi fàng huí qiáng biān . chū mén shí tā shuō zhōu sì jiàn , wǒ huí le hǎo , tí xǐng zì jǐ wǔ diǎn bàn xiān fā xiāo xī .
meaning: She was still quiet during the photographs. I almost asked if she hadn't forgiven me, then held back; asking would only make her repeat herself. After the last shot she came over: the light was good. I sent it and put the chair back. At the door she said see you Thursday. I agreed, reminding myself to message at 5:30.

text: 回家以后，我把新时间放在自己的日历里，写清到场，不是离开。我也保留周五的那段交流，没有拿它去向别的朋友证明她这个人从来不好。它帮助我们核对一次约定，不该变成不断在别人面前讲她失误的材料。我们还会有记不准的时候，希望下一次先问清具体内容，再决定那句话到底是在说一次，还是被自己说成了所有次数。
pinyin: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ xīn shí jiān fàng zài zì jǐ de rì lì lǐ , xiě qīng dào chǎng , bù shì lí kāi . wǒ yě bǎo liú zhōu wǔ de nà duàn jiāo liú , méi yǒu ná tā qù xiàng bié de péng you zhèng míng tā zhè gè rén cóng lái bù hǎo . tā bāng zhù wǒ men hé duì yī cì yuē dìng , bù gāi biàn chéng bù duàn zài bié ren miàn qián jiǎng tā shī wù de cái liào . wǒ men hái huì yǒu jì bù zhǔn de shí hou , xī wàng xià yī cì xiān wèn qīng jù tǐ nèi róng , zài jué dìng nà jù huà dào dǐ shì zài shuō yī cì , hái shi bèi zì jǐ shuō chéng le suǒ yǒu cì shù .

text: 那天我下班以后走去小厅，原来预计两点半到。周五收到邀请时，我把两点才能离开公司、还要半小时写在同一条回复里，也问可以吗。看到好，我就当作两个人已经约好两点半。我没有再把这个时间单独写一遍，也不知道她的日历里记的是两点。我们各自觉得已经说清，却依赖了不同的重点。两点五分她发消息时，我正在走路，没有马上打开手机。十二分在路口停下，我才看见，回说在路上，估计两点半。我不是故意让她等答复，也没有想到她已经一个人准备了那么久。收到每次都迟到，我一下觉得自己的安排被全部否定：明明已经说明，还被说成每次。我也回了很重的一句，说她从没认真看。到场以后，我首先想证明时间没有错。我把消息给她看，话说得快，她一提等待，我就打断。那时候我以为只要她看见两点半，问题就结束了。不料她更生气，说我连她最难受的地方都不听。我后来想，记录可以解决约定里写了什么，不能替一个人解释等待时怎么想，也不能让我随便把她的感受删掉。我们把手机放在桌上，轮流指着看。她承认漏看后面的半小时，我才慢慢平静下来。她问两点五分没回复的缘故，我把走路、停下看手机的过程说了。她没有亲眼看到那段，只能听我的解释；我也没有看见她一个人在小厅时怎么想。各自有自己的经历，也有看不到的部分，不是谁能拿出一条消息，就拥有整个下午。我说没有答应两点到，这句话本身可以核对。但我说她从没认真看，就没有同样的依据。我想到以前她记得我忘了带的东西，也提醒过活动地点，明显不是从没。我没有把这些例子拿来反过来证明她每次都认真，只是收回原来的总说法。关于过去的次数，要真讨论就一件一件看，不在生气的时候随口补成全部。她说特意早到，是想一起准备，不只是按表等一个数字。我才想到，自己虽然预计两点半，也可以先问那之前需要多少准备。如果她确实需要两点一起做，我可能不能参加同一安排，可以改地点、改分工，或者直接说这次不便。我写可以吗，是一个问题；她回好，是答复，却没有把双方需要的全部事情都展开。后来我们分别道歉。她说每次迟到那句太重，我也收回从没认真看，想到上一次，她还问了我两遍在哪里见。说完这些，我们都安静了一会儿。桌上的照片还没拍，她先把纸拿出来，我打开相机。她问要不要先看窗边的光，我说好，跟着她走过去，终于不用两个人一直站在门口说刚才谁怎么想。周四的安排我们写成六点到小厅，五点半再确认。她看着我的日历，提醒我别只记下班的时间，我就在六点后面加了到小厅四个字。路上真有变化，我会再给一个大概时间；着急就打电话，不方便接的时候稍后回。她说这样就能知道先做什么，又把自己要带的东西列在旁边，让我拍下来别忘。拍照片的时候，她还是比较安静。我差点又问是不是还没原谅，话到了嘴边，先咽了回去。她已经把周四记在日历里，现在问这个只会让她再说一遍。最后一张拍好，她走过来看，说这张光不错。我把照片发给她，又把椅子放回墙边。出门时她说周四见，我回了好，提醒自己五点半先发消息。回家以后，我把新时间放在自己的日历里，写清到场，不是离开。我也保留周五的那段交流，没有拿它去向别的朋友证明她这个人从来不好。它帮助我们核对一次约定，不该变成不断在别人面前讲她失误的材料。我们还会有记不准的时候，希望下一次先问清具体内容，再决定那句话到底是在说一次，还是被自己说成了所有次数。

wǒ yě méi yǒu kàn jiàn tā yī gè rén zài xiǎo tīng shí zěn me xiǎng . gè zì yǒu zì jǐ de jīng lì , yě yǒu kàn bù dào de bù fèn , bù shì shéi néng ná chū yī tiáo xiāo xī , jiù yōng yǒu zhěng gè xià wǔ . wǒ shuō méi yǒu dā yìng liǎng diǎn dào , zhè jù huà běn shēn kě yǐ hé duì . dàn wǒ shuō tā cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn , jiù méi yǒu tóng yàng de yī jù . wǒ xiǎng dào yǐ qián tā jì de wǒ wàng le dài de dōng xi , yě tí xǐng guò huó dòng dì diǎn , míng xiǎn bù shì cóng méi . wǒ méi yǒu bǎ zhè xiē lì zi ná lái fǎn guò lái zhèng míng tā měi cì dōu rèn zhēn , zhǐ shì shōu huí yuán lái de zǒng shuō fǎ . guān yú guò qù de cì shù , yào zhēn tǎo lùn jiù yī jiàn yī jiàn kàn , bù zài shēng qì de shí hou suí kǒu bǔ chéng quán bù . tā shuō tè yì zǎo dào , shì xiǎng yì qǐ zhǔn bèi , bù zhǐ shì àn biǎo děng yī gè shù zì . wǒ cái xiǎng dào , zì jǐ suī rán yù jì liǎng diǎn bàn , yě kě yǐ xiān wèn nà zhī qián xū yào duō shao zhǔn bèi . rú guǒ tā què shí xū yào liǎng diǎn yì qǐ zuò , wǒ kě néng bù néng cān jiā tóng yī ān pái , kě yǐ gǎi dì diǎn , gǎi fēn gōng , huò zhě zhí jiē shuō zhè cì bù biàn . wǒ xiě kě yǐ ma , shì yī gè wèn tí ; tā huí hǎo , shì dá fù , què méi yǒu bǎ shuāng fāng xū yào de quán bù shì qíng dōu zhǎn kāi . hòu lái wǒ men fēn bié dào qiàn . tā shuō měi cì chí dào nà jù tài zhòng , wǒ yě shōu huí cóng méi rèn zhēn kàn , xiǎng dào shàng yī cì , tā hái wèn le wǒ liǎng biàn zài nǎ lǐ jiàn . shuō wán zhè xiē , wǒ men dōu ān jìng le yī huì er . zhuō shàng de zhào piān hái méi pāi , tā xiān bǎ zhǐ ná chū lái , wǒ dǎ kāi xiàng jī . tā wèn yào bù yào xiān kàn chuāng biān de guāng , wǒ shuō hǎo , gēn zhe tā zǒu guò qù , zhōng yú bù yòng liǎng gè rén yì zhí zhàn zài mén kǒu shuō gāng cái shéi zěn me xiǎng . zhōu sì de ān pái wǒ men xiě chéng liù diǎn dào xiǎo tīng , wǔ diǎn bàn zài què rèn . tā kàn zhe wǒ de rì lì , tí xǐng wǒ bié zhǐ jì xià bān de shí jiān , wǒ jiù zài liù diǎn hòu miàn jiā le dào xiǎo tīng sì gè zì . lù shàng zhēn yǒu biàn huà , wǒ huì zài gěi yī gè dà gài shí jiān ; meaning: I expected 2:30 arrival after work. My Friday reply combined finishing at two, half-hour travel and asking whether that worked. Her okay seemed agreement on 2:30; I didn’t repeat it and didn’t know her calendar said two. We each felt clear while relying on different details. Walking delayed my 2:05 message check until stopping at 2:12. I replied with the estimate, not deliberately withholding a response or knowing her preparation time. “Always late” felt like denying the arrangement I’d explained, and I replied with an equally harsh “never reads carefully.” On arrival I wanted proof of the correct time and interrupted her waiting account. I thought the 2:30 message would end the issue, but she felt unheard. A record establishes wording, not another person’s experience, and doesn’t license dismissing it. Checking together calmed me when she acknowledged missing the travel time. I explained walking and stopping; neither of us had witnessed the other’s whole experience. A message didn’t give either ownership of the entire afternoon. Not promising two is checkable; “never reads carefully” isn’t supported in the same way. She’d remembered forgotten things and venues before. Those examples invalidate never without proving always. Past frequency requires specific review, not emotional universal wording. She’d come early for joint preparation. I could have asked what was needed before 2:30. If two was essential, we might change place, responsibilities or acknowledge my unavailability. The question and okay didn’t unpack every preparation need. We both apologised. She withdrew 'late every time'; I withdrew 'never read carefully,' remembering that last time she'd checked where to meet twice. We were quiet for a moment. She took out the paper and I opened the camera. Shall we check the window light? Yes. We could finally move from the doorway and begin, rather than keep discussing what we'd thought. We entered Thursday six at the hall, confirming at 5:30. Looking at my calendar, she reminded me not to note just my finish time, so I added 'arrive at the hall.' I'd update the estimate if travel changed; we'd call urgently and reply later when unable to answer. That let her plan what to do first. She listed what she was bringing and told me to photograph it. She was still quiet during the photographs. I almost asked if she hadn't forgiven me, then held back; asking would only make her repeat herself. After the last shot she came over: the light was good. I sent it and put the chair back. At the door she said see you Thursday. I agreed, reminding myself to message at 5:30. I entered arrival explicitly and retained the Friday exchange to check an arrangement, not use it to denigrate her to others. text: 你周六下午是不是正好没事？
pinyin: nǐ zhōu liù xià wǔ shì bú shì zhèng hǎo méi shì ?
meaning: Are you free Saturday afternoon, by any chance?

text: 不太行，三点得走。怎么了？
pinyin: bù tài xíng , sān diǎn děi zǒu . zěn me le ?
meaning: Not really; I have to leave at three. What’s up?

text: 我们有个小活动，缺一个人帮忙。
pinyin: wǒ men yǒu gè xiǎo huó dòng , quē yī gè rén bāng máng .
meaning: We have a small event and need another helper.

text: 帮哪一段？是开头介绍，还是一直留着？
pinyin: bāng nǎ yī duàn ? shì kāi tóu jiè shào , hái shi yì zhí liú zhe ?
meaning: Which part? The introduction, or staying the whole time?

text: 原来想请你从两点待到五点。
pinyin: yuán lái xiǎng qǐng nǐ cóng liǎng diǎn dài dào wǔ diǎn .
meaning: We originally hoped you’d stay from two to five.

text: 那不行。我能两点来，介绍十五分钟，三点以前走。
pinyin: nà bù xíng . wǒ néng liǎng diǎn lái , jiè shào shí wǔ fēn zhōng , sān diǎn yǐ qián zǒu .
meaning: I can’t do that. I can come at two, introduce things for fifteen minutes and leave before three.

text: 你先来，后面到时再说？
pinyin: nǐ xiān lái , hòu miàn dào shí zài shuō ?
meaning: Could you come first and we’ll work out the rest then?

text: 后面不能再说，我三点真的要走。
pinyin: hòu miàn bù néng zài shuō , wǒ sān diǎn zhēn de yào zǒu .
meaning: We can’t leave the rest open; I really have to leave at three.

text: 明白，那我找别人接后面。
pinyin: míng bái , nà wǒ zhǎo bié ren jiē hòu miàn .
meaning: Understood. I’ll find someone for the rest.

text: 你是想借音箱，还是要我一起负责声音？
pinyin: nǐ shì xiǎng jiè yīn xiāng , hái shi yào wǒ yì qǐ fù zé shēng yīn ?
meaning: Do you want the speaker, or for me to manage the sound too?

text: 想借音箱。你能顺便带来吗？
pinyin: xiǎng jiè yīn xiāng . nǐ néng shùn biàn dài lái ma ?
meaning: The speaker. Could you bring it along?

text: 那是我室友的，我只能帮你问。
pinyin: nà shì wǒ shì yǒu de , wǒ zhǐ néng bāng nǐ wèn .
meaning: It’s my flatmate’s; I can only ask for you.

text: 我以为是你的。那先别写成已经借到了。
pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi shì nǐ de . nà xiān bié xiě chéng yǐ jīng jiè dào le .
meaning: I thought it was yours. Then let’s not mark it as borrowed yet.

text: 对，借不借、几点还回去，都要问清。
pinyin: duì , jiè bù jiè , jǐ diǎn huán huí qù , dōu yào wèn qīng .
meaning: Right. We need permission and a return time.

text: 要是他允许，我负责取和送回去，不麻烦你来回跑。
pinyin: yào shì tā yǔn xǔ , wǒ fù zé qǔ hé sòng huí qù , bù má fán nǐ lái huí pǎo .
meaning: If he agrees, I’ll collect and return it, so you don’t have to travel back and forth.

text: 好，你直接跟他联系，我先问他愿不愿意。
pinyin: hǎo , nǐ zhí jiē gēn tā lián xì , wǒ xiān wèn tā yuàn bù yuàn yì .
meaning: Okay. Contact him directly; I’ll first ask if he is willing.

text: 你这么问，是不是其实不太想来？
pinyin: nǐ zhè me wèn , shì bú shì qí shí bù tài xiǎng lái ?
meaning: Does all this mean you don’t really want to come?

text: 不是不想，是我不能答应整个下午。
pinyin: bù shì bù xiǎng , shì wǒ bù néng dā yìng zhěng gè xià wǔ .
meaning: It isn’t that I don’t want to; I can’t commit to the whole afternoon.

text: 那我们写两点介绍到两点十五，不把你排到五点。
pinyin: nà wǒ men xiě liǎng diǎn jiè shào dào liǎng diǎn shí wǔ , bù bǎ nǐ pái dào wǔ diǎn .
meaning: Then we’ll write two to 2:15 for the introduction, not schedule you until five.

text: 这样可以。三点要走也写一下，免得临时又叫我。
pinyin: zhè yàng kě yǐ . sān diǎn yào zǒu yě xiě yī xià , miǎn de lín shí yòu jiào wǒ .
meaning: That works. Write that I must leave at three too, so I’m not called on later.

text: 音箱有消息我再通知你，没借到就用小厅原来的。
pinyin: yīn xiāng yǒu xiāo xī wǒ zài tōng zhī nǐ , méi jiè dào jiù yòng xiǎo tīng yuán lái de .
meaning: I’ll tell you about the speaker; otherwise we’ll use the one already in the small hall.

text: 先试过那个能不能用，别等开场才发现。
pinyin: xiān shì guò nà gè néng bù néng yòng , bié děng kāi chǎng cái fā xiàn .
meaning: Test whether it works before the event starts.

text: 好，周五一起试。你只管来听，不用留下收东西。
pinyin: hǎo , zhōu wǔ yì qǐ shì . nǐ zhǐ guǎn lái tīng , bù yòng liú xià shōu dōng xi .
meaning: Okay, we’ll test it Friday. Come and listen; you needn’t stay to pack up.

text: 这句我听明白了。不过我听完也得走，别又给我加一段。
pinyin: zhè jù wǒ tīng míng bái le . bù guò wǒ tīng wán yě děi zǒu , bié yòu gěi wǒ jiā yī duàn .
meaning: I understand that. But I leave after listening too—don’t add another job.

text: 你周六下午是不是正好没事？不太行，三点得走。怎么了？我们有个小活动，缺一个人帮忙。帮哪一段？是开头介绍，还是一直留着？原来想请你从两点待到五点。那不行。我能两点来，介绍十五分钟，三点以前走。你先来，后面到时再说？后面不能再说，我三点真的要走。明白，那我找别人接后面。你是想借音箱，还是要我一起负责声音？想借音箱。你能顺便带来吗？那是我室友的，我只能帮你问。我以为是你的。那先别写成已经借到了。对，借不借、几点还回去，都要问清。要是他允许，我负责取和送回去，不麻烦你来回跑。好，你直接跟他联系，我先问他愿不愿意。你这么问，是不是其实不太想来？不是不想，是我不能答应整个下午。那我们写两点介绍到两点十五，不把你排到五点。这样可以。三点要走也写一下，免得临时又叫我。音箱有消息我再通知你，没借到就用小厅原来的。先试过那个能不能用，别等开场才发现。好，周五一起试。你只管来听，不用留下收东西。这句我听明白了。不过我听完也得走，别又给我加一段。
pinyin: nǐ zhōu liù xià wǔ shì bú shì zhèng hǎo méi shì ? bù tài xíng , sān diǎn děi zǒu . zěn me le ? wǒ men yǒu gè xiǎo huó dòng , quē yī gè rén bāng máng . bāng nǎ yī duàn ? shì kāi tóu jiè shào , hái shi yì zhí liú zhe ? yuán lái xiǎng qǐng nǐ cóng liǎng diǎn dài dào wǔ diǎn . nà bù xíng . wǒ néng liǎng diǎn lái , jiè shào shí wǔ fēn zhōng , sān diǎn yǐ qián zǒu . nǐ xiān lái , hòu miàn dào shí zài shuō ? hòu miàn bù néng zài shuō , wǒ sān diǎn zhēn de yào zǒu . míng bái , nà wǒ zhǎo bié ren jiē hòu miàn . nǐ shì xiǎng jiè yīn xiāng , hái shi yào wǒ yì qǐ fù zé shēng yīn ? xiǎng jiè yīn xiāng . nǐ néng shùn biàn dài lái ma ? nà shì wǒ shì yǒu de , wǒ zhǐ néng bāng nǐ wèn . wǒ yǐ wéi shì nǐ de . nà xiān bié xiě chéng yǐ jīng jiè dào le . duì , jiè bù jiè , jǐ diǎn huán huí qù , dōu yào wèn qīng . yào shì tā yǔn xǔ , wǒ fù zé qǔ hé sòng huí qù , bù má fán nǐ lái huí pǎo . hǎo , nǐ zhí jiē gēn tā lián xì , wǒ xiān wèn tā yuàn bù yuàn yì . nǐ zhè me wèn , shì bú shì qí shí bù tài xiǎng lái ? bù shì bù xiǎng , shì wǒ bù néng dā yìng zhěng gè xià wǔ . nà wǒ men xiě liǎng diǎn jiè shào dào liǎng diǎn shí wǔ , bù bǎ nǐ pái dào wǔ diǎn . zhè yàng kě yǐ . sān diǎn yào zǒu yě xiě yī xià , miǎn de lín shí yòu jiào wǒ . yīn xiāng yǒu xiāo xī wǒ zài tōng zhī nǐ , méi jiè dào jiù yòng xiǎo tīng yuán lái de . xiān shì guò nà gè néng bù néng yòng , bié děng kāi chǎng cái fā xiàn . hǎo , zhōu wǔ yì qǐ shì . nǐ zhǐ guǎn lái tīng , bù yòng liú xià shōu dōng xi . zhè jù wǒ tīng míng bái le . bù guò wǒ tīng wán yě děi zǒu , bié yòu gěi wǒ jiā yī duàn .
meaning: Are you free Saturday afternoon, by any chance? Not really; I have to leave at three. What’s up? We have a small event and need another helper. Which part? The introduction, or staying the whole time? We originally hoped you’d stay from two to five. I can’t do that. I can come at two, introduce things for fifteen minutes and leave before three. Could you come first and we’ll work out the rest then? We can’t leave the rest open; I really have to leave at three. Understood. I’ll find someone for the rest. Do you want the speaker, or for me to manage the sound too? The speaker. Could you bring it along? It’s my flatmate’s; I can only ask for you. I thought it was yours. Then let’s not mark it as borrowed yet. Right. We need permission and a return time. If he agrees, I’ll collect and return it, so you don’t have to travel back and forth. Okay. Contact him directly; I’ll first ask if he is willing. Does all this mean you don’t really want to come? It isn’t that I don’t want to; I can’t commit to the whole afternoon. Then we’ll write two to 2:15 for the introduction, not schedule you until five. That works. Write that I must leave at three too, so I’m not called on later. I’ll tell you about the speaker; otherwise we’ll use the one already in the small hall. Test whether it works before the event starts. Okay, we’ll test it Friday. Come and listen; you needn’t stay to pack up. I understand that. But I leave after listening too—don’t add another job.

text: 林安问我周六下午有没有事，我听见的不是一个完整邀请，而是邀请的开头。我说三点必须走，接着问有什么安排。她说社区的小活动缺人帮忙。我愿意了解，却没有因此把整个下午交给她。以前遇到这种问法，我常常先答应来，到了才知道帮忙还包括接人、试音箱和最后收东西。这次我想先听清需要哪一段，再判断自己能不能做。
pinyin: lín ān wèn wǒ zhōu liù xià wǔ yǒu méi yǒu shì , wǒ tīng jiàn de bù shì yī gè wán zhěng yāo qǐng , ér shì yāo qǐng de kāi tóu . wǒ shuō sān diǎn bì xū zǒu , jiē zhe wèn yǒu shén me ān pái . tā shuō shè qū de xiǎo huó dòng quē rén bāng máng . wǒ yuàn yì liǎo jiě , què méi yǒu yīn cǐ bǎ zhěng gè xià wǔ jiāo gěi tā . yǐ qián yù dào zhè zhǒng wèn fǎ , wǒ cháng cháng xiān dā yìng lái , dào le cái zhī dào bāng máng hái bāo kuò jiē rén , shì yīn xiāng hé zuì hòu shōu dōng xi . zhè cì wǒ xiǎng xiān tīng qīng xū yào nǎ yī duàn , zài pàn duàn zì jǐ néng bù néng zuò .
meaning: Lin An’s availability question began an invitation, not a complete proposal. I said I had to leave at three and asked about the plan. I was interested, but had not offered the entire afternoon. Previous vague requests had grown into greeting guests, testing equipment and packing up, so I wanted the scope first.

text: 她原来希望我两点到五点都留着。我两点能到，也熟悉开头要介绍的几本书，所以提出介绍十五分钟，结束以后留一会儿听，但三点以前走。这不是把三小时缩成一句有空，而是把到场、负责和离开分开。她说先来，后面到时再说，我又重复三点要走。不是故意把话说硬，只是那个时间已经约了别的事情，到了也不会自动消失。
pinyin: tā yuán lái xī wàng wǒ liǎng diǎn dào wǔ diǎn dōu liú zhe . wǒ liǎng diǎn néng dào , yě shú xī kāi tóu yào jiè shào de jǐ běn shū , suǒ yǐ tí chū jiè shào shí wǔ fēn zhōng , jié shù yǐ hòu liú yī huì er tīng , dàn sān diǎn yǐ qián zǒu . zhè bù shì bǎ sān xiǎo shí suō chéng yī jù yǒu kōng , ér shì bǎ dào chǎng , fù zé hé lí kāi fēn kāi . tā shuō xiān lái , hòu miàn dào shí zài shuō , wǒ yòu chóng fù sān diǎn yào zǒu . bù shì gù yì bǎ huà shuō yìng , zhǐ shì nà gè shí jiān yǐ jīng yuē le bié de shì qíng , dào le yě bù huì zì dòng xiāo shī .
meaning: She wanted me from two to five. I offered a fifteen-minute opening and a little listening time, leaving before three. Arrival, responsibility and departure were separate. When she suggested deciding later, I repeated the limit: my other appointment would not disappear on arrival.

text: 林安听完说找别人接后面，这时我才松了口气。我把三点以后那个安排给她看，车要提前一会儿到，确实没法再留下。她拿笔在表上把我的名字划到两点十五，后面的格子暂时空着，说晚上再问小周。我说可以，把我介绍的两本书发过来，我先准备。她翻了一下包，才发现书单还放在办公室，只好用手机发给我。
pinyin: lín ān tīng wán shuō zhǎo bié ren jiē hòu miàn , zhè shí wǒ cái sōng le kǒu qì . wǒ bǎ sān diǎn yǐ hòu nà gè ān pái gěi tā kàn , chē yào tí qián yī huì er dào , què shí méi fǎ zài liú xià . tā ná bǐ zài biǎo shàng bǎ wǒ de míng zi huà dào liǎng diǎn shí wǔ , hòu miàn de gé zi zàn shí kōng zhe , shuō wǎn shang zài wèn xiǎo zhōu . wǒ shuō kě yǐ , bǎ wǒ jiè shào de liǎng běn shū fā guò lái , wǒ xiān zhǔn bèi . tā fān le yī xià bāo , cái fā xiàn shū dān hái fàng zài bàn gōng shì , zhǐ hǎo yòng shǒu jī fā gěi wǒ .
meaning: Lin An said she'd find someone for the rest, and I relaxed. I showed her my plan after three; I had to reach the bus a little early. She ended my slot at 2:15 on the form, leaving the next space empty while she asked Xiao Zhou. I requested the two books I'd introduce. Searching her bag, she realised the list was at the office and sent it by phone.

text: 音箱是另一件事。林安见过我以前带来，就以为是我的。我说是室友的，拿出手机先问他周六要不要用。她赶忙把安排里的已经借到删掉，改成等待回复。消息还没回来，她问小厅原来的那台在哪儿，我指给她看。我们准备周五先试那台，免得一直等室友回信，到了开场才想起来还没有声音。
pinyin: yīn xiāng shì lìng yī jiàn shì . lín ān jiàn guò wǒ yǐ qián dài lái , jiù yǐ wéi shì wǒ de . wǒ shuō shì shì yǒu de , ná chū shǒu jī xiān wèn tā zhōu liù yào bù yào yòng . tā gǎn máng bǎ ān pái lǐ de yǐ jīng jiè dào shān diào , gǎi chéng děng dài huí fù . xiāo xī hái méi huí lái , tā wèn xiǎo tīng yuán lái de nà tái zài nǎr , wǒ zhǐ gěi tā kàn . wǒ men zhǔn bèi zhōu wǔ xiān shì nà tái , miǎn de yì zhí děng shì yǒu huí xìn , dào le kāi chǎng cái xiǎng qǐ lái hái méi yǒu shēng yīn .
meaning: The speaker was another matter. Having seen me bring it before, Lin An thought it was mine. I asked my roommate whether he needed it on Saturday. She changed 'borrowed' to 'awaiting reply' on the plan, then asked about the hall's own speaker. We'd test that one on Friday instead of waiting until the event to realise we had no sound.

text: 室友说可以借，条件是周六五点以前送回家，线也要一起带回来。他下午要用，不能放在小厅等周日再收。林安听取这个条件，决定自己周五取、周六四点半开始收，活动结束前把归还安排给陈宇。她也向室友确认，陈宇替她送回来可以。负责归还的人变了，主人同意才算安排好，不是写上另一个名字就自动变更。
pinyin: shì yǒu shuō kě yǐ jiè , tiáo jiàn shì zhōu liù wǔ diǎn yǐ qián sòng huí jiā , xiàn yě yào yì qǐ dài huí lái . tā xià wǔ yào yòng , bù néng fàng zài xiǎo tīng děng zhōu rì zài shōu . lín ān tīng qǔ zhè gè tiáo jiàn , jué dìng zì jǐ zhōu wǔ qǔ , zhōu liù sì diǎn bàn kāi shǐ shōu , huó dòng jié shù qián bǎ guī huán ān pái gěi chén yǔ . tā yě xiàng shì yǒu què rèn , chén yǔ tì tā sòng huí lái kě yǐ . fù zé guī huán de rén biàn le , zhǔ rén tóng yì cái suàn ān pái hǎo , bù shì xiě shàng lìng yī gè míng zi jiù zì dòng biàn gēng .
meaning: The owner allowed borrowing with the cable returned home before five Saturday. Lin An planned Friday collection and packing at 4:30, and obtained consent for Chen Yu to return it. A new name on the plan alone did not change the owner’s agreement.

text: 周五试声音时，我们先看小厅自己的音箱。它能放介绍的声音，音量也够，所以借来的那台只是备用选择，不是活动能不能开始的唯一条件。活动有二十个名额，小厅五点关闭。林安把时间重新写成两点开始、四点半收，五点以前离开。借到东西和场地可以无限使用，是两件不同的事；试得好听，也不能把结束时间往后推。
pinyin: zhōu wǔ shì shēng yīn shí , wǒ men xiān kàn xiǎo tīng zì jǐ de yīn xiāng . tā néng fàng jiè shào de shēng yīn , yīn liàng yě gòu , suǒ yǐ jiè lái de nà tái zhǐ shì bèi yòng xuǎn zé , bù shì huó dòng néng bù néng kāi shǐ de wéi yī tiáo jiàn . huó dòng yǒu èr shí gè míng é , xiǎo tīng wǔ diǎn guān bì . lín ān bǎ shí jiān chóng xīn xiě chéng liǎng diǎn kāi shǐ , sì diǎn bàn shōu , wǔ diǎn yǐ qián lí kāi . jiè dào dōng xi hé chǎng dì kě yǐ wú xiàn shǐ yòng , shì liǎng jiàn bù tóng de shì ; shì de hǎo tīng , yě bù néng bǎ jié shù shí jiān wǎng hòu tuī .
meaning: Friday testing established that the venue’s own speaker worked. The borrowed one was optional backup. The event had twenty places, began at two, packed at 4:30 and left before the venue’s five closing. Equipment availability did not extend venue hours.

text: 她把最终分工发给我：我两点到两点十五介绍，陈宇之后负责声音和收东西，林安联系参加者。有关借来音箱的取还，由她和室友直接联系。我读完才回复确认，不把整张表都当成自己的职责。表里也写了三点以前离开，所以我不需要活动当天不断解释，也不用把每一次有人问我事情都听成不能走。
pinyin: tā bǎ zuì zhōng fēn gōng fā gěi wǒ : wǒ liǎng diǎn dào liǎng diǎn shí wǔ jiè shào , chén yǔ zhī hòu fù zé shēng yīn hé shōu dōng xi , lín ān lián xì cān jiā zhě . yǒu guān jiè lái yīn xiāng de qǔ hái , yóu tā hé shì yǒu zhí jiē lián xì . wǒ dú wán cái huí fù què rèn , bù bǎ zhěng zhāng biǎo dōu dàng chéng zì jǐ de zhí zé . biǎo lǐ yě xiě le sān diǎn yǐ qián lí kāi , suǒ yǐ wǒ bù xū yào huó dòng dàng tiān bù duàn jiě shì , yě bù yòng bǎ měi yī cì yǒu rén wèn wǒ shì qíng dōu tīng chéng bù néng zǒu .
meaning: The final plan assigned my opening, Chen Yu’s later sound and packing, and Lin An’s participant contact and equipment arrangements. I confirmed my part, not every task, with my departure limit recorded.

text: 周六有位参加者问我能不能最后再介绍一本书。我说今天三点要走，后面可以问林安。对方说可惜，我也觉得可惜，但这句话没有让我欠下最后一段。我已经完成十五分钟，就可以按约定离开；如果我自己决定临时多留，那是新的选择，也要看后面的安排，不能把可惜当作已经答应。
pinyin: zhōu liù yǒu wèi cān jiā zhě wèn wǒ néng bù néng zuì hòu zài jiè shào yī běn shū . wǒ shuō jīn tiān sān diǎn yào zǒu , hòu miàn kě yǐ wèn lín ān . duì fāng shuō kě xī , wǒ yě jué de kě xī , dàn zhè jù huà méi yǒu ràng wǒ qiàn xià zuì hòu yī duàn . wǒ yǐ jīng wán chéng shí wǔ fēn zhōng , jiù kě yǐ àn yuē dìng lí kāi ; rú guǒ wǒ zì jǐ jué dìng lín shí duō liú , nà shì xīn de xuǎn zé , yě yào kàn hòu miàn de ān pái , bù néng bǎ kě xī dàng zuò yǐ jīng dā yìng .
meaning: A participant asked for another book introduction at the end. I referred them to Lin An and retained my departure. Shared disappointment was not a new commitment. Staying longer would require a new choice and availability.

text: 走到门口时，林安说谢谢我先把范围讲清，不然她还会把帮一下想成帮完整场。我说也谢谢她听完以后真的改了分工，没有一边说知道一边把我的名字放到五点。这次活动没有因为每个人都无条件答应而顺利，而是大家知道谁来、做什么、做到几点，以及哪里还没有人答应。没确定的部分写成没确定，比把它们藏在客气话里更容易处理。
pinyin: zǒu dào mén kǒu shí , lín ān shuō xiè xiè wǒ xiān bǎ fàn wéi jiǎng qīng , bù rán tā hái huì bǎ bāng yī xià xiǎng chéng bāng wán zhěng chǎng . wǒ shuō yě xiè xiè tā tīng wán yǐ hòu zhēn de gǎi le fēn gōng , méi yǒu yī biān shuō zhī dào yī biān bǎ wǒ de míng zi fàng dào wǔ diǎn . zhè cì huó dòng méi yǒu yīn wèi měi gè rén dōu wú tiáo jiàn dā yìng ér shùn lì , ér shì dà jiā zhī dào shéi lái , zuò shén me , zuò dào jǐ diǎn , yǐ jí nǎ lǐ hái méi yǒu rén dā yìng . méi què dìng de bù fèn xiě chéng méi què dìng , bǐ bǎ tā men cáng zài kè qì huà lǐ gèng róng yì chǔ lǐ .
meaning: At departure we appreciated a clear scope and a plan that actually reflected it. The event benefited from knowing who had agreed to what and until when, with unresolved parts labelled unresolved rather than hidden in politeness.

text: 回家以后，室友收到音箱，确认线也在。我没有参加归还，却收到一句已经还好，因为开头是我介绍双方认识。我看完很放心，没有觉得消息发给我就使我负责了整个下午。介绍联系、负责运送、允许借出和检查归还，分别属于不同的人；把这些事说清，人情反而不用靠一个人一直不好意思离开来维持。
pinyin: huí jiā yǐ hòu , shì yǒu shōu dào yīn xiāng , què rèn xiàn yě zài . wǒ méi yǒu cān jiā guī huán , què shōu dào yī jù yǐ jīng hái hǎo , yīn wèi kāi tóu shì wǒ jiè shào shuāng fāng rèn shi . wǒ kàn wán hěn fàng xīn , méi yǒu jué de xiāo xī fā gěi wǒ jiù shǐ wǒ fù zé le zhěng gè xià wǔ . jiè shào lián xì , fù zé yùn sòng , yǔn xǔ jiè chū hé jiǎn chá guī huán , fēn bié shǔ yú bù tóng de rén ; bǎ zhè xiē shì shuō qīng , rén qíng fǎn ér bù yòng kào yī gè rén yì zhí bù hǎo yì sī lí kāi lái wéi chí .
meaning: The owner received the speaker and cable and sent me confirmation because I had introduced them. Receiving that update did not make me responsible for transport. Clear roles supported goodwill without relying on someone feeling unable to leave.

text: 林安问我周六下午有没有事，我听见的不是一个完整邀请，而是邀请的开头。我说三点必须走，接着问有什么安排。她说社区的小活动缺人帮忙。我愿意了解，却没有因此把整个下午交给她。以前遇到这种问法，我常常先答应来，到了才知道帮忙还包括接人、试音箱和最后收东西。这次我想先听清需要哪一段，再判断自己能不能做。她原来希望我两点到五点都留着。我两点能到，也熟悉开头要介绍的几本书，所以提出介绍十五分钟，结束以后留一会儿听，但三点以前走。这不是把三小时缩成一句有空，而是把到场、负责和离开分开。她说先来，后面到时再说，我又重复三点要走。不是故意把话说硬，只是那个时间已经约了别的事情，到了也不会自动消失。林安听完说找别人接后面，这时我才松了口气。我把三点以后那个安排给她看，车要提前一会儿到，确实没法再留下。她拿笔在表上把我的名字划到两点十五，后面的格子暂时空着，说晚上再问小周。我说可以，把我介绍的两本书发过来，我先准备。她翻了一下包，才发现书单还放在办公室，只好用手机发给我。音箱是另一件事。林安见过我以前带来，就以为是我的。我说是室友的，拿出手机先问他周六要不要用。她赶忙把安排里的已经借到删掉，改成等待回复。消息还没回来，她问小厅原来的那台在哪儿，我指给她看。我们准备周五先试那台，免得一直等室友回信，到了开场才想起来还没有声音。室友说可以借，条件是周六五点以前送回家，线也要一起带回来。他下午要用，不能放在小厅等周日再收。林安听取这个条件，决定自己周五取、周六四点半开始收，活动结束前把归还安排给陈宇。她也向室友确认，陈宇替她送回来可以。负责归还的人变了，主人同意才算安排好，不是写上另一个名字就自动变更。周五试声音时，我们先看小厅自己的音箱。它能放介绍的声音，音量也够，所以借来的那台只是备用选择，不是活动能不能开始的唯一条件。活动有二十个名额，小厅五点关闭。林安把时间重新写成两点开始、四点半收，五点以前离开。借到东西和场地可以无限使用，是两件不同的事；试得好听，也不能把结束时间往后推。她把最终分工发给我：我两点到两点十五介绍，陈宇之后负责声音和收东西，林安联系参加者。有关借来音箱的取还，由她和室友直接联系。我读完才回复确认，不把整张表都当成自己的职责。表里也写了三点以前离开，所以我不需要活动当天不断解释，也不用把每一次有人问我事情都听成不能走。周六有位参加者问我能不能最后再介绍一本书。我说今天三点要走，后面可以问林安。对方说可惜，我也觉得可惜，但这句话没有让我欠下最后一段。我已经完成十五分钟，就可以按约定离开；如果我自己决定临时多留，那是新的选择，也要看后面的安排，不能把可惜当作已经答应。走到门口时，林安说谢谢我先把范围讲清，不然她还会把帮一下想成帮完整场。我说也谢谢她听完以后真的改了分工，没有一边说知道一边把我的名字放到五点。这次活动没有因为每个人都无条件答应而顺利，而是大家知道谁来、做什么、做到几点，以及哪里还没有人答应。没确定的部分写成没确定，比把它们藏在客气话里更容易处理。回家以后，室友收到音箱，确认线也在。我没有参加归还，却收到一句已经还好，因为开头是我介绍双方认识。我看完很放心，没有觉得消息发给我就使我负责了整个下午。介绍联系、负责运送、允许借出和检查归还，分别属于不同的人；把这些事说清，人情反而不用靠一个人一直不好意思离开来维持。
pinyin: lín ān wèn wǒ zhōu liù xià wǔ yǒu méi yǒu shì , wǒ tīng jiàn de bù shì yī gè wán zhěng yāo qǐng , ér shì yāo qǐng de kāi tóu . wǒ shuō sān diǎn bì xū zǒu , jiē zhe wèn yǒu shén me ān pái . tā shuō shè qū de xiǎo huó dòng quē rén bāng máng . wǒ yuàn yì liǎo jiě , què méi yǒu yīn cǐ bǎ zhěng gè xià wǔ jiāo gěi tā . yǐ qián yù dào zhè zhǒng wèn fǎ , wǒ cháng cháng xiān dā yìng lái , dào le cái zhī dào bāng máng hái bāo kuò jiē rén , shì yīn xiāng hé zuì hòu shōu dōng xi . zhè cì wǒ xiǎng xiān tīng qīng xū yào nǎ yī duàn , zài pàn duàn zì jǐ néng bù néng zuò . tā yuán lái xī wàng wǒ liǎng diǎn dào wǔ diǎn dōu liú zhe . wǒ liǎng diǎn néng dào , yě shú xī kāi tóu yào jiè shào de jǐ běn shū , suǒ yǐ tí chū jiè shào shí wǔ fēn zhōng , jié shù yǐ hòu liú yī huì er tīng , dàn sān diǎn yǐ qián zǒu . zhè bù shì bǎ sān xiǎo shí suō chéng yī jù yǒu kōng , ér shì bǎ dào chǎng , fù zé hé lí kāi fēn kāi . tā shuō xiān lái , hòu miàn dào shí zài shuō , wǒ yòu chóng fù sān diǎn yào zǒu . bù shì gù yì bǎ huà shuō yìng , zhǐ shì nà gè shí jiān yǐ jīng yuē le bié de shì qíng , dào le yě bù huì zì dòng xiāo shī . lín ān tīng wán shuō zhǎo bié ren jiē hòu miàn , zhè shí wǒ cái sōng le kǒu qì . wǒ bǎ sān diǎn yǐ hòu nà gè ān pái gěi tā kàn , chē yào tí qián yī huì er dào , què shí méi fǎ zài liú xià . tā ná bǐ zài biǎo shàng bǎ wǒ de míng zi huà dào liǎng diǎn shí wǔ , hòu miàn de gé zi zàn shí kōng zhe , shuō wǎn shang zài wèn xiǎo zhōu . wǒ shuō kě yǐ , bǎ wǒ jiè shào de liǎng běn shū fā guò lái , wǒ xiān zhǔn bèi . tā fān le yī xià bāo , cái fā xiàn shū dān hái fàng zài bàn gōng shì , zhǐ hǎo yòng shǒu jī fā gěi wǒ . yīn xiāng shì lìng yī jiàn shì . lín ān jiàn guò wǒ yǐ qián dài lái , jiù yǐ wéi shì wǒ de . wǒ shuō shì shì yǒu de , ná chū shǒu jī xiān wèn tā zhōu liù yào bù yào yòng . tā gǎn máng bǎ ān pái lǐ de yǐ jīng jiè dào shān diào , gǎi chéng děng dài huí fù . xiāo xī hái méi huí lái , tā wèn xiǎo tīng yuán lái de nà tái zài nǎr , wǒ zhǐ gěi tā kàn . wǒ men zhǔn bèi zhōu wǔ xiān shì nà tái , miǎn de yì zhí děng shì yǒu huí xìn , dào le kāi chǎng cái xiǎng qǐ lái hái méi yǒu shēng yīn . shì yǒu shuō kě yǐ jiè , tiáo jiàn shì zhōu liù wǔ diǎn yǐ qián sòng huí jiā , xiàn yě yào yì qǐ dài huí lái . tā xià wǔ yào yòng , bù néng fàng zài xiǎo tīng děng zhōu rì zài shōu . lín ān tīng qǔ zhè gè tiáo jiàn , jué dìng zì jǐ zhōu wǔ qǔ , zhōu liù sì diǎn bàn kāi shǐ shōu , huó dòng jié shù qián bǎ guī huán ān pái gěi chén yǔ . tā yě xiàng shì yǒu què rèn , chén yǔ tì tā sòng huí lái kě yǐ . fù zé guī huán de rén biàn le , zhǔ rén tóng yì cái suàn ān pái hǎo , bù shì xiě shàng lìng yī gè míng zi jiù zì dòng biàn gēng . zhōu wǔ shì shēng yīn shí , wǒ men xiān kàn xiǎo tīng zì jǐ de yīn xiāng . tā néng fàng jiè shào de shēng yīn , yīn liàng yě gòu , suǒ yǐ jiè lái de nà tái zhǐ shì bèi yòng xuǎn zé , bù shì huó dòng néng bù néng kāi shǐ de wéi yī tiáo jiàn . huó dòng yǒu èr shí gè míng é , xiǎo tīng wǔ diǎn guān bì . lín ān bǎ shí jiān chóng xīn xiě chéng wǎng hòu tuī . tā bǎ zuì zhōng fēn gōng fā gěi wǒ : wǒ liǎng diǎn dào liǎng diǎn shí wǔ jiè shào , chén yǔ zhī hòu fù zé shēng yīn hé shōu dōng xi , lín ān lián xì cān jiā zhě . yǒu guān jiè lái yīn yī gè rén yì zhí bù hǎo yì sī lí kāi lái wéi chí .
meaning: Lin An’s availability question began an invitation, not a complete proposal. I said I had to leave at three and asked about the plan. I was interested, but had not offered the entire afternoon. Previous vague requests had grown into greeting guests, testing equipment and packing up, so I wanted the scope first. She wanted me from two to five. I offered a fifteen-minute opening and a little listening time, leaving before three. Arrival, responsibility and departure were separate. When she suggested deciding later, I repeated the limit: my other appointment would not disappear on arrival. Lin An said she'd find someone for the rest, and I relaxed. I showed her my plan after three; I had to reach the bus a little early. She ended my slot at 2:15 on the form, leaving the next space empty while she asked Xiao Zhou. I requested the two books I'd introduce. Searching her bag, she realised the list was at the office and sent it by phone. The speaker was another matter. Having seen me bring it before, Lin An thought it was mine. I asked my roommate whether he needed it on Saturday. She changed 'borrowed' to 'awaiting reply' on the plan, then asked about the hall's own speaker. We'd test that one on Friday instead of waiting until the event to realise we had no sound. The owner allowed borrowing with the cable returned home before five Saturday. Lin An planned Friday collection and packing at 4:30, and obtained consent for Chen Yu to return it. A new name on the plan alone did not change the owner’s agreement. Friday testing established that the venue’s own speaker worked. The borrowed one was optional backup. The event had twenty places, began at two, packed at 4:30 and left before the venue’s five closing. Equipment availability did not extend venue hours. The final plan assigned my opening, Chen Yu’s later sound and packing, and Lin An’s participant contact and equipment arrangements. I confirmed my part, not every task, with my departure limit recorded. A participant asked for another book introduction at the end. I referred them to Lin An and retained my departure. Shared disappointment was not a new commitment. Staying longer would require a new choice and availability. At departure we appreciated a clear scope and a plan that actually reflected it. The event benefited from knowing who had agreed to what and until when, with unresolved parts labelled unresolved rather than hidden in politeness. The owner received the speaker and cable and sent me confirmation because I had introduced them. Receiving that update did not make me responsible for transport. Clear roles supported goodwill without relying on someone feeling unable to leave.

parts.text: 林安问我周六下午有没有事，我听见的不是一个完整邀请，而是邀请的开头。我说三点必须走，接着问有什么安排。她说社区的小活动缺人帮忙。我愿意了解，却没有因此把整个下午交给她。以前遇到这种问法，我常常先答应来，到了才知道帮忙还包括接人、试音箱和最后收东西。这次我想先听清需要哪一段，再判断自己能不能做。
她原来希望我两点到五点都留着。我两点能到，也熟悉开头要介绍的几本书，所以提出介绍十五分钟，结束以后留一会儿听，但三点以前走。这不是把三小时缩成一句有空，而是把到场、负责和离开分开。她说先来，后面到时再说，我又重复三点要走。不是故意把话说硬，只是那个时间已经约了别的事情，到了也不会自动消失。
林安听完说找别人接后面，这时我才松了口气。我把三点以后那个安排给她看，车要提前一会儿到，确实没法再留下。她拿笔在表上把我的名字划到两点十五，后面的格子暂时空着，说晚上再问小周。我说可以，把我介绍的两本书发过来，我先准备。她翻了一下包，才发现书单还放在办公室，只好用手机发给我。
音箱是另一件事。林安见过我以前带来，就以为是我的。我说是室友的，拿出手机先问他周六要不要用。她赶忙把安排里的已经借到删掉，改成等待回复。消息还没回来，她问小厅原来的那台在哪儿，我指给她看。我们准备周五先试那台，免得一直等室友回信，到了开场才想起来还没有声音。
室友说可以借，条件是周六五点以前送回家，线也要一起带回来。他下午要用，不能放在小厅等周日再收。林安听取这个条件，决定自己周五取、周六四点半开始收，活动结束前把归还安排给陈宇。她也向室友确认，陈宇替她送回来可以。负责归还的人变了，主人同意才算安排好，不是写上另一个名字就自动变更。
周五试声音时，我们先看小厅自己的音箱。它能放介绍的声音，音量也够，所以借来的那台只是备用选择，不是活动能不能开始的唯一条件。活动有二十个名额，小厅五点关闭。林安把时间重新写成两点开始、四点半收，五点以前离开。借到东西和场地可以无限使用，是两件不同的事；试得好听，也不能把结束时间往后推。
她把最终分工发给我：我两点到两点十五介绍，陈宇之后负责声音和收东西，林安联系参加者。有关借来音箱的取还，由她和室友直接联系。我读完才回复确认，不把整张表都当成自己的职责。表里也写了三点以前离开，所以我不需要活动当天不断解释，也不用把每一次有人问我事情都听成不能走。
周六有位参加者问我能不能最后再介绍一本书。我说今天三点要走，后面可以问林安。对方说可惜，我也觉得可惜，但这句话没有让我欠下最后一段。我已经完成十五分钟，就可以按约定离开；如果我自己决定临时多留，那是新的选择，也要看后面的安排，不能把可惜当作已经答应。
走到门口时，林安说谢谢我先把范围讲清，不然她还会把帮一下想成帮完整场。我说也谢谢她听完以后真的改了分工，没有一边说知道一边把我的名字放到五点。这次活动没有因为每个人都无条件答应而顺利，而是大家知道谁来、做什么、做到几点，以及哪里还没有人答应。没确定的部分写成没确定，比把它们藏在客气话里更容易处理。
回家以后，室友收到音箱，确认线也在。我没有参加归还，却收到一句已经还好，因为开头是我介绍双方认识。我看完很放心，没有觉得消息发给我就使我负责了整个下午。介绍联系、负责运送、允许借出和检查归还，分别属于不同的人；把这些事说清，人情反而不用靠一个人一直不好意思离开来维持。
