快结束时有人想谈音量，另一个人又开始讲上回什么设备不好。只剩五分钟，我打断了一下，先说这个问题值得单独谈，再请他们把具体情况发给负责设备的人。打断不是因为问题不重要，而是已经约好的时间也需要有人守住。我们用最后几分钟念确认过的分工，提醒场地和最终顺序等周五回复。有人改了一处，原来他答应的是下午帮四把椅子换位置，不是上午搬所有桌子，我当场改掉。
散会后我发了一条很短的消息，没有把整张记录直接贴出去。消息先列已经确认的联系人和回复时间，再列还待确认的场地与顺序，最后放补充意见的方式。有朋友回复一个鼓掌的表情，我笑着回谢谢，这次不把掌声算成搬桌子的报名。她马上又发一条，说周六下午真的可以帮。我们这才问清具体时间和事情，把名字加到新的名单里。会议没有得到所有人同意所有事，却让需要做的下一步有了人，也让还没决定的地方留在原处。

text: 你刚才鼓掌，我以为你同意了。

text: 我是觉得那首歌好，不是答应搬桌子。

text: 周六早上？

text: 那只排你两点以后。

text: 还要问做什么。

text: 搬四把椅子，不搬桌子。

text: 行，这次可以鼓掌了。

text: 给椅子鼓掌？

meaning: For the chairs?

text: 给你终于问清楚了。

pinyin: huì zhǎng ràng dà jiā xiān tí jiāo xiǎng fǎ .

text: 她带一个新人来认识大家。

text: 我们先分工，再开始整理。

meaning: We divide up work before sorting.

text: 这个职责不能随便交给没答应的人。

text: 她承诺周五前回复。

text: 小组派出一人去核对设备。

text: 这两种情况要区分。
pinyin: zhè liǎng zhǒng qíng kuàng yào qū fēn .

text: 新安排提升了参加的便利性。
pinyin: xīn ān pái tí shēng le cān jiā de biàn lì xìng .

text: 她愿意听取相反的看法。

text: 请把确认过的名单提交给工作人员。

text: 有问题先留言，我晚点回复。

text: 他没有马上回应这个建议。

text: 我们想探讨更合适的安排。

text: 至于费用，等确认以后再说。

text: 再说，设备也还没检查。

text: 若人数增加，请提前联系。
pinyin: ruò rén shù zēng jiā , qǐng tí qián lián xì .

text: 她赶车，只得提前离开。
pinyin: tā gǎn chē , zhǐ dé tí qián lí kāi .

text: 请确认能否提前进场。

text: 这个办法切实可行。
pinyin: zhè gè bàn fǎ qiè shí kě xíng .

text: 他们最终同意先试一次。

First address the practical issues. This approach is workable. The final running order waits for Friday's confirmation. They ultimately agreed to try once first. Don't let one question take all the time. The equipment occupies half the table. Let me interrupt briefly to confirm which day you mean. She let her friend finish without interrupting. After the laughter,we returned to timing. Laughter came from next door. Applause shows appreciation,not necessarily agreement to duties. Applause followed the performance.

parts.text: 今天的议题是活动先读书还是先听歌。
这个议题留到下次。
这是小范围座谈会，不是长篇报告。
座谈会结束后还能单独提问。
主持人负责让不同的人有机会说。
主持人提醒大家剩下的时间。
发言人转达小组已经确认的安排。
发言人没有宣布未决定的事。
协会愿意提供小厅。
她加入了本地的音乐协会。
会长周五才能确认场地。
会长让大家先提交想法。
新人也可以先听，不急着上台。
她带一个新人来认识大家。
分工要写谁做和什么时候做。
我们先分工，再开始整理。
检查设备是工作人员的职责。
这个职责不能随便交给没答应的人。
我来协调两组的时间。
她协调了场地和人员安排。
还没问过场地，就不能承诺日期。
她承诺周五前回复。
协会派出两个人帮助布置。
小组派出一人去核对设备。
先区分建议和已经同意的事。
这两种情况要区分。
我们想提升听歌时的体验。
新安排提升了参加的便利性。
先听取还没开口的人的意见。
她愿意听取相反的看法。
会后可以提交补充意见。
请把确认过的名单提交给工作人员。
她留言说不能负责周六布置。
有问题先留言，我晚点回复。
我先回应时间的问题。
他没有马上回应这个建议。
音量的问题需要单独探讨。
我们想探讨更合适的安排。
至于节目单，我来整理。
至于费用，等确认以后再说。
先确认房间，买东西以后再说。
再说，设备也还没检查。
凡是上台的人，都先确认自己的时间。
凡是改过的安排，都写进消息里。
若小厅不能用，就改期。
若人数增加，请提前联系。
场地没确认，我们只得先等。
她赶车，只得提前离开。
周六上午对她不便。
现在不便长谈，晚点再说。
能否安排两次演奏，还没确定。
请确认能否提前进场。
先解决切实的问题。
这个办法切实可行。
最终顺序还要等周五确认。
他们最终同意先试一次。
别让一个问题占据全部时间。
设备占据了桌子的一半。
我打断一下，先确认你说的是哪天。
她没打断，让朋友把话说完。
笑声过后，我们继续讨论时间。
隔壁传来一阵笑声。
掌声表示喜欢，不一定表示同意分工。
演奏结束后响起掌声。

text: 我原本不想去今天的讨论，因为上次只是帮忙提了一句建议，最后就被安排周六一早去搬东西。后来主持人道歉，改掉名单，我知道她不是故意的，可下一次听到要开会，还是先想起那张纸。林安跟我说这回散会前会念确认过的分工，没答应的事情不会直接加进去。我才决定去看看，而且先在群里留言，周六上午不便参加，下午两点以后可以考虑，具体要做什么再问我。
pinyin: wǒ yuán běn bù xiǎng qù jīn tiān de tǎo lùn , yīn wèi shàng cì zhǐ shì bāng máng tí le yī jù jiàn yì , zuì hòu jiù bèi ān pái zhōu liù yī zǎo qù bān dōng xi . hòu lái zhǔ chí rén dào qiàn , gǎi diào míng dān , wǒ zhī dào tā bù shì gù yì de , kě xià yī cì tīng dào yào kāi huì , hái shi xiān xiǎng qǐ nà zhāng zhǐ . lín ān gēn wǒ shuō zhè huí sàn huì qián huì niàn què rèn guò de fēn gōng , méi dā yìng de shì qíng bù huì zhí jiē jiā jìn qù . wǒ cái jué dìng qù kàn kàn , ér qiě xiān zài qún lǐ liú yán , zhōu liù shàng wǔ bù biàn cān jiā , xià wǔ liǎng diǎn yǐ hòu kě yǐ kǎo lǜ , jù tǐ yào zuò shén me zài wèn wǒ .
meaning: I hesitated about today's meeting because a suggestion last time had become an early Saturday moving duty.The host apologised and corrected it,but I still remembered that list.Lin An said duties would now be read back.I went,and first messaged that Saturday morning didn't work;after two might,depending on the task.

text: 今天讨论节目先后，我先说想把读书放前面，好让两位演奏的朋友先听一段，再上去唱。他们八点以后要走，我提议朗读短一点，给歌留够时间。主持人问清是谁以后，把八点写在节目单旁边。有人建议开头一首、后面一首，我看着纸上的两个位置，觉得也可以试。我点了点头，让陈宇去问问那两个人。陈宇拿起手机，说先联系他们，周四晚饭以前给消息，我就把原来画的两段改成三个位置，等回复再排。
pinyin: jīn tiān tǎo lùn jié mù xiān hòu , wǒ xiān shuō xiǎng bǎ dú shū fàng qián miàn , hǎo ràng liǎng wèi yǎn zòu de péng you xiān tīng yī duàn , zài shàng qù chàng . tā men bā diǎn yǐ hòu yào zǒu , wǒ tí yì lǎng dú duǎn yī diǎn , gěi gē liú gòu shí jiān . zhǔ chí rén wèn qīng shì shéi yǐ hòu , bǎ bā diǎn xiě zài jié mù dān páng biān . yǒu rén jiàn yì kāi tóu yī shǒu , hòu miàn yī shǒu , wǒ kàn zhe zhǐ shàng de liǎng gè wèi zhì , jué de yě kě yǐ shì . wǒ diǎn le diǎn tóu , ràng chén yǔ qù wèn wèn nà liǎng gè rén . chén yǔ ná qǐ shǒu jī , shuō xiān lián xì tā men , zhōu sì wǎn fàn yǐ qián gěi xiāo xī , wǒ jiù bǎ yuán lái huà de liǎng duàn gǎi chéng sān gè wèi zhì , děng huí fù zài pái .
meaning: I suggested reading first so the two performers could hear a passage before playing. They had to leave after eight, so I proposed a short reading with enough time left for music. The host checked who they were and noted eight on the programme. One song at the start and one later was another option. I nodded for Chen Yu to ask both performers. He'd contact them and message before Thursday's dinner. I changed my two blocks to three slots while waiting for their reply.

text: 中间有个新人一直听，我本来差点问她怎么不说，后来想起自己有时也要先弄明白大家在聊什么。主持人给全场一个补充的机会，没有点她名字，她说先听。那之后她坐得明显放松些，还在纸上记了两句。沉默的人并不都需要别人马上把话递到嘴边，留一个能自己走进来的入口，有时比当众让她解释为什么不说更舒服。她散会后留下来找林安，我先走了，不知道两人后来谈了什么。
pinyin: zhōng jiān yǒu gè xīn rén yì zhí tīng , wǒ běn lái chà diǎn wèn tā zěn me bù shuō , hòu lái xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ yǒu shí yě yào xiān nòng míng bái dà jiā zài liáo shén me . zhǔ chí rén gěi quán chǎng yī gè bǔ chōng de jī huì , méi yǒu diǎn tā míng zi , tā shuō xiān tīng . nà zhī hòu tā zuò de míng xiǎn fàng sōng xiē , hái zài zhǐ shàng jì le liǎng jù . chén mò de rén bìng bù dōu xū yào bié ren mǎ shàng bǎ huà dì dào zuǐ biān , liú yī gè néng zì jǐ zǒu jìn lái de rù kǒu , yǒu shí bǐ dāng zhòng ràng tā jiě shì wèi shén me bù shuō gèng shū fú . tā sàn huì hòu liú xià lái zhǎo lín ān , wǒ xiān zǒu le , bù zhī dào liǎng rén hòu lái tán le shén me .
meaning: A newcomer listened quietly.I nearly asked why,but remembered sometimes I need to understand first.The host invited additions without naming her;she chose listening and relaxed,scribbling notes.An opening someone can choose may be more comfortable than demanding an explanation for silence.She stayed to talk to Lin An.I left and don't know their later conversation.

text: 我比较在意音量，听说要留到下次，起初觉得自己的问题又被推开了。主持人没有只说时间不够，而是明确请我把上次设备的情况发给联系人，下一次单独谈。我把发生在哪首歌、坐在哪边、声音怎样写下来，觉得比现场一口气说所有设备都不好更有用。她也没有承诺一定换新设备，只说先核对。我能接受先弄清楚再决定，不能接受没有人接着管；这次至少知道把消息发给谁。
pinyin: wǒ bǐ jiào zài yì yīn liàng , tīng shuō yào liú dào xià cì , qǐ chū jué de zì jǐ de wèn tí yòu bèi tuī kāi le . zhǔ chí rén méi yǒu zhǐ shuō shí jiān bù gòu , ér shì míng què qǐng wǒ bǎ shàng cì shè bèi de qíng kuàng fā gěi lián xì rén , xià yī cì dān dú tán . wǒ bǎ fā shēng zài nǎ shǒu gē , zuò zài nǎ biān , shēng yīn zěn yàng xiě xià lái , jué de bǐ xiàn chǎng yì kǒu qì shuō suǒ yǒu shè bèi dōu bù hǎo gèng yǒu yòng . tā yě méi yǒu chéng nuò yí dìng huàn xīn shè bèi , zhǐ shuō xiān hé duì . wǒ néng jiē shòu xiān nòng qīng chǔ zài jué dìng , bù néng jiē shòu méi yǒu rén jiē zhe guǎn ; zhè cì zhì shǎo zhī dào bǎ xiāo xī fā gěi shéi .
meaning: I cared about volume and initially felt postponed again.The host named a contact and a separate discussion.I wrote which song,where I sat and what the sound was like,more useful than condemning all equipment.She promised checking,not new equipment.I could accept checking before deciding,so long as someone owned the next step.Now I knew whom to message.

text: 最后念分工时，有人把我的下午两点以后听成上午两点，我差点笑出声。大家看了一眼日期和时间，把它写成周六下午，任务也从搬桌子改成移动四把椅子。我说这样可以，主持人才在我的名字后面画上确认。那个动作很小，却让我知道这次不需要回家以后再纠正一张已经发到群里的名单。别人不必猜我有没有在生气，我也不必用越来越硬的语气保护一个原本就没答应的早起安排。
pinyin: zuì hòu niàn fēn gōng shí , yǒu rén bǎ wǒ de xià wǔ liǎng diǎn yǐ hòu tīng chéng shàng wǔ liǎng diǎn , wǒ chà diǎn xiào chū shēng . dà jiā kàn le yī yǎn rì qī hé shí jiān , bǎ tā xiě chéng zhōu liù xià wǔ , rèn wù yě cóng bān zhuō zi gǎi chéng yí dòng sì bǎ yǐ zi . wǒ shuō zhè yàng kě yǐ , zhǔ chí rén cái zài wǒ de míng zi hòu miàn huà shàng què rèn . nà gè dòng zuò hěn xiǎo , què ràng wǒ zhī dào zhè cì bù xū yào huí jiā yǐ hòu zài jiū zhèng yī zhāng yǐ jīng fā dào qún lǐ de míng dān . bié ren bù bì cāi wǒ yǒu méi yǒu zài shēng qì , wǒ yě bù bì yòng yuè lái yuè yìng de yǔ qì bǎo hù yī gè yuán běn jiù méi dā yìng de zǎo qǐ ān pái .
meaning: At readback,someone misheard after two in the afternoon as two in the morning.We checked date and time,and changed the task to four chairs.I agreed before the host marked it confirmed.A small act saved me from correcting a published list later,and from sounding increasingly sharp to protect a morning I'd never promised.

text: 会后我给消息回了个鼓掌的表情，主持人拿上次的误会开玩笑，说这次不把掌声算成搬桌子的报名。我觉得能这样笑，说明我们已经把问题放到能处理的位置。之后我正式回复下午可以帮四把椅子，若场地周五确认不了，就先不安排。音乐顺序仍没定，下一次也可能有新问题，但我没有像上次一样只想退出。愿意再来，不是因为每个意见都照我的做，而是因为我的时间、建议和真正答应的工作，这回终于分开记了。
pinyin: huì hòu wǒ gěi xiāo xī huí le gè gǔ zhǎng de biǎo qíng , zhǔ chí rén ná shàng cì de wù huì kāi wán xiào , shuō zhè cì bù bǎ zhǎng shēng suàn chéng bān zhuō zi de bào míng . wǒ jué de néng zhè yàng xiào , shuō míng wǒ men yǐ jīng bǎ wèn tí fàng dào néng chǔ lǐ de wèi zhì . zhī hòu wǒ zhèng shì huí fù xià wǔ kě yǐ bāng sì bǎ yǐ zi , ruò chǎng dì zhōu wǔ què rèn bù le , jiù xiān bù ān pái . yīn yuè shùn xù réng méi dìng , xià yī cì yě kě néng yǒu xīn wèn tí , dàn wǒ méi yǒu xiàng shàng cì yī yàng zhǐ xiǎng tuì chū . yuàn yì zài lái , bù shì yīn wèi měi gè yì jiàn dōu zhào wǒ de zuò , ér shì yīn wèi wǒ de shí jiān , jiàn yì hé zhēn zhèng dā yìng de gōng zuò , zhè huí zhōng yú fēn kāi jì le .
meaning: I sent applause,and the host joked it wouldn't count as volunteering for tables.We could laugh because the problem was now manageable.I confirmed four chairs in the afternoon,conditional on Friday venue confirmation.The music order was still undecided.I wanted to return not because every idea went my way,but because my time,my suggestion and my actual agreed work had been recorded separately.

hòu lái xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ yǒu shí yě yào xiān nòng míng bái dà jiā zài liáo shén me . zhǔ chí rén gěi quán chǎng yī gè bǔ chōng de jī huì , méi yǒu diǎn tā míng zi , tā shuō xiān tīng . nà zhī hòu tā zuò de míng xiǎn fàng sōng xiē , hái zài zhǐ shàng jì le liǎng jù . chén mò de rén bìng bù dōu xū yào bié ren mǎ shàng bǎ huà dì dào zuǐ biān , liú yī gè néng zì jǐ zǒu jìn lái de rù kǒu , yǒu shí bǐ dāng zhòng ràng tā jiě shì wèi shén me bù shuō gèng shū fú . tā sàn huì hòu liú xià lái zhǎo lín ān , wǒ xiān zǒu le , bù zhī dào liǎng rén hòu lái tán le shén me . wǒ bǐ jiào zài yì yīn liàng , tīng shuō yào liú dào xià cì , qǐ chū jué de zì jǐ de wèn tí yòu bèi tuī kāi le . zhǔ chí rén méi yǒu zhǐ shuō shí jiān bù gòu , ér shì míng què qǐng wǒ bǎ shàng cì shè bèi de qíng kuàng fā gěi lián xì rén , xià yī cì dān dú tán . wǒ bǎ fā shēng zài nǎ shǒu gē , zuò zài nǎ biān , shēng yīn zěn yàng xiě xià lái , jué de bǐ xiàn chǎng yì kǒu qì shuō suǒ yǒu shè bèi dōu bù hǎo gèng yǒu yòng . tā yě méi yǒu chéng nuò yí dìng huàn xīn shè bèi , zhǐ shuō xiān hé duì . wǒ néng jiē shòu xiān nòng qīng chǔ zài jué dìng , bù néng jiē shòu méi yǒu rén jiē zhe guǎn ; zhè cì zhì shǎo zhī dào bǎ xiāo xī fā gěi shéi . zuì hòu niàn fēn gōng shí , yǒu rén bǎ wǒ de xià wǔ liǎng diǎn yǐ hòu tīng chéng shàng wǔ liǎng diǎn , wǒ chà diǎn xiào chū shēng . dà jiā kàn le yī yǎn rì qī hé shí jiān , bǎ tā xiě chéng zhōu liù xià wǔ , rèn wù yě cóng bān zhuō zi gǎi chéng yí dòng sì bǎ yǐ zi . wǒ shuō zhè yàng kě yǐ , zhǔ chí rén cái zài wǒ de míng zi hòu miàn huà shàng què rèn . nà gè dòng zuò hěn xiǎo , què ràng wǒ zhī dào zhè cì bù xū yào huí jiā yǐ hòu zài jiū zhèng yī zhāng yǐ jīng fā dào qún lǐ de míng dān . bié ren bù bì cāi wǒ yǒu méi yǒu zài shēng qì , wǒ yě bù bì yòng yuè lái yuè yìng de yǔ qì bǎo hù yī gè yuán běn jiù méi dā yìng de zǎo qǐ ān pái . huì hòu wǒ gěi xiāo xī huí le gè gǔ zhǎng de biǎo qíng , zhǔ chí rén ná shàng cì de wù huì kāi wán xiào , shuō zhè cì bù bǎ zhǎng shēng suàn chéng bān zhuō zi de bào míng . wǒ jué de néng zhè yàng xiào , shuō míng wǒ men yǐ jīng bǎ wèn tí fàng dào néng chǔ lǐ de wèi zhì . zhī hòu wǒ zhèng shì huí fù xià wǔ kě yǐ bāng sì bǎ yǐ zi , ruò chǎng dì zhōu wǔ què rèn bù le , jiù xiān bù ān pái . yīn yuè shùn xù réng méi dìng , xià yī cì yě kě néng yǒu xīn wèn tí , dàn wǒ méi yǒu xiàng shàng cì yī yàng zhǐ xiǎng tuì chū . yuàn yì zài lái , bù shì yīn wèi měi gè yì jiàn dōu zhào wǒ de zuò , ér shì yīn wèi wǒ de shí jiān , jiàn yì hé zhēn zhèng dā yìng de gōng zuò , zhè huí zhōng yú fēn kāi jì le .
meaning: I hesitated about today's meeting because a suggestion last time had become an early Saturday moving duty.The host apologised and corrected it,but I still remembered that list.Lin An said duties would now be read back.I went,and first messaged that Saturday morning didn't work;after two might,depending on the task. I suggested reading first so the two performers could hear a passage before playing. They had to leave after eight, so I proposed a short reading with enough time left for music. The host checked who they were and noted eight on the programme. One song at the start and one later was another option. I nodded for Chen Yu to ask both performers. He'd contact them and message before Thursday's dinner. I changed my two blocks to three slots while waiting for their reply. A newcomer listened quietly.I nearly asked why,but remembered sometimes I need to understand first.The host invited additions without naming her;she chose listening and relaxed,scribbling notes.An opening someone can choose may be more comfortable than demanding an explanation for silence.She stayed to talk to Lin An.I left and don't know their later conversation. I cared about volume and initially felt postponed again.The host named a contact and a separate discussion.I wrote which song,where I sat and what the sound was like,more useful than condemning all equipment.She promised checking,not new equipment.I could accept checking before deciding,so long as someone owned the next step.Now I knew whom to message. At readback,someone misheard after two in the afternoon as two in the morning.We checked date and time,and changed the task to four chairs.I agreed before the host marked it confirmed.A small act saved me from correcting a published list later,and from sounding increasingly sharp to protect a morning I'd never promised. I sent applause,and the host joked it wouldn't count as volunteering for tables.We could laugh because the problem was now manageable.I confirmed four chairs in the afternoon,conditional on Friday venue confirmation.The music order was still undecided.I wanted to return not because every idea went my way,but because my time,my suggestion and my actual agreed work had been recorded separately.

parts.text: 我原本不想去今天的讨论，因为上次只是帮忙提了一句建议，最后就被安排周六一早去搬东西。后来主持人道歉，改掉名单，我知道她不是故意的，可下一次听到要开会，还是先想起那张纸。林安跟我说这回散会前会念确认过的分工，没答应的事情不会直接加进去。我才决定去看看，而且先在群里留言，周六上午不便参加，下午两点以后可以考虑，具体要做什么再问我。
今天讨论节目先后，我先说想把读书放前面，好让两位演奏的朋友先听一段，再上去唱。他们八点以后要走，我提议朗读短一点，给歌留够时间。主持人问清是谁以后，把八点写在节目单旁边。有人建议开头一首、后面一首，我看着纸上的两个位置，觉得也可以试。我点了点头，让陈宇去问问那两个人。陈宇拿起手机，说先联系他们，周四晚饭以前给消息，我就把原来画的两段改成三个位置，等回复再排。
中间有个新人一直听，我本来差点问她怎么不说，后来想起自己有时也要先弄明白大家在聊什么。主持人给全场一个补充的机会，没有点她名字，她说先听。那之后她坐得明显放松些，还在纸上记了两句。沉默的人并不都需要别人马上把话递到嘴边，留一个能自己走进来的入口，有时比当众让她解释为什么不说更舒服。她散会后留下来找林安，我先走了，不知道两人后来谈了什么。
我比较在意音量，听说要留到下次，起初觉得自己的问题又被推开了。主持人没有只说时间不够，而是明确请我把上次设备的情况发给联系人，下一次单独谈。我把发生在哪首歌、坐在哪边、声音怎样写下来，觉得比现场一口气说所有设备都不好更有用。她也没有承诺一定换新设备，只说先核对。我能接受先弄清楚再决定，不能接受没有人接着管；这次至少知道把消息发给谁。
最后念分工时，有人把我的下午两点以后听成上午两点，我差点笑出声。大家看了一眼日期和时间，把它写成周六下午，任务也从搬桌子改成移动四把椅子。我说这样可以，主持人才在我的名字后面画上确认。那个动作很小，却让我知道这次不需要回家以后再纠正一张已经发到群里的名单。别人不必猜我有没有在生气，我也不必用越来越硬的语气保护一个原本就没答应的早起安排。
会后我给消息回了个鼓掌的表情，主持人拿上次的误会开玩笑，说这次不把掌声算成搬桌子的报名。我觉得能这样笑，说明我们已经把问题放到能处理的位置。之后我正式回复下午可以帮四把椅子，若场地周五确认不了，就先不安排。音乐顺序仍没定，下一次也可能有新问题，但我没有像上次一样只想退出。愿意再来，不是因为每个意见都照我的做，而是因为我的时间、建议和真正答应的工作，这回终于分开记了。

text: 等会儿到底多久？

text: 车刚到，十分钟左右。

text: 行，我进去坐，不站通道里了。

text: 好，来得及的话，结尾也给你讲。

text: 演出散场，我站在门边给林安打电话。她那边有车经过，后面几个人一边走一边笑。我问她在哪，她说车还没到，先别等我，你们进去。我只抓住别等两个字，马上问不去了。她提高声音说不是不去，晚点到。我让她把后半句再说一遍，这回总算听清。陈宇已经走到店门口，回头问我还等不等，我说我们先进去，她等到车就发消息。我拿起包，赶紧跟上他。
pinyin: yǎn chū sàn chǎng , wǒ zhàn zài mén biān gěi lín ān dǎ diàn huà . tā nà biān yǒu chē jīng guò , hòu miàn jǐ gè rén yī biān zǒu yī biān xiào . wǒ wèn tā zài nǎ , tā shuō chē hái méi dào , xiān bié děng wǒ , nǐ men jìn qù . wǒ zhǐ zhuā zhù bié děng liǎng gè zì , mǎ shàng wèn bù qù le . tā tí gāo shēng yīn shuō bù shì bù qù , wǎn diǎn dào . wǒ ràng tā bǎ hòu bàn jù zài shuō yī biàn , zhè huí zǒng suàn tīng qīng . chén yǔ yǐ jīng zǒu dào diàn mén kǒu , huí tóu wèn wǒ hái děng bù děng , wǒ shuō wǒ men xiān jìn qù , tā děng dào chē jiù fā xiāo xī . wǒ ná qǐ bāo , gǎn jǐn gēn shàng tā .
meaning: After the show I called Lin An from the doorway. Traffic passed at her end while people behind me laughed on their way out. Her bus hadn't arrived; we should go inside without waiting. Catching only 'don't wait,' I asked if she wasn't coming. She raised her voice: she was coming, just later. I asked her to repeat the second half and finally heard it. Chen Yu, already at the shop door, asked whether we were still waiting. We'd go in; she'd message when the bus came. I picked up my bag and hurried after him.

text: 我们约的地方换过一次，上回在桥那边，这次是电影院旁边的红门小店。我刚才只发了红门，她问哪一个，我才想起附近还有另一家。陈宇把店里的菜单递给我，我照着上面的店名补发过去，又拍了一张门口照片。她说自己还记着上次过桥的路，我赶紧回不用过桥，沿着小路到电影院旁边。消息发完，服务员问我们几个人，我伸出三根手指，说还有一个在路上，先给我们找个里面的位置。
pinyin: wǒ men yuē de dì fāng huàn guò yī cì , shàng huí zài qiáo nà biān , zhè cì shì diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān de hóng mén xiǎo diàn . wǒ gāng cái zhǐ fā le hóng mén , tā wèn nǎ yī gè , wǒ cái xiǎng qǐ fù jìn hái yǒu lìng yī jiā . chén yǔ bǎ diàn lǐ de cài dān dì gěi wǒ , wǒ zhào zhe shàng miàn de diàn míng bǔ fā guò qù , yòu pāi le yī zhāng mén kǒu zhào piān . tā shuō zì jǐ hái jì zhe shàng cì guò qiáo de lù , wǒ gǎn jǐn huí bù yòng guò qiáo , yán zhe xiǎo lù dào diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān . xiāo xī fā wán , fú wù yuán wèn wǒ men jǐ gè rén , wǒ shēn chū sān gēn shǒu zhǐ , shuō hái yǒu yī gè zài lù shàng , xiān gěi wǒ men zhǎo gè lǐ miàn de wèi zhì .
meaning: We'd changed venues: last time beyond the bridge, this time the red-door shop beside the cinema. I'd only texted 'red door.' When she asked which one, I remembered the other nearby shop. Chen Yu handed me the menu so I could send the name and a doorway photo. She still remembered crossing the bridge; I replied that she should follow the path beside the cinema without crossing it. A server asked how many of us there were. Three, I said, with one still on the way; could we sit further inside?

text: 进店以后我又问要不要替她点吃的。她说先别点，路上可能吃一点。我重复了一遍先别点，她又补充水可以先拿。陈宇在旁边把菜单翻回来，问那她到了再看吧。我说对，先别替她选。她听见了，笑着问你们已经帮我想了多少菜，我说还没有，只是快把你的水也一起取消了。陈宇拿了三个杯子，我把她那杯放在空椅子前面。
pinyin: jìn diàn yǐ hòu wǒ yòu wèn yào bù yào tì tā diǎn chī de . tā shuō xiān bié diǎn , lù shàng kě néng chī yī diǎn . wǒ chóng fù le yī biàn xiān bié diǎn , tā yòu bǔ chōng shuǐ kě yǐ xiān ná . chén yǔ zài páng biān bǎ cài dān fān huí lái , wèn nà tā dào le zài kàn ba . wǒ shuō duì , xiān bié tì tā xuǎn . tā tīng jiàn le , xiào zhe wèn nǐ men yǐ jīng bāng wǒ xiǎng le duō shao cài , wǒ shuō hái méi yǒu , zhǐ shì kuài bǎ nǐ de shuǐ yě yì qǐ qǔ xiāo le . chén yǔ ná le sān gè bēi zi , wǒ bǎ tā nà bēi fàng zài kōng yǐ zi qián miàn .
meaning: Inside I asked about ordering food for her. Not yet—she might eat on the way, but water was fine. Chen turned the menu back: let her choose on arrival? Yes. Hearing us, she laughed and asked how many dishes we'd planned for her. None; we'd almost cancelled her water too. Chen fetched three cups, and I set hers before the empty chair.

text: 她上车后发语音，说十分钟左右到，后面还有一句别站通道里等。我当时正在找座位，耳机里只听到十分钟，就把手机放下了。过一会儿想到外面有人进出，重听一次才听见后半句。她到时我已经坐好，给她指旁边的位置。她问你没真守着门吧，我说没有，现在也不需要让大家绕过我走。她笑得很大声，服务员看过来，我们就把声音放低，先让她喝水。
pinyin: tā shàng chē hòu fā yǔ yīn , shuō shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu dào , hòu miàn hái yǒu yī jù bié zhàn tōng dào lǐ děng . wǒ dāng shí zhèng zài zhǎo zuò wèi , ěr jī lǐ zhǐ tīng dào shí fēn zhōng , jiù bǎ shǒu jī fàng xià le . guò yī huì er xiǎng dào wài miàn yǒu rén jìn chū , zhòng tīng yī cì cái tīng jiàn hòu bàn jù . tā dào shí wǒ yǐ jīng zuò hǎo , gěi tā zhǐ páng biān de wèi zhì . tā wèn nǐ méi zhēn shǒu zhe mén ba , wǒ shuō méi yǒu , xiàn zài yě bù xū yào ràng dà jiā rào guò wǒ zǒu . tā xiào de hěn dà shēng , fú wù yuán kàn guò lái , wǒ men jiù bǎ shēng yīn fàng dī , xiān ràng tā hē shuǐ .
meaning: On the bus,she said around ten minutes and not to wait in the passage.While finding a seat,I initially caught only the time.A replay supplied the rest.I was seated when she arrived,and pointed to a place.She joked whether I'd guarded the door.I said people no longer needed to go round me.We lowered our laughter when a server looked over and let her drink.

text: 聊演出时，她说另一场结尾不是不好，是她没听懂。我只听到不好，刚要说那就别推荐了，又停下来问后面是什么。她把话说完，问主角为什么把信留在桌上。我拿出节目单，指着人物名字问是不是姐姐，她摇头，说是后来回家的妹妹。陈宇在旁边问哪场戏，我们两个一起翻那张纸，才发现谁也没记下写信的人。她说下次见小周问问，他那天从头看到尾，也许还记得。
pinyin: liáo yǎn chū shí , tā shuō lìng yī chǎng jié wěi bù shì bù hǎo , shì tā méi tīng dǒng . wǒ zhǐ tīng dào bù hǎo , gāng yào shuō nà jiù bié tuī jiàn le , yòu tíng xià lái wèn hòu miàn shì shén me . tā bǎ huà shuō wán , wèn zhǔ jué wèi shén me bǎ xìn liú zài zhuō shàng . wǒ ná chū jié mù dān , zhǐ zhe rén wù míng zi wèn shì bú shì jiě jie , tā yáo tóu , shuō shì hòu lái huí jiā de mèi mei . chén yǔ zài páng biān wèn nǎ chǎng xì , wǒ men liǎng gè yì qǐ fān nà zhāng zhǐ , cái fā xiàn shéi yě méi jì xià xiě xìn de rén . tā shuō xià cì jiàn xiǎo zhōu wèn wèn , tā nà tiān cóng tóu kàn dào wěi , yě xǔ hái jì de .
meaning: Discussing another show, she said the ending wasn't bad; she hadn't understood it. I caught 'bad' and nearly said not to recommend it, then asked for the rest. She wanted to know why the lead left the letter on the table. Was it the elder sister? No, the younger one who came home later. Chen Yu asked which scene. Checking the programme together, we realised neither of us had noted who wrote the letter. We'd ask Xiao Zhou, who'd watched the whole show and might remember.

text: 原来她说的妹妹和我记得的姐姐，都穿过同一件外套。我还指着窗边那一场，她已经说到妹妹回家以后了。陈宇笑着问这件衣服到底借过几次，我说先别管衣服，把回家那场再讲一遍。林安从进门说起，讲到把信放下，我终于接上自己看过的那一段。她问这回知道是谁了吧，我说知道，妹妹。她把节目单推回来，让我在名字旁边画个圈，省得下一次又从外套猜起。
pinyin: yuán lái tā shuō de mèi mei hé wǒ jì de de jiě jie , dōu chuān guò tóng yī jiàn wài tào . wǒ hái zhǐ zhe chuāng biān nà yī chǎng , tā yǐ jīng shuō dào mèi mei huí jiā yǐ hòu le . chén yǔ xiào zhe wèn zhè jiàn yī fú dào dǐ jiè guò jǐ cì , wǒ shuō xiān bié guǎn yī fú , bǎ huí jiā nà chǎng zài jiǎng yī biàn . lín ān cóng jìn mén shuō qǐ , jiǎng dào bǎ xìn fàng xià , wǒ zhōng yú jiē shàng zì jǐ kàn guò de nà yī duàn . tā wèn zhè huí zhī dào shì shéi le ba , wǒ shuō zhī dào , mèi mei . tā bǎ jié mù dān tuī huí lái , ràng wǒ zài míng zi páng biān huà gè quān , shěng de xià yī cì yòu cóng wài tào cāi qǐ .
meaning: The younger sister she meant and the elder one I remembered had worn the same coat. I was still thinking of the window scene; she'd moved on to the younger sister coming home. How often had that coat been borrowed? Chen Yu laughed. Forget the coat for now—tell the homecoming scene again. From the entrance to putting down the letter, I finally connected it to what I'd seen. The younger sister, then? Yes. She pushed the programme back and had me circle the name so I wouldn't start with the coat again next time.

text: 回家路上，我把她的几条语音又听了一遍。店里的笑声录得特别清楚，先别点后面那句水可以先拿反而不大听得见。我把耳机戴好，再听一次才接上。她最后发文字，说下次店名写全，别只发门的颜色。我回好，又想起刚才妹妹和姐姐的外套，把节目单从包里拿出来看了一眼。陈宇发来明天吃饭的时间，我读完才发现又换了店，赶紧问他店名和地址，先别只告诉我门长什么样。
pinyin: huí jiā lù shàng , wǒ bǎ tā de jǐ tiáo yǔ yīn yòu tīng le yī biàn . diàn lǐ de xiào shēng lù de tè bié qīng chǔ , xiān bié diǎn hòu miàn nà jù shuǐ kě yǐ xiān ná fǎn ér bù dà tīng de jiàn . wǒ bǎ ěr jī dài hǎo , zài tīng yī cì cái jiē shàng . tā zuì hòu fā wén zì , shuō xià cì diàn míng xiě quán , bié zhǐ fā mén de yán sè . wǒ huí hǎo , yòu xiǎng qǐ gāng cái mèi mei hé jiě jie de wài tào , bǎ jié mù dān cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lái kàn le yī yǎn . chén yǔ fā lái míng tiān chī fàn de shí jiān , wǒ dú wán cái fā xiàn yòu huàn le diàn , gǎn jǐn wèn tā diàn míng hé dì zhǐ , xiān bié zhǐ gào sù wǒ mén zhǎng shén me yàng .
meaning: On the way home I replayed her messages. The laughter had recorded clearly, but 'water is fine' after 'don't order yet' was hard to hear. With my earphones properly in, I caught it on another listen. Her final text asked for the full shop name next time, rather than the door's colour. I agreed, then checked the programme again, remembering the sisters' coat. Chen Yu sent tomorrow's meal time, at yet another shop. I asked for its name and address before he could tell me only what the door looked like.

meaning: After the show I called Lin An from the doorway. Traffic passed at her end while people behind me laughed on their way out. Her bus hadn't arrived; we should go inside without waiting. Catching only 'don't wait,' I asked if she wasn't coming. She raised her voice: she was coming, just later. I asked her to repeat the second half and finally heard it. Chen Yu, already at the shop door, asked whether we were still waiting. We'd go in; she'd message when the bus came. I picked up my bag and hurried after him. We'd changed venues: last time beyond the bridge, this time the red-door shop beside the cinema. I'd only texted 'red door.' When she asked which one, I remembered the other nearby shop. Chen Yu handed me the menu so I could send the name and a doorway photo. She still remembered crossing the bridge; I replied that she should follow the path beside the cinema without crossing it. A server asked how many of us there were. Three, I said, with one still on the way; could we sit further inside? Inside I asked about ordering food for her. Not yet—she might eat on the way, but water was fine. Chen turned the menu back: let her choose on arrival? Yes. Hearing us, she laughed and asked how many dishes we'd planned for her. None; we'd almost cancelled her water too. Chen fetched three cups, and I set hers before the empty chair. On the bus,she said around ten minutes and not to wait in the passage.While finding a seat,I initially caught only the time.A replay supplied the rest.I was seated when she arrived,and pointed to a place.She joked whether I'd guarded the door.I said people no longer needed to go round me.We lowered our laughter when a server looked over and let her drink. Discussing another show, she said the ending wasn't bad; she hadn't understood it. I caught 'bad' and nearly said not to recommend it, then asked for the rest. She wanted to know why the lead left the letter on the table. Was it the elder sister? No, the younger one who came home later. Chen Yu asked which scene. Checking the programme together, we realised neither of us had noted who wrote the letter. We'd ask Xiao Zhou, who'd watched the whole show and might remember. The younger sister she meant and the elder one I remembered had worn the same coat. I was still thinking of the window scene; she'd moved on to the younger sister coming home. How often had that coat been borrowed? Chen Yu laughed. Forget the coat for now—tell the homecoming scene again. From the entrance to putting down the letter, I finally connected it to what I'd seen. The younger sister, then? Yes. She pushed the programme back and had me circle the name so I wouldn't start with the coat again next time. On the way home I replayed her messages. The laughter had recorded clearly, but 'water is fine' after 'don't order yet' was hard to hear. With my earphones properly in, I caught it on another listen. Her final text asked for the full shop name next time, rather than the door's colour. I agreed, then checked the programme again, remembering the sisters' coat. Chen Yu sent tomorrow's meal time, at yet another shop. I asked for its name and address before he could tell me only what the door looked like.

parts.text: 演出散场，我站在门边给林安打电话。她那边有车经过，后面几个人一边走一边笑。我问她在哪，她说车还没到，先别等我，你们进去。我只抓住别等两个字，马上问不去了。她提高声音说不是不去，晚点到。我让她把后半句再说一遍，这回总算听清。陈宇已经走到店门口，回头问我还等不等，我说我们先进去，她等到车就发消息。我拿起包，赶紧跟上他。
我们约的地方换过一次，上回在桥那边，这次是电影院旁边的红门小店。我刚才只发了红门，她问哪一个，我才想起附近还有另一家。陈宇把店里的菜单递给我，我照着上面的店名补发过去，又拍了一张门口照片。她说自己还记着上次过桥的路，我赶紧回不用过桥，沿着小路到电影院旁边。消息发完，服务员问我们几个人，我伸出三根手指，说还有一个在路上，先给我们找个里面的位置。
进店以后我又问要不要替她点吃的。她说先别点，路上可能吃一点。我重复了一遍先别点，她又补充水可以先拿。陈宇在旁边把菜单翻回来，问那她到了再看吧。我说对，先别替她选。她听见了，笑着问你们已经帮我想了多少菜，我说还没有，只是快把你的水也一起取消了。陈宇拿了三个杯子，我把她那杯放在空椅子前面。
她上车后发语音，说十分钟左右到，后面还有一句别站通道里等。我当时正在找座位，耳机里只听到十分钟，就把手机放下了。过一会儿想到外面有人进出，重听一次才听见后半句。她到时我已经坐好，给她指旁边的位置。她问你没真守着门吧，我说没有，现在也不需要让大家绕过我走。她笑得很大声，服务员看过来，我们就把声音放低，先让她喝水。
聊演出时，她说另一场结尾不是不好，是她没听懂。我只听到不好，刚要说那就别推荐了，又停下来问后面是什么。她把话说完，问主角为什么把信留在桌上。我拿出节目单，指着人物名字问是不是姐姐，她摇头，说是后来回家的妹妹。陈宇在旁边问哪场戏，我们两个一起翻那张纸，才发现谁也没记下写信的人。她说下次见小周问问，他那天从头看到尾，也许还记得。
原来她说的妹妹和我记得的姐姐，都穿过同一件外套。我还指着窗边那一场，她已经说到妹妹回家以后了。陈宇笑着问这件衣服到底借过几次，我说先别管衣服，把回家那场再讲一遍。林安从进门说起，讲到把信放下，我终于接上自己看过的那一段。她问这回知道是谁了吧，我说知道，妹妹。她把节目单推回来，让我在名字旁边画个圈，省得下一次又从外套猜起。
回家路上，我把她的几条语音又听了一遍。店里的笑声录得特别清楚，先别点后面那句水可以先拿反而不大听得见。我把耳机戴好，再听一次才接上。她最后发文字，说下次店名写全，别只发门的颜色。我回好，又想起刚才妹妹和姐姐的外套，把节目单从包里拿出来看了一眼。陈宇发来明天吃饭的时间，我读完才发现又换了店，赶紧问他店名和地址，先别只告诉我门长什么样。

text: 这结尾不是不好，是我没听懂。
pinyin: zhè jié wěi bù shì bù hǎo , shì wǒ méi tīng dǒng .
meaning: It's not that the ending's bad—I didn't understand it.

text: 我还以为你说不好。
pinyin: wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ shuō bù hǎo .
meaning: I thought you said it was bad.

text: 后半句呢？
pinyin: hòu bàn jù ne ?
meaning: What about the second half?

text: 被门外的声音盖住了。
pinyin: bèi mén wài de shēng yīn gài zhù le .
meaning: Noise outside drowned it out.

text: 那先问我，不用替我写影评。
pinyin: nà xiān wèn wǒ , bù yòng tì wǒ xiě yǐng píng .
meaning: Then ask me first;don't write my review for me.

text: 你再说一遍？
pinyin: nǐ zài shuō yī biàn ?
meaning: Could you say it again?

text: 现在听全了。
pinyin: xiàn zài tīng quán le .
meaning: Now I've heard it all.

text: 想听我哪里没懂吗？
pinyin: xiǎng tīng wǒ nǎ lǐ méi dǒng ma ?
meaning: Want to hear what I didn't understand?

text: 想，但先去安静一点的地方。
pinyin: xiǎng , dàn xiān qù ān jìng yī diǎn de dì fāng .
meaning: Yes,but somewhere quieter first.

text: 这句你倒听得挺快。
pinyin: zhè jù nǐ dào tīng de tǐng kuài .
meaning: You caught that one quickly.

text: 因为我也想听清。
pinyin: yīn wèi wǒ yě xiǎng tīng qīng .
meaning: Because I want to hear properly too.

text: 待会儿再回你消息。

text: 他今晚能不能来，很难说。

text: 说实话，结尾有一点难。

text: 这件事先算了，下次再问。

text: 有问题你只管问。
pinyin: yǒu wèn tí nǐ zhǐ guǎn wèn .

text: 她只顾找卡，忘了拿包。
pinyin: tā zhǐ gù zhǎo kǎ , wàng le ná bāo .
meaning: She was so busy finding her card she forgot her bag.

text: 雨太大，只得先留下。
pinyin: yǔ tài dà , zhǐ dé xiān liú xià .
meaning: The heavy rain leaves us no choice but to stay for now.

text: 再说，你也还没吃饭。
pinyin: zài shuō , nǐ yě hái méi chī fàn .
meaning: Besides,you haven't eaten yet.

text: 就是说，先别替我点？
pinyin: jiù shì shuō , xiān bié tì wǒ diǎn ?
meaning: So don't order for me yet?

text: 她不再用那张旧节目单。
pinyin: tā bù zài yòng nà zhāng jiù jié mù dān .
meaning: She no longer uses that old programme.

text: 他前来问活动时间。
pinyin: tā qián lái wèn huó dòng shí jiān .
meaning: He came to ask the event time.

text: 她路过车站时给我发消息。
pinyin: tā lù guò chē zhàn shí gěi wǒ fā xiāo xī .
meaning: She messaged while passing the station.

text: 那张椅子挨着窗。
pinyin: nà zhāng yǐ zi āi zhe chuāng .
meaning: That chair is next to the window.

text: 前方有一家还开着的店。
pinyin: qián fāng yǒu yī jiā hái kāi zhe de diàn .
meaning: There's a shop still open ahead.

text: 这条通道通向小厅。
pinyin: zhè tiáo tōng dào tōng xiàng xiǎo tīng .
meaning: This passage leads to the small room.

text: 楼上传来搬桌子的响声。
pinyin: lóu shàng chuán lái bān zhuō zi de xiǎng shēng .
meaning: The noise of moving a table came from upstairs.

text: 门外有一阵笑声。
pinyin: mén wài yǒu yī zhèn xiào shēng .
meaning: Laughter came from outside.

text: 把音量调小一点。
pinyin: bǎ yīn liàng diào xiǎo yī diǎn .
meaning: Turn the volume down a little.

text: 她通话结束后才进来。
pinyin: tā tōng huà jié shù hòu cái jìn lái .
meaning: She came in after finishing her call.

text: 他留言说改到门口见。
pinyin: tā liú yán shuō gǎi dào mén kǒu jiàn .
meaning: He left a message changing the meeting to the entrance.

text: 他回应了关于票的问题。
pinyin: tā huí yìng le guān yú piào de wèn tí .
meaning: He answered the ticket question.

text: 电话打断了那句话。
pinyin: diàn huà dǎ duàn le nà jù huà .
meaning: The call interrupted the sentence.

text: 这两种语气要区分。
pinyin: zhè liǎng zhǒng yǔ qì yào qū fēn .
meaning: Distinguish these two tones.

text: 此处是活动入口。
pinyin: cǐ chù shì huó dòng rù kǒu .
meaning: This is the event entrance.

text: 当天的节目临时调整了。
pinyin: dàng tiān de jié mù lín shí tiáo zhěng le .
meaning: That day's programme changed at short notice.

text: 此前一直在小厅见面。
pinyin: cǐ qián yì zhí zài xiǎo tīng jiàn miàn .
meaning: Before this,we always met in the small room.

text: 她事后才知道时间改了。
pinyin: tā shì hòu cái zhī dào shí jiān gǎi le .
meaning: Only afterwards did she learn the time changed.

text: 消息从群里传出去了。
pinyin: xiāo xī cóng qún lǐ chuán chū qù le .
meaning: The news spread beyond the group.

text: 别忽略最后一句。
pinyin: bié hū lüè zuì hòu yī jù .
meaning: Don't overlook the final sentence.

text: 我很喜欢这个结尾。
pinyin: wǒ hěn xǐ huān zhè gè jié wěi .
meaning: I like this ending very much.

text: 能否留座位，先问工作人员。
pinyin: néng fǒu liú zuò wèi , xiān wèn gōng zuò rén yuán .
meaning: Ask staff whether saving a seat is possible.

text: 我待会儿到，你们先进去。待会儿再回你消息。这场什么时候散，很难说。他今晚能不能来，很难说。说实话，我刚才没听清。说实话，结尾有一点难。买不到就算了，我们先进去。这件事先算了，下次再问。你只管先坐下，我去拿水。有问题你只管问。我只顾看路，没听见后半句。她只顾找卡，忘了拿包。那班车已经走了，我只得等下一班。雨太大，只得先留下。先看完，结尾出去再说。再说，你也还没吃饭。就是说，你会来，只是晚一点。就是说，先别替我点？他不再等上一班车了。她不再用那张旧节目单。她前来取票，没留下看演出。他前来问活动时间。我路过门口，听到你说算了。她路过车站时给我发消息。我坐在挨着门的位置。那张椅子挨着窗。沿着小路走到红门。他们沿着河边走。前方那辆不是我们等的车。前方有一家还开着的店。别站在通道里等消息。这条通道通向小厅。响声把后半句盖住了。楼上传来搬桌子的响声。笑声过后她又补了一句。门外有一阵笑声。音量太大，我没听清。把音量调小一点。这里太吵，不便通话。她通话结束后才进来。先留言，我出去再听。他留言说改到门口见。她回应说不是不去。他回应了关于票的问题。我打断一下，你刚才说先别等？电话打断了那句话。把先别等和不会来区分开。这两种语气要区分。此处不能停留，请到门外等。此处是活动入口。当天我们在红门见，不在车站。当天的节目临时调整了。此前我以为她不来了。此前一直在小厅见面。事后重听，才听出不是不去。她事后才知道时间改了。小厅里传出音乐声。消息从群里传出去了。我忽略了那个先字。别忽略最后一句。这次我很想去，只是要晚到。我很喜欢这个结尾。我想问能否晚一点进场。能否留座位，先问工作人员。
pinyin: wǒ dāi huìr dào , nǐ men xiān jìn qù . dāi huìr zài huí nǐ xiāo xī . zhè chǎng shén me shí hou sàn , hěn nán shuō . tā jīn wǎn néng bù néng lái , hěn nán shuō . shuō shí huà , wǒ gāng cái méi tīng qīng . shuō shí huà , jié wěi yǒu yī diǎn nán . mǎi bù dào jiù suàn le , wǒ men xiān jìn qù . zhè jiàn shì xiān suàn le , xià cì zài wèn . nǐ zhǐ guǎn xiān zuò xià , wǒ qù ná shuǐ . yǒu wèn tí nǐ zhǐ guǎn wèn . wǒ zhǐ gù kàn lù , méi tīng jiàn hòu bàn jù . tā zhǐ gù zhǎo kǎ , wàng le ná bāo . nà bān chē yǐ jīng zǒu le , wǒ zhǐ dé děng xià yī bān . yǔ tài dà , zhǐ dé xiān liú xià . xiān kàn wán , jié wěi chū qù zài shuō . zài shuō , nǐ yě hái méi chī fàn . jiù shì shuō , nǐ huì lái , zhǐ shì wǎn yī diǎn . jiù shì shuō , xiān bié tì wǒ diǎn ? tā bù zài děng shàng yī bān chē le . tā bù zài yòng nà zhāng jiù jié mù dān . tā qián lái qǔ piào , méi liú xià kàn yǎn chū . tā qián lái wèn huó dòng shí jiān . wǒ lù guò mén kǒu , tīng dào nǐ shuō suàn le . tā lù guò chē zhàn shí gěi wǒ fā xiāo xī . wǒ zuò zài āi zhe mén de wèi zhì . nà zhāng yǐ zi āi zhe chuāng . yán zhe xiǎo lù zǒu dào hóng mén . tā men yán zhe hé biān zǒu . qián fāng nà liàng bù shì wǒ men děng de chē . qián fāng yǒu yī jiā hái kāi zhe de diàn . bié zhàn zài tōng dào lǐ děng xiāo xī . zhè tiáo tōng dào tōng xiàng xiǎo tīng . xiǎng shēng bǎ hòu bàn jù gài zhù le . lóu shàng chuán lái bān zhuō zi de xiǎng shēng . xiào shēng guò hòu tā yòu bǔ le yī jù . mén wài yǒu yī zhèn xiào shēng . yīn liàng tài dà , wǒ méi tīng qīng . bǎ yīn liàng diào xiǎo yī diǎn . zhè lǐ tài chǎo , bù biàn tōng huà . tā tōng huà jié shù hòu cái jìn lái . xiān liú yán , wǒ chū qù zài tīng . tā liú yán shuō gǎi dào mén kǒu jiàn . tā huí yìng shuō bù shì bù qù . tā huí yìng le guān yú piào de wèn tí . wǒ dǎ duàn yī xià , nǐ gāng cái shuō xiān bié děng ? diàn huà dǎ duàn le nà jù huà . bǎ xiān bié děng hé bù huì lái qū fēn kāi . zhè liǎng zhǒng yǔ qì yào qū fēn . cǐ chù bù néng tíng liú , qǐng dào mén wài děng . cǐ chù shì huó dòng rù kǒu . dàng tiān wǒ men zài hóng mén jiàn , bù zài chē zhàn . dàng tiān de jié mù lín shí tiáo zhěng le . cǐ qián wǒ yǐ wéi tā bù lái le . cǐ qián yì zhí zài xiǎo tīng jiàn miàn . shì hòu zhòng tīng , cái tīng chū bù shì bù qù . tā shì hòu cái zhī dào shí jiān gǎi le . xiǎo tīng lǐ chuán chū yīn yuè shēng . xiāo xī cóng qún lǐ chuán chū qù le . wǒ hū lüè le nà gè xiān zì . bié hū lüè zuì hòu yī jù . zhè cì wǒ hěn xiǎng qù , zhǐ shì yào wǎn dào . wǒ hěn xǐ huān zhè gè jié wěi . wǒ xiǎng wèn néng fǒu wǎn yī diǎn jìn chǎng . néng fǒu liú zuò wèi , xiān wèn gōng zuò rén yuán .
meaning: I'll arrive shortly;go in first. I'll reply in a little while. It's hard to say when this show will finish. It's hard to say whether he can come tonight. Honestly,I didn't catch that. Honestly,the ending is a little difficult. If we can't get it,never mind;let's go in. Let this go for now;ask next time. Go ahead and sit;I'll get water. Just ask if you have questions. I was concentrating on the route and missed the second half. She was so busy finding her card she forgot her bag. That bus has left,so I have to wait for the next. The heavy rain leaves us no choice but to stay for now. Finish watching;discuss the ending outside. Besides,you haven't eaten yet. So you'll come,just a little later. So don't order for me yet? He's no longer waiting for the previous bus. She no longer uses that old programme. She came to collect tickets without staying for the show. He came to ask the event time. I passed the entrance and heard you say never mind. She messaged while passing the station. I sit beside the door. That chair is next to the window. Follow the path to the red door. They walk along the riverbank. The bus ahead isn't the one we're waiting for. There's a shop still open ahead. Don't wait for messages in the passage. This passage leads to the small room. The noise drowned out the second half. The noise of moving a table came from upstairs. After the laughter,she added another sentence. Laughter came from outside. The volume was too loud for me to catch it. Turn the volume down a little. It's too noisy here for a call. She came in after finishing her call. Leave a message;I'll listen outside. He left a message changing the meeting to the entrance. She replied that it wasn't a refusal to go. He answered the ticket question. Let me interrupt—did you say don't wait for now? The call interrupted the sentence. Distinguish don't wait for now from won't come. Distinguish these two tones. No waiting here;please wait outside. This is the event entrance. That day we met at the red door,not the station. That day's programme changed at short notice. Before this,I thought she wasn't coming. Before this,we always met in the small room. Listening again afterwards,I caught wasn't refusing to go. Only afterwards did she learn the time changed. Music came from the small room. The news spread beyond the group. I overlooked the word for now. Don't overlook the final sentence. I really want to go this time;I'll just arrive late. I like this ending very much. I'd like to ask whether I can enter later. Ask staff whether saving a seat is possible.

text: 我今天的演出比陈宇他们那场晚结束一点，跑到车站，等的车还没来。群里问还要等我吗，我先发你们进去，别站门口。电话接通，朋友却问是不是不来了。我说不是不去，车还没到，晚点来。他那边正有人笑，没听清，我又提高声音重复了一遍。看着站牌，我也着急，可车还没来，只好先把晚点到三个字打出来，再让他们给我留一把椅子，不用一起站在外面吹风。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān de yǎn chū bǐ chén yǔ tā men nà chǎng wǎn jié shù yī diǎn , pǎo dào chē zhàn , děng de chē hái méi lái . qún lǐ wèn hái yào děng wǒ ma , wǒ xiān fā nǐ men jìn qù , bié zhàn mén kǒu . diàn huà jiē tōng , péng you què wèn shì bú shì bù lái le . wǒ shuō bù shì bù qù , chē hái méi dào , wǎn diǎn lái . tā nà biān zhèng yǒu rén xiào , méi tīng qīng , wǒ yòu tí gāo shēng yīn chóng fù le yī biàn . kàn zhe zhàn pái , wǒ yě zháo jí , kě chē hái méi lái , zhǐ hǎo xiān bǎ wǎn diǎn dào sān gè zì dǎ chū lái , zài ràng tā men gěi wǒ liú yī bǎ yǐ zi , bù yòng yì qǐ zhàn zài wài miàn chuī fēng .
meaning: My show ended a little later than Chen Yu's group, and the bus still hadn't come when I ran to the stop. Asked whether they should wait, I texted them to go inside. On the phone, a friend thought I wasn't coming. I was, just later—the bus wasn't there yet. Laughter at his end drowned me out, so I repeated it louder. I was anxious too, but could only text that I'd arrive late and ask them to save a chair rather than stand outside in the wind.

text: 车站有人说话，电话那头又有散场的响声，我们两边都不太听得清。我发文字，把晚点到写出来，站在车站继续等。朋友又问多久，我抬头看了两次，车终于来了，才补了一句十分钟左右。上车以后我找到靠窗的位置，把刚才没说完的路问清。他说红门就在电影院旁边，我看着窗外一站一站过去，快到时先发了消息，让他不用再站门口找我。
pinyin: chē zhàn yǒu rén shuō huà , diàn huà nà tóu yòu yǒu sàn chǎng de xiǎng shēng , wǒ men liǎng biān dōu bù tài tīng de qīng . wǒ fā wén zì , bǎ wǎn diǎn dào xiě chū lái , zhàn zài chē zhàn jì xù děng . péng you yòu wèn duō jiǔ , wǒ tái tóu kàn le liǎng cì , chē zhōng yú lái le , cái bǔ le yī jù shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu . shàng chē yǐ hòu wǒ zhǎo dào kào chuāng de wèi zhì , bǎ gāng cái méi shuō wán de lù wèn qīng . tā shuō hóng mén jiù zài diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān , wǒ kàn zhe chuāng wài yī zhàn yī zhàn guò qù , kuài dào shí xiān fā le xiāo xī , ràng tā bù yòng zài zhàn mén kǒu zhǎo wǒ .
meaning: People were talking at the stop and the event was ending at the other end of the call. I texted that I'd arrive late and kept waiting. Asked how long, I looked up twice before the bus finally arrived; only then did I estimate about ten minutes. From a window seat I confirmed the red door beside the cinema, watched the stops go past and messaged near arrival so my friend wouldn't stand outside searching for me.

text: 朋友问要不要替我点吃的，我说先别点，路上也许会买一点。他又问到了以后再看吗，我说对，水可以先拿。刚说完，车到了，我把手机放进口袋，上去找座位。旁边有人拿着面包，我才发现自己也饿了，可两只手还要拿包和扶住椅背，只好先坐下来。朋友发来菜单照片，我看了两眼，回他说到了自己选，别急着点，我还没看完。他回了个好，旁边又发来一只装水的杯子。
pinyin: péng you wèn yào bù yào tì wǒ diǎn chī de , wǒ shuō xiān bié diǎn , lù shàng yě xǔ huì mǎi yī diǎn . tā yòu wèn dào le yǐ hòu zài kàn ma , wǒ shuō duì , shuǐ kě yǐ xiān ná . gāng shuō wán , chē dào le , wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng jìn kǒu dài , shàng qù zhǎo zuò wèi . páng biān yǒu rén ná zhe miàn bāo , wǒ cái fā xiàn zì jǐ yě è le , kě liǎng zhǐ shǒu hái yào ná bāo hé fú zhù yǐ bèi , zhǐ hǎo xiān zuò xià lái . péng you fā lái cài dān zhào piān , wǒ kàn le liǎng yǎn , huí tā shuō dào le zì jǐ xuǎn , bié jí zhe diǎn , wǒ hái méi kàn wán . tā huí le gè hǎo , páng biān yòu fā lái yī zhǐ zhuāng shuǐ de bēi zi .
meaning: Asked whether they should order for me, I said not yet; I might buy something on the way. I'd choose when I arrived, but water was fine. The bus came as I finished, and I put my phone away to board. Someone had bread, reminding me how hungry I was, but I needed both hands for my bag and the seat back. Once seated I looked at the menu photo my friend sent. I'd choose there—don't order before I'd finished reading. He agreed and sent a picture of a glass of water.

text: 下车后我沿着小路走，差点又往桥上去。上次的路太熟，我走了几步才想起这次不用过桥，就停下来打开照片。电影院旁边的小店正好有人出来，红门和照片里一样。我给朋友发到了，避开门口等座位的人往里面走。大家已经坐好，旁边空着一把椅子，桌上还有我的水。朋友问是不是又走错门，我说差一点，你下次直接把店名写出来吧。他把菜单递给我，说先吃，吃完我慢慢念给你听。
pinyin: xià chē hòu wǒ yán zhe xiǎo lù zǒu , chà diǎn yòu wǎng qiáo shàng qù . shàng cì de lù tài shú , wǒ zǒu le jǐ bù cái xiǎng qǐ zhè cì bù yòng guò qiáo , jiù tíng xià lái dǎ kāi zhào piān . diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān de xiǎo diàn zhèng hǎo yǒu rén chū lái , hóng mén hé zhào piān lǐ yī yàng . wǒ gěi péng you fā dào le , bì kāi mén kǒu děng zuò wèi de rén wǎng lǐ miàn zǒu . dà jiā yǐ jīng zuò hǎo , páng biān kōng zhe yī bǎ yǐ zi , zhuō shàng hái yǒu wǒ de shuǐ . péng you wèn shì bú shì yòu zǒu cuò mén , wǒ shuō chà yī diǎn , nǐ xià cì zhí jiē bǎ diàn míng xiě chū lái ba . tā bǎ cài dān dì gěi wǒ , shuō xiān chī , chī wán wǒ màn màn niàn gěi nǐ tīng .
meaning: After getting off, I nearly followed the familiar route over the bridge. Remembering I didn't need to cross it, I stopped to check the photo. Someone was leaving the cinema-side shop; its red door matched. I texted that I'd arrived and went around the people waiting outside. My chair and water were ready. Had I gone to the wrong door again? Almost—write the shop name next time. He handed me the menu: eat first, then he'd read it very slowly to me.

text: 喝过水我们才谈演出。我说结尾不是不好，是我没听懂，朋友马上问哪句没听清。我笑着说这次听清了，只是不明白妹妹为什么把信留下。他说不是姐姐吗，我拿出节目单，指着妹妹的名字，让他想想后来回家那场。他看了半天，说自己好像漏了那一小段。我把记得的几句讲给他听，又问他前面的写信那场怎么样。这回轮到我想不起来，我们只好把节目单摊在桌上，从人物名字重新对一遍。
pinyin: hē guò shuǐ wǒ men cái tán yǎn chū . wǒ shuō jié wěi bù shì bù hǎo , shì wǒ méi tīng dǒng , péng you mǎ shàng wèn nǎ jù méi tīng qīng . wǒ xiào zhe shuō zhè cì tīng qīng le , zhǐ shì bù míng bái mèi mei wèi shén me bǎ xìn liú xià . tā shuō bù shì jiě jie ma , wǒ ná chū jié mù dān , zhǐ zhe mèi mei de míng zi , ràng tā xiǎng xiǎng hòu lái huí jiā nà chǎng . tā kàn le bàn tiān , shuō zì jǐ hǎo xiàng lòu le nà yī xiǎo duàn . wǒ bǎ jì de de jǐ jù jiǎng gěi tā tīng , yòu wèn tā qián miàn de xiě xìn nà chǎng zěn me yàng . zhè huí lún dào wǒ xiǎng bù qǐ lái , wǒ men zhǐ hǎo bǎ jié mù dān tān zài zhuō shàng , cóng rén wù míng zi chóng xīn duì yī biàn .
meaning: Over water I said the ending wasn't bad; I hadn't understood it. Which line hadn't I heard? My friend asked. This time I'd heard it; I didn't understand why the younger sister left the letter. Wasn't it the elder one? I pointed to the younger sister on the programme and the homecoming scene. He thought he'd missed that short section. I recounted what I remembered and asked about the earlier letter-writing scene. That was the part I couldn't recall, so we spread the programme on the table and checked the names together.

text: 聊到后来，刚才和我对节目单的朋友说，他以前看过前半场，后半场没看完；我却漏了开头，刚才问谁写信，正好问到自己没看的地方。陈宇在旁边拿手机找演出的日期，我看了一眼时间，说今天先别回去了，明天还要早起。他说不是现在，只想下次有空三个人一起看完整。我说好，日期以后再定，这回从开头坐到结束。服务员过来问还要什么，我们看着桌上剩下的菜，赶紧说不用了，先把这些吃完，吃完就各自回家。
pinyin: liáo dào hòu lái , gāng cái hé wǒ duì jié mù dān de péng you shuō , tā yǐ qián kàn guò qián bàn chǎng , hòu bàn chǎng méi kàn wán ; wǒ què lòu le kāi tóu , gāng cái wèn shéi xiě xìn , zhèng hǎo wèn dào zì jǐ méi kàn de dì fāng . chén yǔ zài páng biān ná shǒu jī zhǎo yǎn chū de rì qī , wǒ kàn le yī yǎn shí jiān , shuō jīn tiān xiān bié huí qù le , míng tiān hái yào zǎo qǐ . tā shuō bù shì xiàn zài , zhǐ xiǎng xià cì yǒu kōng sān gè rén yì qǐ kàn wán zhěng . wǒ shuō hǎo , rì qī yǐ hòu zài dìng , zhè huí cóng kāi tóu zuò dào jié shù . fú wù yuán guò lái wèn hái yào shén me , wǒ men kàn zhe zhuō shàng shèng xià de cài , gǎn jǐn shuō bù yòng le , xiān bǎ zhè xiē chī wán , chī wán jiù gè zì huí jiā .
meaning: The friend I'd checked the programme with had previously seen the first half but not all of the second; I'd missed the opening, including the letter-writing I'd asked about. Beside us, Chen Yu checked performance dates on his phone. We shouldn't go back tonight—we needed an early start. Not tonight, he said; sometime the three of us could watch the whole thing together. We left the date open and agreed to stay from start to finish. Asked if we wanted anything else, we looked at the food still on the table: finish this, then go home.

text: 我回去以后给他发消息，下一次店名和时间都写全，不只发一个红门。他回了一段故意说得很慢的语音，连店名都说了三遍。我说我听见了，你这样说，等你说完我又饿了。他发来一个笑脸，问那要不要现在再出来吃。我说明天吧，今天真的回家了。我们约好重要的变化先写一句，路上说笑还是照常。睡觉前他把明天的店名和时间发来，我回了个好，这次连地址也看完才放下手机。
pinyin: wǒ huí qù yǐ hòu gěi tā fā xiāo xī , xià yī cì diàn míng hé shí jiān dōu xiě quán , bù zhǐ fā yī gè hóng mén . tā huí le yī duàn gù yì shuō de hěn màn de yǔ yīn , lián diàn míng dōu shuō le sān biàn . wǒ shuō wǒ tīng jiàn le , nǐ zhè yàng shuō , děng nǐ shuō wán wǒ yòu è le . tā fā lái yī gè xiào liǎn , wèn nà yào bù yào xiàn zài zài chū lái chī . wǒ shuō míng tiān ba , jīn tiān zhēn de huí jiā le . wǒ men yuē hǎo zhòng yào de biàn huà xiān xiě yī jù , lù shàng shuō xiào hái shi zhào cháng . shuì jiào qián tā bǎ míng tiān de diàn míng hé shí jiān fā lái , wǒ huí le gè hǎo , zhè cì lián dì zhǐ yě kàn wán cái fàng xià shǒu jī .
meaning: After getting home I asked him to write out the shop name and time next time, instead of just sending “red door.” He replied with a deliberately slow voice message and repeated the name three times. I said I had heard him: at that speed I would be hungry again before he finished. He sent a smiling face and asked if I wanted to go back out for food. Tomorrow, I said; I really was home now. We agreed to text important changes but keep joking on the phone as usual. Before bed he sent tomorrow's shop name and time. I replied yes, this time reading the address too before putting my phone down.

le yī biàn . kàn zhe zhàn pái , wǒ yě zháo jí , kě chē hái méi lái , zhǐ hǎo xiān bǎ wǎn diǎn dào sān gè zì dǎ chū lái , zài ràng tā men gěi wǒ liú yī bǎ yǐ zi , bù yòng yì qǐ zhàn zài wài miàn chuī fēng . chē zhàn yǒu rén shuō huà , diàn huà nà tóu yòu yǒu sàn chǎng de xiǎng shēng , wǒ men liǎng biān dōu bù tài tīng de qīng . wǒ fā wén zì , bǎ wǎn diǎn dào xiě chū lái , zhàn zài chē zhàn jì xù děng . péng you yòu wèn duō jiǔ , wǒ tái tóu kàn le liǎng cì , chē zhōng yú lái le , cái bǔ le yī jù shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu . shàng chē yǐ hòu wǒ zhǎo dào kào chuāng de wèi zhì , bǎ gāng cái méi shuō wán de lù wèn qīng . tā shuō hóng mén jiù zài diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān , wǒ kàn zhe chuāng wài yī zhàn yī zhàn guò qù , kuài dào shí xiān fā le xiāo xī , ràng tā bù yòng zài zhàn mén kǒu zhǎo wǒ . péng you wèn yào bù yào tì wǒ diǎn chī de , wǒ shuō xiān bié diǎn , lù shàng yě xǔ huì mǎi yī diǎn . tā yòu wèn dào le yǐ hòu zài kàn ma , wǒ shuō duì , shuǐ kě yǐ xiān ná . gāng shuō wán , chē dào le , wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng jìn kǒu dài , shàng qù zhǎo zuò wèi . páng biān yǒu rén ná zhe miàn bāo , wǒ cái fā xiàn zì jǐ yě è le , kě liǎng zhǐ shǒu hái yào ná bāo hé fú zhù yǐ bèi , zhǐ hǎo xiān zuò xià lái . péng you fā lái cài dān zhào piān , wǒ kàn le liǎng yǎn , huí tā shuō dào le zì jǐ xuǎn , bié jí zhe diǎn , wǒ hái méi kàn wán . tā huí le gè hǎo , páng biān yòu fā lái yī zhǐ zhuāng shuǐ de bēi zi . xià chē hòu wǒ yán zhe xiǎo lù zǒu , chà diǎn yòu wǎng qiáo shàng qù . shàng cì de lù tài shú , wǒ zǒu le jǐ bù cái xiǎng qǐ zhè cì bù yòng guò qiáo , jiù tíng xià lái dǎ kāi zhào piān . diàn yǐng yuàn páng biān de xiǎo diàn zhèng hǎo yǒu rén chū lái , hóng mén hé zhào piān lǐ yī yàng . wǒ gěi péng you fā dào le , bì kāi mén kǒu děng zuò wèi de rén wǎng lǐ miàn zǒu . dà jiā yǐ jīng zuò hǎo , páng biān kōng zhe yī bǎ yǐ zi , zhuō shàng hái yǒu wǒ de shuǐ . péng you wèn shì bú shì yòu zǒu cuò mén , wǒ shuō chà yī diǎn , nǐ xià cì zhí jiē bǎ diàn míng xiě chū lái ba . tā bǎ cài dān dì gěi wǒ , shuō xiān chī , chī wán wǒ màn màn niàn gěi nǐ tīng . hē guò shuǐ wǒ men cái tán yǎn chū . wǒ shuō jié wěi bù shì bù hǎo , shì wǒ méi tīng dǒng , péng you mǎ shàng wèn nǎ jù méi tīng qīng . wǒ I was anxious too, but could only text that I'd arrive late and ask them to save a chair rather than stand outside in the wind. People were talking at the stop and the event was ending at the other end of the call. I texted that I'd arrive late and kept waiting. Asked how long, I looked up twice before the bus finally arrived; only then did I estimate about ten minutes. From a window seat I confirmed the red door beside the cinema, watched the stops go past and messaged near arrival so my friend wouldn't stand outside searching for me. Asked whether they should order for me, I said not yet; I might buy something on the way. I'd choose when I arrived, but water was fine. The bus came as I finished, and I put my phone away to board. Someone had bread, reminding me how hungry I was, but I needed both hands for my bag and the seat back. Once seated I looked at the menu photo my friend sent. I'd choose there—don't order before I'd finished reading. He agreed and sent a picture of a glass of water. After getting off, I nearly followed the familiar route over the bridge. Remembering I didn't need to cross it, I stopped to check the photo. Someone was leaving the cinema-side shop; its red door matched. I texted that I'd arrived and went around the people waiting outside. My chair and water were ready. Had I gone to the wrong door again? Almost—write the shop name next time. He handed me the menu: eat first, then he'd read it very slowly to me. Over water I said the ending wasn't bad; I hadn't understood it. Which line hadn't I heard? My friend asked. I replied yes, this time reading the address too before putting my phone down.

聊到后来，刚才和我对节目单的朋友说，他以前看过前半场，后半场没看完；我却漏了开头，刚才问谁写信，正好问到自己没看的地方。陈宇在旁边拿手机找演出的日期，我看了一眼时间，说今天先别回去了，明天还要早起。他说不是现在，只想下次有空三个人一起看完整。我说好，日期以后再定，这回从开头坐到结束。服务员过来问还要什么，我们看着桌上剩下的菜，赶紧说不用了，先把这些吃完，吃完就各自回家。
我回去以后给他发消息，下一次店名和时间都写全，不只发一个红门。他回了一段故意说得很慢的语音，连店名都说了三遍。我说我听见了，你这样说，等你说完我又饿了。他发来一个笑脸，问那要不要现在再出来吃。我说明天吧，今天真的回家了。我们约好重要的变化先写一句，路上说笑还是照常。睡觉前他把明天的店名和时间发来，我回了个好，这次连地址也看完才放下手机。

text: 最后一段你没拆信，我还以为忘了。
pinyin: zuì hòu yī duàn nǐ méi chāi xìn , wǒ hái yǐ wéi wàng le .
meaning: You didn't open the letter at the end.I thought you'd forgotten.

text: 没忘，写的就是没拆。
pinyin: méi wàng , xiě de jiù shì méi chāi .
meaning: I hadn't—that's what's written.

text: 那里面到底是什么？
pinyin: nà lǐ miàn dào dǐ shì shén me ?
meaning: What exactly is inside?

text: 没写给观众看。你可以猜，别说你已经知道。
pinyin: méi xiě gěi guān zhòng kàn . nǐ kě yǐ cāi , bié shuō nǐ yǐ jīng zhī dào .
meaning: The audience isn't shown.You can guess,but can't call it known.

text: 我猜是让她别走。
pinyin: wǒ cāi shì ràng tā bié zǒu .
meaning: I guessed it asks her not to leave.

text: 也可能是到了再看。结尾没有给答案。
pinyin: yě kě néng shì dào le zài kàn . jié wěi méi yǒu gěi dá àn .
meaning: It could be for after arrival.The ending gives no answer.

text: 你唱的那句灯还亮着，是等她回来？
pinyin: nǐ chàng de nà jù dēng hái liàng zhe , shì děng tā huí lái ?
meaning: The light still on in the song—is that waiting for her return?

text: 可以这么听，也可以是今晚还没结束。
pinyin: kě yǐ zhè me tīng , yě kě yǐ shì jīn wǎn hái méi jié shù .
meaning: You can hear it that way,or as tonight not being over yet.

text: 没有写下周回来，对吧？
pinyin: méi yǒu xiě xià zhōu huí lái , duì ba ?
meaning: No next-week return date,right?

text: 对。别替歌词订车票。
pinyin: duì . bié tì gē cí dìng chē piào .
meaning: Right.Don't book a ticket on the lyrics' behalf.

text: 好。那现实里你明天几点的车？
pinyin: hǎo . nà xiàn shí lǐ nǐ míng tiān jǐ diǎn de chē ?
meaning: Okay.In real life,when's your train tomorrow?

text: 九点。八点半在入口见就行。
pinyin: jiǔ diǎn . bā diǎn bàn zài rù kǒu jiàn jiù xíng .
meaning: Nine.See you at the entrance at eight thirty.

text: 我来送你。想吃点什么？
pinyin: wǒ lái sòng nǐ . xiǎng chī diǎn shén me ?
meaning: I'll see you off.Want anything to eat?

text: 不用特意买，带水就好。
pinyin: bù yòng tè yì mǎi , dài shuǐ jiù hǎo .
meaning: No special shopping.Just water.

text: 其他人也来？
pinyin: qí tā rén yě lái ?
meaning: Are the others coming too?

text: 他们要上班，别替我把全组叫来。
pinyin: tā men yào shàng bān , bié tì wǒ bǎ quán zǔ jiào lái .
meaning: They have work.Don't call the whole group for me.

text: 知道了。今晚还能再唱一遍吗？
pinyin: zhī dào le . jīn wǎn hái néng zài chàng yī biàn ma ?
meaning: Got it.Can we sing once more tonight?

text: 九点半了，先收东西。场馆十点关。
pinyin: jiǔ diǎn bàn le , xiān shōu dōng xi . chǎng guǎn shí diǎn guān .
meaning: It's nine thirty.Put things away first.The venue closes at ten.

text: 那你要回去休息。
pinyin: nà nǐ yào huí qù xiū xī .
meaning: Then you need rest.

text: 好，没唱完留一点，下次接着唱。
pinyin: hǎo , méi chàng wán liú yī diǎn , xià cì jiē zhe chàng .
meaning: Yes.Leave a little unfinished;continue next time.

text: 这句可以写到群里。
pinyin: zhè jù kě yǐ xiě dào qún lǐ .
meaning: We can put that in the group.

text: 可以，别写下周已经约好了。
pinyin: kě yǐ , bié xiě xià zhōu yǐ jīng yuē hǎo le .
meaning: Yes,but don't say next week is already booked.

text: 到了给我们留言。
pinyin: dào le gěi wǒ men liú yán .
meaning: Message when you arrive.

text: 会的。这句是承诺，不用拿来猜结尾。
pinyin: huì de . zhè jù shì chéng nuò , bù yòng ná lái cāi jié wěi .
meaning: I will.That one's a promise,no need to interpret it like the ending.

text: 短剧最后一幕在车站，主角把一封信递给要走的朋友。她接过来，放进包，没有拆。灯慢慢暗下来，旁边的歌唱到门还没关。我坐在第三排，看见她拉好包带，回头望了一眼，觉得信里肯定是在叫她别走。散场后我把这个想法讲给陈宇，他问哪一句写了别走。我翻节目单找了半天，没有找到。他笑着说刚才连信都没拆，你怎么看到里面的字。我只好把节目单合上，说好吧，那是我猜的。
pinyin: duǎn jù zuì hòu yī mù zài chē zhàn , zhǔ jué bǎ yī fēng xìn dì gěi yào zǒu de péng you . tā jiē guò lái , fàng jìn bāo , méi yǒu chāi . dēng màn màn àn xià lái , páng biān de gē chàng dào mén hái méi guān . wǒ zuò zài dì sān pái , kàn jiàn tā lā hǎo bāo dài , huí tóu wàng le yī yǎn , jué de xìn lǐ kěn dìng shì zài jiào tā bié zǒu . sàn chǎng hòu wǒ bǎ zhè gè xiǎng fǎ jiǎng gěi chén yǔ , tā wèn nǎ yī jù xiě le bié zǒu . wǒ fān jié mù dān zhǎo le bàn tiān , méi yǒu zhǎo dào . tā xiào zhe shuō gāng cái lián xìn dōu méi chāi , nǐ zěn me kàn dào lǐ miàn de zì . wǒ zhǐ hǎo bǎ jié mù dān hé shàng , shuō hǎo ba , nà shì wǒ cāi de .
meaning: In the final station scene, the lead handed a letter to the departing friend. She put it in her bag without opening it. As the lights dimmed, the song mentioned an open door. From the third row, her tightened strap and backward glance made me sure the letter asked her not to leave. Afterwards Chen Yu asked which line said that. I searched the programme without finding it. She hadn't even opened the letter—how had I seen its words? I closed the programme and admitted it was my guess.

text: 陈宇问我为什么这样猜，我说她回头时停了好一会儿，歌也还没结束。他倒觉得那封信是让她到了以后再看，因为前面她说过到了再告诉你。我拿节目单指给他看，问那桌边写信写了那么久呢，他说所以才有很多话，不一定只写别走。我们从最后一幕又讲回前面，越讲越想再看一次。旁边一个朋友插进来，说你们两个猜了半天，还没问演戏的人。我们一起转头，才发现林安已经拿着水出来了。
pinyin: chén yǔ wèn wǒ wèi shén me zhè yàng cāi , wǒ shuō tā huí tóu shí tíng le hǎo yī huì er , gē yě hái méi jié shù . tā dào jué de nà fēng xìn shì ràng tā dào le yǐ hòu zài kàn , yīn wèi qián miàn tā shuō guò dào le zài gào sù nǐ . wǒ ná jié mù dān zhǐ gěi tā kàn , wèn nà zhuō biān xiě xìn xiě le nà me jiǔ ne , tā shuō suǒ yǐ cái yǒu hěn duō huà , bù yí dìng zhǐ xiě bié zǒu . wǒ men cóng zuì hòu yī mù yòu jiǎng huí qián miàn , yuè jiǎng yuè xiǎng zài kàn yī cì . páng biān yī gè péng you chā jìn lái , shuō nǐ men liǎng gè cāi le bàn tiān , hái méi wèn yǎn xì de rén . wǒ men yì qǐ zhuǎn tóu , cái fā xiàn lín ān yǐ jīng ná zhe shuǐ chū lái le .
meaning: Why had I guessed that? Her backward glance lasted, and the song wasn't over. Chen Yu thought she might read the letter after arriving, recalling 'I'll tell you when I get there.' What about the long letter-writing scene? There could be plenty to say beyond asking her to stay. We talked backwards through the play and increasingly wanted another viewing. A friend interrupted: we'd spent all this time guessing without asking the actors. Turning around, we found Lin An had already emerged with water.

text: 林安从后台出来，还拿着半杯水。她今晚演要走的朋友，明早也要坐车去另一个城市，大家围过来就先问信里写了什么。她笑着说剧本没有写，问我们各猜了什么。一个朋友说肯定是让她下周回来，她举起水杯，说先让我把这杯喝完，下周还得看工作。我说好，那明天几点送你，她终于把手机拿出来，指着九点的车次给我看。她点开日期，我这才看清车票早就买好了。
pinyin: lín ān cóng hòu tái chū lái , hái ná zhe bàn bēi shuǐ . tā jīn wǎn yǎn yào zǒu de péng you , míng zǎo yě yào zuò chē qù lìng yī gè chéng shì , dà jiā wéi guò lái jiù xiān wèn xìn lǐ xiě le shén me . tā xiào zhe shuō jù běn méi yǒu xiě , wèn wǒ men gè cāi le shén me . yī gè péng you shuō kěn dìng shì ràng tā xià zhōu huí lái , tā jǔ qǐ shuǐ bēi , shuō xiān ràng wǒ bǎ zhè bēi hē wán , xià zhōu hái děi kàn gōng zuò . wǒ shuō hǎo , nà míng tiān jǐ diǎn sòng nǐ , tā zhōng yú bǎ shǒu jī ná chū lái , zhǐ zhe jiǔ diǎn de chē cì gěi wǒ kàn . tā diǎn kāi rì qī , wǒ zhè cái kàn qīng chē piào zǎo jiù mǎi hǎo le .
meaning: Lin An came backstage with half a cup of water. Like her departing character, she'd travel to another city tomorrow. We crowded round to ask what the letter said. The script didn't say; what did we think? Someone thought it asked her back next week. First let her finish her water, she laughed; next week depended on work. Asked about tomorrow, she showed me the nine o'clock departure on her phone. Opening the date, she let me see that the ticket was already booked.

text: 我还想再听一遍歌，问能不能从灯还亮着那句再来。林安看了看表，说九点半了，十点关门，先收东西吧。陈宇把设备关掉，我和朋友把椅子搬回墙边，刚才坐过的地方一下空了。到了门口，林安轻声唱起今晚这句已经有人听见，我跟着接后面，却又忘了词。她把节目单递给我，上面写着把下一页留给下一次见面。我照着唱完，问下一次是哪天，她说现在还不知道，先让我明天坐上车吧。
pinyin: wǒ hái xiǎng zài tīng yī biàn gē , wèn néng bù néng cóng dēng hái liàng zhe nà jù zài lái . lín ān kàn le kàn biǎo , shuō jiǔ diǎn bàn le , shí diǎn guān mén , xiān shōu dōng xi ba . chén yǔ bǎ shè bèi guān diào , wǒ hé péng you bǎ yǐ zi bān huí qiáng biān , gāng cái zuò guò de dì fāng yī xià kōng le . dào le mén kǒu , lín ān qīng shēng chàng qǐ jīn wǎn zhè jù yǐ jīng yǒu rén tīng jiàn , wǒ gēn zhe jiē hòu miàn , què yòu wàng le cí . tā bǎ jié mù dān dì gěi wǒ , shàng miàn xiě zhe bǎ xià yī yè liú gěi xià yī cì jiàn miàn . wǒ zhào zhe chàng wán , wèn xià yī cì shì nǎ tiān , tā shuō xiàn zài hái bù zhī dào , xiān ràng wǒ míng tiān zuò shàng chē ba .
meaning: Could we sing again from 'the light is still on'? Lin An checked the time: 9:30, with closing at ten; we'd pack first. Chen Yu shut down the equipment while we carried chairs to the wall. At the door she quietly sang 'someone has heard this line tonight.' I tried to join but forgot the words again. Her programme supplied 'leave the next page for our next meeting.' After singing it, I asked when that would be. She didn't know yet—first let her catch tomorrow's train.

text: 第二天我八点半到车站入口，带了一瓶水。林安拉着箱子过来，问其他人呢，我说几个要上班，今天就我来。她接过水，让我帮她拿一下包，自己把箱子上的节目单收进去。我们站到不挡人的地方，又聊昨晚那封信，她还是让我自己猜。我问到了以后能不能告诉我们一声，她说可以，到了就在群里发消息。九点的车快开了，她拿回包，挥挥手走进入口。我站了一会儿，才发现自己手里还拿着没打开的另一瓶水。
pinyin: dì èr tiān wǒ bā diǎn bàn dào chē zhàn rù kǒu , dài le yī píng shuǐ . lín ān lā zhe xiāng zi guò lái , wèn qí tā rén ne , wǒ shuō jǐ gè yào shàng bān , jīn tiān jiù wǒ lái . tā jiē guò shuǐ , ràng wǒ bāng tā ná yī xià bāo , zì jǐ bǎ xiāng zi shàng de jié mù dān shōu jìn qù . wǒ men zhàn dào bù dǎng rén de dì fāng , yòu liáo zuó wǎn nà fēng xìn , tā hái shi ràng wǒ zì jǐ cāi . wǒ wèn dào le yǐ hòu néng bù néng gào sù wǒ men yī shēng , tā shuō kě yǐ , dào le jiù zài qún lǐ fā xiāo xī . jiǔ diǎn de chē kuài kāi le , tā ná huí bāo , huī huī shǒu zǒu jìn rù kǒu . wǒ zhàn le yī huì er , cái fā xiàn zì jǐ shǒu lǐ hái ná zhe méi dǎ kāi de lìng yī píng shuǐ .
meaning: At 8:30 I met Lin An at the station entrance with water. Where were the others? Some had work; it was just me. She had me hold her bag while she packed the programme from her suitcase. Standing out of the way, we discussed the letter again; she still left me to guess. Could she let us know when she arrived? Yes, she'd message the group. With the nine o'clock train nearing departure, she took back her bag and waved. After watching her go, I noticed the other unopened bottle still in my hand.

text: 第二天晚上她发来照片，窗外有很远的灯，配了一句到了，明天再收东西。我把昨天的节目单夹进书里，回她今天有没有忘带伞。她说没有，水也喝完了，又问最后那段录像能不能发给她。我找到递信以后的一小段，先看了一遍，还是没见到信里面写什么。发过去时，我说这回终于把你唱的最后一句听全，下次见面再讲我猜的结尾。
pinyin: dì èr tiān wǎn shang tā fā lái zhào piān , chuāng wài yǒu hěn yuǎn de dēng , pèi le yī jù dào le , míng tiān zài shōu dōng xi . wǒ bǎ zuó tiān de jié mù dān jiā jìn shū lǐ , huí tā jīn tiān yǒu méi yǒu wàng dài sǎn . tā shuō méi yǒu , shuǐ yě hē wán le , yòu wèn zuì hòu nà duàn lù xiàng néng bù néng fā gěi tā . wǒ zhǎo dào dì xìn yǐ hòu de yī xiǎo duàn , xiān kàn le yī biàn , hái shi méi jiàn dào xìn lǐ miàn xiě shén me . fā guò qù shí , wǒ shuō zhè huí zhōng yú bǎ nǐ chàng de zuì hòu yī jù tīng quán , xià cì jiàn miàn zài jiǎng wǒ cāi de jié wěi .
meaning: The next evening she sent a photo of distant lights outside: she'd arrived and would unpack tomorrow. I tucked yesterday's programme inside a book and asked if she'd forgotten her umbrella. I sent it, saying I'd finally caught her full last line and would share my guessed ending next time we met.

meaning: In the final station scene, the lead handed a letter to the departing friend. She put it in her bag without opening it. As the lights dimmed, the song mentioned an open door. From the third row, her tightened strap and backward glance made me sure the letter asked her not to leave. Afterwards Chen Yu asked which line said that. I searched the programme without finding it. She hadn't even opened the letter—how had I seen its words? I closed the programme and admitted it was my guess. Why had I guessed that? Her backward glance lasted, and the song wasn't over. Chen Yu thought she might read the letter after arriving, recalling 'I'll tell you when I get there.' What about the long letter-writing scene? There could be plenty to say beyond asking her to stay. We talked backwards through the play and increasingly wanted another viewing. A friend interrupted: we'd spent all this time guessing without asking the actors. Turning around, we found Lin An had already emerged with water. Lin An came backstage with half a cup of water. Like her departing character, she'd travel to another city tomorrow. We crowded round to ask what the letter said. The script didn't say; what did we think? Someone thought it asked her back next week. First let her finish her water, she laughed; next week depended on work. Asked about tomorrow, she showed me the nine o'clock departure on her phone. Opening the date, she let me see that the ticket was already booked. Could we sing again from 'the light is still on'? Lin An checked the time: 9:30, with closing at ten; we'd pack first. Chen Yu shut down the equipment while we carried chairs to the wall. At the door she quietly sang 'someone has heard this line tonight.' I tried to join but forgot the words again. Her programme supplied 'leave the next page for our next meeting.' After singing it, I asked when that would be. She didn't know yet—first let her catch tomorrow's train. At 8:30 I met Lin An at the station entrance with water. Where were the others? Some had work; it was just me. She had me hold her bag while she packed the programme from her suitcase. Standing out of the way, we discussed the letter again; she still left me to guess. Could she let us know when she arrived? Yes, she'd message the group. With the nine o'clock train nearing departure, she took back her bag and waved. After watching her go, I noticed the other unopened bottle still in my hand. No, and she'd finished the water too. Could I send the last part of the video? Watching the section after the letter was handed over, I still couldn't see its contents. I sent it, saying I'd finally caught her full last line and would share my guessed ending next time we met.

meaning: The rain beside the window hasn't stopped,

text: 你把最后一句留在门边。

meaning: You leave the final sentence by the door.

text: 我把灯调暗一点，

text: 让没说完的话坐在身边。

meaning: And let unfinished words sit beside me.

text: 远处有人叫你的名字，

text: 脚步从这一页走向明天。

text: 灯还亮着，门还没关，

meaning: The light is still on,the door still open,

text: 我在雨里听见一段歌，

meaning: In the rain I hear a piece of song,

text: 唱到这里，先停一停。

text: 下一页留给下一次见面，

text: 今晚这句，已经有人听见。
pinyin: jīn wǎn zhè jù , yǐ jīng yǒu rén tīng jiàn .
meaning: Someone has already heard tonight's line.

text: 窗边的雨还没有停，你把最后一句留在门边。我把灯调暗一点，让没说完的话坐在身边。远处有人叫你的名字，脚步从这一页走向明天。灯还亮着，门还没关，不是每一次等候都要答案。我在雨里听见一段歌，唱到这里，先停一停。下一页留给下一次见面，今晚这句，已经有人听见。
pinyin: chuāng biān de yǔ hái méi yǒu tíng , nǐ bǎ zuì hòu yī jù liú zài mén biān . wǒ bǎ dēng diào àn yī diǎn , ràng méi shuō wán de huà zuò zài shēn biān . yuǎn chù yǒu rén jiào nǐ de míng zi , jiǎo bù cóng zhè yī yè zǒu xiàng míng tiān . dēng hái liàng zhe , mén hái méi guān , bù shì měi yī cì děng hòu dōu yào dá àn . wǒ zài yǔ lǐ tīng jiàn yī duàn gē , chàng dào zhè lǐ , xiān tíng yī tíng . xià yī yè liú gěi xià yī cì jiàn miàn , jīn wǎn zhè jù , yǐ jīng yǒu rén tīng jiàn .
meaning: The rain beside the window hasn't stopped, You leave the final sentence by the door. I turn the light down a little, And let unfinished words sit beside me. Someone far away calls your name, Footsteps walk from this page towards tomorrow. The light is still on,the door still open, Not every wait needs an answer. In the rain I hear a piece of song, Sing this far,and pause for now. Leave the next page for the next meeting, Someone has already heard tonight's line.

meaning: The story moved her deeply.

text: 他们坐在岸边听海浪。
pinyin: tā men zuò zài àn biān tīng hǎi làng .
meaning: They sit by the shore listening to waves.

text: 这封信来自远方。
pinyin: zhè fēng xìn lái zì yuǎn fāng .
meaning: This letter comes from far away.

text: 她有时觉得孤独，仍愿意联系朋友。
pinyin: tā yǒu shí jué de gū dú , réng yuàn yì lián xì péng you .
meaning: She sometimes feels lonely but still wants to contact friends.

text: 这些交流能增进感情。
pinyin: zhè xiē jiāo liú néng zēng jìn gǎn qíng .
meaning: These exchanges can strengthen affection.

text: 两种安排之间需要平衡。
pinyin: liǎng zhǒng ān pái zhī jiān xū yào píng héng .
meaning: The two arrangements need balancing.

text: 作品融合了两种形式。
pinyin: zuò pǐn róng hé le liǎng zhǒng xíng shì .
meaning: The work blends two forms.

text: 别把每个元素都解释成一个人。
pinyin: bié bǎ měi gè yuán sù dōu jiě shì chéng yī gè rén .
meaning: Don't interpret every element as a person.

text: 他愿意演奏最后一段。
pinyin: tā yuàn yì yǎn zòu zuì hòu yī duàn .
meaning: He's willing to play the final passage.

text: 我先把歌词读完整。
pinyin: wǒ xiān bǎ gē cí dú wán zhěng .
meaning: I'll read the full lyrics first.

text: 她想找到合适的节奏。
pinyin: tā xiǎng zhǎo dào hé shì de jié zòu .
meaning: She wants to find a suitable rhythm.

text: 这首乐曲我想再听一遍。
pinyin: zhè shǒu yuè qǔ wǒ xiǎng zài tīng yī biàn .
meaning: I'd like to hear this piece again.

text: 同一场景又上演了一次。
pinyin: tóng yī chǎng jǐng yòu shàng yǎn le yī cì .

text: 你从哪一幕改变了对主角的看法？
pinyin: nǐ cóng nǎ yī mù gǎi biàn le duì zhǔ jué de kàn fǎ ?
meaning: Which scene changed your view of the lead?

text: 换了场景，人物关系没有全变。
pinyin: huàn le chǎng jǐng , rén wù guān xì méi yǒu quán biàn .
meaning: The setting changes without every relationship changing.

text: 先确认场馆的开放时间。
pinyin: xiān què rèn chǎng guǎn de kāi fàng shí jiān .
meaning: First confirm the venue's opening hours.

text: 她说不用每个人都来送行。
pinyin: tā shuō bù yòng měi gè rén dōu lái sòng xíng .
meaning: She says not everyone needs to see her off.

text: 这是一场难忘的见面。
pinyin: zhè shì yī chǎng nán wàng de jiàn miàn .

text: 她为错过那一幕感到遗憾。

text: 先听情绪，再看具体的词。
pinyin: xiān tīng qíng xù , zài kàn jù tǐ de cí .

text: 那句话里隐藏着一个没问出来的问题。
pinyin: nà jù huà lǐ yǐn cáng zhe yī gè méi wèn chū lái de wèn tí .

text: 她透露了下一场的地点。
pinyin: tā tòu lù le xià yī chǎng de dì diǎn .

text: 她收藏了几张旧照片。
pinyin: tā shōu cáng le jǐ zhāng jiù zhào piān .

text: 她盼望收到朋友的消息。

text: 他留言说今天会晚一点。
pinyin: tā liú yán shuō jīn tiān huì wǎn yī diǎn .

text: 她承诺到了以后发消息。
pinyin: tā chéng nuò dào le yǐ hòu fā xiāo xī .
meaning: She promised to message after arriving.

text: 她的心愿是走之前再一起唱一次。这个心愿一直没有说出口。这首歌写心灵里没有说完的话。书里的故事触动了她的心灵。海浪的声音接在最后一句后面。他们坐在岸边听海浪。她要去远方，但没有说永远不回来。这封信来自远方。这一句有孤独，也有期待。她有时觉得孤独，仍愿意联系朋友。一起排练增进了了解。这些交流能增进感情。我想平衡演出和休息。两种安排之间需要平衡。这段把说话和音乐融合起来。作品融合了两种形式。雨声是这段音乐的一个元素。别把每个元素都解释成一个人。演奏结束后，她才把信拿出来。他愿意演奏最后一段。歌词没有写归来的日期。我先把歌词读完整。这一段节奏慢下来，话却没变。她想找到合适的节奏。乐曲在说话之后开始。这首乐曲我想再听一遍。这段短剧今晚首次上演。同一场景又上演了一次。她上台以前先喝了水。上台并不表示不紧张。主角最后没有拆信。你从哪一幕改变了对主角的看法？这个场景发生在车站。换了场景，人物关系没有全变。场馆十点关闭。先确认场馆的开放时间。明早我们去车站送行。她说不用每个人都来送行。那段安静让我很难忘。这是一场难忘的见面。没唱完有点遗憾，但还能下次接着唱。她为错过那一幕感到遗憾。她的情绪在最后一段变了。先听情绪，再看具体的词。她没有隐藏要走的事。那句话里隐藏着一个没问出来的问题。结尾只透露他已经写过信。她透露了下一场的地点。我想收藏这张节目单。她收藏了几张旧照片。经过一番商量，我们先收东西。她一番话让我明白了。这段时而轻，时而响。她时而笑，时而看窗外。早晚还会见面，不等于已经定好日期。这个问题早晚要面对。她仿佛想说什么，又停了。雨声仿佛从窗外进来。我盼望下次一起唱。她盼望收到朋友的消息。到了以后给我们留言。他留言说今天会晚一点。没有确定时间，就别承诺周末回来。她承诺到了以后发消息。

text: 写这首歌的时候，我先写了灯还亮着，再把它放进车站那场戏后面。排练时有人说灯就是等那个朋友回来，我拿着吉他想了一会儿，说我开始写的是人走了，话还留在那个晚上。他说听起来也像在等，我就请他唱一遍他的版本。轮到我唱，最后一句又慢了一点，两个人把录音听完，都觉得那盏灯和开始写时已经有点不一样。至于下周，我连自己的工作时间还没排好，歌词里也确实没写日期。
pinyin: xiě zhè shǒu gē de shí hou , wǒ xiān xiě le dēng hái liàng zhe , zài bǎ tā fàng jìn chē zhàn nà chǎng xì hòu miàn . pái liàn shí yǒu rén shuō dēng jiù shì děng nà gè péng you huí lái , wǒ ná zhe jí tā xiǎng le yī huì er , shuō wǒ kāi shǐ xiě de shì rén zǒu le , huà hái liú zài nà gè wǎn shang . tā shuō tīng qǐ lái yě xiàng zài děng , wǒ jiù qǐng tā chàng yī biàn tā de bǎn běn . lún dào wǒ chàng , zuì hòu yī jù yòu màn le yī diǎn , liǎng gè rén bǎ lù yīn tīng wán , dōu jué de nà zhǎn dēng hé kāi shǐ xiě shí yǐ jīng yǒu diǎn bù yī yàng . zhì yú xià zhōu , wǒ lián zì jǐ de gōng zuò shí jiān hái méi pái hǎo , gē cí lǐ yě què shí méi xiě rì qī .
meaning: I first wrote 'the light is still on,' then placed it after the station scene. Someone heard waiting for the friend to return. Holding my guitar, I said I'd begun with someone leaving while the words stayed in that evening. We each sang a version; mine slowed the last line. Listening back, the lamp felt a little different from when I'd written it. As for next week, my own work schedule wasn't set, and the lyric gave no date.

text: 后来林安建议把下一页留给下一次见面放到后面，而不是开头。前面的雨声和脚步让人先听见离开，后面的那句才带出再见面的盼望。我喜欢这个顺序，可第一次唱太快，下一页几乎跟上一句粘在一起。朋友听完问，结尾不是说先停一停吗，怎么又约见面？我把两句完整读给他听，再按句子分开唱。他跟着读了一遍，笑着说这次听到了，不过最后那个面还能再留长一点。我试着慢下来，林安在旁边数了四下，两个人终于能接上。
pinyin: hòu lái lín ān jiàn yì bǎ xià yī yè liú gěi xià yī cì jiàn miàn fàng dào hòu miàn , ér bù shì kāi tóu . qián miàn de yǔ shēng hé jiǎo bù ràng rén xiān tīng jiàn lí kāi , hòu miàn de nà jù cái dài chū zài jiàn miàn de pàn wàng . wǒ xǐ huān zhè gè shùn xù , kě dì yī cì chàng tài kuài , xià yī yè jī hū gēn shàng yī jù zhān zài yì qǐ . péng you tīng wán wèn , jié wěi bù shì shuō xiān tíng yī tíng ma , zěn me yòu yuē jiàn miàn ? wǒ bǎ liǎng jù wán zhěng dú gěi tā tīng , zài àn jù zi fēn kāi chàng . tā gēn zhe dú le yī biàn , xiào zhe shuō zhè cì tīng dào le , bù guò zuì hòu nà gè miàn hái néng zài liú zhǎng yī diǎn . wǒ shì zhe màn xià lái , lín ān zài páng biān shù le sì xià , liǎng gè rén zhōng yú néng jiē shàng .
meaning: Lin An suggested putting 'leave the next page for our next meeting' near the end. Rain and footsteps first suggested departure; the later line brought back the hope of meeting. But I sang too quickly, joining it to the preceding phrase. My friend heard 'pause for now' and wondered why we were arranging a meeting. I read both lines in full, then sang them separately. He heard it this time, but suggested holding the final syllable a little longer. With Lin An counting four beats, we finally joined in time.

text: 我负责演奏，不演拿信的角色，所以排练时常从旁边看两人。有一次林安忘了把信放进包，直接拿在手上走，画面就像她随时会拆。我们试了两次，最后还是把信收进包，走到门边再回头。包带拉好以后，她看了一眼对方，没有拆信，就转身走。排练完，她问我刚才回头是不是太快。我说只看见头发动了，还没看清表情。她拿起包又走了一遍，回头时多停了一点。我举起吉他，按她走出去的速度再弹两句。陈宇站在门外听，提醒我们别走到一半就把灯关掉。
pinyin: wǒ fù zé yǎn zòu , bù yǎn ná xìn de jué sè , suǒ yǐ pái liàn shí cháng cóng páng biān kàn liǎng rén . yǒu yī cì lín ān wàng le bǎ xìn fàng jìn bāo , zhí jiē ná zài shǒu shàng zǒu , huà miàn jiù xiàng tā suí shí huì chāi . wǒ men shì le liǎng cì , zuì hòu hái shi bǎ xìn shōu jìn bāo , zǒu dào mén biān zài huí tóu . bāo dài lā hǎo yǐ hòu , tā kàn le yī yǎn duì fāng , méi yǒu chāi xìn , jiù zhuǎn shēn zǒu . pái liàn wán , tā wèn wǒ gāng cái huí tóu shì bú shì tài kuài . wǒ shuō zhǐ kàn jiàn tóu fà dòng le , hái méi kàn qīng biǎo qíng . tā ná qǐ bāo yòu zǒu le yī biàn , huí tóu shí duō tíng le yī diǎn . wǒ jǔ qǐ jí tā , àn tā zǒu chū qù de sù dù zài dàn liǎng jù . chén yǔ zhàn zài mén wài tīng , tí xǐng wǒ men bié zǒu dào yí bàn jiù bǎ dēng guān diào .
meaning: As the musician, I watched the two actors from the side. Once Lin An left carrying the letter in her hand, looking ready to open it. After two trials, we put it in the bag and had her look back at the door. She fastened the strap, looked at the other character and left without opening the letter. Had she turned too quickly? I'd seen her hair move but missed her expression. She tried again, pausing longer as she turned. I played two phrases to match her departure; listening outside, Chen reminded us not to switch off the light halfway through.

text: 演出那晚，有人把戏里的离开和林安明早坐车连在一起，围着她问以后还回不回来。她举着水杯，说先别急，明早九点的车，八点半入口见，带水就好。要上班的人不用特意赶去。我第二天有工作，听完松了口气，今晚还可以留下收东西。她把没喝完的水放到桌上，和我一起卷起节目单，说到了以后会发消息，我就请她到时把新房间拍给我们看。
pinyin: yǎn chū nà wǎn , yǒu rén bǎ xì lǐ de lí kāi hé lín ān míng zǎo zuò chē lián zài yì qǐ , wéi zhe tā wèn yǐ hòu hái huí bù huí lái . tā jǔ zhe shuǐ bēi , shuō xiān bié jí , míng zǎo jiǔ diǎn de chē , bā diǎn bàn rù kǒu jiàn , dài shuǐ jiù hǎo . yào shàng bān de rén bù yòng tè yì gǎn qù . wǒ dì èr tiān yǒu gōng zuò , tīng wán sōng le kǒu qì , jīn wǎn hái kě yǐ liú xià shōu dōng xi . tā bǎ méi hē wán de shuǐ fàng dào zhuō shàng , hé wǒ yì qǐ juǎn qǐ jié mù dān , shuō dào le yǐ hòu huì fā xiāo xī , wǒ jiù qǐng tā dào shí bǎ xīn fáng jiān pāi gěi wǒ men kàn .
meaning: After the performance we crowded round Lin An asking about returns. Holding her cup, she gave tomorrow's plan: a nine o'clock departure, meet at the entrance at 8:30, just bring water. People working needn't rush over. I had work and was relieved; I could still help pack tonight. Rolling up programmes together, she promised to message on arrival. I asked for a photograph of her new room.

text: 九点半以后，我们把设备关好。读书的人收纸，工作人员卷线，我把乐器装回盒子。有人走过来说再唱一分钟吧，我指着已经拔掉的线，说唱以前还得重新接线、调音，唱完又要收一遍。他看看空下来的桌子，说那算了，帮我把椅子搬过去。我在门口轻轻哼了一句，林安把最后一行接上，大家笑了。刚才还想再唱的人也跟着哼，没有回去开设备。工作人员拿来最后一把椅子，问我们明天是不是还起得来，我们马上把门让开，一边笑一边往外走。
pinyin: jiǔ diǎn bàn yǐ hòu , wǒ men bǎ shè bèi guān hǎo . dú shū de rén shōu zhǐ , gōng zuò rén yuán juǎn xiàn , wǒ bǎ yuè qì zhuāng huí hé zi . yǒu rén zǒu guò lái shuō zài chàng yī fēn zhōng ba , wǒ zhǐ zhe yǐ jīng bá diào de xiàn , shuō chàng yǐ qián hái děi chóng xīn jiē xiàn , diào yīn , chàng wán yòu yào shōu yī biàn . tā kàn kàn kōng xià lái de zhuō zi , shuō nà suàn le , bāng wǒ bǎ yǐ zi bān guò qù . wǒ zài mén kǒu qīng qīng hēng le yī jù , lín ān bǎ zuì hòu yī xíng jiē shàng , dà jiā xiào le . gāng cái hái xiǎng zài chàng de rén yě gēn zhe hēng , méi yǒu huí qù kāi shè bèi . gōng zuò rén yuán ná lái zuì hòu yī bǎ yǐ zi , wèn wǒ men míng tiān shì bú shì hái qǐ de lái , wǒ men mǎ shàng bǎ mén ràng kāi , yī biān xiào yī biān wǎng wài zǒu .
meaning: After 9:30 we shut down the equipment. Others gathered papers and coiled cables while I packed my instrument. Someone asked for one more minute of singing. I pointed to the disconnected cable: we'd have to reconnect, tune and pack again. Looking at the cleared table, he offered to carry chairs instead. At the door I hummed a phrase; Lin An joined the last line, and we laughed. Even the friend who'd wanted more singing hummed along without restarting anything. Carrying the final chair, a staff member asked if we'd manage to get up tomorrow. We moved out of the doorway, still laughing.

text: 第二天，我在群里看见林安到了的消息，回她新房间看起来怎么样。她说窗很大，东西还没收好，先问昨晚的录像在哪里。我找到文件，把递信和最后一首歌那两段发过去。后来有人问下一次什么时候，我说还没定，等大家把各自的时间发来再约。林安听完录音，指出最后一句比排练时慢，我也发现陈宇在门外那句提醒被录进去了。我们给重复的歌词标了两处，把这一版存好。她说先去收箱子，晚上再听，我回她好，别又把那半杯水忘在桌上。
pinyin: dì èr tiān , wǒ zài qún lǐ kàn jiàn lín ān dào le de xiāo xī , huí tā xīn fáng jiān kàn qǐ lái zěn me yàng . tā shuō chuāng hěn dà , dōng xi hái mò shōu hǎo , xiān wèn zuó wǎn de lù xiàng zài nǎ lǐ . wǒ zhǎo dào wén jiàn , bǎ dì xìn hé zuì hòu yī shǒu gē nà liǎng duàn fā guò qù . hòu lái yǒu rén wèn xià yī cì shén me shí hou , wǒ shuō hái méi dìng , děng dà jiā bǎ gè zì de shí jiān fā lái zài yuē . lín ān tīng wán lù yīn , zhǐ chū zuì hòu yī jù bǐ pái liàn shí màn , wǒ yě fā xiàn chén yǔ zài mén wài nà jù tí xǐng bèi lù jìn qù le . wǒ men gěi chóng fù de gē cí biāo le liǎng chù , bǎ zhè yī bǎn cún hǎo . tā shuō xiān qù shōu xiāng zi , wǎn shang zài tīng , wǒ huí tā hǎo , bié yòu bǎ nà bàn bēi shuǐ wàng zài zhuō shàng .
meaning: The next day Lin An posted that she'd arrived. Her new room had a big window, but she hadn't unpacked; where was last night's video? I sent the letter scene and final song. Asked about another performance, I said we'd wait for everyone's availability. Listening back, Lin An noticed a slower final line; I'd also caught Chen's reminder from outside the door on the recording. We marked two lyric repetitions and saved this version. She'd unpack first and listen again that evening. Fine, I replied—just don't forget another half-cup of water on the table.
