jiā bǎ gè zì de shí jiān fā lái zài yuē . lín ān tīng wán lù yīn , zhǐ chū zuì hòu yī jù bǐ pái liàn shí màn , wǒ yě fā xiàn chén yǔ zài mén wài nà jù tí xǐng bèi lù jìn qù le . wǒ men gěi chóng fù de gē cí biāo le liǎng chù , bǎ zhè yī bǎn cún hǎo . tā shuō xiān qù shōu xiāng zi , wǎn shang zài tīng , wǒ huí tā hǎo , bié yòu bǎ nà bàn bēi shuǐ wàng zài zhuō shàng .
meaning: I first wrote 'the light is still on,' then placed it after the station scene. Someone heard waiting for the friend to return. Holding my guitar, I said I'd begun with someone leaving while the words stayed in that evening. We each sang a version; mine slowed the last line. Listening back, the lamp felt a little different from when I'd written it. As for next week, my own work schedule wasn't set, and the lyric gave no date. Lin An suggested putting 'leave the next page for our next meeting' near the end. Rain and footsteps first suggested departure; the later line brought back the hope of meeting. But I sang too quickly, joining it to the preceding phrase. My friend heard 'pause for now' and wondered why we were arranging a meeting. I read both lines in full, then sang them separately. He heard it this time, but suggested holding the final syllable a little longer. With Lin An counting four beats, we finally joined in time. As the musician, I watched the two actors from the side. Once Lin An left carrying the letter in her hand, looking ready to open it. After two trials, we put it in the bag and had her look back at the door. She fastened the strap, looked at the other character and left without opening the letter. Had she turned too quickly? I'd seen her hair move but missed her expression. She tried again, pausing longer as she turned. I played two phrases to match her departure; listening outside, Chen reminded us not to switch off the light halfway through. After the performance we crowded round Lin An asking about returns. Holding her cup, she gave tomorrow's plan: a nine o'clock departure, meet at the entrance at 8:30, just bring water. People working needn't rush over. I had work and was relieved; I could still help pack tonight. Rolling up programmes together, she promised to message on arrival. I asked for a photograph of her new room. After 9:30 we shut down the equipment. Others gathered papers and coiled cables while I packed my instrument. Someone asked for one more minute of singing. I pointed to the disconnected cable: we'd have to reconnect, tune and pack again. Looking at the cleared table, he offered to carry chairs instead. At the door I hummed a phrase; Lin An joined the last line, and we laughed. Even the friend who'd wanted more singing hummed along without restarting anything. Carrying the final chair, a staff member asked if we'd manage to get up tomorrow. We moved out of the doorway, still laughing. The next day Lin An posted that she'd arrived. Her new room had a big window, but she hadn't unpacked; where was last night's video? I sent the letter scene and final song. Asked about another performance, I said we'd wait for everyone's availability. Listening back, Lin An noticed a slower final line; I'd also caught Chen's reminder from outside the door on the recording. We marked two lyric repetitions and saved this version. She'd unpack first and listen again that evening. Fine, I replied—just don't forget another half-cup of water on the table.

parts.text: 写这首歌的时候，我先写了灯还亮着，再把它放进车站那场戏后面。排练时有人说灯就是等那个朋友回来，我拿着吉他想了一会儿，说我开始写的是人走了，话还留在那个晚上。他说听起来也像在等，我就请他唱一遍他的版本。轮到我唱，最后一句又慢了一点，两个人把录音听完，都觉得那盏灯和开始写时已经有点不一样。至于下周，我连自己的工作时间还没排好，歌词里也确实没写日期。
后来林安建议把下一页留给下一次见面放到后面，而不是开头。前面的雨声和脚步让人先听见离开，后面的那句才带出再见面的盼望。我喜欢这个顺序，可第一次唱太快，下一页几乎跟上一句粘在一起。朋友听完问，结尾不是说先停一停吗，怎么又约见面？我把两句完整读给他听，再按句子分开唱。他跟着读了一遍，笑着说这次听到了，不过最后那个面还能再留长一点。我试着慢下来，林安在旁边数了四下，两个人终于能接上。

我负责演奏，不演拿信的角色，所以排练时常从旁边看两人。有一次林安忘了把信放进包，直接拿在手上走，画面就像她随时会拆。我们试了两次，最后还是把信收进包，走到门边再回头。包带拉好以后，她看了一眼对方，没有拆信，就转身走。排练完，她问我刚才回头是不是太快。我说只看见头发动了，还没看清表情。她拿起包又走了一遍，回头时多停了一点。我举起吉他，按她走出去的速度再弹两句。陈宇站在门外听，提醒我们别走到一半就把灯关掉。
演出那晚，有人把戏里的离开和林安明早坐车连在一起，围着她问以后还回不回来。她举着水杯，说先别急，明早九点的车，八点半入口见，带水就好。要上班的人不用特意赶去。我第二天有工作，听完松了口气，今晚还可以留下收东西。她把没喝完的水放到桌上，和我一起卷起节目单，说到了以后会发消息，我就请她到时把新房间拍给我们看。
九点半以后，我们把设备关好。读书的人收纸，工作人员卷线，我把乐器装回盒子。有人走过来说再唱一分钟吧，我指着已经拔掉的线，说唱以前还得重新接线、调音，唱完又要收一遍。他看看空下来的桌子，说那算了，帮我把椅子搬过去。我在门口轻轻哼了一句，林安把最后一行接上，大家笑了。刚才还想再唱的人也跟着哼，没有回去开设备。工作人员拿来最后一把椅子，问我们明天是不是还起得来，我们马上把门让开，一边笑一边往外走。
第二天，我在群里看见林安到了的消息，回她新房间看起来怎么样。她说窗很大，东西还没收好，先问昨晚的录像在哪里。我找到文件，把递信和最后一首歌那两段发过去。后来有人问下一次什么时候，我说还没定，等大家把各自的时间发来再约。林安听完录音，指出最后一句比排练时慢，我也发现陈宇在门外那句提醒被录进去了。我们给重复的歌词标了两处，把这一版存好。她说先去收箱子，晚上再听，我回她好，别又把那半杯水忘在桌上。

一首开头一首后面，就直接发节目单？
pinyin: yī shǒu kāi tóu yī shǒu hòu miàn , jiù zhí jiē fā jié mù dān ?
meaning: A song each end—publish now?

text: 先问演奏的人，再等场地确认。
那个新人没说话，要不要点名让她讲？
pinyin: nà gè xīn rén méi shuō huà , yào bù yào diǎn míng ràng tā jiǎng ?
meaning: A newcomer is quiet;call on her?

text: 可以问谁想补充，不必点名，她可以只听。
没时间聊音量，是不是就不管了？
pinyin: méi shí jiān liáo yīn liàng , shì bú shì jiù bù guǎn le ?
meaning: No time for volume means ignore it?

text: 留给设备联系人单独讨论，说明谁接着处理。
先别等我，你们进去。我是不来了吗？
pinyin: xiān bié děng wǒ , nǐ men jìn qù . wǒ shì bù lái le ma ?
meaning: Don’t wait for me now;go in.Does that mean not coming?

text: 不是，还会来，只是晚一点到。
不是不好，是没听懂。你听成不好了？
pinyin: bù shì bù hǎo , shì méi tīng dǒng . nǐ tīng chéng bù hǎo le ?
meaning: Not bad—didn’t understand.Did you hear bad?

text: 后半句说明没理解，不是给坏评价。
红门就是上次过桥那家吧？
pinyin: hóng mén jiù shì shàng cì guò qiáo nà jiā ba ?
meaning: Red door means the old place beyond the bridge?

text: 不是，这次挨着电影院，不用过桥。
待会儿就一定是十分钟？
pinyin: dāi huìr jiù yí dìng shì shí fēn zhōng ?
meaning: Shortly must mean ten minutes?

text: 不一定，要看车到没到，再确认大约多久。
信没拆，那里面一定让她别走？
pinyin: xìn méi chāi , nà lǐ miàn yí dìng ràng tā bié zǒu ?
meaning: Unopened letter must say do not leave?

text: 可以这样猜，但内容没给观众看，不能说一定。
歌词说下次见面，所以已经约好下周？
pinyin: gē cí shuō xià cì jiàn miàn , suǒ yǐ yǐ jīng yuē hǎo xià zhōu ?
meaning: Next meeting lyric means next week booked?

text: 不是，具体日期还没定。
再唱一分钟，收尾时间就只多一分钟吧？
pinyin: zài chàng yī fēn zhōng , shōu wěi shí jiān jiù zhǐ duō yī fēn zhōng ba ?
meaning: One minute singing adds only one minute?

text: 还要接线、调音和收好，不能只数唱的时间。
你答应到了留言，这也是歌词猜想？
pinyin: nǐ dā yìng dào le liú yán , zhè yě shì gē cí cāi xiǎng ?
meaning: Your arrival-message promise is also a lyric guess?

text: 不是，这是现实里直接答应的事。
你明天有空吗？
pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān yǒu kòng ma?
meaning: Are you free tomorrow?

text: 有空。几点？
pinyin: Yǒu kòng. Jǐ diǎn?
meaning: I am. What time?

text: 三点。一起喝咖啡吧。
pinyin: Sān diǎn. Yìqǐ hē kāfēi ba.
meaning: Three. Let’s have coffee together.

text: 你明天有空吗？ 有空。几点？ 三点。一起喝咖啡吧。 好啊，明天见！
pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān yǒu kòng ma? Yǒu kòng. Jǐ diǎn? Sān diǎn. Yìqǐ hē kāfēi ba. Hǎo a, míngtiān jiàn!
meaning: Are you free tomorrow? I am. What time? Three. Let’s have coffee together. Sure, see you tomorrow!

parts.text: 你明天有空吗？
有空。几点？
三点。一起喝咖啡吧。
好啊，明天见！

text: 你好！我是小夜。

pinyin: Rènzhēn yìdiǎn. Kāishǐ ba.
meaning: Focus. Let’s begin.

pinyin: Lái le? Kāishǐ ba.
meaning: You’re here? Let’s begin.

text: 再听一遍。
pinyin: Zài tīng yí biàn.
meaning: Listen once more.

text: 大声说。
pinyin: Dàshēng shuō.
meaning: Say it out loud.

text: 看清楚。
pinyin: Kàn qīngchu.
meaning: Look closely.

text: 一笔一笔来。
pinyin: Yì bǐ yì bǐ lái.
meaning: One stroke at a time.

text: 想一想。
pinyin: Xiǎng yi xiǎng.
meaning: Think it through.

text: 下次不看提示。
pinyin: Xià cì bú kàn tíshì.
meaning: Next time, no peeking.

text: 太棒了！
pinyin: Tài bàng le!
meaning: Fantastic!

text: 不错嘛。
pinyin: Bú cuò ma.
meaning: Not bad at all.

text: 再来。
pinyin: Zài lái.
meaning: Again.

text: 声调呢？
pinyin: Shēngdiào ne?
meaning: And the tone?

text: 还记得吗？
pinyin: Hái jìde ma?
meaning: Still remember?

text: 今天够了。
pinyin: Jīntiān gòu le.
meaning: That’s enough for today.

text: 又断了。
pinyin: Yòu duàn le.
meaning: Cut off again.

text: 升级了！
pinyin: Shēngjí le!
meaning: Level up!

text: 天天来。
pinyin: Tiāntiān lái.
meaning: Come back every day.

text: 这次有帮手。
pinyin: Zhè cì yǒu bāngshǒu.
meaning: You had a helper this time.

text: 没事，慢慢来。
pinyin: Méi shì, mànmàn lái.
meaning: It’s okay. Take your time.

text: 这一课拿下了。
pinyin: Zhè yí kè ná xià le.
meaning: You finished this lesson.

text: 对了。
pinyin: Duì le.
meaning: That’s right.

text: 很好。
pinyin: Hěn hǎo.
meaning: Very good.

text: 差一点。
pinyin: Chà yìdiǎn.
meaning: So close.

text: 没关系，再试试。
pinyin: Méi guānxi, zài shìshi.
meaning: No problem. Try again.

text: 从这儿开始。
pinyin: Cóng zhèr kāishǐ.
meaning: Start here.

text: 今天学得不错。
pinyin: Jīntiān xué de bú cuò.
meaning: Good work today.

text: 哎，对了！
pinyin: Āi, duì le!
meaning: Hey, that’s right!

text: 这就对了嘛。
pinyin: Zhè jiù duì le ma.
meaning: There you go.

text: 嗯，有点厉害。
pinyin: Ńg, yǒudiǎn lìhai.
meaning: Hmm. Pretty good.

text: 可以啊，你。
pinyin: Kěyǐ a, nǐ.
meaning: Look at you.

text: 嘿，答对了。
pinyin: Hēi, dá duì le.
meaning: Hey, you got it.

text: 这题拿下。
pinyin: Zhè tí ná xià.
meaning: That one’s yours.

text: 好，这个会了。
pinyin: Hǎo, zhège huì le.
meaning: Good. You got this one.

text: 哦，你记得。
pinyin: Ó, nǐ jìde.
meaning: Oh, you remembered.

text: 就这么来。
pinyin: Jiù zhème lái.
meaning: Keep doing that.

text: 好嘛，挺稳。
pinyin: Hǎo ma, tǐng wěn.
meaning: Well, that was solid.

text: 这次不用我了。
pinyin: Zhè cì bú yòng wǒ le.
meaning: You didn’t need me this time.

text: 有进步嘛。
pinyin: Yǒu jìnbù ma.
meaning: Hey, progress.

text: 好，接住了。
pinyin: Hǎo, jiē zhù le.
meaning: Good. You caught it.

text: 你看，做到了吧。
pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zuò dào le ba.
meaning: See? You did it.

text: 这下记住了。
pinyin: Zhè xià jì zhù le.
meaning: Now you’ve got it.

text: 行，有两下子。
pinyin: Xíng, yǒu liǎng xiàzi.
meaning: Okay. You’ve got something.

text: 嗯，我看见了。
pinyin: Ńg, wǒ kàn jiàn le.
meaning: Hmm. I saw that.

text: 不错，真的。
pinyin: Bú cuò, zhēn de.
meaning: Not bad. Really.

text: 好吧，夸你一下。
pinyin: Hǎo ba, kuā nǐ yí xià.
meaning: Fine. A little praise for you.

text: 别笑，下一题。
pinyin: Bié xiào, xià yì tí.
meaning: Don’t grin. Next question.

text: 嗯，这个漂亮。
pinyin: Ńg, zhège piàoliang.
meaning: Hmm. Nicely done.

text: 今天挺认真嘛。
pinyin: Jīntiān tǐng rènzhēn ma.
meaning: Taking this seriously today, huh?

text: 好，我没白等。
pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ méi bái děng.
meaning: Good. Worth the wait.

text: 这题过关。
pinyin: Zhè tí guò guān.
meaning: This question is cleared.

text: 嗯，放心往下走。
pinyin: Ńg, fàngxīn wǎng xià zǒu.
meaning: Hmm. Go on with confidence.

text: 就是这样！
pinyin: Jiù shì zhèyàng!
meaning: That’s it!

text: 好，继续！
pinyin: Hǎo, jìxù!
meaning: Good. Keep going!

text: 答得好！
pinyin: Dá de hǎo!
meaning: Good answer!

text: 这题漂亮！
pinyin: Zhè tí piàoliang!
meaning: Beautifully done!

text: 行啊！下一题！
pinyin: Xíng a! Xià yì tí!
meaning: Nice! Next question!

text: 先别急着选。
pinyin: Xiān bié jí zhe xuǎn.

text: 再看一眼就好。
pinyin: Zài kàn yì yǎn jiù hǎo.
meaning: Just take another look.

text: 换个思路试试。

pinyin: Tíng yí xià, zài xiǎngxiang.

pinyin: Cuò yí cì, méi guānxi.
meaning: One mistake is okay.

text: 这个容易混。
pinyin: Zhège róngyì hùn.

meaning: Hey, wrong turn.

text: 嗯？再瞧瞧。
pinyin: Ńg? Zài qiáoqiao.
meaning: Hmm? Look again.

pinyin: Bié jí, tí hái zài ne.

text: 这个有点狡猾。
pinyin: Zhège yǒudiǎn jiǎohuá.

text: 好，我们重来。
pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen chóng lái.
meaning: Okay. Let’s try again.

text: 就差那么一点。
pinyin: Jiù chà nàme yìdiǎn.
meaning: Hey, just a little off.

text: 答案在这儿呢。
pinyin: Dá’àn zài zhèr ne.
meaning: The answer is right here.

text: 先别和题吵架。
pinyin: Xiān bié hé tí chǎojià.
meaning: Don’t argue with the question yet.

text: 我们再见它一次。
pinyin: Wǒmen zài jiàn tā yí cì.
meaning: We’ll meet this one again.

text: 好了，记住这个。
pinyin: Hǎo le, jì zhù zhège.
meaning: All right. Remember this one.

meaning: The hint helped. Remember that.

pinyin: Kàn le tíshì, yě yào jì zhù.

text: 下一次，自己来。
pinyin: Xià yí cì, zìjǐ lái.
meaning: Next time, on your own.

text: 先记住，再藏起来。
pinyin: Xiān jì zhù, zài cáng qǐlai.
meaning: Learn it, then hide the help.

text: 提示可以用，别住里面。
pinyin: Tíshì kěyǐ yòng, bié zhù lǐmiàn.

text: 现在试着自己记。
pinyin: Xiànzài shì zhe zìjǐ jì.

text: 好，下回不偷看。

text: 这个还要自己练。

text: 字看到了，记住了吗？

text: 别忘了刚才的提示。
pinyin: Bié wàng le gāngcái de tíshì.
meaning: Remember what the hint showed you.

text: 再练一次，不看提示。
pinyin: Zài liàn yí cì, bú kàn tíshì.
meaning: Practise once more without the hint.

text: 答案看过，要收进脑袋。
pinyin: Dá’àn kàn guo, yào shōu jìn nǎodai.
meaning: You saw it. Put it in your head.

text: 好，提示先放一边。
pinyin: Hǎo, tíshì xiān fàng yì biān.
meaning: Okay. Put the hint aside.

text: 先听声调。
pinyin: Xiān tīng shēngdiào.

text: 注意声音的走向。
pinyin: Zhùyì shēngyīn de zǒuxiàng.
meaning: Notice where the sound goes.

text: 再听，不要急。
pinyin: Zài tīng, bú yào jí.
meaning: Listen again. Don’t rush to guess.

text: 听清楚，再选。
pinyin: Tīng qīngchu, zài xuǎn.
meaning: Listen carefully, then choose.

text: 把这一声听完。
pinyin: Bǎ zhè yì shēng tīng wán.
meaning: Hear this sound all the way through.

text: 先听，再跟着说。
pinyin: Xiān tīng, zài gēn zhe shuō.
meaning: Listen, then say it along with me.

text: 这一声再比较一下。
pinyin: Zhè yì shēng zài bǐjiào yí xià.
meaning: Compare this sound again.

text: 别只听开头。
pinyin: Bié zhǐ tīng kāitóu.
meaning: Don’t just listen to the start.

text: 慢一点，听完整。
pinyin: Màn yìdiǎn, tīng wánzhěng.
meaning: Slow down. Hear the whole sound.

text: 声音有区别，找找看。
pinyin: Shēngyīn yǒu qūbié, zhǎozhao kàn.

text: 好，练过了。
pinyin: Hǎo, liàn guo le.
meaning: Okay. You practised it.

text: 先记下这次练习。
pinyin: Xiān jì xià zhè cì liànxí.

text: 练习留住了。

meaning: Your practice is saved.

text: 好，往下走。
pinyin: Hǎo, wǎng xià zǒu.
meaning: Okay. Move on.

text: 这一步完成了。
pinyin: Zhè yí bù wánchéng le.
meaning: This step is done.

text: 收到，继续吧。
pinyin: Shōu dào, jìxù ba.
meaning: Got it. Keep going.

text: 好，我们接着来。
pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen jiē zhe lái.
meaning: Okay. Let’s carry on.

text: 练过就留个记录。
pinyin: Liàn guo jiù liú ge jìlù.
meaning: Keep a record of the practice.

text: 这次练习收好了。
pinyin: Zhè cì liànxí shōu hǎo le.
meaning: This practice is saved away.

text: 嗯，再走一步。
pinyin: Ńg, zài zǒu yí bù.
meaning: Hmm. One more step.

text: 好，今天这一课完成。
pinyin: Hǎo, jīntiān zhè yí kè wánchéng.
meaning: Good. Today’s lesson is done.

text: 下课了，别全忘了。
pinyin: Xià kè le, bié quán wàng le.
meaning: Class dismissed. Don’t forget everything.

text: 辛苦了，休息一下。
pinyin: Xīnkǔ le, xiūxi yí xià.
meaning: Good work. Take a little break.

text: 收工，明天见。
pinyin: Shōu gōng, míngtiān jiàn.
meaning: Done for now. See you tomorrow.

text: 好，脑袋休息一下。
pinyin: Hǎo, nǎodai xiūxi yí xià.
meaning: Okay. Give your head a break.

text: 嗯，今天没白来。
pinyin: Ńg, jīntiān méi bái lái.
meaning: Hmm. Today was worth showing up for.

text: 先歇歇，我也歇歇。
pinyin: Xiān xiēxie, wǒ yě xiēxie.
meaning: Take a break. I’ll take one too.

text: 学完了，喝点水。
pinyin: Xué wán le, hē diǎn shuǐ.
meaning: Lesson done. Have some water.

text: 下次来，别装不认识。
pinyin: Xià cì lái, bié zhuāng bú rènshi.
meaning: Next time, don’t pretend we haven’t met.

text: 又完成一课！
pinyin: Yòu wánchéng yí kè!
meaning: Another lesson finished!

text: 好，往前一步！
pinyin: Hǎo, wǎng qián yí bù!

text: 新的一课，拿下！
pinyin: Xīn de yí kè, ná xià!

text: 这一步，走到了！
pinyin: Zhè yí bù, zǒu dào le!
meaning: You reached this step!

text: 行，继续往前！
pinyin: Xíng, jìxù wǎng qián!

text: 不错。下一关。
pinyin: Búcuò. Xià yì guān.
meaning: Good. Next checkpoint.

text: 先改错，再往前。
pinyin: Xiān gǎicuò, zài wǎng qián.
meaning: Fix the mistakes. Then move on.

text: 看清题目，别急。
pinyin: Kàn qīng tímù, bié jí.
meaning: Read the question. Don’t rush.

text: 怕什么啊有时让人不舒服，有时是朋友的支持，要听前后说的话。
pinyin: pà shén me a yǒu shí ràng rén bù shū fú , yǒu shí shì péng you de zhī chí , yào tīng qián hòu shuō de huà .
meaning: 怕什么啊 can be uncomfortable or supportive from a friend; listen to what is said around it.

text: 比起自己练，我更喜欢一起读，但今天先自己试。
pinyin: bǐ qǐ zì jǐ liàn , wǒ gèng xǐ huān yì qǐ dú , dàn jīn tiān xiān zì jǐ shì .
meaning: I prefer reading together to solo practice, but will try alone today.

text: 标题说重大，内容还没给具体情况。
pinyin: biāo tí shuō zhòng dà , nèi róng hái méi gěi jù tǐ qíng kuàng .
meaning: The headline says significant; the body gives no details yet.

text: 都十点了，今天先到这里，下次再来。
pinyin: dōu shí diǎn le , jīn tiān xiān dào zhè lǐ , xià cì zài lái .
meaning: It is already ten; stop here today and return next time.

text: 群里还要等她自己的回答。
pinyin: qún lǐ hái yào děng tā zì jǐ de huí dá .
meaning: The group chat still awaits her own answer.

text: 高度
pinyin: gāo dù
meaning: Height

text: 原来的牌子写九点，新通知写十点；两条的时间不同。
pinyin: yuán lái de pái zi xiě jiǔ diǎn , xīn tōng zhī xiě shí diǎn ; liǎng tiáo de shí jiān bù tóng .
meaning: The old sign says nine and the new notice ten; the two are not one time.

text: 谈过不等于答应，群里最后还要等她自己说。
pinyin: tán guò bù děng yú dā ying , qún lǐ zuì hòu hái yào děng tā zì jǐ shuō .
meaning: Discussion is not agreement; the final group-chat line awaits her own answer.

text: 第一段：周六我可以帮忙，但是三点要走。第二段：我们四点才开始搬桌子。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : zhōu liù wǒ kě yǐ bāng máng , dàn shì sān diǎn yào zǒu . dì èr duàn : wǒ men sì diǎn cái kāi shǐ bān zhuō zi .
meaning: Text 1: I can help on Saturday, but I have to leave at three. Text 2: We start moving the tables at four.

text: 我到店了，你慢慢来。先别替我买票，我朋友可能已经买了。等她回复再说。
pinyin: wǒ dào diàn le , nǐ màn màn lái . xiān bié tì wǒ mǎi piào , wǒ péng you kě néng yǐ jīng mǎi le . děng tā huí fù zài shuō .
meaning: I'm at the shop. Take your time. Don't buy my ticket yet; my friend may already have bought it. Wait for her reply.

text: 只有她同意我们才把照片发出去
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu tā tóng yì wǒ men cái bǎ zhào piān fā chū qù
meaning: We only send the photo if she agrees.

text: 虽然雨很大，我们还是按时到了。
pinyin: suī rán yǔ hěn dà , wǒ men hái shi àn shí dào le .
meaning: Although the rain is heavy, we still arrive on time.

text: 她觉得电影不错，但不太喜欢最后一段。朋友问要不要建议看，她说可以，不过先别把最后一段讲出来。
pinyin: tā jué de diàn yǐng bù cuò , dàn bù tài xǐ huān zuì hòu yī duàn . péng you wèn yào bù yào jiàn yì kàn , tā shuō kě yǐ , bù guò xiān bié bǎ zuì hòu yī duàn jiǎng chū lái .
meaning: She likes most of the film, but not the ending. She would recommend it, with no spoilers.

text: 大雨没有让我们取消见面，只是从公园改到咖啡店，时间仍是两点。
pinyin: dà yǔ méi yǒu ràng wǒ men qǔ xiāo jiàn miàn , zhǐ shì cóng gōng yuán gǎi dào kā fēi diàn , shí jiān réng shì liǎng diǎn .
meaning: The heavy rain didn't cancel our meeting. We moved it from the park to a café, still at two.

text: 他原来想报两个班，发现上课时间相同，只报了周三口语班。读书班等下次。
pinyin: tā yuán lái xiǎng bào liǎng gè bān , fā xiàn shàng kè shí jiān xiāng tóng , zhǐ bào le zhōu sān kǒu yǔ bān . dú shū bān děng xià cì .
meaning: He planned to take two classes, but their times clash. This time he enrolled only in Wednesday speaking.

text: 你别误会，我不是不想帮，只是今天六点以后才有空。如果五点就结束，那今天帮不上。
pinyin: nǐ bié wù huì , wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng bāng , zhǐ shì jīn tiān liù diǎn yǐ hòu cái yǒu kōng . rú guǒ wǔ diǎn jiù jié shù , nà jīn tiān bāng bù shàng .
meaning: Don't misunderstand: I want to help, but I'm only free after six. If it ends at five, I can't help today.

text: 只有她同意，我们才发照片。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu tā tóng yì , wǒ men cái fā zhào piān .
meaning: We only share the photo if she agrees.

text: 哪怕
pinyin: nǎ pà
meaning: Even if.

text: 她说这件外套挺好看，就是有点大。服务员建议换小一号，她说先试试，还没决定买。
pinyin: tā shuō zhè jiàn wài tào tǐng hǎo kàn , jiù shì yǒu diǎn dà . fú wù yuán jiàn yì huàn xiǎo yī hào , tā shuō xiān shì shì , hái méi jué dìng mǎi .
meaning: She likes the coat, but it's a little big. She'll try a smaller size before deciding.

text: 这句话是开玩笑，但你没觉得好笑，我就不继续说。不是让你必须跟着笑。
pinyin: zhè jù huà shì kāi wán xiào , dàn nǐ méi jué de hǎo xiào , wǒ jiù bù jì xù shuō . bù shì ràng nǐ bì xū gēn zhe xiào .
meaning: It was a joke, but if you didn't find it funny, I'll stop. You don't have to laugh.

text: 第一段：歌里唱窗户一直开着。第二段：活动通知说九点关闭小房间。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : gē lǐ chàng chuāng hù yì zhí kāi zhe . dì èr duàn : huó dòng tōng zhī shuō jiǔ diǎn guān bì xiǎo fáng jiān .
meaning: Text 1: The song says the window stays open. Text 2: The notice says the room closes at nine.

text: 我问的是这次报名，不是以前有没有学过。她以前学过写作，这次只报口语。
pinyin: wǒ wèn de shì zhè cì bào míng , bù shì yǐ qián yǒu méi yǒu xué guò . tā yǐ qián xué guò xiě zuò , zhè cì zhǐ bào kǒu yǔ .
meaning: I'm asking about this enrolment, not previous study. She studied writing before; this time she enrolled only in speaking.

text: 这本书被她放回了原来的地方
pinyin: zhè běn shū bèi tā fàng huí le yuán lái de dì fāng
meaning: She put the book back in its original place.

text: 我把资料放回原来的地方了。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ zī liào fàng huí yuán lái de dì fāng le .
meaning: I returned the materials to their original place.

text: 两个人各点三十五元的饭，另外一杯茶十元，约好三人付相同的钱，一起分全部费用。第三人只喝茶，也同意这样分。
pinyin: liǎng gè rén gè diǎn sān shí wǔ yuán de fàn , lìng wài yī bēi chá shí yuán , yuē hǎo sān rén fù xiāng tóng de qián , yì qǐ fēn quán bù fèi yòng . dì sān rén zhǐ hē chá , yě tóng yì zhè yàng fēn .
meaning: Two meals cost 35 yuan each and a tea costs 10. All three friends agree to split the whole bill equally.

text: 原来九点开门，新通知说九点半。你九点到可能要等，不是说今天不开。
pinyin: yuán lái jiǔ diǎn kāi mén , xīn tōng zhī shuō jiǔ diǎn bàn . nǐ jiǔ diǎn dào kě néng yào děng , bù shì shuō jīn tiān bù kāi .
meaning: It used to open at nine. The new notice says nine thirty. Arriving at nine may mean waiting, not that it's closed all day.

text: 为了赶车，她没有参加第二段讨论。她说第一段很有意思，下次如果时间合适还想来。
pinyin: wèi le gǎn chē , tā méi yǒu cān jiā dì èr duàn tǎo lùn . tā shuō dì yī duàn hěn yǒu yì si , xià cì rú guǒ shí jiān hé shì hái xiǎng lái .
meaning: She misses the second discussion to catch a bus. She liked the first part and might return if the timing works.

text: 不用一口气讲完，你先说最重要的。我想知道为什么改地点，别的细节以后补。
pinyin: bù yòng yì kǒu qì jiǎng wán , nǐ xiān shuō zuì zhòng yào de . wǒ xiǎng zhī dào wèi shén me gǎi dì diǎn , bié de xì jié yǐ hòu bǔ .
meaning: You don't need to tell me everything at once. Start with why the place changed; the other details can wait.

text: 我把结束时间写清楚了
pinyin: wǒ bǎ jié shù shí jiān xiě qīng chǔ le
meaning: I wrote the ending time clearly.

text: 他既会唱歌，又会写歌词。
pinyin: tā jì huì chàng gē , yòu huì xiě gē cí .
meaning: He can both sing and write lyrics.

text: 朋友写我可能周五来，还要看工作能不能提前结束。负责的人把名字放在还没确认的地方，没有算进已答应人数。
pinyin: péng you xiě wǒ kě néng zhōu wǔ lái , hái yào kàn gōng zuò néng bù néng tí qián jié shù . fù zé de rén bǎ míng zi fàng zài hái méi què rèn de dì fāng , méi yǒu suàn jìn yǐ dā ying rén shù .
meaning: A friend may come on Friday if work finishes early. The organiser keeps the name unconfirmed.

text: 我不是说电影不好，我是没看懂姐姐为什么把信留在桌子上。你看到那一段了吗？
pinyin: wǒ bù shì shuō diàn yǐng bù hǎo , wǒ shì méi kàn dǒng jiě jie wèi shén me bǎ xìn liú zài zhuō zi shàng . nǐ kàn dào nà yī duàn le ma ?
meaning: I'm not saying the film is bad. I didn't understand why the sister left the letter on the table. Did you see that part?

text: 第一段：这个房间安静，我喜欢。第二段：这个房间小，二十个人坐不下。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : zhè gè fáng jiān ān jìng , wǒ xǐ huān . dì èr duàn : zhè gè fáng jiān xiǎo , èr shí gè rén zuò bù xià .
meaning: Text 1: I like this quiet room. Text 2: It's too small for twenty people.

text: 给我留水就好，不用先点饭。我路上吃过一点，到了看饿不饿。
pinyin: gěi wǒ liú shuǐ jiù hǎo , bù yòng xiān diǎn fàn . wǒ lù shàng chī guò yī diǎn , dào le kàn è bù è .
meaning: Just save me some water. Don't order food for me yet. I ate a little on the way and will decide when I arrive.

text: 她不是不去只是晚一点到
pinyin: tā bù shì bù qù zhǐ shì wǎn yī diǎn dào
meaning: She is going; she'll just arrive a little later.

text: 我们先确认地点，然后报名。
pinyin: wǒ men xiān què rèn dì diǎn , rán hòu bào míng .
meaning: We confirm the place, then enrol.

text: 她没有说你做错了，只是问这份资料能不能发给大家。回答还要问作者，所以先没有发。
pinyin: tā méi yǒu shuō nǐ zuò cuò le , zhǐ shì wèn zhè fèn zī liào néng bù néng fā gěi dà jiā . huí dá hái yào wèn zuò zhě , suǒ yǐ xiān méi yǒu fā .
meaning: She asks whether the materials can be shared. The answer is that they still need to ask the author, so they haven't sent them.

text: 你刚才说周四还是周五？这里太吵，我没听清楚，不是已经答应两个晚上都来。
pinyin: nǐ gāng cái shuō zhōu sì hái shi zhōu wǔ ? zhè lǐ tài chǎo , wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ , bù shì yǐ jīng dā ying liǎng gè wǎn shang dōu lái .
meaning: Did you say Thursday or Friday? It's too noisy and I didn't catch it. I haven't agreed to come on both evenings.

text: 第一段：周五前回复才保留座位。第二段：她周六上午才回复。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : zhōu wǔ qián huí fù cái bǎo liú zuò wèi . dì èr duàn : tā zhōu liù shàng wǔ cái huí fù .
meaning: Text 1: Reply before Friday to keep the seat. Text 2: She replies on Saturday morning.

text: 今天别从老入口进，新入口在东边，跟原来的停车地方不同。我发照片给你。
pinyin: jīn tiān bié cóng lǎo rù kǒu jìn , xīn rù kǒu zài dōng biān , gēn yuán lái de tíng chē dì fāng bù tóng . wǒ fā zhào piān gěi nǐ .
meaning: Don't use the old entrance today. The new entrance is on the east side, away from the old parking area. I'll send you a photo.

text: 既然你还没收到回答就先确认一下
pinyin: jì rán nǐ hái mò shōu dào huí dá jiù xiān què rèn yī xià
meaning: Since you haven't received a reply, check first.

text: 手机支架正面承受十二公斤没有问题，背面按同样方法测，超过十公斤就不稳。她想放十一公斤的设备，要求两面都稳。
pinyin: shǒu jī zhī jià zhèng miàn chéng shòu shí èr gōng jīn méi yǒu wèn tí , bèi miàn àn tóng yàng fāng fǎ cè , chāo guò shí gōng jīn jiù bù wěn . tā xiǎng fàng shí yī gōng jīn de shè bèi , yāo qiú liǎng miàn dōu wěn .
meaning: The front of the phone stand holds twelve kilograms. The back becomes unstable above ten. An eleven-kilogram device needs both sides stable.

text: 我只是说她那句写得好，不是说整篇都不用改。第二段还是有点重复。
pinyin: wǒ zhǐ shì shuō tā nà jù xiě de hǎo , bù shì shuō zhěng piān dōu bù yòng gǎi . dì èr duàn hái shi yǒu diǎn chóng fù .
meaning: I said that one sentence was well written, not that the whole article needs no revision. The second paragraph still repeats itself.

text: 第一组说先整理资料再讨论，第二组说可以边整理边讨论。两组都希望周五前做完。
pinyin: dì yī zǔ shuō xiān zhěng lǐ zī liào zài tǎo lùn , dì èr zǔ shuō kě yǐ biān zhěng lǐ biān tǎo lùn . liǎng zǔ dōu xī wàng zhōu wǔ qián zuò wán .
meaning: One group wants to sort the materials before discussing them; the other wants to do both together. Both want to finish before Friday.

text: 周三免费课不用付费，周五正式课一千二百元，书另外买。你别以为听免费课就是已经报名正式课。
pinyin: zhōu sān miǎn fèi kè bù yòng fù fèi , zhōu wǔ zhèng shì kè yī qiān èr bǎi yuán , shū lìng wài mǎi . nǐ bié yǐ wéi tīng miǎn fèi kè jiù shì yǐ jīng bào míng zhèng shì kè .
meaning: Wednesday's trial class is free. Friday's full course costs 1,200 yuan, with books bought separately. Taking the trial doesn't enrol you in the full course.

text: 无论谁先到都先进去坐
pinyin: wú lùn shéi xiān dào dōu xiān jìn qù zuò
meaning: Whoever arrives first should go inside and sit.

text: 公共汽车临时取消，工作的人说十五点十分有替代车。原来十四点的安排不能继续。她给朋友发了新时间。
pinyin: gōng gòng qì chē lín shí qǔ xiāo , gōng zuò de rén shuō shí wǔ diǎn shí fēn yǒu tì dài chē . yuán lái shí sì diǎn de ān pái bù néng jì xù . tā gěi péng you fā le xīn shí jiān .
meaning: The two o'clock bus is cancelled. Staff announce a replacement at 15:10, and she sends her friend the new time.

text: 他不是没做，只是没按我们说的两面分别测试。先把方法说清楚，再重新做。
pinyin: tā bù shì méi zuò , zhǐ shì méi àn wǒ men shuō de liǎng miàn fēn bié cè shì . xiān bǎ fāng fǎ shuō qīng chǔ , zài chóng xīn zuò .
meaning: He did do the work, but didn't test the two sides separately as requested. Let's clarify the method and do it again.

text: 周六生日聚会她不参加，建议周二晚上七点单独吃饭。朋友说周二可以，地点还没定。
pinyin: zhōu liù shēng rì jù huì tā bù cān jiā , jiàn yì zhōu èr wǎn shang qī diǎn dān dú chī fàn . péng you shuō zhōu èr kě yǐ , dì diǎn hái méi dìng .
meaning: She declines Saturday's birthday gathering and suggests dinner at seven on Tuesday. Her friend agrees to the time; the place isn't settled.

text: 她今天想一个人安静坐一会儿，不是跟谁生气。你可以发一句有需要就叫我，不必一直问。
pinyin: tā jīn tiān xiǎng yī gè rén ān jìng zuò yī huìr , bù shì gēn shéi shēng qì . nǐ kě yǐ fā yī jù yǒu xū yào jiù jiào wǒ , bù bì yì zhí wèn .
meaning: She wants to sit quietly alone for a while; she's not angry with anyone. You can say, 'Call me if you need anything,' without continually asking.

text: 如果她没有同意就不要发照片
pinyin: rú guǒ tā méi yǒu tóng yì jiù bú yào fā zhào piān
meaning: If she hasn't agreed, don't send the photo.

text: 她说真早啊，那时朋友比约定晚了二十分钟。后来她明确说是在开玩笑，希望下次早点。
pinyin: tā shuō zhēn zǎo a , nà shí péng you bǐ yuē dìng wǎn le èr shí fēn zhōng . hòu lái tā míng què shuō shì zài kāi wán xiào , xī wàng xià cì zǎo diǎn .
meaning: Her friend is twenty minutes late. She says, 'Really early!' and then says she's joking and hopes they'll come earlier next time.

text: 十八点开始表演，十七点半先确认设备。来帮忙的人按十七点半，不是十八点才到。
pinyin: shí bā diǎn kāi shǐ biǎo yǎn , shí qī diǎn bàn xiān què rèn shè bèi . lái bāng máng de rén àn shí qī diǎn bàn , bù shì shí bā diǎn cái dào .
meaning: The performance begins at six. Equipment checks start at five thirty. Helpers should come for the checks.

text: 第一段：只要天气好就去。第二段：今天下雨，所以没有去。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : zhǐ yào tiān qì hǎo jiù qù . dì èr duàn : jīn tiān xià yǔ , suǒ yǐ méi yǒu qù .
meaning: Text 1: If the weather is good, we'll go. Text 2: Today it rained, so we didn't go.

text: 我喜欢这个建议，不过还要问活动的地方能不能安排，不是现在就宣布下周一定开始。
pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān zhè gè jiàn yì , bù guò hái yào wèn huó dòng de dì fāng néng bù néng ān pái , bù shì xiàn zài jiù xuān bù xià zhōu yí dìng kāi shǐ .
meaning: I like the suggestion, but we still need to ask whether the venue can arrange it. We can't announce a definite start next week yet.

text: 她把信收进包里了
pinyin: tā bǎ xìn shōu jìn bāo lǐ le
meaning: She put the letter into her bag.

text: 她不仅会唱，也会写。
pinyin: tā bù jǐn huì chàng , yě huì xiě .
meaning: She can sing and also write.

text: 她想学夜间课程，但是下班时间常变。她先问能不能补听，再决定要不要报名。
pinyin: tā xiǎng xué yè jiān kè chéng , dàn shì xià bān shí jiān cháng biàn . tā xiān wèn néng bù néng bǔ tīng , zài jué dìng yào bù yào bào míng .
meaning: She wants an evening course, but her finishing time at work varies. She asks about catching up on missed classes before deciding.

text: 从今天起每天复习十分钟，不是今天一次做七十分钟就算一周每天都做了。
pinyin: cóng jīn tiān qǐ měi tiān fù xí shí fēn zhōng , bù shì jīn tiān yī cì zuò qī shí fēn zhōng jiù suàn yī zhōu měi tiān dōu zuò le .
meaning: Review for ten minutes every day from today. One seventy-minute session doesn't count as reviewing on all seven days.

text: 影片最后一段她把信收进包，没有打开。朋友认为是不敢看，另外一人认为想到了以后看。画面没给理由。
pinyin: yǐng piàn zuì hòu yī duàn tā bǎ xìn shōu jìn bāo , méi yǒu dǎ kāi . péng you rèn wéi shì bù gǎn kàn , lìng wài yī rén rèn wéi xiǎng dào le yǐ hòu kàn . huà miàn méi gěi lǐ yóu .
meaning: In the final scene she puts an unopened letter in her bag. One friend thinks she's afraid to read it; another thinks she's saving it for later. The film doesn't give a reason.

text: 那句你别让我先讲，是朋友笑着说的。他接着说今天想先听，一会儿再补。
pinyin: nà jù nǐ bié ràng wǒ xiān jiǎng , shì péng you xiào zhe shuō de . tā jiē zhe shuō jīn tiān xiǎng xiān tīng , yī huìr zài bǔ .
meaning: The friend smiled and said, 'Don't make me speak first.' He explained that he wanted to listen first and add something later.

text: 我们先确认场地再报名
pinyin: wǒ men xiān què rèn chǎng dì zài bào míng
meaning: We confirm the venue before enrolling.

text: 先把结束时间写清楚，避免大家错过车。
pinyin: xiān bǎ jié shù shí jiān xiě qīng chǔ , bì miǎn dà jiā cuò guò chē .
meaning: Write the ending time clearly to avoid people missing their bus.

text: 她给朋友改时间的消息已发，但没收到回答。为了不让人白跑，她决定打电话确认，不把已发当已同意。
pinyin: tā gěi péng you gǎi shí jiān de xiāo xī yǐ fā , dàn mò shōu dào huí dá . wèi le bù ràng rén bái pǎo , tā jué dìng dǎ diàn huà què rèn , bù bǎ yǐ fā dāng yǐ tóng yì .
meaning: She sent the changed time but hasn't received a reply. To avoid a wasted trip, she phones to check.

text: 别只看到价格低。第一家十八元不含运输，第二家二十三元已经送到门口。我们要比较总费用。
pinyin: bié zhǐ kàn dào jià gé dī . dì yī jiā shí bā yuán bù hán yùn shū , dì èr jiā èr shí sān yuán yǐ jīng sòng dào mén kǒu . wǒ men yào bǐ jiào zǒng fèi yòng .
meaning: Don't look only at the low price. The first shop charges eighteen yuan before transport. The second charges twenty-three including delivery. We need the total cost.

text: 第一段：夜间活动只开一楼。第二段：二楼借书的地方仍然六点下班。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : yè jiān huó dòng zhǐ kāi yī lóu . dì èr duàn : èr lóu jiè shū de dì fāng réng rán liù diǎn xià bān .
meaning: Text 1: The evening event uses only the first floor. Text 2: The upstairs book-lending service still closes at six.

text: 来了？先别急着上台，喝口水。你紧张也没关系，能停一下再继续，不用装得什么都记住。
pinyin: lái le ? xiān bié jí zhe shàng tái , hē kǒu shuǐ . nǐ jǐn zhāng yě méi guān xì , néng tíng yī xià zài jì xù , bù yòng zhuāng de shén me dōu jì zhù .
meaning: You're here? Don't rush onto the stage; have some water. It's okay to be nervous. You can pause and continue without pretending you remember everything.

text: 虽然时间很短我们仍然说清楚了
pinyin: suī rán shí jiān hěn duǎn wǒ men réng rán shuō qīng chǔ le
meaning: Although the time was short, we still explained it clearly.

text: 小说里说他坐了很久，始终没有打开那个门。读者可以想到害怕，也可以想到等人，下一段才说明原因。
pinyin: xiǎo shuō lǐ shuō tā zuò le hěn jiǔ , shǐ zhōng méi yǒu dǎ kāi nà gè mén . dú zhě kě yǐ xiǎng dào hài pà , yě kě yǐ xiǎng dào děng rén , xià yī duàn cái shuō míng yuán yīn .
meaning: The novel says he sat for a long time without opening the door. Fear and waiting are possible readings; the next part explains why.

text: 灯还亮着是歌词，不是活动的地方通知。九点半先收东西，十点关闭，别为了再唱把最后的整理工作全留给别人。
pinyin: dēng hái liàng zhe shì gē cí , bù shì huó dòng de dì fāng tōng zhī . jiǔ diǎn bàn xiān shōu dōng xi , shí diǎn guān bì , bié wèi le zài chàng bǎ zuì hòu de zhěng lǐ gōng zuò quán liú gěi bié ren .
meaning: 'The light is still on' is a lyric, not the venue notice. Pack at nine thirty and close at ten. Don't leave all the closing work to others just to sing more.

text: 她写先试四周，如果效果合适再继续。朋友转发成已经永远开放，她请他改回原来的条件。
pinyin: tā xiě xiān shì sì zhōu , rú guǒ xiào guǒ hé shì zài jì xù . péng you zhuǎn fā chéng yǐ jīng yǒng yuǎn kāi fàng , tā qǐng tā gǎi huí yuán lái de tiáo jiàn .
meaning: She proposed a four-week trial, continuing only if it works. A friend reposted this as 'already open forever,' and she asked for a correction.

text: 你说好是好，不过太远。这是还在考虑，不是已经答应。我先不替你买票。
pinyin: nǐ shuō hǎo shì hǎo , bù guò tài yuǎn . zhè shì hái zài kǎo lǜ , bù shì yǐ jīng dā ying . wǒ xiān bù tì nǐ mǎi piào .
meaning: You said, 'It's good, but too far.' That's still considering, not agreement, so I won't buy your ticket yet.

text: 我不是不想参加只是今天不方便
pinyin: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng cān jiā zhǐ shì jīn tiān bù fāng biàn
meaning: I do want to take part; today just doesn't work.

text: 她既想说话，也想赶上车。
pinyin: tā jì xiǎng shuō huà , yě xiǎng gǎn shàng chē .
meaning: She wants to talk and catch her bus.

text: 唱歌时把一个字唱得更长，是音乐的需要。课上另外听说话读法，老师说唱得像，不表示说话时每个字都准确。
pinyin: chàng gē shí bǎ yī gè zì chàng de gèng cháng , shì yīn yuè de xū yào . kè shàng lìng wài tīng shuō huà dú fǎ , lǎo shī shuō chàng de xiàng , bù biǎo shì shuō huà shí měi gè zì dōu zhǔn què .
meaning: Singing may extend a syllable for the music. Class separately practises spoken pronunciation; sounding like the song doesn't prove every spoken syllable is accurate.

text: 不是每一个笑都表示同意。我是喜欢刚才的开玩笑，周六帮忙这件事还得看时间。
pinyin: bù shì měi yī gè xiào dōu biǎo shì tóng yì . wǒ shì xǐ huān gāng cái de kāi wán xiào , zhōu liù bāng máng zhè jiàn shì hái děi kàn shí jiān .
meaning: Not every laugh means agreement. I liked the joke, but helping on Saturday still depends on my schedule.

text: 第一段：我想星期天见，上午不方便。第二段：她建议星期天下午两点，对方回复可以。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : wǒ xiǎng xīng qī tiān jiàn , shàng wǔ bù fāng biàn . dì èr duàn : tā jiàn yì xīng qī tiān xià wǔ liǎng diǎn , duì fāng huí fù kě yǐ .
meaning: Text 1: I want to meet on Sunday, but the morning doesn't work. Text 2: She suggests two on Sunday afternoon, and the other person agrees.

text: 先让她说完。你要补充可以，但别把她最后一句盖住，否则我们又要问一遍。
pinyin: xiān ràng tā shuō wán . nǐ yào bǔ chōng kě yǐ , dàn bié bǎ tā zuì hòu yī jù gài zhù , fǒu zé wǒ men yòu yào wèn yī biàn .
meaning: Let her finish. You can add something, but don't drown out her final sentence or we'll have to ask again.

text: 先听完整句再判断意思
pinyin: xiān tīng wán zhěng jù zài pàn duàn yì si
meaning: Listen to the whole sentence before judging its meaning.

text: 不是每一个笑都表示同意。
pinyin: bù shì měi yī gè xiào dōu biǎo shì tóng yì .
meaning: Not every laugh means agreement.

text: 通知说可以参加活动的人有二十个，工作的人另外有位置。现场四名工作的人，不算进这二十人。
pinyin: tōng zhī shuō kě yǐ cān jiā huó dòng de rén yǒu èr shí gè , gōng zuò de rén lìng wài yǒu wèi zhì . xiàn chǎng sì míng gōng zuò de rén , bù suàn jìn zhè èr shí rén .
meaning: The notice allows twenty participants, with separate places for staff. Four staff members don't count towards those twenty.

text: 我现在离开，不是以后不来。今天回家太晚不方便，下次时间早一点还愿意参加。
pinyin: wǒ xiàn zài lí kāi , bù shì yǐ hòu bù lái . jīn tiān huí jiā tài wǎn bù fāng biàn , xià cì shí jiān zǎo yī diǎn hái yuàn yì cān jiā .
meaning: Leaving now doesn't mean I won't come again. Getting home late doesn't work today; I'd still join another event at an earlier time.

text: 她把歌词里的雨理解为等待，朋友理解为声音。两人都举了句子，没有说这是当天真实天气。
pinyin: tā bǎ gē cí lǐ de yǔ lǐ jiě wèi děng dài , péng you lǐ jiě wèi shēng yīn . liǎng rén dōu jǔ le jù zi , méi yǒu shuō zhè shì dàng tiān zhēn shí tiān qì .
meaning: She reads the rain in the lyric as waiting; her friend reads it as sound. Both point to lines in the song, without claiming that it describes that day's weather.

text: 歌词下一页留给下次见面，没有写下周哪天。现实里要约，还得看大家时间。
pinyin: gē cí xià yī yè liú gěi xià cì jiàn miàn , méi yǒu xiě xià zhōu nǎ tiān . xiàn shí lǐ yào yuē , hái děi kàn dà jiā shí jiān .
meaning: The lyric leaves the next page for a future meeting, but doesn't name a day next week. Making a real plan still requires checking everyone's time.

text: 这次只是试点还没决定长期继续
pinyin: zhè cì zhǐ shì shì diǎn hái méi jué dìng cháng qī jì xù
meaning: This is only a pilot; long-term continuation hasn't been decided.

text: 负责的人请愿意的人补充，有人只听。活动规则没有要求每个人开口，所以沉默不等于不按要求。
pinyin: fù zé de rén qǐng yuàn yì de rén bǔ chōng , yǒu rén zhǐ tīng . huó dòng guī zé méi yǒu yāo qiú měi gè rén kāi kǒu , suǒ yǐ chén mò bù děng yú bù àn yāo qiú .
meaning: The organiser invites anyone who wants to add something. Some people only listen. The rules don't require everyone to speak.

text: 一共有五页，袋里一二三五都在，楼里找到四。放回第四页就齐了，但那张纸没有以前那么平了。
pinyin: yī gòng yǒu wǔ yè , dài lǐ yī èr sān wǔ dōu zài , lóu lǐ zhǎo dào sì . fàng huí dì sì yè jiù qí le , dàn nà zhāng zhǐ méi yǒu yǐ qián nà me píng le .
meaning: There are five pages. The bag has pages one, two, three and five; page four was found in the corridor. Returning it completes the set, but that page is no longer flat.

text: 第一段：采访称活动方便了下班的人。第二段：通知要求提前报名，没有空位不能直接进。
pinyin: dì yī duàn : cǎi fǎng chēng huó dòng fāng biàn le xià bān de rén . dì èr duàn : tōng zhī yāo qiú tí qián bào míng , méi yǒu kōng wèi bù néng zhí jiē jìn .
meaning: Text 1: An interview says the event helps people after work. Text 2: The notice requires registration, and no direct entry when it's full.

text: 我说很难说，是还不知道，不是在保证不会。先等他们回复，别替我把答案改成一定。
pinyin: wǒ shuō hěn nán shuō , shì hái bù zhī dào , bù shì zài bǎo zhèng bù huì . xiān děng tā men huí fù , bié tì wǒ bǎ dá àn gǎi chéng yí dìng .
meaning: When I say 'hard to say', I mean I don't know yet, not that it definitely won't happen. Wait for their reply; don't turn my answer into certainty.

text: 从记录来看，有十二个人留下。
pinyin: cóng jì lù lái kàn , yǒu shí èr gè rén liú xià .
meaning: According to the record, twelve people stayed.

text: 电影里姐姐看着妹妹的包，后来妹妹把信带走。前面的她看着包指姐姐，不是两个人都看。
pinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ jiě jie kàn zhe mèi mei de bāo , hòu lái mèi mei bǎ xìn dài zǒu . qián miàn de tā kàn zhe bāo zhǐ jiě jie , bù shì liǎng gè rén dōu kàn .
meaning: The older sister watches the younger sister's bag. Later, the younger sister takes the letter away. In 'she watches the bag', 'she' refers to the older sister.

text: 你把她那句后半段再放一遍。我听见不是不好，但后面没听到，先别替她说完整个看法。
pinyin: nǐ bǎ tā nà jù hòu bàn duàn zài fàng yī biàn . wǒ tīng jiàn bù shì bù hǎo , dàn hòu miàn méi tīng dào , xiān bié tì tā shuō wán zhěng gè kàn fǎ .
meaning: Replay the second half of her sentence. I heard 'it's not bad' but missed the rest. Don't give her complete opinion for her.

text: 搬家那天下午，朋友答应两点来，三点才出现。重箱子已经由邻居帮忙搬上楼了。朋友说既然东西都搬好了，他就明天再来。我请他先留下整理书架。搬完箱子不代表我不再需要帮助，更不代表他原来的安排没有影响。
pinyin: bān jiā nà tiān xià wǔ , péng you dā yìng liǎng diǎn lái , sān diǎn cái chū xiàn . zhòng xiāng zi yǐ jīng yóu lín jū bāng máng bān shàng lóu le . péng you shuō jì rán dōng xi dōu bān hǎo le , tā jiù míng tiān zài lái . wǒ qǐng tā xiān liú xià zhěng lǐ shū jià . bān wán xiāng zi bù dài biǎo wǒ bù zài xū yào bāng zhù , gèng bù dài biǎo tā yuán lái de ān pái méi yǒu yǐng xiǎng .
meaning: My friend promised to help me move at two but arrived at three. A neighbour had carried the heavy boxes upstairs. My friend proposed coming tomorrow instead; I asked him to stay and organise the shelves. The completed move didn't erase the need for help or the effect of his lateness.

text: 别急着再答应一个更大的任务。我想先知道上次为什么没联系我，再看看这次怎么安排。我不是不信任你，只是不想又到最后才发现时间冲突。
pinyin: bié jí zhe zài dā yìng yī gè gèng dà de rèn wù . wǒ xiǎng xiān zhī dào shàng cì wèi shén me méi lián xì wǒ , zài kàn kàn zhè cì zěn me ān pái . wǒ bù shì bù xìn rèn nǐ , zhǐ shì bù xiǎng yòu dào zuì hòu cái fā xiàn shí jiān chōng tū .
meaning: Don't rush to promise a bigger task. I first want to know why you didn't contact me last time, then plan this time. I don't want to discover another clash at the last moment.

text: 哪怕只有一句话也早点告诉我
pinyin: nǎ pà zhǐ yǒu yī jù huà yě zǎo diǎn gào sù wǒ
meaning: Even a short message is enough; tell me early.

text: 这样一直猜，不如直接问清楚。
pinyin: zhè yàng yì zhí cāi , bù rú zhí jiē wèn qīng chu .
meaning: Rather than keep guessing, ask directly.

text: 即使
pinyin: jí shǐ
meaning: Even if.

text: 尽管
pinyin: jǐn guǎn
meaning: Although.

text: 毕业后，我们没有每天联络。有时一个月才谈一次，也不总是讨论大事。这次她来出差，我们只吃了一顿晚饭，没有安排旅游。离开的时候她说，下次见面不用等到有什么特别的事。听到这句话，我反而放心了，不必每次都准备一个值得报告的好消息。
pinyin: bì yè hòu , wǒ men méi yǒu měi tiān lián luò . yǒu shí yī gè yuè cái tán yī cì , yě bù zǒng shì tǎo lùn dà shì . zhè cì tā lái chū chāi , wǒ men zhǐ chī le yī dùn wǎn fàn , méi yǒu ān pái lǚ yóu . lí kāi de shí hou tā shuō , xià cì jiàn miàn bù yòng děng dào yǒu shén me tè bié de shì . tīng dào zhè jù huà , wǒ fǎn ér fàng xīn le , bù bì měi cì dōu zhǔn bèi yī gè zhí de bào gào de hǎo xiāo xī .
meaning: After graduating, we sometimes talk only once a month. During her work trip we just had dinner, with no sightseeing. She said we needn't wait for a special occasion next time. I was relieved that every meeting didn't need some good news to report.

text: 我承认那句话说得太快，让你以为已经决定了。实际只是一个建议，还得问另外两个人。你先别替我宣布，我今天晚上确认以后给你消息。
pinyin: wǒ chéng rèn nà jù huà shuō de tài kuài , ràng nǐ yǐ wéi yǐ jīng jué dìng le . shí jì zhǐ shì yī gè jiàn yì , hái děi wèn lìng wài liǎng gè rén . nǐ xiān bié tì wǒ xuān bù , wǒ jīn tiān wǎn shang què rèn yǐ hòu gěi nǐ xiāo xī .
meaning: I admit I spoke too quickly and made it sound decided. It was a suggestion; two other people still need asking. Don't announce it yet. I'll update you tonight.

text: 住在一起的朋友以前常替我决定周末的活动。我有一次说想安静待在家里，他以为我不满意我们的友谊。我们后来谈了一下，发现我希望保留自己的时间，而他只是担心我一个人会无聊。现在他会先问要不要参加，我也会明确回复，不让他一直猜。
pinyin: zhù zài yì qǐ de péng you yǐ qián cháng tì wǒ jué dìng zhōu mò de huó dòng . wǒ yǒu yī cì shuō xiǎng ān jìng dài zài jiā lǐ , tā yǐ wéi wǒ bù mǎn yì wǒ men de yǒu yì . wǒ men hòu lái tán le yī xià , fā xiàn wǒ xī wàng bǎo liú zì jǐ de shí jiān , ér tā zhǐ shì dān xīn wǒ yī gè rén huì wú liáo . xiàn zài tā huì xiān wèn yào bù yào cān jiā , wǒ yě huì míng què huí fù , bù ràng tā yì zhí cāi .
meaning: My roommate used to choose our weekend activities. When I wanted a quiet day at home, he thought I was unhappy with our friendship. We talked: I wanted time for myself; he worried I'd be bored. Now he asks, and I answer clearly.

text: 你可以不喜欢这首歌，没关系。我问你最后一句听到了什么，是想知道那里为什么停了一下，不是让你证明歌手一定唱得最好。
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ bù xǐ huān zhè shǒu gē , méi guān xì . wǒ wèn nǐ zuì hòu yī jù tīng dào le shén me , shì xiǎng zhī dào nà lǐ wèi shén me tíng le yī xià , bù shì ràng nǐ zhèng míng gē shǒu yí dìng chàng de zuì hǎo .
meaning: It's okay not to like this song. I'm asking what you heard in the final line to understand the pause, not to prove the singer is the best.

text: 我在车站偶然遇见一位老同学。她说最近换了工作，正在适应新的时间。我差点马上问工资多少，又想起我们已经很久没见。于是先问新工作最喜欢哪一点。她讲了不少，还主动说到了困难。离开的时候我们交换了联系方式，但没有立即约下一次。
pinyin: wǒ zài chē zhàn ǒu rán yù jiàn yī wèi lǎo tóng xué . tā shuō zuì jìn huàn le gōng zuò , zhèng zài shì yìng xīn de shí jiān . wǒ chà diǎn mǎ shàng wèn gōng zī duō shao , yòu xiǎng qǐ wǒ men yǐ jīng hěn jiǔ méi jiàn . yú shì xiān wèn xīn gōng zuò zuì xǐ huān nǎ yī diǎn . tā jiǎng le bù shǎo , hái zhǔ dòng shuō dào le kùn nán . lí kāi de shí hou wǒ men jiāo huàn le lián xì fāng shì , dàn méi yǒu lì jí yuē xià yī cì .
meaning: I ran into an old classmate at the station. She had changed jobs. Instead of immediately asking about pay, I asked what she liked most. She shared both positives and difficulties. We exchanged contact details without setting another meeting.

text: 到了给我一句消息就行，不用一路报告。九点以后我开会，可能不能马上回复。没收到回复也不表示你没到，我会晚点看。
pinyin: dào le gěi wǒ yī jù xiāo xī jiù xíng , bù yòng yī lù bào gào . jiǔ diǎn yǐ hòu wǒ kāi huì , kě néng bù néng mǎ shàng huí fù . méi shōu dào huí fù yě bù biǎo shì nǐ méi dào , wǒ huì wǎn diǎn kàn .
meaning: Send one message on arrival; no need for a report all the way. I'll be in a meeting after nine and may not reply immediately. I'll check later.

text: 朋友送我一本她喜欢的小说。我读了前几段，发现自己暂时读不下去，担心直接说会伤害她。后来她问我读得怎样，我说人物很有意思，但现在更想看短一点的文章。她笑着说自己第一次读也没读完。我才知道，珍惜礼物不等于必须喜欢每一页。
pinyin: péng you sòng wǒ yī běn tā xǐ huān de xiǎo shuō . wǒ dú le qián jǐ duàn , fā xiàn zì jǐ zàn shí dú bù xià qù , dān xīn zhí jiē shuō huì shāng hài tā . hòu lái tā wèn wǒ dú de zěn yàng , wǒ shuō rén wù hěn yǒu yì si , dàn xiàn zài gèng xiǎng kàn duǎn yī diǎn de wén zhāng . tā xiào zhe shuō zì jǐ dì yī cì dú yě méi dú wán . wǒ cái zhī dào , zhēn xī lǐ wù bù děng yú bì xū xǐ huān měi yī yè .
meaning: A friend gave me a novel she loved. I struggled after a few chapters and worried about hurting her. I told her the characters interested me but I currently wanted shorter pieces. She laughed that she hadn't finished it on her first attempt either.

text: 我今天想早点回去，但不是要你们也散场。你们继续谈就好。我明天很早出门，下次不用这么早的时候再留下。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí qù , dàn bù shì yào nǐ men yě sàn chǎng . nǐ men jì xù tán jiù hǎo . wǒ míng tiān hěn zǎo chū mén , xià cì bù yòng zhè me zǎo de shí hou zài liú xià .
meaning: I want to go home early, but you don't all need to leave. Keep talking. I leave early tomorrow; I'll stay next time when I don't need such an early start.

text: 不是每一次沉默都表示反对
pinyin: bù shì měi yī cì chén mò dōu biǎo shì fǎn duì
meaning: Not every silence means opposition.

text: 只有确认了时间，我才答应参加。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu què rèn le shí jiān , wǒ cái dā yìng cān jiā .
meaning: I only agree to attend after confirming the time.

text: 聚会结束后，有人建议大家把照片发到网上。我愿意分享我们一起做饭的照片，但不想公开家里的地址。朋友先让我选照片，后来还把纸上的地址挡住了。最后发出的两张照片都经过确认。那天我感觉自己的意见被认真听取了，而不是被看成麻烦。
pinyin: jù huì jié shù hòu , yǒu rén jiàn yì dà jiā bǎ zhào piān fā dào wǎng shàng . wǒ yuàn yì fēn xiǎng wǒ men yì qǐ zuò fàn de zhào piān , dàn bù xiǎng gōng kāi jiā lǐ de dì zhǐ . péng you xiān ràng wǒ xuǎn zhào piān , hòu lái hái bǎ zhǐ shàng de dì zhǐ dǎng zhù le . zuì hòu fā chū de liǎng zhāng zhào piān dōu jīng guò què rèn . nà tiān wǒ gǎn jué zì jǐ de yì jiàn bèi rèn zhēn tīng qǔ le , ér bù shì bèi kàn chéng má fán .
meaning: After the gathering, I agreed to share cooking photos but not my home address. My friend let me choose and covered the address on a paper. We confirmed the two photos before posting. I felt my view had been heard.

text: 不是你选的饭店不好，是那里离我下班的地方太远。周五只有一个小时，我怕大部分时间都在路上。周末去就没有这个问题。
pinyin: bù shì nǐ xuǎn de fàn diàn bù hǎo , shì nà lǐ lí wǒ xià bān de dì fāng tài yuǎn . zhōu wǔ zhǐ yǒu yī gè xiǎo shí , wǒ pà dà bù fèn shí jiān dōu zài lù shàng . zhōu mò qù jiù méi yǒu zhè gè wèn tí .
meaning: The restaurant isn't bad; it's far from work. I only have an hour on Friday and worry about spending it travelling. A weekend visit wouldn't have that problem.

text: 她原来准备给迟到的同事发一条很长的消息，把过去几次失误都列出来。写到一半，她发现自己最需要知道的是这次能不能按时完成。于是把消息改成先问进度，再约十分钟沟通。旧问题仍然存在，但她决定不在一条消息里解决所有矛盾。
pinyin: tā yuán lái zhǔn bèi gěi chí dào de tóng shì fā yī tiáo hěn cháng de xiāo xī , bǎ guò qù jǐ cì shī wù dōu liè chū lái . xiě dào yí bàn , tā fā xiàn zì jǐ zuì xū yào zhī dào de shì zhè cì néng bù néng àn shí wán chéng . yú shì bǎ xiāo xī gǎi chéng xiān wèn jìn dù , zài yuē shí fēn zhōng gōu tōng . jiù wèn tí réng rán cún zài , dàn tā jué dìng bù zài yī tiáo xiāo xī lǐ jiě jué suǒ yǒu máo dùn .
meaning: She began a long message listing a late colleague's past mistakes. Halfway through, she realised she mainly needed the current deadline clarified. She instead asked about progress and arranged ten minutes to talk. Older issues remained, but weren't all handled in one message.

text: 你听到我说可以再看看，别直接记成一定会买。我想先比较一下尺寸和价格。要是另外一家更合适，我还可能换。
pinyin: nǐ tīng dào wǒ shuō kě yǐ zài kàn kàn , bié zhí jiē jì chéng yí dìng huì mǎi . wǒ xiǎng xiān bǐ jiào yī xià chǐ cùn hé jià gé . yào shì lìng wài yī jiā gèng hé shì , wǒ hái kě néng huàn .
meaning: When I say we can look again, don't record that as a definite purchase. I want to compare sizes and prices; I might choose another shop.

text: 我先把时间确认好再答应参加
pinyin: wǒ xiān bǎ shí jiān què rèn hǎo zài dā yìng cān jiā
meaning: I'll confirm the time before agreeing to attend.

text: 他说自己不在乎朋友是否回了消息，过了一会儿却又看手机。我问他是不是担心周末的安排。他承认还不知道对方来不来，所以没法买票。后来他发了一个具体问题，说明今天晚上需要决定。回复来得很快，原来对方以为只是普通交流，不知道要确认时间。
pinyin: tā shuō zì jǐ bù zài hū péng you shì fǒu huí le xiāo xī , guò le yī huìr què yòu kàn shǒu jī . wǒ wèn tā shì bú shì dān xīn zhōu mò de ān pái . tā chéng rèn hái bù zhī dào duì fāng lái bù lái , suǒ yǐ méi fǎ mǎi piào . hòu lái tā fā le yī gè jù tǐ wèn tí , shuō míng jīn tiān wǎn shang xū yào jué dìng . huí fù lái de hěn kuài , yuán lái duì fāng yǐ wéi zhǐ shì pǔ tōng jiāo liú , bù zhī dào yào què rèn shí jiān .
meaning: Li said he didn't care about the reply but kept checking his phone. He admitted he needed confirmation before buying weekend tickets. He then asked a specific question and explained the evening deadline. The friend replied quickly; they hadn't realised confirmation was needed.

text: 先别把她没回消息说成不愿意帮。她今天要照顾家人，昨天已经告诉我们晚上才有空。我们可以先找另外一个办法，不必一直等。
pinyin: xiān bié bǎ tā méi huí xiāo xī shuō chéng bù yuàn yì bāng . tā jīn tiān yào zhào gù jiā rén , zuó tiān yǐ jīng gào sù wǒ men wǎn shang cái yǒu kōng . wǒ men kě yǐ xiān zhǎo lìng wài yī gè bàn fǎ , bù bì yì zhí děng .
meaning: Don't take her silence as unwillingness to help. She's caring for family today and told us she'd be free in the evening. We can find another solution instead of waiting.

text: 我们两个人都喜欢旅行，但准备方法不同。她喜欢先查好每段交通，我更愿意到了再决定。一起出门前，我们只把最后一班车和住的地方确定下来，白天留一些空间。旅行过程中有一次多走了路，也没有谁宣布自己的方法永远正确。后来我们仍愿意再一起旅行。
pinyin: wǒ men liǎng gè rén dōu xǐ huān lǚ xíng , dàn zhǔn bèi fāng fǎ bù tóng . tā xǐ huān xiān chá hǎo měi duàn jiāo tōng , wǒ gèng yuàn yì dào le zài jué dìng . yì qǐ chū mén qián , wǒ men zhǐ bǎ zuì hòu yī bān chē hé zhù de dì fāng què dìng xià lái , bái tiān liú yī xiē kōng jiān . lǚ xíng guò chéng zhōng yǒu yī cì duō zǒu le lù , yě méi yǒu shéi xuān bù zì jǐ de fāng fǎ yǒng yuǎn zhèng què . hòu lái wǒ men réng yuàn yì zài yì qǐ lǚ xíng .
meaning: We both like travelling but plan differently. Before leaving we fixed the last bus and accommodation while leaving daytime flexible. We once walked farther than intended, but neither declared their method always right. We still want to travel together.

text: 我感谢你提醒，不过现在这个办法不适合我。不是说你以后别提建议。我想先把手上的事做完，再讨论要不要换方法。
pinyin: wǒ gǎn xiè nǐ tí xǐng , bù guò xiàn zài zhè gè bàn fǎ bù shì hé wǒ . bù shì shuō nǐ yǐ hòu bié tí jiàn yì . wǒ xiǎng xiān bǎ shǒu shàng de shì zuò wán , zài tǎo lùn yào bù yào huàn fāng fǎ .
meaning: Thanks for the reminder, but this method doesn't suit me now. That doesn't mean you should never offer suggestions. I want to finish the current task before discussing a change.

text: 即使这次不能来也可以以后再见
pinyin: jí shǐ zhè cì bù néng lái yě kě yǐ yǐ hòu zài jiàn
meaning: Even if you can't come this time, we can meet later.

text: 既然你还没决定，我们就先不买票。
pinyin: jì rán nǐ hái méi jué dìng , wǒ men jiù xiān bù mǎi piào .
meaning: Since you haven't decided, we won't buy tickets yet.

text: 她参加新小组时很少发言，后来负责整理大家提出的问题。有成员以为她没有兴趣，她就说明自己需要先听明白再加入。第二次活动，她带来两个具体问题，讨论得很投入。小组没有因此要求她每次都主持，而是继续让成员自己选择任务。
pinyin: tā cān jiā xīn xiǎo zǔ shí hěn shǎo fā yán , hòu lái fù zé zhěng lǐ dà jiā tí chū de wèn tí . yǒu chéng yuán yǐ wéi tā méi yǒu xìng qù , tā jiù shuō míng zì jǐ xū yào xiān tīng míng bái zài jiā rù . dì èr cì huó dòng , tā dài lái liǎng gè jù tǐ wèn tí , tǎo lùn de hěn tóu rù . xiǎo zǔ méi yǒu yīn cǐ yāo qiú tā měi cì dōu zhǔ chí , ér shì jì xù ràng chéng yuán zì jǐ xuǎn zé rèn wù .
meaning: She spoke little in a new group but organised its questions. She explained that she needed to understand first. At the second meeting she brought two questions and joined enthusiastically. Members still chose their tasks; she wasn't required to host every time.

text: 我刚才不是笑你。你说那句的时候，后面有人把椅子拉倒了，我没忍住。你的问题我还没回答，现在我们接着说。
pinyin: wǒ gāng cái bù shì xiào nǐ . nǐ shuō nà jù de shí hou , hòu miàn yǒu rén bǎ yǐ zi lā dào le , wǒ méi rěn zhù . nǐ de wèn tí wǒ hái méi huí dá , xiàn zài wǒ men jiē zhe shuō .
meaning: I wasn't laughing at you. Someone behind you pulled a chair over and I couldn't help laughing. I haven't answered your question yet; let's continue.

text: 我们比较两个夜间课程。第一家学费五百元，教材一百元，每次去上课再回家的车费二十元，共十次。第二家学费七百元，包含教材，也在步行范围内。第一家可以分两次付钱，第二家一次付完。我暂时不考虑付钱的时间，只比较参加全部课程的总费用。
pinyin: wǒ men bǐ jiào liǎng gè yè jiān kè chéng . dì yī jiā xué fèi wǔ bǎi yuán , jiào cái yī bǎi yuán , měi cì qù shàng kè zài huí jiā de chē fèi èr shí yuán , gòng shí cì . dì èr jiā xué fèi qī bǎi yuán , bāo hán jiào cái , yě zài bù xíng fàn wéi nèi . dì yī jiā kě yǐ fēn liǎng cì fù qián , dì èr jiā yī cì fù wán . wǒ zàn shí bù kǎo lǜ fù qián de shí jiān , zhǐ bǐ jiào cān jiā quán bù kè chéng de zǒng fèi yòng .
meaning: The first evening course costs 500 yuan plus 100 for books and 20 for each return trip, for ten sessions. The second costs 700 including books and is within walking distance. For now I'm comparing total cost, not payment timing.

text: 周六有两个时间，你别记反了。十三点半可以进去，十四点才开始。十五点结束以后还有十分钟签名，工作人员最后整理到十五点半。你只参加正式活动的话，按十四点到十五点算。
pinyin: zhōu liù yǒu liǎng gè shí jiān , nǐ bié jì fǎn le . shí sān diǎn bàn kě yǐ jìn qù , shí sì diǎn cái kāi shǐ . shí wǔ diǎn jié shù yǐ hòu hái yǒu shí fēn zhōng qiān míng , gōng zuò rén yuán zuì hòu zhěng lǐ dào shí wǔ diǎn bàn . nǐ zhǐ cān jiā zhèng shì huó dòng de huà , àn shí sì diǎn dào shí wǔ diǎn suàn .
meaning: Don't mix up Saturday's times. Entry is 13:30, the programme is 14:00–15:00, signing lasts ten minutes after that, and staff finish at 15:30.

text: 先比较总费用再决定报哪个班
pinyin: xiān bǐ jiào zǒng fèi yòng zài jué dìng bào nǎ gè bān
meaning: Compare total costs before choosing a class.

text: 只有收到确认，才把人数算进去。
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu shōu dào què rèn , cái bǎ rén shù suàn jìn qù .
meaning: Count someone only after confirmation.

text: 活动准备了二十八把椅子，其中四把给工作的人。报名人数是二十四，后来有两人说不能来，也没有安排其他人替代。负责人没有减少工作人数，仍用原来的四把椅子。我们检查参加者的座位是否足够，不把工作的人算进参加者人数。
pinyin: huó dòng zhǔn bèi le èr shí bā bǎ yǐ zi , qí zhōng sì bǎ gěi gōng zuò de rén . bào míng rén shù shì èr shí sì , hòu lái yǒu liǎng rén shuō bù néng lái , yě méi yǒu ān pái qí tā rén tì dài . fù zé rén méi yǒu jiǎn shǎo gōng zuò rén shù , réng yòng yuán lái de sì bǎ yǐ zi . wǒ men jiǎn chá cān jiā zhě de zuò wèi shì fǒu zú gòu , bù bǎ gōng zuò de rén suàn jìn cān jiā zhě rén shù .
meaning: There are 28 chairs, four reserved for staff. Twenty-four people registered, but two cancelled without replacements. Staffing stays the same. We're checking participant seating separately from staff.

text: 这张票五十元，运输五元。买两张票只收一次运输费，不是每张都加五元。你要两张，全部五十五元是不够的，应该再把第二张票的钱加上。
pinyin: zhè zhāng piào wǔ shí yuán , yùn shū wǔ yuán . mǎi liǎng zhāng piào zhǐ shōu yī cì yùn shū fèi , bù shì měi zhāng dōu jiā wǔ yuán . nǐ yào liǎng zhāng , quán bù wǔ shí wǔ yuán shì bù gòu de , yīng gāi zài bǎ dì èr zhāng piào de qián jiā shàng .
meaning: Each ticket is 50 yuan. Delivery is five once per order, not per ticket. Two tickets therefore cost more than 55.

text: 我们约好八点三十分到车站，九点的车出发。他八点十五从家里出门，平常路上用二十分钟。那天实际用了三十分钟，他没有在路上停下。到了以后先给我们发消息，再去找入口。我们问的是他到车站的时间，不是找到入口的时间。
pinyin: wǒ men yuē hǎo bā diǎn sān shí fēn dào chē zhàn , jiǔ diǎn de chē chū fā . tā bā diǎn shí wǔ cóng jiā lǐ chū mén , píng cháng lù shàng yòng èr shí fēn zhōng . nà tiān shí jì yòng le sān shí fēn zhōng , tā méi yǒu zài lù shàng tíng xià . dào le yǐ hòu xiān gěi wǒ men fā xiāo xī , zài qù zhǎo rù kǒu . wǒ men wèn de shì tā dào chē zhàn de shí jiān , bù shì zhǎo dào rù kǒu de shí jiān .
meaning: We agreed to arrive at the station at 8:30 for a nine o'clock train. Chen left home at 8:15. The journey normally takes 20 minutes, but actually took 30 that day with no stops. He messaged on arrival, before finding the entrance.

text: 先把周五的约定取消，不要直接改成周六。她只是说周六可能有空，还没看安排。我们今天晚上再确认，明天早上之前给店里回复。
pinyin: xiān bǎ zhōu wǔ de yuē dìng qǔ xiāo , bú yào zhí jiē gǎi chéng zhōu liù . tā zhǐ shì shuō zhōu liù kě néng yǒu kōng , hái méi kàn ān pái . wǒ men jīn tiān wǎn shang zài què rèn , míng tiān zǎo shàng zhī qián gěi diàn lǐ huí fù .
meaning: Cancel Friday first, but don't automatically switch to Saturday. She only said she might be free and hasn't checked her schedule. We'll confirm tonight and tell the shop before tomorrow morning.

text: 如果时间有冲突就提前告诉我们
pinyin: rú guǒ shí jiān yǒu chōng tū jiù tí qián gào sù wǒ men
meaning: Tell us early if the times clash.

text: 虽然人数减少了，总时间却没有减少。
pinyin: suī rán rén shù jiǎn shǎo le , zǒng shí jiān què méi yǒu jiǎn shǎo .
meaning: Headcount fell, but total time did not.

text: 以前的活动从七点到九点。新通知把开始时间推后半小时，结束时间不变。负责人解释，先减少一段介绍，不让回家的人错过最后一班车。有成员以为活动也会延长半小时，负责人再次说明，只改开始，不改结束。
pinyin: yǐ qián de huó dòng cóng qī diǎn dào jiǔ diǎn . xīn tōng zhī bǎ kāi shǐ shí jiān tuī hòu bàn xiǎo shí , jié shù shí jiān bù biàn . fù zé rén jiě shì , xiān jiǎn shǎo yī duàn jiè shào , bù ràng huí jiā de rén cuò guò zuì hòu yī bān chē . yǒu chéng yuán yǐ wéi huó dòng yě huì yán cháng bàn xiǎo shí , fù zé rén zài cì shuō míng , zhǐ gǎi kāi shǐ , bù gǎi jié shù .
meaning: The event originally ran from seven to nine. The new notice delays the start by half an hour but keeps the end unchanged. An introduction is shortened so people can catch the last bus.

text: 我今天只借两本，第三本先放回去。规则是同时最多三本，我家里还有一本没还。不是总共只能读三本，是手上同时不能超过三本。
pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān zhǐ jiè liǎng běn , dì sān běn xiān fàng huí qù . guī zé shì tóng shí zuì duō sān běn , wǒ jiā lǐ hái yǒu yī běn méi hái . bù shì zǒng gòng zhǐ néng dú sān běn , shì shǒu shàng tóng shí bù néng chāo guò sān běn .
meaning: I'll borrow two today and return the third to the shelf. The limit is three at a time and I still have one at home. It's not a lifetime reading limit.

text: 四周的读书活动每周一次，参加人数分别为十八、二十、十二、十四。负责人说总共有六十四次参加记录，但还没有整理哪些人来了不止一次。新闻文章写成六十四个不同的人，他请作者改正。活动确实有六十四次参加，不代表六十四个不同的人。
pinyin: sì zhōu de dú shū huó dòng měi zhōu yī cì , cān jiā rén shù fēn bié wèi shí bā , èr shí , shí èr , shí sì . fù zé rén shuō zǒng gòng yǒu liù shí sì cì cān jiā jì lù , dàn hái méi yǒu zhěng lǐ nǎ xiē rén lái le bù zhǐ yī cì . xīn wén wén zhāng xiě chéng liù shí sì gè bù tóng de rén , tā qǐng zuò zhě gǎi zhèng . huó dòng què shí yǒu liù shí sì cì cān jiā , bù dài biǎo liù shí sì gè bù tóng de rén .
meaning: Four weekly sessions recorded 18, 20, 12 and 14 attendances. The organiser reports 64 attendance records but hasn't checked repeat visitors. He corrects a draft calling them 64 different people.

text: 九点半之前把设备送回，十点关闭。你九点四十才送到，虽然门还开着，也超过设备的时间了。现在先问工作人员能不能接收，别说门开着就一定没问题。
pinyin: jiǔ diǎn bàn zhī qián bǎ shè bèi sòng huí , shí diǎn guān bì . nǐ jiǔ diǎn sì shí cái sòng dào , suī rán mén hái kāi zhe , yě chāo guò shè bèi de shí jiān le . xiàn zài xiān wèn gōng zuò rén yuán néng bù néng jiē shōu , bié shuō mén kāi zhe jiù yí dìng méi wèn tí .
meaning: Return equipment by 9:30; the building closes at ten. Arriving at 9:40 is late for equipment even though the door is open. Ask staff whether they can accept it.

text: 活动不仅要准时开始，还要按时结束。
pinyin: huó dòng bù jǐn yào zhǔn shí kāi shǐ , hái yào àn shí jié shù .
meaning: The event must start and end on time.

text: 一份原来的计划要三个人各工作两小时。新计划只需要两个人，但每个人要工作三小时。经理说人数减少，不一定总工作时间也减少。这里计算的是每个人的工作时间加起来，不考虑同时工作时钟上过去了多久。
pinyin: yī fèn yuán lái de jì huà yào sān gè rén gè gōng zuò liǎng xiǎo shí . xīn jì huà zhǐ xū yào liǎng gè rén , dàn měi gè rén yào gōng zuò sān xiǎo shí . jīng lǐ shuō rén shù jiǎn shǎo , bù yí dìng zǒng gōng zuò shí jiān yě jiǎn shǎo . zhè lǐ jì suàn de shì měi gè rén de gōng zuò shí jiān jiā qǐ lái , bù kǎo lǜ tóng shí gōng zuò shí zhōng shàng guò qù le duō jiǔ .
meaning: The old plan requires three people for two hours each. The new plan requires two people for three hours each. We're comparing the sum of individual work hours, not elapsed time.

text: 这个短班是六次，不是六周。每周上两次，星期二和星期四。如果没有停课，三个星期就上完。你把每周一次的旧安排去掉，避免一直空出六个星期。
pinyin: zhè gè duǎn bān shì liù cì , bù shì liù zhōu . měi zhōu shàng liǎng cì , xīng qī èr hé xīng qī sì . rú guǒ méi yǒu tíng kè , sān gè xīng qī jiù shàng wán . nǐ bǎ měi zhōu yī cì de jiù ān pái qù diào , bì miǎn yì zhí kōng chū liù gè xīng qī .
meaning: The short course has six sessions, not six weeks. It meets Tuesdays and Thursdays, twice a week, so takes three weeks if uninterrupted.

text: 网上报名以前规定周五晚上六点结束，后来延长到周六中午十二点。他周六上午十一点完成报名，收到确认。朋友只看到旧通知，以为他已经错过。他把新通知和确认消息一起发过去，说明自己按更新后的时间参加。
pinyin: wǎng shàng bào míng yǐ qián guī dìng zhōu wǔ wǎn shang liù diǎn jié shù , hòu lái yán cháng dào zhōu liù zhōng wǔ shí èr diǎn . tā zhōu liù shàng wǔ shí yī diǎn wán chéng bào míng , shōu dào què rèn . péng you zhǐ kàn dào jiù tōng zhī , yǐ wéi tā yǐ jīng cuò guò . tā bǎ xīn tōng zhī hé què rèn xiāo xī yì qǐ fā guò qù , shuō míng zì jǐ àn gēng xīn hòu de shí jiān cān jiā .
meaning: Online registration was extended from Friday at six to Saturday at noon. Lin registered at eleven on Saturday and received confirmation. A friend saw only the old notice, so Lin sent the updated one and the confirmation.

text: 第一天有二十个人，其中八个留下讨论。第二天有三十个人，其中十八个留下。人数和比例都上升了，可是两天看的电影不同，现在不能只说是主持方法造成的。
pinyin: dì yī tiān yǒu èr shí gè rén , qí zhōng bā gè liú xià tǎo lùn . dì èr tiān yǒu sān shí gè rén , qí zhōng shí bā gè liú xià . rén shù hé bǐ lì dōu shàng shēng le , kě shì liǎng tiān kàn de diàn yǐng bù tóng , xiàn zài bù néng zhǐ shuō shì zhǔ chí fāng fǎ zào chéng de .
meaning: Eight of twenty people stayed on day one; eighteen of thirty stayed on day two. Both the count and share rose, but the films differed, so we can't attribute it solely to hosting.

text: 她原来准备每天复习十五分钟，连续六天。第一天实际做了三十分钟，后面五天仍各做十五分钟。她记录实际时间，没有把第一天多做的十五分钟看成第二天已经完成。后来想比较以前的计划和实际的总时间。
pinyin: tā yuán lái zhǔn bèi měi tiān fù xí shí wǔ fēn zhōng , lián xù liù tiān . dì yī tiān shí jì zuò le sān shí fēn zhōng , hòu miàn wǔ tiān réng gè zuò shí wǔ fēn zhōng . tā jì lù shí jì shí jiān , méi yǒu bǎ dì yī tiān duō zuò de shí wǔ fēn zhōng kàn chéng dì èr tiān yǐ jīng wán chéng . hòu lái xiǎng bǐ jiào yǐ qián de jì huà hé shí jì de zǒng shí jiān .
meaning: She planned 15 minutes daily for six days. The first day she did 30; the next five stayed at 15 each. Extra work wasn't counted as doing the following day.

text: 有四位朋友，三位点饭，每份二十元。第四位只喝十元的茶。大家这次明确说各付自己的，不平均分。所以只喝茶的人就付十元，没有人要求他分饭钱。
pinyin: yǒu sì wèi péng you , sān wèi diǎn fàn , měi fèn èr shí yuán . dì sì wèi zhǐ hē shí yuán de chá . dà jiā zhè cì míng què shuō gè fù zì jǐ de , bù píng jūn fēn . suǒ yǐ zhǐ hē chá de rén jiù fù shí yuán , méi yǒu rén yāo qiú tā fēn fàn qián .
meaning: Four friends: three meals at 20 yuan each, and the fourth has a ten-yuan tea. They explicitly agree to pay individually rather than split evenly.

text: 两家旅馆都住三晚。第一家每晚二百元，离车站远，三晚期间去旅馆再回车站的交通共一百二十元。第二家每晚二百四十元，在车站旁边，不需要这笔交通费。早餐都另外付钱，我们先不加入比较。朋友只看房间的价格，以为第一家一定更省。
pinyin: liǎng jiā lǚ guǎn dōu zhù sān wǎn . dì yī jiā měi wǎn èr bǎi yuán , lí chē zhàn yuǎn , sān wǎn qī jiān qù lǚ guǎn zài huí chē zhàn de jiāo tōng gòng yī bǎi èr shí yuán . dì èr jiā měi wǎn èr bǎi sì shí yuán , zài chē zhàn páng biān , bù xū yào zhè bǐ jiāo tōng fèi . zǎo cān dōu lìng wài fù qián , wǒ men xiān bù jiā rù bǐ jiào . péng you zhǐ kàn fáng jiān de jià gé , yǐ wéi dì yī jiā yí dìng gèng shěng .
meaning: For three nights, the first hotel costs 200 per night plus 120 total transport. The second costs 240 per night near the station, with no transport charge. Breakfast is excluded from this comparison.

text: 我十点五分看到她的消息，十点四十才打电话。不是消息发来以后马上就联系。中间我先处理了一件工作，但这段时间不能算成我们通话的时间。
pinyin: wǒ shí diǎn wǔ fēn kàn dào tā de xiāo xī , shí diǎn sì shí cái dǎ diàn huà . bù shì xiāo xī fā lái yǐ hòu mǎ shàng jiù lián xì . zhōng jiān wǒ xiān chǔ lǐ le yī jiàn gōng zuò , dàn zhè duàn shí jiān bù néng suàn chéng wǒ men tōng huà de shí jiān .
meaning: I saw her message at 10:05 and called at 10:40. I handled some work between them; that waiting period wasn't call time.

text: 她保存了十二段学习录音，其中四段是在有文字帮助时完成的。另外八段没有看文字，但其中两段还没有听完就回答。她只把没看文字而且听完的六段放进这次记录，不说另外六段没有任何价值，只是不把不同条件放在一起。
pinyin: tā bǎo cún le shí èr duàn xué xí lù yīn , qí zhōng sì duàn shì zài yǒu wén zì bāng zhù shí wán chéng de . lìng wài bā duàn méi yǒu kàn wén zì , dàn qí zhōng liǎng duàn hái méi yǒu tīng wán jiù huí dá . tā zhǐ bǎ méi kàn wén zì ér qiě tīng wán de liù duàn fàng jìn zhè cì jì lù , bù shuō lìng wài liù duàn méi yǒu rèn hé jià zhí , zhǐ shì bù bǎ bù tóng tiáo jiàn fàng zài yì qǐ .
meaning: She saved twelve learning recordings. Four used written help. Of the other eight, two were answered before listening finished. For this record she uses only the six without text help and with completed listening.

text: 这个方案写试六周，第三周可以讨论调整，六周结束以后再决定是否长期继续。我没有说第三周就一定停止，也没有说一开始就永远采用。
pinyin: zhè gè fāng àn xiě shì liù zhōu , dì sān zhōu kě yǐ tǎo lùn tiáo zhěng , liù zhōu jié shù yǐ hòu zài jué dìng shì fǒu cháng qī jì xù . wǒ méi yǒu shuō dì sān zhōu jiù yí dìng tíng zhǐ , yě méi yǒu shuō yī kāi shǐ jiù yǒng yuǎn cǎi yòng .
meaning: The plan is a six-week trial, with possible adjustments discussed in week three. Long-term continuation is decided after week six, not guaranteed at the start.

text: 电影里，姐姐把信放进包里，后来在车站又拿出来，但没有打开。妹妹问她要不要现在看，她说等回家再说。镜头随后转到开走的车。观众知道她把信带走了，却还不知道信里写了什么；下一段也没有出现读信的画面。
pinyin: diàn yǐng lǐ , jiě jie bǎ xìn fàng jìn bāo lǐ , hòu lái zài chē zhàn yòu ná chū lái , dàn méi yǒu dǎ kāi . mèi mei wèn tā yào bù yào xiàn zài kàn , tā shuō děng huí jiā zài shuō . jìng tóu suí hòu zhuǎn dào kāi zǒu de chē . guān zhòng zhī dào tā bǎ xìn dài zǒu le , què hái bù zhī dào xìn lǐ xiě le shén me ; xià yī duàn yě méi yǒu chū xiàn dú xìn de huà miàn .
meaning: In the film, the older sister puts a letter in her bag, takes it out at the station, but doesn't open it. She tells her younger sister she'll discuss it at home. The film then cuts to the departing train and never shows the letter being read.

text: 你把前一句也放回来，只听她说那就这样，会以为她已经完全同意。前面她说的是这次先试试看，下周再讨论。这里答应的是试一次，不是长期都按这个办法。
pinyin: nǐ bǎ qián yī jù yě fàng huí lái , zhǐ tīng tā shuō nà jiù zhè yàng , huì yǐ wéi tā yǐ jīng wán quán tóng yì . qián miàn tā shuō de shì zhè cì xiān shì shì kàn , xià zhōu zài tǎo lùn . zhè lǐ dā yìng de shì shì yī cì , bù shì cháng qī dōu àn zhè gè bàn fǎ .
meaning: Play the preceding line too. 'Let's do that' sounds like full agreement alone, but she first said to try it once and discuss next week. She agreed to a trial, not a permanent arrangement.

text: 只有听完后半句才能理解这次的条件
pinyin: zhǐ yǒu tīng wán hòu bàn jù cái néng lǐ jiě zhè cì de tiáo jiàn
meaning: The final qualification needs the second half heard.

text: 歌词表达的是希望，并不是已经确定的日期。
pinyin: gē cí biǎo dá de shì xī wàng , bìng bù shì yǐ jīng què dìng de rì qī .
meaning: The lyric expresses hope, not a fixed date.

text: 并不是
pinyin: bìng bù shì
meaning: Is not.

text: 自己写的歌里有一句“把下一页留到下次见面”。朋友说听起来像一种希望，而不是一个确定的日期。我们又读了活动通知，发现下次演出还没决定时间。两种文字都谈以后，却承担不同作用：歌词表达感受，通知说明实际安排。
pinyin: zì jǐ xiě de gē lǐ yǒu yī jù bǎ xià yī yè liú dào xià cì jiàn miàn . péng you shuō tīng qǐ lái xiàng yī zhǒng xī wàng , ér bù shì yī gè què dìng de rì qī . wǒ men yòu dú le huó dòng tōng zhī , fā xiàn xià cì yǎn chū hái méi jué dìng shí jiān . liǎng zhǒng wén zì dōu tán yǐ hòu , què chéng dān bù tóng zuò yòng : gē cí biǎo dá gǎn shòu , tōng zhī shuō míng shí jì ān pái .
meaning: An original lyric says, 'Leave the next page for our next meeting.' It sounds like a hope, not a fixed date. The event notice says the next performance is not yet scheduled. Both concern the future, but one expresses feeling and the other arrangements.

text: 我想听的是她为什么把那句话说得这么轻，不是要你模仿到跟演员完全一样。你可以先说自己听出来的意思，再找前后哪句支持这个理解。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng tīng de shì tā wèi shén me bǎ nà jù huà shuō de zhè me qīng , bù shì yào nǐ mó fǎng dào gēn yǎn yuán wán quán yī yàng . nǐ kě yǐ xiān shuō zì jǐ tīng chū lái de yì si , zài zhǎo qián hòu nǎ jù zhī chí zhè gè lǐ jiě .
meaning: I want to hear why you think she said the line quietly, not a perfect imitation. Explain what you understood, then find supporting surrounding lines.

text: 第一篇文章写书店晚上的活动让下班的人有地方坐，举了两位参加者的经历。第二篇是本月通知，说明周四需要提前报名，二楼借书服务仍六点结束。读者可以同时理解活动的价值和参加条件，不能因为文章说方便，就省掉通知中的要求。
pinyin: dì yī piān wén zhāng xiě shū diàn wǎn shang de huó dòng ràng xià bān de rén yǒu dì fāng zuò , jǔ le liǎng wèi cān jiā zhě de jīng lì . dì èr piān shì běn yuè tōng zhī , shuō míng zhōu sì xū yào tí qián bào míng , èr lóu jiè shū fú wù réng liù diǎn jié shù . dú zhě kě yǐ tóng shí lǐ jiě huó dòng de jià zhí hé cān jiā tiáo jiàn , bù néng yīn wèi wén zhāng shuō fāng biàn , jiù shěng diào tōng zhī zhōng de yāo qiú .
meaning: The first article describes how evening bookshop events help people after work, with two visitors' experiences. The second is a monthly notice: Thursday needs registration, and upstairs lending still ends at six.

text: 画面上的字里是先别等我，不是以后别见我。她下班晚，想让大家先吃，自己到了再点。后面还问饭店地址，这也说明她打算来。
pinyin: huà miàn shàng de zì lǐ shì xiān bié děng wǒ , bù shì yǐ hòu bié jiàn wǒ . tā xià bān wǎn , xiǎng ràng dà jiā xiān chī , zì jǐ dào le zài diǎn . hòu miàn hái wèn fàn diàn dì zhǐ , zhè yě shuō míng tā dǎ suàn lái .
meaning: The subtitle says 'Don't wait for me first', not 'Never see me again'. She's finishing late and wants others to eat first. She asks for the address and plans to come.

text: 她不是不喜欢只是还没有决定
pinyin: tā bù shì bù xǐ huān zhǐ shì hái méi yǒu jué dìng
meaning: She doesn't dislike it; she simply hasn't decided.

text: 演员练习时，第一次把一句话说得很快，第二次在“我不是不想去”以后停了一下，再接“只是今天不方便”。朋友说第二次比较容易听清楚条件在哪里。演员没有把声音变得更大，只调整了停顿。我们讨论的是表达结构，而不是给他的心情下结论。
pinyin: yǎn yuán liàn xí shí , dì yī cì bǎ yī jù huà shuō de hěn kuài , dì èr cì zài wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng qù yǐ hòu tíng le yī xià , zài jiē zhǐ shì jīn tiān bù fāng biàn . péng you shuō dì èr cì bǐ jiào róng yì tīng qīng chu tiáo jiàn zài nǎ lǐ . yǎn yuán méi yǒu bǎ shēng yīn biàn de gèng dà , zhǐ tiáo zhěng le tíng dùn . wǒ men tǎo lùn de shì biǎo dá jié gòu , ér bù shì gěi tā de xīn qíng xià jié lùn .
meaning: An actor rehearses 'It's not that I don't want to go; today just doesn't work.' The second attempt pauses after the first clause. His partner finds the qualification clearer. He changes the pause rather than volume.

text: 那段雨声不是歌词里的字。画面上的字有一行说明窗户外在下雨，但歌里唱的是回家的路。加入歌词时别把这行说明也看成要唱的句子。
pinyin: nà duàn yǔ shēng bù shì gē cí lǐ de zì . huà miàn shàng de zì yǒu yī xíng shuō míng chuāng hù wài zài xià yǔ , dàn gē lǐ chàng de shì huí jiā de lù . jiā rù gē cí shí bié bǎ zhè xíng shuō míng yě kàn chéng yào chàng de jù zi .
meaning: The rain sound isn't a lyric. A subtitle describes rain outside, while the song is about the road home. Don't include that description as a sung line.

text: 我以为画面上的字中的“她”指刚走进房间的人。重看前面两句才发现，姐姐说自己在门外等，而妹妹已经进去拿包。后一句“她把包拿出来”接着妹妹的行动。画面上的字没有重复名字，理解人物关系要把前后几句放在一起，不能只看最后一个镜头。
pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi huà miàn shàng de zì zhōng de tā zhǐ gāng zǒu jìn fáng jiān de rén . zhòng kàn qián miàn liǎng jù cái fā xiàn , jiě jie shuō zì jǐ zài mén wài děng , ér mèi mei yǐ jīng jìn qù ná bāo . hòu yī jù tā bǎ bāo ná chū lái jiē zhe mèi mei de xíng dòng . huà miàn shàng de zì méi yǒu chóng fù míng zi , lǐ jiě rén wù guān xì yào bǎ qián hòu jǐ jù fàng zài yì qǐ , bù néng zhǐ kàn zuì hòu yī gè jìng tóu .
meaning: I thought 'she' in the subtitles referred to the person just entering the room. The preceding lines explain that the older sister waited outside while the younger went in for the bag. 'She brought the bag out' continues the younger sister's action.

text: 第二句的意思要接着前面看。她先说这个办法不是不好，接着说只是现在没那么多时间。不是完全反对方法，是这次条件不够。
pinyin: dì èr jù de yì si yào jiē zhe qián miàn kàn . tā xiān shuō zhè gè bàn fǎ bù shì bù hǎo , jiē zhe shuō zhǐ shì xiàn zài méi nà me duō shí jiān . bù shì wán quán fǎn duì fāng fǎ , shì zhè cì tiáo jiàn bù gòu .
meaning: Read the second sentence with the first: 'The method isn't bad; we just don't have that much time now.' It's a limitation of current conditions, not total rejection.

text: 先把前一句听清楚再判断她答应了什么
pinyin: xiān bǎ qián yī jù tīng qīng chu zài pàn duàn tā dā yìng le shén me
meaning: Hear the preceding sentence before judging her agreement.

text: 即使声音很轻，也要听清楚具体要求。
pinyin: jí shǐ shēng yīn hěn qīng , yě yào tīng qīng chu jù tǐ yāo qiú .
meaning: Even with a gentle tone, hear the specific request.

text: 朋友评价影片“前面很平静，最后一下倒挺有力量”。我只听见“很平静”，以为她觉得无聊。她让我再听后半句，才知道她在比较前后变化。她没有说每一段都喜欢，也没说整部都讨厌。我们的误解来自少听了一部分。
pinyin: péng you píng jià yǐng piàn qián miàn hěn píng jìng , zuì hòu yī xià dào tǐng yǒu lì liàng . wǒ zhǐ tīng jiàn hěn píng jìng , yǐ wéi tā jué de wú liáo . tā ràng wǒ zài tīng hòu bàn jù , cái zhī dào tā zài bǐ jiào qián hòu biàn huà . tā méi yǒu shuō měi yī duàn dōu xǐ huān , yě méi shuō zhěng bù dōu tǎo yàn . wǒ men de wù jiě lái zì shǎo tīng le yī bù fèn .
meaning: My friend calls the film quiet early on but powerful at the end. I hear only 'quiet' and assume boredom. The second half reveals a contrast, not total praise or total dislike.

text: 我看见信在桌子上，但没看见是谁放的。下一段姐姐说早上放过一本书，不能因此把信也算成她放的。我们先把两件东西分清楚。
pinyin: wǒ kàn jiàn xìn zài zhuō zi shàng , dàn méi kàn jiàn shì shéi fàng de . xià yī duàn jiě jie shuō zǎo shàng fàng guò yī běn shū , bù néng yīn cǐ bǎ xìn yě suàn chéng tā fàng de . wǒ men xiān bǎ liǎng jiàn dōng xi fēn qīng chu .
meaning: I saw a letter on the table but not who put it there. The sister later says she left a book in the morning. That doesn't establish who placed the letter.

text: 我们练一首自己写的短歌。我们唱的时候第二个字要拉长，按照音乐进入下一拍。老师让我们再读一遍普通说话的版本，再比较哪部分只是音乐安排。她鼓励跟着唱，但没有把唱歌的快慢看成日常说话速度，也没有说唱得像就表示所有说话读法都准确。
pinyin: wǒ men liàn yī shǒu zì jǐ xiě de duǎn gē . wǒ men chàng de shí hou dì èr gè zì yào lā cháng , àn zhào yīn yuè jìn rù xià yī pāi . lǎo shī ràng wǒ men zài dú yī biàn pǔ tōng shuō huà de bǎn běn , zài bǐ jiào nǎ bù fèn zhǐ shì yīn yuè ān pái . tā gǔ lì gēn zhe chàng , dàn méi yǒu bǎ chàng gē de kuài màn kàn chéng rì cháng shuō huà sù dù , yě méi yǒu shuō chàng de xiàng jiù biǎo shì suǒ yǒu shuō huà dú fǎ dōu zhǔn què .
meaning: We practise an original short song whose second syllable is lengthened for the melody. The teacher also has us read the spoken version and compare. Singing is encouraged, but musical timing isn't treated as everyday speech or proof of perfect pronunciation.

text: 笑着说不代表什么都可以接受。她那句笑着说的别再拿这件事开玩笑，后面还说自己真的不喜欢。我们听见明确要求，就该停止，不用把笑看成可以继续。
pinyin: xiào zhe shuō bù dài biǎo shén me dōu kě yǐ jiē shòu . tā nà jù xiào zhe shuō de bié zài ná zhè jiàn shì kāi wán xiào , hòu miàn hái shuō zì jǐ zhēn de bù xǐ huān . wǒ men tīng jiàn míng què yāo qiú , jiù gāi tíng zhǐ , bù yòng bǎ xiào kàn chéng kě yǐ jì xù .
meaning: Smiling doesn't mean accepting everything. She smiled while saying not to joke about this again, then said she really disliked it. The explicit request is to stop.

text: 短的戏里的朋友晚到二十分钟，进门时别人笑着说“你来得真早”。他随后说对不起，对方说下次早点就好，没有继续批评。画面上的字只写了那句字面的话，画面和后面的交流才让人知道是在开玩笑。只按早这个字判断，就会错过这层意思。
pinyin: duǎn de xì lǐ de péng you wǎn dào èr shí fēn zhōng , jìn mén shí bié ren xiào zhe shuō nǐ lái de zhēn zǎo . tā suí hòu shuō duì bù qǐ , duì fāng shuō xià cì zǎo diǎn jiù hǎo , méi yǒu jì xù pī píng . huà miàn shàng de zì zhǐ xiě le nà jù zì miàn de huà , huà miàn hé hòu miàn de jiāo liú cái ràng rén zhī dào shì zài kāi wán xiào . zhǐ àn zǎo zhè gè zì pàn duàn , jiù huì cuò guò zhè céng yì si .
meaning: A friend arrives twenty minutes late in an original short play. Another smiles, 'You're really early.' After an apology, they ask for an earlier arrival next time. The scene establishes teasing even though the subtitle gives literal words.

text: 你刚才跟唱的快慢很好。说话版本我们另外练，这两个记录分开保存。今天这一遍我只记跟上了音乐，不会把没有检查的说话说话读法也写成完全正确。
pinyin: nǐ gāng cái gēn chàng de kuài màn hěn hǎo . shuō huà bǎn běn wǒ men lìng wài liàn , zhè liǎng gè jì lù fēn kāi bǎo cún . jīn tiān zhè yī biàn wǒ zhǐ jì gēn shàng le yīn yuè , bù huì bǎ méi yǒu jiǎn chá de shuō huà shuō huà dú fǎ yě xiě chéng wán quán zhèng què .
meaning: You followed the singing rhythm well. We'll practise and record ordinary speech separately. Today's result records musical timing, not unchecked spoken pronunciation.

text: 两位观众谈这个最后一段。甲觉得关灯代表离开，乙觉得人物留下一个小灯，是仍想再见。两人都指出了画面中的细节，也承认最后没有直接说明。讨论时他们比较各自依据，没有要求每个人必须同意一种感受。
pinyin: liǎng wèi guān zhòng tán zhè gè zuì hòu yī duàn . jiǎ jué de guān dēng dài biǎo lí kāi , yǐ jué de rén wù liú xià yī gè xiǎo dēng , shì réng xiǎng zài jiàn . liǎng rén dōu zhǐ chū le huà miàn zhōng de xì jié , yě chéng rèn zuì hòu méi yǒu zhí jiē shuō míng . tǎo lùn shí tā men bǐ jiào gè zì yī jù , méi yǒu yāo qiú měi gè rén bì xū tóng yì yī zhǒng gǎn shòu .
meaning: Two viewers discuss an ending: one reads switching lights off as departure; the other sees a remaining lamp as hope of meeting again. Both cite details and acknowledge that the film gives no explicit explanation.

text: 先看通知，再听歌。歌里说灯一直亮，实际场地十点关闭，九点半开始收东西。想多唱一首的话，要算上准备和整理的时间，不能只加唱的三分钟。
pinyin: xiān kàn tōng zhī , zài tīng gē . gē lǐ shuō dēng yì zhí liàng , shí jì chǎng dì shí diǎn guān bì , jiǔ diǎn bàn kāi shǐ shōu dōng xi . xiǎng duō chàng yī shǒu de huà , yào suàn shàng zhǔn bèi hé zhěng lǐ de shí jiān , bù néng zhǐ jiā chàng de sān fēn zhōng .
meaning: Read the notice before the song. The lyric says the light stays on, but the venue closes at ten and packing starts at 9:30. An extra song also needs preparation and packing, not just three minutes of singing.

text: 她虽然笑着说，要求却很明确。
pinyin: tā suī rán xiào zhe shuō , yāo qiú què hěn míng què .
meaning: Although she said it smiling, her request was clear.

text: 我把一段很快的对话分成两句练。第一次看着画面上的字，第二次把画面上的字关掉，只听声音。第二次听错了日期，我回到声音再听，没有把第一次有帮助时的成功记成第二次也听懂。最后一次没看字能答对，才把那次单独保存。
pinyin: wǒ bǎ yī duàn hěn kuài de duì huà fēn chéng liǎng jù liàn . dì yī cì kàn zhe huà miàn shàng de zì , dì èr cì bǎ huà miàn shàng de zì guān diào , zhǐ tīng shēng yīn . dì èr cì tīng cuò le rì qī , wǒ huí dào shēng yīn zài tīng , méi yǒu bǎ dì yī cì yǒu bāng zhù shí de chéng gōng jì chéng dì èr cì yě tīng dǒng . zuì hòu yī cì méi kàn zì néng dá duì , cái bǎ nà cì dān dú bǎo cún .
meaning: I practise fast dialogue in two parts, first with subtitles and then without. I miss the date without subtitles, listen again, and keep the attempts separate. I save the later correct attempt without text help as its own result.

text: 这次讨论先说故事里发生的事，再说自己的感觉。两种都可以说，但别把我觉得她舍不得直接改成影片已经明确这样解释。可以有依据，也可以保留不确定的地方。
pinyin: zhè cì tǎo lùn xiān shuō gù shì lǐ fā shēng de shì , zài shuō zì jǐ de gǎn jué . liǎng zhǒng dōu kě yǐ shuō , dàn bié bǎ wǒ jué de tā shě bù de zhí jiē gǎi chéng yǐng piàn yǐ jīng míng què zhè yàng jiě shì . kě yǐ yǒu yī jù , yě kě yǐ bǎo liú bù què dìng de dì fāng .
meaning: First discuss what happens in the story, then your feelings. Both are welcome, but 'I think she's reluctant' isn't the same as an explicit explanation in the film. Use evidence and keep uncertainty where appropriate.

text: 周五朋友借走蓝袋，周六上午还回来时里面是空的。下午我把五页材料放进去，交给楼上的同学。后来同学在楼里找到第四页，另外四页仍在袋里。有人听说蓝袋以前放过地下室，就建议去地下室找。我把这些时间重新列出来，发现那是更早的使用记录，与这次缺页没有直接关系。
pinyin: zhōu wǔ péng you jiè zǒu lán dài , zhōu liù shàng wǔ huán huí lái shí lǐ miàn shì kōng de . xià wǔ wǒ bǎ wǔ yè cái liào fàng jìn qù , jiāo gěi lóu shàng de tóng xué . hòu lái tóng xué zài lóu lǐ zhǎo dào dì sì yè , lìng wài sì yè réng zài dài lǐ . yǒu rén tīng shuō lán dài yǐ qián fàng guò dì xià shì , jiù jiàn yì qù dì xià shì zhǎo . wǒ bǎ zhè xiē shí jiān chóng xīn liè chū lái , fā xiàn nà shì gèng zǎo de shǐ yòng jì lù , yǔ zhè cì quē yè méi yǒu zhí jiē guān xì .
meaning: A friend borrowed the blue bag on Friday and returned it empty Saturday morning. I later put five pages inside and passed it upstairs. Page four was found in the corridor; the others remained in the bag. An earlier use in the basement doesn't belong to this missing-page sequence.

text: 你问我为什么没说话，我可以解释。不过先别替我说成同意或反对。我当时还没听懂新的时间，想等她把后面说完。后来我已经发了一个具体问题，等回复以后再决定。
